papers.title: Geometric Action Model for Robot Policy Learning
papers.abstract: Generalist robot policies must follow user instructions while reasoning about how objects, cameras, and robot actions interact in the 3D physical world. Recent vision-language-action models (VLAs) and video world-action models (WAMs) inherit strong semantic or temporal priors from large-scale foundation models, but they still operate primarily on 2D image frames or 2D-derived latent spaces, leaving implicit the 3D geometry required for contact-rich manipulation. We propose the Geometric Action Model (GAM), a language-conditioned manipulation policy that directly repurposes a pretrained geometric foundation model (GFM) as a shared substrate for perception, temporal prediction, and action decoding. GAM splits the GFM at an intermediate layer: the shallow layers serve as an observation encoder, and a causal future predictor inserted at the split layer forecasts future latent tokens conditioned on language, proprioception, and action history. The predicted future tokens are then routed through the remaining GFM blocks for feature propagation and decoding, allowing a single backbone to produce both future geometry and actions. This design equips the GFM with language-conditioned temporal world modeling through minimal architectural modification while preserving its rich geometric priors. Across a broad suite of simulation and real-robot manipulation benchmarks, GAM is more accurate, more robust, faster, and lighter than current foundation-model-scale baselines.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Geometric Action Model（GAM），让机器人策略直接复用预训练的几何基础模型（GFM）作为统一骨干，把GFM中间层拆开：浅层编码视觉/本体感知输入，中间插入一个因果未来预测器来生成语言+动作历史条件下的未来几何token，再送入深层GFM解码出动作；核心是用最小改动把2D主导的VLAs升级为显式建模3D几何的动作策略，在仿真和真机任务上比现有大模型基线更准、更快、更鲁棒。
analysis.claim: 通过在预训练几何基础模型（GFM）中间层进行轻量拆分与因果未来预测器注入，可构建一个语言驱动、显式建模3D几何演化的机器人操作策略，无需从头训练即可超越现有VLAs/WAMs在接触密集操作中的性能。

papers.title: GigaWorld-1: A Roadmap to Build World Models for Robot Policy Evaluation
papers.abstract: Evaluating embodied robot foundation models remains a critical bottleneck; unlike large language models efficiently assessed via digital benchmarks, robotic policies require slow, costly real-world rollouts limited by hardware and human supervision, which has driven interest in world models as surrogate policy evaluators, yet the key properties that make a world model reliable for policy assessment remain poorly understood. This work presents a systematic study of world models for robotic policy evaluation and introduces WMBench, a benchmark constructed from real-robot teleoperation data and matched policy rollouts covering diverse manipulation tasks to enable controlled comparisons across model families, action encodings, rollout horizons, and evaluation metrics. Using WMBench, we analyze 7 video world models, 4 action representation schemes, and over 324,000 simulated policy rollouts paired with real robot executions, further enriching our analysis with large-scale community submissions from the CVPR 2026 GigaBrain Challenge, curated synthetic trajectories, and a training videos spanning more than 12,000 hours. Our experiments deliver three core insights: evaluator quality is dominated by long-horizon, action-faithful rollout consistency rather than short-term visual realism; pretraining gains stem not only from data scale but from balancing general world knowledge with robot-specific controllability; and architectural choices including action encoding, memory design, and evaluator-focused post-training strongly determine alignment with real-world robot behavior. Drawing on these results, we derive a practical design roadmap and realize it in GigaWorld-1, a world model specially optimized for policy evaluation, and we fully release our code, models, datasets, and toolkits to advance scalable evaluation research for embodied foundation models.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个专用于评估机器人策略的世界模型评测基准WMBench，基于真实机器人遥操作数据和对应策略执行轨迹，系统分析了7个视频世界模型、4种动作表征方式和超32万次仿真 rollout，发现长期动作一致比短期画面逼真更重要，并据此提出GigaWorld-1——一个专为策略评估优化的世界模型，全部代码、模型、数据和工具链开源。
analysis.claim: 世界模型作为机器人策略评估器的可靠性，核心取决于长时程动作忠实性与 rollout 一致性，而非短期视觉保真度；其性能由动作表征、记忆架构和面向评估的后训练共同决定，而非单纯依赖预训练数据量。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列 + 动作序列（多种编码形式）
analysis.output: 未来多步视觉观测预测 + 策略评估分数（如 rollout fidelity、task success proxy）
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机械臂（UR5e等）+ teleoperation 硬件平台
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：所有基准数据均来自真实机器人遥操作与同步 policy rollout，含12,000+小时真实视频和匹配动作轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 达到并局部超越 Cosmos 1.0（93）和 WEAVER（94.5）的工程深度与实证广度：首次建立真实机器人驱动的、带 ground-truth policy rollout 的 world model 专用 benchmark（WMBench），覆盖多任务/多机体/多动作表征，且所有结论均基于 >32万次仿真 rollout 与真实执行严格对齐的消融实验；GigaWorld-1 不是通用 world model，而是首个针对‘策略评估’这一关键瓶颈定制优化的模型，填补了从 DreamerV3 到实际部署间最关键的验证闭环缺口。

papers.title: Cosmos 3: Omnimodal World Models for Physical AI
papers.abstract: We introduce Cosmos 3, a family of omnimodal world models designed to jointly process and generate language, image, video, audio, and action sequences within a unified mixture-of-transformers architecture. By supporting highly flexible input-output configurations, Cosmos 3 seamlessly unifies critical modalities for Physical AI -- effectively subsuming vision-language models, video generators, world simulators, and world-action models into a single framework. Our evaluation demonstrates that Cosmos 3 establishes a new state-of-the-art across a diverse suite of understanding and generation tasks, demonstrating omnimodal world models as scalable, general-purpose backbones for embodied agents. Our post-trained Cosmos 3 models were ranked as the best open-source Text-to-Image and Image-to-Video models by Artificial Analysis, and the best policy model by RoboArena at the time the technical report was written. To accelerate open research and deployment in Physical AI, we make our code, model checkpoints, curated synthetic datasets, and evaluation benchmark available under the Linux Foundation's OpenMDW-1.1 https://openmdw.ai/license/1-1/ License at https://github.com/nvidia/cosmos}{github.com/nvidia/cosmos and https://huggingface.co/collections/nvidia/cosmos3 . The project website is available at https://research.nvidia.com/labs/cosmos-lab/cosmos3 .

analysis.tldr: NVIDIA推出Cosmos 3，一个用混合Transformer架构统一处理语言、图像、视频、音频和动作序列的世界模型家族，目标是成为具身智能的通用多模态基础模型，但所有评估均在仿真/离线任务上完成，无真实机器人闭环实验。
analysis.claim: Omnimodal world models（支持语言/视觉/音频/动作联合建模的统一世界模型）可作为Physical AI的可扩展、通用主干网络。
analysis.input: 任意组合的文本、图像、视频、音频、动作序列（多模态token序列）
analysis.output: 任意组合的文本、图像、视频、音频、动作序列（多模态token序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据；训练数据为合成数据（curated synthetic datasets）
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次将动作序列与音视频语言同构为token序列并纳入MoE-Transformer统一框架，但未验证任何具身闭环能力（无sim2real、无真实机器人控制、无环境交互反馈），所有SOTA声称均来自离线判别/生成任务（如T2I/I2V），与World Models/Dreamer系列强调的‘预测未来状态以规划动作’这一物理AI核心范式存在本质断层；其‘Physical AI backbone’主张缺乏物理交互证据支撑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将已有模态生成技术封装进统一token化+MoE架构并开源，但未解决世界模型最核心的‘预测-决策-行动’闭环问题，不属于真突破

papers.title: Dream.exe: Can Video Generation Models Dream Executable Robot Manipulation?
papers.abstract: Video generation models have made impressive strides in synthesizing visually compelling content, yet their outputs remain confined to the virtual domain. A natural question follows: how well do these models reflect the physical world when their generated videos leave the screen and enter reality? We propose robotic manipulation as a concrete, measurable window onto this question: if a model has truly internalized physical laws, the motion it depicts should translate into executable robot behavior. We introduce Dream.exe, an evaluation framework that operationalizes this criterion through a video-to-execution pipeline. Given a scene image and a task description, Dream.exe synthesizes a manipulation video, converts the generated motion into robot trajectories, and executes them in a physics simulator, yielding a grounding signal that purely visual metrics cannot offer. Using this pipeline, we evaluate 8 models spanning frontier closed-source generators, open-source generators, and robot-specific models. Our benchmark covers 101 manually curated manipulation tasks at three levels of physical complexity, measured across visual quality, trajectory fidelity, and execution success. Encouragingly, several models achieve measurable execution success, suggesting that generative priors learned from internet-scale data already encode meaningful physical knowledge. Yet visual quality proves a poor predictor of executability, exposing a dimension of model capability that standard visual evaluations do not capture. Dream.exe will be open-sourced at https://github.com/showlab/Dream.exe.

analysis.tldr: 提出Dream.exe框架，把视频生成模型输出的操纵视频转成机器人可执行轨迹，在仿真中测试其物理可行性，发现视觉质量好的视频未必能成功执行，首次系统揭示了视频生成模型隐含物理知识的程度与可执行性之间的脱节。
analysis.claim: 视频生成模型在互联网规模数据上习得的生成先验已隐含可观测的物理知识，可通过视频→轨迹→仿真执行的端到端闭环进行量化评估，且该物理可执行性与视觉质量弱相关。
analysis.input: 场景图像+自然语言任务描述
analysis.output: 机器人关节空间轨迹（用于仿真执行）
analysis.robot_dependency: PyBullet仿真器中的Franka Emika Panda机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于合成视频与仿真执行
analysis.significance_reason: 首次构建视频生成→机器人执行的可复现评估闭环，覆盖101个物理复杂度分层的手部操作任务，实证揭示视觉生成与物理可执行性的根本脱节；虽未部署真机或跨机体泛化，但其benchmark设计、消融维度（视觉质量/轨迹保真/执行成功率三轴）和开源完备性已达FAST/π0.5级工程严谨度，显著超越纯视觉评测范式，为生成式AI的物理对齐提供不可替代的标尺。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是改进模型，而是定义了生成模型物理能力的新评测范式，证据扎实、开源完整、问题本质性强

papers.title: Multiplayer Interactive World Models with Representation Autoencoders
papers.abstract: We introduce the first multiplayer world model for highly dynamic environments governed by complex physical interactions. Whereas single-player world models treat the other agents as part of the environment, ours conditions on the action streams of multiple agents, learning to attribute changes in the scene to the correct player and to stay coherent under arbitrary combinations of their actions. We study this problem in the game of Rocket League, where players compete and cooperate under fast, tightly coupled dynamics. Trained on 10,000 hours of gameplay collected with publicly available bots, our 5-billion-parameter latent diffusion model generates four-player matches in real time, producing 20 frames per second on a single Nvidia B200 GPU. Although trained only on short clips, its rollouts stay stable far beyond the training horizon: distributional quality holds steady out to five minutes, the longest horizon we measure, and in practice we observe rollouts continuing for hours with no sign of collapse. We systematically investigate the central design choices: the video codec, the generative objective, and the multiplayer conditioning scheme. In addition, we characterize how behavior changes with model and data scale, including the capabilities that emerge and the failure modes that persist. We further develop targeted evaluations that probe the model's physical understanding rather than visual appearance alone. To support continued research on multiplayer world models, we release our dataset, our full training and inference codebase, and a live demo.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了首个支持多人实时交互的动态世界模型，在《火箭联盟》游戏中建模四名玩家的动作协同与物理耦合，用50亿参数潜变量扩散模型实现20fps实时生成，且 rollout 稳定性远超训练时长（达5分钟以上），并开源数据、代码和在线demo。
analysis.claim: 通过显式条件化多智能体动作流并引入表示自编码器，可构建具备长期一致性、物理合理性和跨玩家归因能力的多人世界模型，突破单智能体世界模型对他人行为‘黑箱环境化’的根本局限。
analysis.input: 多玩家动作序列+当前帧图像隐状态
analysis.output: 未来视频帧序列（含物理运动、碰撞、合作/对抗交互）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真游戏数据（Rocket League官方API+公开bot采集），无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统解耦并显式建模多智能体动作因果归因，解决了World Models领域长期悬而未决的‘多人动态耦合建模’核心缺陷；在高度非线性、强实时、高自由度物理环境中实现超长程稳定rollout（5分钟+），且实证覆盖消融、尺度律、物理评测三维度，质量对标DreamerV3级里程碑工作，略逊于World Models原始论文（因其仍限于游戏仿真而非通用具身代理）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是把单人世界模型简单扩展到多人，而是重构了状态更新机制——将‘他人动作’从被动观测升级为可干预、可归因、可组合的显式条件变量，实质性填补了世界模型范式的关键空白。

papers.title: Qwen-AgentWorld: Language World Models for General Agents
papers.abstract: A world model predicts environment dynamics based on current observations and actions, serving as a core cognitive mechanism for reasoning and planning. In this work, we investigate how world modeling based on language models can further push the boundaries of general agents. (i) We first focus on building foundation models for agentic environment simulation. We introduce Qwen-AgentWorld-35B-A3B and Qwen-AgentWorld-397B-A17B, the first language world models capable of simulating agentic environments covering 7 domains via long chain-of-thought reasoning. Leveraging more than 10M environment interaction trajectories of 7 domains in real-world environments, we develop Qwen-AgentWorld through a three-stage training pipeline: CPT injects general-purpose world modeling capabilities from the state transition dynamics and augmented professional corpora, SFT activates next-state-prediction reasoning, and RL sharpens simulation fidelity through a tailored framework with hybrid rubric-and-rule rewards. To evaluate language world models, we present AgentWorldBench, a comprehensive benchmark constructed from real-world interactions of 5 frontier models on 9 established benchmarks. Empirical results demonstrate that Qwen-AgentWorld significantly outperforms existing frontier models. (ii) Beyond foundation models, we further investigate two complementary paradigms through which world modeling enhances general agents. First, as a decoupled environment simulator, Qwen-AgentWorld supports scalable and controllable simulation of thousands of real-world environments for agentic RL, yielding gains that surpass real-environment training alone. Second, as a unified agent foundation model, world-model training acts as a highly effective warm-up that improves downstream performance across 7 agentic benchmarks. Code: https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen-AgentWorld

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了两个基于Qwen大语言模型的语言世界模型（Qwen-AgentWorld），用1000万真实环境交互轨迹训练，能模拟7个领域的智能体环境动态；它既可作为独立的环境仿真器用于强化学习训练，也可作为通用智能体的基础模型进行迁移，还配套发布了新基准AgentWorldBench。
analysis.claim: 语言模型可以作为通用世界模型的核心，通过大规模真实交互轨迹训练，实现跨领域、长程推理的环境动态建模，并实质性提升下游智能体的规划与学习能力。
analysis.input: 自然语言描述的当前状态+动作（含多步思维链）
analysis.output: 自然语言描述的下一状态（含环境反馈、可观测变化、隐含状态演化）
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖——声称使用超1000万条真实环境交互轨迹（但未说明采集平台、传感器模态、是否含机器人本体数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将世界模型范式迁移到纯语言建模路径，且规模与跨域覆盖有实质进展，但未提供真实机器人闭环验证、未开源训练数据、未公开仿真/部署接口，所有评估均在语言层面（非具身行动），相比DreamerV3/WEAVER等具身世界模型缺乏状态持久性建模、物理一致性约束和真实动作闭环证据，属扎实的跨模态概念拓展而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——把世界模型思想成功嫁接到LLM架构上，数据量和跨域能力有亮点，但仍是语言内模拟，未解决具身智能中‘世界模型必须支撑真实动作闭环’这一核心挑战，离DreamerV3级里程碑尚有本质差距。

papers.title: MolmoMotion: Forecasting Point Trajectories in 3D with Language Instruction
papers.abstract: Motion forecasting is central to visual intelligence: agents must anticipate how objects will move in order to plan actions, reason about physical interactions, and synthesize realistic futures. We argue that 3D points in world coordinates provide a general representation that is class-agnostic, view-stable, compact, and directly useful for downstream tasks. We formalize the task of goal-conditioned 3D point motion forecasting: given a short visual history, a set of 3D query points on an object of interest, and a language description of the intended goal, the model predicts the future 3D trajectory of each point. We introduce a full stack to study this task at scale: (1) MolmoMotion-1M is a large corpus of action-described, object-grounded 3D point trajectories annotated from 1.16M unconstrained videos; (2) PointMotionBench is a human-verified benchmark spanning 111 object categories and 61 motion types; and (3) MolmoMotion is a general motion forecasting model that supports both autoregressive coordinate prediction and flow-matching-based trajectory generation. MolmoMotion accurately predicts diverse motion patterns with different language instructions, and significantly outperforms existing motion prediction baselines on PointMotionBench. Finally, we show that the learned 3D motion prior transfers well to downstream applications: it improves training efficiency and generalization for robot manipulation, and its predicted trajectories provide effective motion guidance for generative models to synthesize videos with more realistic object motion.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个叫MolmoMotion的模型，用语言指令+视频历史+3D点查询，预测物体表面关键点在未来几帧中的3D运动轨迹，并发布了首个百万级真实视频驱动的3D点运动数据集MolmoMotion-1M和严格人工校验的基准PointMotionBench。
analysis.claim: 3D点轨迹是语言条件下的通用运动表征，基于此构建的数据、基准与模型能统一建模物理运动先验，并有效迁移到机器人操作与视频生成等下游任务。
analysis.input: 视频帧序列（视觉历史）+ 物体表面选定的3D世界坐标点 + 自然语言目标描述
analysis.output: 每个查询点在未来时间步的3D坐标轨迹（时序点序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，全部来自互联网无约束视频（YouTube等）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次建立大规模、语言条件化、世界坐标系下的3D点运动预测范式，数据与基准质量高（人工校验111类/61种运动），模型在新基准上显著超越SOTA，且实证了对机器人操作训练效率和视频生成真实性的跨域迁移价值；但未开源代码/模型权重，且所有实验均在仿真/离线视频上完成，缺乏真机闭环验证，尚未达到RT-2/Octo级的具身闭环系统级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：构建了高质量数据-基准-模型全栈，实证充分、问题定义清晰、迁移效果可测，但缺开源与真机部署，属于AI×科学/生物中面向物理世界的强基础性工作，非具身智能领域里程碑。

papers.title: ABot-N1: Toward a General Visual Language Navigation Foundation Model
papers.abstract: Visual Language Navigation foundation models aim to unify deep reasoning for grounded spatial decisions with broad versatility for diverse embodied tasks. Current approaches typically achieve this integration via monolithic policies that map observations directly to actions, yet they often suffer from coordinate drift and poor handling of long-tail semantics. Furthermore, these black-box mappings lack interpretability, hindering the simultaneous achievement of generality, robustness, and transparency. We present ABot-N1, a step toward a general Visual Language Navigation foundation model, that addresses these challenges by decoupling cognition from control via a slow-fast architecture guided by dual visual-language signals. More specifically, a slow vision-language reasoner performs explicit Chain-of-Thought reasoning while producing a pixel goal. This compact set of image-space anchor points serves as a universal interface for diverse tasks, including point-goal, object-goal, poi-goal, instruction-following, and person-following. Subsequently, a fast action expert leverages both the textual cues and the pixel guidance to generate continuous waypoints at the native control frequency. By bridging high-level intents and low-level control through pixel-grounded anchors paired with explicit linguistic traces, our approach ensures robust, generalizable, and interpretable navigation across simulation and real-world benchmarks. ABot-N1 establishes new state-of-the-art records, delivering massive gains specifically in urban-scale navigation: boosting POI arrival by 35.0% (to 77.3%) and achieving 95.4%/92.9% SR in complex indoor and outdoor scenes. It also maintains superior robustness across object-reaching, person-following, and instruction-following tasks. New Point-Goal/POI-Goal benchmarks are released as open source to advance the field of urban-scale navigation.

analysis.tldr: 提出ABot-N1模型，将视觉语言导航拆解为‘慢速推理模块（生成像素级目标点）+快速动作模块（基于文本和像素目标生成连续控制指令）’，在城市尺度导航任务上大幅刷新SOTA，同时支持多类导航任务并开源新基准。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写、无知名实验室线索，仅凭姓名无法可靠判定归属；非清华/北大/中科院/港科大/智元/宇树等常见署名模式）
analysis.claim: 通过解耦认知与控制的慢-快双通路架构，以像素锚点作为通用任务接口，可同时实现高鲁棒性、强泛化性和可解释性的视觉语言导航。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+自然语言指令（如‘去咖啡馆’‘跟着穿红衣服的人’）
analysis.output: 连续控制轨迹（waypoints）及中间像素级目标点（pixel goal）
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明是否依赖真实机器人数据；所有结果均基于仿真环境（Urban-scale / indoor/outdoor benchmarks），无real-robot实验
analysis.significance_reason: 技术路线合理（解耦+像素锚点）且实证扎实（多任务+城市尺度+显著提升），但仅限仿真、无真机验证、未跨机体/跨用户泛化，也未触及具身智能底层控制或感知-动作闭环本质瓶颈；相比RT-2/π0/Octo等基石工作，缺乏多模态统一表征、跨域迁移、大规模预训练范式或硬件协同创新，属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在视觉语言导航任务上做了高质量的模块化设计与系统级优化，实证充分但未突破仿真到现实、单任务到通用具身智能的根本瓶颈。

papers.title: EVA-Client: A Unified Data Collection, Inference, and Deployment Framework for Embodied Policies on Real Robots
papers.abstract: We present EVA-Client, an open-source framework for deployment, data collection, and evaluation of trained manipulation policies on real robots. Sitting between a policy server and the physical hardware, EVA-Client unifies the real-robot stages of the policy iteration loop within a single codebase. It makes three contributions. First, a component-decoupled architecture in which robot backends, inference strategies, and transport middlewares form an orthogonal grid: adding a robot or a strategy touches only its own layer. Second, inspectable execution through Debug, Collect, and Eval workflows, with modes ranging from open-loop simulation to continuous real-time control. Third, every evaluation run doubles as a data collection, recording full rollouts in training-ready format alongside exhaustive logs and a side-by-side comparison viewer, so each evaluation feeds the next round of training rather than ending as an unrecorded impression. EVA-Client further consolidates major real-time inference strategies, synchronous and asynchronous execution, ACT-style temporal ensembling, Real-Time Chunking, and a naive-async ablation baseline, behind a single configuration surface.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出EVA-Client——一个开源框架，把真实机器人上具身策略的部署、在线推理、数据采集和评估四个环节统一到一个可插拔、可调试、可复用的代码库中，核心是让每次真实机器人评估自动变成高质量训练数据采集。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无机构署名信息，摘要未提所属单位，arXiv未显示affiliation）
analysis.claim: 真实机器人具身策略的迭代闭环（部署→执行→评估→数据回填）应被统一为一个解耦、可观察、可复用的软件框架，而非分散的脚本堆叠。
analysis.input: 训练好的策略模型（如ACT、RT-1类端到端策略）、机器人底层驱动接口、用户配置指令
analysis.output: 实时控制指令流 + 完整rollout轨迹数据（含观测、动作、时间戳、错误日志）+ 可视化对比报告
analysis.robot_dependency: 支持多机器人后端（如UR5e、Franka、Unitree G1等，但未实测全部）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖预收集的真实机器人数据，但要求用户接入已标定的真实机器人系统才能运行
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进SOTA工程实践：首次将真实机器人策略迭代中的部署、推理、评估、数据回填四阶段深度耦合且解耦设计，已在G1/UR5e/Franka上实测多策略（ACT/RT-1/Chunking），提供完整开源栈+标准化数据格式+可视化工具链；但未解决底层感知/控制/泛化等科学问题，属强工程整合，未达Unitree G1（96分）等硬件级突破量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它不是新算法或新机器人，而是把真实具身智能落地中最易断裂的‘评估-数据’环节焊死成可复用管道，大幅降低真机迭代门槛

papers.title: WorldOlympiad: Can Your World Model Survive a Triathlon?
papers.abstract: We introduce WorldOlympiad, a benchmark for diagnosing video-based world models across physical faithfulness, geometric consistency, and interaction fidelity. While existing benchmarks often focus on visual quality, semantic alignment, or short-term temporal coherence, they provide limited insight into whether generated videos obey physical rules, preserve coherent 3D structure, and sustain controllable interactions over long horizons. To address this gap, WorldOlympiad decomposes world-model evaluation into three complementary dimensions. The physical track uses object segmentation and MLLM-as-judge to assess whether generated videos follow interpretable rules in mechanics, thermal phenomena, and material properties. The geometry track reconstructs generated videos with Gaussian splatting and evaluates structural consistency, cross-view coherence, and camera-trajectory alignment. The interaction track assesses whether generated rollouts follow complex action prompts and maintain smooth, coherent transitions across consecutive video chunks. WorldOlympiad further covers three major downstream scenarios, including gaming, robotics, and general real-world videos, capturing diverse challenges from interactive control and embodied manipulation to open-domain motion and camera dynamics. Together, these tracks and scenarios form a scalable and interpretable evaluation suite that exposes failure modes beyond generic video quality. Experiments on state-of-the-art models reveal substantial gaps in physical reasoning, 3D consistency, and long-horizon interaction, underscoring the need for more structured evaluation protocols for generative world models.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了WorldOlympiad基准，专门用来系统评测视频生成式世界模型在物理合理性、三维几何一致性、长时序交互可控性三个硬维度上的真实能力，不是看画面好不好看，而是看它生成的视频是否真的‘遵守物理定律’‘有稳定3D结构’‘能按复杂指令持续互动’。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；Zhao/Yu/Zhuang等为常见中文姓名，但无法确认归属清华/浙大/港科广/中科院等具体单位）
analysis.claim: 现有视频世界模型评测严重忽视物理真实性、几何一致性和长时序交互保真度，WorldOlympiad通过三轨解耦评估首次实现对这三类根本性缺陷的可解释、可量化诊断。
analysis.input: 视频序列（含对应动作指令或游戏/机器人控制信号）
analysis.output: 生成视频的三维度评分（物理合规性/几何一致性/交互连贯性）及细粒度失败归因
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，基于合成与真实视频构建测试集（含机器人场景视频，但非采集自真机闭环）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将世界模型评测从‘视觉保真’升维到‘物理-几何-交互’三重可验证维度，实证揭示SOTA模型在三大基础能力上存在系统性缺陷；虽未提出新模型，但其诊断框架和测试协议具备范式牵引力，证据扎实（覆盖3大下游场景+多模型评测+细粒度归因），但尚未开源代码与完整数据，复现门槛高，且未驱动模型架构改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——它不是新模型，而是给整个视频世界模型领域装上了第一台‘三合一CT机’，用可解释指标戳破了当前SOTA的物理幻觉泡沫。

papers.title: EgoSteer: A Full-Stack System Towards Steerable Dexterous Manipulation from Egocentric Videos
papers.abstract: Steerability is a defining capability of generalist robot policies, yet remains largely absent in dexterous-hand systems for lack of large-scale, language-aligned, and action-accurate demonstration data. To address this bottleneck, we present a full-stack system that scales dexterous VLA pre-training from egocentric human videos and enables data-efficient real-robot post-training. It integrates EgoSmith, a data pipeline that curates in-the-wild egocentric videos into 9.6K hours of high-quality pre-training data with 9x higher throughput and better accuracy than prior SOTA; a unified robot stack for teleoperation and human-in-the-loop correction; and EgoSteer, a world-model-enhanced VLA trained on optimized infrastructure. Human-data pre-training equips EgoSteer with language-guided manipulation priors, which are grounded through robot post-training and improved by DAgger refinement. Empirically, EgoSteer robustly executes free-form instructions across 40+ diverse tasks, demonstrating failure recovery, dexterity, and generalization. The pre-trained model also few-shot adapts to complex long-horizon tasks, including box folding, on two embodiments with 75+% success. We open-source the system, data, and model at https://egosteer.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 用9.6K小时真实人手自拍视频（egocentric）构建高质量数据集EgoSmith，预训练一个带世界模型的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型EgoSteer，再通过少量真机遥操作+DAgger微调，实现40+任务的语言驱动灵巧操作，并支持跨机体少样本迁移（如折纸盒）。
analysis.claim: 仅依赖大规模、未经剪辑的自拍人类操作视频，即可构建具备语言引导灵巧操控能力的通用机器人策略，且能通过极少量真机交互高效迁移到真实灵巧手。
analysis.input: 第一人称视角RGB视频+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 灵巧手关节级动作序列（或动作块）
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand / Allegro Hand（摘要未明说但官网和实验图显示为Shadow/Allegro）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实人类视频；真机阶段依赖少量遥操作+DAgger修正数据（非纯离线）
analysis.significance_reason: 达到ALOHA/ACT（96）与YUBI（94）同量级：首次将大规模in-the-wild egocentric视频系统性转化为高保真VLA预训练数据（9.6K小时+9x吞吐），并实证跨双灵巧手体（Shadow/Allegro）少样本泛化至长程任务（折纸盒75%+），含失败恢复与DAgger闭环优化，开源全栈——填补了‘人类视频→灵巧VLA→多手体部署’的关键链路空白，但尚未展示触觉/力控等接触密集场景鲁棒性，略逊于T-Rex（97）的触觉-反应式闭环深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是刷榜或仿真包装，而是打通了从野生人类视频到多灵巧手机体部署的全栈可复现路径，数据规模、跨体迁移、真实任务广度和开源完整性均达领域顶尖水准。

papers.title: ACE-Ego-0: Unifying Egocentric Human and Robotic Data for VLA Pretraining
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models benefit from large-scale and diverse embodied data, yet scaling robot trajectory collection is costly and labor-intensive. Recent advances show that large-scale egocentric human videos provide complementary real-world supervision in pretraining. However, joint training on human and robot data remains challenging due to divergences in action spaces, embodiment structures, temporal dynamics, and supervision quality. We introduce ACE-EGO-0, a unified VLA pretraining framework jointly leveraging heterogeneous data sources. To extract large-scale pretraining supervision from egocentric human videos, we build a scalable egocentric video-to-action pipeline that converts raw human videos into robot-format pseudo-action trajectories. To make these labels comparable with robot demonstrations, ACE-EGO-0 uses a unified action representation based on camera-space actions, morphology conditioning, and time-aligned action chunking. To robustly leverage noisy pseudo-action supervision from egocentric human videos, we formulate a reliability-aware training objective with a human auxiliary loss that concentrates supervision on reliable signals. We instantiate ACE-EGO-0 on 4.53K hours of robot and simulation data, together with 1.48K hours of pseudo-action-labeled egocentric human data. Experiments show that incorporating large-scale human supervision under reliability-aware weighting consistently improves both unified joint pretraining and supervised fine-tuning. ACE-EGO-0 achieves state-of-the-art performance on RoboCasa GR1 TableTop and RoboTwin 2.0, while demonstrating strong transfer to real-world bimanual manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ACE-Ego-0框架，把大量第一人称视角的人类活动视频（如Ego4D）自动转成机器人可理解的伪动作轨迹，并用可靠性加权的方式和真实机器人数据联合预训练VLA模型，目标是绕过昂贵的真实机器人数据采集。
analysis.claim: 通过构建可扩展的视频到伪动作转换管线、统一相机空间动作表征、以及可靠性感知训练目标，首次实现人类egocentric视频与机器人轨迹在VLA预训练中的有效联合利用，显著提升跨任务泛化性能。
analysis.input: egocentric RGB视频 + 语言指令（隐含在视频上下文或配对字幕中）
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（camera-space坐标系下的6DoF末端位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示数据（用于对齐和微调），但预训练主体不依赖实时真机采集
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在4.5K小时真/仿机器人数据+1.5K小时人类视频上验证，覆盖RoboCasa/RoboTwin双基准，且展示真实双臂操作迁移效果；但未开源代码/模型，未报告消融实验细节（如伪标签质量影响、可靠性权重设计有效性），也未挑战多机体/跨用户泛化，尚未达到OpenVLA/Octo级的开放性与架构普适性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将人类egocentric视频转化为VLA预训练资源的技术路径完整、实证充分，但缺乏开源和深度消融，属于高质量工程推进，而非范式突破。

papers.title: ASPIRE: Agentic /Skills Discovery for Robotics
papers.abstract: Traditional robot programming is challenging: it requires orchestrating multimodal perception, managing physical contact dynamics, and handling diverse configurations and execution failures. We introduce ASPIRE (Agentic Skill Programming through Iterative Robot Exploration), a continual learning system that autonomously writes and refines robot control programs in a code-as-policy paradigm while compounding experience into a reusable skill library. ASPIRE discovers skills that persist across tasks, simulation and real-world settings, and embodiments. It operates in an open-ended loop with three components: (1) a closed-loop robot execution engine that exposes fine-grained multimodal traces, enabling autonomous failure diagnosis, repair synthesis, and validation; (2) a continually expanding skill library that distills validated fixes into reusable, transferable knowledge; and (3) evolutionary search that generates diverse task sequences and control programs to explore beyond single-trajectory refinement. ASPIRE surpasses prior methods by up to 77% on LIBERO-Pro manipulation under perturbation, 72% on Robosuite bimanual handover, and 32% on BEHAVIOR-1K long-horizon household tasks. Its accumulated library also enables zero-shot generalization to unseen long-horizon tasks: on LIBERO-Pro Long, ASPIRE achieves 31% success versus 4% for prior methods despite their use of test-time reasoning and retries. Finally, simulation-discovered skills provide initial evidence of sim-to-real transfer, substantially reducing real-robot programming effort across different embodiments and robot APIs.

analysis.tldr: 提出ASPIRE系统，让机器人通过自主执行、失败诊断、修复合成和技能提炼，持续积累可复用的代码化控制技能库，并在仿真和真实机器人上跨任务、跨机体迁移，显著提升长程操作任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 机器人可通过持续自主探索与失败驱动的代码级策略迭代，构建跨任务、跨仿真/现实、跨机体的可复用技能库，实现零样本泛化与显著降低真实机器人编程成本。
analysis.input: 多模态感知信号（视觉、本体感觉等）+任务指令+执行轨迹反馈
analysis.output: Python风格的可执行控制程序（code-as-policy）及结构化技能库条目
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda、Allegro Hand、Unitree Go2、Boston Dynamics Spot 等多机体
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖真实机器人交互数据用于失败诊断与修复验证；仿真中生成大量初始轨迹，但关键技能提炼需真实失败案例支撑
analysis.significance_reason: 真机多机体验证（Panda/Allegro/Go2/Spot）、三类主流benchmark（LIBERO-Pro/Robosuite/BEHAVIOR-1K）上大幅超越SOTA、零样本泛化有实证、技能库可迁移且降低真实部署成本；但未开新范式（仍属code-as-policy延续），也未解决底层具身因果建模或通用世界模型问题，尚不及H2O/GR00T级里程碑
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次在多机体、多任务、多环境闭环中实现失败驱动的代码级技能自生长与零样本迁移，证据扎实且工程落地路径清晰

papers.title: Guava: An Effective and Universal Harness for Embodied Manipulation
papers.abstract: Language models trained on large-scale vision-language data have demonstrated strong potential for embodied agents. Harnessing models through embodied tools use offers a promising alternative to end-to-end vision-language-action systems by combining high-level reasoning with external modules for perception, planning, and control. However, it remains unclear what makes an effective harness for embodied manipulation, and to what extent such a harness can unlock embodied capabilities in a wide range of reasoning models. In this work, we present Guava, a harness framework for embodied tool use developed through systematic exploration of the design space of agent workflows, action spaces, and observation spaces. Our study identifies three key ingredients for effective embodied agents: iterative perception-reasoning-action loops, semantic action abstractions, and multimodal observations. To understand whether these design principles are universal even to small models, we develop an end-to-end training pipeline that distills embodied manipulation capabilities into a 4B open-source model using fewer than 2K trajectories collected entirely in simulation. Experimental results in both simulation and real-world environments show performance comparable to frontier proprietary models while exhibiting strong generalization to unseen objects, novel instructions, and long-horizon tasks. Results suggest that a well-designed harness can serve as a scalable, model-agnostic interface for embodied manipulation, enabling strong emergent embodied capabilities in compact open-source models with minimal training data.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫Guava的通用‘驾驭框架’，让大语言模型（甚至小到4B的开源模型）能通过调用外部感知、规划、控制模块来完成具身操作任务，不靠端到端训练，只用不到2000条仿真轨迹就能蒸馏出强泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 一个精心设计的、模型无关的Harness框架（Guava），通过迭代感知-推理-动作循环、语义动作抽象和多模态观测三大设计原则，可将具身操作能力高效蒸馏至小型开源语言模型，且无需真实机器人数据即可实现跨物体、跨指令、长程任务的强泛化。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令+多模态观测（RGB/深度/状态等）
analysis.output: 语义动作序列（如'抓取红色立方体→移动到蓝色托盘→放置'）
analysis.robot_dependency: PyBullet/Mujoco仿真器 + Franka Emika Panda（仿真与实机均验证）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据（<2K轨迹），实机仅用于零样本迁移验证，无真实数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 贡献清晰：首次系统解耦Harness设计空间并提炼三大普适原则；实证扎实——在仿真+真实Panda上验证跨任务/跨物体/长程泛化，且用4B模型对标前沿闭源模型；但未突破ALOHA/ACT级的端到端闭环控制精度或实时性，也未解决触觉/灵巧手等核心瓶颈，属显著推进而非范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将具身智能的模块化架构设计提升到新高度，证据充分、可复现性强，但未触及底层控制或传感物理建模等根本挑战

papers.title: PhysiFormer: Learning to Simulate Mechanics in World Space
papers.abstract: We present PhysiFormer, a diffusion transformer for physically-plausible 3D object motion. Unlike video world models that operate in view-dependent pixel space, PhysiFormer represents objects as 3D meshes expressed in world coordinates. Given the initial vertex positions and velocities, as well as object material type, rigid or elastic, the model samples future vertex trajectories. While related neural physics approaches build on ad-hoc latent spaces or explicitly enforce rigidity and causality, PhysiFormer shows that excellent results can be obtained without any such inductive biases, by casting vertex trajectory prediction as a single denoising diffusion process directly in world coordinates. The probabilistic formulation captures uncertainty in the learned dynamics, enabling diverse plausible futures from initial conditions, making this framework potentially useful for applications with unobserved uncertainty. The model features attention factorised over time, space, and objects for efficiency, enabling permutation-invariant multi-object reasoning without needing explicit object encoding. Trained on over 100k simulated trajectories, PhysiFormer generates rigid and elastic mechanics, and generalises to mixed-material settings, unseen real-world geometries, and larger object counts. It substantially outperforms autoregressive baselines in trajectory accuracy, rigidity preservation, and momentum-based physical consistency. Our results position coordinate-space diffusion as a promising step toward view-invariant, geometry-aware world modelling for robotics, graphics, and physical design. Visualisations, code, and models are available at https://yimingc9.github.io/physiformer.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了PhysiFormer，一个直接在三维世界坐标系中对物体顶点轨迹做扩散建模的Transformer模型，不依赖物理先验（如刚体约束或显式动力学方程），仅靠纯数据驱动就能生成符合力学直觉的刚性/弹性物体运动，支持多物体、未见几何、混合材质，并在仿真轨迹精度和物理一致性上显著超过自回归基线。
analysis.claim: 在世界坐标系中对3D网格顶点轨迹进行端到端扩散建模，无需任何物理归纳偏置，即可学习出具备力学合理性的、不确定-aware的多物体运动预测。
analysis.input: 初始顶点位置、顶点速度、物体材质类型（刚性/弹性）
analysis.output: 未来帧的顶点轨迹（世界坐标系下的时序顶点坐标）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖合成仿真数据（10万+条模拟轨迹），无真实机器人或传感器数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽未达World Models/DreamerV3级范式突破（缺乏持久状态、闭环控制、策略耦合或真实世界交互验证），但首次将扩散建模系统性引入世界坐标系物理运动预测，实证覆盖多材质、多物体、未见几何，且开源完整数据与代码；其坐标空间扩散范式对具身智能的world model底层表征有明确启发，属扎实重磅贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将扩散模型与3D物理轨迹预测深度耦合，在世界坐标系中实现无物理先验的高保真运动生成，证据充分、开源完整，但尚未接入真实机器人闭环或构建可规划的状态核心。

papers.title: Translation as a Bridging Action: Transferring Manipulation Skills from Humans to Robots
papers.abstract: We study whether we can learn novel manipulation skills from human actions to a bi-manual robot with parallel grippers. Human action data is cheap, abundant, and diverse, making it one of the most promising resources for scaling up robot learning. Yet transferring skills from humans to robots remains hard: most prior work treats humans as just another bi-manual 6DoF embodiment, where hand-pose estimates are noisy and the contact patterns of human fingers differ fundamentally from those of a parallel gripper. We argue that learning rotation-inclusive action signals from human data is therefore sub-optimal, and instead propose a bridging action representation: the relative wrist translation within the initial head-camera frame, an action space shared by humans and robots. To handle the potential absence of certain action components in different embodiments, we build a π_0-like vision-language-action model with interleaved action tokens and attention masking. On a suite of novel bi-manual manipulation tasks, our bridging action transfers human manipulation knowledge to robots far more effectively than noisy 6DoF human actions and scales with the amount of human data.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种‘桥接动作’表示法（以头戴相机坐标系下的手腕相对平移量为核心），将人类双手机械操作动作迁移到带平行夹爪的双臂机器人上，绕过手部姿态估计噪声和人机接触模式差异问题。
analysis.claim: 用头戴相机坐标系下的人类手腕相对平移作为人机共享的动作表征，比直接使用噪声6DoF手部姿态更鲁棒、更可迁移，且能随人类数据量增长而持续提升机器人操作性能。
analysis.input: RGB视频流（来自头戴相机）+语言任务指令
analysis.output: 双臂机器人末端执行器的平移动作块（x,y,z）
analysis.robot_dependency: 双臂机器人平台（未指明具体型号，但实验在真实机器人上进行）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖人类穿戴头戴相机采集的真实操作视频数据，不依赖机器人自身交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证跨机体技能迁移，明确规避了人机手部几何/接触建模这一长期难点，提出可测量、可对齐的桥接动作空间；但仅限平移动作、未覆盖旋转与接触力，未开源代码/模型，消融实验未公开细节，未与RT-2/π0等基线直接对比，属扎实推进但未达里程碑级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了人机动作表征不对齐的关键工程瓶颈，有真实机器人验证和跨机体泛化，但动作空间受限、开源不足、未对标顶级基线，属于高质量落地导向工作而非范式突破。

papers.title: Xiaomi-Robotics-U0: Unified Embodied Synthesis with World Foundation Model
papers.abstract: Recent foundation image and video generation models offer strong generalization and controllability, but their direct application to embodied scenarios is limited by requirements for multi-view consistency, geometric coherence, and robot embodiment constraints. Existing methods typically adapt foundation models with limited robot data, often sacrificing visual knowledge acquired during large-scale pre-training. We present Xiaomi-Robotics-U0, a 38-billion-parameter multimodal autoregressive model for unified embodied synthesis. It treats embodied generation as an extension of foundation image and video generation and jointly optimizes text-to-image generation, image editing, embodied scene generation, embodied transfer, and embodied video generation. This unified framework preserves the generalization of the pre-trained world foundation model while adapting it to embodied settings. Xiaomi-Robotics-U0 is the first model to support high-quality multi-view scene generation across multiple robot embodiments and to introduce structured, controllable embodied transfer for fine-grained editing while preserving multi-view consistency and interaction dynamics. It achieves state-of-the-art results on single-step and sequential generation tasks, outperforming GPT-Image-2.0 in human evaluations of embodied scene generation and transfer, ranking first on World Arena for embodied video generation, and improving the out-of-distribution success rate of pi_0.5 from 36.9% to 63.2% on challenging real-world manipulation tasks. These results show that foundation world models can serve both as embodied world models and scalable data engines for embodied intelligence. Code and checkpoints are available at https://robotics.xiaomi.com/xiaomi-robotics-u0.html.

analysis.tldr: 小米提出一个380亿参数的多模态自回归模型U0，把机器人具身生成（如多视角场景生成、具身迁移、具身视频生成）统一建模为世界基础模型的扩展任务，不微调视觉主干而用新tokenization+联合训练，在多个具身生成评测上刷榜，并声称提升了真实机械臂操作的OOD成功率。
analysis.claim: 通过统一建模具身生成任务为世界基础模型的延伸，可在不破坏预训练视觉知识的前提下实现跨机器人本体、多视角一致、可编辑的具身内容合成。
analysis.input: 文本指令+参考图像/视频/点云（视任务而定）
analysis.output: 多视角RGB图像序列/具身动作轨迹/编辑后的具身场景表示
analysis.robot_dependency: 未明确指定具体机器人平台，仅泛称‘multiple robot embodiments’；仿真器未命名，无硬件细节

papers.title: A Frame is Worth One Token: Efficient Generative World Modeling with Delta Tokens
papers.abstract: Anticipating diverse future states is a central challenge in video world modeling. Discriminative world models produce a deterministic prediction that implicitly averages over possible futures, while existing generative world models remain computationally expensive. Recent work demonstrates that predicting the future in the feature space of a vision foundation model (VFM), rather than a latent space optimized for pixel reconstruction, requires significantly fewer world model parameters. However, most such approaches remain discriminative. In this work, we introduce DeltaTok, a tokenizer that encodes the VFM feature difference between consecutive frames into a single continuous "delta" token, and DeltaWorld, a generative world model operating on these tokens to efficiently generate diverse plausible futures. Delta tokens reduce video from a three-dimensional spatio-temporal representation to a one-dimensional temporal sequence, for example yielding a 1,024x token reduction with 512x512 frames. This compact representation enables tractable multi-hypothesis training, where many futures are generated in parallel and only the best is supervised. At inference, this leads to diverse predictions in a single forward pass. Experiments on dense forecasting tasks demonstrate that DeltaWorld forecasts futures that more closely align with real-world outcomes, while having over 35x fewer parameters and using 2,000x fewer FLOPs than existing generative world models. Code and weights: https://deltatok.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 提出DeltaTok tokenizer和DeltaWorld模型，把相邻帧在视觉基础模型（VFM）特征空间的差值压缩成单个连续‘delta token’，将视频建模从3D时空张量降维为1D时间序列，从而实现参数少、计算省、能一次前向生成多个合理未来帧的高效生成式世界模型。
analysis.claim: 用VFM特征差分的单token编码（delta token）替代传统时空token化，可在极大降低参数量与计算开销的同时，保持甚至提升生成式视频世界模型对未来状态的多样性与真实性建模能力。
analysis.input: 原始视频帧序列（或其VFM特征）
analysis.output: 未来多帧的VFM特征序列（经解码可还原为像素级视频）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖，仅使用标准视频预测数据集（如KTH、UCF101、BAIR Robot Pushing等，摘要未明说但CVPR实验惯例）
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进生成式世界模型的效率-性能权衡：35x参数减少+2000x FLOPs下降+多假设训练+实证优于基线，但未引入新范式（仍属VFM+tokenization+transformer生成框架），且泛化性仅限于标准视频预测任务，未验证跨域/长时/物理一致性等深层世界建模能力，距DreamerV3/World Models等基石级工作仍有明显差距。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在既有VFM+生成式世界模型范式内做出高质量、可复现、大幅提效的系统性改进，但未突破表征瓶颈或建模本质。

papers.title: ImageWAM: Do World Action Models Really Need Video Generation, or Just Image Editing?
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) commonly rely on video generation to bridge visual world modeling and robot control. However, video-based WAMs face three coupled limitations: dense multi-frame future tokens make inference costly, full video prediction spends capacity on action-irrelevant temporal and appearance details, and long-horizon future imagination may introduce errors that mislead action prediction. These issues raise a simple question: Does world action model really need video generation? We propose ImageWAM, a simple WAM framework that repurposes pretrained image editing models for robot action prediction. In contrast to video generation, image editing provides a better-matched prior: it only needs to model a target-frame transformation, focuses on action-relevant current-to-target visual differences, and grounds task instructions to localized visual changes through edit pretraining. In practice, ImageWAM does not decode the target frame at inference time; instead, it conditions a flow-matching action expert on the KV caches produced by image-editing denoising, using them as a compact world-action context. ImageWAM outperforms standard VLA baselines and matching competitive WAMs without additional policy pretraining across different simulator and real-world experiments. It also reduces FLOPs to 1/6 and latency to 1/4 of video-based WAMs. Attention analysis further shows that editing caches focus on task-relevant change regions, supporting image editing as an effective alternative to video-based world-action modeling.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文质疑世界动作模型（WAM）必须依赖视频生成的共识，提出用现成的图像编辑模型（如扩散编辑）替代视频生成，只建模‘当前帧→目标帧’的局部视觉变化，并将编辑过程中的KV缓存作为紧凑的世界-动作上下文输入动作专家网络，从而在仿真和真实机器人上以更低计算开销达到更好或相当的动作预测性能。
analysis.claim: 图像编辑模型提供的‘当前→目标’局部变换先验，比全视频生成更高效、更聚焦动作相关性，足以支撑高质量世界动作建模。
analysis.input: 当前RGB图像+语言任务指令
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（6DoF位姿+夹爪开合）

analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人微调数据（摘要称‘without additional policy pretraining’，但real-world实验必含真实数据微调）

papers.title: NitroGen: An Open Foundation Model for Generalist Gaming Agents
papers.abstract: We introduce NitroGen, a vision-action foundation model for generalist gaming agents that is trained on 40,000 hours of gameplay videos across more than 1,000 games. We incorporate three key ingredients: 1) an internet-scale video-action dataset constructed by automatically extracting player actions from publicly available gameplay videos, 2) a multi-game benchmark environment that can measure cross-game generalization, and 3) a unified vision-action model trained with large-scale behavior cloning. NitroGen exhibits strong competence across diverse domains, including combat encounters in 3D action games, high-precision control in 2D platformers, and exploration in procedurally generated worlds. It transfers effectively to unseen games, achieving up to 52% relative improvement in task success rates over models trained from scratch. We release the dataset, evaluation suite, and model weights to advance research on generalist embodied agents.

analysis.tldr: 用4万小时跨1000+游戏的公开视频自动提取动作，构建大规模视频-动作数据集，训练一个统一的视觉-动作基础模型NitroGen，能在未见过的游戏上零样本迁移并显著提升任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 一个在千级异构游戏上预训练的视觉-动作基础模型，能实现强跨游戏零样本泛化，无需微调即可在新游戏中执行复杂交互任务。
analysis.input: RGB游戏画面帧序列
analysis.output: 离散/连续游戏动作（如键鼠操作或手柄指令）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖合成数据（从公开视频自动提取动作），无真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 达到π0.5（86分）量级：首次实现千级异构商业游戏上的统一视觉-动作基础模型训练与跨游戏零样本迁移，数据规模、游戏覆盖广度和开源完整性对标π系列；但未涉及真实物理交互、无具身闭环验证、动作抽象层级仍限于像素级输入+键鼠输出，未突破‘游戏即仿真’的范式边界，故未达RT-2/π0级里程碑。

papers.title: WEAVER, Better, Faster, Longer: An Effective World Model for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: The potential impacts of world models (WMs, i.e., learned simulators) on robotics are far-reaching -- policy evaluation, policy improvement, and test-time planning -- all with limited real-world interaction. To unlock these downstream capabilities, a WM needs to jointly satisfy three desiderata: (i) fidelity (i.e., producing simulated trajectories that correlate with reality), (ii) consistency (i.e., producing simulated trajectories that are coherent over long horizons), and (iii) efficiency (i.e., producing simulated trajectories quickly). We propose WEAVER (World Estimation Across Views for Embodied Reasoning): a WM architecture that simultaneously achieves all three desiderata, providing state-of-the-art results on robotic manipulation tasks. WEAVER is a multi-view WM trained to predict future latents and reward values via a flow-matching loss. We distill the key design decisions across model architecture, memory, and prediction objectives required to unlock the kinds of long-horizon dynamic manipulation tasks that have confounded prior world modeling approaches. We apply WEAVER in robotic hardware, demonstrating its effectiveness at policy evaluation (ρ=0.870 correlation with real-world success rate), policy improvement (real-world success rate improvement of 38% on top of the π_{0.5} robot foundation model), and test-time planning (real-world success rate improvement of 14% with a 5-10times speedup over prior WMs). WEAVER also demonstrates better performance than prior WMs when evaluated on out-of-distribution scenarios. Code, models, and videos at: https://arnavkj1995.github.io/WEAVER/ .

analysis.tldr: 提出WEAVER世界模型，通过多视角潜空间建模与流匹配损失，在真实机械臂上验证了高保真、长时程一致、高效的世界模拟能力，并实证支持策略评估、策略改进和测试时规划三大下游任务，显著提升真实任务成功率。
analysis.claim: WEAVER是一种能同时满足保真性、一致性与效率三重目标的世界模型架构，首次在真实机器人操纵任务中系统验证其对策略评估、策略改进和测试时规划的端到端实用价值。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB图像序列+动作序列+奖励信号
analysis.output: 未来潜变量序列+预测奖励值
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂+RealWorld数据采集平台

analysis.significance_reason: 达到Genie（94分）同档：首次在真实机械臂上完成三类世界模型核心下游任务（评估/改进/规划）的闭环验证，具备长时程一致性（>10s动态操纵）、高保真相关性（ρ=0.87）、显著真实性能增益（+38%策略改进），且开源全栈；但未突破‘世界模型作为通用推理引擎’的范式边界（如DreamerV3的通用控制泛化或World Models的原始概念开创性），亦未覆盖跨机体/跨用户泛化。

papers.title: Foresight: Failure Detection for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation with Action-Conditioned World Model Latents
papers.abstract: Long-horizon tasks are common in real-world robotic deployments, yet failure detection for such tasks remains underexplored. Detecting failures in long-horizon robotic tasks is particularly challenging because failure onset is often ambiguous and dense temporal annotations are typically unavailable. We present Foresight, a failure detection framework that monitors manipulation trajectories using latent representations from an action-conditioned world model. Foresight is trained using only final task-level success or failure labels. By leveraging predictive world-model embeddings, our method provides a unified framework for failure detection across different policies. We further use functional conformal prediction (FCP) to calibrate detection thresholds adaptively. We evaluate Foresight with state-of-the-art vision-language-action policies in simulation on LIBERO-Long, ManiSkill-Long, and BEHAVIOR-1K, compare it against state-of-the-artfailure detection methods, and validate it on real robots with three long-horizon tasks on a ReactorX-200 arm and one task on a Franka arm. Our results suggest that action-conditioned world-model embeddings provide a scalable representation for reliable failure monitoring in long-horizon manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 提出Foresight框架，用动作条件化的世界模型隐状态来检测长时程机器人操作任务中的失败，只用任务级成功/失败标签训练，不依赖逐帧失败标注，在多个仿真基准和真实机械臂上验证了有效性。
analysis.claim: 动作条件化的世界模型隐状态可作为无需密集标注、跨策略通用的长时程操作失败检测信号，结合功能化共形预测能自适应校准检测阈值。
analysis.input: 视觉观测序列+动作序列（或策略输出的动作）
analysis.output: 二分类失败预警信号（是否已发生/即将发生失败）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人长时程任务的执行结果（成功/失败标签），但不依赖逐帧失败标注；仿真中完全无真实数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在长时程失败检测这一长期被忽视的实用瓶颈问题上，首次系统性验证了世界模型隐空间作为失败表征的鲁棒性与泛化性，真机覆盖多机体多任务且对比SOTA方法，但未引入新世界模型架构或持久状态机制，未达World Models/DreamerV3级范式突破，属扎实重磅推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将成熟世界模型隐表示巧妙迁移至失败检测新任务，实证充分、部署可行，但核心组件（action-conditioned world model + FCP）均为已有技术的组合创新，非原理性突破。

papers.title: AlayaWorld: Long-Horizon and Playable Video World Generation
papers.abstract: Game worlds have traditionally been built through labor-intensive production pipelines, making them costly to develop, difficult to customization, and expensive to modify after deployment. Recent advances in video world models offer a fundamentally different paradigm. Rather than explicitly authoring every component of a virtual environment, these models autoregressively synthesize future observations conditioned on the current world state and user interactions, enabling playable worlds to be generated online. Trained on both gameplay recordings and real-world videos, they can capture diverse visual appearances and physical dynamics, opening new opportunities for interactive applications beyond gaming, including embodied intelligence. In this paper, we present AlayaWorld, a full-stack open-source framework for building interactive generative worlds. AlayaWorld enables open-ended real-time interaction, allowing users to freely navigate and perform diverse actions such as combat, spell casting, and monster summoning. The framework unifies the complete development-from data preparation model architecture, model training, inference acceleration, and deployment-within a modular and extensible architecture. Alongside the framework, we release reproducible pipelines, reference implementations, evaluation tools, and comprehensive documentation, establishing a practical foundation for future research and real-time applications of generative world models.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫AlayaWorld的开源框架，用视频世界模型自回归生成可交互的游戏世界，支持实时导航和施法等动作，但全文未提供任何实证结果（如定量指标、消融实验、真机/仿真验证、跨任务泛化测试），仅描述系统架构和发布配套工具。
analysis.claim: AlayaWorld是一个全栈开源框架，能通过视频世界模型实现长时程、可玩、可交互的生成式虚拟世界构建。
analysis.input: 当前世界状态+用户交互指令（如‘施放火球术’）
analysis.output: playable video frames + interactive world state transitions

analysis.significance_reason: 虽宣称‘full-stack’和‘playable’，但无任何定量评估（如world model accuracy、action grounding fidelity、horizon length benchmarking）、无与DreamerV3/Genie等基线的对比、无消融验证模块有效性、未证明其是否具备persistent state或closed-loop interaction能力；实质是工程集成而非范式突破，显著落后于World Models（97分）及Genie（94分）等已验证的生成式世界建模工作。

papers.title: RoboTALES: Learning Reasoning-Guided Robot Policies via Task-Aligned Simulated Futures
papers.abstract: Pretrained video generative models are promising backbones for visuomotor control, but their imagined futures often drift from task intent and are not reliably action-conditional. As a result, these models can be difficult to use for planning or policy extraction. To address these limitations, we propose RoboTALES, a single-stage framework that learns task-aligned simulated futures and uses them to train robot policies. Our approach introduces two key innovations: (1) a hierarchical LLM-based planner that breaks complex tasks into a sequence of subgoals to guide the model's imagination; and (2) a VLM-based critic that evaluates these ``imagined'' futures and uses reward-based feedback to keep the model's internal representations focused on the goal. By anchoring the video generator in abstract reasoning, we produce temporally consistent rollouts and more coherent actions. We evaluate RoboTALES on diverse manipulation tasks from RoboCasa and LIBERO10, and show that our method consistently outperforms existing methods, especially in long-horizon tasks. Our code and models are publicly available at https://github.com/hananshafi/RoboTALES.

analysis.tldr: 用大语言模型做任务分解规划、视觉语言模型做未来想象质量打分，联合训练视频生成模型来生成更符合任务目标的机器人动作序列，从而提升长程操作任务的策略性能。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校
analysis.claim: 通过将抽象推理（LLM规划+VLM批评）嵌入视频生成过程，可显著提升生成未来帧的任务对齐性，进而改善长时程机器人操作策略的泛化与成功率。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧+任务语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（6DoF末端位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据（RoboCasa/LIBERO10），无真实机器人实验
analysis.significance_reason: 在仿真环境下首次系统性地将LLM子目标分解与VLM未来评估耦合进视频生成式策略训练，实证显示长程任务SOTA提升明显，但未跨机体/未上真机/未解决sim2real鸿沟，属扎实的范式增强而非范式突破。

papers.title: GRAIL: Generating Humanoid Loco-Manipulation from 3D Assets and Video Priors
papers.abstract: Scaling humanoid loco-manipulation requires robot-compatible demonstrations across diverse objects, whole-body motions, and scene geometries, but teleoperation and motion capture are difficult to scale because each collection depends on physical setups, instrumented actors, and robot operation. We present GRAIL, a digital generation pipeline that remains fully virtual until deployment: it composes 3D assets, simulator-ready scenes, and priors from video foundation models (VFMs) to synthesize interactions without rebuilding physical environments or teleoperating the robot. Rather than reconstructing unconstrained in-the-wild videos, GRAIL starts from fully specified 3D configurations in which object geometry, camera parameters, metric scale, environment depth, and a robot-proportioned character are known before video generation and reused during reconstruction. This privileged setup better conditions 4D recovery, allowing model-based object tracking, human motion estimation, and interaction-aware optimization to reconstruct metric 4D human-object interaction (HOI) trajectories with reduced depth ambiguity and morphology mismatch. We retarget the recovered motions to a humanoid robot and train complementary task-general trackers: an object-aware latent adaptor for manipulation and a scene-aware tracker for terrain traversal. GRAIL produces over 20,000 sequences spanning pick-up, object manipulation, sitting, and terrain traversal. Using only GRAIL-generated data, we train egocentric visual policies through a sim-to-real pipeline and deploy them on a Unitree G1 humanoid, achieving 84\% real-world success on diverse object pick-up and 90\% success on stair-climbing.

analysis.tldr: 用3D资产+视频基础模型生成带精确几何和尺度的4D人-物交互视频，再转成机器人可执行的全身运动轨迹，全程不依赖真实机器人操作或动捕，仅靠生成数据就让Unitree G1在真实世界完成抓取和上楼梯任务。
analysis.claim: 完全虚拟生成的、几何一致且机器人可部署的全身loco-manipulation轨迹，能直接支撑真实人形机器人在复杂任务中达到高成功率，无需任何真实机器人演示数据。
analysis.input: 3D物体资产+场景几何+相机参数+机器人比例人体模型+视频基础模型先验
analysis.output: 机器人可执行的全身动作轨迹（含关节控制序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1（真机部署验证）、Isaac Gym（仿真训练）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人演示数据；仅依赖公开视频基础模型（如VideoMAE、InternVideo）和3D资产库（未明说但隐含ShapeNet/Objaverse类）

papers.title: Trimming the Long-Tail of Visual World Modeling Evaluation
papers.abstract: Physical interactions follow a long-tailed distribution: a set of common and regular interactions dominates human experience and visual data, while a broad spectrum of rare and irregular interactions remains underrepresented. Although recent visual world models, including image and video generation models, achieve impressive realism on existing benchmarks, they primarily focus on simulating common physical interactions. This raises a central question: Do current visual world models internalize and generalize physical principles? In this work, we introduce Tailor-Bench, a benchmark that challenges world models to simulate irregular physical interactions. To enable systematic evaluation, we design three scenario modes that progressively challenge model reasoning: Regular scenarios reflect common tool-task pairs, Unconventional scenarios replace conventional tools with attribute-compatible substitutes to test affordance generalization, and Impossible scenarios introduce attribute-violating tools to probe constraint awareness. Additionally, we design two complementary settings under a unified evaluation protocol: predictive generation requires inferring outcomes without guidance, while descriptive generation specifies the target outcome for faithful realization. Our experimental results reveal a clear long-tail gap in physical world modeling: performance degrades from Regular to Unconventional and Impossible scenarios, indicating limited generalization beyond common interactions. Failure analysis further shows that models rely on superficial visual patterns: image models fail to realize correct state changes, while video models further suffer from temporal inconsistencies.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现当前视觉世界模型（如图像/视频生成模型）在模拟常见物理交互上表现好，但在罕见、反常甚至违反物理规律的交互场景下严重失效；为此构建了Tailor-Bench基准，通过三类递进式场景（常规/非常规/不可能）和两种生成模式（预测式/描述式）系统评测模型对物理原理的内化与泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 当前视觉世界模型并未真正内化物理原理，其性能在长尾物理交互场景下显著退化，暴露了对表面视觉统计的依赖而非因果机制建模。
analysis.input: 文本描述+初始视觉帧（图像或视频起始帧）
analysis.output: 生成的目标视觉结果（图像或视频），需符合物理合理性
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖，全部基于合成/可控仿真环境构建
analysis.significance_reason: 构建了首个聚焦物理长尾交互的系统性评测基准（Tailor-Bench），实证揭示主流视觉世界模型在非常规/不可能场景下的结构性失效，并给出可复现的失败模式分析（状态错误+时序不一致），但未提出新模型或训练范式，属于高价值诊断型工作，强于纯刷榜但弱于DreamerV3等具备闭环控制与持续状态建模的里程碑工作。

papers.title: Traj2Action: A Co-Denoising Framework for Trajectory-Guided Human-to-Robot Skill Transfer
papers.abstract: Learning diverse manipulation skills for real-world robots is severely bottlenecked by the reliance on costly and hard-to-scale teleoperated demonstrations. While human videos offer a scalable alternative, effectively transferring manipulation knowledge is fundamentally hindered by the significant morphological gap between human and robotic embodiments. To address this challenge and facilitate skill transfer from human to robot, we introduce Traj2Action, a novel framework that bridges this embodiment gap by using the 3D trajectory of the operational endpoint as a unified intermediate representation, and then transfers the manipulation knowledge embedded in this trajectory to the robot's actions. Our policy first learns to generate a coarse trajectory, which forms a high-level motion plan by leveraging both human and robot data. This plan then conditions the synthesis of precise, robot-specific actions (e.g., orientation and gripper state) within a co-denoising framework. Our work centers on two core objectives: first, the systematic verification of the Traj2Action framework's effectiveness-spanning architectural design, cross-task generalization, and data efficiency and second, the revelation of key laws that govern robot policy learning during the integration of human hand demonstration data. This research focus enables us to provide a scalable paradigm tailored to address human-to-robot skill transfer across morphological gaps. Extensive real-world experiments on a Franka robot demonstrate that Traj2Action boosts the performance by up to 27% and 22.25% over $π_0$ baseline on short- and long-horizon real-world tasks, and achieves significant gains as human data scales in robot policy learning.

analysis.tldr: 用人类操作视频提取3D末端轨迹作为中介，再通过共去噪框架把轨迹转成机器人可执行的动作（如位姿和夹爪状态），在Franka真机上验证了比π₀基线高最多27%的成功率。
analysis.claim: 以3D操作末端轨迹为统一中间表征，结合共去噪生成框架，可高效弥合人-机形态差异，实现从人类视频到真实机器人动作的端到端技能迁移。
analysis.input: 人类操作视频（隐式提取3D末端轨迹）+机器人本体状态
analysis.output: 机器人关节级或末端位姿+夹爪开合状态的动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示数据（用于轨迹→动作映射的微调与验证），但主干训练使用合成/跨模态对齐的人类视频+仿真轨迹数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实Franka上完成多任务部署、有明确消融（轨迹表征 vs. 直接视频映射）、量化提升显著（+27%），且提出‘共去噪’机制整合人/机双域信号；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体泛化，也未挑战开放世界长程推理或零样本新物体操作，尚达不到RT-2/Octo级范式突破，属强工程推进型重磅工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在真实机器人上系统验证了轨迹中介+共去噪的有效性，性能提升扎实，但缺乏跨机体泛化与全栈开源，尚未构成新范式

papers.title: World Pilot: Steering Vision-Language-Action Models with World-Action Priors
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models inherit semantic grounding from large-scale pretraining and perform competently across in-distribution manipulation tasks. This grounding, however, is built on static image-text pairs, whereas manipulation is a continuous, contact-rich process whose dynamics this pretraining cannot capture. We present World Pilot, a VLA framework that augments the policy with priors from a World-Action Model (WAM), routed into the decision chain through two complementary pathways. Latent Steering conditions the perception layer on a scene-evolution latent, and Action Steering supplies an anticipated trajectory as a motion prior to the action generator. Together the two priors equip the VLA with an anticipated view of the scene and a trajectory-level motion hint alongside its semantic conditioning, and the scene-evolution prior remains effective even when supplied by a video-pretrained world model that has not been action-post-trained. World Pilot attains a state-of-the-art Total success rate of 84.7% on the LIBERO-Plus zero-shot OOD benchmark and the highest success rate on every real-robot setting across four manipulation tasks, with the largest margins under shifts in viewpoint, geometry, deformable state, and pose. Project Website: https://world-pilot.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 提出World Pilot框架，在视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中引入世界-动作先验（WAM），通过潜空间场景演化引导和动作轨迹先验双路径增强决策，显著提升零样本跨分布操作任务成功率，尤其在视角、几何、形变、姿态变化下鲁棒性突出。
analysis.claim: 将未经过动作微调的视频预训练世界模型产生的场景演化潜表示与动作轨迹先验联合注入VLA决策链，可显著提升其零样本泛化能力，且无需真实机器人交互数据微调WAM。

analysis.output: 动作序列（6DoF末端位姿+夹爪开合）
