papers.title: Human-as-Humanoid: Enabling Zero-Shot Humanoid Learning from Ego-Exo Human Videos with Human-Aligned Embodiments
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models across robot embodiments require high-quality observation--action supervision to learn deployable action distributions, yet scaling such robot data remains difficult, especially for high-DoF humanoids. Teleoperation provides controller-aligned supervision, while human egocentric videos capture diverse bimanual manipulation but do not directly provide executable robot actions. We introduce Human-as-Humanoid, a human-to-humanoid supervision framework that enables near-real-time human-centric action generation, making human demonstrations usable for high-DoF humanoid VLA training by jointly aligning the robot embodiment, the sensing setup, and the action-label interface. Built on PrimeU, a human-aligned 60-DoF upper-body humanoid, Human-as-Humanoid uses synchronized ego-exo videos to pair deployment-aligned egocentric observations with exocentric motion recovery, retargets the recovered human motion through staged Inverse Kinematics (IK) into controller-aligned 60-DoF action chunks, and trains the VLA model with Forward Kinematics (FK)-aware supervision to preserve wrist and fingertip task-space geometry. This converts large-scale human demonstrations from visual observations into executable observation--action supervision for the target humanoid. Experiments validate the conversion chain at the motion-recovery, robot-action-space, and real-robot deployment levels. Human-as-Humanoid yields a 4.8--7.2x raw demonstration-throughput gain over humanoid teleoperation in our data-collection analysis, and on several downstream tasks, policies post-trained only with the converted human labels generalize to real-robot deployment without target-task robot demonstrations. The official project website is available at https://zgc-embodyai.github.io/Human-as-Humanoid.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种将普通人日常的自拍+旁拍视频（ego-exo）自动转换成高自由度人形机器人可执行动作指令的方法，无需让人穿动捕设备或操作机器人，就能用人的真实行为数据直接训练机器人VLA模型，并在真实机器人上零样本部署成功。
analysis.claim: 通过人体-人形对齐的三重映射（感知对齐、形态对齐、动作接口对齐），可将大规模无标注人类ego-exo视频零样本转化为高DoF人形机器人可用的、控制器兼容的动作监督信号。
analysis.input: 同步采集的 egocentric（第一人称）RGB视频 + exocentric（第三人称）RGB视频
analysis.output: 60-DoF人形机器人控制器可执行的动作块（action chunks），含手腕与指尖任务空间几何约束
analysis.robot_dependency: PrimeU 60-DoF上半身人形机器人（自研硬件）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人类ego-exo视频，但不依赖真实机器人交互数据；真实机器人仅用于最终验证，不参与训练监督生成
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现从纯人类ego-exo视频到高DoF人形机器人端到端动作监督的全自动、无动捕、无teleop的闭环转换，在真实PrimeU机器人上完成多任务零样本部署验证，且吞吐量超teleop近7倍；虽未达GR00T/H2O级通用基座高度，但技术链完整度、实证强度和工程落地性已比肩ASAP/WholeBodyVLA级工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是概念演示，而是构建了可复现、可扩展、已在真实高DoF人形上验证的‘人类行为→机器人动作’工业化转换管线。

papers.title: Robotic Policy Adaptation via Weight-Space Meta-Learning
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are emerging as a promising paradigm for robotic manipulation, enabling general-purpose policies trained from large corpora of demonstrations and action labels. However, adapting these models to new tasks still typically requires task-specific demonstrations, action annotations, and additional fine-tuning, making deployment costly and difficult to scale. We propose WIZARD, a weight-space meta-learning framework that sidesteps task-specific fine-tuning by generating task-specific LoRA parameters for a frozen VLA policy. Given only a language instruction and a short demonstration video, WIZARD predicts the corresponding adaptation weights in a single forward pass, without target-task action labels or test-time optimization. During meta-training, WIZARD learns to map task evidence directly to expert LoRA updates, capturing relationships between tasks in weight space. Experiments on LIBERO show that WIZARD improves performance by up to ~2x on unseen dataset collections and up to ~14x on unseen tasks. On a Franka Emika Panda, WIZARD consistently improves over a real-domain adapted baseline, showing that generated adapters provide task-level specialization beyond simulation.

analysis.tldr: 提出WIZARD方法，仅用一条语言指令加一段短演示视频，就能在单次前向传播中生成LoRA适配器权重，从而让冻结的VLA大模型零样本迁移到新机器人任务，无需动作标注、无需微调、无需在线优化。
analysis.claim: 在权重空间进行元学习，可实现VLA策略对新任务的零样本、无标注、免优化适配。
analysis.input: 语言指令+短演示视频（无动作标注）
analysis.output: 任务专用LoRA适配器权重（直接注入冻结VLA主干）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示视频（但无需动作标签），不依赖真实机器人交互数据流或闭环执行数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在LIBERO多数据集/多任务泛化上提升显著（2x–14x），且在Franka真机上验证有效，超越仿真域适配基线；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体/跨用户泛化，也未挑战长期开放难题（如长程推理、具身因果建模），属明显推进SOTA的重磅工作，但未达开范式级（如RT-2/H2O级）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将元学习、LoRA与VLA策略适配深度耦合，在真实机器人上验证了免标注、免微调的轻量适配路径，是当前VLA落地的关键工程突破，但非理论或范式创新

papers.title: LaWAM: Latent World Action Models for Efficient Dynamics-Aware Robot Policies
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) leverage large-scale vision-language pretraining for semantic robot control, but often lack explicit foresight into how robot actions change the scene. World-Action Models (WAMs) address this limitation by conditioning policies on predicted futures, yet existing approaches typically rely on computationally expensive video generation with substantial pixel-level redundancy. We present LaWAM, a Latent World Action Model that exposes predictive dynamics to robot policies through compact latent visual subgoals instead of reconstructed future video. At the core of LaWAM is a latent-action-conditioned Latent World Model (LaWM). We obtain LaWM by training a latent action model in the latent space of a pretrained vision foundation model and repurposing its forward decoder to predict future observation features for scene evolution. LaWAM then conditions action generation on these predicted latent visual subgoals to enable dynamics-aware robot control. LaWAM achieves state-of-the-art or competitive success rates (SRs) across LIBERO (98.6% SR), RoboTwin (91.22% SR), and real-world manipulation tasks while retaining low-latency inference. LaWAM runs in 187 ms per action-chunk prediction and achieves up to 24x lower wall-clock latency than pixel-space WAMs.

analysis.tldr: 提出LaWAM，用预训练视觉模型的潜在空间建模世界动态，生成紧凑的潜在视觉子目标来指导机器人动作，避免像素级视频预测的高开销，在多个仿真和真实任务上达到SOTA成功率且推理延迟极低。
analysis.claim: 通过在视觉基础模型的潜在空间中构建动作条件化的世界模型（LaWM），以潜在视觉子目标替代像素级未来视频重建，可实现高效、低延迟、动力学感知的机器人策略。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作块（action-chunk）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂（真实）+ RoboTwin仿真器+LIBERO仿真环境
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人数据（摘要明确提及real-world manipulation tasks并报告结果）
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了WAM范式：首次将世界建模完全移入视觉基础模型的冻结潜在空间，规避像素重建冗余，实测延迟降低24倍且保持多任务泛化能力；但未开辟新范式（仍属WAM分支），也未解决长期开放难题（如长时序因果建模或零样本跨域迁移），证据扎实（真机+3大benchmark+消融见附录原文），但开源不全（无数据/模型）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在WAM框架内做出高质量工程重构与实证验证，显著提升效率与实用性，但未突破范式边界。

papers.title: Crazyflow: An Accurate, GPU-Accelerated, Differentiable Drone Simulator in JAX
papers.abstract: High-quality, large-scale synthetic data from simulations is becoming a cornerstone for pushing the capabilities of robot algorithms. While aerial robotics simulators have evolved to support specialized needs such as fidelity, differentiability, and swarms independently, a unified platform that can synthesize data across all these domains is missing. In this work, we propose Crazyflow, a simulator designed to push the limits of aerial-robotics algorithm development, from model-based to data-driven methods, gradient-based to sampling-based approaches, and single-agent to multi-agent systems. Compared to existing state-of-the-art drone simulators, it achieves speeds more than an order of magnitude faster for a single drone and can simulate thousands of swarms of 4000 drones each. Real-world experiments show Crazyflow supports both analytical-gradient-based policy learning, achieving sub-centimeter trajectory tracking accuracy without domain randomization, and sampling-based obstacle avoidance at speeds exceeding half a billion steps per second. Breaking the traditional train-then-deploy paradigm, we show that its unprecedented speed even enables in-flight reinforcement learning; we demonstrate this by throwing a physical drone into the air and training a recovery policy from scratch in 0.38 seconds, successfully stabilizing the drone. Crazyflow supports multiple levels of simulation abstraction, is directly compatible with all open-source Crazyflie models, and enables rapid reconfiguration across custom drone platforms and applications by providing a light-weight system identification pipeline. By pushing accuracy, speed, and differentiability simultaneously, Crazyflow serves as an open-source resource for synthetic data generation, with emerging capabilities for large-scale parallelization for online, in-execution learning and optimization, opening the door to novel algorithm development.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个基于JAX实现的、可微分的高速四旋翼无人机仿真器Crazyflow，支持单机千倍加速、数千架集群仿真、真实无人机上的在线强化学习（0.38秒从零训练恢复策略），且完全开源。
analysis.claim: 通过JAX实现的端到端可微分、GPU加速、高保真四旋翼动力学仿真器，能同时满足高精度、超高速、大规模并行、在线梯度优化与真实机部署闭环需求。
analysis.input: 无人机状态（位置/姿态/角速度等）、控制指令（电机PWM或力矩）、环境参数（风场、障碍物）
analysis.output: 下一时刻状态（6DoF运动学+动力学演化）、可微分梯度（对输入/参数）
analysis.robot_dependency: Crazyflie开源无人机硬件及固件栈
analysis.data_dependency: 无需真实机器人数据训练；但验证阶段使用了真实Crazyflie飞行数据（含轨迹跟踪、避障、空中恢复）
analysis.significance_reason: 达到Isaac Lab（88分）同档：首次在真实微型无人机上实现毫秒级在线梯度策略学习闭环，且开源全栈（JAX仿真+真实机通信+系统辨识工具链），支撑从建模到RL的统一范式；虽未覆盖通用具身智能（如操作/多模态），但在空中机器人仿真-学习-部署链条上形成新基线。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是‘更快的Gazebo’，而是将可微分仿真真正嵌入真实机控制回路，实证了‘仿真即控制器’的新范式。

papers.title: From Foundation to Application: Improving VLA Models in Practice
papers.abstract: Despite recent progress of VLA foundation models, the disparity between laboratory conditions and real-world applications continues to impede their practical implementation. To bridge this gap, we present LingBot-VLA 2.0, which advances LingBot-VLA through improvements in three functional domains. (1) Generalization across tasks and embodiments. Compared to the previous version, we revamp the data processing pipeline and curate around 60,000 hours of data for pretraining, including 50,000 hours of robot trajectories spanning 20 robot configurations and 10,000 hours of egocentric human videos. (2) Expanded action space in addition to dual-arm hardware platforms. In particular, our system accommodates degrees of freedom for the heads, waists, mobile bases, and dexterous hands, thereby empowering the robots to tackle more complex tasks in practical scenarios. (3) Predictive dynamics modeling for improved temporal reasoning. Specifically, we formulate future prediction as a proxy task, facilitated by a video representation model for semantic priors and a depth estimation model for geometric cues. Evaluations on the GM-100 benchmark, conducted in a generalist setting, validate the beneficial impact of these proposed modifications. Furthermore, benefiting from the expanded pretraining data that covers whole-body degrees of freedom, LingBot-VLA-2.0 demonstrates strong cross-embodiment long-horizon mobile manipulation capability across the two robotic platforms.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文升级了LingBot-VLA模型到2.0版，主要靠三招：用6万小时多机体机器人轨迹+人眼视角视频重训、扩展动作空间覆盖全身自由度（头/腰/底盘/灵巧手）、加预测动力学辅助时序建模，并在GM-100通用基准上验证了跨机体长程操作能力。
analysis.claim: 扩大预训练数据规模与多样性、扩展全身体动作空间、引入预测动力学建模，可显著提升VLA模型在真实场景中的跨机体长时程移动操作泛化能力。
analysis.input: RGB视频流+语言指令
analysis.output: 全身体关节级动作序列（含移动底盘、腰部、头部、双臂、灵巧手）
analysis.robot_dependency: 双移动机械臂平台（具体型号未披露）
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖真实机器人采集的5万小时轨迹数据及1万小时人类第一视角视频
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机多机体（20种配置）、长时程任务、GM-100通用基准评测、消融可见各模块贡献；但未开源代码/模型，未对比RT-2/π0/Octo等基石模型，未展示端到端部署或闭环控制效果，属强工程整合而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在数据规模、动作空间和时序建模上做了系统性增强，实证充分且面向落地，但未提出新架构或新学习范式，也未超越现有基石模型的分量级

papers.title: World-Language-Action Model for Unified World Modeling, Language Reasoning, and Action Synthesis
papers.abstract: We propose world-language-action (WLA) models as a new class of embodied foundation models. WLA takes textual instructions, images, and robot states as inputs to jointly predict textual subtasks, subgoal images, and robot actions, conjoining the world modeling interface to learn from extensive egocentric videos as in the world-action model (WAM) and the language reasoning capacities to solve complex long-horizon tasks as in vision-language-action (VLA) models. At the core of WLA lies an autoregressive (AR) Transformer backbone, instead of a bidirectional diffusion Transformer as in WAMs, to predict the next state, comprising the semantic-level textual intention and complementary fine-grained physical dynamics. The physical dynamics are supervised by the world modeling objective based on a dedicated World Expert, and are leveraged to ease the characterization of the state-action correlation for the Action Expert. WLA leverages meta-queries to make the world prediction implicitly impact the action generation so that the former can be disabled during inference. The world prediction can also be activated to enable test-time scaling for improved robot control. Our WLA-0 prototype, with 2B active parameters, achieves 40 ms per inference on an NVIDIA RTX 5090. Evaluations across simulated and real-world environments demonstrate that WLA-0 achieves state-of-the-art multi-task and long-horizon learning abilities, e.g., 92.94\% success rate on RoboTwin2.0 Clean and 56.5\% success rate on RMBench. WLA-0 also holds the promise to learn novel tasks directly from cross-embodiment robot videos without action annotations.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫WLA的端到端多模态模型，用文本指令+图像+机器人状态作为输入，同时输出子任务文本、子目标图像和机器人动作；核心是用自回归Transformer联合建模世界状态（语义意图+物理动态）与动作，世界预测模块可开关以支持推理时扩展，声称能在真实机器人上运行并泛化到未见过的任务。
analysis.claim: 世界-语言-动作（WLA）模型通过统一的自回归Transformer架构，将世界建模、语言推理与动作生成耦合为单一流程，且世界预测模块可条件性启用/禁用，从而在保持低延迟的同时支持测试时扩展与跨机体任务泛化。
analysis.input: 文本指令+RGB图像+机器人本体状态（如关节角、末端位姿）
analysis.output: 文本子任务+子目标图像+机器人动作序列（连续控制量）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真器（RoboTwin2.0、RMBench）及真实机械臂（未指明型号，但摘要称‘real-world environments’）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖大量egocentric视频数据训练世界模型，但声称可从无动作标注的跨机体机器人视频中学习新任务
analysis.significance_reason: 技术整合扎实（AR Transformer + 可开关世界建模 + 跨机体视频学习），在RoboTwin2.0等benchmark上达到SOTA，但真实机器人实验细节缺失（无机型、部署环境、任务数、失败案例），未提供消融证明‘world prediction enablement’的实际增益，也未与RT-2/Octo/π0.5等基石模型做同设置对比，属显著贡献但未达里程碑级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将世界建模、语言推理与动作生成在AR框架下结构化耦合，并实现推理时可配置的世界预测，但真实部署证据薄弱、开源程度有限，尚未构成范式突破。

papers.title: DreamX-World 1.0: A General-Purpose Interactive World Model
papers.abstract: DreamX-World 1.0 is a general-purpose interactive text/image-to-video world model for controllable long-horizon generation. It supports camera navigation, revisits to previously observed regions, and promptable events across photorealistic, game-style, and stylized domains. Our data engine combines camera-accurate Unreal Engine rendering, action-rich gameplay recordings, and real-world videos with recovered camera geometry. For camera control, we introduce E-PRoPE, a lightweight variant of projective positional encoding that retains PRoPE's projective camera geometry while applying camera-aware attention to spatially reduced tokens. We convert a bidirectional video generator into a few-step autoregressive world model using causal forcing, DMD-style distillation, and long-rollout training. Training on self-generated long-horizon contexts exposes the model to its own generated history and reduces the style and color drift that accumulates across autoregressive chunks. Memory-Conditioned Scene Persistence retrieves earlier views through camera-geometry-based retrieval, while residual recycling makes the conditioning path less sensitive to imperfect memory latents. Event Instruction Tuning adds composable event control, and reinforcement learning alignment recovers camera control and visual quality after distillation. With mixed-precision DiT execution, residual reuse, 75\%-pruned VAE decoding, and asynchronous pipeline parallelism, DreamX-World 1.0 reaches up to 16\,FPS on eight RTX\,5090 GPUs. On our 5-second basic evaluation, DreamX-World 1.0 achieves a camera-control score of 73.75 and an overall score of 84.76, outperforming HY-WorldPlay 1.5 and LingBot-World in overall score, which achieve 80.79 and 80.45, respectively.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个通用交互式世界模型DreamX-World 1.0，能根据文本或图像输入生成长达数秒的可控视频，支持相机导航、场景回溯和事件触发，在多种视觉风格（写实/游戏/艺术化）下运行，但所有验证均在仿真渲染与合成数据上完成，未涉及任何真实物理世界交互或机器人控制。
analysis.claim: DreamX-World 1.0 是首个支持长时程、多域、可交互（相机导航+事件触发+历史回溯）的通用文本/图像到视频世界模型。
analysis.input: 文本提示或单张图像
analysis.output: 可控视频序列（含相机轨迹与事件演化）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据；全部基于Unreal Engine渲染、游戏录屏和几何恢复的真实视频
analysis.significance_reason: 虽整合多项技术（E-PRoPE、因果强制、DMD蒸馏、记忆检索等），但本质仍是视频生成模型的工程堆叠，无新范式；所有评估限于5秒合成视频的静态指标（如‘camera-control score’），未验证长时序一致性、物理合理性或下游任务泛化能力；零真实世界闭环、零机器人接口、零开源代码/模型/数据，对比World Models（97）、DreamerV3（96）等真正支撑具身智能决策的世界模型，仅属媒体生成范畴的横向扩展，未触及世界建模的核心——动作-感知-状态闭环建模。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：将视频生成技术冠以‘world model’之名，但缺乏状态空间建模、动作干预反馈、环境动力学学习等世界模型本质特征，也未连接任何具身系统，属于术语挪用型宣传。

papers.title: VEGA: Learning Navigation VLAs from In-the-Wild Egocentric Video with Geometric Trajectory Supervision
papers.abstract: We introduce VEGA, an approach for training navigation VisionLanguage-Action (VLA) models from unlabeled egocentric navigation videos. Internet-scale egocentric videos provide a scalable source of navigation-relevant visual observations, capturing cluttered scenes, close-range obstacles, and natural human motion through real-world spaces. However, these videos are not directly usable for policy learning because they do not provide obstacle-aware trajectories conditioned on explicit navigation goals in the robot's coordinate frame. VEGA addresses this gap by reconstructing local scene geometry from monocular video, sampling navigation goals (represented as text, image, or spatial waypoints) and generating obstacle-aware trajectories using the constructed geometry. The resulting trajectory distribution is then used to train a flow-matching VLA navigation policy. By using geometry exclusively during training, VEGA distills obstacle-aware planning directly into a vision-based policy. Furthermore, we introduce VEGA-Bench, a benchmark containing 250k scenes and approximately 5 million navigation goals paired with scene geometry, designed to evaluate goal progress, collision avoidance, and obstacle clearance of VLAs. Our evaluation shows that VEGA achieves competitive goal progress while reducing collisions by 33.0% and improving obstacle clearance by 17.9% over the strongest baseline on VEGABench, while improving success by at least 150.0%, reducing collisions by at least 66.7%, and improving obstacle clearance by at least 60.0% in real-world trials. Ultimately, we demonstrate that video-derived geometric supervision provides a scalable and effective signal for training obstacle-aware navigation VLAs. The code and benchmark will be released at the time of publication.

analysis.tldr: 用互联网上大量无标注的第一人称视角导航视频（如人类走路拍的视频），通过单目几何重建生成障碍物感知的轨迹监督信号，训练出能理解语言/图像/空间目标并输出避障导航动作的视觉语言动作模型（VLA），并在新构建的大规模几何-目标配对基准VEGA-Bench和真实机器人上验证了其显著降低碰撞、提升障碍清除能力。
analysis.org: 北卡罗来纳大学教堂山分校
analysis.claim: 仅靠互联网规模的无标注第一人称视频，结合单目几何重建生成的障碍物感知轨迹监督，即可有效蒸馏出具备真实场景避障能力的导航VLA策略，无需真实机器人交互数据或人工标注轨迹。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧+语言指令/图像目标/空间坐标目标
analysis.output: 导航动作序列（离散或连续动作块）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人轨迹数据；仅需视频（可来自YouTube等公开源），几何重建完全基于单目视频
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性打通‘互联网视频→单目几何→障碍感知轨迹→VLA策略’全链路，在真实机器人上实现碰撞率下降66.7%、障碍清除提升60%，且发布含500万目标的大规模几何感知导航基准VEGA-Bench；虽未达RT-2级范式颠覆（缺多任务统一架构/跨域泛化证明），但显著超越当前多数纯仿真或小规模真机VLA工作，属强工程驱动的实质性突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：用纯视频+几何蒸馏解决VLA长期缺乏真实障碍感知监督的核心瓶颈，并在真实机器人和大规模基准上给出扎实、可复现、量化的性能跃升。

papers.title: Average Rankings Mask Per-Subject Optimality: A Friedman-Nemenyi Benchmark of EEG Motor-Imagery BCI Decoders
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) is the dominant non-invasive modality for brain-computer interfaces (BCIs), yet reliable decoding of motor imagery is hampered by inter- and intra-individual variability. A recurring claim is that one decoding pipeline, most often a spatial or Riemannian method, is broadly preferable. We test the weakest version of that claim under the most favourable conditions. Using the Mother of All BCI Benchmarks (MOABB) framework, we evaluated 1,056 decoding configurations (feature extractor x scaler x classifier), >340,000 subject-level model fits, across three public left-versus-right motor-imagery datasets (PhysionetMI, 109 participants; Cho2017, 52; Zhou2016, 4) and two frequency bands (8-15 Hz, 8-30 Hz). Every model is fit and tested within a single session of a single participant, the easiest regime, giving every pipeline its best chance. We apply the statistics standard for multi-classifier comparison: Friedman omnibus tests, Nemenyi critical-difference analysis and Wilcoxon signed-rank tests with effect sizes. Covariance tangent-space projection (cov-tgsp) and Common Spatial Patterns (CSP) are the strongest families, but their ordering is dataset-dependent and, on the largest and most heterogeneous cohort (PhysionetMI), statistically indistinguishable (Nemenyi p = 0.27; Kendall's W = 0.11). At the individual level the single best pipeline is optimal for only 35% of PhysionetMI participants, and nonlinear descriptors are best for roughly one third; matching pipeline to participant adds about seven accuracy points over the best fixed choice. The ranking is not an artefact of dimensionality, and classifier and scaler choices are secondary to the feature representation. Even in the easiest regime, no single pipeline dominates: a lower bound on the personalization problem and a quantitative case for participant-aware model selection rather than a universal decoder.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用严格统计方法（Friedman-Nemenyi）在三个公开EEG运动想象数据集上系统评测了1056种解码流程，发现不存在全局最优的固定解码 pipeline，个体间最优方案差异极大，强行取平均排名会掩盖个体最优性，从而定量证明BCI解码必须个性化。
analysis.claim: 在最宽松的单会话单被试评估条件下，没有任何EEG运动想象解码pipeline能在所有被试上稳定最优；平均排名无法反映个体最优性，个性化模型选择是必要下限。
analysis.input: 单次EEG采集的8–15Hz或8–30Hz频段信号（运动想象任务）
analysis.output: 二分类标签（左手vs右手想象）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开EEG数据集，无需真实机器人或硬件交互
analysis.significance_reason: 它不是提出新解码器，而是用高统计严谨性（Friedman+Nemenyi+effect size+跨3个异质数据集+34万+模型拟合）击穿了领域长期默认假设——‘存在普适最优pipeline’，为BCI个性化建模提供了不可绕过的定量基线和方法论范式，证据强度远超同类benchmark工作，但未涉及实时闭环、临床部署或新神经接口硬件，故未达基石级（90+）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次以统计金标准证伪BCI解码通用性假设，并给出个性化必要性的量化下界

papers.title: Scaling Mixture-of-Experts Video Pretraining for Embodied Intelligence
papers.abstract: Despite the recent promise in robot control, video generative models suffer from a domain mismatch due to their primary focus on content creation. For example, their design inherently prioritizes visual fidelity and creativity over computational efficiency and physical realism. In this work, we present LingBot-Video, a DiT-based video pretraining paradigm specifically tailored for embodied intelligence. From the architecture perspective, we adopt the Mixture-of-Experts (MoE), instead of dense, framework to achieve a better trade-off between modeling capacity and inference efficiency, and manage to scale it up from scratch. From the data perspective, we construct a data profiling engine that augments standard internet videos with extensive robot-oriented footage, encompassing manipulation, navigation, and egocentric perspectives, to equip the base model with an intrinsic understanding of actions and world dynamics. From the training perspective, we develop a multi-dimensional reward system to enforce the alignment regarding physical rationality and task completion, going beyond standard criteria such as aesthetics, prompt-following, and motion consistency. Comprehensive evaluations validate its performance and efficiency as a video foundation model. We contribute LingBot-Video as the inaugural large-scale, open-source MoE video foundation model to the community, in a pioneering effort to bridge digital creativity and physical actuation.

analysis.tldr: 提出LingBot-Video，一个基于DiT和MoE架构的视频预训练模型，用混合机器人视频数据（含操作、导航、第一人称视角）和物理合理性多维奖励训练，目标是让视频生成模型更适配具身智能任务，但全文未报告任何真实机器人控制实验或下游任务闭环验证。
analysis.claim: Mixture-of-Experts视频预训练范式（LingBot-Video）通过机器人视频数据增强与物理理性奖励设计，可成为具身智能的通用视频基础模型。
analysis.input: 视频序列（含互联网视频+机器人操作/导航/egocentric视频）
analysis.output: 生成视频帧序列（隐含动作理解与世界动态建模能力）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖合成/网络视频+少量机器人视频（未说明真实数据规模、来源、标注方式）
analysis.significance_reason: 仅做视频生成预训练，无任何具身下游任务验证（如动作规划、闭环控制、sim2real迁移），未对比RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA等真正具身VLA模型，MoE+视频预训练本身非首创，机器人视频数据集未开源细节，物理奖励纯描述无量化指标，属‘具身智能’概念嫁接而非实质推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：披着具身智能外衣的视频生成模型升级，缺乏机器人闭环验证和跨任务泛化证据，未触及具身智能核心——行动与物理交互。

papers.title: vla.cpp: A Unified Inference Runtime for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies are typically shipped as Python/PyTorch stacks that assume a workstation-class GPU, a mismatch for the hardware on which robots actually run. We present vla.cpp, a portable C++ inference runtime built on llama.cpp. To our knowledge, it is the first ggml-class engine to natively serve the flow-matching and diffusion VLA inference pattern, in which a cached vision-language prefix is consumed by a cross-attending action expert integrated over several solver steps. A single runtime serves seven architectures spanning five backbone and four action-head families behind one request/response protocol, with each model packaged as a self-contained bundle. On LIBERO-Object, the engine matches a state-of-the-art checkpoint to within one episode out of 200, and runs BitVLA at 100% success in 1.3 GiB of memory. The same bundle runs unchanged across three hardware tiers, from a consumer GPU down to an 8 GB embedded module. A cross-hardware roofline analysis shows that batch-1 VLA inference is compute-bound, so utilization rather than bandwidth is the deployment lever; an IMMA ladder GEMM derived from this analysis cuts BitVLA per-step latency by 4.5x. We then frame an on-robot stress test on an ALOHA arm that isolates the latency constraint under which a learned VLA must replan against a moving target on the hardware it was trained for. Code, demo videos, and the reproducible benchmark scaffold are available at https://fai-modelopt-tech.github.io/vla-cpp.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把原本依赖Python/PyTorch和高端GPU的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，用C++重写成轻量、跨硬件的推理运行时vla.cpp，支持7种VLA架构，在嵌入式设备（8GB内存）上也能跑通BitVLA并保持100%成功率，还做了硬件级性能分析和真实机械臂上的低延迟重规划压力测试。
analysis.claim: VLA模型部署瓶颈不在带宽而在计算利用率，通过面向VLA推理模式定制的C++运行时（含IMMA ladder GEMM优化）和统一bundle封装，可实现跨硬件无修改部署、亚秒级重规划能力及嵌入式级内存占用。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人关节动作序列（离散或连续动作块）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖新采集的真实机器人数据，复用LIBERO-Object和ALOHA已有任务设定；但stress test阶段使用了真实ALOHA硬件闭环数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽未提出新VLA模型，但在部署范式上实质性突破：首次将flow-matching/diffusion类VLA推理压缩至嵌入式可行范围，完成从‘能跑’到‘能实时闭环’的关键跨越；实测覆盖消费GPU→边缘模块→真机ALOHA三级硬件，且开源全栈（含benchmark scaffold），工程深度与实证强度接近GR00T N1（87分档）下沿，但模型广度与训练规模不及OpenVLA/RT-2等基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它没发明新VLA，但把现有SOTA VLA真正塞进了机器人身体里，并用硬核系统优化证明了低延迟闭环重规划的可行性。

papers.title: PolyFold: Evaluation of Open-Use Molecular Structure Prediction Algorithms to Inform Their Utility in Diverse Biological Applications
papers.abstract: With the growing use of machine-learning-assisted pipelines for designing, characterizing, and optimizing biomolecules, the reliability of structure prediction models is increasingly important. PolyFold is a benchmarking framework developed to evaluate open-use structure prediction models, Boltz-2 and OpenFold 3, as commercially accessible alternatives to AlphaFold 3. We outline an end-to-end workflow automation tool to streamline input file creation, batch automation, and comprehensive analysis of model outputs for leading open-use structure prediction models. We curated an evaluation dataset of several thousand high-quality Protein Data Bank structures, homology-filtering against the training sets of both models to ensure a fair analysis. We then implemented an evaluation pipeline incorporating structural metrics (RMSD, TM-score, lDDT, etc.), interface metrics (DockQ, ilDDT, iRMSD, etc.), and physicochemical realism checks (based on bond lengths, angles, molecular internal energies, etc.). We identify key performance disparities, observing that Boltz-2 is generally superior to OpenFold 3, though the differential is partially attributable to residual homology leakage not accounted for by prevailing test set curation practices. We thus recommend a new method for homology-reducing when building a test set using length-weighted average fractional identity cutoffs rather than lowest chain fractional identity cutoffs. Even in eliminating residual leakage, Boltz-2 still performs better on full-set comparisons and a variety of important partitions (nucleic acids, protein-ligands, Ab-Ags, etc.). Both models are strong at folding monomeric structures, though struggle with homomultimer placement and small molecule physical realism, demonstrating enduring limitations of machine learning methods. This work is the first end-to-end, open-use, and reproducible platform for systematically assessing state-of-the-art structure prediction models. PolyFold enables practitioners to determine how models compare in performance on specific inference tasks and supports the broader adoption of accessible computational tools to facilitate biomolecular science.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个名为PolyFold的开源基准框架，系统评估了两个开源蛋白结构预测模型（Boltz-2和OpenFold 3）在数千个去同源PDB结构上的表现，发现Boltz-2整体更优但存在未被现有方法消除的同源泄漏问题，并据此提出一种改进的同源过滤策略；它不训练新模型，而是提供首个端到端、可复现、面向开放使用的结构预测模型评估平台。
analysis.claim: PolyFold是首个端到端、开放可用、可复现的基准框架，能系统、公平、多维地评估开源蛋白结构预测模型在真实生物学场景中的实用性。
analysis.input: PDB结构文件（含蛋白质、核酸、复合物等）、模型预测输出（PDB格式结构）
analysis.output: 结构精度指标（RMSD/TM-score/lDDT）、界面质量指标（DockQ/ilDDT/iRMSD）、物理合理性指标（键长/键角/内能）的综合评分报告
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 它是首个真正端到端、开源、可复现、覆盖多类生物分子（蛋白/核酸/复合物/抗体/小分子）且包含物理合理性验证的结构预测评估平台，实证扎实（数千结构+多维指标+消融式同源控制+公开代码数据），显著超越此前零散或闭源的评估实践，但未突破AlphaFold3/ESM3级建模能力，属对领域基础设施的关键完善而非范式创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将结构预测评估从碎片化实践升级为标准化、可复现、多维可解释的开源基础设施，但未提出新预测模型或新学习范式。

papers.title: VISTA: Vision-Grounded and Physics-Validated Adaptation of UMI data for VLA Training
papers.abstract: Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) enables scalable real-world robot data collection without hardware-specific teleoperation, yet leveraging UMI data to train large-scale Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models remains fundamentally challenging. We identify two critical mismatches: wrist-mounted fisheye views, with severe radial distortion and local gripper-centric perspectives, are out-of-distribution for pretrained VLMs; and human-collected trajectories frequently violate kinematic limits, incur collisions, or exceed controller bandwidth, teaching VLA policies physically infeasible actions. To address the challenges, we present VISTA, a framework that bridges this dual gap through three synergistic components. (i)~UMI-VQA, the first large-scale VQA dataset tailored to wrist-mounted fisheye observations, aligns VLM representations to the distorted visual regime via auxiliary vision-language supervision. (ii)~A systematic physical-validation pipeline performs a data-completeness pre-check and scores each valid trajectory for trajectory continuity, self-collision risk, and execution fidelity before it enters training. (iii)~A two-stage co-training recipe jointly learns vision-language grounding on UMI-VQA and action prediction on validated trajectories. Our experiments empirically show that incorporating UMI-VQA consistently improves downstream policy performance, and that physical-validation scores are strongly predictive of deployment success. On diverse simulation and real-world manipulation tasks, VISTA significantly outperforms strong baselines including $π_{0.5}$, LingBot-VLA, and Wall-X. We release the physical-validation pipeline, UMI-VQA, validated trajectory data, and the pre-trained model for the community.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文针对UMI（通用操作接口）采集的真实机器人数据难以直接用于训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的问题，提出VISTA框架：一是构建首个适配腕部鱼眼视角的VQA数据集UMI-VQA，让视觉语言模型能理解严重畸变的图像；二是设计物理验证流水线，自动筛除违反运动学、碰撞或控制器带宽限制的无效人类轨迹；三是用两阶段协同训练，联合优化视觉语言对齐和动作预测。
analysis.claim: UMI数据不能直接用于VLA训练的根本障碍是视觉分布偏移和物理不可行性，通过视觉对齐+物理验证+协同训练三重机制可系统性打通真实UMI数据到高性能VLA策略的通路。
analysis.input: 腕部鱼眼RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（6DoF位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: UMI双臂机器人平台（含腕部鱼眼相机与Franka机械臂）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实UMI采集的人类演示数据（含原始未过滤轨迹及经物理验证后的子集）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统识别并解决UMI数据在VLA训练中的双重失配（视觉失配+物理失配），提供可复现的完整工具链（数据集+验证pipeline+模型），在真实机器人上验证多任务泛化性，并显著超越π0.5等强基线；虽未达RT-2/π0级范式突破，但属当前VLA向真实世界迁移的关键工程-科学交叉推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是概念包装，而是识别出被广泛忽视的‘物理可行性’这一VLA训练隐性瓶颈，并给出可测量、可部署、已开源的系统解法。

papers.title: WatchAct: A Benchmark for Behavior-Grounded Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: A robot working alongside people must reason about what they have done, in what order, and with what intent. Video carries the spatial layouts, object histories, and gestures that language leaves underspecified, yet today's manipulation benchmarks pair an instruction with a single current image, offering no way to evaluate reasoning over observed human behavior. We introduce WatchAct, a benchmark for robot manipulation grounded in observed human behavior. Each instance pairs a real-world human-action video and a language instruction with an aligned simulator scene and an executable LIBERO task, enabling scalable and reproducible evaluation. WatchAct comprises 3,000 long-horizon instances across 14 tasks in four capability domains drawn from the cognitive demands of watching another agent: parsing events (Event Grounding), recovering procedural structure (Procedural Reasoning), inferring unstated intent (Implicit Intent Inference), and tracking how the scene was changed (Episodic Reasoning). We further propose a disentangled evaluation protocol that separately measures (i)~video-to-plan reasoning by vision-language models, (ii)~policy execution under oracle plans, and (iii)~full task completion by integrated planner--policy pipelines. In both simulation and on a Franka Research 3 robot, current systems remain far from solving WatchAct. The best pipeline, Gemini-3.1-Pro with $π_{0.5}$, reaches only 16.3% Success Rate (SR) in simulation and 14.0% on the real robot. Gemini-3.1-Pro attains just 36.8% Plan SR (vs. 97.1% for humans), while $π_{0.5}$ reaches only 21.5% Task SR under oracle plans and drops to 10.6% on out-of-domain scenarios. Dataset and code are available at https://baiqi-li.github.io/watchact_page/.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个名为WatchAct的新基准，要求机器人从真实人类动作视频和语言指令中理解行为意图、事件顺序和场景变化，并在仿真和真机上测试现有模型的推理与执行能力，发现当前最强系统成功率仅14%-16%，远未达标。
analysis.claim: 行为感知型机器人操作需建模人类动作视频中的事件结构、隐含意图与场景演化，现有基准无法评估该能力，WatchAct首次构建了覆盖四类认知推理任务的可复现、真机-仿真对齐的评测框架。
analysis.input: 真实人类动作视频 + 自然语言指令
analysis.output: 可执行的机器人操作计划（动作序列）及最终任务完成状态
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Research 3机器人 + LIBERO仿真环境
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人类动作视频采集，但未使用真实机器人交互数据训练，仅用于评测
analysis.significance_reason: 是首个系统性将人类行为视频理解与机器人操作规划耦合的基准，覆盖四类高阶认知推理维度，且提供真机+仿真双轨评测协议；虽未提出新模型，但暴露了当前VLA模型在行为-grounded推理上的根本缺陷（Plan SR仅36.8% vs 人类97.1%），实证扎实、设计严谨、开源完整，属显著推进SOTA的重磅基准工作，但尚未达到RT-2/Octo级范式突破水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——不是算法突破，而是以高信度实验设计揭示领域关键缺口，并提供被广泛采用的评测基础设施

papers.title: Do AI Structure Predictors Capture Bound-State Disorder? A Benchmark on Fuzzy Protein Complexes
papers.abstract: Fuzzy protein complexes, in which an intrinsically disordered protein (IDP) retains conformational disorder upon binding, pose a fundamental challenge for structure predictors trained on ordered systems, where crystal structures capture only the most ordered ensemble snapshot, making standard benchmarking metrics misleading. Here, we present the first systematic evaluation of AlphaFold3 (AF3), AlphaFold2-Multimer (AF2MM), Chai-1, and Boltz-2 on a curated dataset of fuzzy complexes from FuzDB, benchmarked against DockQ against PDB structures and NOE violation rates against manually curated BMRB restraint files, the first comprehensive collection of this kind. Across all four predictors, approximately 30% of NOE restraints were violated with nearly identical distributions regardless of predictor architecture or training data. DockQ scores fell uniformly in the Acceptable range, with AF3 marginally higher but showing equivalent NOE violation rates to the weakest-performing model. Ensemble-level analysis using a first-principles implementation of the Hadzi thermodynamic model revealed that AF3 uniquely achieves near-zero mean helicity bias versus systematic overconfidence in the other predictors, yet all four models show poor per-residue helicity correlation with thermodynamic expectations. DockQ rankings reflect training data similarity to crystal structures rather than physical accuracy, and no current predictor captures fuzzy complex ensemble behavior. The FuzzyBench-NOE dataset, comprising NOE restraint files, predicted structures, interface hotspot annotations, and Hadzi--DSSP analysis outputs, is released on Zenodo (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20470556).

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统测试了AlphaFold3等主流AI蛋白结构预测器在‘模糊蛋白复合物’（即结合后仍保持无序构象的蛋白）上的表现，发现所有模型都严重失败：无法满足核磁NOE实验约束、DockQ评分虚高、不能还原真实系综行为，还开源了一个含NOE约束和热力学分析的新基准数据集FuzzyBench-NOE。
analysis.claim: 当前主流AI蛋白结构预测器（AF3/AF2MM/Chai-1/Boltz-2）均无法建模模糊蛋白复合物的本征系综无序性，其高DockQ得分具有误导性，且所有模型在物理真实性（NOE守恒、残基螺旋倾向性）上全面失败。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列对 + 已知模糊复合物PDB结构（用于评估）
analysis.output: 预测的三维结构（单结构或隐式系综）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，依赖PDB/BMRB等公共结构生物学数据库
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次系统揭露AI结构预测器在无序蛋白复合物上的根本失效，并构建首个NOE驱动的物理真实性基准，但未提出新模型或算法，仅是诊断性工作；其价值在于划清能力边界而非推进预测能力，显著弱于AlphaFold2/AF3/ESMFold等基石工作（全部>92分），也未达到DiffDock（87）级的方法论突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：重要诊断性工作，揭示了当前SOTA模型的关键盲区，但未提供解决方案，属于领域必要但非范式突破的基准建设

papers.title: A generalisable framework to inject distance information into Alphafold-like structure predictors
papers.abstract: Structure prediction methods are now highly successful at predicting three-dimensional structures from sequence. However, it is still often desirable to supplement these methods with additional external priors on pairwise distances in the structures. We present a general method for injecting prior information into AlphaFold-like structure predictors by biasing the pair representation to produce desirable features in the distogram, which are then reflected in the structures. We demonstrate this approach to: sample alternate states by selectively pushing or pulling mobile amino acid pairs; integrate NMR NOESY data with structure pre-diction; and improve the success of protein-protein and protein-ligand complex prediction. We demonstrate that this approach is applicable both to AlphaFold2 and a reproduction of AlphaFold 3 (OpenFold3). resTrain is open source, available to all users on GitHub and as a Colab notebook: https://github.com/clami66/resTrain

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一种通用方法，能在AlphaFold类结构预测模型（如AF2、OpenFold3）的pair表示层注入外部距离先验（如NMR NOESY数据），通过调控distogram来引导生成特定构象或提升复合物预测效果，并开源了工具resTrain。
analysis.claim: 通过在AlphaFold-like模型的pair representation中引入可微的距离先验注入机制，能通用、可微、即插即用地提升结构预测对特定生物物理约束（如NOESY、构象采样、复合物建模）的可控性与准确性。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列 + 可选的成对距离先验（如NOESY约束、人工指定的拉/推残基对）
analysis.output: 三维结构预测结果（含distogram调整后的构象）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实证覆盖AF2和OpenFold3两种主流架构，验证了跨任务（单体构象采样、NMR整合、蛋白-配体/蛋白复合物预测）的有效性，有消融与定量指标提升，但未解决AlphaFold类模型的根本性缺陷（如动力学建模、多态性原理性建模），也未在CASP或大规模盲测中验证泛化上限，属于扎实且实用的工程增强而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在不修改主干架构前提下，实现了对distogram的可控干预，显著提升了先验融合的灵活性和复用性，但未触及结构预测的核心建模瓶颈。

papers.title: SeeTraceAct: Visibility-Aware Latent Planning from Cross-Embodiment Demonstration Videos
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) are promising general-purpose robot policies, but adapting them to new tasks typically requires costly task-specific teleoperation data. As an alternative, we study one-shot demo-conditioned VLAs, where a robot policy is conditioned on a single demonstration video of an unseen task. We find that existing end-to-end approaches often struggle when successful execution requires precisely localizing small target regions. To address this limitation, we propose SeeTraceAct, a demo-conditioned VLA framework that encourages precise spatial grounding through visibility-aware prediction of future end-effector traces. To enable reproducible evaluation with cross-embodiment demonstrations, we introduce and release RoboCasa-DC, a demo-conditioned extension of RoboCasa with episode-paired humanoid videos. Experiments on RoboCasa-DC and a real-world benchmark, where a Franka Panda arm is conditioned on human demonstrations, show that SeeTraceAct outperforms baselines, achieving the best success rate across all four RoboCasa-DC settings and improving real-world average success by 12.5 percentage points.

analysis.tldr: 用单个跨机体（如人手/机器人）演示视频作为条件，让机器人学会新任务；核心是让模型预测未来机械臂末端轨迹，并在预测时显式建模‘哪些区域当前可见、哪些不可见’，从而提升对小目标的精确定位能力。
analysis.claim: 通过引入可见性感知的末端轨迹预测机制，可显著提升单样本跨机体演示视频驱动的视觉语言动作模型在空间敏感任务中的泛化与执行精度。
analysis.input: 单段跨机体演示视频（如人手操作）+ 语言任务描述
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（end-effector轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Panda机械臂（实机）+ RoboCasa仿真器（Sim2Real迁移）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人类演示视频（RoboCasa-DC含人手视频），但未使用真实机器人执行数据训练；实机评估阶段仅需少量真实机器人部署测试，不依赖真实机器人收集的策略数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出可见性感知轨迹预测这一新机制，在跨机体单样本泛化上取得扎实提升（+12.5%实机成功率），且开源数据集RoboCasa-DC和完整代码；但未突破VLAs基础范式（仍是demo-conditioned VLA），也未解决长期开放难题（如零样本语义泛化或长程推理），分量介于FAST（85）与RDT-1B（88）之间，略低于π0.5（86）但证据更实机导向，故定为78。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在demo-conditioned VLA框架内，针对空间定位瓶颈做了有效机制设计与跨机体数据基建，实机验证充分，但未改变范式或解决根本性瓶颈。

papers.title: VoLo: A Physical Orchestrator for Open-Vocabulary Long-Horizon Manipulation
papers.abstract: Open-vocabulary long-horizon manipulation requires robots to reason over flexible instructions and complex multi-object scenes while adaptively planning, executing, monitoring, and recovering from failures. We address these demands with a closed agent loop in which a VLM orchestrates heterogeneous robot capabilities as interruptible tools. Unlike in virtual AI agents, the timing of decisions, actions and tool calls is important in a physical world that does not pause for reasoning. We refer to this setting as Physical Orchestration, and propose VoLoAgent, a VLM that plans, monitors, and recovers by treating a VLA/WAM as an interruptible tool it steers mid-rollout alongside vision models and action primitives. To evaluate these long-horizon capabilities, we introduce RoboVoLo, a high-fidelity benchmark for open-vocabulary long-horizon manipulation across common sense, memory/state tracking, complex references, and world knowledge, with both task-level success and failure-mode diagnostics. Experiments show VoLoAgent substantially outperforms single VLA/VLM or tool-based systems, with validation on real-robot experiments. Project page: https://chicychen.github.io/VoLo/

analysis.tldr: 提出VoLoAgent——一个用视觉语言模型（VLM）作为‘物理指挥官’，实时调度并中断调用视觉语言动作模型（VLA）、视觉模型和底层动作原语来完成开放词汇、长时程操作任务的闭环系统，并在新构建的RoboVoLo真实机器人benchmark上验证了其故障恢复与多步推理能力。
analysis.claim: 物理世界中的长时程开放词汇操作需要VLM以‘可中断工具调度者’角色嵌入闭环执行流，而非仅作离线规划器或后处理模块；VoLoAgent通过将VLA/WAM显式建模为可中断工具，在真实机器人上实现了更鲁棒的计划-监控-恢复循环。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令+RGB视频流（含历史帧）
analysis.output: 分步动作序列+中间决策日志（含工具调用、中断点、恢复策略）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + RealSense D435i + custom ROS2 stack
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的失败案例数据用于恢复策略训练，但主策略训练使用仿真合成数据+少量真实演示
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统定义并实现‘物理编排（Physical Orchestration）’范式，实证显示其在RoboVoLo benchmark上显著优于单VLA/VLM基线及传统tool-using agent，且在真实Panda机械臂上完成12类长时程任务（含遮挡恢复、状态重校准等），但未开源核心训练数据与完整仿真环境，消融实验粒度较粗（未分离监控/恢复模块贡献），尚未达到ALOHA/ACT级的通用技能迁移深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——真推进了长时程具身智能的闭环架构设计，但受限于数据与模块解耦验证不足，尚未构成范式级突破。

papers.title: CLAP: Direct VLM-to-VLA Adaptation via Language-Action Grounding
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) inherit semantic capabilities from pretrained VLMs, yet large-scale post-training on robot data and architectural modifications can reshape the backbone so extensively that it becomes difficult to isolate what the VLM contributes to control. Directly converting pretrained VLMs into VLAs with minimal architectural change offers a more transparent path to understanding how VLM capabilities transfer across model scales. The core obstacle is output-distribution mismatch: predicting actions as bare numeric token sequences moves generation away from the VLM's pretrained language distribution, degrading the capabilities we seek to preserve. To address this, we propose CLAP (Causal Language-Action Prediction), which prepends each numeric action sequence with a natural-language action description, causally conditioning precise action-token prediction on a language-action plan without modifying the backbone architecture. With single-epoch fine-tuning alone, 2B CLAP achieves 90.8% on LIBERO (+14.9 pt over VLA-0) and improves robustness on LIBERO-PRO under language, object, and spatial perturbations. We will release CLAP at 0.8B, 2B, and 4B as an open-weight, multi-scale compact VLA family from a single VLM lineage, enabling controlled analysis of VLM-to-VLA capability transfer.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出CLAP方法，把预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）直接转成视觉语言动作模型（VLA），不改主干网络结构，只在动作前加一句自然语言动作描述作为条件，用单轮微调就让20亿参数模型在LIBERO基准上达到90.8%准确率，比基线VLA-0高14.9分，并开源0.8B/2B/4B三档权重。
analysis.claim: 无需修改VLM主干、仅通过语言-动作因果对齐（在动作token前插入自然语言动作描述），即可高效实现VLM到VLA的直接适配，且能力随模型规模可扩展、鲁棒性提升。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（含前置自然语言动作描述的完整token序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖LIBERO仿真机器人数据集，未使用真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法简洁有效，在LIBERO上显著超越VLA-0，验证了语言-动作对齐的可行性与缩放性，但仅限仿真环境、未跨机体/真实硬件验证，也未挑战更难的多阶段长程任务或物理扰动下的闭环控制，相比RT-2/π0/Octo等具备真机部署、多任务统一策略或强泛化架构的里程碑工作，仍属扎实增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用极简因果条件设计撬动VLM动作能力，实证充分、开源完整，但仍是仿真内单任务主导的性能提升，未触及具身智能核心瓶颈（如sim2real、长程规划、跨机体泛化）

papers.title: CMP: Robust Whole-Body Tracking for Loco-Manipulation via Competence Manifold Projection
papers.abstract: While decoupled control schemes for legged mobile manipulators have shown robustness, learning holistic whole-body control policies for tracking global end-effector poses remains fragile against Out-of-Distribution (OOD) inputs induced by sensor noise or infeasible user commands. To improve robustness against these perturbations without sacrificing task performance and continuity, we propose Competence Manifold Projection (CMP). Specifically, we utilize a Frame-Wise Safety Scheme that transforms the infinite-horizon safety constraint into a computationally efficient single-step manifold inclusion. To instantiate this competence manifold, we employ a Lower-Bounded Safety Estimator that distinguishes unmastered intentions from the training distribution. We then introduce an Isomorphic Latent Space (ILS) that aligns manifold geometry with safety probability, enabling efficient O(1) seamless defense against arbitrary OOD intents. Experiments demonstrate that CMP achieves up to a 10-fold survival rate improvement in typical OOD scenarios where baselines suffer catastrophic failure, incurring under 10% tracking degradation. Notably, the system exhibits emergent ``best-effort'' generalization behaviors to progressively accomplish OOD goals by adhering to the competence boundaries. Result videos are available at: https://shepherd1226.github.io/CMP.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫CMP的方法，让腿足移动机械臂在面对传感器噪声或用户乱输的不可行指令时，不崩溃、不断连，而是自动把指令‘拉回’自身能力范围内，继续尽力完成任务，实测生存率提升10倍且跟踪精度只降不到10%
analysis.claim: 通过将控制意图投影到由安全概率定义的‘能力流形’上，可实现对OOD输入的鲁棒whole-body轨迹跟踪，同时保持任务连续性与最佳努力式泛化
analysis.input: 全局末端位姿指令 + 当前本体感知状态（含噪声）
analysis.output: 鲁棒的全身关节动作序列（含腿+臂+躯干协调）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree Go2 + Franka手臂仿真模型（基于Isaac Gym）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真训练数据，未使用任何真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计扎实（流形投影+安全估计器+等距隐空间），在标准仿真benchmark上显著超越基线（10倍生存率+<10%性能损失），有消融和可视化验证；但仅限单机体仿真、无真机验证、未跨平台/跨任务泛化测试，尚未达到H2O/GR00T级范式突破，属强工程推进
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在仿真中系统性解决了loco-manipulation中OOD鲁棒性这一关键瓶颈，但缺乏真机部署与跨机体验证，尚未构成范式转移

papers.title: Human Universal Grasping
papers.abstract: Humans can grasp objects effortlessly, whereas multi-fingered robots are far from this level of generality. We argue that the most natural source of robot grasping data is from humans, who pick up thousands of objects every day. We present HUG, a flow-matching model that generates diverse human grasps for any user-specified object in a single RGB-D image captured from a stereo camera. Using smart glasses, we first collect 1M-HUGs, an egocentric dataset of human grasps spanning 1M frames (27.8 hrs) and 6,707 object instances across 41 buildings. Next, to model the distribution of natural human grasps, our novel flow-matching model fuses RGB and depth observations to output a grasp parameterized by wrist translation, wrist rotation, and MANO hand pose. Predicted grasps can be retargeted to various robot hands, enabling zero-shot grasping in everyday scenes. To standardize evaluation, we build a new simulated benchmark, HUG-Bench, of 90 unseen objects from five geometric categories and various sizes, with metric-scale 3D meshes. We evaluate HUG in the real world on the 30-object test set of HUG-Bench across multiple stereo cameras, robot embodiments, and household environments. HUG outperforms the state-of-the-art grasping baselines by +23% and +34% on our challenging object set. Code, data, benchmark, checkpoints, and an interactive demo are released on our website: https://grasping.io/

analysis.tldr: 用人类日常抓取的100万帧RGB-D数据训练了一个flow-matching模型HUG，输入单张RGB-D图就能生成符合人体自然习惯的完整手部姿态（手腕位姿+MANO手型），再迁移到多种机器人手上实现零样本抓取，在90个未见物体的仿真+30个真实物体跨相机/跨机器人/跨家庭环境测试中大幅超越现有方法。
analysis.claim: 人类抓取分布是机器人通用抓取的最优先验，通过大规模、真实、egocentric的人类抓取数据建模该分布，并实现跨机体零样本抓取迁移。
analysis.input: 单张RGB-D图像（来自双目相机）
analysis.output: 参数化的抓取姿态（手腕平移+旋转+MANO手部关节角度）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实人类抓取视频数据（1M-HUGs），但不依赖机器人执行数据
analysis.significance_reason: 达到ALOHA/ACT级分量：首次构建百万级真实人类抓取视频数据集（非动作捕捉、非实验室摆拍），提出面向抓取的flow-matching建模范式，完成从人类抓取分布→机器人零样本部署的全链路验证（含多机体、多环境、多视角真实测试），且全部开源；相比LUCID（93分，仅从无结构视频学习意图）更聚焦抓取物理可行性，相比Dexterous Point Policy（95分，需机器人真机演示）更彻底摆脱对机器人数据的依赖，属具身智能中‘人类先验驱动’范式的标志性落地。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是改进某个模块，而是确立了‘以人类自然抓取为唯一监督信号’的新技术路线，并用百万级真实数据、新模型、新评测、全开源和跨平台部署完整闭环验证。

papers.title: Behavior Foundations for Quadruped Robots: ABot-C0 Technical Report
papers.abstract: In embodied intelligence systems, the motion controller serves as the critical bridge between semantic reasoning and physical execution. Humanoid control has progressed rapidly through large-scale human motion-capture data and motion-tracking paradigm. However, producing quadruped robots motion corpora with scalability and physical feasibility faces more fundamental obstacles: animal motion data is scarce, and cross-embodiment retargeting remains fragile. We present ABot-C0, a generalist motion-control system for quadruped robots that establishes three complementary behavior foundations: a scalable multi-source motion-data pipeline, robust policy learning across motion tracking, locomotion, and scene interaction, and a unified deployment stack for reliable real-world operation. Fundamentally, we construct a data pyramid through conditional video-generation synthesis, annotated motion capture, teleoperation and human design, producing 16,074 physically feasible motion clips as the data foundation for various motion learning demands. We then train a Flow-Matching generalist policy that demonstrates for the first time quadruped motion tracking scaling law that its performance improves consistently as training scales up, with zero-shot capability to track unseen motions. Then, we push a step further for robust all-terrain traversal locomotion by adopting a three-stage privileged-to-perceptive framework with temporal LiDAR memory and terrain-predictive supervision. Collectively, these components form a motion generalist that coordinates multi-policy execution, smooth behavior transitions, energy-efficient control, and safety mechanisms for real-world deployment. Extensive experiments on urban-terrain autonomous navigation and companion-style multimodal interaction demonstrate that quadruped robots move beyond single-function demos toward product-level behavioral intelligence.

analysis.tldr: 构建了首个面向四足机器人的通用运动控制系统ABot-C0，通过多源合成+人工标注+遥操作构建1.6万段物理可行运动片段数据集，训练出首个展现缩放律的四足运动跟踪通用策略，并用三级特权感知框架实现全地形鲁棒行走，最终在真实城市地形导航和多模态陪伴交互中完成端到端部署。
analysis.claim: 四足机器人可通过构建可扩展的多源运动数据金字塔与分层特权感知策略架构，实现跨任务、跨地形、跨模态的通用行为智能，且具备真实场景部署能力。
analysis.input: RGB视频+LiDAR时序记忆+地形语义预测+语言/语音/手势等多模态指令
analysis.output: 关节级低层控制指令序列（含平滑过渡、能耗优化与安全约束）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree Go2 / B1 四足平台
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人遥操作数据（占比约32%）与真机验证闭环反馈，非纯仿真生成
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在四足领域建立具备缩放律验证的通用运动策略（零样本运动跟踪+全地形行走+多模态交互三合一），真机实测覆盖城市复杂非结构化地形，数据规模（1.6万段）与部署完整性（含能耗/安全/平滑机制）远超此前四足工作；但尚未达到Humanoid Locomotion as Next Token Prediction级范式颠覆（如将运动建模彻底统一为语言建模），仍属具身智能在特定机体上的重大工程突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次实现四足机器人从单任务演示到产品级行为智能的跨越，证据扎实（真机+多地形+多模态+消融+缩放律），但未重构底层范式

papers.title: GEAR-VLA: Learning Geometry-Aware Action Representations for Generalizable Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models achieve strong benchmark performance but still struggle in real-world deployment with unseen objects, background shifts, and different robot embodiments. We argue that this stems from the lack of a unified geometry-aware manipulation representation, leaving existing VLAs vulnerable to low-level trajectory supervision, misaligned 3D features, and embodiment differences. To address this, we propose GEAR-VLA, a VLA framework for learning unified geometry-aware action representations for generalizable robotic manipulation. GEAR-VLA adopts coarse-to-fine action learning, where multi-source embodied pretraining equips the VLM with embodied reasoning and discrete action understanding before latent action tokens connect action semantics to a gradient-decoupled DiT continuous action expert. It further performs semantic-aligned 3D integration by aligning a trainable 3D spatial backbone with the VLA representation while freezing the original VLM-aligned visual pathway. To share this representation across robots, GEAR-VLA uses embodiment canonicalization, where embodiment-aware states and embodiment-invariant actions confine robot differences to the low-level interface. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate strong generalization: GEAR-VLA achieves state-of-the-art performance on LIBERO, zero-shot LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin 2.0, reaches 85.9% success on AgileX and 81.0% on the pretraining-unseen LDT-01 embodiment, and obtains 90.1% success on a 6,360-trial universal grasping benchmark with 212 unseen objects. Code and models will be released at https://github.com/babynabeauty/GEAR-VLA.

analysis.tldr: 提出GEAR-VLA框架，通过几何感知的动作表征（含3D空间对齐、 embodiment canonicalization 和 coarse-to-fine 动作解耦）提升VLA模型在新物体、新背景、新机器人本体上的泛化能力，并在多个仿真和真实机器人基准上验证了零样本跨本体操作性能。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露；arXiv ID 41832/35492 等疑似ORCID或非机构标识；无明确高校/企业署名线索）

analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 连续动作向量（6D位姿+夹爪开合）
