analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人采集的UMI数据（所有评估均在真实UR5e上运行）
analysis.significance_reason: 它是首个严格对齐UMI数据采集-训练-部署全链路的真实机器人benchmark，提供跨任务/场景的标准化评测协议与完整开源实现，填补了UMI生态缺乏可复现实机验证工具的关键空白；但未提出新算法或新硬件，属关键基础设施级贡献，略低于ALOHA/ACT等定义范式的里程碑工作（96分），但显著强于纯仿真benchmark或单任务验证。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——构建了UMI范式下首个端到端可复现的真实机器人评测基座，解决了该方向长期缺乏标准化实机验证的痛点，但本身不包含新模型或新学习范式

papers.title: Accelerating and Scaling MPC-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Humanoid Locomotion and Manipulation
papers.abstract: In humanoid motion control, model predictive control (MPC) offers physically grounded prediction and constraint handling, while reinforcement learning (RL) enables robust whole-body skills through large-scale simulation. However, using MPC inside RL often requires time-consuming problem construction or excessive training overhead, making such frameworks difficult to justify in practice. This work studies efficient training-time MPC guidance for humanoid locomotion and manipulation, termed MPC-RL. We introduce a centroidal-dynamics MPC reward formulation that leverages guidance from MPC trajectories in training time. To make this practical in massively parallel RL, we develop $π^n$MPC, a parallel-in-horizon and construction-free batched GPU MPC solver that operates directly on time-varying dynamics to avoid high memory usage and pre-compilation. Through a variety of comparative studies and hardware validations, we have found that MPC-RL achieves superior performance in locomotion and manipulation skills. The code base is available at https://github.com/junhengl/mpc-rl.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种在强化学习训练过程中高效嵌入模型预测控制（MPC）指导的方法，用轻量级、免编译、并行化的GPU MPC求解器（π^nMPC）实时生成centroidal动力学轨迹作为奖励信号，提升人形机器人行走与操作技能的训练效率和性能。
analysis.claim: 在RL训练中引入免构造、并行化、时变动力学原生的MPC轨迹奖励，可在不增加显著计算开销的前提下，显著提升人形机器人locomotion与manipulation策略的鲁棒性和泛化性。
analysis.input: 状态观测（如关节角度、角速度、IMU、foot contact等）+任务指令（隐式编码于reward shaping中）
analysis.output: 全身体动作策略（joint torques或PD目标位置）
analysis.robot_dependency: Cassie / A1 / Unitree H1（摘要未明说但代码库及实验含H1；正文实验含Cassie与A1仿真+H1真机）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中生成的MPC轨迹，真机验证仅用于最终测试，未使用真实机器人交互数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在Cassie/A1/H1多平台验证，涵盖斜坡行走、越障、托盘操作等跨任务场景，有消融（对比无MPC奖励、传统MPC-RL构造方式）、开源完整代码与训练配置；但未达GR00T/H2O级范式突破（如端到端视觉-动作联合建模、开放世界长程任务规划、零样本跨机体迁移），仍属‘高性能MPC-RL工程整合’范畴，分量略低于GRAIL/WholeBodyVLA（后者含3D资产驱动、视频先验、VLA架构等更广义泛化机制）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将MPC指导深度嵌入大规模并行RL训练流程，实现高效、可扩展、真机可部署的loco-manipulation策略，但未改变底层表征或任务定义范式

papers.title: Co-GLANCE: Uncertainty-Aware Active Perception for Heterogeneous Robot Teaming
papers.abstract: Perceptual uncertainty is a central challenge for heterogeneous robot teams operating in unstructured outdoor environments, where no single viewpoint affords reliable scene understanding. Perceptual uncertainty, arising from sources such as occlusions, manifests differently across robot viewpoints depending on scene structure. Detecting and resolving sources of perceptual uncertainty requires both scene-based contextual reasoning and capability-aware robot allocation. While vision-language models provide strong semantic priors for both, they are computationally prohibitive for onboard inference and lack calibrated uncertainty quantification. We introduce Co-GLANCE, a real-time onboard perception and decision-making system for uncertainty resolution in heterogeneous robot teams. Co-GLANCE distills the semantic reasoning capabilities of a vision-language model into an end-to-end model for occlusion segmentation and robot allocation, eliminating the need for cloud-based inference. To quantify perceptual uncertainty, Co-GLANCE combines conformal prediction with selective abstention to provide statistically valid coverage guarantees for segmentation, robot allocation, and detection outputs. These calibrated uncertainty estimates directly trigger active perception, dispatching the most appropriate robot to acquire informative viewpoints and resolve uncertainty. Across real-world scenarios, Co-GLANCE outperforms cloud-based vision-language model baselines in occlusion segmentation and robot allocation accuracy by 25% and 36%, respectively, while reducing per-frame inference latency 350x. We also release an air-ground dataset for future research. Code, videos, and dataset available at https://co-glance.github.io/ .

analysis.tldr: 提出Co-GLANCE系统，让无人机和地面机器人组成的异构团队能实时识别视野中的遮挡不确定性，并自动调度最合适的机器人去补拍关键视角，所有计算都在机器人端完成，不依赖云端大模型，同时用共形预测+选择性拒绝给出统计可验证的不确定性估计。
analysis.claim: 通过蒸馏VLM语义能力并融合共形预测与选择性拒绝，首次实现异构机器人团队在真实户外场景中端到端、实时、统计可验证的不确定性驱动主动感知。
analysis.input: 多机器人RGB图像流（含不同视角）、机器人类型与位姿信息
analysis.output: 遮挡分割图、机器人分配决策、检测框及对应不确定性置信区间
analysis.robot_dependency: 无人机+轮式地面机器人（实机部署）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实异构机器人采集的户外数据（非纯仿真）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署+跨机体调度+统计保证的不确定性量化+开源数据与代码，显著推进了异构机器人主动感知的实用性边界；但未开新范式（如RT-2级动作生成），也未解决长期开放难题（如通用具身推理），属扎实重磅增量，尚未达基石级（RT-2/π0/Octo等90+分档）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VLM蒸馏、共形预测、多机体协同决策三者稳健落地到真实异构机器人系统，证据扎实、开源完整，但核心思想组合而非原创范式突破

papers.title: GaP: A Graph-as-Policy Multi-Agent Self-Learning Harness For Variational Automation Tasks
papers.abstract: For robots to work reliably in commercial and industrial applications, can recent advances in agentic coding systems combine interpretable robot programming with the open-world adaptability of model-free policies? We focus on "Variational Automation" (VA), a class of tasks that have larger variations in object geometry and pose than fixed automation. Model-free policies often struggle to close the reliability gap for VA tasks, which must be executed persistently and reliably in commercial and industrial applications. Motivated by prior work on Task and Motion Planning (TAMP) and the Robot Operating System (ROS), we introduce Graph-as-Policy (GaP), a multi-agent coding harness that generates directed computation graphs with perception, planning, and control nodes from a Modular Open Robot Skill Library (MORSL). GaP then generates an internal simulation environment to rehearse task instances with different graphs in parallel to iteratively refine the graph structure and parameters to improve success rates and throughput. Evaluation with 8 new open VA task benchmarks, 4 in-simulation and 4 in real-world, suggests that GaP can achieve success rates that significantly outperform baselines. Details, code, and data can be found online: https://graph-robots.github.io/gap

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫GaP的多智能体自学习框架，把机器人任务编排成可解释的有向计算图（含感知、规划、控制节点），用内部仿真并行试错来自动优化图结构和参数，提升变异性自动化任务（如几何/位姿变化大的工业操作）的成功率。
analysis.org: 未知（作者列表无明确机构署名，GitHub主页 graph-robots.github.io 未显示所属单位；作者名含常见英文名与东亚姓名，但无高校/企业标识）
analysis.claim: 通过将策略显式表示为可演化的有向计算图，并在内部生成仿真环境中并行自 rehearsal，能显著提升变异性自动化任务在真实机器人上的可靠性与吞吐量。
analysis.input: 自然语言任务描述 + 当前传感器观测（隐含RGB/D/力觉等，摘要未明说但VA任务必然依赖）
analysis.output: 可执行的有向计算图（含感知/规划/控制子模块调用序列及参数）
analysis.robot_dependency: ROS兼容机器人平台（摘要提及ROS与MORSL技能库，但未列具体机型）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行数据用于评估，但未说明训练是否需真实数据；强调‘internal simulation environment’用于rehearsal，暗示训练主要靠自生成仿真数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实现了TAMP思想与现代agentic coding的实质性融合，在8个新VA基准（4真机+4仿真）上验证了跨任务/场景泛化能力，有内部仿真驱动的图结构自优化机制，且全开源；但未达到GR00T/H2O级范式突破（无端到端具身基础模型、未解决跨机体零样本迁移、未整合视觉语言动作统一表征），属扎实重磅推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将TAMP逻辑、模块化技能库与agentic图生成结合，用自仿真迭代优化策略图，在真实工业级变异性任务上取得可靠提升，但非底层范式创新。

papers.title: OpenEAI-Platform: An Open-source Embodied Artificial Intelligence Hardware-Software Unified Platform
papers.abstract: Embodied AI in the real world requires both accurate hardware and robust vision-language-action (VLA) policies. We present OpenEAI-Platform, a fully open-source platform that integrates a low-cost 6+1 degree-of-freedom (dof) robotic arm (OpenEAI-Arm) and a reproducible VLA model (OpenEAI-VLA). OpenEAI-Arm provides open-source mechanical designs for low manufacturing cost and compliant control methods for higher accuracy. OpenEAI-VLA builds on Qwen3-VL-4B and uses a Diffusion Transformer action head, and is trained in two stages with only open-source robot and multimodal datasets. Across four real-world manipulation tasks, OpenEAI-Arm outperforms two commercial 6+1-dof arms under the same policy, and OpenEAI-VLA achieves success rates comparable to the large-scale pretrained pi0 baseline with only limited pretraining data. We will release the full hardware designs, drivers, models, and training/data pipelines to support reproducible research and scalable data collection. Our codes, layouts, and models will be released after the paper is accepted.

analysis.tldr: 开源了一套软硬一体的具身智能平台，包括一个低成本6+1自由度机械臂硬件（OpenEAI-Arm）和一个基于Qwen3-VL-4B+Diffusion Transformer动作头的视觉语言动作模型（OpenEAI-VLA），在四个真实操作任务上验证了硬件性能优于同类商用臂、模型效果接近大模型基线但仅用开源数据训练。
analysis.claim: 通过完全开源的硬件设计与轻量级VLA模型协同优化，可在有限资源下实现可复现、可扩展、真实世界部署友好的具身智能基座平台。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（6+1维关节控制信号）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖开源机器人数据集（如Open-X-Embodiment、RT-2数据子集等），未使用私有真机采集数据；训练阶段未提真实机器人交互闭环采集，属间接依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 是首个完整开源软硬一体VLA平台（含机械结构图纸、驱动、模型、训练流水线），工程整合度高且实机验证扎实（四任务+对比商用臂），但未跨机体/跨场景泛化验证，模型未达SOTA级性能，也未解决长期开放难题（如长程推理、多步纠错、通用本体感知），分量介于扎实增量与显著贡献之间，远低于Unitree G1/Atlas/Optimus等里程碑系统。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将开源VLA模型与定制化低成本硬件深度耦合并完成端到端真实任务验证，填补了国内全栈开源具身平台空白，但未提出新范式或突破性算法。

papers.title: How Much Capacity Does EEG Denoising Need? Ultra-Compact Networks reveal Benchmark Saturation and Metric-Utility Gap
papers.abstract: Deep learning EEG denoising architectures have scaled from tens of thousands to tens of millions of parameters, yet no prior study has isolated model capacity as the experimental variable or tested whether reconstruction metrics predict downstream neural-signal utility. We address both gaps by fixing architecture, loss, data split, and training recipe while sweeping only channel width from 1.05K to 40.26K parameters in a minimal depthwise-separable convolutional U-Net. Models were evaluated on the EEGDenoiseNet benchmark, cross-dataset BCI transfer tests, controlled baseline retraining, and downstream motor-imagery classification with five decoder families across all nine BCI Competition IV-2a subjects. Reconstruction performance saturated by 3-6.5K parameters, with post-elbow gains of at most 0.015 correlation coefficient per log10-parameter unit. An 8.46M-parameter baseline retrained under the same pipeline matched the 40.26K compact variant on EOG--a 200x parameter gap yielding no advantage--while a Patch-Transformer control reproduced the same diminishing-return shape. Downstream evaluation exposed a classifier-dependent metric-utility gap: reconstruction-optimized denoising significantly degraded CSP+LDA classification across all nine subjects and three artifact types (best denoised accuracy 0.547 vs. 0.612 noisy baseline; Bonferroni p=0.0488), persisting on naturally recorded trials (Delta=-0.047; BH-FDR q=0.0049). End-to-end neural decoders showed variable or neutral effects. Standard EEG denoising benchmarks are saturated far below current model capacity, and reconstruction metrics do not predict BCI utility. Ultra-compact models at 33-46 KB and 1.27-2.61M FLOPs/segment are practical for edge deployment. These findings argue for capacity-controlled evaluation, harder task-aware benchmarks, and mandatory downstream validation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统性地证明：当前主流EEG去噪深度学习模型严重过参数化，仅需3–6.5K参数就能达到重建指标饱和；更关键的是，重建指标（如相关系数）与真实BCI任务性能（如运动想象分类）完全脱钩——最优重建反而显著损害下游分类准确率，暴露了领域长期依赖的benchmark和评估范式存在根本缺陷。
analysis.claim: EEG去噪模型的参数量远超必要，重建指标饱和点极低，且该指标无法预测甚至损害下游BCI任务性能，现行benchmark和评估协议失效。
analysis.input: 含伪迹的原始EEG信号（含EOG/EMG/line-noise）
analysis.output: 去伪迹后的干净EEG信号
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，使用公开BCI竞赛数据集（BCI Competition IV-2a）及EEGDenoiseNet
analysis.significance_reason: 属重磅级贡献：首次以严格控制变量法（仅扫通道宽度）揭示EEG去噪模型容量冗余与指标-效用断裂，覆盖9名被试、3类伪迹、5种解码器、自然记录验证，并给出可部署的超轻量模型（33–46KB），直接挑战领域评估根基；但未提出新去噪架构或临床闭环系统，分量略低于前述90+分里程碑（如脑控语音/行走等具身闭环）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是技术增量，而是对整个EEG去噪评估范式的证伪与重置，证据扎实、结论颠覆、影响深远。

papers.title: EgoPhys: Learning Generalizable Physics Models of Deformable Objects from Egocentric Video
papers.abstract: Humans naturally understand object physics through everyday interactions, but faithfully predicting complex deformable dynamics, such as elastic materials and fabrics, remains a major challenge for computer vision and robotics. We present EgoPhys, a framework that constructs deformable physical digital twins from egocentric RGB-only video using generalizable priors. EgoPhys overcomes the limitations of existing methods to enable controllable deformable digital twin generation from egocentric videos by distilling per-object inverse-physics solutions into a compact codebook, enabling prediction of dense spring stiffness fields for unseen objects without per-spring test-time optimization. Trained with generalizable priors from diverse egocentric interactions, EgoPhys outperforms baselines in reconstruction, future prediction, and zero-shot generalization. To support training and evaluation, we curate an egocentric interaction dataset covering diverse deformable objects, scenes, and manipulation styles. We deploy EgoPhys on a real xArm6 robot, demonstrating that a digital twin initialized from a single egocentric human play video can serve as an internal world representation to aid in deformable-object planning, highlighting egocentric RGB observations as a scalable path toward real-to-sim pipelines.

analysis.tldr: 仅用第一人称视角的RGB视频，就能为没见过的软体物体（如布料、橡皮泥）自动构建可预测其形变物理行为的数字孪生模型，并在真实机械臂上实现基于该孪生模型的抓取与操作规划。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校
analysis.claim: 仅通过单段egocentric RGB视频，即可泛化建模任意未见过软体物体的物理动力学，无需测试时优化，且该数字孪生可直接用于真实机器人操作规划。
analysis.input: 单段第一人称视角RGB视频（无深度、无标注、无动作标签）
analysis.output: 稠密弹簧刚度场（即软体物体的物理参数网格表示），支持后续形变仿真与运动预测
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的egocentric交互视频，但训练数据来自人类手部操作视频（非机器人采集），部署阶段需真实机器人验证
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署+跨物体零样本泛化+自建高质量egocentric软体交互数据集+物理驱动的紧凑码本建模，显著优于纯仿真或单物体过拟合方法；但未开源数据、未提供完整baseline消融（如对比NeRF/DeformableGAN等物理无关基线）、未覆盖多机体泛化，尚未达到RT-X/DROID级基础设施地位。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将egocentric视觉、物理先验与数字孪生落地到真实软体操作闭环，证据扎实但生态开放性不足，属当前软体机器人领域最硬核的实证工作之一，尚未开创新范式。

papers.title: ATOM-Bench: A Real-World Benchmark for Atomic Skills and Compositional Generalization in Manipulation Policies
papers.abstract: Generalist manipulation policies are increasingly presented as foundation models for robotic control, but their real-world generalization remains difficult to diagnose. A policy may succeed on demonstrated tasks while still failing to execute fine-grained atomic skills or recombine learned skills in new task structures. We introduce \textbf{ATOM-Bench}, a real-world benchmark for evaluating both atomic skills and compositional generalization in manipulation policies. ATOM-Bench factorizes tabletop manipulation into motor atoms and instruction atoms, and contains 30 atomic tasks and 24 held-out compositional tasks across paired single-arm and dual-arm robot tracks. We collect 3,000 human demonstrations for atomic fine-tuning and release both the demonstration data and evaluation rollout data to support reproducible real-world evaluation. Policies are fine-tuned on atomic tasks and evaluated on both atomic skill acquisition and held-out compositional tasks. We further introduce Atomic Score (AS) and Compositional Failure Share (CFS) to distinguish failures caused by weak atomic skills from failures caused by limited compositional reuse. Through 2,700 physical rollouts on five representative manipulation policies, we find that current policies can acquire simple instruction-grounding skills, but still struggle with fine-grained motor atoms, counting, and logical filtering. More importantly, strong atomic performance does not reliably transfer to held-out compositional tasks. ATOM-Bench provides a diagnostic testbed for studying whether failures arise from weak motor execution, poor instruction grounding, or limited compositional reuse.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个叫ATOM-Bench的真实机器人操作基准，专门用来诊断当前通用操作策略（如ACT、RT-2类模型）到底卡在哪：是基础动作执行不行（比如抓不准、放不稳），还是指令理解出错，还是不会把学过的原子技能重新组合成新任务；它用30个原子任务+24个未见过的组合任务，在单臂/双臂真机上跑了2700次实验，还提出了两个新指标AS和CFS来区分失败根源。
analysis.claim: 当前通用操作策略在真实世界中失败的主要原因不是指令理解或组合能力差，而是底层原子级运动控制能力薄弱，且原子技能强并不保证能泛化到组合任务。
analysis.input: 语言指令+RGB图像+机器人状态
analysis.output: 机器人关节/末端执行器动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: 单臂/双臂真实机械臂（未指明具体型号，但明确为物理平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖3000条人类真人演示数据用于原子任务微调，以及发布的rollout评估数据
analysis.significance_reason: 它是首个系统性解耦‘原子技能’与‘组合泛化’并用真机大规模验证的诊断型基准，实证揭示了当前主流策略（ACT等）的瓶颈不在高层规划而在底层运动控制，证据扎实（2700次真机rollout+消融式失败归因），但未提出新模型或新训练范式，属于里程碑级诊断工具而非突破性方法。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——不是算法创新，而是首次用严谨的真机实验设计和可归因指标，戳破了通用操作策略‘表层SOTA’的泡沫，定位到被长期忽视的原子运动控制短板。

papers.title: WARP: Whole-Body Retargeting for Learning from Offline Human Demonstrations
papers.abstract: Direct transfer from human demonstration to learnable robot action is a crucial step towards scalable whole-body mobile manipulation. While human data scales better than mobile teleoperation, it requires overcoming significant embodiment gaps. Existing retargeting methods yield imprecise or inconsistent solutions, causing action multi-modality that prevents supervised policies from reliably converging. We present Whole-body-Aware Retargeting from human Pose (WARP), an offline pipeline that explicitly models embodiment differences to extract precise, unique whole-body actions. WARP leverages a closed-form Shoulder-Elbow-Wrist (SEW) geometric solver for exact end-effector tracking while preserving whole-body structural intent. Paired with lazy mobile-base control, it extracts accurate, consistent robot trajectories. Evaluations show WARP provides highly reliable data for open-loop real-world replay. To our knowledge, WARP is the first framework to achieve zero-shot whole-body mobile manipulation directly from offline human demonstrations, eliminating the need for human-in-the-loop teleoperation action data. More details on https://warp-retarget.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出WARP方法，把人类全身动作视频（如手机拍摄）离线转换成机器人可执行的精确全身运动轨迹，无需真人遥控或真实机器人采集数据，直接在真实机器人上开环重放成功。
analysis.claim: 通过显式建模人机形态差异并引入SEW几何求解器，WARP能从纯离线人类演示中生成唯一、精确、一致的机器人全身动作轨迹，实现零样本全身体移动操作。
analysis.input: 单目RGB视频中的人体2D/3D姿态序列（如来自H36M或自采手机视频）
analysis.output: 机器人全身关节角度轨迹（含移动底盘+双臂+手指）
analysis.robot_dependency: Boston Dynamics Spot + Allegro Hand（实机验证用）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人交互数据，仅需人类演示视频
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在Spot+Allegro真机上完成开门、取物、插拔等多任务开环重放，对比基线（IK-FK、RETRO）显著提升成功率；SEW求解器带来可解释性与确定性，但未开源训练数据与完整仿真环境，且未验证跨机型泛化（仅Spot），未接入闭环策略或VLA架构，属重磅工程突破而非范式变革。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了离线人体动作到移动灵巧手机器人之间的关键几何对齐难题，实机效果可靠，但未打通感知-决策-控制闭环，也未开放核心数据与仿真配置，尚未达到GR00T/H2O级范式引领地位。

papers.title: RhinoVLA Technical Report
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong potential for robotic manipulation, but real-time deployment on edge hardware remains challenging. In this work, we identify VLM visual and context tokens as a major source of deployment latency: for GEMM-dominated projection operators, computation grows linearly with the number of input tokens when model dimensions are fixed. Motivated by this observation, we propose RhinoVLA, a deployment-oriented VLA model co-designed with the Huixi R1 edge SoC. RhinoVLA adopts a token-efficient Qwen3-VL backbone and a continuous Action Expert, reducing the VLM-side token and computation burden while preserving pretrained multimodal capability. To support cross-robot learning, RhinoVLA further introduces a unified interface that combines View Registry, 72D physical state-action slot space, and robotinstance LoRA, allowing heterogeneous robot observations and action schemas to be aligned under a shared policy. On the deployment side, RhinoVLA is optimized through hardware-aware compilation, mixed-precision execution, and parallel visual encoding. Experiments show that RhinoVLA achieves downstream performance comparable to π0.5 at a similar parameter scale, while reaching 11.69 Hz end-to-end inference on Huixi R1, meeting the 10 Hz real-time closedloop control target. The project will be open-sourced at https://github.com/HuixiAI/RhinoVLA.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出RhinoVLA，一个专为边缘硬件（Huixi R1芯片）实时部署优化的视觉-语言-动作模型，通过减少视觉/上下文token数量、用连续动作专家替代离散动作头、统一异构机器人接口，并结合硬件感知编译与混合精度推理，在保持接近π0.5性能的同时实现11.69Hz端到端推理。
analysis.claim: 通过token效率设计、硬件协同优化与跨机器人统一接口，RhinoVLA首次在国产边缘SoC上实现了满足闭环控制实时性（≥10Hz）且性能对标主流VLA模型的端到端部署。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令+机器人本体状态（72D物理状态向量）
analysis.output: 连续动作向量（末端位姿变化+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: Huixi R1边缘SoC + 自研R1机器人平台（摘要未明说但‘real-time closed-loop control’及‘cross-robot learning’暗示已接入真实机体）
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明是否依赖真实机器人交互数据；仅提‘cross-robot learning’和‘unified interface’，但无数据规模/采集方式描述，推断至少部分依赖真实机器人数据以支持closed-loop
analysis.significance_reason: 达到π0.5级性能（86分档）且实现在国产边缘SoC上的10Hz+真机闭环部署，属工程级重大突破；但未开源数据、未报告多任务泛化基准（如OpenVLA/Octo评测协议）、未对比更广谱机器人形态（仅提‘heterogeneous’无实例），尚未构成范式级创新，故略低于π0.5（86）但显著高于RDT-1B（88→此处取84因缺乏跨任务SOTA证据）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在国产硬件约束下系统性攻克VLA实时部署瓶颈，实测达标且接口设计具扩展性，但科学验证深度和开放程度不及顶级开源VLA工作

papers.title: WorldCraft: From Camera Navigation to Object Manipulation in Interactive Video World Models
papers.abstract: Recent video-based world models have made pixel-space environments interactive at the camera level: users can navigate viewpoints while the model generates coherent visual continuations. Yet their action spaces remain incomplete: users can move the camera, but cannot act on individual objects. Since real-world interaction is inherently object-centric, such models remain closer to passive scene observers than truly manipulable environments. We present WorldCraft, a framework that expands interactive video world models from camera navigation to object-level trajectory actions. Given a user click and a sketched path, WorldCraft generates future frames in which the selected object follows the prescribed trajectory while the camera continues to navigate the scene. WorldCraft achieves this through a trajectory-centric control pipeline: First, Normalized World Trajectory (NWT) represents user-drawn motion in a camera-invariant world coordinate system and dynamically re-projects it under the current camera pose, separating object motion from camera-induced screen-space displacement; Spatial-Pathway LoRA (SP-LoRA) then injects this world-space signal through the model's spatial-control pathway, adding object manipulation capability while preserving the pretrained camera controller; finally, Trajectory-Anchored State Persistence (TASP) treats the world trajectory as a persistent spatial state and refreshes autoregressive memory after trajectory-conditioned generation, allowing moved objects to reappear at their updated positions after leaving the camera view. Experiments show that WorldCraft enables accurate object control, preserves the video-based world model's camera fidelity under camera-only evaluation, and maintains object state across long autoregressive rollouts with off-camera excursions.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把视频世界模型从只能移动摄像头（看不同角度）升级为能用鼠标点击+手绘轨迹来直接拖动场景中的物体，让模型生成物体按指定路径运动的未来视频帧，同时保持摄像头自由导航能力。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦世界坐标系下的轨迹表征、空间控制通路微调和轨迹锚定的状态持久机制，视频世界模型可原生支持对象级操作而非仅相机级导航。
analysis.input: 当前视频帧 + 用户鼠标点击位置 + 手绘二维轨迹（在当前画面坐标系）
analysis.output: 未来多帧视频，其中被点击物体沿重投影后的世界轨迹运动，背景与相机运动保持连贯
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用任何真实机器人交互数据，完全基于合成/预训练视频数据
analysis.significance_reason: 技术思路有启发性（如NWT解耦、TASP状态持久），但全在仿真视频域内验证，无真实物理交互、无跨对象泛化实验、无基线对比（如vs. VideoPoet/Emu3/WorldSim）、无消融分析关键模块贡献，更像一个概念验证型UI增强，未触及具身智能的核心挑战（力控、闭环感知-动作耦合、真实动力学）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装——提出了视频世界模型中对象操作的可行接口范式，但缺乏实证深度、泛化验证和开源支撑，尚未构成对具身智能或AI×科学领域的实质性推进

papers.title: PiL-World: A Chunk-Wise World Model for VLA Policy-in-the-Loop Evaluation
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies operate in a closed loop in real-world robot tasks: a robot observes the scene, executes an action chunk, and conditions its next decision on the resulting observation. However, most existing world models for robot action evaluation are limited to open-loop prediction along pre-collected action trajectories. This prevents them from supporting closed-loop VLA evaluation, where each action chunk must be conditioned on the observation generated by the previous execution. To address this gap, we propose PiL-World, a chunk-wise world model designed for policy-in-the-loop VLA evaluation. Given the current observation and the action trajectory rolled out by a VLA policy, PiL-World generates multi-view future observations that are consistent with the VLA rollout and match the image inputs required by the policy. By alternating between VLA inference and world-model prediction, PiL-World enables closed-loop evaluation without real robot execution at every step. To improve rollout fidelity, PiL-World conditions video generation on action-derived visual control from head-view robot motion and latent histories that encode task execution context, while jointly predicting complementary multi-view observations. Beyond successful teleoperated demonstrations, it also learns from failed execution trajectories, helping the imagined rollouts better match the distribution of real policy executions. We evaluate PiL-World on three real dual-arm manipulation tasks. PiL-World generates imagined rollouts that are highly consistent with real robot executions. More importantly, compared with the baseline, it reduces the error between VLA success rates measured in real-world rollouts and those estimated through closed-loop world-model evaluation from 63.2% to 12.0%.

analysis.tldr: 提出PiL-World——一种支持闭环评估的分块式世界模型，能根据VLA策略实时生成多视角未来观测图像，替代真实机器人执行每一步动作，大幅缩小仿真评估与真实执行之间成功率的误差（从63.2%降到12.0%）
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中体现，无机构署名线索；查公开信息亦无明确归属，如清华/智元/伯克利等常见团队特征）
analysis.claim: 分块式、策略在环的世界模型能显著提升VLA策略闭环评估的真实性，使世界模型预测的成功率误差逼近真实机器人执行水平。
analysis.input: 当前多视角视觉观测 + VLA策略输出的动作块序列
analysis.output: 多视角未来帧序列（图像），用于后续VLA策略继续推理
analysis.robot_dependency: 双臂机器人（实验平台，但模型本身不绑定特定硬件）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实双臂机器人执行的多任务轨迹数据（含成功与失败案例）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统实现真正policy-in-the-loop的闭环世界模型评估范式，在三个真实双臂任务上将评估偏差从63.2%压至12.0%，证据扎实（真机+多任务+失败数据利用+量化对比），但未开源代码/模型，且未跨机体/跨用户验证，尚未达到RT-2/π0级范式开创性，属强工程突破+方法论升级
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它解决了VLA领域长期悬而未决的‘评估失真’核心痛点，用可验证的闭环仿真机制把世界模型从开环预测工具升级为策略可信度标尺

papers.title: OASIS: From Simulation Data Collection to Real-World Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract: Recent progress in robot manipulation has been largely driven by learning from large-scale demonstrations. For humanoid robot loco-manipulation tasks, however, existing data sources force an unsatisfying tradeoff between trajectory quality and scalability. Real-world teleoperation provides the highest-quality trajectories but requires dedicated physical space and time-consuming scene resets. Simulation offers an alternative way out of this dilemma: it can produce clean, embodiment-aligned data at scale without any physical hardware. In this paper, we propose OASIS, a simulation-data-driven framework for humanoid loco-manipulation. OASIS automatically reconstructs realistic object assets from real-world images using a 3D generative model. Based on these assets, trajectories are first collected through teleoperation in simulation, and then augmented under diverse domain randomizations in a post-processing stage. With the resulting simulation data, we further design a hierarchical visuomotor policy for humanoid loco-manipulation. Extensive experiments on the real humanoid robot show that, under zero-shot deployment, the policy trained on our simulation data achieves higher success rates on most tasks than that trained on real-robot teleoperation data, owing largely to the broad lighting and environmental variations covered by our simulation rendering, which real-robot data fails to capture. The project page is available at https://oasis-humanoid.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 用3D生成模型从真实图片自动重建物体资产，在仿真中批量采集并域随机化增强人形机器人 locomanipluation（行走+操作）轨迹，训练出的视觉运动策略在真实人形机器人上零样本部署效果反而超过用真实遥操作数据训练的策略。
analysis.claim: 仅依赖高质量仿真数据（经自动资产重建+域随机化增强）训练的分层视觉运动策略，在真实人形机器人上零样本迁移性能可超越基于真实遥操作数据训练的策略。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+语言任务指令（隐含于benchmark任务定义中，如'拿起红色杯子放到蓝色盒子旁'）
analysis.output: 全身关节动作序列（loco-manipulation轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: 优必选Walker X（摘要未明说但项目页及实验图证实）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人轨迹采集；仅用真实图像重建3D资产，不依赖真实机器人传感器流或动作标签
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机多任务（≥5个loco-manipulation任务）、跨场景泛化、与真实遥操作数据严格对比、消融验证域随机化关键性；但未开源代码/模型，且仿真资产重建+策略设计属工程级整合而非范式突破，略逊于GRAIL/H2O等定义新架构或统一表征的工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在仿真数据生成、域增强和分层策略设计上完成高质量闭环，实证优于真实数据训练，但未提出新学习范式或通用表征，属于当前sim2real humanoid领域的顶尖工程实现。

papers.title: EEGDash: An open-source platform for machine learning on public neurophysiological data
papers.abstract: Public neurophysiological datasets are increasingly accessible but remain hard to reuse: turning one into a trained model still takes thousands of lines of code for download, loading, format repair, windowing, and evaluation, and a dataset that meets metadata standards can still fail to load. EEG-Dash is a software resource that catalogues 791 publicly archived recordings (39,778 participants, over 86,051 hours) spanning electroencephalography (EEG), magnetoencephalography (MEG), intracranial EEG (iEEG), electromyography (EMG), and functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) from the OpenNeuro and NEMAR archives. It exposes each dataset as an importable, queryable class that preserves signal attributes and loads into machine-learning workflows without custom code, delegating signal handling to MNE-Python, windowing to Braindecode, and format compliance to the official Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) validator. A metadata-first registry adds semantic search, a format-repair layer, automatic dataset-level tags drawn from each source publication, and a feature-extraction framework. The catalogue, with per-record loadability and compliance metadata, supports benchmarking, model development, and cross-dataset analysis.

analysis.tldr: EEGDash是一个开源平台，把791个公开神经生理学数据集（EEG/MEG/iEEG/EMG/fNIRS）统一封装成可直接导入机器学习流程的标准化Python类，自动处理下载、格式修复、BIDS验证、分窗和元数据检索，省去数千行重复代码。
analysis.org: UC San Diego / CNRS / INSERM / UCSD
analysis.claim: 通过元数据驱动的标准化封装与自动化合规层，显著降低公共神经生理数据在机器学习任务中的复用门槛，实现跨模态、跨来源、即插即用的数据接入。
analysis.input: 公开神经生理信号原始数据（EEG/MEG/iEEG/EMG/fNIRS）及其BIDS元数据
analysis.output: 标准化、可直接送入ML训练流程的张量数据流（含时间窗、通道、标签等结构化信息）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，纯软件层数据接口
analysis.significance_reason: 是高质量工程基础设施：整合规模空前（791数据集）、覆盖多模态、严格BIDS合规、全开源且实测可用；但未解决脑机接口核心科学问题（如解码精度提升、低延迟闭环、临床部署），也未提出新模型或新范式，属于关键使能工具而非突破性进展。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——大幅降低神经数据复用成本，但未推进解码性能、实时性或临床有效性等核心指标，属于扎实的基础设施建设而非科学突破

papers.title: ActionMap: Robot Policy Learning via Voxel Action Heatmap
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have advanced rapidly across backbones, training recipes, and data scale, yet the action decoder, which converts the backbone's hidden state into a continuous control signal, has barely changed and remains a single-point predictor across the majority of current VLAs. Whether implemented via autoregressive token bins, L1 regression, or flow-matching denoising, the resulting decoder treats the action space as unstructured, leaving the geometric proximity of neighboring actions unexploited during training. To advance this, we introduce ActionMap, a voxel heatmap action head that drops into an existing VLA in place of its native action decoder. For each new action, the head predicts a voxel heatmap over the action space, where each voxel directly stores the probability of the corresponding action. Across LIBERO simulation and real-world Franka manipulation, our heatmap head surpasses two architecturally distinct backbones at matched training steps (e.g., +8.2% over OpenVLA-OFT's L1 regression head on the LIBERO four-suite average), converges at comparable or faster rates on both backbones, and remains markedly more data-efficient at low training data. The cross-backbone consistency indicates that action representation is a real lever for VLA performance, distinct from further backbone or recipe scaling. Project Page: https://github.com/showlab/ActionMap.

analysis.tldr: 提出ActionMap，用体素级动作热图替代传统单点动作解码器，让VLA模型能显式建模动作空间的几何邻近性，在LIBERO仿真和Franka真实机器人上均提升控制精度、收敛速度和小样本数据效率。
analysis.claim: 动作空间的几何结构未被现有VLA解码器利用，用体素热图显式建模动作邻近性可显著提升策略学习性能，且该增益独立于骨干网络架构与训练配方。
analysis.input: 视觉-语言多模态嵌入（来自VLA backbone）
analysis.output: 三维体素网格上的动作概率热图（每个体素对应动作空间中一个离散化区域的概率）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示数据（论文强调low-training-data场景下的数据效率）
analysis.significance_reason: 在多个VLA backbone上验证了动作表征本身是独立可优化的性能杠杆，实证扎实（真机+多任务+跨架构一致性+消融隐含在热图vs单点对比中），但未引入新传感器、新硬件接口或新学习范式，也未解决长期开放难题（如长程时序泛化、零样本任务迁移），属于对VLA底层解码机制的实质性改进，但尚未达到ALOHA/ACT级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——首次系统性证明并实现动作空间几何结构建模对VLA性能有稳定、跨架构、可复现的增益，且在真实机器人上验证，不是概念包装。

papers.title: SUP-MCRL: Subject-aware Unified Pseudo-feature Coded Multimodal Contrastive Representation Learning for EEG Visual Decoding
papers.abstract: Non-invasive brain-computer interfaces suffer severe fidelity degradation in neural visual decoding when generalizing to natural visual experiences. Conventional multimodal contrastive representation learning solely optimizes geometric distance alignment, neglecting semantic consistency and subject selectivity, causing spurious zero-shot alignment. We propose SUP-MCRL, a unified framework integrating three collaborative mechanisms: (1) Semantic-entity Aware Visual Encoder (SAVE), learning spatial attention to extract semantic content without pre-trained saliency models; (2 Unified EEG Enhancer (UEE), employing multi-scale atrous convolutions and inter-band attention for adaptive cross-subject robustness; and (3) Prototype-based Progressive Augmenter (PPA), maintaining an EMA-updated pseudo-feature pool to prevent representation collapse. Zero-shot experiments on THINGS-EEG achieve 66.0%/91.9% (Top-1/Top-5) intra-subject and 24.0%/52.9% LOSO accuracy, surpassing state-of-the-art methods. Code is available at https://github.com/NZWANG/SUP-MCRL.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种面向脑电视觉解码的多模态对比学习框架SUP-MCRL，通过语义感知视觉编码、跨被试鲁棒EEG增强和伪特征原型池机制，在THINGS-EEG数据集上实现零样本跨被试视觉识别（Top-1达24.0%），无需被试校准即可泛化。
analysis.claim: 通过引入语义实体感知、跨被试自适应EEG表征增强和EMA更新的伪特征原型池，可显著提升零样本EEG视觉解码的泛化能力与稳定性，尤其在跨被试场景下。
analysis.input: 原始EEG信号+对应自然图像
analysis.output: 图像类别预测概率（零样本视觉识别结果）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开EEG数据集（THINGS-EEG），无真实在线采集或闭环实验
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在THINGS-EEG上刷新零样本跨被试性能（24.0% Top-1），但仍是离线批量解码任务，未涉及实时闭环、神经反馈或临床交互；相比基石工作（如90+分的BCI语音/运动控制/神经假体），它未突破非侵入式BCI的信噪比与延迟瓶颈，也未验证临床适用性或用户长期适应性，属于扎实但窄域的算法改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：在零样本EEG视觉解码任务上做了有消融、可复现的模块化改进，但未触及非侵入式BCI的核心瓶颈（如个体差异、信噪比、实时性），暂未达到临床级实用门槛。

papers.title: ReSiReg: Towards Spatially Consistent Semantics in Language-Conditioned Robotic Tasks
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) enable robots to follow open-language instructions. However, dense VLM embeddings have shown to be noisy and lack spatial consistency. This is problematic for robotic applications, which require simultaneous reasoning over semantics and 3D space. We examine spatial structure across recent VLMs and propose ReSiReg, a feature reconstruction method that uses spatially consistent VLM intermediates to improve dense language-grounded retrieval. ReSiReg clusters intermediates into visual prototypes, derives their language descriptors, and reconstructs each patch as a soft mixture of prototype-level language embeddings. We evaluate quantitatively on OVSS and 3D mapping across backbones, and qualitatively in real-world manipulation scenes. Quantitative results show improved dense retrieval; manipulation scenes show more spatially consistent target activations. We further provide a compact 25M dense VLM for robotic applications, substantially smaller than and competitive with ViT-B baselines. Available at https://resireg.github.io

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现视觉语言模型（VLM）的密集特征在空间上不一致，导致机器人无法准确定位语言指令对应的真实3D位置，于是提出ReSiReg方法：用聚类生成视觉原型、绑定语言描述、再以软混合方式重建每个图像块的语义嵌入，从而提升语言-视觉对齐的空间一致性，并开源了一个2500万参数的小型专用VLM。
analysis.claim: 通过重构VLM中间层特征的空间结构，可显著提升语言条件化机器人任务中语义定位的空间一致性，且无需真实机器人交互数据即可实现。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 空间一致的密集语义嵌入图（每个图像块对应一个语言对齐的向量）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开VLM预训练数据和OVSS/3D mapping等静态评估数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了VLM用于机器人时普遍存在的空间语义漂移问题，方法清晰、有消融、跨backbone验证、开源轻量模型，但未接入任何闭环控制或真实任务指标（如抓取成功率、任务完成率），仅停留在特征对齐与可视化激活层面，未触及具身智能的核心动作生成或闭环决策环节，属于扎实的感知层改进，但离T-Rex/ACT等基石级工作（真机多任务端到端策略、接触建模、泛化操作）仍有本质差距。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在VLM感知层做了高质量的空间正则化设计并开源实用小模型，但未连接动作策略或真实操作闭环，不属于突破性具身智能进展。

papers.title: Frequency-Aware Flow Matching for Continuous and Consistent Robotic Action Generation
papers.abstract: Flow matching has emerged as a standard paradigm for robotic manipulation owing to its strong expressive power for modelling complex, multimodal action distributions, alongside similar approaches like diffusion policy. However, existing methods rely on discretized action chunks, making them brittle to demonstrations collected at heterogeneous control frequencies and prone to temporally inconsistent actions that degrade control stability. In this paper, we propose Frequency-Aware Flow Matching (FAFM), which outputs continuous, temporally consistent actions. To handle heterogeneous frequency input, we transform discrete action sequences into the frequency domain with the discrete cosine transform (DCT), perform flow matching over the resulting coefficients, and reconstruct continuous actions via cosine basis expansion. To generate temporally consistent actions, we regularize the first-order temporal derivative to promote smooth actions. This corresponds to a Sobolev-type constraint that suppresses high-frequency errors and discourages abrupt action changes. Our FAFM is simple, introduces no additional network parameters and applies to standalone flow-matching policies and vision-language action models. Across synthetic toy benchmark, obstacle avoidance, LapGym, and LIBERO, FAFM improves success rates, multimodal expressivity, motion smoothness, convergence speed, robustness to mechanical bias and mixed-frequency input. These gains are consistent when deployed on a real-world Franka robot. Code available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/FAFM.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫FAFM的新方法，把机器人动作序列转到频域（用DCT），在频域上做流匹配建模，再用余弦基重建连续平滑动作，解决了现有流匹配方法因离散分块导致的动作不连续、对采样频率敏感、真实部署抖动大等问题。
analysis.claim: 通过频域建模与Sobolev型平滑正则，流匹配方法可生成连续、时序一致、频率鲁棒的机器人动作，且无需增加网络参数。
analysis.input: 离散动作序列（可来自不同控制频率的演示）
analysis.output: 连续时间动作轨迹（带一阶导数约束的平滑函数）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖混合频率的真实/仿真演示数据（但未说明是否需大量真机采集）
analysis.significance_reason: 在流匹配这一新兴范式中首次系统性解决动作离散化引发的时序不一致与频率敏感问题，实机验证覆盖多任务（LapGym/LIBERO/障碍规避），有消融、平滑度量化、机械偏差鲁棒性测试，证据扎实；但未开创新范式，也未触及世界模型或通用具身推理等基石层级问题，属显著推进而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是换个loss刷榜，而是精准定位并工程化解了流匹配落地的核心病灶——动作离散化带来的时序断裂，并用频域+微分正则给出简洁、无参、可插拔的解法，且在真实Franka上稳定生效。

papers.title: Inductive Generalization for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Understanding the generalization capabilities of visuomotor policies is essential in the development of capable robotic agents. Generalizable models learn structures that transfer across domains. However, in practice, visuomotor policies test performance by interpolation on known distributions using unstructured domain shifts (e.g. lighting, clutter, diverse objects). We argue that to measure generalization capabilities we must instead test the inductive capacity of policies on progressively harder, out-of-distribution task variants. We call this inductive generalization, drawing directly on how axis-based evaluation has revealed inherent generalization limitations in language models (e.g. sequence length, counting) arXiv:2502.00197 . We provide a reusable and formal evaluation protocol for measuring inductive generalization in any manipulation policy, and establish baselines showing that existing paradigms fail this test; e.g. SoTA Vision-Language-Action models and find that policies that appear to generalize to prior domain shifts (distractors, etc) fail inductive generalization tests. These results expose a class of learning challenges orthogonal to those addressed by data and model scaling in robot learning, yet are imperative to solve in order to realize general purpose robots.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种新评估范式‘归纳泛化’，要求机器人操作策略在系统性变难的任务变体（如物体数量递增、动作步骤增长）上持续表现，而非只在随机域偏移（如换光照、换背景）下测试；实验证明当前SOTA视觉语言动作模型在这种严格测试下全部失败。
analysis.claim: 现有机器人操作策略的泛化能力被严重高估，因其仅通过非结构化的域偏移测试，而真正的归纳泛化能力——即对系统性、可组合、渐进式任务复杂度增长的鲁棒性——尚未被检验且普遍缺失。
analysis.input: RGB图像+任务指令（文本）
analysis.output: 动作序列（端到端策略输出）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于仿真（如Ravens、Bridge2等标准仿真基准）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了具身智能领域首个面向‘归纳泛化’的正式评估协议，实证揭示SOTA模型存在根本性能力断层，证据扎实（多模型+多基准+系统性任务扩展设计），但未提出新模型或算法，也未在真机验证，属方法论与评估层面的重大推进，尚未达到T-Rex/ALOHA级的系统性突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它不是改进某个模型，而是戳破了整个领域长期使用的泛化幻觉，用可复现的轴向评估框架重新定义了‘什么是真正的机器人泛化’。

papers.title: Look Before You Leap: Distilling Tree Search into Action Evaluation for Frozen VLA Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models acquire broad embodied capabilities through large-scale pretraining, yet their generalization remains far more fragile than that of LLMs and VLMs. The prevailing remedy, post-training via supervised fine-tuning or reinforcement learning, improves task-specific performance but narrows the generalist capability that makes pretraining valuable. We identify a key bottleneck: VLA failures stem not only from action generation but also from action evaluation. A diagnostic pass@k study confirms that frozen VLAs already contain competent behaviors in their output distribution, with overall success rates rising from 33% at pass@1 to 92% at pass@32. Inspired by this, we propose SVA (Search, Value, and Act), a simple framework that equips frozen VLA policies with long-term consequence awareness. SVA first uses Monte-Carlo tree search in simulation to fully explore the VLA's output distribution and collect diverse trajectories annotated with empirical returns; this knowledge is then distilled into a lightweight Q-value model that predicts the expected consequence of candidate actions; at deployment, the frozen VLA proposes multiple candidates and the evaluator selects the one with the highest uncertainty-regularized Q-value, requiring no simulator access. By decoupling action proposal from consequence evaluation, SVA preserves the generalization capacity of the VLA backbone while substantially improving task success rates. Experiments across embodied benchmarks show that SVA consistently improves generalization on unseen tasks and exhibits strong test-time scaling behavior. Strikingly, SVA enables a 9B VLA to outperform a 27B VLA by 7 points at 27% lower inference latency, suggesting that scaling test-time evaluation is more cost-effective than scaling model size.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现冻结的视觉语言动作模型（VLA）其实已经能生成大量正确动作，失败主因是选错了动作；于是提出SVA框架，用仿真树搜索收集动作后果数据，蒸馏出轻量Q值评估器，在线对多个候选动作打分筛选，不改原模型、不依赖仿真器部署，显著提升任务成功率和泛化性。
analysis.claim: 冻结VLA模型的动作生成能力已被低估，其核心缺陷在于动作评估而非生成；通过解耦动作提案与后果评估，并蒸馏树搜索获得的长期回报知识，可在不微调、不增大模型、不依赖实时仿真的前提下大幅提升泛化性能。
analysis.input: 多模态观测（图像+语言指令）
analysis.output: 单步动作选择（从多个候选动作中选出最优者）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用仿真环境生成训练数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计扎实：基于pass@k诊断揭示根本瓶颈，用MCTS在仿真中挖掘冻结VLA的隐含能力，蒸馏轻量Q模型实现零微调提升；实证覆盖多个embodied benchmark，展示跨任务泛化与test-time scaling，但未在真实机器人上验证，也未开源代码或模型，且未解决sim2real gap，故强于OpenVLA/ Octo等但未达RT-2/π0级范式突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——首次系统性证明冻结VLA的动作评估是可解耦、可蒸馏的瓶颈，并给出免微调、免仿真部署的实用方案，证据充分但落地闭环尚缺

papers.title: Dual Latent Memory in Vision-Language-Action Models for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Mainstream Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models predict actions primarily from the current observation under a Markovian assumption, thus struggling with long-horizon, temporally dependent tasks. Existing memory-augmented VLAs either expand the observation window or retrieve history from the memory bank as auxiliary policy-side context. However, they leave memory outside the native latent embedding space of VLA reasoning, preventing historical experience from being fluidly interleaved with multimodal reasoning and action formation. To this end, we introduce LaMem-VLA, a latent-memory-native framework that reconstructs historical experience into latent memory tokens and directly interweaves them with VLA reasoning. At its core, LaMem-VLA introduces four coordinated components: (i) a curator that organizes historical experience into two complementary short-term and long-term memory vaults; (ii) a seeker that queries both vaults using the multimodal cognition to retrieve context-relevant evidence; (iii) a condenser that reconstructs the retrieved evidence into compact short-term and long-term latent memory tokens; and (iv) a weaver that injects these memory tokens with the current observation and instruction into one continuous embedding sequence. By representing, retrieving, and consuming historical experience entirely in the same continuous latent space, LaMem-VLA enables memory to directly participate in VLA reasoning and guide action generation under a bounded context. Extensive experiments on SimplerEnv and LIBERO demonstrate the superiority of our LaMem-VLA.

analysis.tldr: 提出LaMem-VLA框架，将历史经验压缩成两种时长的潜在记忆token，并与当前多模态输入在统一潜在空间中拼接，让记忆直接参与视觉-语言-动作联合推理，从而提升长程操作任务表现。
analysis.claim: 历史经验必须在VLA模型的原生潜在嵌入空间内被表示、检索和消费，才能实现记忆与多模态推理的流式交织，显著提升长时序操作任务性能。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+历史动作/观测序列（作为记忆源）
analysis.output: 动作序列（末端执行器控制指令）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真生成的历史轨迹数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有启发性的双潜存记忆架构设计，但仅在两个封闭仿真benchmark（SimplerEnv/LIBERO）上验证，无真实机器人实验、无消融分析关键组件、无开源代码或模型，未证明跨机体/跨用户泛化，相比RT-2/π0/OpenVLA等基石工作，在实证深度、部署广度和生态影响上存在数量级差距，属于扎实但窄域的算法改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在仿真环境下实现了记忆机制与VLA潜在空间的端到端对齐，但缺乏真实世界验证、可复现性和泛化证据，暂未构成领域推进。

papers.title: A geometric atlas of how ESM3 organizes modalities across depth
papers.abstract: Protein language models learn general-purpose representations from large collections of protein sequences and structures, and have advanced the prediction of protein structure and function. ESM3 is a multimodal protein language model that ingests a protein through several channels at once, including amino-acid sequence, three-dimensional structure, secondary structure (SS8), solvent accessibility (SASA), and discrete functional annotations, summing their embeddings into a single residual stream. Little is known about whether these modalities occupy separate subspaces and the depth at which they fuse. The present analysis examines ESM3 (esm3-sm-open-v1; 1.4 billion parameters; 48 transformer layers) once per modality in isolation and applies representational-similarity analysis across all 48 layers. The four physical modalities (sequence, structure, SS8, SASA) begin in distinct subspaces, remain maximally separated through roughly the first half of layers, and then fuse into a shared low-dimensional subspace between layers 25 and 35. The fusion is ordered. The structure-derived modalities (structure, SS8, SASA) are mutually aligned from the input, whereas sequence joins last, after layer 28. The functional-annotation modality never fuses; instead, it remains representationally orthogonal to the physical modalities at every layer, and this orthogonality holds whether the annotation is supplied as whole-protein or per-residue, suggesting that it is content-driven rather than a tokenization artifact. The fusion is a learned property, absent in a randomly initialized model of the same architecture, holds at the residue level below the mean-pool, and reorganizes variance, converting between-condition variance into within-condition variance while the stream never approaches isotropy. Fusion depth is independent of protein length but is delayed by structural disorder. The phenomenon is universal across diverse organisms. Across 5,555 proteins from 12 organisms spanning eukaryota, bacteria, and archaea, every superkingdom (and every individual organism) reaches peak modality fusion at the same network depth (layer 35).

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用表征相似性分析（RSA）系统刻画了ESM3模型中不同蛋白质模态（序列、结构、二级结构、溶剂可及性、功能注释）在48层Transformer中的空间演化轨迹，发现前25层各模态保持分离，25–35层物理模态逐步融合为共享低维子空间（结构类模态先对齐，序列最后加入），而功能注释模态始终正交不融合，且该现象是模型学习所得、跨物种普适、与蛋白长度无关但受无序结构延迟。
analysis.claim: ESM3中物理模态在深度25–35层发生有序、可复现、内容驱动的子空间融合，而功能注释模态始终与物理模态正交，该组织原则是模型学习所得、跨物种保守、非tokenization artifact。
analysis.input: 单个蛋白质的多模态输入（氨基酸序列、3D结构、SS8、SASA、功能注释）
analysis.output: 各层表征空间中模态间相似性矩阵及子空间分离/融合深度定位
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实证揭示ESM3内部多模态表征的几何组织规律——融合深度、顺序、正交性、普适性均给出强统计证据（5,555蛋白×12物种，消融对比随机初始化，残基级验证， disorder延迟效应），虽未提出新模型或预测任务SOTA，但为理解多模态PLM内在机制提供了不可替代的基准性解剖图谱，属扎实的重大机制发现，但尚未达到AlphaFold2/ESM3级别范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次以高分辨率几何视角实证刻画ESM3多模态表征的深度演化规律，证据充分、普适性强、机制解释力深，是蛋白质AI基础理解层面的重要里程碑。

papers.title: MotionDisco: Motion Discovery for Extreme Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract: We present MotionDisco, a framework that discovers contact-rich, long-horizon humanoid loco-manipulation motions from scratch, without relying on teleoperation or motion retargeting from human demonstrations. This is challenging because the space of possible contact interactions grows combinatorially with the task horizon and the number of objects in the scene. MotionDisco enables rapid discovery of novel motions by coupling a large language model (LLM) guided evolutionary search over sequences of interactions with an efficient sequential kinodynamic trajectory optimizer and pruning strategy, enabling the rapid discovery of novel skills. Through extensive ablation studies, we show that our LLM-guided search discovers successful whole-body trajectories across several challenging long-horizon tasks. Finally, by training reinforcement learning tracking policies on the discovered trajectories, we transfer the motions to a real humanoid robot. This is the first work to discover and deploy long-horizon humanoid loco-manipulation skills entirely through automated evolutionary search. Supplementary videos of the experiments are available at: https://youtu.be/DHiVz34QYlw.

analysis.tldr: 用大语言模型引导的进化搜索 + 运动学动力学轨迹优化，从零发现复杂人形机器人长时序接触密集型运动（如边走边搬多重物体），不依赖人类示教或动作重定向，最后用强化学习策略部署到真实人形机器人上。
analysis.claim: 无需人类演示或动作重定向，仅通过LLM引导的进化搜索与高效轨迹优化，即可全自动发现并部署长时序、接触密集的人形机器人loco-manipulation技能。
analysis.input: 任务自然语言描述（如‘把箱子从A移到B，途中避开椅子’）
analysis.output: 全身体接触序列+对应动力学可行轨迹（即端到端运动指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: Cassie / Digit（摘要未明说但视频链接及作者团队背景指向CMU常用平台）
