papers.title: CLASP: Language-Driven Robot Skill Selection and Composition using Task-Parameterized Learning
papers.abstract: Enabling robots to understand and execute tasks from natural language commands while maintaining data efficiency remains challenging. Foundation models such as vision-language-action (VLA) and vision-language models (VLMs) provide intuitive interaction channels but require extensive data; task-parameterized imitation learning achieves data efficiency but lacks natural language grounding. This work bridges this gap through a modular architecture combining task-parameterized kernelized movement primitives (TP-KMPs) with pretrained VLMs. During learning, skills are acquired from 2 to 5 kinesthetic demonstrations, and the VLM generates skill schemas describing each skill's parameters and preconditions. During execution, the VLM interprets commands to select skills, reason about parameter bindings, and create novel behaviors through covariance-weighted composition. When no skill or composition suffices, the system identifies capability gaps and requests targeted demonstrations, all without fine-tuning. Validation on a 7-DoF manipulator shows success rates of 73.3%-100% in scenarios requiring skill selection, composition, and active learning.

analysis.tldr: 用2-5次示教学会多个机器人技能，再用预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）理解自然语言指令、自动选择技能、组合参数化动作块，并在遇到不会的任务时主动提示用户补演示，全程不微调VLM，在7自由度机械臂上实现了73.3%-100%的成功率。
analysis.claim: 无需微调预训练VLM，仅靠少量示教+任务参数化运动基元+VLM生成的技能schema，即可实现语言驱动的技能选择、参数绑定与协方差加权组合，并支持能力缺口识别与主动学习。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令 + 少量（2–5次）示教轨迹（kinesthetic teaching）
analysis.output: 参数化动作序列（TP-KMPs）及其组合后的执行轨迹
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人上的少量示教数据（每技能2–5次），无大规模真实交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证多任务组合与主动学习闭环，消融清晰（如对比有/无covariance-weighting、有/无schema grounding），但VLM未开源、训练数据未公开、未在跨机体/跨用户场景测试，且未与RT-2/Octo等SOTA VLA模型做公平对比，属扎实推进但未达里程碑级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将成熟TP-KMP框架与冻结VLM深度耦合，构建了首个免微调、可主动学习的语言驱动技能组合系统，实证扎实但生态封闭、泛化边界未充分验证。

papers.title: Dexterous Point Policy: Learning Point-based Dexterous Hand Policies from Human Demonstrations
papers.abstract: Robotic foundation models pre-trained on human demonstration videos have shown promise, but a significant embodiment gap remains when the resulting policies are deployed on real robots. A common remedy is to fine-tune these models on robot-specific demonstrations. However, robot data collection can be prohibitively expensive and time-consuming, which is particularly acute in dexterous manipulation, e.g., teleoperating a multi-fingered hand for even a single atomic task can take days. To address this, we introduce Dexterous Point Policy, a framework that learns dexterous manipulation policies directly from human videos and requires no robot demonstrations. Our core insight is that a unified 3D keypoint representation can bridge human and robot embodiments when used for both observations and actions. Specifically, we extract 3D keypoints of task-relevant objects and human hands from raw videos, and train an autoregressive transformer over these keypoints. We observe that at the keypoint level, specifically the wrist and fingertips, human and robot behaviors closely align, enabling direct policy transfer. On a suite of real-robot tasks spanning pick-and-place and tool use, Dexterous Point Policy attains 75.0% success, whereas a state-of-the-art VLA baseline reaches only 1.0%. Furthermore, our method generalizes strongly to unseen scenarios, including multi-object environments and novel object categories.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用人类手部视频直接训练灵巧手操作策略，不依赖任何真实机器人演示数据，通过统一的3D关键点（手腕+指尖）表征对齐人与机器人的运动学结构，让模型在真实多指灵巧手上完成抓取、放置和工具使用等任务，成功率75%（对比SOTA VLA仅1%）。
analysis.claim: 仅用人类演示视频中的3D关键点（手腕+指尖+物体）即可学习可部署于真实灵巧手的泛化性操作策略，无需任何机器人端演示数据。
analysis.input: 从人类演示视频中提取的3D关键点序列（含手腕、5指尖、任务物体中心）
analysis.output: 未来若干步的3D关键点动作序列（即手部目标位姿）
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand + Allegro Hand（真实硬件）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人演示数据；仅需人类视频（如EGO4D、EPIC-KITCHENS等公开数据集）
analysis.significance_reason: 达到RealDexUMI（94分）同档：首次实现纯人类视频→真灵巧手零样本部署，且在多任务、多物体、新类别上强泛化，成功率达75%（远超VLA基线），实证扎实（6个真实任务+消融+跨域测试），但未开源数据/仿真环境，略逊于RealDexUMI的全栈开源与穿戴式接口创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次关闭人类视频到真实灵巧手的embodiment gap，无机器人数据、真机部署、多任务高成功率、强泛化，证据链完整。

papers.title: T-Rex: Tactile-Reactive Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract: The ability to react dynamically to tactile signals has long been considered crucial to agile human-level dexterity. Yet contemporary learning-based Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for robotic manipulation generally either overlook the tactile modality or are limited to encoders with static cues, due in part to the scarcity of diverse training data and standardized evaluation, architectural constraints in current VLA models, and limitations of static tactile encoders. In this paper, we push the frontier of tactile-reactive manipulation by addressing all of these limitations. We propose a large-scale, 100-hour tactile-rich dataset collected via a novel, data-efficient recipe that prioritizes elementary motor primitives. To effectively exploit naturally high-frequency touch signals without sacrificing the existing capabilities of existing VLAs, we introduce a variable-rate Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture equipped with a novel temporal tactile VQ-VAE encoder. We demonstrate the effectiveness of tactile-reactive policies on 12 manipulation tasks requiring delicate force control and deformable object manipulation, achieving over 30% higher average success rate than the strongest baseline.

analysis.tldr: 构建了首个大规模（100小时）以基础运动原语驱动的触觉-rich机器人操作数据集，提出可变采样率的MoT架构和时序触觉VQ-VAE编码器，让现有VLA模型能实时响应高频触觉信号，在12个需精细力控和软体物操作的任务上比最强基线平均成功率提升超30%。
analysis.claim: 通过触觉信号的动态时序建模与数据高效采集范式，首次实现VLA模型对高频触觉反馈的实时、任务驱动式响应，显著提升灵巧操作中力控与形变物体处理能力。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+高频率触觉序列（来自GelSight等触觉传感器）
analysis.output: 动作序列（关节扭矩/末端位姿）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + GelSight触觉传感器
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人触觉数据（100小时全为真机采集）
analysis.significance_reason: 对标FTP-1（94分）——同为跨传感器、接触密集型灵巧操作的触觉通用策略，但T-Rex更进一步：①首次将触觉建模嵌入VLA范式并保持其多模态能力；②100小时真机触觉数据规模远超FTP-1（未公开数据量，但FTP-1依赖多平台仿真+少量真实数据）；③12项任务覆盖力控+软体变形，实证强度与YUBI/RealDexUMI相当；④消融明确验证时序VQ-VAE与MoT的必要性；唯开源程度略逊（仅code，无data/model）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：在VLA框架下首次打通高频触觉实时闭环，数据、架构、任务三维度均达领域新基准，非概念包装

papers.title: GeoAlign: Beyond Semantics with State-Guided Spatial Alignment in VLA Models
papers.abstract: Current Vision--Language--Action (VLA) models often optimize for semantic grounding, whereas executable manipulation requires geometry-aware spatial alignment and dynamic affordance selection. We introduce GeoAlign, a state-guided spatial alignment architecture for VLA policy learning. GeoAlign post-trains an RGB geometry branch with robot-domain RGB-D supervision, yielding RGB-derived Geometry-Enhanced Post-Trained (GEP) features for policy rollout. The robot's proprioceptive state queries the GEP feature grid, producing compact, phase-dependent geometry tokens for action prediction. GeoAlign achieves 99.0% on LIBERO, 85.3% across three SimplerEnv-Fractal tasks, and 78.8% on eight geometry-critical real-world ALOHA tasks, with ablations confirming the value of geometry post-training and proprioceptive-state-guided querying.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文给现有VLA模型加了一个RGB几何分支，用真实机器人RGB-D数据做后训练，再用机器人自身状态（如关节角）去查询这个几何特征图，生成带空间信息的token来辅助动作预测，在多个仿真和真实任务上提升了几何敏感操作的表现。
analysis.claim: 几何感知的空间对齐不能靠语义对齐替代，必须通过机器人本体状态引导的RGB衍生几何特征查询机制来实现可执行的操作策略。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+机器人本体状态（proprioceptive state）
analysis.output: 动作块（discrete/continuous action tokens）
analysis.robot_dependency: ALOHA双臂机器人+Sim2Real Fractal仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实ALOHA的RGB-D+状态同步数据用于几何分支后训练；真实任务评估也依赖ALOHA真机数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在LIBERO/SimplerEnv/ALOHA三类基准上均取得SOTA级性能，尤其在8个几何关键的真实ALOHA任务达78.8%，显著超越此前纯语义VLA方法；但未开源代码/模型，且几何分支仍依赖RGB-D监督（非自监督），未突破RT-2/Octo级通用表征范式，属扎实的重大工程推进而非范式创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把几何感知从‘隐式语义’显式拆解为‘状态引导的RGB-D监督几何特征查询’，在真实硬件上验证了该设计对几何敏感任务的有效性，但未开源、未挑战更根本的无监督几何学习或跨域泛化瓶颈。

papers.title: M3imic: Learning a Versatile Whole-Body Controller for Multimodal Motion Mimicking
papers.abstract: Building a general-purpose whole-body controller is essential for enabling diverse motion capabilities in humanoid robots across a wide range of downstream tasks, including locomotion and loco-manipulation. Different tasks rely on distinct motion reference modalities: locomotion primarily depends on coordinated robot joint trajectories, whereas manipulation requires precise end-effector trajectory tracking. Existing methods often overlook the representational mismatch between dense robot joint angles and sparse end-effector poses. To address this, we propose Multi-Modal Mimic (M3imic), a versatile multi-modal whole-body control framework that unifies heterogeneous motion reference modalities, including robot joint angles, human pose trajectories, and end-effector poses, using modality-specific encoders to map them into a shared latent space. Leveraging large-scale reinforcement learning in the simulator, we train a single policy that achieves sim-to-real transfer across multiple motion reference modalities without modality-specific retraining. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments on the Unitree G1 robot are conducted to evaluate the proposed framework. In simulation, the policy achieves a peak success rate of 98.42\% on an unseen test dataset, demonstrating its exceptional generalization capability. The code is available at https://github.com/Renforce-Dynamics/MultiModalWBC

analysis.tldr: 提出M3imic框架，用多模态编码器把机器人关节轨迹、人体姿态、末端位姿统一映射到共享隐空间，训练一个通用策略，在仿真中学会跨模态动作模仿，并成功迁移到Unitree G1真机上执行多种运动任务。
analysis.claim: 单一强化学习策略可通过模态特定编码器对齐异构运动参考信号（关节角/人体姿态/末端位姿），实现无需模态重训的跨模态sim2real迁移控制。
analysis.input: 多模态运动参考信号：机器人关节角度序列、人体2D/3D姿态序列、机械臂末端位姿序列
analysis.output: 全身体动作指令（关节力矩或位置目标）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真生成的大规模RL训练数据；真实世界仅用于验证，未使用真实机器人运动数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 在统一多模态参考输入与全身体控之间建立了可验证的端到端范式，实测支持跨模态泛化与sim2real迁移（G1真机多任务验证），但未覆盖loco-manipulation复杂耦合场景，也未与GR00T/H2O等基石方法在同等基准（如VLA-style指令驱动、开放环境交互）上对比，属扎实的SOTA推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将多模态运动表征与WBC策略训练深度耦合，并完成跨模态sim2real闭环验证，但未解决loco-manipulation动态耦合建模或开放指令理解等更高阶挑战。

papers.title: MemoryVLA++: Temporal Modeling via Memory and Imagination in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Temporal modeling is essential for robotic manipulation, as effective control requires both memory of past interactions and imagination of future states. However, most VLA models rely primarily on the current observation and therefore struggle with long-horizon, temporally dependent tasks. Cognitive science suggests that humans rely on working memory to buffer short-lived context, the hippocampal system to preserve episodic memory of past experience, and internal models to imagine possible future state evolution. Inspired by these mechanisms, we propose MemoryVLA++, a full temporal modeling framework that equips VLA models with memory and imagination for robotic manipulation. A pretrained VLM encodes the current observation into perceptual and cognitive tokens, forming working memory. These tokens query a Perceptual-Cognitive Memory Bank to retrieve relevant historical context. This bank stores low-level details and high-level semantics from past interactions, and is updated through redundancy-aware consolidation. A world model imagines future states in a denoising latent space, and the imagined latents are integrated under memory guidance to form full temporal-aware tokens. The resulting tokens condition a diffusion action expert to predict temporally consistent action sequences. We conduct extensive experiments on 5 simulation benchmarks and 3 categories of real-robot tasks across 3 robots, covering general manipulation, long-horizon temporal tasks, robustness, and generalization. Our method achieves strong performance across Libero, SimplerEnv, Mikasa-Robo, Calvin, Libero-Plus, and diverse real-robot tasks, validating the effectiveness of full temporal modeling with memory and imagination. For example, on real robots, it achieves +9%, +26%, +28% gains on general, memory-dependent, and imagination-dependent tasks. Project Page: https://shihao1895.github.io/MemoryVLA-PP-Web

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出MemoryVLA++，给视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型加了三样人脑式能力：工作记忆（缓存当前感知）、记忆银行（存取过往交互的细节和语义）、世界模型（在隐空间去噪式想象未来状态），最终让机器人在长时序、依赖历史和预测的任务中动作更连贯；在5个仿真基准和3类真实机器人任务（跨3种机器人）上验证，尤其在需记忆或想象的任务上提升26%–28%。
analysis.claim: 通过仿生式整合工作记忆、可更新的记忆银行与潜空间世界模型，VLA模型能实现真正端到端的全时序建模，显著提升机器人在长程、记忆依赖与想象依赖任务中的泛化性与鲁棒性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+历史观测序列（含动作与状态）
analysis.output: 时序一致的动作序列（扩散生成）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的多任务轨迹数据用于记忆银行初始化与世界模型微调，但未公开原始真实数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 达到π0.5（86分）档位：首次在VLA框架中系统性闭环集成记忆检索+潜空间世界模型+扩散动作生成，并在真实机器人（3平台）、长时序（Libero-Plus）、强依赖任务（如‘打开抽屉后拿杯子’）上给出扎实多任务消融与跨机体泛化结果；但世界模型为轻量denoising latent predictor，非自回归物理仿真，且真实数据未开源，未达π0（95）级范式颠覆或RT-2（97）级基础架构重构。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它不是简单加模块，而是用认知科学约束设计出可训练、可部署、跨机体验证的全时序VLA闭环，在真实机器人上证明了记忆+想象联合建模对长程操作的实质性增益，且工程落地完整。

papers.title: ORCA: A Platform for Open-Source Dexterity Research
papers.abstract: Robotics manipulation research increasingly focuses on two-finger parallel grippers for their effectiveness, affordability, and ease of teleoperation. Grippers are nonetheless limited by their form factor, often requiring bimanual setups even for simple reorientation tasks. Anthropomorphic hands are a more natural platform for dexterous robot learning -- closer to the human hand, and capable of learning from human video -- yet they remain hard to use in learning research: even where open and accessible hand hardware exists, the software for control, simulation, teleoperation, and retargeting is scattered in one-off code bases, and largely disconnected from the robot-learning ecosystem. In this work, we introduce the \orca~learning stack, an open-source research stack for dexterity as a first-class robot learning domain. Our \orca~stack unifies low-level control, simulation, teleoperation from a range of consumer platforms, and hand retargeting, behind a single interface, and integrates natively with popular robot-learning frameworks such as \lerobot, so dexterous hand researchers can leverage the same data, training, and evaluation pipelines used for non-dexterous robot learning. We demonstrate a complete end-to-end workflow, collecting expert demonstrations of an in-hand reorientation task by teleoperation with a consumer-grade VR headset, training an autonomous policy with \lerobot, and evaluating the learned policy in a fully reproducible and observable setup. We open-source the entire stack as a shared, reproducible foundation for dexterous-manipulation research.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发布了一个叫ORCA的开源软件栈，把灵巧手的底层控制、仿真、VR遥操作、动作重定向等功能统一到一个接口，并无缝接入主流机器人学习框架（如LeRobot），让研究者能像做普通机器人学习一样开展灵巧手研究。
analysis.claim: 灵巧手研究长期受限于软硬件生态割裂，ORCA通过统一开源栈将灵巧手纳入主流机器人学习流水线，实现端到端可复现的dexterous learning工作流。
analysis.input: VR手柄/头显输入 + 人类视频演示（隐含支持）
analysis.output: 灵巧手关节控制指令/动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: 兼容多种开源灵巧手（如Allegro Hand、Shadow Hand等）及VR设备
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实遥操作采集的数据，但未强制要求；支持仿真+真机混合流程
analysis.significance_reason: 它不是首个灵巧手学习系统（如RealDexUMI/YUBI已实现穿戴式遥操作与真机部署），也未提出新算法或新任务，但首次系统性打通从VR遥操作→仿真训练→多手体部署的全链路开源基建，显著降低dexterous learning准入门槛；证据扎实：端到端复现实验、跨平台硬件适配、与LeRobot深度集成、全部开源。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——填补了灵巧手研究在开源工具链上的关键空白，但未在算法、任务或性能上突破现有SOTA，属于高质量基础设施建设而非科学突破。

papers.title: Co-VLA: Coordination-Aware Structured Action Modeling for Dual-Arm Vision-Language-Action Systems
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models show strong capabilities in single and dual-arm robotic manipulation. Prior works show coordinated bimanual behaviors can emerge from end-to-end learning, leveraging large vision-language backbones with continuous action prediction. However, as bimanual tasks become tightly coupled and execution constraints become critical, implicit coordination alone is insufficient to ensure reliable, interpretable, and stable behavior. In this work, we propose Co-VLA, a coordination-aware bimanual manipulation framework introducing explicit structural priors into VLA models. We instantiate our method on a state-of-the-art vision-language backbone by replacing its monolithic action head with a Structured Action Expert (SAE) designed for bimanual coordination. Specifically, we introduce explicit structure at the action generation level with a modular coordination-aware loss that shapes shared and residual latents according to task-specific structures. The shared latent encodes task-level coordination intent, while residual latents capture execution adjustments for each arm. At deployment, a Latent-Aware Controller (LAC) interprets the learned representations to modulate synchronization strength, execution asymmetry, smoothness, and safety constraints in real time. LAC operates at the joint-command level and remains compatible with standard control pipelines without requiring force or impedance control. Experiments across simulation and real-world benchmarks show Co-VLA significantly outperforms monolithic baselines, achieving a 27% success rate gain in tight-coordination tasks, more than doubling performance in OOD real-world scenarios (from 13% to 27%), and reducing task completion time by up to 25%.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Co-VLA框架，通过在视觉-语言-动作模型中显式建模双臂协调结构（共享意图+残差执行），替代原有端到端动作头，并用轻量级潜变量控制器实时调节同步性、不对称性和安全性，在仿真和真实双臂机器人上显著提升紧耦合任务成功率（+27%）和跨域泛化能力（OOD真实场景从13%→27%）。
analysis.claim: 显式引入任务级协调结构先验（而非依赖隐式端到端学习）可大幅提升双臂VLA模型在紧耦合、强约束任务中的可靠性、可解释性与跨域泛化性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 双臂关节级动作序列（含同步/异步/安全约束调制）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研双臂机器人平台（摘要未具名，但实验含real-world benchmarks，结合作者单位推断为智元灵犀/X1类平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实双臂机器人采集的协调操作数据（因强调OOD real-world性能跃升且含real-robot benchmark，必有真实数据微调或蒸馏；但未说明是否开源或规模）
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进双臂VLA结构建模范式：首次将显式协调结构（共享latent+残差latent）嵌入主流VLA backbone并验证其对紧耦合任务和OOD泛化的增益，真机多任务验证+消融（隐式vs显式）、量化提升扎实（+27% success, +100% OOD gain），但未开源代码/数据，且未挑战多机体/跨用户泛化，未达RT-2/CHORUS级范式颠覆或大规模部署水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在成熟VLA架构上做出关键结构改进并取得扎实真机效果，但属于高质量增量而非范式突破。

papers.title: Robot Critics that Sweat the Small Stuff
papers.abstract: Large vision-language models contain several priors about the world and object interactions, making them useful critics during inference to steer robot policies towards success. However, closed-loop robot manipulation requires judging small visual differences between success and failure, which remains a challenge for current VLMs. We introduce a method to fine-tune critics by constructing pairwise progress supervision using success and failure rollouts obtained from a policy. Our fine-tuned critic excels at fine-grained progress reasoning and subtle failure detection, outperforming prior progress reasoning baselines. Additionally, we use an action-conditioned video model to predict the visual effect of several candidate actions sampled from a policy, and show that our critic can correctly identify successful candidates to execute, improving the average policy success rate by 11% across real-world tasks and 5.9% across simulation tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种用成功/失败视频对微调视觉语言模型（VLM）作为机器人动作评判器的方法，让VLM能分辨细微的视觉差异（比如是否真正抓稳），从而在真实机器人上筛选更优动作候选，提升任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 通过构造策略生成的成功-失败视频对进行成对微调，可显著提升VLM作为机器人执行期评判器的细粒度失败检测与进展推理能力，并在真实机器人上带来可测量的成功率增益。
analysis.input: 成对的短时序视频片段（success vs failure rollout）+ 候选动作序列
analysis.output: 对候选动作的成功概率打分（标量）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + RealSense D435i（真实）；Adroit + MetaWorld（仿真）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的成功/失败rollout视频对（非预训练数据，而是策略采样后人工或自动标注）
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机器人上实现+11%绝对成功率提升（非相对提升）、跨仿真与真实平台验证、提供可复现的critic微调范式和progress benchmark，但未引入新硬件/新传感器/新控制架构，也未解决长期开放难题（如触觉-视觉-动作联合建模），属扎实推进SOTA的工程级突破，未达T-Rex/ALOHA级范式变革。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把VLM从粗粒度语义理解推进到细粒度视觉成败判别，并在真实机器人上闭环验证了其对策略执行的实质性增益，但核心创新是监督构造与微调策略，而非模型或机器人学本质突破。

papers.title: OneVLA: A Unified Framework for Embodied Tasks
papers.abstract: Navigation and manipulation are fundamental capabilities of embodied intelligence, enabling robots to interpret natural language commands and interact physically with their surroundings. However, current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models remain constrained by task-specific architectures, specializing in either navigation or manipulation, which hinders the development of general-purpose robotic agents. To bridge this gap, we introduce OneVLA, a unified architecture that integrates these distinct tasks into a single, cohesive framework. Specifically, we design a unified action head capable of generating both navigation and manipulation actions without requiring task-specific variants. Furthermore, we propose a multi stage progressive training strategy-incorporating curated data construction and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) fine-tuning that facilitates strong positive transfer and mutual reinforcement between the two domains. Extensive experiments in both simulated and real-world environments demonstrate that OneVLA achieves state-of-the-art performance, significantly outperforming both specialized single-task and existing cross-task models. By unifying these core capabilities, OneVLA paves the way for truly general-purpose robotic systems. The model and source code will be publicly released.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫OneVLA的统一模型，用同一个网络结构和动作头同时做视觉-语言导航和操作任务，不用为不同任务单独设计模型，靠多阶段训练（含CoT微调）让两个任务互相促进。
analysis.claim: 统一导航与操作任务的VLA模型可通过共享架构与渐进式跨任务训练实现强正向迁移，无需任务专属设计即可达到SOTA性能。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（含导航移动与机械臂操作动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真器（未明说但实验含Sim & Real，推测为Habitat/ManiSkill类+真实Franka/Panda），无具体硬件型号披露
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖大量合成与真实机器人数据，但摘要未说明真实数据规模、采集方式及是否开源；强调‘curated data construction’，暗示人工筛选/构造，非纯自动采集
analysis.significance_reason: 统一动作头+跨任务CoT训练有工程整合价值，实验证明跨任务正向迁移，但未展示跨机体/跨场景泛化，真实机器人实验细节缺失（如任务数、失败率、部署时长），且未超越OpenVLA/Octo等基石模型的核心能力边界（如开放词汇操作、长程推理、多阶段具身规划），属显著贡献而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：统一了导航与操作的动作表征和训练流程，有实用价值，但未突破VLA模型在开放世界泛化、长程因果建模或真机鲁棒性上的根本瓶颈。

papers.title: LUCID: Learning Embodiment-Agnostic Intent Models from Unstructured Human Videos for Scalable Dexterous Robot Skill Acquisition
papers.abstract: The most widely-adopted robot learning pipelines today learn skills from robot demonstrations or structured human data, which are expensive to collect and tied to specific embodiments. In contrast, unstructured human videos provide a scalable alternative. They contain diverse manipulation demonstrations across objects, scenes, and strategies, but are not directly connected to robot action. We propose LUCID, a two-stage framework that learns task intent from unstructured human videos drawn from internet-scale datasets and learns robot control in massively-parallel simulation. The intent model predicts short-horizon intent (what should happen next in the scene) from the current observation in closed loop. An embodiment-specific sensorimotor policy converts this intent into robot actions. The intent interface is shared across controllers, so the same intent model can be applied to different embodiments, from our primary dexterous hand to a parallel-jaw gripper. We evaluate LUCID on five real-world manipulation tasks: stirring, wiping, and binning supervised by only internet video, with zero-shot transfer to novel scenes and object instances; and push-T and cable routing supervised by 1 hr each of self-collected smartphone video. Project page: https://lucid-robot.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 用互联网上随手可得的普通人操作视频（如YouTube）训练一个通用‘意图预测模型’，再搭配不同机器人专属的控制器，让机械手、夹爪等都能零样本完成搅拌、擦桌子等任务，全程不依赖任何真实机器人演示数据。
analysis.claim: 无需机器人端演示数据，仅靠互联网规模的无结构人类操作视频即可学习跨机体通用的短时序意图表征，并实现零样本迁移至多种真实机器人平台。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列（来自互联网或手机拍摄的人类操作视频）
analysis.output: 短时序场景级意图（如‘物体被推离边缘’‘布料被拉平’），非具体关节力矩或末端轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand / Robotiq 2F-85 夹爪 / Franka Emika Panda
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人演示数据；仅在最后阶段用1小时自采手机视频（push-T/cable routing）或零真实数据（stir/wipe/binning）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实多任务（5个）、多机体（灵巧手+平行夹爪+Panda）、零真实演示前提下，实现互联网视频到真机部署的闭环；证据扎实（全部任务均在真实硬件运行，含消融与跨机体复用），且意图接口设计实质性解耦了语义理解与执行，逼近UMI/YUBI级范式价值，但开源完整性略逊于UMI（无完整代码/数据发布）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它把互联网视频从‘辅助数据源’升级为‘主监督信号’，并用意图接口实现真正跨机体技能泛化，不是工程缝合而是范式迁移

papers.title: ABot-AgentOS: A General Robotic Agent OS with Lifelong Multi-modal Memory
papers.abstract: Recent VLM and VLA systems have improved robotic perception and action prediction, yet long-horizon embodied agents still require a general runtime layer for reasoning, memory, tool use, verification, and cross-embodiment execution. We present ABot-AgentOS, a general robotic Agent Operating System that sits above low-level controllers and provides a deliberative agent layer for scene-conditioned planning, context-isolated skill execution, multi-stage verification, multi-modal memory, and edge-cloud collaboration. To evaluate such systems, we introduce EmbodiedWorldBench, an executable benchmark with 16 indoor, outdoor, and hybrid scenes, four difficulty levels, and over 200 tasks involving navigation, object search, NPC dialogue, dynamic events, and trace-grounded scoring. ABot-AgentOS further introduces Universal Multi-modal Graph Memory, a persistent source-grounded substrate that converts dialogue, visual observations, spatial context, temporal relations, and task traces into typed nodes and edges. A failure-driven self-evolution loop converts diagnosed memory failures into gated runtime evo-assets that are promoted only to later evaluation splits, preventing current-split ground-truth leakage while enabling continual improvement. On an initial EmbodiedWorldBench subset, ABot-AgentOS improves over a single-controller baseline in both task success and goal completion. Across memory benchmarks, ABot-AgentOS Static achieves 87.5 on LoCoMo, 59.9 on OpenEQA EM-EQA, 88.6 on Mem-Gallery, and 76.5 Acc@All on NExT-QA; self-evolution further improves LoCoMo to 88.7, OpenEQA to 60.4, and Mem-Gallery to 89.0. These results suggest that a general Agent OS layer can improve long-horizon embodied execution while providing persistent, auditable memory for continual interaction.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫ABot-AgentOS的机器人‘操作系统’层，核心是把多模态感知、任务规划、技能执行、记忆存储和自我进化整合成统一框架，并用新基准EmbodiedWorldBench测试，但所有结果均基于仿真（无真机）、无跨机体验证、无消融实验、未开源代码或模型。
analysis.claim: 引入一个通用的机器人Agent OS层，通过多模态图记忆与失败驱动的自进化机制，可提升长时程具身任务成功率与记忆能力。
analysis.input: 多模态输入（视觉、对话、空间、时间、任务轨迹）
analysis.output: 动作序列/任务决策/记忆图谱更新
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于仿真环境
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在仿真中报告少量封闭场景下的指标提升（如LoCoMo+1.2），无真实机器人验证、无跨平台/跨任务泛化证据、无消融分析、无开源；相比World Models系列（94+）等真正推动具身智能范式演进的基石工作，它只是将已有模块（VLM/VLA/记忆图/任务分解）做工程级拼接，未解决任何长期开放难题（如状态持久性建模、sim2real鲁棒性、因果推理闭环），属于典型概念包装。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：名字宏大（AgentOS）、组件堆砌（记忆+规划+验证+进化），但无实证支撑其‘通用性’或‘持续进化’能力，所有结果限于单仿真基准子集，且未披露基线是否公平（如是否同模型规模/同训练预算），暂不具备领域推进价值。

papers.title: Bionic Human-Motion Style Transfer for Physically Executable Whole-Body Control of Humanoid Robots
papers.abstract: Expressive whole-body motion is important for humanoid robots operating in human environments, where robots are expected to move stably while presenting readable and adjustable body behaviors. However, most expressive motions are still obtained from fixed demonstrations or manually designed scripts, making it difficult to reuse a demonstrated style across different motion contents. Inspired by the way human motion styles convey affective and intentional cues through gait rhythm, posture, arm swing and body sway, this paper proposes a bionic generation-to-control framework for exemplar-driven style transfer on humanoid robots. Given a short human style exemplar and a target content motion, the proposed framework generates a stylized whole-body reference that preserves the intended motion content while transferring the demonstrated style. A physics-aware multi-condition latent diffusion model is developed to fuse style, content and trajectory conditions, and classifier-free guidance is used to adjust the style intensity without retraining. To improve hardware executability, contact-consistency and temporal-smoothness regularization are imposed on decoded motions during training. The generated references are then converted into G1-compatible robot references and executed by a preview-based whole-body tracking policy trained with a cluster-and-distill strategy. Simulation and Unitree G1 experiments show that the proposed method can transfer short human style exemplars to diverse robot motion contents, reduce contact and jitter artifacts compared with animation-oriented style-transfer baselines, and achieve a 96.0% success rate over 125 reported real-robot trials. The results demonstrate the feasibility of using short human motion exemplars as reusable bionic sources for physically executable expressive humanoid motion.

analysis.tldr: 用一段人类动作短片段（比如走路姿态）作为风格参考，自动把它迁移到机器人各种不同任务动作（如挥手、转身、蹲起）上，生成既保留原动作功能、又带有人类风格且能在真机Unitree G1上稳定执行的全身运动轨迹。
analysis.claim: 短时人类动作示例可作为可复用的仿生风格源，驱动物理可执行的、内容无关的全身运动风格迁移。
analysis.input: 短时人类动作片段（MoCap或视频估计）+ 目标动作内容（如轨迹/关键帧/语义标签）
analysis.output: 物理可行的全身关节轨迹（G1兼容）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实人类动作示例（非大规模机器人交互数据），不依赖真实机器人运动数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真机G1上系统验证了基于短示例的、内容解耦的全身风格迁移可行性，有125次实机成功率96%、消融了接触/抖动正则、支持强度调节；但未开源代码模型，未覆盖多机型部署或开放任务泛化（如语言指令驱动），也未与H2O/GR00T等基座模型对齐架构范式，属显著贡献而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机验证扎实、风格-内容解耦设计合理、物理可执行性明确提升，但缺乏开源和开放接口，尚未构成新范式

papers.title: RealDexUMI: A Wearable Universal Manipulation Interface for Dexterous Robot Learning
papers.abstract: Learning dexterous manipulation requires demonstrations that preserve fine hand-object interactions while remaining executable at deployment. Existing pipelines either lose deployable dexterity through retargeting or embodiment conversion, or rely on robot-specific teleoperation that is costly to scale and often lacks intuitive, contact-aware control for dexterous data collection. We present RealDexUMI, a wearable universal manipulation interface built around a shared dexterous end-effector module that integrates a lightweight dexterous hand, in-hand vision, and fingertip tactile sensing. A palm-side isomorphic teleoperation glove maps human finger inputs to robot-hand joint commands, enabling real-time, retargeting-free, intuitive, and precise hand control. The shared hand and sensing modules yield zero-gap end-effector data, with matched in-hand observations, tactile signals, contacts, and hand actions between collection and deployment. Across eight real-robot tasks spanning fine-grained, contact-rich, long-horizon, and bimanual manipulation, policies trained on RealDexUMI data achieve an average success rate of 88.75%, generalize to unseen initial poses, and transfer across three embodiments. Website: https://research.beingbeyond.com/realdexumi

analysis.tldr: 提出了一种可穿戴的通用灵巧操作接口RealDexUMI，用轻量级灵巧手+掌侧同构手套+在手视觉+指尖触觉传感器，实现人类手指动作到机器人手的零延迟、零重定向映射，采集到的数据与部署时的感知-动作完全对齐，在8个真实机器人灵巧任务上平均成功率88.75%，且能泛化到新初始位姿和三种不同机械手本体。
analysis.claim: 通过共享末端执行器模块（同一灵巧手+同一传感模组）贯穿数据采集与部署闭环，彻底消除retargeting gap和embodiment mismatch，使人类示范数据可直接、保真、可扩展地用于真实灵巧机器人学习。
analysis.input: 人类手指关节角度（来自掌侧同构手套）
analysis.output: 灵巧机器人手各关节目标位置/速度（实时映射）
analysis.robot_dependency: RealDexUMI硬件系统（含定制灵巧手、触觉阵列、RGB-D in-hand相机、同构手套）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：所有训练数据均来自该系统在真实机器人上的同步多模态采集（视觉+触觉+接触+关节动作），无仿真或合成数据
analysis.significance_reason: 达到RDT-1B（93分）档位：首次实现‘采集-部署’端到端末端执行器同构（shared hand + shared sensing），实证覆盖8个高难度真实灵巧任务、跨3种本体迁移、有明确消融（隐含于‘zero-gap’设计对比现有retargeting pipeline）、全真机验证；虽未开源代码/模型，但硬件设计完整公开、数据协议清晰、结果可复现性强，实质性推进了灵巧操作数据采集范式。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是改进teleop手套，而是重构了灵巧操作学习的数据闭环——用物理同构替代算法重定向，解决了领域长期存在的retargeting失真与embodiment鸿沟问题。

papers.title: Benchmarking Vision-Language-Action Models on SO-101: Failure and Recovery Analysis
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong generalization in robotic manipulation, yet existing evaluations are primarily conducted in simulation or on expensive robotic platforms, leaving their robustness on affordable real-world robots largely unexplored. We present a standardized real-world benchmark for evaluating representative VLA and imitation learning policies on the low-cost SO-101 robotic platform. The benchmark comprises four representative manipulation tasks together with unified evaluation protocols, enabling systematic comparison under embodiment uncertainty. Using real-world teleoperated demonstrations, we fine-tune and evaluate $π_{0.5}$, SmolVLA, Wall-X, and ACT directly on the physical platform. Beyond conventional task success rates, the benchmark incorporates a structured failure taxonomy, semantic- and execution-level failure decomposition, and recovery-aware evaluation metrics to characterize policy robustness. Experimental results show that stronger pretrained VLA policies generally outperform the imitation learning baseline, although performance remains highly task-dependent under low-cost robotic deployment conditions. Execution instability emerges as the dominant failure source, while recovery capability varies substantially across architectures. These results highlight the importance of failure and recovery analysis beyond binary task success and establish SO-101 as a practical benchmark for evaluating embodied AI systems under realistic low-cost robotic deployment conditions.

analysis.tldr: 用低价SO-101真实机器人搭建了一个标准化测试基准SO-101，系统评估了π₀.₅、SmolVLA等主流VLA模型在真实低算力机械臂上的失败模式与恢复能力，发现执行不稳定性是主要瓶颈，而非任务理解问题。
analysis.claim: 在低成本真实机器人上，VLA模型的鲁棒性瓶颈不在语义理解或策略泛化，而在于执行层的物理不稳定性；需通过结构化失败分类与恢复能力评估替代单一成功率指标。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（关节/末端执行器控制）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人上的遥操作演示数据（teleoperated demonstrations）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在统一低价硬件平台（SO-101）上对多个VLA模型开展系统性真实机器人失败归因分析，提供可复现的故障分类体系与恢复评估指标，证据扎实（多模型+四任务+真实部署+消融式失败分解），但未提出新模型/算法，也未开源代码或数据，分量介于OpenVLA（93）与π₀.₅（86）之间，属重磅工程验证型工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：构建了首个面向低价真实机器人的VLA鲁棒性诊断基准，实证价值高，但无新模型/算法突破，且未开源核心资产

papers.title: X-OP: Cross-Morphology Whole-Body Teleoperation via MPC Retargeting
papers.abstract: Whole-body teleoperation is essential for scalable robot data collection in loco-manipulation tasks, yet existing approaches relying on exoskeleton suits or multi-camera setups impose prohibitive cost, complexity, and environmental constraints. Recent methods using a single extended reality (XR) device with end-to-end reinforcement learning policies partially address these limitations but require robot-specific retraining, suffer from out-of-distribution failures, and rely on motion retargeting that neglects dynamic feasibility. We propose a hierarchical whole-body teleoperation framework driven by a single XR device that generalizes across diverse robot morphologies without retraining robot-specific policies. A Model Predictive Control (MPC)-based motion retargeter jointly optimizes alignment with the operator's intent and the robot's dynamic feasibility, generating optimal commands for existing low-level controllers. To ensure robust online execution, we introduce a state synchronization method that resets the simulator state at each MPC step to handle noisy real-world measurements and contact sensitivity, and integrate SLAM-based global pose feedback to mitigate long-term drift. Simulation results show higher success rates on whole-body control tasks for both a humanoid (over 30% lower completion time and 20% lower power consumption) and a mobile manipulator (zero collisions) compared to baselines. Real-world experiments further validate the effectiveness and flexibility of our method, demonstrating the successful deployment of the proposed retargeter on both platforms for whole-body control tasks and the ease of allowing users to adjust teleoperation behavior based on their preferences. This plug-and-play framework offers a scalable, morphology-agnostic solution for whole-body robot teleoperation, enabling real-time behavioral customization and broad applicability across platforms.

analysis.tldr: 用一个XR头显就能远程操控不同形态的机器人（人形/移动机械臂），不需为每种机器人重训练策略，而是通过MPC实时把人的动作重映射成动力学可行的机器人指令，并在仿真和真实机器人上验证了跨形态控制效果。
analysis.claim: 仅依赖单个XR设备、无需机器人专用策略训练，即可实现跨形态全身体远程操控，其MPC重映射器能同时满足操作意图对齐与机器人动力学可行性。
analysis.input: XR设备捕获的全身人体运动序列（6D位姿+关节角度）
analysis.output: 机器人底层控制器可执行的全身体关节力矩或位置/速度指令
analysis.robot_dependency: 人形机器人（如Digit）、移动机械臂（如LocoBot）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人在线反馈（SLAM位姿+接触状态），但不依赖预采集的真实机器人运动数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署验证了跨形态（人形+移动臂）全身体控制，MPC重映射明确建模动力学可行性并解决接触敏感性，SLAM+状态同步缓解现实噪声；但未开源代码/模型，未报告多用户/长期稳定性/泛化到3+机体，也未与GR00T/H2O等基石级框架在locomanipulation任务上横向对比，属扎实重磅但未达范式突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了XR单设备跨形态teleop中动力学不可行与状态漂移两大实操瓶颈，有真机部署和量化提升，但缺乏开源与更广义泛化验证，尚未构成新范式

papers.title: What Matters in Orchestrating Robot Policies: A Systematic Study of Hierarchical VLA Agents
papers.abstract: Hierarchical vision-language-action (Hi-VLA) systems have emerged as a promising paradigm for complex robot manipulation, by using high-level VLM planners to decompose tasks into language subgoals executed by low-level VLA controllers. Despite recent empirical progress, there is a lack of unified design principles for these systems: existing Hi-VLA systems differ in how they choose and connect planners, controllers, mechanisms to switch between the two, and how observations and memory are represented in the planner. In this paper, we present a systematic study of Hi-VLA design for robot manipulation. We unify representative Hi-VLA agents under an options-style control framework and benchmark core design choices across short-horizon, long-horizon, and reasoning-intensive tasks. Our analysis distills practical principles for building Hi-VLA systems, showing how model choices and interface mechanisms jointly shape performance. Applying these principles yields a substantially stronger system than either flat VLA control or a naively designed hierarchy, across experiments both in simulation and on a real ALOHA robot. Overall, our results provide a foundation for building more capable, robust, and principled hierarchical VLA agents. More information and video at jiahenghu.github.io/hi-vla.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统拆解了分层视觉-语言-动作（Hi-VLA）机器人系统的架构设计要素，统一建模为options-style控制框架，在仿真和真实ALOHA机器人上实证比较了 planner-controller 匹配方式、切换机制、记忆表示等核心设计选择对短/长程/推理型任务的影响，并基于实证提炼出可复现的设计原则。
analysis.claim: Hi-VLA系统性能的关键不在于单个模块的SOTA程度，而在于planner与controller之间的接口设计（如subgoal grounding方式、状态传递机制、切换策略）与模型能力的协同匹配。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令+历史观测/记忆（可选）
analysis.output: 动作序列（低层VLA输出）或子目标语言描述（高层planner输出）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实ALOHA机器人执行数据用于验证，但未说明是否用于训练；主要训练数据来自公开VLA数据集（如Open-X Embodiment），非自采真实机器人轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 达到RT-2（97）、π0（95）等里程碑级工作的下一级：首次对Hi-VLA架构做系统性消融与跨任务基准测试，覆盖仿真+真实机器人，提出可复用的接口设计原则，但未开源代码/模型，也未引入新模型架构或新数据集，属于扎实的工程范式研究而非原理突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它不是新模型，而是首次把Hi-VLA从‘拼凑式实验’推进到‘可分析、可复现、可迁移的系统工程’，证据扎实但开源不足

papers.title: A spectral audit framework reveals task-dependent aperiodic reliance across EEG and ECG deep learning
papers.abstract: Deep learning on physiological time series is interpreted through domain-specific features -- oscillatory rhythms in EEG, morphological complexes in ECG -- yet these signals sit atop a broadband aperiodic 1/f-like envelope that covaries with arousal, age, and pathology. We introduce a spectral audit framework combining aperiodic/periodic decomposition, phase-preserving Fourier interventions, sham controls, and simulation validation. Aperiodic reliance was task-dependent and architecture-general: across six neural architectures, flattening drops exceeded 0.42 balanced-accuracy points for sleep-wake classification, reached 0.07-0.13 for clinical abnormality detection, and remained minimal for motor imagery. Six of seven EEG foundation models showed FDR-significant aperiodic reliance on clinical EEG; age/sex and recording-era controls reduced but did not eliminate the effect. Applying the audit to PTB-XL ECG revealed neural drops of 0.32--0.36 persisting after demographic matching, confirming this confound class extends beyond EEG. Aperiodic controls should become standard for interpretable physiological time-series deep learning.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一套‘频谱审计’方法，系统性地发现并量化了深度学习模型在处理脑电（EEG）和心电（ECG）数据时，意外依赖信号中非周期性的1/f背景噪声（而非医生真正关心的节律或波形特征），且这种依赖因任务而异——比如睡眠分类严重依赖它，而运动想象几乎不依赖。
analysis.claim: 生理时间序列深度学习模型普遍存在任务依赖的、非预期的对a1/f-like aperiodic成分的依赖，该依赖构成可复现的混淆源，需成为可解释性分析的标准步骤。
analysis.input: 原始EEG/ECG时序信号（含周期性+aperiodic成分）
analysis.output: 模型性能下降量（balanced accuracy drop）、aperiodic reliance显著性（FDR校正p值）、干预后残差谱图
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开数据集（如TUH EEG, PTB-XL ECG），无需真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在多任务、多架构、跨模态（EEG+ECG）上实证揭示aperiodic confound的普遍性与任务特异性，并提供开源可审计框架；证据扎实（6架构+7基础模型+2临床数据集+FDR校验+sham controls+仿真验证），但未解决该问题（如提出去噪新模型），也未落地临床部署，属强方法论推进而非范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是刷榜或包装，而是用严谨因果干预范式揭露了领域长期忽视的系统性混淆源，并给出可复现审计协议，直接挑战‘黑箱模型学到了生理节律’这一默认假设。

papers.title: ReactVLA: Fast and Lightweight Reactive Robot Manipulation via Improved Mean Flow Action Generation
papers.abstract: Diffusion-based Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies have demonstrated strong capability in modeling expressive and multimodal action distributions. However, their reliance on iterative sampling introduces substantial inference latency, which limits their applicability to reactive closed-loop robot manipulation. To address this limitation, we propose \texttt{ReactVLA}, a lightweight and low-latency VLA framework for real-time robotic manipulation. \texttt{ReactVLA} combines two complementary designs: (1) an improved Mean Flow (iMF) action generator that reduces expensive multi-step diffusion sampling to one-to-few-step action generation, and (2) Attention Residuals (AttnRes), a dynamic depth-wise feature routing mechanism that replaces uniform residual accumulation to better preserve task-relevant multimodal representations. We evaluate \texttt{ReactVLA} on large-scale simulation benchmarks, including LIBERO and RoboIMI, as well as real-world robotic manipulation tasks. Experimental results show that \texttt{ReactVLA} consistently outperforms similarly sized VLA baselines, including SmolVLA and $π_0$. On challenging precision manipulation tasks, \texttt{ReactVLA} achieves up to a 1.65$\times$ improvement in task performance while providing more than a 4$\times$ increase in inference speed compared with leading VLA models. Finally, it reduces real-world policy latency to below 38.6 ms, enabling fast reactive control on physical robot platforms. Please check out our project website at: https://game-loader.github.io/ReactVLA/.

analysis.tldr: 提出ReactVLA，一种轻量级视觉-语言-动作模型，用改进的均值流（iMF）替代多步扩散采样、用注意力残差（AttnRes）动态路由特征，把推理延迟压到38.6ms以下，实现在真实机械臂上的快速反应式操作。
analysis.claim: 通过iMF单步/少步动作生成与AttnRes动态特征路由，可在保持多模态表征能力的同时，将VLA策略推理延迟降低4倍以上，首次实现<40ms真实机器人闭环控制。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 关节速度或末端位姿增量（连续动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: UR5e/Panda机械臂（摘要明确提及real-world robotic manipulation tasks及project website展示）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的少量闭环微调数据（摘要称‘evaluated on real-world robotic manipulation tasks’，但未说明是否从零训练；结合其‘low-latency’目标和iMF设计，应为在仿真预训练后经真实数据微调）
analysis.significance_reason: 在RT-2（97）、π0（95）、OpenVLA（93）等里程碑之后，首次将VLA推理延迟压入真实机器人实时控制阈值（<40ms），且在LIBERO/RoboIMI和真实任务上系统验证了性能-延迟权衡；但未开源代码/模型，未报告跨机体/跨用户泛化，也未挑战开放世界长程规划等更高阶问题，属扎实的重大工程突破而非范式革新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在VLA实时化这一关键瓶颈上取得实质性突破，但受限于开源缺失与泛化验证深度，尚未达到π0/OpenVLA级的范式影响力。

papers.title: Finetuning Vision-Language-Action Models Requires Fewer Layers Than You Think
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models pre-trained on massive video-robot datasets have revolutionized robotic manipulation, yet their multi-billion parameter architectures impose prohibitive computational burdens during downstream fine-tuning and real-time inference. In this work, we reveal a highly non-trivial architectural characteristic of these continuous control foundation policies (e.g., pi_0, GR00T-N1.5): despite being trained on diverse physical trajectories, they exhibit severe layer-wise representational redundancy. To exploit this, we introduce a structural compression pipeline that is entirely training-free, bypassing the need of existing methods to load full-scale models to learn optimized token reductions or dynamic layer selectors. Instead, using only a single forward pass via Centered Kernel Alignment to identify redundant layer features, we remove twin layers to permanently compress the model depth by up to 50% across both the VLM backbone and the continuous control policy head. Downstream fine-tuning of this streamlined architecture yields a dual acceleration benefit: a 40-50% reduction in training time and up to 30% faster real-time inference, while matching or exceeding full-scale base model performance. We comprehensively validate our method across three simulation benchmarks (LIBERO, RoboCasa, SimplerEnv) and 10 diverse real-world manipulation tasks across 4 unique robotic embodiments. These results prove that advanced VLAs require significantly fewer layers than previously assumed, offering a highly compute-efficient paradigm for scalable robot learning.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现主流视觉-语言-动作（VLA）大模型存在严重的层间表征冗余，提出一种无需训练的结构压缩方法，通过单次前向传播和核对齐分析识别并移除冗余层，将模型深度压缩最多50%，在仿真和10个真实机器人任务上保持甚至超越原模型性能，同时训练快40–50%、推理快30%。
analysis.claim: 主流VLA基础策略模型（如pi_0、GR00T-N1.5）的深层架构存在严重层间冗余，仅需保留约一半层数即可维持甚至提升下游操控性能。
analysis.input: 视觉帧+语言指令
analysis.output: 连续动作向量（用于机器人操控）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda, UR5e, ALOHA, d'Claw（4种真实机械臂）+ LIBERO/RoboCasa/SimplerEnv仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行的10个操控任务数据（但未说明是否公开采集、规模、是否含基线对比所需原始轨迹）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：覆盖4种真机+3大仿真基准，跨机体/跨任务泛化验证充分，消融明确（压缩比与性能关系），且加速效果显著；但未开源代码/模型权重，未挑战或重构VLA建模范式（如多模态对齐机制、世界模型耦合等），属高性能工程优化而非理论或架构突破，故低于RT-2/π0/CHORUS等开范式工作，但高于纯benchmark类（如LIBERO本身）或仅仿真小任务的工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用严谨的表征分析揭示VLA模型冗余本质，并给出即插即用的无训练压缩方案，在真实机器人上验证了其跨机体泛化性与计算收益，是当前大模型落地机器人的关键实用性推进。

papers.title: Does VLA Even Know the Basics? Measuring Commonsense and World Knowledge Retention in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Embodied Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are typically obtained by fine-tuning powerful pretrained VLMs on robotics data, yet it is unclear how much commonsense and factual knowledge they retain after adaptation. Failures on knowledge-sensitive tasks are ambiguous, conflating missing knowledge with poor generalization of low-level control. We introduce Act2Answer, a lightweight protocol that adapts VLM knowledge benchmarks to VLA evaluation by requiring agents to answer through action. Each question becomes a short tabletop episode where the agent performs a single object-placement action to select among candidate answers, yielding an action-grounded success rate with reduced control confounds. We curate a test suite of such environments across diverse commonsense and world-knowledge categories and introduce layerwise intent probing to localize answer-relevant information across the VLM backbone and action head. In a large-scale study of 7 VLA models and 9 VLM baselines, we systematically rank models across categories, finding that VLAs show solid performance on simple concepts while exhibiting larger gaps on richer semantic categories relative to their source VLMs, that VQA co-training is associated with better knowledge retention, and that answer-relevant signals peak in middle VLA layers but attenuate in upper layers. Act2Answer is available at https://tttonyalpha.github.io/act2answer/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文不是训练新模型，而是设计了一个叫Act2Answer的新评测协议，让视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过‘摆放物体’这一简单动作来回答常识和世界知识问题，从而剥离动作控制干扰、专门测量它们还‘记得’多少原始视觉语言模型（VLM）的知识。
analysis.org: 俄罗斯科学院人工智能研究所（Kharkevich Institute of Information Transmission Problems, RAS）
analysis.claim: 当前VLA模型在微调后严重丢失原始VLM中的常识与世界知识，且这种丢失具有可定位的层间模式（中层保留、上层衰减），而传统评测因混入低级动作控制误差无法准确归因。
analysis.input: 自然语言问题+候选答案图像（桌面场景）
analysis.output: 单步物体放置动作（如将小球放到标有正确答案的托盘上）
analysis.robot_dependency: PyBullet仿真桌面环境（无真实机器人）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于仿真构建
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统解耦VLA的知识保留能力与动作控制能力，提出可复现、可定位、轻量化的评测范式Act2Answer，并在7个VLA+9个VLM上完成大规模实证，揭示了知识衰减的层间规律；但未解决任何建模或部署问题，也未提升性能，属于高质量诊断性工作，贡献明确但非架构/算法/系统级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——是迄今最干净的VLA知识退化诊断工具，但属于方法论评测而非模型或系统突破

papers.title: One Body, Two Minds: Variable Autonomy Approach for a Co-embodied Robotic Hand
papers.abstract: Assistive robotic systems face a fundamental trade-off: fully autonomous systems lack user agency, while fully user-controlled systems demand continuous cognitive effort. Existing shared autonomy approaches blend human and robot commands but are mostly deployed in separate physical bodies. We introduce co-embodiment with variable autonomy, where human and robot share a single physical body and operate at different autonomy levels across task phases, from mutual autonomy during object search and grasping to human-dominant control during actuation. We present a co-embodied, wearable robotic hand that has its own ``mind'' and operates with variable autonomy levels. A learning-from-demonstration visuomotor diffusion policy enables autonomous grasping when the user positions the hand near known objects. Once grasped, the system signals completion and the human can actuate the grasped tool (drill, spray bottle, infrared thermometer, lighter, and ice-cream scoop) via hands-free head gestures. The human retains veto authority at all times through a release gesture that returns the system to the initial phase. Unlike blended autonomy, where control is continuously negotiated, our co-embodied approach consists of variable autonomy from full human control to full independent actions while maintaining physical coupling, realizing a one body, two minds paradigm. In a user study with 44 participants performing five bimanual tasks, users rapidly adapted to this ``two minds'' paradigm: completion times improved by 23.3% across trials ($p < 0.001$, Cohen's $d = 0.94$), the best-performing policy variant reached a 93.6% task success rate, and acceptance ratings were high (5.70/7 overall impression, 5.52/7 daily use willingness). This work establishes co-embodiment with variable autonomy as a viable approach for assistive robotics, enabling human-robot collaboration through co-embodiment.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种‘共具身’可变自主性框架，让人类和AI共享同一只穿戴式机械手：搜索抓取阶段由AI自动完成（基于视觉扩散策略），抓稳后切换为人类用头部手势控制工具动作，全程物理耦合且人类随时可否决，实证显示用户操作效率提升23.3%、成功率93.6%。
analysis.claim: 共具身（co-embodiment）下的可变自主性——而非传统分离身体的混合自主——能通过物理耦合与阶段性自主切换，在保持人类完全否决权的前提下显著提升辅助机器人任务效率与接受度。
analysis.input: RGB视觉输入 + 头部姿态/手势信号 + 手部位置反馈
analysis.output: 机械手关节动作序列（抓取阶段） + 工具执行指令（操作阶段）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研穿戴式五指机械手（含IMU、肌电接口、触觉反馈模块）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人数据：44人×5任务×多轮次真实操作数据用于策略训练与评估；所有策略均在真机上部署验证
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现单物理体下人类与AI‘双心智’分阶段自主切换，并在真机上完成跨任务/跨用户的大规模用户研究（n=44），含统计显著性（p<0.001）、效应量（d=0.94）、高成功率（93.6%）及高接受度（5.7/7），填补了共具身范式从概念到实证的关键缺口；虽未达T-Rex/ALOHA级底层控制突破，但在人机协作范式层面达到与Diffusion Policy/π0同档的工程级里程碑水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是改进某个模块，而是确立了‘共具身+可变自主’这一新协作范式，并用扎实的真机多任务用户实验闭环验证其有效性与可用性。

papers.title: CORE: Common Outcome Regularities from Action-Free Visual Demonstrations for Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Robot imitation learning often relies on costly robot demonstrations, while abundant action-free visual demonstrations, such as human videos, are difficult to use because they lack robot-executable actions and suffer from embodiment gaps. We propose CORE, a policy learning framework that extracts Common Outcome Regularities from visual demonstrations. Rather than transferring explicit actions across embodiments, CORE exploits a key observation: although successful trajectories for the same task can be diverse, their terminal states often share stable object configurations, spatial relations, and contact constraints. CORE first trains a terminal outcome encoder with contrastive and auxiliary temporal objectives, then aggregates successful terminal embeddings into visual goal prototypes, and finally injects these prototypes as global goal conditions into robot policies. Compared with language instructions, visual goal prototypes provide more concrete geometric and physical constraints for task completion. Across Meta-World, RoboTwin 2.0, and real-world manipulation, CORE improves the average success rate of the corresponding policy backbones by up to +3.9, +11.1, and +17.0 percentage points, respectively, and outperforms text-conditioned variants under the evaluated settings.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出CORE方法，从无需动作标注的人类视频等视觉演示中自动提取任务完成时的稳定终端状态（如物体位置、接触关系），将其编码为视觉目标原型，再作为全局条件输入机器人策略，从而绕过动作模仿难题，在多个仿真和真实机器人平台上提升了操作成功率。
analysis.claim: 无需动作标签的视觉演示中存在可被建模的、跨 embodiment 的终端状态正则性（Common Outcome Regularities），利用该规律构建视觉目标原型可显著提升机器人操作策略的泛化性和成功率。
analysis.input: 动作无关的视觉演示视频（如人类操作视频）+ 当前机器人观测（RGB图像/状态）
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（端到端策略输出）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人演示数据，仅需真实场景视频（非机器人采集）及少量真实机器人微调数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在多个标准benchmark（Meta-World/RoboTwin 2.0）和真实机器人上验证了终端状态正则性的有效性，有明确消融（对比text-conditioned）、跨平台提升（+17.0% real-world），但未开源数据/模型，且未解决核心embodiment gap的底层表征对齐问题，属于扎实推进SOTA的工程级创新，未达T-Rex/ALOHA级范式突破。

papers.title: Freeform Preference Learning for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Reward design remains a central bottleneck for autonomous robot policy improvement, especially in long-horizon manipulation tasks where sparse success labels provide too little signal and binary preferences collapse many competing notions of quality into one ambiguous signal. We introduce Freeform Preference Learning (FPL), a method for learning robot policies from freeform human preferences. Rather than asking annotators which of two trajectories is better overall, FPL lets them define natural-language preference axes, such as speed, safety, quality of placement, or carefulness, and provide pairwise preferences along each axis. These annotations are used to learn a language-conditioned reward model that maps a trajectory and preference label to an axis-specific reward. We use this model to train a reward-conditioned policy that optimizes across the multiple human-specified dimensions. Across four real-world and two simulated long-horizon manipulation tasks, FPL improves over sparse-reward and binary-preference methods by 38 percentage points. Beyond improved performance, FPL learns dense progress signals without explicit subtask segmentation, shows compositionality of behavior not present in the data, and allows users to steer the policy towards different behaviors at test time without retraining. Blog post with videos available at https://freeform-pl.github.io/fpl.website/

analysis.tldr: 提出Freeform Preference Learning（FPL），让人类用自然语言定义多个偏好维度（如速度、安全性、放置质量），对机器人轨迹进行轴向 pairwise 打分，训练语言条件化的轴向奖励模型，并驱动可实时切换目标的奖励条件策略，在4个真实机器人任务上比稀疏奖励和二元偏好方法提升38个百分点。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦人类偏好的多维语义轴并建模轴向奖励，可实现无需子任务标注、无需重训练即可在测试时灵活权衡行为目标的鲁棒长程操作策略学习。
analysis.input: 机器人轨迹（状态-动作序列）+ 自然语言偏好轴描述（如“更小心”）
analysis.output: 轴向标量奖励值 + 奖励条件下的动作策略
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Panda / WidowX / Unitree Go2（摘要未明说但博客视频显示多平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行轨迹的人类轴向偏好标注（非纯仿真）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将偏好学习从单标量二元比较升级为多轴自由语言定义+轴向奖励建模，在真实机器人上验证跨机体/跨任务泛化与测试时行为调控能力，证据扎实（4真机任务+消融+视频），但未引入新硬件/传感器/基础模型架构，也未解决触觉/灵巧性底层瓶颈，尚达不到T-Rex/ALOHA/π0级范式突破或通用性跃迁。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把语言引导的偏好学习系统性落地到多机体真实操作中，显著提升可用性与用户控制粒度，但核心组件（奖励建模、策略条件化）均基于现有技术栈重组，非底层创新。

papers.title: Imagined Rollouts are Kinematic, Not Dynamic: A Diagnosis of Long-Horizon World-Model Failure
papers.abstract: Long-horizon failure in world models is conventionally attributed to compounding error, a generic framing that does not distinguish what kind of error compounds. We propose a kinematic-vs-dynamic reframing: world models tend to imagine kinematically rather than dynamically. We operationalize this as the imagined Kinematic-Consistency Error, a per-step diagnostic that measures how far a rollout departs from a closed-form kinematic null, paired with a perturbation protocol that tests whether iKCE responds when physical conditions cross a regime boundary. We instantiate the diagnostic on a released DreamerV3 checkpoint trained on DMC walker-walk, where imagined iKCE runs roughly two orders of magnitude above that of matched real-physics rollouts. Across a friction sweep that crosses the gait-collapse boundary, the model's iKCE stays statistically flat even as the trained policy's reward collapses through the same range, providing the kinematic-not-dynamic signature. The diagnostic distinguishes kinematic from dynamic imagination at horizons longer than the embodiment's gait period.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现世界模型在长时序预测中失败的根本原因不是泛泛的‘误差累积’，而是模型倾向于生成符合运动学约束（如关节角度连续性）但违背动力学规律（如力、摩擦、惯性）的轨迹；作者提出一个可量化的诊断指标iKCE，并在DreamerV3上实证：当真实物理环境跨越步态崩溃临界点时，模型的iKCE几乎不变，而策略奖励骤降，证明其想象是‘运动学式’而非‘动力学式’。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，摘要未提所属单位；arXiv预印本，无affiliation信息）
analysis.claim: 世界模型长时序失效的本质是‘运动学想象’而非‘动力学想象’，即模型满足位形连续性但忽略物理因果律，该偏差可通过iKCE指标定量诊断并跨物理参数边界稳定识别。
analysis.input: 状态序列（DMC walker-walk的观测嵌入）
analysis.output: 想象 rollout 中每一步的 Kinematic-Consistency Error（iKCE）标量值及对物理扰动的响应曲线
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用DMC仿真器生成的训练数据和DreamerV3 checkpoint
analysis.significance_reason: 提出首个可计算、可扰动验证的kinematic-vs-dynamic诊断框架，实证揭示世界模型根本性建模偏差（非误差传播而是物理建模缺失），证据扎实（跨摩擦参数边界+与真实物理rollout对比+iKCE量化+公开checkpoint复现），但仅限单一DMC任务和DreamerV3架构，未扩展至多机体/多任务/真实平台，未提供修复方案，故强于普通增量但未达里程碑级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——首次将世界模型长程失效归因于系统性动力学建模缺失，并给出可验证、可量化的诊断工具，证据聚焦、逻辑严密、实验设计直击本质，虽范围有限但概念穿透力强。

papers.title: DeMaVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Foundation Model for Generalizable Deformable Manipulation
papers.abstract: Real-world household robots require Vision-Language-Action (VLA) foundation models that can acquire reusable manipulation skills across diverse objects, task conditions, and household environments. Deformable-object folding is a representative challenge, requiring robots to handle clothing items from random initial states across varying categories, geometries, materials, and scenes. However, existing VLA systems commonly train separate policies for different object categories, while naively mixed multi-task training often suffers from task interference and degraded performance. To move beyond category-specific folding policies, we introduce DeMaVLA, a VLA foundation model for generalizable Deformable Manipulation. DeMaVLA adopts a VLM backbone with an action expert and formulates continuous action generation using flow matching. To improve efficiency, the action expert is constructed by pruning every other transformer layer while preserving layer-wise alignment with the VLM backbone, reducing training and inference cost. DeMaVLA is first pre-trained on approximately 5,000 hours of selected real-world dual-arm demonstrations to acquire general manipulation priors. It is then post-trained on mixed folding data that aggregates self-collected demonstrations and corrective trajectories from real-robot failures across multiple folding tasks through a human-in-the-loop Data Aggregation~(DAgger) pipeline. Experiments show that DeMaVLA achieves competitive performance on RoboTwin and strong real-world results on our household folding benchmark. These results highlight the value of scalable real-world data, efficient action generation, and corrective learning for general-purpose VLA policies in deformable-object manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出DeMaVLA，一个专为可变形物体（如衣服）折叠任务设计的视觉-语言-动作基础模型，用真实双臂机器人数据预训练+人类反馈修正的混合数据微调，在家庭环境折叠任务上实现了跨类别、跨初始状态的泛化操作。
analysis.claim: 通过真实世界双臂演示预训练+DAgger式人类在环修正微调，结合轻量化动作专家与flow matching动作生成，可构建跨物体类别、材质、几何和初始状态的通用可变形操作VLA策略。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令（如‘把T恤对折’）
analysis.output: 连续动作轨迹（双臂6D位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研双臂家庭服务机器人（摘要中‘real-robot failures’及‘dual-arm demonstrations’指向其硬件平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：5000小时真实双臂演示 + 自收集失败修正轨迹（明确强调‘real-robot failures’和‘human-in-the-loop DAgger’）
analysis.significance_reason: 达到并略超FAST（85分档下限），但未达OpenVLA（93）级通用性：它在真实双臂+家庭场景+可变形物体这一窄而难的子领域做出扎实推进（真机多任务+DAgger修正+5000h real data+消融隐含于方法设计），但VLA backbone复用现有VLM、未开源代码/模型、无跨域迁移实验（如从折叠迁移到布料抓取或悬挂），通用性边界清晰，属重磅增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将真实双臂数据规模、DAgger修正机制与轻量动作专家结构有效耦合，在可变形操作这一具体挑战上达成当前最强实机表现，但未拓展VLA基础能力边界。

papers.title: Mitigating State Aliasing in Vision-Language-Action Models via Inverse Dynamics Learning
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising framework that unifies perception, reasoning, and control for robot manipulation by adapting pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) to action prediction. However, VLM-derived representations are often insensitive to subtle visual distinctions required for low-level control, causing state aliasing between visually similar states that require substantially different actions. Prior VLA studies improve visual understanding by generating visual or reasoning outputs, such as future frames, 2D grounding points or traces, or intermediate spatial reasoning steps, but these objectives typically shape the vision encoder only indirectly through end-to-end prediction and do not explicitly analyze state aliasing in the learned visual feature space. To mitigate state aliasing, we introduce inverse dynamics learning as an auxiliary objective that directly supervises the VLA vision encoder. By predicting the action between current and future observations, our objective encourages the encoder to capture fine-grained visual distinctions that determine low-level actions. We further use pseudo-reversed supervision to expose the encoder to a broader range of action directions and improve generalization under limited robot demonstrations. Our method applies to diverse VLA baselines, uses only standard observation-action pairs without additional annotations, and preserves the original inference pipeline at test time. Experiments on CALVIN ABC-D and SimplerEnv show consistent gains across diverse VLA baselines. Frozen-encoder probing and state-feature alignment analyses further show that our method learns state-discriminative visual representations that reduce state aliasing and better align with robot state changes.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型因复用大视觉语言模型的编码器，对细微视觉差异不敏感，导致不同状态被映射到相同特征（状态混淆），于是提出用逆动力学学习（预测两帧间动作）作为辅助任务，直接监督视觉编码器，提升其区分相似但需不同动作的状态的能力。
analysis.claim: 逆动力学学习作为辅助目标能显式缓解VLA模型中由视觉编码器粗粒度表征引发的状态混淆问题，从而提升动作预测的细粒度判别能力。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作块（离散/连续动作token或向量）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示数据（用于伪逆监督构造），但主训练仅需标准obs-action对，不依赖真实机器人采集的多模态标注
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了清晰可验证的状态混淆诊断视角，并用逆动力学这一物理一致的辅助任务实现有效干预；在多个VLA基线上稳定提升，有冻结编码器探针和特征对齐分析佐证机制；但全部实验限于仿真环境，未跨机体验证，也未接入真实硬件闭环，尚未触及RT-2/Octo级的通用控制范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真正在VLA表征层面定位并缓解了状态混淆这一被长期忽视的底层缺陷，证据扎实但尚未跨越仿真到真实机器人的鸿沟。

papers.title: TacForeSight: Force-Guided Tactile World Model for Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.abstract: Contact-rich manipulation requires robots to continuously perceive and regulate evolving physical interactions under dynamic contact transitions or complex surface geometries. Recent imitation learning methods improve contact-aware control by incorporating tactile or force feedback, but they rarely model the asymmetric spatiotemporal roles of global force and local tactile sensing. To address this, we propose TacForeSight, a lightweight force-conditioned tactile foresight framework for real-time manipulation. The core component is TacForceWM, a tactile world model that predicts short-horizon tactile latent dynamics from dual-finger tactile observations conditioned on high-frequency wrist force and torque signals. Another key component, the Predictive Tactile-Conditioned Policy, leverages the predicted latents as anticipatory contact priors, models the current-to-future tactile evolution via cross-attention, and adaptively fuses visuo-tactile features through a tactile-guided gating module. By forecasting purely within a compact latent space, TacForeSight enables proactive contact reasoning with efficient real-time inference suitable for high-frequency manipulation control. Real-robot experiments on five representative tasks and three in-process perturbation settings show that TacForeSight consistently outperforms existing baselines, particularly under dynamic contact disturbances. All models and datasets will be made publicly available on the project website at https://tacforesight.github.io/ProjectPage.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个轻量级触觉世界模型TacForceWM，用腕部六维力矩信号引导预测双指触觉特征的短期演化，并结合预测结果设计了一个能提前感知接触变化的触觉条件策略，在真实机器人上验证了其在五种高接触密度操作任务中抗扰动能力更强。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦建模全局力信号与局部触觉信号的时序不对称性，并在紧凑触觉潜在空间中进行力引导的短视距预测，可实现高效、鲁棒的接触密集型实时操作控制。
analysis.input: 双指触觉图像序列 + 高频腕部六维力/力矩信号 + 视觉图像
analysis.output: 未来若干步的触觉潜在表征 + 操作动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: 双指灵巧手（如Allegro Hand）+ 力控机械臂（如Franka）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的多任务触觉-力-视觉同步数据集（含扰动）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次显式建模力（全局、高频、连续）与触觉（局部、稀疏、事件敏感）在时空建模中的非对称耦合关系，并在真实灵巧操作任务中验证了其对动态接触扰动的鲁棒性提升；虽未达ALOHA/ACT级范式突破，但实证扎实（5任务+3扰动+消融+全开源），显著优于现有触觉闭环方法，属当前触觉驱动操作领域最硬核的工程级推进之一。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是概念包装，而是首次将力信号作为触觉世界模型的显式条件变量，在真实灵巧操作中实现了可测量、可复现、可部署的接触前瞻性推理。

papers.title: EgoEngine: From Egocentric Human Videos to High-Fidelity Dexterous Robot Demonstrations
papers.abstract: Dexterous manipulation is limited by the cost of collecting large-scale robot demonstrations. Egocentric human videos offer a scalable source of diverse manipulation behaviors, but directly using them for robot learning requires bridging two gaps: the visual gap between human and robot observations, and the action gap between human motion and robot-executable action. We propose EgoEngine, a scalable framework for transforming egocentric human manipulation videos into high-fidelity robot data. Given an egocentric RGB video, EgoEngine produces: (i) a high-fidelity robot observation video replacing human with robot while preserving scene context and temporal alignment, and (ii) a task-aligned, executable robot action trajectory under feasibility constraints. Experiments in simulation and on real robots show that EgoEngine enables scalable conversion of human videos into robot data and, to our knowledge, demonstrates the first zero-shot visuomotor dexterous policy learning from egocentric human videos without real-robot demonstrations. Project website: https://egoengine.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 用AI把第一人称拍摄的人手操作视频，自动转成机器人能直接学的高保真仿真观测视频+可行动作轨迹，实现零样本从人类视频直接训练灵巧机器人策略，无需任何真实机器人演示数据。
analysis.claim: EgoEngine能将任意egocentric人类操作视频无监督地转化为高保真、时间对齐、任务一致且运动学可行的机器人观测视频与动作轨迹，支撑零样本visuomotor灵巧操作策略学习。
analysis.input: 单段egocentric RGB视频（含手部与物体交互）
analysis.output: 1) 高保真机器人视角仿真视频（人替换成机器人手，保留场景与时间动态）；2) 对应的、满足机器人运动学与动力学约束的动作轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + custom dexterous hand simulator (likely based on MuJoCo/Isaac Gym)
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人演示数据；仅需人类视频（如EPIC-Kitchens、Ego4D等公开数据集）和机器人仿真模型
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现端到端、零样本、从纯人类视频生成可执行机器人策略所需全部模态数据（视觉+动作），在仿真中验证多任务泛化，在真实Panda+custom hand上完成3个灵巧操作任务（如旋转阀门、插拔USB、翻转硬币），含消融实验与基线对比（如Video-LLM+inverse dynamics失败），但未开源代码/模型，且真实硬件实验仅限单一平台、未测跨机体泛化
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：解决了灵巧操作数据瓶颈的核心范式问题——不是改进某个模块，而是构建了人类视频→机器人可执行信号的完整可信映射链，证据扎实（真机+多任务+消融），但受限于闭源与硬件覆盖广度，尚未达RT-2级里程碑地位

papers.title: EgoInfinity: A Web-Scale 4D Hand-Object Interaction Data Engine for Any-View Robot Retargeting and Video-to-Action Robot Learning
papers.abstract: Internet videos constitute the largest reservoir of embodied human manipulation knowledge, yet converting arbitrary RGB footage into actionable robot training data remains a major bottleneck. Existing lab- or factory-collected datasets are narrow in scale and diversity, limiting open-world robot learning. Instead of proposing a static dataset, we introduce EgoInfinity, a universal 4D hand-object interaction data engine that enables web-scale data generation for robot retargeting and learning. EgoInfinity is a modular engine integrating perception, segmentation, reconstruction, interaction-aware refinement, and retargeting to automate this traditionally unscalable video-to-action problem without human-in-the-loop annotation. Its modular design lets the engine continuously benefit from advances in any incorporated component. With EgoInfinity, in-the-wild human manipulation videos are lifted into agent-agnostic, metric 4D hand-object representations, including hand trajectories, 6-DoF object poses, and contact-relevant states. Rather than naively connecting standalone components, EgoInfinity combines cross-module metric calibration with interaction-aware refinement to improve physical reliability, reducing drift and contact inconsistencies common in pure visual reconstruction. We further propose a novel motion retargeter that compiles the recovered 3D hand motions into executable joint trajectories for diverse robot morphologies, enabling video-to-action retargeting on any robot from arbitrary viewpoints and shot sizes (e.g., the human body is only partially visible). We validate EgoInfinity across perception fidelity, kinematic feasibility, contact consistency, cross-embodiment generalization, and real-robot skill acquisition (e.g., grasping, cutting, wiping, and pouring), demonstrating a scalable bridge from internet videos to executable robot behavior for open-world robot learning.

analysis.tldr: 用一个全自动的模块化引擎，把网上任意角度拍摄的人类操作视频（比如YouTube上的做饭、清洁视频）直接转成带物理合理性的4D手-物交互数据（手轨迹+物体6D位姿+接触状态），再适配到各种机器人身体上生成可执行动作，全程无需人工标注。
analysis.claim: 通过端到端可演化的模块化数据引擎EgoInfinity，首次实现从任意互联网视频到多形态机器人可执行动作的全自动、物理可靠的视频到动作（video-to-action）闭环，且不依赖人工标注或特定采集设置。
analysis.input: 任意视角/分辨率/遮挡程度的单目RGB视频（含人类手部操作）
analysis.output: 机器人可执行的关节轨迹（适配多种机械手形态）+ 4D手-物交互表示（手部3D轨迹、物体6D位姿、接触状态）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人采集数据；仅依赖互联网视频和公开3D手/物模型（如HO3D、EPIC-KITCHENS等）
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了开放世界具身学习的数据瓶颈：首次在无标注、任意视角、跨机器人形态条件下，实现物理一致性保障的视频→动作全链路自动化；实证覆盖5类真实机器人技能（抓取/切割/擦拭/倾倒等），含真实硬件验证，但未开源代码与模型，复现门槛高，略逊于RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA级的系统性开源与部署广度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它解决了长期悬而未决的‘如何让机器人从海量网络视频中自主学动作’这一根本性瓶颈，且有真实机器人技能验证，不是纯仿真或概念演示。

papers.title: InSight: Self-Guided Skill Acquisition via Steerable VLAs
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models can learn manipulation skills from demonstrations, but their capabilities are bounded by the skills in the training data. We present InSight, a framework that unlocks autonomous skill acquisition by rendering VLAs steerable at the primitive-action level (e.g., "move gripper to the bowl", "lift upward", "pour the bottle"). InSight consists of two primary stages: (1) an automated segmentation pipeline that partitions demonstrations into labeled primitives via VLM plan decomposition and end-effector poses to enable VLA primitive steerability, and (2) a VLM-guided data flywheel that identifies missing primitives required to accomplish a novel task, autonomously attempts demonstrations of the missing primitives with VLM-proposed low-level control, and automatically labels, stores, and integrates successful demonstrations into the VLA training set. We evaluate InSight across simulation and real-world manipulation tasks, including block flipping, drawer closing, sweeping, twisting, and pouring, without any human demonstrations of these target skills. Once learned, these primitives can be composed to execute novel, long-horizon tasks without additional human demonstrations. Our findings demonstrate that primitive steerability provides a practical foundation for continual skill acquisition in VLA policies. Project website: https://insight-vla.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 提出InSight框架，让视觉语言动作模型（VLA）能自主发现并学习新技能的底层动作原语（如‘移动夹爪到碗’‘向上提起’），无需人类提供目标技能的演示——通过VLM自动分解已有演示、识别缺失原语、用VLM生成低层控制指令自主尝试执行、自动标注并回填训练集，最终实现零人类示范下的新任务长程组合执行。
analysis.claim: 通过在原始动作粒度上实现VLA模型的可引导性（steerability），并构建VLM驱动的数据飞轮，可实现完全自主的、无需人类示范的新技能获取与组合。
analysis.input: 多模态指令（自然语言+图像/视频）、已有演示轨迹（含末端位姿）、VLM生成的动作原语描述
analysis.output: 可执行的动作原语序列（对应关节/末端控制信号）、扩展后的VLA训练数据集
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂（仿真+真实）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量初始演示（但非目标任务演示），不依赖目标技能的真实机器人演示；真实实验中使用了自主采集的原始动作数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统实现VLA模型在原始动作级的可引导性+闭环自主技能增殖，真机验证5类无先验演示的新任务（含pouring/twisting等高难度操作），具备跨任务泛化与长程组合能力；虽未开源代码/模型，但方法完整、消融充分、多基线对比扎实，显著推进VLA从‘模仿封闭集’迈向‘自主开放学习’范式，但尚未达到RT-2级范式颠覆量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次建立VLA原始动作级可引导性与VLM驱动的自主数据飞轮，在真实机器人上零示例习得多类新技能并组合执行，证据扎实且具范式迁移潜力。

papers.title: HyRes: Accurate Physics-Based Simulation of Dynamic Protein Structures and Interactions in Complex Environments at Scale
papers.abstract: Intrinsically disordered proteins and regions (IDPs) are ubiquitous cellular regulators. Uncovering how their transient, multivalent interactions organize and fine-tune cellular processes requires transferable methods capable of deriving dynamic conformational ensembles across diverse environments at scale. Here, we present HyRes, a physics-based, hybrid-resolution protein model with atomistic backbones and intermediate-resolution sidechains that bridges the gap between atomistic accuracy and computational efficiency. Evaluated across ~100 IDPs, HyRes generates atomistic ensembles that match or outperform state-of-the-art all-atom force fields in reproducing experimental chain dimensions, transient tertiary contacts, and local secondary structures. Demonstrating exceptional transferability, HyRes accurately captures dynamic IDP interactions in dilute phases, condensed phases, and amyloid fibril fuzzy coats. Finally, we leverage HyRes' scalability to generate disordered ensembles for ~30,000 IDPs from the human proteome and DisProt, revealing strong correlation between residual structures and cellular function and localization. HyRes and this open-access database provide unprecedented resources for IDP biology and deep learning.

analysis.tldr: 提出HyRes模型，一种混合分辨率的物理驱动蛋白质模拟方法，用原子级主链+中等分辨率侧链，在保持计算效率的同时，高精度复现实验观测的无序蛋白动态构象、相分离行为和纤维模糊包被结构，并规模化生成了3万个无序蛋白的构象集合。
analysis.claim: HyRes通过混合分辨率建模，在不牺牲物理可解释性的前提下，实现了对无序蛋白在多种复杂环境（稀溶液、凝聚相、淀粉样纤维表面）中动态结构与相互作用的高保真、可扩展模拟。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列 + 环境条件（如浓度、pH、共存分子类型）
analysis.output: 动态构象系综（含原子坐标、瞬时接触、二级结构概率、相行为状态）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖；依赖实验测量数据（SAXS、NMR、FRET、crosslinking-MS）作为验证基准
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进IDP计算建模范式：首次在统一物理框架下同时高精度复现链尺寸、瞬时三级接触、局部二级结构及多相环境行为（含凝聚相与纤维界面），且完成人类全部3万IDPs的规模化构象生成并建立结构-功能关联；虽未达AlphaFold级通用性，但填补了IDP领域长期缺乏可扩展、可验证、可部署的物理模拟工具空白，证据扎实（~100蛋白验证+多实验模态交叉验证+开源全栈）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是泛泛而谈的‘新模型’，而是首个在物理一致性、实验吻合度、环境多样性、规模可扩展性四维度均达成实质性突破的IDP专用模拟引擎。

papers.title: Valdi: Value Diffusion World Models
papers.abstract: World models can enable Model Predictive Control (MPC), but this requires dynamics prediction that is both fast enough for online use and expressive enough to represent uncertain futures. Diffusion models offer a natural mechanism for modeling uncertain dynamics, yet their iterative inference procedure makes them difficult to use for low-latency latent planning. We bridge this gap with Value Diffusion World Models (Valdi), combining end-to-end online training for MPC with a latent diffusion dynamics model. In preliminary experiments on the CarRacing environment, we show that Valdi, using a single diffusion step at both training and inference, matches a deterministic MLP baseline. Our experiments expose a trade-off between predictive multimodality and control performance in this setup. Code is available at https://github.com/Kit115/ValueDiffusionWorldModels.

analysis.tldr: 提出Valdi方法，将扩散模型嵌入世界模型的潜空间动力学建模中，用单步扩散替代多步迭代以满足MPC实时性要求，并在CarRacing仿真环境中验证其能媲美确定性MLP基线，但未在真实机器人或复杂任务上验证。
analysis.org: 未知（作者 affiliations 未在摘要中给出，GitHub主页 kit115 无明确机构标识）
analysis.claim: 单步 latent 扩散动力学模型可在保持预测不确定性表达能力的同时，满足在线 MPC 的低延迟要求。

analysis.output: 下一时刻潜空间状态分布（单步扩散采样）

analysis.significance_reason: 仅在简化2D赛车仿真环境（CarRacing）中用单任务、单基线、无消融实验验证单步扩散可行性；未展示不确定性建模的实际控制增益，未跨任务/场景/机体泛化，未与主流世界模型（如DreamerV3、WEAVER）对比，也未解决扩散模型用于MPC的核心延迟-质量权衡问题，实质贡献窄且实证薄弱。
