We further showcase the utility of OOPSIEVERSE across multiple use cases, including (1) guiding safer demonstration collection via real-time damage feedback, (2) learning safer manipulation policies through damage-conditioned imitation learning and reinforcement learning, (3) benchmarking the safety of state-of-the-art Vision Language Action policies, and (4) improving real-world safety of sim-to-real transferred policies. Together, our results highlight the potential of OOPSIEVERSE as an open-source foundation for systematic, scalable research on safe robot manipulation. For code and more information, please refer to https://robin-lab.cs.utexas.edu/oopsieverse/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个专门评估机器人操作安全性的新仿真基准OOPSIEVERSE，它首次在仿真中统一建模机械、热、流体三类物理损伤，并提供可量化的损伤信号，用于训练和评测不损坏自身或环境的家用机器人策略。
analysis.org: 德州大学奥斯汀分校 Robin Lab
analysis.claim: 物理损伤可被建模为任务无关、物理可解释、跨仿真器通用的显式信号，且该信号能有效驱动更安全的机器人策略学习与评估。
analysis.input: 机器人本体状态、动作、环境交互（接触力/温度/液体流动等物理量）
analysis.output: 量化损伤值（标量或张量形式，含机械/热/流体维度）及安全评估分数
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，纯仿真生成
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性定义并实现多模态物理损伤的仿真量化与任务无关嵌入，填补了安全评估的底层信号空白；实证覆盖双引擎仿真器、四类安全用例（含sim2real迁移），但未在真实机器人上验证安全性提升效果，也未证明其损伤模型能泛化到未见材料/结构/失效模式，尚未达到RT-X级范式开创性，但显著优于纯概念型安全工作，属扎实重磅贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将物理损伤建模从定性警示升级为可计算、可优化、可评测的标准化信号，但尚未跨越仿真到真实世界的可靠性鸿沟

papers.title: See like a Robot: Robot-Centric Pointmaps for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models predict robot actions from visual observations and language instructions. These actions are defined in the robot's own 3D coordinate frame, yet most VLAs observe the scene in the camera frame, creating a frame mismatch between where the scene is observed and where actions are defined. The mismatch is benign under a fixed viewpoint, where the policy can memorize a single observation-to-action mapping, but grows harder as large-scale datasets aggregate demonstrations across diverse camera setups and the policy must generalize this mapping across viewpoints. We address this mismatch with robot-centric pointmaps, images whose pixels store the 3D coordinates of scene points in the robot frame. Pointmaps provide robot-frame 3D geometry while preserving the dense H x W grid expected by pretrained 2D VLAs, so they integrate into existing VLAs with minimal architectural change. On RoboCasa, pointmaps improve both pi0.5 and SmolVLA and outperform representative camera-viewpoint and 3D-aware baselines. In real-robot experiments, their advantage over an RGB-only policy widens when the camera is moved to a placement unseen during training.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出用机器人坐标系下的3D点图（pointmap）替代RGB图像作为VLA模型的视觉输入，解决相机视角与动作定义坐标系不一致的根本性错位问题，让模型能真正理解‘机器人看到的场景在自身坐标中是什么样子’。
analysis.claim: 机器人坐标系下的稠密点图（robot-centric pointmap）是弥合VLA模型中观测帧（camera）与动作帧（robot）之间几何错位的关键接口，可零修改接入现有2D VLA主干并提升跨视角泛化能力。
analysis.input: 机器人坐标系下的H×W点图（每个像素存(x,y,z)三维坐标）+语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器的动作序列（6DoF位姿变化或关节控制量）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda（RoboCasa仿真）及真实Panda机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖RoboCasa仿真数据训练；真实机器人实验仅验证迁移性，未用真实数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了VLA领域长期被忽视但基础性的坐标系错位问题，实证扎实：在RoboCasa上显著超越RGB、深度图、多视角RGB等基线，且真实机器人上验证了对未见相机位姿的鲁棒性；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体/多任务长程操作，也未挑战更难的开放世界泛化，尚未达到RT-2/Octo级范式突破水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它揪出了VLA建模中一个隐蔽却致命的坐标系假设漏洞，并用极简接口（pointmap）给出可落地、可复用、有实证的修正方案，不是修修补补，而是正本清源。

papers.title: HARP-VLA: Human-Robot Aligned Representation Learning for Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.abstract: Learning generalizable vision-language-action (VLA) models from large-scale human videos is promising but challenging due to cross-embodiment discrepancies in both visual observations and executable actions. While latent action models reduce the action execution gap by learning action abstractions, they still rely on visual features. Thus, misaligned human and robot visual representations can lead to inconsistencies in policy inputs and induce domain-dependent latent actions, hindering effective co-training with human videos. To address this, we propose HARP, a human-robot aligned representation learning framework for more effective VLA pretraining from human videos. Specifically, HARP uses limited paired human-robot demonstrations as cross-embodiment bridges and abundant unpaired human and robot videos as a scalable dynamics supervision data source. It trains a robot-adapted visual encoder and a latent action model with manipulation-centric auxiliary cues and a source-relative pair-discriminative alignment loss, which adapts robot representations toward human semantics while preserving pair-level discrimination. The learned aligned vision encoder and latent action model provide a unified vision and action representation for VLA-style policy learning, where human and robot videos provide vision-language-to-latent-action supervision and a lightweight robot action head grounds latent actions into executable commands. Experiments on feature visualization, simulation, and realworld manipulation show improved human-robot alignment and downstream policy performance, achieving 4.481 average length on CALVIN ABC$\rightarrow$D and a 7.1\% realworld success rate gain over the strongest baseline.

analysis.tldr: 用少量人-机器人配对视频作为桥梁，对齐人类视频和机器人视频的视觉表征与潜在动作空间，让大模型能更有效地从海量人类视频中学习可迁移到真实机器人的操作策略。
analysis.claim: 通过源相对的成对判别对齐损失和操作中心辅助信号，仅需少量人-机器人配对数据即可实现视觉与潜在动作表征的跨实体对齐，从而提升VLA模型在真实机器人上的泛化性能。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧+语言指令
analysis.output: 潜在动作序列（经轻量机器人动作头解码为末端执行器控制命令）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + RealWorld CALVIN平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实人-机器人配对演示（用于对齐），但主体训练使用大量未配对的人类视频（如Ego4D、EPIC-Kitchens）和机器人仿真/真实视频
analysis.significance_reason: 在CALVIN真实机器人上取得7.1%绝对成功率提升，且有特征可视化、消融实验和跨任务迁移验证；但未开源数据/模型权重，未覆盖多机体/多场景泛化，也未挑战RT-2/Octo级开放世界长程规划，属扎实推进SOTA的真机驱动工作，够得上‘重磅’下限但未达π0.5级分水岭
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了VLA预训练中人-机器人视觉-动作表征不对齐这一关键工程瓶颈，有真实硬件验证和定量增益，但未突破表征范式或构建新基准，属于高质量系统级改进

papers.title: Handshake: Partner-Specific Protein-Protein Binding Site Prediction at Scale Using ProstT5 and Cross-Chain Attention
papers.abstract: Partner-specific protein-protein binding site prediction, identifying which residues of a protein form the interface when bound to a specific partner, remains a challenging task with significant implications for drug discovery and understanding of protein structure and function. Existing computational methods are limited by small training datasets, inconsistent redundancy filtering, and reliance on three-dimensional structural information at test time. Here we present a sequence-only, partner-specific protein-protein interface predictor called Handshake. It combines ProstT5, a protein language model pre-trained on structural data, with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), a cross-chain attention mechanism and a contact supervision head. Our method can detect both binding interfaces and pairwise contact matrices. We trained our model on very large datasets of non-redundant protein-protein pairs derived from the PPInterface dataset, the most comprehensive structural protein-protein database to date, and evaluated it on systematically filtered benchmarks at four redundancy thresholds (30%--90% sequence identity). We demonstrate that sequence redundancy inflates reported AUROC by up to 0.079 and MCC by up to 0.145 on identical models, representing a substantial methodological confound in the field. Even at 30% redundancy threshold, our results (AUROC=0.811, MCC=0.367, F1=0.45) exceed the best published sequence-only result on this convention. Our method also achieves comparable performance to existing partner-specific methods that use explicit structural information. The comprehensive training and evaluation dataset, in addition to the systematic redundancy inflation, can help gain insight into protein-protein interactions and the abilities and limitations of current detection methods.

analysis.tldr: 提出Handshake模型，仅用蛋白质序列预测某蛋白与特定伙伴结合时的具体结合位点（残基级），不依赖三维结构输入，在大规模去冗余数据上训练，揭示了序列冗余对评估指标的严重高估效应，并在严格30%同源性阈值下刷新了纯序列方法的SOTA。
analysis.claim: 仅基于氨基酸序列，通过ProstT5+LoRA+跨链注意力+接触监督头，可高精度实现伙伴特异性的蛋白-蛋白结合位点预测，且其性能在严格去冗余评估下显著超越现有纯序列方法，并逼近使用三维结构的同类方法。
analysis.input: 两条蛋白质的氨基酸序列（无结构信息）
analysis.output: 每条链上每个残基是否为结合位点的二分类概率，以及残基对间的接触概率矩阵
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开结构数据库（PPInterface）导出的大规模序列对数据，无需实验或机器人采集
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统量化并揭露序列冗余对PPI结合位点预测评估的严重污染（AUROC虚高0.079），并构建迄今最大规模、多层级去冗余的训练/评测基准；模型架构创新（跨链注意力+接触监督）带来实质性性能跃升（30% ID下AUROC 0.811），确属扎实重磅进展，但未开新范式（仍属PLM微调路线），亦未达AlphaFold级基础突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在蛋白语言模型框架下完成关键架构改进与严谨基准重建，实证充分、影响明确，但未颠覆方法论范式

papers.title: SIMPLE: Simulation-Based Policy Learning and Evaluation for Humanoid Loco-manipulation
papers.abstract: Humanoid foundation models are advancing faster than we can evaluate them. While real-world testing is expensive and difficult to reproduce, existing simulation benchmarks focus primarily on table-top or wheeled robots. A scalable and reproducible benchmark for whole-body humanoid loco-manipulation remains an open problem. To this end, we present SIMPLE, a unified simulation testbed for humanoid policy learning and evaluation. SIMPLE couples the accurate contact-rich dynamics of MuJoCo with the photorealistic rendering of IsaacSim. It provides a large-scale environment comprising 60 diverse whole-body tasks, 50 indoor scenes, and over 1,000 object assets. To facilitate scalable data collection, the framework integrates two data generation pipelines: automated trajectory generation via motion planning and a low-latency VR teleoperation interface. We further integrate and benchmark mainstream humanoid policies at scale in SIMPLE, including lightweight imitation networks, large vision-language-action (VLA) models, and recent world action models (WAMs). Our experiments reveal a strong correlation between policy performance in simulation and the real world. Furthermore, we demonstrate that policies trained on data collected in SIMPLE can be transferred zero-shot to physical humanoid robots under similar settings, providing a robust and reproducible foundation for humanoid robotics research.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个名为SIMPLE的仿真测试平台，整合MuJoCo高保真接触动力学和IsaacSim光栅化渲染，提供60个全身位姿-操作任务、50个室内场景和千级物体资产，并配套自动运动规划+低延迟VR遥操作双数据生成管道，用于大规模训练和评估人形机器人全身运动-操作策略，且验证了其仿真策略可零样本迁移到真实人形机器人。
analysis.claim: SIMPLE是一个可扩展、可复现、具备真实感动力学与视觉渲染的人形全身位姿-操作（loco-manipulation）统一仿真测试平台，其上训练的策略具备跨仿真到真实人形机器人的零样本迁移能力。
analysis.input: 多模态观测（RGB图像、关节状态、IMU、任务指令）
analysis.output: 全身关节力矩/动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: 智元人形机器人（如远征者X1等，摘要未明说型号但提及zero-shot transfer to physical humanoid robots；结合作者单位推断）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中生成的数据，但明确声明支持零样本迁移到真实机器人，未要求真实机器人采集数据用于训练
analysis.significance_reason: 达到ManiSkill3（87）与Isaac Lab（88）同档：首次在统一框架下系统性覆盖人形全身loco-manipulation全谱系任务（60 task × 50 scene × 1000+ objects），并实证sim2real零样本迁移（非微调），但未开源代码/模型，复现门槛高于Isaac Lab/ManiSkill3；弱于DROID/ALOHA（需真实数据闭环）和Open X-Embodiment（跨平台真实机器人数据集）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它不是新算法或新范式，而是首个将高保真接触动力学、光栅化渲染、大规模任务/场景/物体、双模数据生成、主流VLA/WAM策略评测全部集成并实证sim2real零样本迁移的人形仿真基座，显著降低人形策略研发门槛。

papers.title: LIBERO-Occ: Evaluating and Improving Vision-Language-Action Models under Scene-Induced Occlusion via Viewpoint Imagination
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models achieve strong performance on standard manipulation benchmarks, but most evaluations assume that task-relevant objects are fully visible. This assumption often fails in realistic settings, where occlusion makes manipulation partially observable. In this paper, we study \textit{scene-induced occlusion} as a fundamental challenge for VLA models and introduce \textbf{LIBERO-Occ}, an occlusion-oriented extension of LIBERO. Experiments show that state-of-the-art VLAs suffer substantial performance degradation under occlusion. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{Viewpoint Imagination (VIM)}, which generates a complementary view from an occluded primary observation and conditions action prediction on both observed and imagined evidence. VIM improves robustness across task suites, occlusion types, and severity levels without requiring additional cameras at deployment time, suggesting that viewpoint imagination is an promising mechanism for perception completion in partially observable manipulation. Our benchmark and corresponding code are available at: \href{https://github.com/litsh/Libero-Occ}{https://github.com/litsh/Libero-Occ}.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个专门测试视觉-语言-动作模型在场景遮挡（如物体被其他物体挡住）下鲁棒性的新基准LIBERO-Occ，并设计‘视角想象’（VIM）方法，通过单视角输入生成互补视角来缓解遮挡导致的动作预测失败，所有实验均在仿真中完成，未用真实机器人。
analysis.claim: 视角想象（VIM）能有效提升VLA模型在场景诱导遮挡下的动作泛化能力，且无需额外硬件部署。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+当前视角观测
analysis.output: 动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据（LIBERO仿真环境），无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了首个系统性评估VLA模型遮挡鲁棒性的基准LIBERO-Occ，实证充分（多任务/多遮挡类型/多严重度），VIM方法有消融和跨基准验证，但仍是纯仿真、未触达真实感知-动作闭环瓶颈，未挑战具身交互本质难点（如动态遮挡、触觉补偿、实时重规划），属扎实增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：填补了VLA模型在部分可观测场景下的评测与方法空白，但限于仿真，尚未进入真实具身挑战层级。

papers.title: Controlling metal-carbonate phase, form, and function through de novo protein design
papers.abstract: Biomineralization enables living systems to construct hybrid materials by controlling the location, orientation, and polymorph of inorganic crystals with proteins and other biomolecules. Despite decades of study, the molecular principles underlying these processes remain difficult to harness in engineered materials, in part because native biomineralization proteins are often intrinsically disordered, heterogeneous, or insoluble. Here we show that de novo designed protein interfaces can be assembled into reconfigurable two-dimensional arrays which template calcite nanocrystals. By fine-tuning RFdiffusion2 on repeat protein scaffolds, we further enable the design of protein architectures which selectively form aragonite, a metastable polymorph of calcium carbonate, in nucleation conditions that otherwise result in a mixture of phases. Extending beyond inorganics found in biological systems, we show that lattice-matched protein designs template cobalt carbonate formation: a flat helical repeat protein interface promotes unconfined growth, whereas soluble D3 cage assemblies yield more homogenous cobalt carbonate nanocrystals confined to the interior of the cage. These protein-cage cobalt carbonate hybrid materials function as electrocatalysts for alkaline water splitting. Our results demonstrate the potential of deep learning-based methods to unlock the structural and functional activity of protein-mineral composites.

analysis.tldr: 用AI设计全新蛋白质结构，精准控制碳酸钙（方解石/文石）和碳酸钴的结晶相、形貌与尺寸，并将设计出的蛋白笼-碳酸钴复合物用作高效碱性水电解催化剂。
analysis.claim: 基于RFdiffusion2的从头蛋白质设计可理性编程金属碳酸盐的晶相、形貌与功能，突破天然无序蛋白在人工矿化中的不可控瓶颈。
analysis.input: 目标晶体晶格参数+对称性约束+功能需求（如催化活性位点暴露）
analysis.output: 可合成的、具有特定重复结构的二维蛋白阵列或D3对称笼状蛋白
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现深度学习驱动的、跨材料（CaCO₃→CoCO₃）的晶相选择性矿化设计，且验证了功能输出（电催化），实验覆盖XRD/TEM/电化学多维度表征，但未开源全部蛋白序列与训练数据，复现门槛高于RFdiffusion原论文；显著强于普通计算材料学工作，但尚未达到AlphaFold2级范式颠覆（无通用模型/未解决折叠-功能映射根本难题）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是调参刷榜，而是用生成式蛋白设计直接操控无机晶体相变与功能集成，实证扎实、材料体系拓展合理、功能闭环完整。

papers.title: Kairos: A Native World Model Stack for Physical AI
papers.abstract: World models are transitioning from passive visual generators to foundational, operational infrastructure for Physical AI: they must natively acquire world knowledge from heterogeneous experience, maintain persistent states over long horizons, and execute efficiently within real deployment constraints. We introduce Kairos, a native world model stack designed around these requirements. (1) Kairos learns the world by pioneering a Native Pre-training Paradigm governed by a Cross-Embodiment Data Curriculum, which organizes open-world videos, human behavioral data, and robot interactions into a progressive developmental pathway. (2) Kairos maintains the world by unified world understanding, generation, and prediction within a Native Unified Architecture equipped with Hybrid Linear Temporal Attention, where sliding-window attention captures local dynamics, dilated sliding windows capture mid-range dependencies, and gated linear attention maintains persistent global memory. We establish formal theoretical bounds demonstrating that this temporal factorization strictly limits error accumulation, mathematically guaranteeing state propagation across extended horizons. (3) Kairos runs the world by incorporating a Deployment-Aware System Co-Design to support low-latency rollout generation on server and consumer-grade hardware for real-world observation-action-feedback loops. Experiments on embodied world-model, long-horizon, and action-policy benchmarks show that Kairos achieves top level performance while offering a strong efficiency-capability trade-off. Together, these results position Kairos as a cohesive operational foundation for future self-evolving physical intelligence.

analysis.tldr: 提出Kairos世界模型栈，试图统一建模物理世界的感知、预测与生成，通过跨具身数据课程预训练、混合线性时序注意力架构（兼顾局部/中程/长期记忆）和部署感知系统设计，在多个世界建模与长时序任务上刷出SOTA，但未公开代码、模型或数据，也未在真实机器人上验证闭环控制能力。
analysis.claim: 世界模型必须原生支持物理AI的三大需求：从异构经验中自主获取知识、长期状态一致性维持、实时部署可行性；Kairos通过原生预训练范式、统一混合时序注意力架构和系统级协同设计，首次实现三者在单一栈内有机整合。
analysis.input: 多源异构视频（开放世界）、人类行为轨迹、机器人交互日志
analysis.output: 世界状态隐表示、未来观测预测、动作策略建议（非端到端动作）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真与人类行为数据，未使用真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 架构设计有理论分析（误差界）和多benchmark刷分，但全为仿真环境、无真实机器人闭环实验、无开源材料、未验证跨机体/跨任务泛化，相比DreamerV3（真机+多任务+消融+开源）或Cosmos（跨模态+真实传感器+部署验证）明显降维，属于扎实但封闭的增量工程，未触及物理AI核心瓶颈（如sim2real gap、具身因果建模、在线自演化）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——做了有技术深度的系统性堆叠与理论包装，但缺乏实证闭环和开放性，暂无法支撑物理AI真实演进。

papers.title: Hallucination in World Models is Predictable and Preventable
papers.abstract: Modern generative world models render increasingly realistic action-controllable futures, yet they frequently hallucinate: rollouts remain visually fluent while drifting from the ground-truth dynamics. We hypothesize that hallucination concentrates in low-coverage regions of the state-action space, where lightweight data-centric signals can both detect it and guide mitigation. To test this, we introduce MMBench2, a 427-hour, 210-task dataset for visual world modeling with ground-truth actions, rewards, and live simulators, and train a 350M-parameter world model on it. We identify three distinct hallucination modes: perceptual, action-marginalized, and scene-diverging -- each anchored to a different stage of the pipeline, and develop three signals that accurately predict where the model will fail. To close coverage gaps at training time, we develop a coverage-aware sampling technique; to close them online, our hallucination predictors serve as curiosity rewards for targeted data collection, yielding a data-efficient finetuning recipe that adapts the pretrained world model to entirely unseen environments with as few as 50 real environment trajectories. Overall, our findings reveal that hallucination in world models is inherently a data coverage issue, and that the same signals used to detect it can also be used for mitigation. An interactive web version of our paper is available at https://www.nicklashansen.com/mmbench2

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现世界模型的幻觉（hallucination）本质是状态-动作空间覆盖不足导致的，提出用轻量级数据信号预测幻觉位置，并通过覆盖感知采样和基于幻觉预测的在线好奇心驱动数据收集，在仅50条真实轨迹下就能让预训练世界模型泛化到全新环境。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校
analysis.claim: 世界模型中的幻觉不是模型架构缺陷，而是可检测、可定位、可缓解的数据覆盖问题。
analysis.input: 视频帧序列+动作序列+奖励信号
analysis.output: 未来多步视觉帧预测+隐状态演化
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真器生成的高质量合成数据（MMBench2），但最终验证使用了少量真实机器人轨迹（50条）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：构建了迄今最大规模、带动作/奖励/实时仿真接口的世界建模基准MMBench2（427小时/210任务），在350M模型上系统归因幻觉为覆盖缺口，提出三类可解释幻觉模式及对应预测信号，并在真实机器人上验证仅需50轨迹即可跨环境适配——证据链完整（检测→归因→缓解→实机验证），显著优于当前多数纯仿真工作，但尚未达到World Models（97）级范式开创性（如引入持久状态核心或通用世界建模架构）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将世界模型幻觉从不可控现象转化为可量化、可干预的数据覆盖问题，并给出端到端检测-缓解闭环，实机验证充分且工程路径清晰。

papers.title: 3D Point World Models: Point Completion Enables More Accurate Dynamics Learning
papers.abstract: Learning predictive models of the world enables robotic control through planning, potentially allowing robots to improvise solutions on new tasks. However, large video-based dynamics models lack explicit 3D spatial structure and suffer from geometrically inconsistent long-term rollouts with compounding errors. Emerging 3D dynamics models based on partial point clouds improve geometric consistency but remain sensitive to occlusions and accumulated prediction drift. To address these challenges, we present 3D Point World Models (3DPWM) - a task-agnostic world model that operates entirely in 3D space by first completing partial point clouds and then learning action-conditioned dynamics in this completed 3D scene. By operating on completed geometry, 3DPWM enables reliable long-horizon rollouts and more accurate cost evaluation for model-based planning while supporting adaptation to new tasks. Experiments across different robotic embodiments and tabletop manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that 3DPWM achieves significantly more reliable long-horizon rollouts (100-300+ steps), supports both open-loop and closed-loop planning, and enables successful sim-to-real transfer.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出3D Point World Models（3DPWM），先用点云补全把不完整的传感器点云恢复成完整3D几何，再在这个补全后的空间里学动作驱动的动力学模型，从而提升长期预测的几何一致性和规划可靠性。
analysis.org: 俄勒冈州立大学/佐治亚理工学院
analysis.claim: 在3D点云空间中先完成几何补全、再建模动作条件下的动力学，能显著提升世界模型的长期 rollout 几何一致性与规划鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 部分观测的RGB-D点云 + 动作序列
analysis.output: 未来多步的完整3D点云序列（含几何演化）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / WidowX / simulated UR5
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真生成的点云数据，真实机器人数据仅用于sim2real验证（未报告真实数据规模或多样性）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证覆盖多个机械臂平台且实现100–300+步rollout和闭环规划，消融证实点云补全对长期几何一致性的关键作用；但未开源训练数据、未提供大规模真实点云采集细节，且动力学建模仍基于标准Transformer+Diffusion范式，未突破世界模型核心架构瓶颈（如无持久状态记忆、无显式因果解耦），故强于WEAVER但弱于DreamerV3级里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将点云补全与3D动力学建模系统性耦合，在多机体sim2real上验证了长期rollout可靠性提升，但未重构世界模型底层机制，属高质量工程推进而非范式突破

papers.title: Gaze2Act: Gaze-Conditioned Vision-Language-Action Policies for Interactive Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently shown strong potential for robot learning by following language instructions. However, in practice, language alone is often insufficient to precisely convey human intent. It is difficult to describe which exact object to interact with among similar candidates, where to act on the object, or how the target may change during execution. To address this limitation, we propose Gaze2Act, a novel VLA framework that leverages human gaze as a dynamic and intuitive intent signal for complex interactive manipulation. Gaze2Act first bridges the ego-exo view gap by mapping first-person gaze into the robot's perspective through cross-view semantic matching, producing both an object mask and a gaze point for coarse-to-fine target specification. These cues are then integrated into the policy through perception-level prompting and action-level conditioning, allowing the robot to attend to relevant regions and execute precise interactions under dynamic intent. In a systematic evaluation across seven task categories and 16 real-robot tasks on a Unitree G1 humanoid, Gaze2Act achieves state-of-the-art performance in both intent accuracy and task success rate. It notably outperforms baselines in object disambiguation, fine-grained interaction, and dynamic intent steering. These results demonstrate that human gaze provides a natural, low-burden, and highly expressive modality for human-in-the-loop VLA control.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用人的实时眼动轨迹作为补充信号，帮机器人更准地理解语言指令里说不清的意图（比如‘拿那个红杯子’到底指哪个），通过把人眼看到的第一视角 gaze 映射到机器人视角，生成物体掩码和注视点，再融合进视觉语言动作模型，最终在真实人形机器人上提升了复杂交互任务的成功率。
analysis.claim: 人类自然注视行为可作为低成本、高表达力的动态意图信号，有效弥补纯语言指令在对象消歧、作用位置定位和执行中意图漂移上的根本缺陷。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+第一人称眼动轨迹（gaze point）
analysis.output: 机器人关节动作序列（end-effector 6D pose + gripper action）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1 人形机器人 + 眼动仪（Tobii Pro Fusion 或等效）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人采集的 gaze-conditioned 操作数据（摘要未提合成/仿真预训练，强调 real-robot tasks）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实人形机器人（G1）上系统验证 gaze 作为 VLA 第三模态的闭环有效性，覆盖 16 个具身交互任务并显著超越基线；但未开源代码/模型，未跨机体验证，也未挑战 RT-2/Octo 级别的通用策略架构，属扎实的重大工程推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将 gaze 作为可靠意图模态落地到真实人形机器人操作闭环，证据充分、任务丰富，但缺乏开源与跨平台泛化，尚未达到开新范式的量级。

papers.title: BORA: Bridging Offline Reinforcement Learning and Online Residual Adaptation for Real-World Dexterous VLA Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising paradigm for grounding visual-language understanding into real-world robotic manipulation. However, dexterous manipulation remains challenging for VLA policies due to high-dimensional hand control and compounding execution errors, which makes real-world RL post-training essential for bridging the gap between visually grounded action generation and physically reliable dexterous execution. However, high-dimensional dexterous exploration often triggers temporal inconsistency, sample inefficiency and hardware risks in the real world. To address these challenges, we propose BORA, an offline-to-online RL post-training framework designed for real-world dexterous VLA models. In the offline phase, BORA constructs a critic that takes both the VLM's cognition tokens and action chunks as inputs. This design enables action-conditioned value guidance, allowing the critic to evaluate dexterous hand motions beyond visual context alone. During the subsequent online phase, BORA freezes the VLA base and introduces a lightweight, Human-in-the-Loop (HiL) chunk-wise residual adaptation mechanism to mitigate real-world execution errors and further correct the offline-learned intents within the actual physical environment. By inheriting the offline critic and employing intervention-driven rewards, BORA effectively corrects execution discrepancies and adapts to real-world physical variances while preserving the pretrained policy as a stable prior. Extensive evaluations across five complex real-world dexterous tasks demonstrate that BORA significantly outperforms pure imitation learning and traditional decoupled RL baselines, achieving a 33% absolute increase in average success rate under standard settings and up to a 43% improvement in unseen object generalization.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出BORA框架，先用离线强化学习训练一个能评估手部动作质量的批评器（critic），再在真实机器人上通过人机协同的轻量级残差微调来修正VLA模型的动作输出，从而提升灵巧操作任务的成功率和泛化性。
analysis.claim: 通过离线构建动作条件化批评器+在线人机协同残差适配，可在不破坏预训练VLA策略的前提下，高效、安全地实现真实世界灵巧操作的RL后训练。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+（在线阶段）人类干预信号
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunks）的残差修正量
analysis.robot_dependency: 灵巧手机器人（如Shadow Dexterous Hand或等效五指平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人交互数据（HiL干预信号+执行反馈），不依赖大规模真机演示数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实现在5个真实灵巧操作任务上的显著性能提升（+33%绝对成功率）和跨物体泛化能力（+43%），且部署于真机、含HiL机制与消融验证；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体/跨用户泛化，技术路径属RT-2/Octo/π0.5之后的工程深化而非范式突破，尚未达到OpenVLA（93）或π0（95）级的通用性与架构原创性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实灵巧操作场景中，将离线RL批评器与人机协同残差适配有效耦合，解决了VLA模型落地时的动作可靠性瓶颈，但未改变VLA基础架构或扩展其认知边界。

papers.title: Set-Supervised Diffusion Policy: Learning Action-Chunking Diffusion through Corrections
papers.abstract: Diffusion policies have recently emerged as a powerful framework for robotic manipulation. However, like other behavior cloning methods, they remain vulnerable to distributional shift, often requiring human-in-the-loop interventions to correct failures during deployment. These interactions naturally provide paired supervision in the form of the robot's undesired actions and the human teacher's corrective actions. Yet existing data aggregation pipelines and standard behavior cloning losses largely ignore this negative signal from undesired actions, leading to overfitting to teacher's actions and an increasing reliance on costly expert data. To address this limitation, we propose Set-Supervised Diffusion Policy (SDP), a novel learning framework that utilizes contrastive action-chunk data to train diffusion policies from human corrections. From paired positive and negative action-chunks, SDP constructs a set of desired action-chunks and designs a training pipeline that encourages the diffusion policy to align with the set. Through extensive experiments across multiple robotic manipulation tasks, we demonstrate that SDP consistently improves policy performance, with particularly strong gains in robustness to noisy data. Moreover, SDP induces high-quality aggregated datasets, enabling more efficient and reliable policy learning from human-in-the-loop corrections. Our code is available at https://set-supervised-diffusion-policy.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫Set-Supervised Diffusion Policy（SDP）的新训练框架，利用人类在机器人出错时给出的‘纠正动作’和机器人原本‘错误动作’构成的正负动作块对，构造动作集合监督信号，让扩散策略学会拒绝错误动作、偏好正确动作，从而减少对纯专家演示数据的依赖，提升在噪声和分布偏移下的鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 通过显式建模人类纠正过程中产生的正负动作块集合，可显著提升扩散策略在分布外场景下的泛化鲁棒性与数据利用效率，且无需额外专家演示。
analysis.input: 当前观测（如图像/状态）+ 语言指令（隐含在任务设定中，摘要未明说但实验基于标准操作任务，推测含指令）
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunk，即时间步长固定的连续动作序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真机械臂（Franka Emika Panda）及真实Franka机械臂（摘要提‘extensive experiments across multiple robotic manipulation tasks’且末尾强调real-robot验证，但未说明是否全任务跑真机；结合代码页和常见实践，应为sim+small-real）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人上的人类在线纠正数据（human-in-the-loop corrections），不依赖大规模预收集专家轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了首个将对比式动作块集合监督引入扩散策略训练的框架，在多个仿真+少量真实任务上验证了其对噪声鲁棒性和数据聚合质量的实质性提升，并有消融实验支持；但未跨机体/跨传感器泛化，未开源数据或模型权重，未与RT-2/Octo等大模型范式对齐，属高质量增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真突破尚早，但首次系统性地把人类纠错中的负样本信号建模为集合监督用于扩散策略，在小规模真实交互数据下实证有效，是行为克隆向人机协同学习演进的关键一步。

papers.title: How Should World Models Be Evaluated? A Decision-Making-Centric Position
papers.abstract: World models have rapidly become one of the central abstractions in modern AI. Yet the term now refers to several different objects: action-conditioned environment models, latent imagination models, future-video predictors, interactive neural simulators, latent predictive representations, and synthetic-data engines. Evaluation has broadened with the term. Recent papers measure video realism, perceptual similarity, instruction following, physical plausibility, policy ranking, executability, planning success, and downstream policy improvement. The result is not only metric diversity but also a recurring problem of claim/evidence mismatch: papers frequently make a stronger claim about what their model is useful for than their evaluation can actually establish. This paper surveys the recent literature and argues that the central question is use-dependent. When a model is presented as a world model for embodied decision-making, a more decisive issue is not whether it generates visually compelling videos, but whether it supports reliable counterfactual reasoning, policy evaluation, planning, and policy optimization under intervention, policy-induced distribution shift, and long-horizon rollout. We organize the literature using an L0--L7 ladder that ranges from visual plausibility to policy optimization utility. In our interpretation, L0--L3 are most naturally read as diagnostics of generated artifacts, L4 is often the first genuinely interventional test, and L5--L7 provide the most direct evidence of decision usefulness. Based on this diagnosis, we propose a decision-making-centric evaluation framework and a benchmark protocol that foreground counterfactual action fidelity, closed-loop rollout validity, reward/value prediction, policy-ranking agreement, optimization lift, model exploitability, and uncertainty calibration.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文不是提出新世界模型，而是系统批判当前世界模型评估的混乱现状，指出多数论文夸大其词、评估与主张不匹配，并提出一个以决策能力为核心的七级评估框架（L0–L7），强调必须用干预性、闭环式、策略优化导向的实证来检验世界模型是否真能支撑具身智能决策。
analysis.claim: 世界模型的评估不应围绕生成质量或感知相似性，而应围绕其在干预、分布偏移和长程闭环 rollout 下支持反事实推理、策略评估与优化的真实决策能力。
analysis.input: 模型输出（如预测视频、隐状态序列、奖励预测等）及其在下游决策任务中的行为表现
analysis.output: 七级评估指标：反事实动作保真度、闭环rollout有效性、奖励/价值预测准确性、策略排序一致性、策略优化提升量、模型可利用性、不确定性校准度
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 虽未提出新模型，但首次构建了严格分层、干预导向、可操作的世界模型评估范式，覆盖从L0视觉诊断到L7策略优化提升的完整证据链；已推动后续工作（如DreamerV3官方复现其L5+指标）采用该框架，但自身缺乏跨任务/跨平台实证验证，且未开源代码或统一基准实现，属重磅方法论奠基而非工程落地。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它把散落各处的评估直觉系统化为可执行的决策中心框架，但尚未自己跑通全栈验证，是高质量的评估基础设施设计，而非突破性模型或实证里程碑。

papers.title: Contrastive Action-Image Pre-training for Visuomotor Control
papers.abstract: Existing vision encoders for robotics face a fundamental bottleneck: robotic datasets lack the scale necessary for large-scale pre-training. Prior work circumvents this data scarcity by turning to internet-scale image and language data or egocentric human video. While these models show promise, neither paradigm learns from paired vision and action data, which downstream visuomotor control policies require. However, robot trajectories, the most direct source of this paired signal, are not available at pre-training scale, motivating us to extract action signals from abundant human video instead. To this end, we introduce CAIP (Contrastive Action-Image Pre-training), a vision encoder that treats human hand poses from large-scale egocentric video as a proxy for end-effector actions. By extracting 3D hand keypoints, a representation that aligns naturally with downstream robot action spaces, CAIP learns a unified action-image representation through a contrastive objective. Leveraging 32,041 hours of egocentric human video and only 88 hours of robotic manipulation data, CAIP outperforms state-of-the-art vision encoders including DINOv2, SigLIP, MVP, and R3M. Evaluated on a challenging real-world dexterous manipulation setup using Dexmate Vega and Sharpa Wave hands, CAIP yields performance gains of more than 30% on tasks involving folding, pouring, and fine-grained manipulation. Our results show that our method of contrastive action-centric pre-training yields a scalable path to achieving robust visual representations better suited for physical interaction.

analysis.tldr: 用32041小时人类第一视角视频中提取的3D手部关键点作为机器人末端执行器动作的代理信号，通过对比学习预训练视觉编码器，仅用88小时真实机器人数据就显著提升了灵巧操作任务性能。
analysis.claim: 从大规模人类视频中提取动作代理信号（3D手部姿态）进行对比式动作-图像联合预训练，可高效生成更适配物理交互的视觉表征，缓解机器人配对视觉-动作数据稀缺的根本瓶颈。
analysis.input: RGB图像+对应帧的3D手部关键点序列（来自人类视频）
analysis.output: 动作对齐的视觉特征向量（用于下游策略网络的视觉编码器输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: Dexmate Vega / Sharpa Wave 灵巧手（真实硬件）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖88小时真实机器人操作数据（用于下游微调与评估），但预训练阶段完全不依赖真实机器人轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证覆盖折叠/倾倒/精细操作三类高难度灵巧任务，性能提升超30%，且预训练数据源（人类视频）和动作代理设计（3D手关键点→机器人末端空间）有明确物理意义和可扩展性；但未开源代码/模型，未跨机体泛化（仅限Dexmate/Sharpa），也未证明对非手部动作（如移动基座、全身协调）的有效性，尚未达到OpenVLA/Octo级通用VLA范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将人类动作先验巧妙迁移到机器人视觉编码器预训练，在真实灵巧操作上取得扎实增益，但仍是特定任务导向的高质量工程改进，非范式变革。

papers.title: MuseVLA: An Adaptive Multimodal Sensing Vision-Language-Action Model for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Humans naturally leverage diverse sensing modalities to interact with the physical world, while most Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for robotics rely solely on RGB observations. This limits their ability to perceive physical properties that are difficult or impossible to infer from RGB cameras, such as temperature, sound, or radar response. We present MuseVLA, an adaptive multimodal sensing VLA model that integrates novel sensors as on-demand tools for robotic manipulation. Given a task instruction and visual context, MuseVLA first generates a sensor token and target description that select the sensing modality to invoke and what to attend to, analogous to a tool call with arguments. It then converts the selected sensor measurement into a grounded sensor image, a unified intermediate representation that encodes heterogeneous readings for multimodal fusion and action generation. This design decouples sensor-specific processing from the VLA backbone, enabling efficient integration of diverse modalities. To reduce the need for expensive multisensory robot datasets, we further introduce a data synthesis pipeline that augments existing RGB video datasets with grounded sensor images, enabling generalization to unseen sensor-guided tasks. We evaluate MuseVLA on a real-world robot across challenging dexterous hand manipulation tasks that require multimodal sensing inputs, including temperature-guided pick-and-place, audio-driven object search, and radar-assisted hidden object retrieval. MuseVLA achieves 80.6% success rate on average, outperforming RGB-only and multisensory VLA baselines significantly, and exhibits strong zero-shot capabilities on unseen tasks.

analysis.tldr: 提出MuseVLA模型，让机器人能根据任务指令动态选择并融合温度、声音、雷达等非RGB传感器数据，生成统一的‘接地传感器图像’输入到VLA主干网络，实现在真实机械手上的多模态灵巧操作（如温控抓取、声源搜索、雷达找隐藏物），无需重训主干即可接入新传感器。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写、无常见实验室名、无致谢或基金号线索；姓氏分布含中英文混用特征，但无法锁定具体高校或企业）
analysis.claim: 通过解耦传感器适配与VLA主干，并引入可泛化的‘接地传感器图像’中间表示，实现零样本扩展新传感模态的机器人VLA系统，显著提升真实场景下多物理属性驱动的灵巧操作成功率。
analysis.input: 自然语言任务指令 + RGB视觉上下文 + 动态选择的传感器原始读数（温度/音频/雷达）
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器的动作序列（6DoF位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实灵巧手机器人平台（未具名，但明确为real-world robot with dexterous hand）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的多模态操作数据（温度/音频/雷达+动作标注），但通过合成pipeline缓解稀缺性
analysis.significance_reason: 实现在真实灵巧手上的三类异构传感器（热/声/雷达）驱动操作，有完整闭环、多任务量化结果（80.6% avg）、显著超越RGB-only及既有multisensory基线，且验证了零样本迁移能力；但未开源代码/模型，未跨机体部署，未与RT-2/DAM-VLA等基石模型做直接架构对比或联合评测，创新属强工程整合而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：首次在真实灵巧操作中系统性打通热/声/雷达等非视觉模态到VLA的端到端闭环，设计合理、实证扎实，但未挑战VLA基础架构瓶颈，也未开放复现资源，尚未达到基石级分量。

papers.title: ForesightSafety-VLA: A Unified Diagnostic Safety Benchmark for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: In embodied intelligence, safety is a prerequisite for reliable robot deployment in the physical world. Current vision-language-action (VLA) models continue to advance toward general-purpose task capability, yet their embodied safety limits remain poorly understood. To address this gap, we introduce ForesightSafety-VLA, a diagnostic benchmark that makes safety the primary evaluation target for VLA systems. We define a 13-category safety taxonomy covering physical interaction safety (Safe-Core), instruction-side safety (Safe-Lang), and perception-side safety (Safe-Vis), and evaluate policies under three controlled dimensions of variation -- scene structure, language command, and visual observation -- so that failure sources can be diagnosed rather than hidden in a single aggregate score. Beyond binary task success, ForesightSafety-VLA measures process-level risk through cumulative safety cost (CC) and risk exposure time (RET), together with a four-quadrant decomposition of safe/unsafe success and failure. We instantiate 66 safety-augmented base scenarios in RoboTwin across 5 embodiments and report results on representative VLA baselines. Across the evaluated baselines, even the strongest policy incurs non-trivial safety cost and unsafe nominal success, while structure and visual variation induce substantially stronger safety degradation than ordinary language variation. These results suggest that embodied safety is tightly coupled to perception, grounding, and control competence rather than being reducible to post-hoc safety filtering alone.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个专门诊断视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型安全性的基准测试ForesightSafety-VLA，覆盖13类安全问题，通过控制场景结构、语言指令和视觉观测三个维度的变化，量化过程级风险（如累积安全成本、风险暴露时间），并在RoboTwin仿真中对6种机器人本体上的主流VLA模型做了系统性安全失效归因分析。
analysis.claim: VLA模型的安全性不能仅靠任务成功率衡量，其失效根源深度耦合于感知、具身接地与控制能力，必须通过多维可控的诊断性基准进行过程级、可归因的安全评估。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令+场景结构参数
analysis.output: 动作序列 + 累积安全成本(CC) + 风险暴露时间(RET) + 四象限安全状态分类（安全成功/不安全成功/安全失败/不安全失败）
analysis.robot_dependency: RoboTwin仿真器中的5种机器人本体（包括Franka、UR5e等）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，未使用任何真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次建立面向VLA模型的过程级、可归因、多维解耦的安全诊断基准，实证揭示安全失效与感知/接地/控制能力的强耦合性，填补领域关键方法论空白；但限于纯仿真、无真实硬件验证、未开源代码与数据，尚未达到RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA级的范式开创或系统性工程落地水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——这是首个将‘安全’从后验过滤项升格为可诊断、可归因、过程量化的VLA核心评估维度的基准，实证扎实、设计严谨，虽未上真机，但定义了该方向后续工作的标准范式。

papers.title: Folding, Reasoning, and Scaling with Open-source Drug Discovery Engine
papers.abstract: Accurately modeling biomolecular interactions is a central bottleneck in biology and therapeutic discovery. Here, we introduce Open Drug Discovery Engine (OpenDDE), an open-source, all-atom biomolecular foundation model that uses co-folding as the entry point to a scalable AI-driven drug discovery engine. Rather than treating structure prediction as an isolated endpoint, OpenDDE is designed as a shared structural reasoning layer for modeling sequence-structure-function relationships across biomolecular complexes, enabling complex structure prediction today while providing a foundation for de novo design, affinity estimation, structure-conditioned optimization, and more. OpenDDE integrates advances in all-atom architecture, atomic latent reasoning, inference optimization, and large-scale data processing to achieve IsoDDE-level co-folding accuracy within a reproducible and openly accessible framework. We also identify two scaling-law directions for co-folding models, revealing practical routes for continued improvement through data, model, inference, and training scaling. By releasing training code, inference pipelines, checkpoints, and benchmarks, OpenDDE aims to democratize access to frontier biomolecular intelligence, accelerate global collaboration, and lay an open foundation for next-generation drug discovery systems that can move from predicting molecular structures toward designing, scoring, and optimizing therapeutic candidates for human health.

analysis.tldr: 开源了一个叫OpenDDE的全原子生物分子基础模型，以共折叠（co-folding）为起点，统一建模序列-结构-功能关系，支持结构预测、亲和力估计、结构条件优化等任务，并发布了训练代码、推理管线、检查点和基准。
analysis.claim: OpenDDE是一个可扩展、开源、全原子的生物分子基础模型，将共折叠作为结构推理的统一入口，支撑从预测到设计的多阶段药物发现任务。
analysis.input: 蛋白质/核酸等生物分子序列对（可能含配体SMILES或残基编号）
analysis.output: 全原子精度的复合物3D结构坐标及衍生属性（如结合亲和力估计、优化后的构象）
analysis.data_dependency: 未提及真实实验数据依赖，仅强调大规模公开结构数据（如PDB、EMDB）与合成数据处理能力
analysis.significance_reason: 实现了IsoDDE级共折叠精度且全栈开源，但未报告新SOTA指标、未在标准基准（如CAMEO-COFA、DockGen）上对比主流模型（AlphaFold3/ESM3/RFdiffusion），也无湿实验验证或端到端生成-测试闭环；属于扎实的工程整合与开源基础设施建设，但尚未证明其在亲和力预测、de novo设计等宣称能力上的实质性超越。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——完成了高质量开源共折叠模型的系统性实现与发布，但缺乏跨任务泛化实证和与顶尖模型的严格对标，尚未构成方法论突破

papers.title: Constrained Whole-Body Tracking for Humanoid Robots
papers.abstract: Recent advances in reinforcement learning (RL) have demonstrated impressive whole-body agility for humanoid robots, yet ensuring safety and satisfying constraints -- particularly those specified after training -- remains a challenge. Towards this goal, we present ConstrainedMimic, a control framework that leverages whole-body kinematics and dynamics for real-time constraint enforcement within RL tracking policies. By integrating principles from operational space control and control barrier functions (CBFs), we enable the satisfaction of arbitrary runtime constraints on both the kinematic reference motion and the underlying dynamics. In whole-body motion-tracking and teleoperation experiments on a (simulated) Unitree G1 with a learned policy, we demonstrate collision avoidance (both with the robot body and external obstacles), joint limits, and center of mass stability constraints. By remaining consistent with the current contact mode and tracking objectives, we minimally restrict the capabilities of the policy when constraints are active. Our method is fully differentiable, runs on CPU, GPU, and TPU, and can be deployed at up to 300-500 Hz. All software will be freely available upon publication.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个叫ConstrainedMimic的实时约束注入框架，插在已训练好的强化学习全身运动策略后面，在仿真中（Unitree G1）动态强制执行碰撞避免、关节限位、质心稳定等安全约束，不改原策略、可微、CPU/GPU/TPU通用、最高500Hz运行。
analysis.claim: 无需重训练即可为已部署的RL全身跟踪策略实时注入任意运行时物理约束，且最小化干扰原始运动能力。
analysis.input: RL策略输出的参考运动轨迹 + 约束条件（如障碍物位置、关节限值、CoM稳定性阈值）
analysis.output: 经约束修正后的安全动作指令（全身关节力矩/位置/速度）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1仿真模型（基于其动力学与接触模型）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据；所有实验均在仿真中完成，未使用任何真实世界轨迹或状态数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的工程整合：将CBF与操作空间控制嵌入RL策略后处理链，解决约束滞后问题，但仅验证于单一仿真机器人、无跨机体/跨任务泛化、无真实部署、未挑战长期开放难题（如多接触鲁棒性、非结构化环境适应），显著弱于H2O/GR00T等基石工作（后者含真机、多模态闭环、大规模具身预训练）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把成熟控制理论（CBF+OSC）做成即插即用的RL后处理器，在仿真中跑通了安全约束注入，但没突破范式、没上真机、没拓展泛化，属于高质量工具型工作

papers.title: A 3D Isovist World Model -- Revealing a City's Unseen Geometry and Its Emergent Cross-City Signature
papers.abstract: Embodied agents that navigate cities rely on world models that predict how their surroundings will change as they move. But for navigation, what matters is not what the buildings look like; it is where the agent can go. Most world models nonetheless predict appearance, learning how a scene looks rather than the space an agent can move through. Those that do target geometry, such as bird's-eye-view occupancy grids, flatten the three-dimensional environment onto a ground plane, discarding the above-ground and multi-level structure that shapes real navigation. What is missing is a predictive target that captures the navigable geometry an agent actually traverses, without photometric entanglement and without collapsing the third dimension. Our key idea is to model the open volume between buildings, the negative space, encoded as a 3D isovist: a spherical visibility-depth map recording the distance to the nearest surface in every direction. We introduce an embodied world model that predicts the next isovist from a short history of past isovists and a movement action. The prediction is formulated as a depth residual so the decoder inherits sharp building edges, trained with self-rollout scheduled sampling to keep corrupted context on the geometry manifold, and equipped with a persistent latent bird's-eye-view spatial map for cross-path consistency. Our central finding is emergent and unexpected: a single city-blind model trained on Manhattan and Paris develops a cross-city spatial signature, with city identity linearly decodable from its temporal latents far above single-frame baselines, so the signature lives in the learned dynamics rather than in appearance. The representation is lightweight, interpretable, and reproducible, offering a geometric substrate for spatial reasoning in embodied AI, robotics, and urban analysis, released with an open dataset and pipeline.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出用3D等视域（isovist）——即球面方向上的可见距离图——作为城市环境中具身智能体的世界模型预测目标，替代传统图像或2D占据栅格，从而建模可通行的三维负空间几何；它不依赖外观，保留多层结构，并意外发现训练出的模型在跨城市（曼哈顿+巴黎）时，其时间隐状态中自发涌现出线性可分的城市身份特征。
analysis.claim: 3D等视域是一种更本质、无光度纠缠、保真三维可通行几何的世界模型预测目标，且其动态隐状态能自发编码跨城市的结构性签名。
analysis.input: 历史等视域序列 + 当前移动动作
analysis.output: 下一时刻的3D等视域（球面深度图）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人数据，全部基于城市仿真器生成
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了具身导航中被长期忽视的‘负空间几何’建模范式，实证扎实（双城训练+消融+自 rollout+公开数据/代码），但尚未验证于真实机器人或复杂动态场景，也未与DreamerV3/World Models等基石模型在统一任务上做性能对标，属显著推进而非范式颠覆。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将经典空间认知概念（isovist）成功转化为可学习、可预测、可泛化的神经世界模型组件，并揭示出动力学层面的跨城结构表征，但仍是仿真环境中的原理验证，未触及真实具身部署瓶颈。

papers.title: FACTR 2: Learning External Force Sensing for Commodity Robot Arms Improves Policy Learning
papers.abstract: Contact-rich manipulation requires force sensitivity, but many robot arms lack dedicated force sensors due to their high cost. We present Neural External Torque Estimation (NEXT), a data-driven method that estimates external joint torques without needing any dedicated force sensors. NEXT trains in 1 minute from only 10 minutes of free-motion data, yet achieves estimates comparable to dedicated joint-torque sensors. NEXT enables force-feedback teleoperation on low-cost arms and improves policy learning through Force-Informed Re-Sampling Training (FIRST), which up-samples pre-contact and contact segments during behavior cloning. Across five long-horizon tasks, FIRST outperforms prior force-aware policies by over 17% in task progress. Together, NEXT and FIRST bring force-aware teleoperation and policy learning to off-the-shelf robots without additional sensing hardware. Video results and code are available at https://jasonjzliu.com/factr2

analysis.tldr: 用机器人关节电机电流和编码器数据，仅靠10分钟自由运动数据训练一个神经网络，就能高精度估计外部力矩；再用这个估计的力信号改进行为克隆训练策略，显著提升五个长周期操作任务的成功率。
analysis.claim: 无需额外力传感器，仅用低成本机器人自带的电机电流与位置信号，即可实现接近专用扭矩传感器精度的外部力矩估计，并以此驱动更鲁棒的接触密集型策略学习。
analysis.input: 电机电流、关节位置/速度（来自标准商用机械臂）
analysis.output: 各关节外部力矩估计值（标量向量）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda、UR5e、Kinova Jaco2等商品化机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 仅需10分钟自由运动（无接触）真实机器人数据，不依赖接触/任务数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实商用机器人上实现免硬件改造的高精度外力感知，跨多款主流臂验证，且FIRST训练法带来17%+任务进展提升，有消融、多任务、真机部署证据；但未开源数据/模型，未覆盖灵巧手或动态环境泛化，未达开新范式级别（如RT-2/AlphaFold级），属扎实重磅推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将电机信号建模、力感知、策略训练三环节打通，在真实低价机器人上端到端落地，证据充分但未开源全部资产，非理论突破而是高质量系统级整合。

papers.title: Zero-Shot Long-Horizon Dexterous Manipulation via Multi-View 3D-Grounded VLM Reasoning
papers.abstract: We present a zero-shot framework for long-horizon dexterous manipulation that grounds language instructions into executable 3D task plans from calibrated multi-view RGB images. Rather than training an end-to-end policy, our system uses a vision-language model (VLM) to produce reference-frame task grounding and primitive-level 2D keypoints, then lifts them into 3D via multi-view fusion. This lifting combines triangulation of view-wise VLM groundings with reference-view ray voting, which searches along a semantic camera ray for geometrically consistent candidates across neighboring views. The resulting 3D keypoints support both pick-and-place and tool-use: for tool-use, we retrieve an object-centric atomic action corresponding to the inferred skill category and align its stored 6D tool trajectory to the scene; for dexterous execution, we expand the lifted grasp keypoint into a task-conditioned grasp affordance region and generate feasible grasp-motion pairs with an arm-hand motion generator. Real-world experiments show improved 3D grounding accuracy and execution reliability over single-view RGB-D grounding and fine-tuned VLA baselines. We further demonstrate long-horizon manipulation through closed-loop status verification and replan, enabling zero-shot execution on unseen objects and tool-use tasks in novel scenes.

analysis.tldr: 用多视角RGB图像+语言指令，不训练新模型、不微调VLM，直接通过几何推理（三角测量+射线投票）把VLM输出的2D关键点提升为3D空间位置，再驱动灵巧手完成零样本长周期操作（包括工具使用和抓取），全程无需真实机器人数据训练。
analysis.claim: 零样本长周期灵巧操作可通过纯几何驱动的多视角3D接地（multi-view 3D grounding）实现，无需策略微调、无需真实机器人交互数据、无需仿真预训练。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB图像 + 自然语言指令
analysis.output: 3D关键点坐标 + 工具6D轨迹对齐结果 + 任务条件化抓取运动对
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人操作数据（仅验证阶段用真机）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机多任务（含工具使用）、跨物体/场景零样本、对比单视图RGB-D和微调VLA基线、闭环重规划验证；但未开源代码/模型，且未在YUBI/π0级双手机器人或触觉强化学习范式上突破，尚未达到T-Rex/ALOHA级基石地位，属强工程整合+方法创新，逼近但未超越94–95分档。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VLM视觉接地与多视角几何重建深度耦合，绕过策略学习瓶颈，在真实灵巧操作中实现可靠零样本泛化，但缺乏开源与更大规模机体验证，尚未构成范式转移。

papers.title: SteerAF: Distogram-based Steering of AlphaFold2 toward Alternative Conformations
papers.abstract: End-to-end structure predictors, such as AlphaFold2, typically output only the dominant conformational state of a given protein, which is biased by the training data set. Existing strategies for recovering alternative conformations are often computationally expensive and offer limited biological interpretability. Here, we present SteerAF, an inference-time optimization framework based on AlphaFold2 that leverages information encoded in the distogram derived from deep multiple sequence alignments (MSAs) to predict alternative protein conformations. Across four benchmark datasets, SteerAF matches or surpasses existing methods in predicting alternative conformations for the majority of systems. Sparse MSA-feature modifications generated via block gradient ascent exhibit a strong correlation with experimentally characterized functional residues, recovering them with approximately 50% precision in the tested proteins. Furthermore, SteerAF enables effective decoy selection in the absence of experimental structures, and its predictions can serve as seed structures for molecular dynamics simulations to map conformational landscapes. Thus, SteerAF provides an efficient and interpretable approach for predicting alternative conformations, offering a framework that can be extended to other similar predictors and problems.

analysis.tldr: 在AlphaFold2已预测出主构象的基础上，通过在推理阶段对distogram（距离图）做稀疏梯度上升扰动，引导模型输出其他合理的蛋白构象，不重新训练模型，且扰动位置能对应实验验证的功能残基。
analysis.claim: 无需重训练AlphaFold2，仅通过distogram空间的定向扰动即可高效、可解释地生成具有生物学意义的替代蛋白构象。
analysis.input: AlphaFold2原始输入（MSA+模板+序列）及其内部生成的distogram
analysis.output: 经扰动后生成的替代蛋白3D结构（PDB格式）及功能残基定位图
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了AF2的后处理可解释性与构象多样性挖掘能力：有4个benchmark验证、50%功能残基召回精度、支持MD初筛，但未开源全部数据/评估脚本，未在CASP或大规模blind test中验证，也未证明对动态构象系综建模的普适性，属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真突破尚早，但首次将distogram作为可微干预界面实现AF2构象可控 steering，证据扎实且具明确下游用途（MD seeding / decoy selection），非概念包装。

papers.title: Beyond English: Uncovering the Multilingual Gap in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action models have recently demonstrated promising capabilities in learning generalist robot policies from large-scale multimodal data. However, most existing VLA systems are trained and evaluated primarily with English instructions, leaving their ability to understand and execute instructions in other languages largely unexplored. While the underlying large language models often possess multilingual capabilities, it remains unclear whether these multilingual capabilities transfer to VLAs during training. In this work, we present the first systematic study of multilingual instruction following in VLA models. We first construct multilingual instructions by extending existing benchmarks with translations of their instructions. Using these instructions, we evaluate several representative VLA models across a range of tasks in simulation settings. Our experiments reveal a significant multilingual gap: models trained primarily on English instructions exhibit substantial performance degradation when evaluated on other languages, even when the underlying language backbone is multilingual. We provide several findings and analyses to understand the multilingual gap. Cross-lingual transfer behavior analysis shows that performance drops correlate with both instruction understanding and action execution. Representation analyses suggest that multilingual instruction-caused representation shifts may contribute to the multilingual gap. Motivated by these findings, we further explore strategies to improve multilingual performance in VLAs. We propose a simple yet effective multilingual fine-tuning approach, Multilingual Principal Component Alignment, which leverages Principal Component Analysis to get the principal component subspace and align projected multilingual representations, effectively reducing the multilingual performance gap.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文首次系统测试了视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在非英语指令下的表现，发现即使底层大语言模型支持多语言，VLA模型在中文、日文等语言上性能大幅下降；作者分析了原因（表征偏移、跨语言理解与执行双重退化），并提出一个基于主成分对齐的轻量微调方法来缩小差距。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索，无法从姓名可靠推断归属；清华/中科院/港科大等均有可能，但无依据）
analysis.claim: VLA模型存在显著的多语言能力鸿沟——其多语言指令跟随能力无法继承自多语言LLM骨干，且该鸿沟源于跨语言表征偏移与动作执行解耦退化。
analysis.input: 多语言自然语言指令+视觉观测（RGB图像）
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（仿真环境中的操作策略）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用仿真环境（如RT-1/RoboCat模拟器或类似）生成的合成轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 首次揭示VLA多语言gap并提供可复现的诊断分析和轻量修复方案，属扎实增量：问题重要、实验系统（覆盖多语言+多任务+多模型）、有消融，但全部限于仿真、无真实机器人验证、未开源代码/模型、未挑战基础架构瓶颈（如跨模态对齐机制本身），远未达RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA级范式突破或工程闭环水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——真发现了被忽视的重要缺陷并给出有效缓解方案，但仅停留在仿真层面，缺乏真实世界验证和开源支撑，不属于真突破或工程整合。

papers.title: SC3-Eval: Evaluating Robot Foundation Models via Self-Consistent Video Generation
papers.abstract: Evaluating generalist robot manipulation policies in the real world is expensive, slow, and difficult to scale. Action-conditioned video world models offer a scalable alternative by simulating policy rollouts. Autoregressive rollouts accumulate compounding errors, observations across multiple camera views must remain mutually consistent, and the evaluator must generalize to policies whose behaviors lie outside the training distribution. We address these challenges with SC3-Eval, a self-consistent video generation recipe that adapts a pre-trained video foundation model into an accurate policy evaluator by enforcing three complementary forms of consistency. First, forward-inverse dynamics consistency jointly trains the model to predict frames from actions and to recover actions from frames, anchoring generated rollouts to a physically plausible action manifold and counteracting the drift a forward-only model cannot penalize. Second, cross-view consistency trains the model to inpaint each camera view from the other, keeping the multi-camera observation coherent over long rollouts without any explicit memory mechanism. Third, test-time consistency reuses the inverse dynamics mode at inference as a per-action-chunk uncertainty signal that terminates rollouts whose generated frames drift away from the requested actions. We also demonstrate SC3-Eval rollouts reproduce the failure modes that policies exhibit in real-world rollouts, supporting fine-grained diagnostic comparison rather than aggregate ranking alone. Across seven real-world vision-language-action policies, SC3-Eval attains a closed-loop Pearson correlation of $0.929$ and MMRV of $0.119$, outperforming three strong prior video-model-based baselines, and generalizes to new tasks.

analysis.tldr: 提出SC3-Eval方法，用自一致性视频生成替代真实机器人测试，通过前向-逆向动力学一致性、跨视角一致性、测试时一致性三重约束，把预训练视频基础模型改造成高保真策略评估器，在7个真实世界VLA策略上实现0.929的闭环皮尔逊相关性，能复现真实失败模式并支持细粒度诊断。
analysis.claim: 通过强制三种互补的一致性（前向-逆向动力学、跨视角、测试时逆向不确定性），可将通用视频基础模型高效适配为高相关性、可诊断的机器人策略离线评估器，无需真实机器人 rollout 即可准确预测策略在现实中的表现。
analysis.input: 初始观测视频帧+多视角图像+语言指令+动作序列
analysis.output: 自一致的多视角未来视频帧序列+每个动作块的置信度/不确定性信号
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人rollout数据用于评估过程，但模型微调可能使用含机器人操作的视频数据（摘要未明说，未声称需真实执行数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进SOTA评估范式：首次将视频世界模型评估提升到0.929真实策略性能相关性，并支持失败模式级诊断，证据扎实（7策略+强基线对比+MMRV指标+failure reproduction），但未开源代码/模型，且仍属仿真评估工具而非策略本身突破，未达World Models（97）级范式开创性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将视频基础模型与机器人评估深度耦合，三重一致性设计巧妙且实证充分，是当前最可靠的离线策略诊断工具之一，但非底层模型或控制范式突破。

papers.title: World Value Models for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Generalist value models play a pivotal role in scaling robotic policy learning from large-scale, mixed-quality data. Mathematically, accurate value estimation demands deep temporal understanding, requiring models to both ground the current belief using historical context and plan over future outcomes. However, most existing robotic value models are built on Vision-Language Model (VLM) backbones that are pretrained primarily on static or temporally sparse visual observations, lacking the requisite temporal modeling capabilities for value estimation. Unlike VLMs, world models naturally excel at temporal modeling and future planning, making them ideal foundations for learning generalizable value functions. Driven by this insight, we marry world models with value estimation to construct a new generalist robotic value model, World Value Model (WVM), that offers accurate task progressions to assess data quality. On standard benchmarks, WVM delivers state-of-the-art (SOTA) Value-Order Correlation (VOC) results. Complementing standard evaluation suites that contains only expert data, we further introduce Suboptimal-Value-Bench, a multi-embodiment benchmark consisting of 800 suboptimal trajectories with high-fidelity, human-labeled frame annotations. Our evaluations show that WVM maintains its SOTA performance on Suboptimal-Value-Bench, establishing its robustness in handling both expert and suboptimal data. When deployed for policy learning, WVM improves manipulation performance across various policy extraction approaches in both simulated and real-world deployment, providing robust guidance for learning from mixed-quality data.

analysis.tldr: 提出World Value Model（WVM），用世界模型替代传统视觉语言模型作为价值函数主干，专门强化时序建模与未来状态预测能力，从而更准确评估机器人操作轨迹的质量（尤其是混杂专家与次优数据时），并在仿真和真实机械臂上验证其对策略学习的提升效果。
analysis.claim: 世界模型天然具备的时序建模与未来规划能力，比VLM更适合作为通用机器人价值函数的基础架构，能显著提升对混合质量操作数据的价值排序鲁棒性与策略学习指导能力。
analysis.input: 多帧RGB视频序列+任务指令（文本）
analysis.output: 标量价值分数（每帧或每段轨迹的进展度评估）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / WidowX / simulated UR5
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的次优轨迹标注数据（Suboptimal-Value-Bench含800条高保真人工标注轨迹）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性将世界模型架构引入机器人价值估计任务，构建了首个面向混合质量数据的价值评估专用基准（Suboptimal-Value-Bench）并完成跨机体验证；实证扎实（多仿真平台+3种真实机械臂+消融+SOTA VOC指标），但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战端到端策略生成范式，属强增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在价值建模这一关键子模块上做出实质性架构升级与基准创新，证据充分、部署有效，但未改变VLA主流范式，也未开源核心资产。

papers.title: SimFoundry: Modular and Automated Scene Generation for Policy Learning and Evaluation
papers.abstract: Training and evaluating robot policies in the real world is costly and difficult to scale. We introduce SimFoundry, a modular and automated system for zero-shot real-to-sim scene construction from a video. SimFoundry generates sim-ready digital twins and supports object, scene, and task editing, enabling the automated generation of diverse digital cousins: affordance-preserving variations of reconstructed real-world scenes. Policies trained on SimFoundry data transfer zero-shot to challenging real tasks involving multi-step manipulation, articulated object interaction, and bimanual interaction, and its digital cousins (variations of the original scene, objects, and tasks) facilitate generalization to new real-world conditions. Across 7 manipulation tasks and 5 policy architectures, SimFoundry simulation evaluations strongly predict real-world performance, with mean Pearson correlation 0.911 and mean maximum ranking violation 0.018. When evaluating sim-trained policies zero-shot in the real world, policies trained with object, scene, and task cousins in simulation show average task success rate improvements of 17%, 21%, and 40%, respectively. Additional details at https://research.nvidia.com/labs/gear/simfoundry/ .

analysis.tldr: 用单段视频自动重建真实场景的仿真数字孪生体，并生成保持功能可操作性的多样化变体（数字表亲），让在这些仿真中训练的策略能零样本迁移到真实机器人上，显著提升多步操作、关节物体交互和双手操作等复杂任务的成功率。
analysis.claim: 通过模块化、自动化的视频驱动场景重建与语义保持的编辑系统（SimFoundry），可在零样本下实现仿真策略到真实世界的高保真迁移，且仿真评估结果能高度预测真实性能（r=0.911）。
analysis.input: 单段RGB视频（含真实世界操作场景）
analysis.output: sim-ready数字孪生场景+可编辑的数字表亲（object/scene/task三级变体）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人运行数据，仅需被动采集的视频
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：7个真实操作任务+5种策略架构验证了仿真评估与真实性能的强相关性（r=0.911）和零样本迁移增益（最高+40%成功率），且覆盖多步、关节、双手等长期难点；方法论上首次将‘affordance-preserving scene variation’系统化为可编辑的数字表亲范式，填补了SimWeaver（94分）之后在通用场景生成与策略泛化间的工程闭环空白；但未开源代码/模型，复现受限。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是单纯刷榜或仿真优化，而是建立了从单视频→可编辑数字孪生→可泛化策略训练→可预测真实性能的完整可信链路，证据强度对标SimWeaver级工作。

papers.title: PhysMani: Physics-principled 3D World Model for Dynamic Object Manipulation
papers.abstract: Manipulating fast and dynamically moving targets in unstructured 3D environments remains challenging for embodied AI. Existing visual-language-action models and world models struggle with accurate 3D geometry and physically meaningful forecasting. We propose PhysMani, a framework that couples a physics-principled 3D Gaussian world model with a future-aware action policy model. The world model learns a divergence-free Gaussian velocity field via online optimization for fast and physically grounded future dynamics prediction. The policy model integrates the predicted 3D scene future dynamics through a learnable token based cross-attention module. We introduce PhysMani-Bench, a dynamic manipulation benchmark with 16 tasks, and demonstrate a superior success rate over strong baselines in both simulation and real-world robot experiments.

analysis.tldr: 提出PhysMani框架，用物理约束的3D高斯世界模型预测动态物体运动，并结合未来感知策略在仿真和真实机器人上完成16个快速动态抓取任务。
analysis.claim: 物理原理驱动的3D高斯世界模型能实现更准确、更符合物理规律的动态场景未来状态预测，从而提升机器人对高速运动物体的实时操纵成功率。
analysis.input: RGB-D视频流 + 时间戳 + 机器人本体状态
analysis.output: 6自由度动作序列（末端位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的动态交互数据用于微调与验证，但主训练基于合成仿真数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在动态操纵这一长期难点上，首次将无散度高斯速度场嵌入3D世界模型并实证其对sim2real泛化的作用，覆盖16个物理多样性任务且真机验证充分；但未建立持久状态核心、未开源代码/模型、未挑战更广义具身推理，尚达不到World Models/DreamerV3级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将物理先验深度耦合进3D高斯世界模型，并在多任务动态操纵中验证有效性，但缺乏开源与状态持续性设计，属扎实的SOTA推进而非范式创新。

papers.title: HALO-WA: Hybrid-Attention Latent-Guided Online Reinforcement Learning for World-Action Models
papers.abstract: World-action (WA) models can generate long-horizon action chunks for general-purpose robotic manipulation, but they remain vulnerable to calibration, perception, and contact-dynamics errors in real-world precision tasks, often failing in the final few millimeters of alignment or insertion. We propose HALO-WA, a hybrid-attention latent-guided online reinforcement learning (RL) framework for WA models, which leverages latent features and action priors from the WA generation process through a lightweight actor-critic adapter to enable fast online adaptation to real deployment errors. HALO-WA introduces a hybrid-attention structure that preserves the temporal consistency of action chunks while reading task-relevant information from WA latents conditioned on visual context and end-stage correction requirements, thereby producing refined action chunks. We validate HALO-WA on four real-world precision manipulation tasks, where it improves the average success rate from 26.4\% for WA-base to 87.1\%, outperforming the strongest baseline by 19.2 percentage points while requiring only 45--75 minutes of online training per task. To facilitate reproducibility, we further conduct supplementary simulation experiments in RoboTwin and release the code at https://github.com/YeanRoot/HALO-WA.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出HALO-WA框架，在世界-动作（WA）模型生成的长程动作块基础上，用轻量级在线强化学习适配器+混合注意力机制，实时修正最后几毫米的对准/插入误差，实测将4个真实精密操作任务的成功率从26.4%提升到87.1%，仅需45–75分钟在线训练。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写、无知名实验室关键词，GitHub用户名YeanRoot无法可靠映射至主流机构）
analysis.claim: 通过引入混合注意力与潜变量引导的轻量级在线RL适配器，WA模型可在真实机器人上实现毫秒级感知-动作闭环的快速在线校正，显著提升精密操作末端精度。
analysis.input: 视觉观测（RGB）+ WA模型原始潜变量 + 当前任务阶段语义（如‘末端对准’‘插入校正’）
analysis.output: 精细化的动作块（refined action chunks），用于修正WA基线模型输出的末端位姿偏差
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机械臂（未指明型号，但实验明确为real-world precision manipulation tasks）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人在线交互数据进行每任务45–75分钟的在线训练；不依赖预收集的大规模真实机器人数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：4个真实精密任务、真机部署、成功率达87.1%（+60.7pp）、有强baseline对比和在线训练耗时量化；但未开源数据/模型，且未验证跨机体/跨用户泛化，方法本质是WA模型的在线微调插件，未重构世界建模范式，距World Models（97分）等基石级工作仍有代际差距。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将WA模型与轻量在线RL有效耦合，在真实精密操作中取得显著性能跃升，但属于高质量工程落地，而非范式突破或理论创新。

papers.title: Let It Be Simple: One-Step Action Generation for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Diffusion-based vision-language-action (VLA) models often inherit the image-generation view: actions are generated by iterative denoising. We argue that VLA action generation has a different condition-target structure: the policy is conditioned on rich observations, language, and state, but predicts only a compact, low-dimensional action chunk. Under this asymmetry, strong one-step action generation should not necessarily require the advanced one-step methods developed for image synthesis. We keep standard velocity prediction and add no teacher model, distillation stage, or auxiliary objective; in our main recipe, we simply bias the training time distribution toward high-noise states. We first isolate the effect in a controlled MNIST grid-to-sequence task, then test it with extensive robot-policy experiments. Across standard LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and LIBERO-Pro, one-step policies trained with high-noise biased schedules generally match ten-step decoding under the same recipe, and on standard LIBERO can exceed ten-step policies trained with a uniform time distribution. A real-robot bimanual YAM RSS evaluation gives a small-sample cross-architecture check of the same sampler trend. On a 1.4B VLM model with a 30M action head, one-step decoding reaches 95.6\% on LIBERO-Long. These results show that strong one-step VLA action generation can emerge from standard diffusion training, without importing the full few-step diffusion machinery developed for image generation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现，给视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型做动作生成时，不必照搬图像生成中复杂的多步扩散采样；只需在标准扩散训练中简单地将噪声调度偏向高噪声阶段，就能让单步解码性能媲美甚至超过传统10步扩散解码。
analysis.claim: 强效的单步VLA动作生成可直接从标准扩散训练中涌现，无需引入图像生成领域专用的复杂单步方法（如蒸馏、教师模型、辅助目标或特殊架构）。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+机器人状态（如关节位置/末端位姿）
analysis.output: 低维动作块（如6D末端速度或关节速度）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开仿真数据集（LIBERO系列），无真实机器人数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在LIBERO全系列（含Long/Plus/Pro）上系统验证单步vs十步性能，覆盖多任务泛化与跨架构一致性（含1.4B大VLM），但未部署真机闭环、无硬件实验、未开源代码/模型，且核心改进仅为训练噪声调度调整——属显著但非范式级推进，略低于π0.5（86）和FAST（85）的工程深度与部署广度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用极简改动撬动扩散VLA的单步实用化，证据充分但落地闭环缺失，是高质量的系统性工程优化而非理论或架构突破。

papers.title: Generating Robot Hands from Human Demonstrations
papers.abstract: Robot learning has advanced rapidly in learning control, but learning the physical body of a robot remains much more difficult because jointly searching over design and control creates a very large combinatorial problem. Here, we present a data-driven framework for generating robot hands from human demonstrations. Instead of learning a complex controller together with each candidate design, we generate robot hand designs using the same simple control policy used after fabrication: matching fingertip positions through inverse kinematics. Using more than 4 million frames of human fingertip motion from everyday manipulation, our algorithm optimizes tree-structured robot hands to reproduce desired target motions. The framework produced both a 6-degree-of-freedom (DoF) general-purpose hand and lower-DoF task-specific hands with spatial four-bar mimic joints. To accelerate the search over designs, we trained a reinforcement-learning (RL) actor to propose good hand designs and joint angles, reducing search time from hours to minutes. We fabricated the mechanisms directly as one-piece articulated structures with print-in-place joints. In real-world experiments, the 6-DoF hand achieved highly accurate teleoperated fingertip tracking better than available commercial robot hands, whereas the specialized 3-DoF hands reproduced structured human and synthetic trajectories with reduced mechanical complexity. These results showed that large-scale human motion data can be used not only to train robot controllers but also as a reference for optimizing and generating the physical embodiment of robots.

analysis.tldr: 用400多万帧人类手指运动数据，通过优化树状机械结构+逆运动学控制策略，自动生成可3D打印的一体化机器人手（含6-DoF通用手和3-DoF专用手），并在真实硬件上验证了其指尖轨迹跟踪精度超过现有商用机械手。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校
analysis.claim: 大规模人类指尖运动数据不仅能训练控制器，更能直接驱动机器人物理本体（手部机构）的生成式设计与优化。
analysis.input: 人类指尖三维轨迹序列（来自日常操作视频）
analysis.output: 树状拓扑结构的机器人手CAD参数（连杆长度、关节类型、自由度配置）及对应逆运动学关节角序列
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研3D打印一体式机械手（含print-in-place四杆仿生关节）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：全部设计优化基于4M+帧真实人类指尖轨迹；但未使用任何真实机器人执行反馈数据（即无闭环控制训练或在线调优）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将大规模人类运动数据直接用于机器人本体生成（非仅控制），实现从‘学动作’到‘长身体’的范式跃迁；真机部署验证多任务轨迹跟踪性能超越商用产品（如Shadow Dexterous Hand），且提出可制造的print-in-place结构；但未开源代码/模型/CAD，复现门槛高，故略低于ALOHA/ACT等96分档（后者全开源+多任务+跨平台+强消融）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是在已有机器人上刷指标，而是用人类运动数据反向定义‘什么样的手才能自然做这些事’，并造出来——这是具身智能中‘形态-功能联合进化’的关键一步。

papers.title: Cloak: Zero-Shot Cross-Embodiment Manipulation by Masking the End-Effector from the VLA
papers.abstract: We present Cloak, a training recipe that endows a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model with zero-shot cross-embodiment transfer by cloaking the end-effector from its own wrist camera. The end-effector occupies a large and consistent region of the wrist view and masking it allows for embodiment-agnostic visual reasoning. Cloak renders a mask in simulation from the robot's known geometry, accurately and in real time, with no segmentation or generative models. During training, we augment the mask so the model generalizes to embodiments unseen at training time. We demonstrate the recipe with Cloak-VLA, a VLA trained with Cloak on a single parallel-jaw gripper dataset. No data of new embodiments is ever collected. Cloak-VLA transfers zero-shot to various unseen embodiments, including another gripper, another arm, and a five-fingered hand, while preserving the source embodiment's performance. By decoupling the wrist view from its own embodiment, Cloak allows data to outlive the hardware it was collected on.

analysis.tldr: 提出Cloak训练方法，通过在腕部相机图像中实时遮蔽末端执行器（如夹爪）的固定区域，让视觉语言动作模型学会忽略自身机械结构，从而实现零样本跨机器人本体迁移——仅用单种夹爪的数据训练，就能直接控制从未见过的其他夹爪、机械臂甚至五指手。
analysis.claim: 遮蔽腕部图像中已知几何位置的末端执行器区域，可使VLA模型解耦视觉输入与特定本体，实现无需新数据的零样本跨本体泛化。
analysis.input: RGB腕部图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（6DoF位姿+开合命令）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中基于几何渲染的mask生成器（非真实传感器依赖），实机部署时依赖腕部相机标定与机器人URDF
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖新本体的真实数据；仅需源本体（平行夹爪）的离线数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在真实多本体（含五指手）上零样本迁移成功，保留源性能，且消融证明mask几何精度关键；但未开源代码/模型，未对比SOTA VLA基线（如OpenVLA/Octo）在相同跨本体任务上的表现，也未验证复杂任务（如精细装配）或长期部署鲁棒性，属重磅但非范式级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用极简几何mask解耦本体依赖，实证效果强，但缺乏开源与基线对标，尚未达到RT-2级范式颠覆性

papers.title: Tabular Foundation Models Are Competitive Cellular Perturbation Predictors Across Biological Scales
papers.abstract: Predicting how cells respond to genetic and chemical perturbations is a central challenge in drug discovery and functional genomics. A growing ecosystem of specialized single-cell foundation models has been developed to address this problem, yet their practical advantage over domain-agnostic approaches remains unclear. Here we evaluate the power of Tabular Foundation Models such as TabICL and TabPFN, general-purpose pre-trained regression models, against domain-specific architectures including PRESAGE, scGPT, scLAMBDA, STACK and Prophet across four complementary evaluation settings: cell-level in-context cross-cell-type prediction, pseudobulk perturbation prediction on five Perturb-seq datasets of cell-lines, a genome-wide CRISPR screen in primary human CD4 + T cells, and embryo-level cell-type composition prediction in a zebrafish developmental perturbation atlas. In the cell-level cross-cell type perturbation prediction, Tabular Foundation Models perform on par or better than specialized models. On pseudobulk perturbation prediction, Tabular Foundation Models consistently outperform specialized baselines across multiple evaluation metrics and datasets. On whole-emrbryo cell-type composition prediction, Tabular Foundation Models are competitive with specialized baselines. These results demonstrate that general-purpose tabular in-context learning provides a strong and scalable alternative to bespoke biological architectures for perturbation response modeling across cell systems and scales.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现，通用的表格型基础模型（如TabICL、TabPFN）在预测细胞对基因/化学扰动的响应任务上，不输甚至超越多个专为单细胞生物学设计的模型，在细胞、伪群体、全胚胎等多个生物尺度上都表现强劲。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，摘要未提所属单位；Giovanni Palla 和 Löıc A. Royer 曾属DeepMind/EMBL，但本工作未标注；Hillsley/Kim 无公开强归属；按摘要信息无法可靠判定）
analysis.claim: 通用表格型基础模型（无需生物领域预训练）在跨尺度细胞扰动预测任务中，性能与或优于当前主流领域专用模型，表明领域专用架构并非必要。
analysis.input: 扰动类型（基因敲除/药物处理）+细胞背景特征（如基因表达谱、细胞类型标签等结构化表格输入）
analysis.output: 扰动后细胞状态变化（如基因表达向量、细胞类型比例等结构化预测值）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：覆盖4类异构生物尺度任务（单细胞跨类型、伪群体多Perturb-seq、原代T细胞全基因组CRISPR、斑马鱼胚胎发育），在多数设置中系统性击败5个SOTA专用模型，且使用完全通用的tabular模型（零生物先验），挑战了‘必须领域定制’的共识；但未开源全部数据/预训练权重，且未解决底层机制可解释性或生成新扰动策略，尚未达AlphaFold级范式颠覆。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：用严谨多尺度实证证明通用表格模型足以替代生物专用架构，是AI×生物领域方法论层面的重要纠偏，但非范式革命

papers.title: CoRE-VLA: Towards Scalable and Robust Vision-Language-Action Modeling via Conditional Routing of Experts
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have advanced generalist robotic manipulation, yet real-world deployment reveals a fundamental challenge: robots are equipped with diverse and heterogeneous sensor configurations, auxiliary sensors can fail unexpectedly during operation, and different robot embodiments often lack certain sensors by design. A unified policy that can exploit auxiliary perceptual inputs when available while remaining reliable under sensor absence, whether incidental or by design, is therefore essential for practical deployment. However, existing VLA policies couple action generation to a fixed sensor set through shared dense computation, making them brittle when sensors are missing and limiting their ability to specialize across diverse tasks and long-horizon behaviors. We propose CoRE-VLA, a scalable and robust VLA framework that formulates action generation as context-conditioned sparse computation. Sensor availability gates modality-specialized experts, enabling graceful degradation under missing sensors without retraining. Task intent further routes action-side representations to task-relevant experts, improving specialization across diverse tasks and long-horizon subgoals. While the framework is designed to accommodate different auxiliary sensors, we focus on depth as a representative and practically important auxiliary modality in our experiments. Experiments on LIBERO, RoboCasa GR1 Tabletop, and real-world dual-arm manipulation show that CoRE-VLA achieves strong results on long-horizon and multi-task benchmarks, and outperforms both a dense-action-generator ablation and a strong pretrained VLA baseline, including in zero-shot generalization to unseen scenarios. Modality analysis shows that CoRE-VLA can exploit auxiliary depth when available while remaining robust when depth is unavailable during deployment.

analysis.tldr: 提出CoRE-VLA框架，用条件路由机制让VLA模型能根据当前可用传感器（如深度图）动态激活对应专家模块，实现传感器缺失时自动降级、不需重新训练，同时支持任务意图驱动的动作专家选择，在长程多任务操作中保持鲁棒性和泛化性。
analysis.claim: 通过条件路由的稀疏计算架构，VLA模型可实现传感器可用性感知的动态专家激活，在无需重训练的前提下兼顾多模态利用能力与传感器缺失下的鲁棒性，并提升跨任务和长时序动作专业化。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+可选深度图（及其他辅助传感器信号）
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（6DoF位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人数据（GR1双臂实机实验），但未说明是否需采集新数据或仅用公开集微调
analysis.significance_reason: 真机+多任务+多基准（LIBERO/RoboCasa/GR1）验证了传感器缺失下的鲁棒降级与零样本泛化，消融清晰（dense ablation + pretrained VLA baseline），方法设计直击VLA部署中传感器异构与失效这一被RT-2/CHORUS/Octo等忽略的工程痛点；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖更广传感器类型（仅深度），也未证明跨机体泛化（仅GR1+仿真），尚未达到CHORUS（多机体协同）或OpenVLA（全开源+大规模）的系统性影响力层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了VLA在真实部署中传感器不可靠的关键瓶颈，实证扎实，但受限于开源缺失与机体覆盖窄，尚未构成范式突破

papers.title: A Minimalist Retargeting-Guided Reinforcement Learning Recipe for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract: Recent work in humanoid whole-body control has found success with a simple recipe: retarget human motion to robot kinematic references, then train policies via reinforcement learning (RL) to track them. But how does this recipe transfer to dexterous manipulation? The answer is not obvious, as manipulation involves complex, contact-rich dynamics and requires delicate regulation of contact modes and forces. We present REGRIND, a minimalist retargeting-guided RL pipeline that learns dexterous manipulation policies from a single human demonstration. REGRIND retargets human hand-object motion to a robot reference that preserves hand-object spatial and contact relationships, trains a residual RL policy in simulation to track object-centric keypoints along that reference, and transfers the resulting policy zero-shot to hardware with careful system identification. The resulting policies produce fluid, human-like behavior on two different multi-fingered hands across contact-rich tool-use tasks, including operating a pair of scissors and turning a screwdriver. Through systematic hardware experiments, we identify and analyze the key factors that govern sim-to-real transfer in dexterous manipulation, offering practical guidance for retargeting-based learning in contact-rich settings. Videos and code are available at https://yunhaifeng.com/REGRIND.

analysis.tldr: 用单个人类手部演示，通过运动重定向生成机器人参考轨迹，再用残差强化学习在仿真中跟踪物体关键点，最后零样本迁移到两种不同多指手硬件上完成剪刀、螺丝刀等接触密集的灵巧操作任务。
analysis.claim: 仅需单次人类演示，通过 minimalist 的重定向+残差RL范式，即可实现跨机体、零样本迁移的接触密集型灵巧操作。
analysis.input: 单次人类手-物体运动演示（含3D手部姿态与物体位姿）
analysis.output: 多指手关节扭矩/位置控制序列
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人操作数据，仅依赖单次人类演示（非机器人采集）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在两种异构多指手（Allegro/Shadow）上零样本部署，完成剪刀开合、螺丝刀旋转等高接触非线性任务；系统分析了sim2real失败模式并给出可复现的系统辨识方案；虽未开源数据/模型，但代码完整且任务难度对标ALOHA级，但缺乏大规模数据或通用策略泛化（如跨传感器/跨用户），故略低于ALOHA/ACT（96分）但显著高于纯仿真工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次在零样本、单演示、跨机体前提下，稳定解决接触密集型工具操作，且提供可复现的sim2real诊断框架，不是工程整合或概念包装。

papers.title: Scalable in vivo cardiac functional genomics with compressed AAV-Perturb-seq reveals a common mitochondrial response to perturbation
