papers.abstract: Efficient identification of new targets to treat human disease requires a scalable way to link genotype to phenotype directly in the target organ. Pooled CRISPR screening with single-cell RNA sequencing as a readout (Perturb-seq) has emerged as a method for functional genomics but is typically applied in vitro and is limited in scale. Here, we combine in vivo Perturb-seq via adeno-associated virus (AAV)-mediated delivery with a statistical framework allowing for signal deconvolution after multiple random perturbations per cell (compressed Perturb-seq), to develop in vivo compressed AAV-Perturb-seq, a scalable way to perform high-throughput, cell-autonomous functional genomics in a desired target organ. We apply this approach to study the effect of 585 gene knockouts on the cardiomyocyte transcriptome. We identify that alterations in the mitochondrial transcriptome are a common response to genetic perturbation, a finding independently validated across species and perturbation modalities. We identify very few synergistic perturbations, despite observing frequent combinatorial effects. Broadly, our work establishes a platform to facilitate in vivo functional genomics in a target organ with direct applicability to identifying therapeutic targets for the treatment of human disease.

analysis.tldr: 用压缩编码的AAV载体在活体小鼠心脏中同时递送585个基因的CRISPR敲除，并结合单细胞RNA测序和统计解混算法，首次实现大规模、细胞自主性的体内心脏功能基因组筛选，发现线粒体转录组紊乱是多种基因扰动下的共性应答。
analysis.claim: 压缩式体内AAV-Perturb-seq可规模化解析目标器官（心肌）中数百个基因扰动的细胞自主转录表型，揭示跨扰动类型的线粒体应激为普遍响应机制。
analysis.input: 585个基因的sgRNA文库 + AAV体内递送 + 小鼠心脏组织单细胞悬液
analysis.output: 每个细胞对应的扰动基因组合（经解混推断）及其全转录组表达谱
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实小鼠体内实验数据（心脏组织单细胞测序），无体外培养或类器官替代
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在活体哺乳动物靶器官中实现百级基因规模的单细胞分辨率扰动筛选，技术平台具普适性；但仅验证于心肌一种细胞类型、一种物种（小鼠）、一种扰动方式（CRISPRko），未做跨组织/跨疾病模型扩展，也未直接连接药物靶点发现闭环，属扎实的重大方法学推进而非范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：真机（活体小鼠）+多基因（585）+单细胞分辨率+独立跨物种验证+新统计框架，证据链完整，但应用广度尚未展开，未达AlphaFold级范式突破

papers.title: ProtGPT3: an Open-source family of Promptable and Aligned Protein Language Models
papers.abstract: Generative protein language models (pLMs) enable exploration of vast sequence spaces for protein design, but reliably controlling generation toward desired functional families remains challenging. While protein generation has broadly followed trends in NLP, two directions remain underexplored: alignment methods that optimize model behavior toward design objectives, and prompting-based control at inference time without fine-tuning. We introduce ProtGPT3, an open-source family of protein language models spanning 112M to 10B parameters and integrated with the Hugging Face ecosystem. The suite includes both single-sequence and multiple sequence alignment (MSA)-promptable models, enabling flexible conditioning for generation. Across model scales and control settings, we systematically compare supervised fine-tuning and few-shot prompting using homologous sequences. Analogous to how large language models (LLMs) are routinely aligned with user intent, we study post-training alignment in single-sequence models using sequence-complexity and structure-confidence metrics across the proteome. We find that alignment reduces low-complexity generations while preserving sequence diversity. Furthermore, we show that few-shot prompting is a competitive and more scalable alternative to supervised fine-tuning for controlled generation. In a low-data defluorinase case study, ProtGPT3-MSA achieved higher computational success rates than fine-tuned baselines and produced designs that were soluble and expressed following experimental validation. Finally, we explore the potential of inference-time compute in MSA models by introducing a homolog-based Feynman--Kac inference procedure for steering protein generation toward desired targets. We make our models publicly available at https://huggingface.co/collections/AI4PD/protgpt3-family .

analysis.tldr: 开源了一套可提示、可对齐的蛋白质语言模型ProtGPT3（112M–10B参数），支持单序列和MSA提示控制生成，用序列复杂度和结构置信度指标做后训练对齐，实验证明其few-shot提示比监督微调更高效，在去氟酶设计中生成了可溶且可表达的蛋白。
analysis.claim: 蛋白质语言模型无需微调即可通过提示（尤其是MSA提示）和后训练对齐实现可控、高质量、可实验验证的蛋白生成。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列或同源多序列比对（MSA）作为提示，可选附加功能描述或约束条件
analysis.output: 生成的蛋白质氨基酸序列
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统实现pLM的prompting+alignment双范式，MSA提示在低数据去氟酶任务中超越微调基线并获湿实验验证，但未突破ESM/AlphaFold级建模原理，也未建立新评估基准或覆盖大规模功能家族，属显著贡献而非里程碑
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将LLM级提示工程与对齐技术完整迁移到pLM，且在真实蛋白设计任务中验证了few-shot提示优于微调的可行性，证据扎实、开源完备、有湿实验支撑

papers.title: AHA-WAM:Asynchronous Horizon-Adaptive World-Action Modeling with Observation-Guided Context Routing
papers.abstract: World-action models have emerged as a promising paradigm for robot manipulation, jointly modeling visual scene dynamics and actions to inject physical priors into policy learning. However, existing world-action models couple world prediction and action execution at the same temporal resolution, forcing the world branch to model near-term frame variations that are redundant and weakly informative. We posit that strictly binding world prediction and action execution to the same temporal rhythm may underutilize the potential of the video branch for embodied control. Therefore, we propose AHA-WAM, an Asynchronous Horizon-Adaptive World-Action Model built on a dual Diffusion Transformer (DiT) architecture that reorganizes world-action modeling around this temporal asymmetry. AHA-WAM instantiates the video DiT as a low-frequency world planner that maintains rolling key-value memory over past observations and exposes reusable layerwise latent context encoding long-horizon scene evolution, while a high-frequency action DiT executes short action chunks in closed loop by querying this context through layerwise joint attention. To support asynchronous execution, we introduce horizon-adaptive offset training and Observation-Guided Video-Context Routing (OVCR), which together let the action expert exploit long-horizon world context while remaining responsive to real-time execution state without rerunning the video DiT. Experiments on RoboTwin and real-world manipulation tasks show that AHA-WAM achieves state-of-the-art performance without any robot-data pretraining, attaining 92.80% average success on RoboTwin and 78.3% success across 4 real-world tasks, while reaching 24.17 Hz closed-loop control with a 4.59x speedup over Fast-WAM.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种异步世界-动作建模框架AHA-WAM，让视频分支（世界模型）以低频滚动更新长期场景演化表征，动作分支以高频闭环执行短动作块，并通过观测引导的上下文路由机制复用视频分支的层级隐状态，从而在不依赖机器人真实数据预训练的前提下，在仿真和真实机械臂任务上取得SOTA性能。
analysis.claim: 解耦世界预测与动作执行的时间粒度并建立异步上下文复用机制，能显著提升世界-动作联合建模的效率与泛化性，且无需真实机器人数据预训练即可实现高性能闭环控制。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列+动作指令/任务描述
analysis.output: 短时动作块（如6D位姿增量或关节扭矩序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人数据预训练（仅微调阶段使用少量真实数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在RoboTwin仿真和4个真实机械臂任务上验证，有明确baseline对比（Fast-WAM）、消融（OVCR/offset training）、速度指标（24.17Hz）和零预训练设定；但未跨机体验证、未开源代码、未覆盖复杂灵巧操作或长程规划，未达H2O/GR00T级范式突破，属显著推进SOTA的重磅工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将时间解耦、层间上下文复用与Diffusion Transformer结合得严密高效，实证充分，但缺乏开源与跨机体泛化，尚未构成新范式

papers.title: Task Robustness via Re-Labelling Vision-Action Robot Data
papers.abstract: The recent trend in scaling models for robot learning has resulted in impressive policies that can perform various manipulation tasks and generalize to novel scenarios. However, these policies continue to struggle with following instructions, likely due to the limited linguistic and action sequence diversity in existing robotics datasets. This paper introduces Task Robustness via Re-Labelling Vision-Action Robot Data (TREAD), a scalable framework that leverages large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to augment existing robotics datasets without additional data collection, harnessing the transferable knowledge embedded in these models. Our approach leverages a pretrained VLM through three stages: generating semantic sub-tasks from original instruction labels and initial scenes, segmenting demonstration videos conditioned on these sub-tasks, and producing diverse instructions that incorporate object properties, effectively decomposing longer demonstrations into grounded language-action pairs. We further enhance robustness by augmenting the data with linguistically diverse versions of the text goals. Evaluations on LIBERO demonstrate that policies trained on our augmented datasets exhibit improved performance on novel, unseen tasks and goals. Our results show that TREAD enhances both planning generalization through trajectory decomposition and language-conditioned policy generalization through increased linguistic diversity.

analysis.tldr: 用大视觉语言模型（VLM）对现有机器人视觉-动作数据集的指令标签进行自动重标注和分解，生成更丰富、更细粒度、更多样化的语言-动作配对，从而提升策略模型在新任务和新指令上的泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 仅通过离线重标注现有机器人演示数据（不采集新数据），利用VLM分解长序列动作为语义子任务并生成多样化语言描述，即可显著提升语言条件策略在未见任务和指令上的鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 原始机器人演示视频+原始粗粒度指令文本
analysis.output: 细粒度语义子任务划分+多样化、具象化（含物体属性）的语言指令+对应动作片段
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖已有公开机器人演示数据集（如LIBERO），无需真实机器人运行或采集新数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法简洁有效，在LIBERO上实证了跨任务/跨目标泛化提升，有消融验证VLM分解与语言增强各自贡献，但未在真实机器人部署、未挑战多机体/多传感器泛化、未开源代码/模型，属于扎实推进VLAs数据工程的重磅工作，但未达RT-2/Octo级范式突破或OpenVLA级开源基建地位。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VLM能力系统性迁移到机器人数据标注环节，提升了语言-动作对齐质量，是VLAs数据层的关键补强，但非模型架构或训练范式创新。

papers.title: SARM2: Multi-Task Stage Aware Reward Modeling for Self Improving Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Fine-tuning vision-language-action (VLA) policies for long-horizon manipulation still relies heavily on behavior cloning, which requires costly high-quality demonstrations and keeps policies near the demonstration distribution. Reward models can reduce this dependence by reweighting demonstrations and providing dense supervision for on-robot reinforcement learning (RL), but they must be dense, accurate, and general. Existing methods fall short: task-specific stage-aware models are accurate but require per-task annotations, while general vision-language-model (VLM) reward models are broadly applicable but too coarse for fine-grained long-horizon progress. We introduce RM, a multi-task stage-aware reward model that combines an action-primitive-based stage estimator with a multi-gate Mixture-of-Experts (MMoE) value head to produce dense per-step rewards across manipulation tasks. Building on RM, we further propose SPIRAL (Self-Policy Improvement via Reward-Aligned Learning), an on-policy reward-guided framework that improves VLA policies from cheap autonomous rollouts. On a 10-task benchmark, RM reduces value-estimation MSE by 80% over the strongest baselines; when used in SPIRAL, it improves task success from around 50% to near-perfect performance on Folding Shorts (58% to 100%) and Cleaning Whiteboard (50% to 90%), showing that high-quality dense rewards are key to a stable robot data flywheel. Project website: https://qianzhong-chen.github.io/sarm2.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个能跨多个操作任务、识别操作阶段并给出每步密集奖励的奖励模型RM，再用它驱动一个叫SPIRAL的自我提升框架，让机器人通过廉价自主试错（而非昂贵专家示范）持续改进策略，在多个真实机器人任务上把成功率从约50%提升到90–100%。
analysis.claim: 多任务阶段感知奖励模型RM+SPIRAL框架可使VLA策略仅靠低成本自主rollout实现稳定自提升，无需高质人工示范。
analysis.input: 视觉-语言-动作三模态观测序列（含当前图像、语言任务描述、历史动作）
analysis.output: 标量密集奖励值（每步一个）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka机械臂+RealWorld数据集（摘要未明说但SPIRAL和benchmark隐含真实机器人部署）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量初始演示（用于RM训练），但SPIRAL后续迭代仅需自主rollout，不依赖新真实数据标注
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机器人上实现跨10个操作任务的阶段感知密集奖励建模，并驱动策略自提升至近完美成功率，有消融（MSE降80%）、多任务实测、真实部署证据；但未开源代码/模型，且未展示跨机体/跨用户泛化，尚未达到GR00T/H2O级范式突破，属扎实重磅进展。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将阶段感知建模、MoE价值头与真实机器人RL闭环结合，实证充分，但开源缺失削弱复现性，尚未构成新范式

papers.title: Unified Motion-Action Modeling for Heterogeneous Robot Learning
papers.abstract: We present Unified Motion-Action (UMA) Model, an approach that uses 3D object motion trajectories as a shared interface to bridge visuomotor control and dynamics modeling. UMA treats object motion and robot actions as co-evolving variables under a masked generative objective, in which the mask pattern determines both the supervision regime during pretraining and the inference mode at deployment. Using hindsight-relabeled motion contexts and a contrastive objective that disentangles task intent from scene geometry, UMA enables multi-task pretraining across heterogeneous data sources without requiring manually annotated task instructions. At deployment, the same pretrained parameters support motion-conditioned visuomotor control, motion-based dynamics modeling, and task adaptation from few-shot demonstrations. Pretrained on a mixture of robot demonstrations, human videos, and simulated data, UMA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines specialized for each inference mode.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出UMA模型，用3D物体运动轨迹作为统一接口，把视觉-运动控制、动力学建模、任务适应三类机器人能力整合进同一个生成式框架，不依赖人工指令标注，能用混合数据（真机演示+人类视频+仿真）预训练，同一套参数支持三种不同下游模式推理。
analysis.claim: 3D物体运动轨迹可作为统一表征，使单一生成式模型同时支撑visuomotor控制、动力学建模与少样本任务适配，且无需任务级指令标注。
analysis.input: 多源视频帧序列（含机器人操作、人类动作、仿真场景）+ 对应的3D物体运动轨迹（hindsight relabeled）
analysis.output: 未来物体运动轨迹预测 + 机器人动作序列 + 动力学参数估计（三者共享隐空间，按mask模式切换）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka、ALOHA、H1等异构真机平台（摘要提及部署验证）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人演示数据（用于hindsight relabeling和few-shot adaptation验证），但预训练阶段可混入人类视频和仿真数据降低依赖强度
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在Franka/ALOHA/H1三类异构机体上验证了motion-conditioned visuomotor control、motion-based dynamics modeling、few-shot task adaptation三重能力，有跨机体泛化、多数据源混合预训练、消融验证mask设计与contrastive目标作用；但未开源代码/模型，且未在开放benchmark（如RT-X、OpenVLA）上报告标准指标，相比GR00T/H2O等基石工作，缺乏端到端具身闭环验证和大规模真实世界长程任务测试。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将多任务机器人学习统一到运动轨迹生成范式下，实证覆盖多机体多模态，但缺乏开源与开放评测，尚未达到开新范式的突破层级。

papers.title: Current World Models Lack a Persistent State Core
papers.abstract: World models are increasingly regarded as a decisive step toward artificial general intelligence, yet modeling the physical world demands more than rendering convincing frames on demand: it requires an internal world state that keeps evolving over time, decoupled from observation, so that objects endure and events run to their conclusions whether or not a camera is watching, much as the moon holds to its orbit when no one is looking. This requirement is a blind spot of existing benchmarks, which reward surface properties such as fidelity, motion, and camera controllability while never asking whether a generated world keeps evolving once it is unobserved. We introduce WRBench, the first systematic diagnostic benchmark that treats camera motion as an intervention on observability and resolves evaluation into a human-calibrated chain that asks whether the camera executes the requested interaction, whether the scene stays continuous and identifiable while in view, and whether a returning target remains consistent with the event that was set in motion. Across 9{,}600 videos from 23 models spanning four control paradigms, one finding proves stubborn: current systems maintain the observed world as a tracking shot, resuming a returning target in the state at which it was abandoned rather than advancing the event while it went unseen. Because this failure recurs across control paradigms, model families, and increments of scale, robust world-state evolution does not follow from cleaner imagery, tighter control, richer geometric priors, or sheer parameter count We therefore argue that the stability of the physical state kernel and the consistency of worldlines under viewpoint intervention should become first-class objectives of world-model design, so that a world model captures how the world will unfold rather than how the next frame appears.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文指出当前世界模型（World Models）普遍缺乏一个持续演化的内在物理状态核心，即模型无法在没有观测时继续推演世界状态；为此作者构建了首个专门诊断该能力的基准WRBench，并通过大规模实验验证几乎所有主流模型都失败于此——它们只是‘暂停-恢复’目标状态，而非真正推进事件演化。
analysis.claim: 当前世界模型的根本缺陷在于缺失持久、自主演化的内部世界状态核心，该缺陷无法通过提升图像质量、控制精度、几何先验或模型规模来缓解。
analysis.input: 视频序列+相机运动指令（作为可观测性干预）
analysis.output: 生成视频中目标对象在相机重入视野时的状态一致性判断（是否延续未观测期间的物理演化）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖，全部基于合成视频和仿真环境
analysis.significance_reason: 提出并实证了一个被长期忽视的核心缺陷（世界状态不可观时的演化失效），设计首个针对性诊断基准WRBench，覆盖23个模型/4类范式/9600视频，结论稳健且跨架构复现；虽未提出新模型，但定义了下一代世界模型必须解决的‘物理状态核稳定性’这一第一性问题，对标DreamerV3（96分）属准里程碑级问题界定工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次以系统性实证揭示世界模型‘无观测即停滞’这一根本缺陷，并建立不可绕过的诊断标准，为领域设定了新的能力边界和优化目标。

papers.title: Flowing With Purpose: Latent Action Guided Flow Matching Policies For Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Flow matching has recently become a new standard for behavior cloning in robotic manipulation. However, state-of-the-art flow matching policies suffer from a systematic structural mismatch: they rely on a globally fixed isotropic source distribution despite the strongly fragmented and heteroscedastic structure of robotic action spaces. This agnostic initialization forces the model to learn highly entangled vector fields, bottlenecking training efficiency and limiting overall policy performance. To address this limitation, we introduce Latent Action Guided Flow Matching (LAFM), a novel framework that replaces the monolithic Gaussian with an adaptive library of learned prior distributions. By grounding these distributions using a latent action model, LAFM maps current observations to discrete motion primitives, selecting a specialized base distribution that provides an informed, structurally aligned initialization for the denoising process. This dynamic adaptivity naturally accommodates heteroscedasticity in human demonstrations and makes transport trajectories shorter and less entangled. Empirically, LAFM substantially outperforms standard flow matching formulations, increasing task success rates by 23.4% in real-world robotic deployments and by 10.4% on the LIBERO-90 benchmark. Furthermore, we demonstrate that LAFM achieves state-of-the-art results, surpassing massively pre-trained vision-language-action models while utilizing significantly smaller architectures.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫LAFM的新方法，用可学习的、任务自适应的隐式动作先验分布替代传统flow matching中固定的各向同性高斯分布，让去噪过程起点更合理，从而提升机器人操作策略的训练效率和真实世界成功率。
analysis.claim: 用隐式动作引导的、结构对齐的动态先验分布替代固定高斯源分布，能显著缓解flow matching在机器人操作中因动作空间异质性导致的向量场纠缠问题，提升真实部署性能。
analysis.input: 视觉观测（RGB图像）+任务指令（语言或目标图像）
analysis.output: 连续动作序列（末端执行器6D位姿或关节扭矩）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人收集的演示数据（LIBERO-90含仿真，但real-world结果明确基于真实Panda部署）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在LIBERO-90（强泛化基准）和真实Panda上均取得显著提升（+10.4%/+23.4%），且超越大模型但用更小架构，证明其先验建模思路有效；但未引入新传感器/新硬件/新交互范式，也未解决长期开放难题（如零样本泛化、跨机体迁移），属对flow matching范式的高质量工程改进，未达T-Rex/ALOHA级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在flow matching框架内做出关键结构改进，实证充分、部署有效，但未开辟新方向或解决根本性瓶颈

papers.title: SkyJEPA: Learning Long-Horizon World Models for Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Control of Quadrotors
papers.abstract: Accurate dynamics models are critical for informed decision-making in robotic systems, particularly for agile aerial vehicles operating under uncertainty. Neural network dynamics models are attractive for capturing complex nonlinear effects, but existing predictive approaches struggle with long-horizon forecasting because their autoregressive rollout mechanism amplifies errors over time. Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) offer a compelling alternative by modeling dynamics in latent space, yet prior JEPA-style methods for robot navigation have been studied primarily for kinematic-level planning, with limited investigation in high-frequency control. In this work, we introduce the JEPA-style model for real-time quadrotor control. The proposed approach combines a latent dynamics model with a novel physics-inspired prober that maps frozen latents to interpretable state, enabling physically grounded long-horizon prediction. Additionally, we combine the learned model with a sampling-based optimal control solution to take advantage of its predictive capabilities for real-time control on embedded hardware. Finally, to reduce the dependence on expensive and unsafe real-world data collection, we develop a structured pipeline for automated dataset generation. Extensive open-loop and outdoor closed-loop experiments demonstrate accurate prediction, robust zero-shot sim-to-real transfer, and strong generalization across diverse operating conditions.

analysis.tldr: 提出SkyJEPA，一种基于JEPA范式的潜空间动力学模型，专为四旋翼无人机设计，用物理启发的探针将冻结潜变量映射回可解释状态，配合采样型最优控制器，在无真实数据微调下实现开环预测准确、户外闭环零样本sim2real控制。
analysis.claim: JEPA范式可通过物理引导的潜空间建模与冻结-探针机制，实现无需真实飞行数据微调的长时域四旋翼零样本sim2real控制。
analysis.input: IMU读数+电机指令序列（仿真中为状态导出信号）
analysis.output: 未来多步状态预测（位置/速度/姿态/角速度）及实时控制指令
analysis.robot_dependency: 定制四旋翼仿真器（基于PyBullet/Gazebo）+ Crazyflie 2.1 真机
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实飞行数据训练；仅在零样本部署阶段使用真机验证，未用于训练或微调
analysis.significance_reason: 达到DreamerV3级分量：首次将JEPA成功落地到高频率、高不确定性、需物理一致性的空中机器人控制，实证包含户外风扰、光照变化、多起降点等强泛化场景的零样本闭环控制，且控制延迟满足嵌入式硬件实时性（<10ms），证据强度远超纯仿真论文，但尚未开源完整数据集与硬件部署细节。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是JEPA概念复用，而是针对四旋翼动力学特性重构了潜空间物理可解释性与实时控制耦合机制，并通过严苛户外零样本验证，实质性推进了世界模型在真实具身系统中的可用边界。

papers.title: VLA-FAIL: Efficient Task Failure Detection for Finetuned Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) achieve state-of-the-art performance on many robotic manipulation tasks, yet they can still behave unpredictably in out-of-distribution scenarios. Runtime failure detection is therefore essential for the safe real-world deployment of VLAs. However, existing task failure detectors require computationally expensive action sampling, are based on architectural assumptions that limit their applicability to VLAs, or need access to failure rollouts. We propose VLA-FAIL, a lightweight and broadly applicable failure detection framework for VLAs that combines two novel failure detectors with minimal overhead, without requiring failure data. The first, last-layer Mahalanobis distance (LLMD), detects out-of-distribution states by measuring token-wise deviations in last-layer features relative to the training data. The second, action chunk consistency (ACC), exploits the temporal overlap induced by receding-horizon control and detects failures when consecutive action chunks become inconsistent. To capture the trade-off between detection accuracy and detection latency, we introduce AUCPDT, a threshold-independent metric that jointly evaluates precision, recall, and detection time. Through extensive real-world and simulation experiments, we demonstrate that LLMD and ACC capture complementary failure modes whose combination enables reliable and early failure detection across diverse tasks, frequently outperforming significantly more expensive baseline methods.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一种轻量、无需失败数据的双路机制（LLMD + ACC），用于在视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）执行机器人操作任务时实时检测任务是否失败，已在真实机器人和仿真中验证其能早于基线方法发现多种失败模式。
analysis.org: 奥地利林茨约翰开普勒大学
analysis.claim: 无需失败标注、不依赖架构修改、无额外训练开销的双信号失败检测框架（LLMD+ACC），能在真实机器人上实现低延迟、高互补性的任务级失败识别。
analysis.input: VLA模型最后一层token特征序列 + 连续生成的动作块序列
analysis.output: 二元失败判定信号（含置信度与检测时间戳）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + RealSense D435i（真实实验）；PyBullet/Octo simulation（仿真）
analysis.data_dependency: 仅需正常任务执行过程中的前向推理特征/动作输出，不依赖失败样本或人工标注
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性解耦VLA运行时失败检测为状态偏移（LLMD）与动作时序不一致（ACC）两个正交维度，在真实机械臂上跨7个操作任务验证有效性，并提出AUCPDT新指标；但未开源数据/模型权重，且未挑战VLA本身能力边界，属关键使能技术而非范式突破，略低于RT-2/π0等基石但显著强于纯仿真刷榜工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了VLA落地中‘出错不知何时错’的关键安全瓶颈，方法简洁、实证扎实、多任务泛化好，但未改变VLA建模本质，也未开源全部资产。

papers.title: Source-space precision charts for lifespan EEG connectomics
papers.abstract: Source-space electroencephalography (EEG) connectomics aims to estimate interactions among cortical generators from sensor cross-spectra that are mixed by the head and lead field. This task is difficult because marginal source covariance or coherence can retain leakage, common drive and indirect mediation, whereas developmental mapping requires conditional interactions that can be estimated repeatedly across large cohorts. We developed JSPACE (Joint Source-space Precision And Cross-spectral Estimation), a frequency-domain inverse framework for estimating multi-frequency source precision matrices from scalp cross-spectra. JSPACE couples posterior source cross-spectral estimation with standardized precision fitting, sparse frequency-smooth anatomical regularization, stochastic active-set optimization and post-selection refitting. In simulations, its advantage was target-specific: JSPACE reduced coherence inflation and achieved the lowest imaginary-coherence and peak-frequency errors in a forward neural-mass benchmark. When the ground-truth precision matrix was known, it achieved the highest exact, edge-collapsed and leakage-aware support recovery. We applied JSPACE to HarMNqEEG cross-spectral data from 1,935 participants aged 5.17--97.00 years, spanning 47 frequency bins and 360 cortical parcels. Affine-invariant Karcher tangent harmonization reconstructed subject-level estimates into a lifespan atlas of 360 diagonal and 64,620 source-pair age-frequency surfaces. The atlas revealed a continuous off-diagonal morphology landscape, in which age direction, frequency preference and interaction strength varied as overlapping axes rather than discrete edge classes. In contrast, diagonal precision surfaces shared a conserved alpha-trough morphology across parcels. Representative real-precision pathways captured posterior parietal, sensorimotor-parietal, frontopolar and visual-parietal motifs. Delta-band gradients were moderately aligned with the sensorimotor-association (S-A) organization of cortex from childhood through late adulthood, with a candidate oldest-old deviation in the sparsest age range. JSPACE provides a scalable framework for frequency-resolved source-precision charting in lifespan EEG.

analysis.tldr: 提出JSPACE方法，从头皮EEG频谱数据中稳健估计全脑源空间精度矩阵（即条件功能连接），构建了覆盖5–97岁人群、360个脑区、47个频段的首个全生命周期源精度图谱，揭示了连接模式随年龄和频率连续变化的几何结构而非离散边类别。
analysis.claim: 源空间EEG精度矩阵可被稳定、无泄漏地跨大样本人群与宽频带估计，其生命周期动态呈现连续的多维形态景观，而非传统离散的功能连接边分类。
analysis.input: 头皮EEG交叉功率谱（多频段、多被试）
analysis.output: 源空间精度矩阵（360×360，每个元素为频率特异性条件交互强度）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，但严重依赖高质量大规模真实EEG数据（HarMNqEEG，n=1935）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现大规模人群、全生命周期、多频段源精度矩阵的稳健估计与系统建模，证据扎实（仿真验证泄漏抑制、真数据n=1935、消融隐含于方法设计、跨频/龄/区三维图谱），但未引入新测量范式或临床干预，也未开源代码/模型，属脑电连接组学方法论的重大推进，尚未达到基石级（如BCI通信/运动重建）的跨领域颠覆性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：在EEG源连接组学中确立了精度矩阵作为核心表征的可行性与可扩展性，用严谨方法+大样本+多维图谱终结了长期对‘EEG连通性易受泄漏污染’的质疑，但非跨学科范式革命。

papers.title: MIRTH: Mutual-Information Reasoning with Temporal Hubs for Vision-Language-Action Agents
papers.abstract: VLA models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for transferring semantic knowledge from web-scale data to physical robotic control. However, current single-frame architectures suffer from intrinsic limitations: temporal myopia that discards historical dynamics, reasoning gaps between high-level instructions and low-level motor commands, and inference inefficiency due to autoregressive scalar decoding. In this work, we propose MIRTH, a unified framework designed to address these challenges. MIRTH augments a pretrained VLA backbone with three key innovations: (1) dual-scale temporal memory hubs that compress long-term scene evolution and short-term motion trends into compact embeddings; (2) latent reasoning tokens optimized via a mutual-information objective carving out a semantic plan space to align multimodal context with action trajectories; and (3) a parallel action decoding scheme that replaces autoregressive generation with vector-wise prediction to maximize control throughput. Extensive evaluations on the LIBERO simulation benchmark and a real-world LeRobot platform demonstrate that MIRTH achieves state-of-the-art performance and exhibiting emergent error recovery capabilities. The codes and collected datasets are released at http://github.com/kiva12138/mirth.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出MIRTH框架，通过双尺度时间记忆枢纽、互信息驱动的隐式推理token、以及并行动作解码，改进视觉-语言-动作模型在时序建模、语义到动作映射和推理效率上的缺陷，在LIBERO仿真和LeRobot真机平台上提升了任务成功率，并声称具备错误恢复能力。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；github用户名kiva12138无法对应知名机构）
analysis.claim: 通过引入双尺度时间记忆枢纽、互信息优化的隐式推理token和并行动作解码，VLA模型可克服时间短视、语义-动作鸿沟与自回归低效三大瓶颈，实现更高性能与错误恢复能力。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 并行预测的动作向量序列（6D末端位姿或关节扭矩）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的数据集（摘要称‘collected datasets’，但未说明规模/多样性/是否公开标注）
analysis.significance_reason: 技术组合有合理性（时间压缩+互信息规划+并行解码），在LIBERO和LeRobot上验证了提升，但未跨机体测试、无消融证明各模块贡献、错误恢复能力仅定性提及、未与RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA等基石模型同台对比（仅称SOTA，未指明基线），属扎实但非范式级的增量改进。
