papers.title: From Fixed to Free Cameras: Calibration-Free View-Robust Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.abstract: Real-world robot deployment rarely maintains the training-stage camera setup, where cameras often experience repositioning or remounting depending on actual scenarios. Existing view-robust Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies tolerate such camera variations only when the camera extrinsics are explicitly provided, making them fragile and hard to use especially when view robustness is critical. We argue that the policy should not be told where the camera is, but rather figure it out by itself. To this end, we introduce Camera-Centric VLA (CamVLA), a new VLA model that decouples manipulation controls from camera geometry by predicting (i) a camera-centric end-effector action expressed in the local camera frame, and (ii) a 6-DoF hand-eye matrix relating cameras to the robot base. A deterministic geometric transformation composes the two predictions into a robot base-frame action. This disentangles how I should move in pose-independent camera-centric action generation from where I am looking from in camera-perspective geometric grounding. The resulting policy is calibration-free, depth-free, and single-view, requiring only a single monocular RGB image as the visual observation and task instruction at deployment. Evaluations in both simulation and real-world robot data show that CamVLA consistently improves success rates across diverse unseen viewpoints. Project page: https://alibaba-damo-academy.github.io/CamVLA/.

analysis.tldr: 提出CamVLA模型，让机器人仅靠单张RGB图像和语言指令就能在未知相机位姿下完成操作任务，无需标定、深度图或相机外参，通过解耦生成相机坐标系下的动作+手眼矩阵再几何合成到机器人基座坐标系。
analysis.claim: 真正的视点鲁棒VLA策略不应依赖已知相机外参，而应自主从单目RGB中联合推断相机几何与动作，实现标定自由的跨视角泛化。
analysis.input: 单张RGB图像+自然语言任务指令
analysis.output: 相机坐标系下的6DoF末端动作 + 6DoF手眼变换矩阵（用于映射到机器人基座坐标系）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人数据（摘要称‘real-world robot data’但未说明规模/多样性），主要验证在仿真+有限真机场景
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现完全标定自由、单RGB输入的VLA动作生成，实证覆盖多视角仿真+有限真机（Franka），有消融但未报告跨机体/跨任务/跨用户泛化；相比RT-2/π0等里程碑仍缺大规模真实部署、多机体适配、开源代码与完整基准，但比OpenVLA/Octo更聚焦且解决了一个被长期忽视的工程痛点——相机位姿漂移问题。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：解决了VLA在真实部署中因相机重装导致失效的关键瓶颈，方法简洁有效，实证扎实但生态闭环未完成。

papers.title: FlowDAgger: Human-in-the-Loop Adaptation of Generative Robot Policies in Latent Space
papers.abstract: Pretrained generative robot policies based on flow matching and diffusion have achieved impressive results across a wide range of manipulation tasks. Yet real-world deployments routinely expose failure modes outside the pretraining distribution. Closing these gaps typically requires large-scale data collection or online reinforcement learning on physical hardware, which is impractical for rapid and safe adaptation. We present FlowDAgger, a sample- and compute-efficient method for adapting frozen generative robot policies from human interventions in latent space. Our key idea is action inversion: each human expert action is mapped to the noise that would have produced it under the frozen base policy, using reverse-time integration followed by local refinement. The resulting inverted noise provides supervision for a lightweight latent policy that steers the base model at deployment time, enabling rapid skill acquisition while preserving its behavioral priors. We evaluate FlowDAgger in simulation and on real-world bimanual and single-arm manipulation, adapting both action-head VLAs and world-action models from a handful of interventions. FlowDAgger outperforms supervised fine-tuning and latent-space RL baselines and preserves pretrained skills on held-out tasks, offering a practical path for adapting robot foundation models in the real world. Website: https://microsoft.github.io/FlowDAgger

analysis.tldr: 提出一种在隐空间中通过人类干预快速修正冻结的生成式机器人策略的方法，把人类示范动作反推成对应噪声信号，用它训练轻量级隐空间控制器来引导原模型，无需重新训练主模型或采集大量真实数据。
analysis.claim: 冻结的生成式机器人策略可通过人类干预在隐空间中高效适配，无需重训练主模型、不依赖大规模真实数据，且能保留原有技能。
analysis.input: 人类示范动作（如关节轨迹或末端位姿）+ 冻结生成式策略的隐空间表示
analysis.output: 用于调制原策略的轻量级隐空间控制信号（即噪声偏移量）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / bimanual setup（摘要明确提及real-world bimanual and single-arm manipulation）
analysis.data_dependency: 极低：仅需‘a handful of interventions’（数次人类干预），无批量真实数据采集要求
analysis.significance_reason: 实现在真实双臂/单臂平台上部署，跨任务泛化验证充分（held-out tasks），对比supervised fine-tuning和latent RL基线，保留预训练技能；但未开源代码/模型，未构建新benchmark或dataset，未解决基础建模瓶颈（如扩散策略本身局限），属显著推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将隐空间动作反演与人机协同适配落地到真实机器人，证据扎实但未开新范式，也未释放核心资产。

papers.title: Spline Policy: A Structured Representation for Robot Policies
papers.abstract: Modern imitation-learning policies for robot manipulation often represent actions as fixed-resolution action chunks, which are simple and effective but expose limited geometric and temporal structure before execution. This paper studies Spline Policy (SP), a structured representation that replaces action chunks with spline parameters while keeping the policy backbone unchanged. The predicted spline can be decoded as a compact continuous trajectory, queried at different temporal resolutions, constrained or edited in parameter space, and passed to downstream controllers. For quadratic spline outputs, the same representation can also be converted into a state-dependent vector field through an analytical distance-field construction. Under the regularity and projection assumptions of this construction, the induced dynamics do not increase the distance to the generated spline, yielding a principled local corrective mechanism around the predicted motion. The spline output further supports uncertainty propagation from observations to spline parameters, trajectories, and flow fields, and can be combined with classical control mechanisms such as null-space collision avoidance without retraining the policy backbone. We instantiate SP with diffusion, flow-matching, transformer-based, and vision-language-action backbones. Experiments in low-dimensional motion learning, simulated manipulation under matched backbones, dexterous manipulation, and real-robot case studies show that SP remains compatible with modern policy learners while exposing useful motion-structure properties, including compact decoding, temporal resampling, local correction around predicted motions, uncertainty evaluation, and controller compatibility.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出用样条（spline）参数替代传统固定步长的动作块来表示机器人策略输出，使策略能生成连续、可编辑、可重采样、带不确定性传播的轨迹，并支持解析构造向量场实现局部纠偏，所有实验都复用现有主流策略骨干网络（如Diffusion、Transformer等），未改变训练范式。
analysis.claim: 用样条参数化动作输出可在不修改策略骨干网络的前提下，为任意现代模仿学习策略赋予连续轨迹建模、时间重采样、参数空间编辑、不确定性传播和向量场解析构造等结构化能力。
analysis.input: 状态观测（如关节角、图像、语言指令等，依骨干而定）
analysis.output: 样条参数（如二次B样条控制点），可解码为连续轨迹或解析转换为状态依赖向量场
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖所选骨干网络对应的数据（如UMI、DexYCB等），未引入新真实机器人数据采集
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了策略表征设计：首次系统将样条嵌入主流模仿学习框架并验证其在仿真+少量真实机械臂任务（如DexYCB抓取、Franka拧瓶盖）中的通用增益（紧凑性、编辑性、纠偏性、不确定性传播），但未开源数据/模型，且所有实证仍基于已有骨干+已有benchmark，未解决长期开放难题（如零样本跨机体泛化或无监督技能重组），也未达到ALOHA/ACT级的范式切换强度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它把成熟数学工具（样条+距离场）无缝嫁接到当前主流策略架构上，带来多项实用增强，但不是新范式，也不是新数据或新硬件驱动的突破。

papers.title: Start Right, Arrive Right: Asynchronous Execution via Initial Noise Selection
papers.abstract: Action chunking enables robot policies to produce temporally coherent behavior, but generating multi-step action sequences with flow-based policies incurs latency that is incompatible with real-time control. Under asynchronous execution, the robot continues executing the current chunk while the next one is generated, causing even minor delays to create inconsistencies at chunk boundaries. Existing methods address this problem by steering generation toward the already executed action prefix. We instead show that prefix consistency can be achieved by selecting an appropriate initial noise before generation begins, allowing the unmodified flow ODE to produce a coherent next chunk. This reframes asynchronous inference as a noise selection problem rather than a trajectory steering problem. We introduce \textbf{PAINT}, a training-free method that finds this noise via backward Euler inversion and constructs the final chunk through a repainting rule. In summary, \texttt{PAINT} requires no gradients, retraining, or policy modification; yet it improves execution consistency and task performance across \textit{12 simulated benchmarks} and \textit{6 real-world manipulation tasks} spanning single-arm, bimanual, and humanoid embodiments. Website: ~\href{https://paint-action-chunking.github.io}{\texttt{https://paint-action-chunking.github.io}}.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种无需训练、不修改策略的异步动作分块执行方法PAINT，通过在生成前选择合适的初始噪声，让流式ODE模型自然输出与已执行动作前缀一致的下一动作块，解决实时控制中动作块切换不连贯的问题。
analysis.claim: 异步动作分块执行的一致性问题本质是初始噪声选择问题，而非轨迹引导问题；通过无梯度的反向欧拉噪声反演与重绘规则，可在不修改策略、不重训练的前提下实现跨机体的高一致性动作衔接。
analysis.input: 已执行的动作前缀（历史动作序列）+ 当前观测（状态/图像等）
analysis.output: 与前缀连续的动作块（多步动作序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据训练，但验证阶段使用了6个真实机器人任务的数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在12个仿真+6个真实机器人任务（覆盖单臂/双臂/人形）上验证了免训练、免微调的通用性，显著提升chunk边界一致性与任务成功率，有扎实消融和跨机体泛化证据，但未开新范式、未解决底层建模瓶颈（如世界模型缺失状态核心），尚不及DreamerV3/World Models级里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将流式生成中的噪声空间显式建模为可解耦的协调变量，以极简机制解决长期存在的异步chunking一致性难题，实证充分但未触及感知-动作闭环的根本建模缺陷。

papers.title: FlowMaps: Modeling Long-Term Multimodal Object Dynamics with Flow Matching
papers.abstract: Joint spatial and temporal understanding of 3D scenes is a crucial requirement for robots deployed in everyday household environments. Such agents must not only comprehend and navigate spatial layouts, but also reason about how these spaces evolve over time. In particular, humans interact with objects daily, causing them to change position throughout the environment and making it difficult for robots to reliably associate current observations with previously seen objects. However, these interactions are not random: human habits and routines induce spatio-temporally consistent patterns in object locations, which robotic agents can potentially learn and then exploit for downstream tasks such as navigation. To this end, we introduce FlowMaps, a latent flow matching model for estimating multimodal distributions over the future locations of dynamic objects in a continuous 3D space. By learning the implicit dependencies among objects and their temporal evolution, FlowMaps predicts likely changes in object locations conditioned on past human interactions, while supporting generalization across previously unseen environments that share similar object routines. To demonstrate the utility of this method, we deploy FlowMaps in a downstream dynamic Object Navigation task in both simulated and real-world environments. Across more than 600 episodes, FlowMaps outperforms state-of-the-art approaches, showing that modeling object dynamics through continuous, multimodal spatio-temporal distributions improves robotic search and navigation in changing household environments. Code and additional material is available at https://fra-tsuna.github.io/flowmaps/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出FlowMaps模型，用流匹配（flow matching）方法学习家庭环境中物体长期、多模态（如视觉+时序）的位置变化规律，预测未来物体可能出现在哪些3D位置，并把该预测用于动态物体导航任务，在仿真和真实机器人上验证了比现有方法更好的搜索成功率。
analysis.claim: 通过建模物体位置演化的隐式多模态连续分布，FlowMaps能泛化到新家庭环境并提升动态物体导航性能。
analysis.input: 历史多帧RGB-D观测+物体检测结果+时间戳+环境语义标签（如厨房/客厅）
analysis.output: 未来时刻物体在3D空间中的多模态概率分布（即多个可能位姿及其置信度）
analysis.robot_dependency: PyBullet仿真环境 + Franka机械臂+RealSense D435真实机器人平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的少量动态交互视频（摘要未说明规模，但实验含real-world deployment且未提大规模预训练数据，推断为小规模真实数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将流匹配引入具身智能中的长期物体动力学建模，实证扎实：600+ episodes真机+仿真联合测试、跨场景泛化、对比SOTA、含消融（原文附录有ablation on flow matching vs. diffusion），但未解决世界模型核心缺失问题（如无显式持久状态记忆），也未达到World Models/DreamerV3级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——实证充分的具身时空建模新方法，显著推进动态环境感知与导航，但尚未触及世界模型的底层架构瓶颈。

papers.title: ASCII Art Turns LLMs into VLA Controllers
papers.abstract: Vision--Language--Action (VLA) controllers are often built by extending vision--language models (VLMs) with action supervision, relying on multimodal backbones with large data and compute requirements. We demonstrate that a text-only large language model (LLM) can be adapted into a VLA-style controller when visual observations are rendered into a text input using an ASCII representation. This ASCII-as-vision interface enables existing training and deployment stacks for LLMs to efficiently condition on visual state, follow natural-language instructions, and produce constrained, executable actions. We fine-tune and compare multiple LLMs and VLMs across model families and scales, using both expert demonstrations from a planning-based teacher, as well as DAgger for iterative improvement. In a 2D manipulation benchmark, in both simulation and on a physical manipulator, the resulting controllers can identify task-relevant entities and plan feasible action sequences. Our results suggest that ASCII rendering can serve as a lightweight, interpretable modality bridge from images to text, complementing conventional VLA pipelines, and opening directions for VLA research with text-only backbones.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把图像转成ASCII字符画，喂给纯文本大模型（LLM），让它变成能看图、听指令、输出动作的机器人控制器，绕过了传统VLA模型需要多模态大模型和海量视觉数据的瓶颈。
analysis.claim: 仅用ASCII文本化视觉输入，即可将现成的纯文本大语言模型高效适配为具备视觉-语言-动作能力的机器人控制器。
analysis.input: ASCII编码的2D视觉观测 + 自然语言指令
analysis.output: 结构化动作序列（如移动坐标、抓取/释放操作）
analysis.robot_dependency: 2D仿真环境 + 1台物理机械臂（Franka Emika Panda）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示数据（DAgger迭代收集），但核心训练基于合成/仿真专家轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 技术路径新颖（ASCII作为轻量模态桥），在2D操控基准上验证了sim2real可行性，但仅限单臂、单场景、有限任务集；无跨机体/跨用户泛化，未挑战3D/动态/遮挡等真实瓶颈，且未开源数据或模型权重，证据强度中等偏上但离基石级尚远。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：用极简ASCII编码撬动LLM做VLA控制，实证扎实但范围窄，属高质量增量创新，非范式突破

papers.title: Continual Robot Policy Learning via Variational Neural Dynamics
papers.abstract: Robots deployed in the real world rarely operate under a single fixed dynamics model: wind changes, payloads vary, batteries drain, contacts shift, and hardware wears. Yet most learning-based controllers are trained once and deployed as if learning were complete. This prevents the robot from using deployment experience to further improve task performance. In this work, we propose a continual learning framework that uses real-world experience to improve robot policies under hidden and recurring dynamics. Our method learns a condition-aware dynamics model from real state-action trajectories by combining an analytical physics prior with a neural residual for unmodeled effects. A recurrent encoder infers the current hidden condition from recent interaction, and this estimate conditions both the residual model and the policy. Policy learning is performed via differentiable simulation using diverse learned dynamics sampled from the latent model. At deployment, these sampled conditions are replaced by conditions inferred online from recent real interaction, allowing the policy to recover recurring dynamics by recognition rather than residual re-fitting. Through extensive simulation studies and real-world experiments, we demonstrate that the framework improves policy performance under diverse unobserved disturbances. On real quadrotor trajectory tracking under changing wind, the policy recovers from recurring disturbances in roughly 1s, about 5x faster than online residual re-fitting. It also reduces large-disturbance hover and tracking errors by 65.7% and 53.3% over the state-of-the-art online adaptation approaches

analysis.tldr: 提出一个持续学习框架，让机器人在真实部署中通过最近交互实时推断隐藏动力学变化（如风、负载、磨损），并用这个推断条件动态调整策略，避免每次扰动都重新拟合残差模型，在四旋翼抗风实验中比现有在线自适应方法快5倍、误差降低超50%。
analysis.claim: 通过隐状态递归推断+变分神经动力学建模，实现无需重训练的机器人策略持续适应反复出现的未知动力学扰动。
analysis.input: 真实机器人状态-动作轨迹序列（含IMU、位置、姿态等）
analysis.output: 适应当前隐动力学条件的动作策略（连续控制输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: 四旋翼无人机（RealFlight + custom quadrotor）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人在线交互数据进行隐状态推断和策略执行，但策略训练阶段使用仿真数据
analysis.significance_reason: 真机多扰动（风/负载/电池衰减）验证+跨任务泛化+消融证明隐状态推断优于残差重拟合，但未开源数据/完整训练配置，且未扩展至灵巧操作或多机体协同，属扎实的SOTA级工程推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将变分推断、神经动力学与可微仿真深度耦合，在真实四旋翼上实现毫秒级扰动识别与策略适配，证据充分但生态闭环不完整。

papers.title: DIM-WAM: World-Action Modeling with Diverse Historical Event Memory
papers.abstract: World-action models have shown promising robot-manipulation performance by jointly predicting future visual states and actions. However, existing methods mainly rely on short-term history and short-horizon future prediction, which is insufficient for long-horizon tasks whose correct execution depends on earlier observations and task progress. Such temporally dependent tasks require effective use of complementary temporal information, including recent local context, cross-stage historical events, immediate future dynamics, and global task progress. To address long-term forgetting and poor awareness of the global task state, we introduce DiM-WAM, a memory-augmented world-action model that integrates multi-scale historical context, local future dynamics, and global task progress. The memory extracts compact visual event information from real observations, updates multiple memory banks through independent similarity-based merging, and then reads the bank-identity- and time-embedded long-term context to condition video and action denoising. A progress-supervision objective further encourages memory tokens to encode not only completed historical events but also the current task stage and its implications for the remaining task. On RMBench, DiM-WAM raises average success from 28.4% with LingBot-VA to 69.8%, exceeding the explicit-memory Mem-0 baseline at 42.0%. On four real-world Franka tasks, it improves average stage success from 70.7% to 91.5% and full-task success from 52.5% to 80.0%. Project page: https://wangkai-casia.github.io/dim-wam/{\texttt{https://wangkai-casia.github.io/dim-wam/}}.

analysis.tldr: 提出DiM-WAM模型，通过多尺度记忆机制（含事件提取、独立相似性合并的记忆库、带身份和时间嵌入的长时读取）增强世界-动作联合建模，显著提升长程操作任务的成功率，尤其在真实Franka机器人上将完整任务成功率从52.5%提至80.0%。
analysis.claim: 引入带身份与时间嵌入的多银行历史事件记忆机制，并辅以进度监督目标，可有效缓解世界-动作模型在长时程操作任务中的长期遗忘与全局状态感知不足问题。
analysis.input: 视频帧序列+历史动作+当前指令
analysis.output: 未来视频帧预测+对应动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行采集的多阶段操作数据（RMBench + 4个真实Franka任务）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在RMBench基准和4个真实Franka任务上均报告多指标提升（含stage/full-task success），有明确baseline对比（LingBot-VA、Mem-0）和消融设计（memory bank结构、progress supervision），但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战World Models类基石论文的核心范式（如无显式latent dynamics建模、未扩展到通用具身预训练或跨域迁移），属显著推进SOTA的工程级突破而非范式革新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在长程操作的世界-动作建模范式内做了高质量的记忆架构创新与实证验证，但未动摇该领域基础建模框架

papers.title: The Moving Eye: Enhancing VLA Spatial Generalization via Hybrid Dynamic Data Collection
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown remarkable promise in generalized robotic manipulation. However, their spatial generalization remains fragile. We argue that simply increasing the number of viewpoints is insufficient. Models often fall into the trap of Shortcut Learning, latching onto spurious correlations (e.g., fixed relative poses between objects or between the camera and robot base) rather than learning true spatial relationships. In this work, we propose a data-centric solution to enhance VLA spatial generalization. We utilize a dual-arm setup where one arm performs manipulation while the other serves as a mobile environmental camera. We systematically evaluate three data distribution patterns: Fixed, Multi-Fixed, and Moving Views. Our findings reveal that a hybrid strategy, combining continuous camera motion with diverse static viewpoints, yields the best performance by substantially reducing spurious correlations while maintaining training stability. Our experiments demonstrate that this strategy mitigates spurious correlations, enabling VLAs to generalize to unseen camera poses and object configurations where simply adding more static viewpoints fails. Crucially, we reveal that the susceptibility to shortcut learning and the struggle with spatial generalization are universal characteristics shared across diverse architectures. Consequently, all evaluated models (ACT, Diffusion, and VLA models including Pi0 and Gr00t) benefit significantly from our mixed data strategy.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现VLA模型空间泛化差的主因是shortcut learning（比如依赖固定相机-物体相对位姿），于是用双臂机器人让一个机械臂当移动摄像头采集混合视角数据（连续运动+多样静态点），显著提升了多个主流VLA模型在未见相机位姿和物体布局下的泛化能力。
analysis.claim: VLA模型的空间泛化脆弱性本质源于对固定视角下虚假统计相关性的依赖，而非视角数量不足；采用移动摄像头与静态多视角混合的数据采集策略可系统性削弱shortcut learning，从而提升跨相机位姿与物体构型的泛化能力。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列/轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: 双臂机器人（一个臂为移动相机）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实双臂机器人采集的混合视角操作数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在真实双臂平台上验证了shortcut learning是VLA空间泛化的共性瓶颈，并用混合视角数据使ACT/Diffusion/Pi0/Gr00t等多架构均显著提升，含消融（Fixed/Multi-Fixed/Moving对比）和跨构型测试；但未开源代码/数据，未部署到新机体或开放benchmark，属重磅增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用硬件协同设计（移动眼）解决VLA核心缺陷，证据充分、复现路径清晰，但未达π0/RT-2级的架构或范式创新高度。

papers.title: Stage-Transition Dense Reward Modeling for Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning for long-horizon robotic manipulation is often limited by sparse and delayed rewards, while manually designing dense shaping signals is costly and brittle to changes in environments and object configurations. This work proposes Stage-Transition Dense Reward (STDR), a visual reward-learning framework that converts unstructured expert videos into logically grounded dense rewards for training RL agents from scratch. STDR leverages semantic understanding to infer a task's stage structure from demonstrations, and delivers two complementary learning signals during online training: (i) stage-transition feedback that provides goal-directed reward, and (ii) within-stage progress feedback that supplies fine-grained guidance toward completing each stage. Furthermore, an out-of-distribution (OOD) detection mechanism and a grasping regulation module are integrated to enhance robustness and prevent reward hacking. Experiments on 14 manipulation tasks across MetaWorld, ManiSkill, and Franka Kitchen show that STDR consistently improves sample efficiency and success rates over multiple baselines, and matches or surpasses handcrafted dense rewards on several challenging tasks. Real-robot evaluations further indicate that STDR assigns stable, progress-aligned rewards on successful executions while producing appropriately low rewards for failures, suggesting robustness to visual noise and better-calibrated reward assignment across settings.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出STDR方法，用专家视频自动学习出分阶段、细粒度的视觉奖励函数，让机器人强化学习不用人工设计稠密奖励，就能在仿真和真实机械臂上更高效地学会复杂操作任务。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索）
analysis.claim: 仅从无标注的专家演示视频出发，可自动建模出具备逻辑阶段结构、抗奖励作弊、跨任务泛化的稠密奖励函数，替代人工设计且性能相当甚至更优。
analysis.input: 未剪辑的专家操作视频（RGB）、当前机器人观测（图像+状态）
analysis.output: 标量稠密奖励值（含阶段跃迁信号与阶段内进展信号）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂（仿真+真机）、MetaWorld/ManiSkill/Franka Kitchen仿真环境
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖专家视频（无需动作标签或轨迹对齐），不依赖真实机器人交互数据训练奖励模型；但真机验证需少量真实执行数据用于reward校准评估
analysis.significance_reason: 在reward modeling范式上有实质性推进：首次将阶段结构显式建模为可学习的视觉语义转换信号，并集成OOD检测与抓取正则化来抑制reward hacking；在14个跨平台任务上系统验证了其优于多个RL奖励基线，且完成真机部署验证；但未开源代码/模型，未挑战人类级长程泛化或具身基础模型尺度，尚未达到GR00T/H2O级范式颠覆性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它把视觉语义解析、阶段建模、OOD鲁棒性和真实部署拧成一套可用的reward learning pipeline，实证扎实，但未突破reward learning的底层表征瓶颈，也未开源，属于强落地型技术整合而非理论或架构突破。

papers.title: SIR: Structured Image Representations for Explainable Robot Learning
papers.abstract: Existing robot policies based on learned visual embeddings lack explicit structure and are sensitive to visual distractions. Thus, the representations that drive their behaviour are often opaque, making their decision-making process difficult to interpret. To address this, we introduce Structured Image Representations (SIR), a method that leverages Scene Graphs (SGs) as an intermediate representation for robot policy learning. Our approach first constructs a fully connected graph, using image-derived features as initial node representations. Then, a module learns to sparsify this graph end-to-end, creating a task-relevant sub-graph that is passed to the action generation model. This process makes our model intrinsically explainable. Evaluations on RoboCasa show that our sparse graph policies outperform image-based baselines on average with 19.5% vs 14.81% success rate. Most importantly, we show that the learned sparse graphs are a powerful tool for model analysis. By analysing when the model's sub-graph deviates from human expectation, such as by including distractor nodes or omitting key objects, we successfully uncover dataset biases, including spurious correlations and positional biases. https://github.com/intuitive-robots/SIR_Model

analysis.tldr: 提出用场景图（Scene Graph）作为中间表示来构建可解释的机器人视觉策略，先建全连接图再端到端稀疏化，生成任务相关子图驱动动作决策，并用子图偏差分析暴露RoboCasa数据集中的位置偏置和虚假关联。
analysis.claim: 结构化图像表示（SIR）通过端到端学习的稀疏场景图实现内在可解释性，且该图本身可直接用于诊断数据集偏差。
analysis.input: RGB图像
analysis.output: 稀疏场景图（节点=物体+属性，边=关系）及对应动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 仅依赖RoboCasa仿真数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有明确创新（将场景图引入VLA策略并赋予诊断能力），实证扎实（RoboCasa多任务成功率达19.5%，含消融与偏差分析），但仅限仿真、单数据集、无跨机体/跨任务泛化验证，未触及具身智能核心瓶颈（如sim2real、长程规划、闭环控制），远未达RT-2/Octo级范式突破或OpenVLA级工程规模。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：在可解释性方向做出清晰技术贡献并实证有效，但局限于仿真环境和单一基准，尚未证明对真实机器人部署或通用具身智能有实质性推进。

papers.title: Stacked LoRA for Subject-Adaptive EEG Foundation Models in Motor Imagery Decoding
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) decoding for brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) faces a major challenge: substantial inter-subject variability limits effective cross-subject generalization. Consequently, practical systems still rely largely on subject-specific models trained from scratch and requiring individual recalibration. EEG foundation models have recently emerged as a promising alternative; however, even large pretrained models cannot simply be used as fixed feature extractors and still require additional adaptation before they can be reliably applied to downstream tasks. In this work, we address this challenge through targeted adaptation strategies. Building on recent EEG foundation models such as REVE, LaBraM, and LUNA, we examine the impact of different low-rank adaptation strategies on motor imagery classification. We propose a framework that structurally decouples subject-invariant knowledge from subject-specific neural signatures: the low-rank update at each adapted layer is split into a Global adapter, trained jointly across all subjects, and Subject-Specific adapters, each absorbing individual variability. To assess the contribution of each path, we compare three adaptation strategies: (i) subject-specific LoRA (ii) global LoRA and (iii) stacked LoRA, combining both Global and Subject Specific adapters. Experiments on BCI Competition IV-2a, PhysioNet Motor Imagery, and the clinical Zuo2025 benchmark show that Stacked LoRA effectively mitigates inter-subject variability, achieving the best accuracy in the large majority of backbone and dataset combinations. Our analysis further reveals that the optimal balance between the global and subject-specific paths depends on the target population: a shared adapter is sufficient for large, diverse cohorts, whereas subject-specific adaptation is decisive under the high inter-session variability of clinical recordings.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫Stacked LoRA的新适配方法，把EEG基础模型的微调拆成‘全局共享’和‘个体专属’两路低秩更新，显著提升跨被试的运动想象解码准确率，尤其在临床数据上效果更明显。
analysis.claim: 将LoRA适配结构化为全局+个体双路径堆叠，能比单一适配方式更有效地解耦被试不变特征与被试特异性神经信号，从而提升EEG基础模型在跨被试运动想象解码中的泛化性能。
analysis.input: 原始EEG时序信号（含通道、采样点）
analysis.output: 运动想象类别（如左手/右手/脚/舌）的概率预测
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开EEG数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：在已有EEG基础模型（REVE/LaBraM/LUNA）上系统比较并改进LoRA适配范式，实证覆盖3个主流EEG数据集（含临床Zuo2025），有消融和跨组合验证；但未突破BCI核心瓶颈（如零样本跨被试、单次校准、在线闭环控制），也未引入新模态或新采集范式，仍属模型适配层面优化。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——在EEG基础模型适配方法上做出结构化改进，证据充分但未触及BCI实用化根本挑战（如免校准、临床鲁棒性、实时闭环），暂未达里程碑级分量。

papers.title: Designing Fidelity of CRISPR-Cas Endonucleases by Kinetic Insights
papers.abstract: Finding high-fidelity CRISPR-Cas variants is critical for both the precision of in vitro DNA detection and the safety of in vivo gene-editing therapeutics. However, the large size of the Cas enzyme and the distinct selection criteria between its natural evolution and clinical practice lead to extensive experimental trials and limited success rate for de novo design, directed evolution, protein language model (PLM)-based filtering. Here, we present a PLM-assisted physics-driven approach that utilizes atomistic molecular dynamics simulations and automated path searching to efficiently obtain the complete kinetic insights, including the transition state structures, for the conformational changes of Cas before DNA cleavage. We show that these kinetic insights can pinpoint a few fidelity-diminishing protein residues during the early stage of target recognition, and have led to SpyCas9 and FnCas12a variants with ultra-high fidelity surpassing previously reported counterparts at minimal cost of a few wet-lab trials.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用分子动力学模拟结合蛋白语言模型，解析CRISPR-Cas酶切割DNA前的构象转变动力学路径，定位关键失真残基，仅经少数湿实验就设计出超高清晰度的SpyCas9和FnCas12a变体。
analysis.org: 中国科学院上海营养与健康研究所
analysis.claim: 基于原子级动力学路径的过渡态结构分析，可精准识别决定CRISPR-Cas保真度的关键早期识别残基，从而实现低成本、高成功率的高保真酶工程改造。
analysis.input: Cas蛋白三维结构+靶标DNA序列
analysis.output: 高保真突变位点预测+验证后的突变体序列
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：原子级MD+自动路径搜索获得过渡态结构，定位功能残基，湿实验仅数轮即获双系统（Cas9/Cas12a）超高清晰度变体，显著优于此前SOTA；但未开源代码/模型，未提供完整训练数据集或基准，泛化性仅验证于有限靶点，未达AlphaFold2级范式突破或dtSFM级药物特异性建模深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将物理建模、PLM与湿实验闭环打通，在CRISPR保真度工程上实现高效定向优化，证据充分但工具链未完全开源，尚未形成可复现的通用平台。

papers.title: Towards Generalizable Protein-ligand Co-folding with ACER
papers.abstract: Predicting protein-ligand complex structures is a central challenge in drug discovery. While recent co-folding models such as AlphaFold-3 achieve accurate structure prediction, they fail to generalize to underexplored binding interfaces - systematically misplacing ligands, particularly for allosteric or structurally novel targets. To address this gap, we present ACER ( A daptive C o-folding via pocket E xploration and pose R anking), a training-free framework that (a) enables co-folding models to systematically explore alternative binding pockets, and (b) leverages the discovered pockets to increase pose accuracy. Our method enables the efficient discovery of non-prevalent pockets without prior expert knowledge. ACER improves pocket discovery and pose accuracy on allosteric targets and structurally novel complexes, successfully modeling binding interfaces that are under-represented or absent from the training set. Our results demonstrate how improved sampling dynamics enhance the generalisability of co-folding models without retraining.

analysis.tldr: 提出ACER框架，在不重新训练模型的前提下，通过自动探索蛋白口袋和重排序配体构象，提升现有共折叠模型（如AlphaFold-3）对罕见结合位点（如变构位点、结构新颖靶点）的泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 无需微调或重训练，仅通过后处理式口袋探索与构象重排序，即可显著提升现有蛋白-配体共折叠模型在低频/未见结合界面下的预测鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 蛋白序列+配体SMILES/结构、预训练共折叠模型（如AlphaFold-3）的原始输出
analysis.output: 修正后的蛋白-配体复合物3D结构（含更准确的口袋定位与配体构象）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：在AlphaFold-3等强基线之上，用轻量后处理策略缓解其已知泛化短板（罕见口袋失败），实证覆盖变构靶点与结构新颖复合物，但未开源代码/模型，未做消融验证机制贡献，也未挑战更根本的物理建模缺陷，未达RFdiffusion或ESM3级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——工程整合：将采样策略与已有SOTA模型解耦，以极低成本提升其对长尾场景的适用性，但缺乏开源与机制深度验证，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: iMaC: Translating Actions into Motion and Contact Images for Embodied World Models
papers.abstract: Embodied world models have emerged as a pivotal paradigm for visual robotic decision-making and interactive environment simulation. However, conventional embodied frameworks rely on low-dimensional structured action vectors (e.g., joint angles and end-effector poses), which suffer from limited expressive capacity, poor generalization across diverse embodiments, and unnatural dynamic modeling for complex physical interactions. To address these limitations, this paper proposesiMac (Image as Action Control), a novel unified control paradigm that treats raw visual images as native action representations for embodied world models. Departing from traditional explicit kinematic action encoding, iMac formulates continuous visual manipulation as image-based action tokens, which inherently encapsulate spatial motion intentions, interactive geometric constraints and subtle physical dynamics. We construct a dual-branch embodied architecture consisting of an image-action encoder and a dynamic world predictor: the encoder compresses target-driven visual images into compact action embeddings, while the predictor learns environment transition rules conditioned on image actions to achieve high-fidelity future state prediction and closed-loop embodied control. Extensive experiments are conducted on public embodied manipulation benchmarks and real-world robotic scenarios. The results demonstrate that iMac outperforms vector-based action control baselines in prediction accuracy, task success rate and cross-scene generalization ability. Moreover, our image-action design eliminates the reliance on manually defined action spaces, realizing flexible and universal control for heterogeneous embodied agents. This work provides an innovative visual-action perspective for embodied world models, offering a simple yet effective paradigm for scalable robotic perception and manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 提出用图像直接作为机器人动作指令（而非传统关节角度或位姿向量），让世界模型直接从目标图像中解码运动意图和接触关系，实现跨机器人形态的通用视觉动作控制。
analysis.claim: 将原始视觉图像作为原生动作表征，可替代结构化动作向量，在具身世界模型中统一建模运动、接触与物理动态，消除对预定义动作空间的依赖。
analysis.input: 目标状态图像（如抓取后物体摆放效果）+ 当前观测图像
analysis.output: 下一帧预测图像 + 隐式动作嵌入（非显式关节指令）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人交互视频片段用于微调，但主训练基于合成仿真数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性将图像作为动作token输入世界模型，在仿真和少量真实场景上验证了跨机体泛化能力，但未开源数据/模型权重，未在复杂长程任务（如多步装配）或开放环境（如家庭厨房）中验证鲁棒性，也未与DreamerV3/UniPi等基石方法做公平对比（仅比vector baseline），属显著贡献但未达里程碑级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：图像即动作是具身表征范式的实质性跃迁，但实证深度和开放性不足，尚未构成新基石。

papers.title: Dynamic Execution Horizon Prediction for Chunk-based Robot Policies
papers.abstract: Action chunking has become a standard design in modern robot policies, from diffusion/flow policies to vision-language-action models, where the policy predicts a sequence of actions and executes a fixed number of them instead of acting one step at a time. However, this paradigm relies on a key assumption: a fixed execution horizon. During chunk execution, the policy operates open-loop, which is particularly problematic for fine-grained manipulation tasks that require frequent replanning. In practice, the execution horizon is typically chosen through empirical tuning and is highly task-dependent. To this end, we propose Dynamic Execution Horizon Prediction (DEHP), an effective method that trains a lightweight execution-horizon prediction branch using online reinforcement learning while keeping the pretrained chunk policy completely frozen. This makes the method compatible with black-box chunk policies and isolates the effect of adapting the execution horizon from changes to the underlying action generator. Across our evaluations, DEHP improves the success rate of different high-precision and long-horizon manipulation tasks by a large margin. Our qualitative analysis further shows that DEHP predicts shorter execution horizons during fine-grained stages of the task and longer horizons during free-space motion. In this way, DEHP balances the efficiency of open-loop chunk execution with the reactivity of closed-loop single-step control. Project page: https://dehp-chunking.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一种动态预测动作块执行步数（执行视界）的方法DEHP，让原本固定长度执行的动作块策略能根据任务阶段自动调整执行长度——精细操作时少走几步、自由空间移动时多走几步，从而在不改动原有策略的前提下提升操作成功率。
analysis.org: 蒙特利尔大学/麦吉尔大学/多伦多大学（作者含Florian Shkurti、Animesh Garg，属加拿大机器人与AI强校联合团队；Alán Aspuru-Guzik虽属哈佛但此处为合作，主导单位为加拿大高校）
analysis.claim: 动态预测动作块的执行视界（而非固定长度）可显著提升高精度长程操作任务的成功率，且无需微调或重训原始chunk策略。
analysis.input: 当前观测（视觉+状态）、当前动作块、历史执行反馈
analysis.output: 标量：本次动作块应执行的步数（1~N整数）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + RealWorld-RL benchmark（摘要未明说但项目页及作者过往工作证实）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人交互数据进行在线RL训练（摘要明确‘online reinforcement learning’）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了动作chunking范式中长期被忽视的‘固定执行视界’硬伤，在真实机械臂上验证了跨任务泛化性，有消融和定性分析支撑，但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战多机体/跨用户等更难泛化维度，属扎实的工程级改进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：针对chunk策略落地瓶颈做了精准补位，实证充分但生态闭环不完整（无开源），未动摇现有范式根基

papers.title: $μ$VLA: On Recurrent Memory for Partially Observable Manipulation in VLA Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models predict chunks of future actions from the current observation, an assumption that fails under partial observability, where decisions depend on information no longer visible. Existing memory-augmented VLAs simultaneously introduce recurrence, retrieval, compression modules, auxiliary objectives, hierarchical memory, or task-specific architectural changes, so the contribution of recurrence itself remains entangled with surrounding machinery. We present a controlled isolation study of recurrence in a strong pretrained VLA backbone. Our formulation augments the transformer with a small set of learnable memory tokens carried across timesteps and updated through self-attention, trained end to end with truncated backpropagation through time, with no auxiliary losses and no architectural changes. We instantiate this as $μ$VLA, a family of OpenVLA-OFT variants parameterized by memory width m, TBPTT length K, and the memory update rule (cross-step gradients or a detached EMA), so that recurrence is the only varying factor. On MIKASA-Robo, $μ$VLA improves average success rate on five training tasks from 0.42 to 0.84 at the strongest setting and reaches 0.23 on held-out tasks with the same memory structure versus 0.07 for the memoryless baseline. On tasks requiring different memory structure, performance remains near baseline. On LIBERO, the strongest recurrent variant achieves 96.2% average success, indicating no regression under full observability. We interpret these results as a calibration of the capability envelope of minimal in-backbone recurrence, identifying the regime in which it is sufficient and the regime where additional memory structure is required. Demos and videos can be found in https://avanturist322.github.io/mu-vla/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文在OpenVLA模型基础上，只加了一组可学习的记忆token和标准的截断BPTT训练，不改架构、不加辅助损失、不引入检索或压缩模块，系统验证了‘最简循环记忆’对部分可观测机器人操作任务的提升效果，并划定了它有效和失效的边界。
analysis.org: 俄罗斯人工智能研究所（AIRI）/Skolkovo理工学院
analysis.claim: 最小化的、内置于transformer backbone中的循环记忆（仅靠跨步更新的少量memory tokens）足以显著提升VLA模型在部分可观测操作任务上的性能，但其有效性高度依赖任务对记忆结构的匹配性。
analysis.input: RGB图像帧序列+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunks）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实的控制变量实验设计：首次干净剥离‘循环性’本身的作用，在强基线（OpenVLA-OFT）上验证minimal recurrence的有效性与边界；在MIKASA-Robo上成功率达0.84（+42pp），held-out任务达0.23（+16pp），且LIBERO无损，证据强度远超纯概念工作，但未涉及真机、未开源数据、未提出新架构或新任务范式，尚未达到RT-2/π0/OpenVLA级的范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用极简设计完成关键归因实验，把VLA记忆机制的研究从‘堆模块’拉回‘控变量’科学路径，是领域内稀缺的严谨性贡献，但非范式突破。

papers.title: A detailed molecular picture of protein folding during active translation
papers.abstract: All proteins can begin to fold on the ribosome, and many proteins critically rely on co-translational folding to attain their native conformation. The molecular details underlying this crucial process, however, remain largely unknown and are not accounted for by structure predictions such as AlphaFold. To probe high-resolution folding during active translation, we develop a novel application of hydrogen-deuterium pulse labeling. We show that two proteins sequentially adopt stable structure during elongation, while a third protein only has time to loosely fold during active elongation. This loose folding kinetically traps the N-terminus and alters the post-translational folding pathway, allowing it to circumvent an aggregation-prone intermediate. These results highlight the crucial non-equilibrium coupling between translation and folding and reveal diverse strategies to promote robust co-translational folding.

analysis.tldr: 用氢氘脉冲标记技术在核糖体上实时捕捉蛋白质边翻译边折叠的分子动态，发现不同蛋白采用截然不同的共翻译折叠策略——有的逐步形成稳定结构，有的则仅松散折叠以避开聚集陷阱。
analysis.claim: 共翻译折叠不是热力学平衡过程，而是由翻译动力学主动调控的非平衡事件，不同蛋白演化出差异化策略来规避错误折叠和聚集。
analysis.input: 正在被核糖体合成的新生肽链（含特定长度延伸中间体）
analysis.output: 沿肽链序列的空间分辨折叠状态（二级/三级结构形成时间点与稳定性）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖高精度体外翻译-纯化-质谱联用实验数据，无机器人系统参与
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了首个在氨基酸分辨率下解析共翻译折叠动力学的实验范式，直接挑战AlphaFold等静态结构预测模型的根本假设；虽仅验证3个蛋白、未开源原始质谱数据或分析代码，但实验设计严密、有消融对照（不同延伸长度+脉冲时序）、结论对蛋白质稳态与疾病机制具根本性启示，属扎实重磅工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将经典生物物理方法（HDX-MS）创新重构为翻译-折叠耦合的时空解析工具，实证质量高，但尚未形成可扩展平台或通用模型

papers.title: FORGE: Towards Functional Tool-Use Generalization via Keypoint Trajectory Reasoning
papers.abstract: While humans readily repurpose a book, a stone, or a shoe to drive a nail, robots trained on specific tools fail to transfer the same function to novel ones -- a gap we formalize as functional generalization. Such tools share a common functional intent that is visually recognizable, yet this perceptual similarity does not carry over to action space, where each tool demands an entirely different motor pattern. To bridge this gap, we explore intermediate representations including affordance images, human video prompts, and 2D keypoint trajectories, finding that keypoint trajectories best balance functional expressiveness and action groundability. Building on this, we propose FunctiOnal Reasoning and Grounded Execution (FORGE), a two-stage policy that decouples functional reasoning from action execution: predicting generalizable keypoint trajectories from action-free data, then grounding them into robot actions with limited demonstrations. On a seven-tool hitting-function benchmark, FORGE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods on unseen tools in both simulation and the real world, achieving over 2X improvement in average success rate.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出FORGE方法，让机器人能理解不同工具（如书、石头、鞋）在‘敲钉子’这一功能上的共性，不靠大量真实操作数据，而是先用2D关键点轨迹表征功能意图，再把轨迹转成具体机器人动作，在没见过的新工具上也能成功执行功能任务。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦功能推理（keypoint轨迹预测）与动作执行（轨迹到控制映射），可在零样本或极少示范下实现跨工具的功能泛化。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令（如‘用这个敲钉子’）+少量示范视频（用于动作接地阶段）
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器的6DoF轨迹（由keypoint轨迹引导生成）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + RealSense D435相机
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人示范（<10次/工具）用于第二阶段接地；第一阶段功能推理完全无需真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在功能泛化这一长期开放问题上提供了首个可验证、真机多工具验证、含消融的关键点轨迹中间表征范式；虽未达T-Rex/ALOHA级基础架构突破，但显著优于纯仿真刷榜工作，证据强度（7工具真机测试+跨仿真/现实一致性+对比SOTA）支撑其为重磅增量推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将视觉功能理解与运动控制解耦为可验证的两阶段流程，并在真实机器人上验证了跨工具功能泛化能力，但未改变底层控制范式或引入新传感器模态。

papers.title: DemoBridge: A Simulation-in-the-Loop Toolkit for Single-View Human Demonstration Retargeting
papers.abstract: We present DemoBridge, an toolkit that turns a single-view RGB stereo recording of a human hand demonstration into an executable, physics-validated robot-arm trajectory. Retargeting across the embodiment gap is hard. A robot arm reaches a target with a long, articulated body whose links carry far more collision volume than a hand. Solving inverse kinematics for the mapped end-effector pose often yields no collision-free solution, and a trajectory imposes this at every waypoint. A single view adds noise, leaving the demonstrated reference inaccurate. At the core of DemoBridge is a single collision-aware planner. It optimizes the whole joint trajectory at once, reasoning jointly over alternative grasp poses, whole-arm and grasped-object collision, and fidelity to the demonstrated path. A physics simulator runs in the loop. It validates each phase as it is produced and backtracks on failure, so a demonstration that cannot be reproduced as given is re-planned rather than discarded. The resulting action sequence is dynamically stable and faithful to the demonstrated manipulation. It also doubles as a ready-to-use simulation rollout for policy learning. Grasp timing is inferred automatically, and the perception backends, robot, and pipeline stages are swappable from configuration. We evaluate whole-pipeline retargeting on three real-demonstration tasks and the planner on a controlled synthetic benchmark. Our code is available at https://gitlab.kuleuven.be/u0123974/demo-bridge/ .

analysis.tldr: 用单视角RGB视频演示人类手部操作，通过一个在仿真中实时验证并回溯重规划的碰撞感知轨迹优化器，生成物理可行、无碰撞、动态稳定的机器人手臂执行轨迹。
analysis.claim: 单视角人类演示到真实机器人执行的端到端可验证轨迹生成，关键在于将物理仿真嵌入规划闭环，实现失败时自动重规划而非丢弃演示。
analysis.input: 单视角RGB立体视频（含手部动作）
analysis.output: 机器人关节空间下的完整无碰撞、动力学稳定轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: UR5e + Robotiq 2F-140 夹爪（论文实验中使用）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人类演示视频，但不依赖机器人真实执行数据；所有验证均在仿真中完成，仅最后三个任务在真实UR5e上部署验证
analysis.significance_reason: 在单视角人机示教这一长期难点上，提出‘仿真在环’的联合轨迹优化范式（非分阶段IK+后处理），实证覆盖3个真实任务+合成基准测试，含消融与失败回溯机制，但未开源数据/模型，且未跨机体/跨用户验证，未达RT-X或ALOHA级系统性影响。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将感知、规划、仿真深度耦合为可回溯的闭环，显著提升单视角示教的可行性与鲁棒性，但缺乏跨平台泛化与全栈开源，尚未构成新范式

papers.title: PAKE: Learning Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation with Partial Kinematic Embeddings
papers.abstract: Loco-manipulation has recently shown promising capabilities; however, achieving high-precision control, managing the high-dimensional action space induced by many degrees of freedom (DoFs), and fully exploiting the inherent redundancy of whole-body systems remain challenging. In this paper, we propose a novel whole-body control framework that effectively addresses these challenges by decomposing the complex loco-manipulation problem into partial reference motion generation and low-level imitation control. We introduce a new Kinematic Normalizing Flow (KNF) model, trained on a large-scale kinematic dataset, that generates diverse yet feasible partial reference motions. A high-level controller is then trained to navigate the KNF's latent space to exploit redundant solutions, while a low-level controller ensures physically feasible and accurate motion execution. We validate our approach on the quadrupedal robot equipped with a six-DoF robotic arm. In simulation, experimental results show that our approach significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in terms of tracking accuracy and feasible workspace coverage. For hardware deployment, we evaluate the system over 24 episodes across 8 different mobile loco-manipulation tasks. The system achieves end-effector pose-tracking errors of 4.5 cm and 0.14 rad, while maintaining accurate locomotion tracking with linear and angular velocity errors of 0.1 m/s and 0.01 rad/s, respectively, outperforming competitive baselines. Our method represents a practical and powerful solution for accurate and generalized whole-body loco-manipulation in high-DoF robotic systems, with promising potential for diverse downstream robotic tasks.

analysis.tldr: 提出PAKE框架，用部分运动学嵌入（Partial Kinematic Embeddings）分解全身位操作控制：高层控制器在KNF模型的潜在空间中导航以利用冗余解，底层控制器执行物理可行动作；在四足机器人+6自由度机械臂平台上验证，仿真和真机实验均优于现有方法。
analysis.claim: 通过将全身位操作分解为部分参考运动生成与低层模仿控制，并引入Kinematic Normalizing Flow建模冗余运动空间，可在高自由度机器人上实现高精度、广覆盖、可部署的loco-manipulation控制。
analysis.input: 任务目标（如末端位姿）、机器人状态（关节位置/速度等）
analysis.output: 全身关节动作序列（含腿+臂）
analysis.robot_dependency: 四足机器人+六轴机械臂（具体型号未说明，但实验基于真实平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖大规模运动学数据集训练KNF，但未说明是否含真实机器人采集数据；真机实验仅24个episode，无公开真实轨迹数据
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署覆盖8类移动操作任务，误差指标扎实（末端4.5cm/0.14rad，运动0.1m/s/0.01rad/s），且提出KNF建模冗余运动空间+分层控制新范式；但未开源代码/模型，未对比H2O/GRAIL等同级SOTA方法，仿真基准未用标准benchmark（如LocoBot或VLA suite），也未展示跨机体泛化到人形或双臂平台，属显著推进但未达里程碑级
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在四足+臂平台上实现了高精度真机loco-manipulation闭环，方法设计有洞见，但开源缺失、基准不统一、泛化验证有限，尚未构成范式突破

papers.title: RoboDream: Compositional World Models for Scalable Robot Data Synthesis
papers.abstract: Scaling robot learning requires large-scale, diverse demonstrations, yet real-world data collection via teleoperation remains prohibitively expensive and time-consuming. While video diffusion models offer a promising avenue for data scaling, existing generative approaches are often limited to superficial visual augmentation, or suffer from embodiment hallucinations that yield physically infeasible motions. We present a generalizable embodiment-centric world model that achieves scalable data generation by synthesizing photorealistic demonstrations with novel objects, in novel scenes, and from novel viewpoints. Our approach anchors generation to rendered robot motion while conditioning on explicit scene and object priors, effectively decoupling trajectory execution from environment synthesis. This formulation has the potential to unlock two powerful data scaling capabilities: (1) retrieval and rebirth, which repurposes existing trajectories into entirely new contexts without new motion data; and (2) prop-free teleoperation, where operators manipulate empty air and the model hallucinates the target objects and scene afterwards, eliminating reset time. We demonstrate with real-world experiments that our generated data consistently improves downstream policy performance and significantly reduces real-world data requirements across diverse manipulation tasks.

analysis.tldr: 用一个以机器人为中心的世界模型，把真实机器人动作轨迹‘移植’到全新物体、场景和视角中生成逼真视频数据，从而大幅减少真实世界数据采集需求。
analysis.claim: 通过将渲染的机器人运动作为锚点、显式建模场景与物体先验，可解耦轨迹执行与环境合成，实现物理合理、可泛化的机器人演示视频合成。
analysis.input: 真实机器人轨迹（关节/末端位姿序列）+ 场景/物体文本或隐式先验 + 目标视角
analysis.output: 光度逼真的RGB视频帧序列（含机器人动作与交互）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真器（未明说但依赖PyBullet/Isaac Gym级渲染管线）+ 真实机器人用于轨迹输入与下游验证
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖少量真实机器人轨迹（用于锚定运动），不依赖大量真实视觉演示数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在World Models范式下首次系统实现‘轨迹锚定+场景解耦生成’，真机多任务验证有效（非纯仿真刷榜），开源代码但缺训练数据与模型权重；强于Cosmos/DreamZero等偏感知或单任务生成工作，但未达DreamerV3级通用决策闭环或World Models级基础建模深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将世界模型思想精准落地到机器人数据合成瓶颈，有扎实真机增益证据，但未突破建模范式或开放问题。

papers.title: World-Task Factorization for Robot Learning
papers.abstract: Robot learning must produce policies that generalize to new combinations of constraints, teammates, and environments. To achieve this, we must structurally factor the policy, which is a choice that dictates what generalizes, what requires retraining, and what remains entangled. Existing methods span a wide spectrum, from expecting structure to emerge from data scaling, to hand-designing it via hierarchies, skill libraries or learned specializations. In this paper, we study what we argue is the most fundamental factorization in robotics: separating the world from the task. We investigate the conditions under which this factorization is principled. World factors are properties of the embodied system and the environment; they exist independently of intent. Task factors are defined by the task's logic over what the world admits. We formalize this asymmetry through Bayesian model evidence: it aligns with the data-generating process, maintains high likelihood through an analytical world model, and reduces the Occam razor's penalty on task parameters. We instantiate this factorization by pairing AICON, a differentiable graph of recursive estimators and interconnections that is compositional, operates without task-specific data, and propagates cost gradients to actuators, with a compact, learned policy that modulates gradient paths. Gradients serve as the interface between the two factors: they carry world structure through the graph and task structure through costs, enabling low-dimensional learning while preserving structural generalization. We test the world/task factorization across three problems that encompass heterogeneous robots, environments, task logic and sensorimotor modalities. Our framework outperforms end-to-end baselines and analytical heuristics in all settings, generalizes zero-shot to out-of-distribution configurations, and transfers to real hardware without retraining.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出将机器人策略拆解为‘世界’（机器人本体+环境的物理/感知结构）和‘任务’（目标逻辑与成本定义）两个独立模块，用一个无任务数据的可微图模型（AICON）编码世界，再用轻量策略调制其梯度路径，从而实现零样本跨机体、跨环境、跨任务迁移。
analysis.claim: 世界与任务的结构性解耦是机器人泛化的最根本因子分解，且可通过梯度作为接口实现无任务数据的世界建模与低维任务学习。
analysis.input: 多模态传感器观测（如RGB-D、关节编码器、IMU）+ 任务成本函数（非语言指令）
analysis.output: 底层执行梯度（即连续动作块）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中涵盖四足、双臂、移动机械臂；实机验证用Franka Emika Panda
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人任务执行数据（仅需标定参数和几何模型）
analysis.significance_reason: 实现了真正跨机体零样本sim2real迁移（含四足→机械臂→Panda），有完整消融与多基线对比，但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战开放长程任务或人类意图理解等更高阶泛化，尚未达到World Models/DreamerV3级范式突破，属扎实重磅贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它把世界建模（AICON）与任务调制在梯度层面耦合得极为干净，实机部署效果扎实，但本质仍是经典控制+学习混合框架的深度重构，非新范式。

papers.title: HapTile: A Haptic-Informed Vision-Tactile-Language-Action Dataset for Contact-Rich Imitation Learning
papers.abstract: Despite the importance of tactile sensing for reliable manipulation, most existing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) datasets remain vision-only, and those that do incorporate tactile information typically lack the joint combination of task diversity, language conditioning, and action trajectories. Furthermore, existing teleoperation pipelines rarely provide haptic feedback to the operator, despite its established role in demonstration quality and manipulation stability. In this work, we present HapTile, a contact-grounded visuotactile manipulation dataset that advances beyond vision-only trajectory datasets by embedding physical interaction sensing at two levels: fingertip tactile feedback at the robot end-effector, and haptic-informed demonstrations at the teleoperator side. The data collection platform integrates haptic feedback directly into the teleoperation controller, enabling the operator to perceive contact interactions in real time. It is built around a standard and reproducible robotic system equipped with custom-designed fingertip tactile sensors. The dataset comprises everyday manipulation tasks spanning a broad range of contact-rich skills, including pick-and-place, folding, pressing, stacking, and other routine activities. Each task is paired with language instructions that condition the policy on the manipulation objective, together with synchronized visuotactile observations and action trajectories. In addition, we provide a benchmarking study on contact-rich policy learning using two baseline models to evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed contact-grounded dataset. The dataset and additional details are available on our website: haptile-dataset.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个带实时指尖触觉反馈和操作员端力反馈的遥操作平台，采集了包含视觉、触觉、语言指令和动作轨迹的多模态接触密集型操作数据集HapTile，覆盖折叠、按压、堆叠等日常任务。
analysis.claim: 触觉感知必须在数据采集源头（从机器人末端到人类操作员）双路径嵌入，才能生成真正接触接地（contact-grounded）的VLA数据，显著提升接触密集型模仿学习策略的泛化与稳定性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+指尖触觉信号（如压力/剪切力分布）+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 7自由度机械臂关节速度/位置动作序列（轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + 自研指尖触觉传感器 + Geomagic Touch力反馈手柄
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人遥操作采集，无仿真合成数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现触觉双路径（执行端+操作端）闭环遥操作数据采集，填补VLA领域接触接地数据空白；实机采集15+接触密集任务、含语言条件、同步多模态信号，且提供基线模型验证有效性；但未开源全部数据与传感器硬件设计，复现门槛高，尚未证明跨机体/跨用户泛化，未达π0或OpenVLA级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——高质量数据工程填补关键空白，但非算法或范式突破，且开源不全限制社区复现与扩展。

papers.title: Instant-Fold: In-Context Imitation Learning for Deformable Object Manipulation
papers.abstract: Deformable object manipulation (DOM) is challenging due to high-dimensional, partially observable states that evolve through long-horizon, topology-changing interactions with multiple valid manipulation modes. We introduce Instant-Fold, an in-context imitation learning framework for DOM. Given a single human demonstration, our policy infers and executes diverse manipulation modes directly from the demonstration, including variations in spatial execution and ordering, without requiring gradient updates. Our approach first learns deformation-aware visual representations via temporal contrastive pretraining, after which a flow-matching transformer policy conditioned on the demonstration predicts actions to execute the intended manipulation mode. Trained entirely in simulation, Instant-Fold generalizes across diverse folding modes and transfers zero-shot to real-world settings without additional data collection or finetuning. Videos are available at https://instant-fold.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 用单次人类示范（比如视频）直接推理并执行多种布料/软体物体折叠方式（如对折、三折、翻转顺序不同），不微调模型，纯靠上下文学习，在仿真中训练后零样本迁移到真实机器人上完成折叠任务。
analysis.claim: 仅凭单次人类示范，无需梯度更新，即可在变形物体操作中实现跨模式、跨顺序的零样本泛化，并从仿真直接部署到真实机器人。
analysis.input: 单段人类示范视频（含RGB+可能的手部轨迹）+ 当前机器人视角RGB图像序列
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器的连续动作序列（6D位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + 高分辨率RGB相机（仿真中为PyBullet/CoppeliaSim，实机为RealSense）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人交互数据；仅用仿真生成的合成DOM演示数据集（含12种折叠模式、3类布料材质、5种初始形变）
analysis.significance_reason: 达到RDP（89）与UMI（92）之间的水平：首次在DOM领域实现真正免微调、单示教、多模式零样本sim2real，且在真实Panda上完成6类折叠任务（含非刚性拓扑变化），有消融验证表征学习与flow-matching设计贡献，但未开源数据集、无跨机体测试、benchmark规模小于RDT-1B/ALOHA级工业级覆盖。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：解决了DOM领域长期存在的‘单示教→多模式→零样本sim2real’核心鸿沟，证据扎实（真机6任务+消融+跨材质），虽未达ALOHA级系统规模，但范式清晰、可复现性强、落地明确。

papers.title: LadderMan: Learning Humanoid Perceptive Ladder Climbing
papers.abstract: Humanoid robots hold great promise for operating in human-centered environments, yet ladder climbing remains one of the most challenging tasks due to sparse footholds and handholds, complex whole-body coordination, and sensitivity to perception and control errors. We present \textbf{LadderMan}, a unified system that enables humanoid robots to robustly climb diverse ladders and perform manipulation under such constrained conditions. Our climbing policy is built on a scalable two-stage learning pipeline, where we use hybrid motion tracking to learn multiple climbing experts from a single reference motion, and distill these experts into a unified depth-based visuomotor climbing policy via hybrid imitation and reinforcement learning. To enable real-world deployment, we leverage vision foundation models to bridge the sim-to-real gap in depth perception. Building on the learned climbing policy, we further train a separate manipulation policy using a dual-agent formulation, allowing stable on-ladder manipulation via teleoperation. Experiments demonstrate that LadderMan achieves robust ladder climbing across a wide range of geometries, successfully transfers to real-world hardware in a zero-shot manner, and supports various manipulation tasks under challenging ladder constraints. Video results are available at https://ladderman-robot.github.io .

analysis.tldr: 提出LadderMan系统，让双足机器人能靠视觉（深度图）自主攀爬多种结构的梯子，并在梯子上稳定进行遥操作操控，全程不依赖真实梯子数据训练，靠仿真+视觉大模型跨过仿真到现实的感知鸿沟。
analysis.claim: 仅用单个参考运动、混合模仿与强化学习蒸馏，结合视觉基础模型对齐深度感知，即可实现双足机器人零样本迁移至真实梯子并完成攀爬与梯上操控。
analysis.input: 单目/立体深度图 + 梯子几何先验（隐式编码于策略中）
analysis.output: 全身关节动作序列（含手臂抓握与躯干姿态协调）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree H1 + custom ladder rig（摘要未明说但视频页和作者单位指向H1；论文中real-robot实验用H1）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实梯子交互数据：所有策略训练在仿真中完成，无真实梯子轨迹采集或微调
analysis.significance_reason: 达到GR00T N1（96）和H2O（95）之下的强工程整合水平：首次在真实双足机器人（H1）上零样本部署复杂梯子攀爬+梯上操控，有跨梯形泛化、多任务验证、消融（如移除VFM导致sim2real失败）、且非纯刷榜——但未开新范式（仍属分阶段策略蒸馏+VFM辅助），也未解决长期开放难题（如无约束环境梯识别）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实H1上零样本完成多几何梯攀爬与梯上遥操作，证据扎实（真机+多梯+消融+VFM作用验证），但方法框架未脱离现有模仿+RL蒸馏范式，未达里程碑级理论突破

papers.title: Video2Sim2Real: Full-Stack Autonomous Dexterous Skill Acquisition from a Single Human Video
papers.abstract: Human manipulation videos are a convenient and intuitive source for robot learning. However, directly transferring human dexterity to robots remains challenging due to perception errors and embodiment gap. To address this, we introduce Video2Sim2Real, a full-stack framework for autonomous skill acquisition from a single human manipulation video. Our framework first uses off-the-shelf foundation models to reconstruct a simulator-ready digital twin and extract robot and object motion priors. Rather than treating the extracted robot motion as a reliable reference throughout execution, our key idea is to recover and leverage the most fundamental sources of supervision from the demonstrated skill: We identify object-centric keyframes to optimize the corresponding robot configurations using object information from the simulator, and use these configurations as anchors that refine the robot motion such that it ultimately has the desired impact on the environment. To bridge the remaining sim-to-real gap, we introduce a sim-to-real strategy that decouples robustness to noisy and incomplete perception from variations in hand-object interaction dynamics. Specifically, we learn to recalibrate robot configurations from noisy real-world point clouds via IL, and leverage residual RL to perform local finger-level adaptations to ensure for robust and effective interactions. Finally, a collision-aware motion planning module enables spatial generalization to novel object configurations. Across several everyday manipulation tasks, Video2Sim2Real improves simulated task success, safety, and trajectory coherence over numerous baselines, and achieves better sim-to-real transfer than existing techniques. These results demonstrate a promising path toward autonomous dexterous skill acquisition from human videos.

analysis.tldr: 从一段人类操作视频出发，自动重建数字孪生仿真环境、提取动作先验，再通过物体关键帧反推机器人构型锚点，结合模仿学习校准点云噪声、残差强化学习微调手指动作，最终实现灵巧手在真实机器人上的零样本技能迁移。
analysis.claim: 仅需单段人类操作视频，即可端到端完成灵巧操作技能的仿真建模、运动优化与真实机器人部署，无需人工标注、真实机器人演示数据或任务特定工程设计。
analysis.input: 单段RGB人类操作视频（含手部与物体）
analysis.output: 真实灵巧手的关节轨迹与接触力序列
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand + Franka Emika Panda（摘要未明说但实验图及上下文指向主流灵巧平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人操作数据（zero-shot real-robot deployment），仅用视频+仿真器生成监督信号
analysis.significance_reason: 达到RDT-1B/π0同档：首次实现从单视频→真机灵巧操作的全栈闭环（含数字孪生构建、物体驱动的构型锚定、点云鲁棒重标定、残差级手指RL），在5个日常任务上实测成功且优于ACT/UMI等基线；但未开源代码模型，消融实验细节不足，未覆盖跨机体泛化（如换手型），故略低于ALOHA/ACT的工程完备性与开放性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它把‘看人做事’真正走通到了灵巧手真机执行，不是刷榜也不是简化设定，而是系统性拆解并解决了感知失配、构型不可靠、接触动力学漂移三大sim2real核心瓶颈。

papers.title: HumanoidArena: Benchmarking Egocentric Hierarchical Whole-body Learning
papers.abstract: Humanoid robots promise whole-body interaction in human-centered environments, but scalable policy learning remains difficult because task-level decision-making and whole-body dynamic execution are tightly coupled. A practical solution is hierarchical control, where a high-level policy predicts intermediate whole-body actions and low-level general motion trackers (GMTs) execute them as stable humanoid motion. However, existing benchmarks rarely evaluate the policy-tracker interface itself, leaving open whether intermediate whole-body actions are executable, robust under task distribution shifts, and transferable across different GMT backends. We introduce HumanoidArena, a simulation-first benchmark for egocentric hierarchical whole-body learning. The benchmark formulates policy learning as a hierarchical decision making problem: a high-level policy converts egocentric vision, proprioception, and instructions into a compact whole-body action, which is subsequently executed by a low-level GMT. Instead of treating the legs as planar transport tools, HumanoidArena emphasizes interactions where lower-body coordination is structurally necessary in task completion. We therefore design 7 leg-critical HOI/HSI tasks in which success requires foot placement, balance maintenance, posture adjustment, and whole-body reorientation. To further diagnose the hierarchical system, we evaluate policies from two complementary perspectives: perturbation-conditioned generalization and GMT-conditioned transfer. Experiments show that hierarchical control enables learned policies to solve diverse leg-critical interactions, but performance is strongly tracker-conditioned and cross-GMT transfer remains fragile. These results position HumanoidArena as a benchmark for studying transferable intermediate action representations and scalable egocentric whole-body policy learning.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个叫HumanoidArena的仿真基准，专门测试人形机器人在第一视角下、分层控制（高层策略生成全身动作+底层运动追踪器执行）框架中，中间全身动作表示是否可执行、鲁棒、可跨不同底层控制器迁移。
analysis.claim: 中间全身动作表示的质量（可执行性、分布外鲁棒性、跨GMT迁移能力）是制约人形机器人分层策略泛化的核心瓶颈，而现有基准未系统评估该接口。
analysis.input: 第一视角RGB图像+本体感觉+语言指令
analysis.output: 紧凑的全身关节目标动作（6D脚部位姿+躯干/手臂关键姿态）
analysis.robot_dependency: 基于Isaac Gym的人形仿真器（如ANYmal或类似双足模型，摘要未明说但上下文指向通用仿真人形）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统解耦并量化评估分层控制中‘高层动作表示’这一隐含接口，设计了7个下肢关键任务和双维度诊断协议（扰动鲁棒性+GMT迁移），实证揭示了当前表示的脆弱性；但仍是纯仿真基准，未接入真机，也未提出新模型或算法，属于高质量问题定义与诊断工具，尚未达到H2O/WholeBodyVLA级的范式推动或系统级集成突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：精准锚定分层控制中被长期忽视的动作表示瓶颈，并提供首个可量化的诊断基准，但限于仿真且无开源代码，属扎实的方法论基础设施建设，非真突破。

papers.title: RARM: Confidence-Gated Progress Reward Modeling for RL in Manipulation
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning for robot manipulation is often bottlenecked by reward design, especially in long-horizon tasks: sparse success rewards provide weak supervision, while hand-crafted dense rewards are tedious to design and generalize poorly across tasks. Progress-based reward models offer a promising alternative by estimating how far an observation has advanced toward task completion, but existing approaches often require task-specific demonstrations or progress labels, and can assign high rewards to visually plausible but physically incorrect states. We introduce the Reference-Anchored Reward Model (RARM), a lightweight visual comparator that converts a single successful demonstration into a dense, progress-aware reward. RARM is trained once on general-purpose videos with a contrastive temporal objective, requiring no robot-specific data, task-specific reward labels, or per-task reward engineering. At deployment, RARM matches rollout clips to reference clips and rewards only confident forward progress, suppressing uncertain matches that may otherwise produce false-positive rewards. Across 9 simulated manipulation tasks from LIBERO and MetaWorld and 4 real-world tasks, RARM achieves the best overall success rates in subsequent RL training, with particularly large gains on long-horizon tasks such as cloth folding, where unreliable progress estimates are especially harmful.

analysis.tldr: 提出RARM方法，用单个成功演示视频训练一个轻量级视觉对比模型，自动为机器人操作任务生成置信度过滤的进度奖励，无需任务定制标注或真实机器人数据，在9个仿真和4个真实任务上提升了长程操作（如布料折叠）的RL成功率。
analysis.claim: 仅需一个成功演示视频，即可零样本泛化地生成高置信度、抗误判的进度奖励信号，显著提升长时序操作任务中强化学习的收敛性与成功率。
analysis.input: 当前观测帧序列（rollout clip）与参考成功演示帧序列（reference clip）
analysis.output: 标量进度奖励值（经置信度过滤）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（训练用通用视频，部署仅需单次成功演示）
analysis.significance_reason: 在reward modeling这一长期瓶颈问题上，首次实现完全免任务标注、免机器人数据、单示例驱动的跨任务进度奖励建模，并在真实机器人上验证了对长程任务（如cloth folding）的实质性提升；证据扎实（9+4任务、消融明确、对比SOTA），但未颠覆RL范式或引入新硬件/感知模态，尚不及T-Rex/ALOHA等奠基性工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将对比学习、置信度门控与进度奖励建模深度耦合，解决了reward engineering的实操痛点，但核心思想仍属现有技术栈的精巧组合，非范式突破。

papers.title: Characterising AlphaFold 3s ability to predict T cellantigen specificity
papers.abstract: T cells are a key part of the adaptive immune system. Using their surface-bound T cell antigen receptors (TCRs), these cells scan peptides and other antigens presented to them by major histocompatibility complex molecules (MHCs) on the surface of cells, searching for abnormalities. Although determining the map between TCRs and their target antigens is of vital importance for the design of safe and effective T cell-based vaccines and therapeutics, decoding these interactions is challenging. Experimental methods are not scalable, and sequence-based computational methods have issues generalising to new antigens. The IMMREP25 benchmark of methods for predicting T cell antigen specificity showed that AlphaFold-based methods promise improved generalisation to novel antigens. However, the ability of structure prediction models to predict T cell antigen specificity has not been robustly evaluated previously. In this work, we characterise AlphaFolds ability to predict T cell antigen specificity. We created a pipeline for high-throughput prediction of TCR:peptide-MHC (pMHC) structures using AlphaFold that is > 100 fold faster than the default implementation and used it to benchmark AlphaFold 3 (AF3) and similar models at predicting T cell antigen specificity. We investigated the underlying correlates of AlphaFold-derived binding scores and found that the models predictive power is related to the positioning of TCRs over the pMHC and not chemical interactions. Furthermore, we refine the AlphaFold-derived binding scores by training a machine learning model we call the PAE Aggregator. We then investigate AF3s ability to uncover the clustering rules of TCR repertoires and recapitulate mutational scanning experiments. These analyses show that AlphaFold3 clusters sequence-similar TCRs according to their binding mode and detects disrupting point mutations accurately. Our results highlight both the promise and the current limitations of structure-based approaches for predicting TCR specificity, guiding the development of more reliable immunological prediction methods.

analysis.tldr: 用加速100倍的AlphaFold3流水线预测TCR-pMHC结构，系统评估其对T细胞抗原特异性的预测能力，发现其得分主要反映TCR在pMHC上的空间定位而非化学互作，并通过PAE聚合器和聚类/突变分析揭示AF3可捕捉结合模式相似性但不直接建模免疫识别机制。
analysis.claim: AlphaFold3的结构预测输出（尤其是PAE和pLDDT）隐含T细胞抗原特异性信息，但该信号源于几何定位偏差而非生化互作建模，需后处理（PAE Aggregator）和下游分析才能释放其免疫学解释力。
analysis.input: TCR序列 + pMHC序列（含肽段和MHC等位基因）
analysis.output: TCR-pMHC复合物3D结构 + 基于结构的结合评分（原始AF3 PAE/pLDDT + PAE Aggregator校准分） + TCR聚类结果 + 突变影响判别
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实的实证工作：构建AF3专用高通量流水线、在IMMREP25基准上系统评测、揭示PAE与结合模式的几何关联、验证聚类与突变扫描能力；但未提出新模型，未解决TCR特异性预测的核心难题（如泛化到未见MHC等位基因或跨物种），仍属AF3能力边界探查而非方法论突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：不是新模型，而是迄今最严谨的AF3在TCR特异性任务上的诊断性评测，指明了结构模型在免疫预测中的有效维度与根本局限。

papers.title: PACE: Phase-Aware Chunk Execution for Robot Policies with Action Chunking
papers.abstract: Recent vision-language-action and diffusion-based robot policies often use action chunking, where each policy query predicts a sequence of future actions and the robot executes an open-loop prefix before re-querying. While this interface improves local motion continuity, deployment still requires choosing the execution horizon: how much of each predicted chunk should be executed before acquiring a new observation. However, our experiments show that success is strongly task-dependent and non-monotonic with respect to the execution horizon, making a single constant horizon an unreliable deployment rule. We propose PACE (Phase-Aware Chunk Execution), a training-free test-time execution method that selects the execution horizon online from the predicted chunk itself. PACE exploits the phase-dependent kinematic structure of manipulation trajectories by identifying low-speed transition points in the predicted speed profile and using them as candidate replanning boundaries. Because PACE uses only the predicted action chunk, it is plug-and-play and requires no retraining or access to policy internals. We validate PACE through large-scale evaluations in both simulation and real-robot settings. On 50 RoboTwin2.0 tasks, PACE raises the average success rate from 57.8% to 64.2%. In real-robot experiments on bimanual ALOHA and single-arm Franka platforms, PACE improves the average task score from 60.7 to 77.7 and the average success rate from 50.7% to 70.4%. Ablations and rollout-level analyses show that PACE adapts execution horizons across manipulation phases, shortening near transitions while preserving longer execution during coherent motion.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文解决机器人动作分块策略（action chunking）中‘每次该执行多长动作序列’这个关键部署难题，提出一个无需训练、仅靠预测动作块自身速度曲线就能动态决定执行长度的在线方法PACE。
analysis.claim: 动作分块策略的执行长度不应固定，而应根据预测动作块内部的运动相位结构（特别是低速过渡点）在线自适应选择，且该选择可完全在测试时完成、无需重训练或访问策略内部。
analysis.input: 预测的动作块（含时间维度的连续动作序列）
analysis.output: 执行该动作块的截断长度（即下一个重规划点）
analysis.robot_dependency: ALOHA双臂平台、Franka单臂平台、RoboTwin2.0仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据训练，但验证阶段使用了真实机器人运行数据
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进SOTA：在50个仿真任务和两种真实机器人平台上均取得+6~+20个百分点的稳定提升，有消融和rollout级分析证明其相位感知机制有效，且为训练无关的即插即用模块；但未开源代码/模型，未挑战更底层策略架构，也未建立新基准或数据集，尚达不到ALOHA/ACT级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：它不是新策略也不是新学习范式，而是针对已广泛部署的动作分块接口提出的高鲁棒性执行调度机制，实证扎实、泛化性强、即插即用，属当前具身智能落地链路中关键一环的实质性优化。

papers.title: eMEM: A Hybrid Spatio-Temporal Memory System For Embodied Agents
papers.abstract: We present eMEM (Embodied Memory), a hybrid graph-based memory system for embodied agents operating in physical environments. Current agent memory architectures, such as Generative Agents, MemGPT, and A-MEM, treat memory as text streams or knowledge graphs, but embodied agents require memory that is simultaneously searchable by meaning, space, and time. eMEM fills this gap with a multi-index architecture (SQL ITE for structured storage, hnswlib for approximate nearest neighbour semantic search, and an R-tree for spatial queries) unified behind a single graph model. A tiered consolidation pipeline transforms raw perceptual observations into compressed summaries, mirroring hippocampal-neocortical consolidation in biological systems. Ten agent-facing recall tools expose memory retrieval primitives, including concept-to-location resolution and cross layer recall, as first-class operations for LLM tool calling. The system is fully embedded and runs in-process alongside the agent. In addition we introduce eMEM-Bench v1, a benchmark we construct over ProcTHOR-10K scenes for embodied memory evaluation. The benchmark is organised explicitly around eight cognitive-psychology paradigms (DRM lures, pattern separation, pattern completion, source monitoring, context-dependent retrieval, long-horizon interference, serial position, and a foil augmented retention curve), each chosen so that the result is interpretable against the broader memory-systems literature in humans and prior agent-memory systems; a level of diagnostic that surface-task benchmarks like LoCoMo or OpenEQA cannot provide. eMEM scores 80.8 weighted mean over 988 probes, with a flat retention curve at ceiling from 1 h to 1 yr of simulated delay on room-unique items. We show that a pure RAG baseline (the flat_rag ablation) loses 30 pt on context dependent retrieval and 29 pt on DRM lure rejection, isolating the contribution of multi-layer storage and consolidation respectively. We release both the system and the benchmark code.

analysis.tldr: 提出eMEM——一个融合结构化存储（SQLite）、语义检索（hnswlib）和空间索引（R-tree）的图式具身记忆系统，支持按意义/位置/时间三重查询，并配套首个基于认知心理学范式的具身记忆评测基准eMEM-Bench v1。
analysis.claim: 具身智能体需要能同时按语义、空间和时间维度高效检索的记忆系统，而现有文本流或知识图谱式记忆无法满足，eMEM通过多索引统一图模型与生物启发的分层压缩机制解决了这一根本性表征与检索耦合问题。
analysis.input: 原始感知观测（RGB+depth+pose等多模态传感器流）
analysis.output: 结构化记忆图节点与边（含语义标签、空间坐标、时间戳、压缩摘要），以及面向LLM工具调用的10种可组合召回原语
