papers.title: Regulatory landscape of widespread stop codon readthrough in Drosophila
papers.abstract: In stop codon readthrough (SCR), ribosomes continue to translate past the stop. While programmed SCR is rare in mammals, it appears remarkably widespread in insects, yet its regulation and biological significance remain poorly understood. Here, we systematically characterize SCR in Drosophila melanogaster by integrating ribosome profiling, comparative genomics, proteomics, and functional screening. We identify ~1,400 SCR genes, reveal sequence features associated with programmed SCR, and distinguish constitutive and tissue-restricted modes. We identify conserved cis-elements sufficient to stimulate constitutive SCR and demonstrate that many remain functional in mammalian cells. Unexpectedly, the major distinction between insect and mammalian cells was not termination efficiency, but insect responsiveness to SCR-promoting regulatory elements. SCR was further associated with increased overall protein output, suggesting a function beyond proteome diversification. Our results establish SCR as a pervasive regulatory mechanism in Drosophila and provide a new framework for its study through the Drosophila Stop Codon Readthrough Atlas.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统绘制了果蝇中广泛存在的终止密码子通读（SCR）图谱，整合多种组学数据鉴定出约1400个发生SCR的基因，发现并验证了保守的顺式调控元件，揭示其在果蝇中是普遍存在的转录后调控机制，且部分元件在哺乳动物细胞中仍具功能。
analysis.org: 麻省理工学院/哈佛大学Broad研究所
analysis.claim: 终止密码子通读（SCR）在果蝇中是一种广泛、受顺式元件调控、具有组织特异性和功能输出效应的内源性基因表达调控机制，而非随机翻译错误。
analysis.input: 果蝇多组织核糖体图谱（Ribo-seq）、比较基因组序列、质谱蛋白质组数据、功能筛选报告系统
analysis.output: SCR基因列表、SCR顺式调控元件图谱、组织特异性SCR模式分类、跨物种功能验证结果
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量系统生物学工作：真数据驱动（Ribo-seq+proteomics+functional assay），覆盖全基因组尺度（~1400基因），发现可移植的保守调控元件，并给出机制解释（昆虫特异性响应而非终止效率差异）；但未解决根本性范式问题（如SCR如何被动态调控、是否直接参与发育或疾病），也未开发通用预测模型或工具链，分量介于ESM-2（95）与典型高影响力Cell/Nature方法学论文之间。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将多组学数据深度整合为首个果蝇SCR系统图谱和可复用资源（Drosophila SCR Atlas），证据扎实、开源完备，但未提出新计算范式或颠覆性生物学机制。

papers.title: VQActFlow: Vector-Quantized Action Mode Steering for Multi-Task Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Multi-task robot manipulation policies are challenging to learn from demonstration because traditionally a single network must select among qualitatively different action modes from a multimodal demonstration distribution, conditioned on language and visual context. A wrong mode selection means executing the wrong task or an action infeasible in the scene. Tokenizing continuous actions into a learned discrete codebook separates these modes at the representation level, offering structural advantages for multi-task learning. We propose VQActFlow, a multi-task manipulation policy that tokenizes action chunks and generates code sequences via Variational Flow Matching. VQActFlow maintains an explicit preference over action modes throughout generation. Inference-time guidance acts on this preference to steer mode commitment. We instantiate this with classifier-free guidance over language conditioning, which steers the policy toward the instructed action mode, and a learned codebook critic that supplies a complementary feasibility signal. We evaluate VQActFlow on three platforms: the LIBERO simulation benchmarks, a Unitree G1 humanoid performing whole-body pick-and-place, and an ALOHA-style bimanual platform performing contact-rich tasks. Across these benchmarks, VQActFlow outperforms both continuous and discrete baselines.

analysis.tldr: 提出VQActFlow，将连续动作分块并用向量量化（VQ）映射到离散码本，再用变分流匹配（Variational Flow Matching）生成码序列，并在推理时通过无分类器语言引导和可学习码本判别器联合调控动作模式选择，从而提升多任务机器人操作中动作模式的准确性和场景可行性。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露；Zhao、Wu、Zhao等常见于清华/伯克利/CMU，但Leggiero、Xue、Zhan等无明确指向；无机构缩写或项目归属线索）
analysis.claim: 通过将动作显式离散化为码本并引入可调控的模式偏好机制，VQActFlow能更鲁棒地从多模态示范中解耦并选择正确动作模式，显著提升跨平台多任务操作的泛化性与可行性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+历史动作片段（用于动作分块建模）
analysis.output: 离散动作码序列（每个码对应一个语义动作模式块）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1 humanoid, ALOHA-style bimanual platform, LIBERO simulator
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人演示数据（ALOHA/Unitree任务需真实数据训练，但摘要未说明是否使用真实数据微调或仅仿真预训练）
analysis.significance_reason: 技术组合扎实（VQ+Flow Matching+双路引导）且实证覆盖仿真（LIBERO）、人形（Unitree G1全身体操作）、双臂（ALOHA接触密集任务）三类平台，多任务性能超越连续/离散基线，但未开源代码/模型，缺乏消融实验细节（如各引导模块贡献度）、未报告真实数据规模与采集方式，也未挑战如YUBI/RealDexUMI级别的通用双指灵巧操作或FTP-1级触觉泛化，属强工程整合而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：融合VQ表征、流匹配生成与双路推理引导，在多平台多任务上验证有效，但缺乏开源与深度消融，未触及灵巧操作或跨模态感知的核心瓶颈，尚未达到基石论文的范式影响力。

papers.title: EEG Benchmarking Needs a Task Specification Layer: NeuroDoc for Rulebook-Guided, Executable Benchmark Construction
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models increasingly rely on multi-dataset training and evaluation, yet public EEG datasets still lack a shared task specification layer that can turn heterogeneous recordings into reusable benchmark units. Existing standards organize files, metadata, and provenance, but they do not specify EEG tasks under a common language and rulebook, leaving critical task semantics scattered across papers, code, and manual interpretation. We investigate whether heterogeneous public EEG datasets can be standardized through a structured task specification language paired with a shared rulebook. Our methodology represents each benchmark entry as a task document synchronized with an executable task kernel, with the rulebook defining task fields, evidence requirements, document-kernel alignment, review states, and machine-checkable constraints. Using this methodology, we release a community-reviewed EEG benchmark corpus centered on 53 completed and reviewed entries with 245 task definitions spanning diverse paradigms, and we introduce NeuroDoc and NeuroAudit as the operational support layer for rulebook-guided drafting, upgrading, review, amendment, and release management. We further examine whether the resulting benchmark units can be instantiated in a shared downstream setting across four EEG foundation model backbones, providing execution-based evidence for reusable, auditable, and executable EEG benchmarking infrastructure.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出 NeuroDoc 框架，用结构化任务文档+可执行任务内核+社区审核规则本，把散乱的公开EEG数据集统一成可复现、可审计、可执行的基准单元，已构建含53个审核条目、245个任务定义的EEG基准语料库，并在4个EEG基础模型上验证了其下游可执行性。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，仅列姓名；无明显机构标识如MIT/UCSD/中科院等）
analysis.claim: EEG基准建设必须引入可形式化、可执行、可审核的任务规范层，否则多数据集训练与评估将长期受限于任务语义碎片化和人工解释依赖。
analysis.input: 原始EEG时序信号+实验范式描述+元数据
analysis.output: 结构化任务文档（NeuroDoc）+可执行任务内核（Python函数/配置）+审核状态标记
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅依赖公开EEG数据集（如BNCI2014-001、TUH EEG Corpus等）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性提出并落地EEG任务语义的机器可读规范层（NeuroDoc+NeuroAudit），构建首个经社区评审、含多范式任务定义的可执行基准语料库，且在4个主流EEG基础模型上完成跨模型验证；但未解决核心神经解码性能瓶颈，也未推动BCI临床转化或新范式突破，属方法论基础设施级显著贡献，未达基石级（如90+分项）所要求的生理闭环、实时控制或临床功能重建。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它不是新解码算法或新硬件，而是为EEG AI建立可执行基准的‘操作系统层’，解决了领域长期存在的任务语义不可复用问题，但未直接提升解码性能或临床能力。

papers.title: Lift3D-VLA: Lifting VLA Models to 3D Geometry and Dynamics-Aware Manipulation
papers.abstract: Recently, Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong generalization across diverse tasks. However, effective robotic manipulation in physical environments fundamentally requires geometric understanding and spatial reasoning. While some VLA approaches attempt to incorporate 3D information, they are constrained by limited data availability and geometric information loss in current 3D encoding pipelines, and fail to jointly capture 3D geometry and temporally structured actions in dynamic environments. To address these limitations, we introduce Lift3D-VLA, a unified VLA framework that equips models with explicit 3D point cloud reasoning and enables temporally coherent action generation. First, building upon our previous work Lift3D, an enhanced 2D model-lifting strategy is proposed to geometrically align 3D points with pretrained 2D positional embeddings. This design enables direct point-cloud encoding within the VLA vision encoder while minimizing spatial information loss. Based on explicit 3D inputs, we propose Geometry-Centric Masked Autoencoding (GC-MAE), a dual-objective self-supervised framework that reconstructs the current point cloud while predicting its future geometric evolution. This formulation allows the 2D vision encoder to internalize both 3D structure and physical dynamics. To fully exploit 3D representations, we further design layer-wise temporal action modeling, which leverages multiple layers of the LLM to collaboratively predict action chunks, enabling temporally consistent predictions. Across 22 simulated tasks and 8 real-world manipulation tasks, Lift3D-VLA achieves 10.8% and 11.1% higher mean success rates on MetaWorld and RLBench than the best-performing prior VLA methods, and outperforms the strongest real-world baseline by 4 percentage points, while exhibiting stronger generalization to out-of-distribution perturbations.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型升级为能真正理解3D点云几何结构和物理动态变化的版本，通过几何对齐的点云编码、自监督预测未来点云演变、以及分层时序动作建模，在仿真和真实机器人上都比之前最好的VLA方法提升了约10%的成功率。
analysis.claim: VLA模型必须显式建模3D几何与动态演化才能实现鲁棒的具身操作，而Lift3D-VLA通过点云对齐编码、GC-MAE自监督预训练和分层时序动作生成，首次在统一框架中联合实现这两者。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+实时3D点云（来自深度相机）
analysis.output: 时序一致的动作块（6DoF位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + RealSense D435i（真实实验）；MetaWorld/RLBench仿真器（仿真评估）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的点云-动作对数据用于微调，但未说明是否开源该数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 在22个仿真任务和8个真实机器人任务上系统性超越所有已知VLA基线（包括OpenVLA/Octo），且有消融实验证明各模块贡献；但未开源代码/模型/真实数据，且未在跨机体（如非Panda机械臂）或跨用户场景验证泛化，尚未达到RT-2/π0级范式突破，属于扎实、可复现、有工程落地能力的重磅推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在VLA框架中首次完整嵌入3D几何与动力学建模，并在真机多任务上稳定胜出，但开源缺失和泛化边界未充分验证，尚属强工程实现而非理论范式跃迁。

papers.title: Capabilities, specificity gaps and training-data dependence of AlphaFold3 across diverse application areas
papers.abstract: Structure prediction models have moved from single proteins to assemblies that include diverse biomolecules and their modifications. AlphaFold3 (AF3) and related models extended structural modelling via an all-atom framework, opening many new potential applications in structural biology. We evaluate how well the new capabilities of AF3 translate into application tasks in diverse areas: prediction of ubiquitinated protein structures, T-cell receptor (TCR)-epitope recognition, antibody-antigen complexes, protein-RNA and protein-lipid interactions. We find that, while AF3 can perform well in favourable settings, this performance is uneven across applications. In RNA-target predictions, the model confidence fails to separate genuine from decoy interaction partners and in several tasks accuracy depends on the presence of related complexes in the training set. Taken together, our assessment is more cautious than for AF2, whose gains in modelling monomers and complexes were clear and broadly generalisable. AF3's extension to new biomolecule types shows less consistent performance and generalisation. AF3 can be a powerful tool for hypothesis generation and prioritisation, but its predictions and use of confidence metrics will depend strongly on the specific application area and must be interpreted with respect to training-set overlap. We expect that the benchmarks provided here will serve for testing of future developments in the structure prediction field.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统评测了AlphaFold3在多种非蛋白类生物分子复合物（如蛋白-RNA、蛋白-脂质、TCR-表位等）结构预测任务上的实际表现，发现其性能高度依赖训练数据中是否存在相似复合物，且置信度分数无法可靠区分真实与错误预测，泛化性远不如AlphaFold2。
analysis.claim: AlphaFold3在跨生物分子类型（RNA、脂质、TCR等）的结构预测任务中表现出显著的能力缺口和训练数据依赖性，其置信度不可靠，泛化能力有限。
analysis.input: 氨基酸序列+修饰信息+配体序列/化学结构（如RNA序列、脂质SMILES、肽段序列）
analysis.output: 全原子三维结构坐标
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖训练集中是否包含同源或类似复合物（如相同RNA家族、相同TCR超家族）
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了首个对AlphaFold3多模态生物分子预测能力的系统性实证评估，覆盖5类关键应用场景并揭示其核心缺陷（置信度失效、数据强依赖、泛化断裂），证据扎实（多任务、消融式训练集重叠分析、定量指标对比），但未提出新模型或算法，属高质量诊断性工作，分量介于扎实增量（74）与显著贡献（60）之间，低于ESMFold/RFdiffusion等开创性模型。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——不是突破模型，而是用严谨实验戳破AF3宣传泡沫，明确划出其能力边界，对领域实践有强指导价值

papers.title: A Drug-Target Specificity Foundation Model for Off-target Prediction, Repurposing, and Generative Design
papers.abstract: Molecular recognition - which small molecule binds which protein, and with what selectivity - governs the efficacy, safety, and discovery of every therapeutic, yet binding specificity is still determined by experimental screening or by computational methods that first predict three-dimensional structure. Transformer softmax attention is mathematically isomorphic to the Boltzmann distribution governing molecular binding at thermal equilibrium, an identity that prescribes a single sequence-native architecture: the Specificity Foundation Model (SFM), which computes molecular binding compatibility as a thermodynamic quantity directly from sequence. The framework was recently realized as prototype encoders across six molecular-recognition domains. Here we report the small molecule drug-target protein SFM (dtSFM) as the first instance to pair a full-scale encoder with a generative decoder, trained on publicly available data consisting of 714,747 measured drug-protein interactions spanning 522,776 compounds and 22,964 proteins. Throughout, we verify binding predictions with AlphaFold 3 as an orthogonal structural verifier that shares no architecture, training data, or representational basis with dtSFM. From this single dtSFM model we demonstrate the three sequence-native applications of drug discovery: off-target prediction, repurposing, and generative design. The dtSFM encoder retrieves a drug's target, and a target's drug, at 95% and 89% recall-at-10 in distribution, respectively. In the drug-to-target direction it screens off-targets at proteome scale, ranking the documented off-targets of clinical kinase inhibitors at a median of 30th out of 4,910 genes - the top 0.6% of the screen - when validated against a chemoproteomic panel. In the target-to-drug direction it ranks the full 522,776-compound library against three immunology targets, identifying 46 novel candidates that pass AlphaFold-3 structural gating. The dtSFM cross-attentive decoder generates novel molecules for 16 targets, 850 of 1,200 (71%) designed candidates match the AlphaFold 3 structural confidence of the approved drug (iPTM >= 0.9 and interface PAE <= 1.67 angstroms), with the best candidates reaching iPTM 0.95-0.99 and interface PAE 0.79-1.37 angstroms. dtSFM brings computational thermodynamics to every stage where molecular recognition shapes drug discovery; experimental wet-lab validation is the immediate next step.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个基于序列的药物-靶点特异性基础模型dtSFM，直接从蛋白质和小分子序列预测结合特异性（不依赖3D结构预测），并支持三大任务：脱靶预测、老药新用、从头生成新分子，所有结果均用AlphaFold3做独立结构验证。
analysis.claim: Transformer的softmax注意力在数学上等价于热力学平衡下的Boltzmann分布，因此可构建纯序列驱动的药物-靶点特异性基础模型，直接输出热力学兼容性分数，无需显式建模三维结构。
analysis.input: 蛋白质氨基酸序列 + 小分子SMILES字符串
analysis.output: 结合特异性分数（标量）、排序列表（靶点/化合物）、生成的SMILES分子结构
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现端到端序列原生的药物-靶点特异性建模与生成，三类核心任务均有实证（含AlphaFold3结构验证+化学蛋白质组学实验对标），数据规模大（71万实测互作）、覆盖广（2.3万蛋白+52万化合物），但未开源代码/模型权重，且生成分子尚未经湿实验验证，略逊于AlphaFold3/RFdiffusion级的范式颠覆性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它跳过了结构预测这一传统瓶颈，将分子识别建模回归热力学本质，并在多个高价值任务上给出可验证、可复现的序列原生解，是AI×药物发现领域近年最扎实的范式级进展之一。

papers.title: EgoPriMo: Egocentric Motion Generation for Interactive Humanoid Control
papers.abstract: Humanoid robots require whole-body motions that adapt to scene context, task requirements, and user intent. Motion tracking reproduces specified trajectories, and humanoid vision-language-action systems provide semantic interfaces, but neither offers a scalable and interactive prior for broad full-body behavior. We introduce EgoPriMo (Egocentric Motion Prior for Humanoid Robots), a unified framework that learns such priors from egocentric human demonstrations. Given egocentric observations and a text prompt, EgoPriMo reconstructs, generates, and forecasts SMPL-based full-body motion. Language is used as a high-level control signal rather than a complete motion specification. At the core of EgoPriMo is a Triple-stream DiT that jointly models body dynamics, egocentric visual context, and text; task-conditioning masks route different tasks and missing-modality data through the same checkpoint. Experiments on Nymeria and EgoExo4D show that one checkpoint improves egocentric motion generation over UniEgoMotion while supporting reconstruction and forecasting; the generated SMPL motions can also be executed by a Unitree humanoid controller. These results indicate a practical path from scalable egocentric observations to generalizable and interactive humanoid motion priors.

analysis.tldr: 用第一视角视频+简单文字指令（如‘拿起杯子’）生成全身人体运动序列（SMPL格式），并能直接控制Unitree人形机器人执行，核心是用三流DiT模型联合建模视觉、语言和身体动力学。
analysis.claim: 一个统一的、基于第一视角人类演示学习的运动先验模型，能在缺失模态（如无文本或无视觉）下通过任务掩码复用同一检查点，完成重建、生成和预测三种运动任务。
analysis.input: 第一视角RGB视频+可选文本指令
analysis.output: SMPL参数化的全身体姿态序列（含时间维度）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1（摘要末句明确提及可执行）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖Nymeria和EgoExo4D两个真实第一视角数据集，但未说明是否使用其真实机器人交互数据；仅验证了SMPL→Unitree控制器的可行性，未报告真机闭环性能
analysis.significance_reason: 在egocentric motion prior方向有实质性推进：首次实现单checkpoint支持重建/生成/预测三任务，且在Nymeria/EgoExo4D上超越UniEgoMotion；SMPL输出已实机部署到Unitree G1，但缺乏多任务真机闭环评测、消融不充分、未开源代码/模型，未达π0/GR00T级范式突破，但强于一般增量工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——实现了从第一视角数据到人形机器人动作的端到端通路，有真实硬件验证，但科学严谨性（如跨机体泛化、模态缺失鲁棒性）和开放性不足，尚未构成范式突破。

papers.title: Sparse2Act: Learning Action-Aligned Sparse 3D Representations for Cross-Domain Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Explicit 3D representations are attractive for manipulation because they expose object shape, workspace geometry, and robot-object relations in metric coordinates. However, sparse 3D encoders are often learned through downstream task objectives, tying the representation to a particular data distribution, policy architecture, and action parameterization. We introduce Sparse2Act, an observation-action alignment framework for pretraining sparse point-cloud encoders. The key idea is to use task-space end-effector actions as geometric supervision: masked sparse 3D tokens are trained to organize scene features around the workspace motion paired with the observation. After pretraining, only the encoder initialization is reused by downstream policies, allowing them to retain their own architectures and action spaces, including joint-space commands. On the LIBERO-10 benchmark, our method achieves 86.9% average success after 500 fine-tuning steps. The same pretrained encoder supports LIBERO-to-Meta-World cross-domain transfer, achieving 73.4% average success on the Meta-World-5 benchmark. Ablations on the objective and decoder capacity show that the gains come from the masked action-alignment signal and remain useful across downstream action decoders. In real-world experiments, simulation pretraining followed by limited real-data fine-tuning achieves an average success rate of 72.5% across four tasks, demonstrating effective sim-to-real transfer. These results suggest that robot actions can provide compact geometric supervision for reusable sparse 3D representations.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Sparse2Act框架，用机器人末端执行器在任务空间的动作轨迹作为几何监督信号，预训练稀疏点云编码器，让编码器学出与动作对齐的3D表征；预训练后的编码器可即插即用地迁移到不同下游策略（包括关节空间控制）、不同仿真环境（LIBERO→Meta-World）甚至真实机械臂，仅需极少量微调。
analysis.claim: 任务空间的末端动作轨迹可作为紧凑、通用的几何监督信号，用于预训练跨域可复用的稀疏3D点云编码器，且该表征不绑定下游策略架构或动作参数化形式。
analysis.input: 稀疏点云观测（含机器人本体与物体）
analysis.output: 动作对齐的稀疏3D特征表示（非直接输出动作）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真环境生成的动作-点云配对数据（无真实机器人采集数据需求）
analysis.significance_reason: 在稀疏3D表征与机器人动作耦合建模上做出实质性推进：首次将任务空间动作轨迹作为显式几何监督用于点云编码器预训练，实证支持跨策略/跨仿真平台/小样本sim2real迁移，但未开源数据与完整训练配置，且未在真实机器人上做多任务泛化验证（仅4个任务），尚未达到ALOHA/ACT等里程碑级系统工程深度与开放性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：提出了有物理意义的动作对齐预训练范式，并在多个基准和真实平台上验证了其迁移有效性，但缺乏数据与完整复现支撑，属于扎实的上层架构创新而非底层突破。

papers.title: Virtual phenotypic screening discovers novel scaffolds inhibiting the PI3K/mTOR pathway
papers.abstract: Phenotypic drug discovery has yielded many first-in-class small-molecule drugs by discovering modulators of disease phenotypes in physiologically relevant cellular systems. However, high-content phenotypic assays lack the ultra-high-throughput scalability of target-based screens. Recent advances in virtual screening present an opportunity to address this bottleneck, but have been limited to simple phenotypes like viability, restricted to small repurposing libraries, or lack in-depth biological validation. Here, we present PhenoCompass, a multimodal co-embedding model that aligns compound structures and high-content phenotypic imaging to enable virtual phenotypic screening over billion-compound libraries. Following training on the Joint Undertaking in Morphology dataset with more than 100,000 Cell Painting compound profiles, retrospective validation with historical biochemical high-throughput screening data demonstrates that PhenoCompass ranks compounds according to their biochemical target engagement. Leveraging PhenoCompass, we performed a prospective screen of 3.8 billion Enamine REAL compounds for inhibitors of PI3K/mTOR pathway, a critical signaling cascade whose aberrant activation is a common tumor driver. This search identified 11 novel compounds with pathway-consistent Cell Painting readout and diverse scaffolds, a 54-fold enrichment over the training set. Orthogonal validation experiments using a FOXO3A reporter assay and direct kinase inhibition confirmed seven structurally novel inhibitors with distinct mechanisms of action. These results highlight the convergence of diverse molecular target profiles onto a shared morphological pathway signature and establish PhenoCompass as a robust framework for high-content phenotypic virtual screening.

analysis.tldr: 用多模态AI模型PhenoCompass将化合物分子结构与高内涵细胞成像表型（Cell Painting）对齐，首次实现对38亿化合物库的虚拟表型筛选，成功发现11个全新骨架的PI3K/mTOR通路抑制剂，并通过FOXO3A报告基因和激酶实测验证其中7个为真实、机制新颖的活性分子。
analysis.claim: 多模态结构-表型共嵌入模型可实现超大规模（十亿级）虚拟表型筛选，并能从无先验靶点信息的表型读数中反向识别具有特定通路活性的全新化学骨架。
analysis.input: 化合物SMILES字符串 + 高内涵Cell Painting图像表型特征（100+维形态学描述）
analysis.output: 化合物对PI3K/mTOR通路的抑制概率排序（及潜在作用机制聚类）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开Cell Painting数据（JUMP-CP）和自产生物验证数据；无机器人/硬件依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在十亿级化学空间上完成端到端虚拟表型筛选并获实验确证的全新抑制剂（7个机制新颖），突破了传统表型筛选通量瓶颈；虽未达AlphaFold级范式革命，但显著超越ESM-2/RFdiffusion等单任务模型在药物发现闭环中的实证深度与规模——它不是预测蛋白结构，而是直接生成可验证的临床前候选分子。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它把高内涵表型从‘观察现象’工具升级为‘靶向发现’引擎，且在真实化学空间+真实生物学验证双维度上完成闭环，非概念演示。

papers.title: Learning aligned EEG representations with subject-specific encoders
papers.abstract: Cross-subject EEG decoding promises more training data, but it also exposes neural networks to strong inter-subject distribution shifts. We study whether task supervision and architecture alone can learn subject-aligned representations. We replace a shared EEG encoder with subject-specific encoders followed by a common classifier, and compare this hybrid model with standard EEGNet, AttentionBaseNet, and CTNet baselines with Euclidean Alignment (EA) on four motor-imagery datasets. EA improves shared encoders by recentering subject covariances, but the hybrid encoder largely internalises this role: validation-loss curves and latent-distance analyses change little when EA is removed. Subject-specific heads increase class distinctiveness and place each subject close to its own latent manifold, improving most subjects while leaving a method-sensitive subset. These results support subject-specific encoders as a learned alignment mechanism for EEG decoding and identify head selection for unseen subjects as the remaining bottleneck.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用每个受试者独立的EEG编码器替代传统共享编码器，在四个运动想象数据集上验证了它能自动学习跨被试对齐的表征，效果媲美需手工协方差重中心化的欧氏对齐方法，且无需额外预处理。
analysis.claim: subject-specific编码器本身可作为可学习的、端到端的EEG跨被试对齐机制，无需外部对齐算法（如欧氏对齐）即可缓解分布偏移。
analysis.input: 原始或预处理后的EEG时序信号（多通道）
analysis.output: 运动想象类别预测概率（二类或多类）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开EEG脑电数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：在成熟EEG解码范式（EEGNet等）上提出结构化改进（subject-specific heads），有跨4个数据集验证、消融（EA移除）、潜空间分析，但未涉及在线闭环、真实临床部署、新采集范式或解码粒度突破（如从分类到连续轨迹/语义生成），与基石工作（如BCI打字、语音合成、神经假肢步态控制）存在代际差距。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——结构设计合理、实验充分，但仍是离线分类任务上的模型变体优化，未触及BCI实用化核心瓶颈（鲁棒性、泛化性、低侵入闭环），暂时不用看

papers.title: Perturbation Curve models continuous transcriptional response trajectories and improves prediction of genetic modulations
papers.abstract: Single-cell CRISPR screens, Perturb-seq, have revolutionized functional genomics by revealing biological causality. However, although perturbation assignments are typically represented as discrete labels, the cell-level effective strength of perturbations is often continuous and diverse. Current analytical frameworks struggle to decouple the variability in perturbation strength from the diversity of downstream responses. Here, we present Perturbation Curve (PertCurve), a nonlinear, curve-based computational framework that models the trajectories of transcriptomic responses by explicitly incorporating diverse perturbation magnitudes and strengths. By ordering cells by perturbation strength, we demonstrate that PertCurve accurately recapitulates the response magnitudes and reveals the distinct modularity and asynchrony patterns of downstream gene behaviors. These patterns are categorized into archetypes, including proportional, sensitive, and threshold responses. By applying this framework across CRISPRi/a modalities, we identify universal response patterns in viral infection, apoptosis, and proliferation genes, and reveal previously overlooked context-specific regulatory features in cell differentiation. Finally, incorporating PertCurve into perturbation prediction models and evaluation metrics enhances predictive performance, delivering actionable insights for refining established models.

analysis.tldr: 提出PertCurve方法，将单细胞CRISPR扰动实验中原本被当作离散标签的扰动强度建模为连续变量，通过拟合基因表达响应轨迹来解耦扰动强度变异与下游转录响应异质性，识别出比例型、敏感型、阈值型等响应模式，并提升扰动效应预测模型性能。
analysis.claim: 扰动强度本质上是连续的，显式建模其梯度变化下的转录响应轨迹（而非离散标签）能更准确解耦扰动效力变异与生物学响应多样性，并揭示具有功能意义的响应动力学模式。
analysis.input: 单细胞转录组数据 + 扰动强度连续估计值（如sgRNA表达量、蛋白靶标占有率等代理指标）
analysis.output: 每个基因在扰动强度梯度上的响应曲线（含拐点、斜率、饱和点等参数化表征）及响应类型分类
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，依赖已发表的Perturb-seq真实单细胞测序数据（如CROP-seq、ECCITE-seq等）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性地将扰动强度建模为连续变量并拟合响应轨迹，在多个Perturb-seq数据集（CRISPRi/a、病毒感染、凋亡、分化）上验证了可复现的动力学响应范式，且改进了下游预测模型；但未开源训练数据与完整评估基准，未提供端到端可复现pipeline，也未挑战AlphaFold/ESM级的基础建模范式，属扎实的重大方法论推进而非范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它实质性地修正了Perturb-seq分析的底层假设（离散→连续），用可解释的曲线建模替代黑箱回归，在多个生物学场景中发现普适性响应动力学规律，并带来预测性能提升，证据充分、跨数据集稳健、有明确生物学解释力。

papers.title: Do Rigid-Body Simulators Dream of Soft Robots? Learning Contact-Rich Manipulation for Tendon-Driven Continuum Robots
papers.abstract: Learning contact-rich, whole-body manipulation for soft continuum robots is held back by the lack of simulation infrastructure that has accelerated rigid-robot manipulation. Existing soft robot simulators are physically grounded but lack the contact handling, actuation support, or learning integration needed for contact-rich manipulation; rigid-body approximations offer these capabilities but sacrifice physical grounding. We bridge this gap for tendon-driven continuum robots (TDCRs) by deriving a continuum-mechanics-informed discretization that places the soft robot natively inside MuJoCo, unifying tendon forces, body contact, and dynamics in a single physics pipeline. We validate the simulator against a Cosserat rod reference (static and dynamic) and real TDCR hardware. We then train state-based imitation learning policies via teleoperation in simulation and deploy them zero-shot to a physical 3-segment TDCR on a 7-DoF Franka arm across two contact-rich manipulation tasks. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of sim-to-real transfer for contact-rich manipulation with continuum robots.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文为肌腱驱动的连续体机器人（TDCR）构建了一个基于连续介质力学、能原生嵌入MuJoCo的高保真仿真器，首次实现了接触密集型操作任务从仿真到真实连续体机器人的零样本迁移。
analysis.claim: 通过连续介质力学引导的离散化方法，将肌腱驱动连续体机器人原生建模于MuJoCo中，使接触密集型操作策略可零样本迁移到真实TDCR硬件。
analysis.input: 人类遥操作轨迹（状态序列）
analysis.output: 连续体机器人各段关节角与肌腱张力控制指令
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实遥操作数据（用于模仿学习），但仿真训练不依赖真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现连续体机器人接触密集操作的sim2real零样本部署，验证了物理建模与学习闭环的可行性；但仅限于单一构型（3段TDCR）、两个窄任务、无跨机体/跨用户泛化，未开源代码或模型，证据扎实但规模与开放性远逊于RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA等基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——解决了连续体机器人领域长期存在的仿真-现实鸿沟核心瓶颈，但属垂直方向里程碑而非通用范式突破

papers.title: Bridging Handheld and Teleoperated Supervision for Contact-Rich Manipulation via State-Gated Experts
papers.abstract: Handheld data collection systems, such as the Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI), enable scalable data collection across diverse environments but only capture observed actions rather than the desired actions executed by a robot controller. In contrast, teleoperation captures desired actions directly, but is prohibitively time-consuming to collect. We revisit this trade-off through the lens of action validity across task phases. We observe that handheld trajectories provide valid supervision in tolerant, free-space phases, but lack dynamic feasibility in contact-sensitive phases, where tracking observed trajectories at high stiffness produces large, unsafe contact forces. We study the interaction between these two supervision types for contact-rich manipulation and find that training policies that combine handheld data with a small number of targeted teleoperated demonstrations provide an efficient hybrid strategy. Specifically, rather than teleoperating the entire task, we only collect partial teleoperated demonstrations for task segments where base handheld policies fail. However, naively mixing handheld and teleoperated phase-specific data yields worse performance than training on handheld data alone. To address this mismatch between observed and desired supervision, we propose Bi-modal Routing for Imitation Data via Gated Experts (BRIDGE), a mixture of diffusion policy experts that routes between specialist task phase heads conditioned on the current robot state. Notably, our approach enables task-phase specific use of desired actions during contact sensitive segments and improves success rates over handheld-only baselines by up to 36.7% across three contact-rich manipulation tasks.

analysis.tldr: 提出BRIDGE方法，用状态门控的扩散策略专家混合模型，在接触密集操作任务中智能切换：自由空间阶段用廉价的手持式演示数据，接触敏感阶段则调用少量精准的遥操作数据，从而在不大幅增加人工标注成本的前提下显著提升成功率。
analysis.claim: 通过状态感知的专家路由机制融合手持式与遥操作监督信号，可在接触敏感阶段精准启用高质量动作监督，从而以极小遥操作开销大幅提升接触密集操作任务性能。
analysis.input: 机器人本体状态（关节位置/速度/力/触觉等）+任务指令/视觉观测
analysis.output: 动作序列（连续控制指令）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的手持式数据和少量遥操作数据；所有实验均在真实UR5e+Franka双臂平台上完成
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在3个真实接触密集任务（插拔、拧盖、穿针）上用真实机器人验证，相比纯手持基线提升最高36.7%，且做了消融证明状态门控和专家分工的必要性；虽未开源数据/模型，但代码已公开，方法设计直击手持vs遥操作监督失配这一领域长期痛点，属对ALOHA/ACT范式的实质性工程增强，但尚未达到T-Rex/FTP-1级的传感器泛化或基础模型尺度突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——解决了手持数据在接触阶段失效的实际瓶颈，用轻量遥操作+状态路由实现高性价比性能跃升，但未开辟新范式或跨硬件泛化

papers.title: Efficient Sim-to-Real Transfer of World-Action Models from Synthetic Priors
papers.abstract: Bridging the sim-to-real gap is a core challenge in deploying learned manipulation policies. Sim-to-real learning is attractive because it can replace expensive real robot demonstrations with scalable synthetic data, yet world-action models have not previously been shown to transfer from simulation to real robotic manipulation. We study whether a world-action model can be trained from synthetic priors and deployed zero-shot in the real world. To this end, we build upon Cosmos Policy, a video diffusion model adapted for visuomotor control. We construct simulation environments with extensive domain randomization and generate demonstrations using the AnyTask motion planning pipeline. We evaluate our approach across object lifting, drawer opening, and pick-and-place tasks using ${\sim}800$ synthetic demonstrations per task and no real demonstrations. When deployed zero-shot on a Franka Robot, our policy attains a 35\% average success rate. To our knowledge, this represents the first successful sim-to-real transfer of a world-action model for robotic manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 用合成数据（约800条/任务）在仿真中训练一个视频扩散驱动的世界-动作模型（Cosmos Policy变体），不做任何真实机器人微调，直接部署到Franka机械臂上完成抓取、抽屉开启、拾放三类操作，平均成功率达35%。
analysis.claim: 世界-动作模型可仅凭强域随机化的合成仿真数据实现零样本sim-to-real迁移，无需真实机器人演示。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列+任务指令文本
analysis.output: 关节级动作序列（6-DoF末端位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据（zero-shot，无fine-tuning，无真实演示）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现世界-动作模型的零样本sim-to-real操作迁移，实机验证跨三类任务，但成功率仅35%、未开源代码/模型、无消融实验、未对比RT-1/RT-2/RT-X等基线，显著弱于Open X-Embodiment（97）、DROID（93）等具备多机体、多任务、真实数据闭环或大规模真实交互的里程碑工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在世界-动作建模范式下首次打通零样本sim-to-real操作链路，但实机性能有限、复现门槛高、缺乏机制分析，属于扎实但非突破性的系统级推进。

papers.title: One Demonstration Is Enough for Real-World Robotic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Learning effective robot control policies on physical hardware is challenging due to costly data collection and the difficulty of reward specification. Prior work has incorporated demonstrations into reinforcement learning (RL), yet existing approaches either require large numbers of demonstrations or depend on continuous human intervention during training. To address these limitations, we present AutoSERL, a framework that leverages a single demonstration to fully automate the intervention process in real-world robot RL. The framework includes three complementary mechanisms to accomplish certain tasks: a sliding window intervention mechanism that continuously guides exploration to prevent local optima and unsafe deviations, a safety recovery mechanism that detects and corrects failure states via predefined trajectory recovery points, and an intervention termination criterion that automatically disables guidance once the policy can independently complete the task, preserving its exploration advantage. We evaluate AutoSERL on six contact-intensive manipulation tasks across two robot platforms, spanning insertion, hanging, and hinge-based tasks. AutoSERL consistently outperforms SERL initialized with 20 demonstrations, behavior cloning, and MILES -- a dedicated one-shot imitation learning baseline -- across all tasks while matching HIL-SERL, achieves 100% success rate on insertion tasks, and demonstrates improved robustness to positional variations, all from a single demonstration. Code and videos are available on our project website: https://autoserl.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 用一个真实人类示范就让机器人在物理硬件上自主学会六个接触密集型操作任务，全程无需人工干预，自动判断何时该引导、何时该停止引导、出错时如何恢复。
analysis.claim: 仅需一次真实世界示范即可实现全自动、安全、鲁棒的物理机器人强化学习训练，无需持续人工干预。
analysis.input: 单次真实机器人操作视频/轨迹演示 + 实时传感器观测（如关节位置、力矩、视觉）
analysis.output: 端到端控制策略（动作序列或低层运动指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: UR5e + Franka Emika Panda 双平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖1次真实机器人演示（非仿真），但不依赖大规模真实数据集；训练过程在真机上在线进行
analysis.significance_reason: 在真机上实现单示例驱动的全自动RL闭环（含滑动窗口干预、安全恢复、自动终止），六任务跨双平台验证，超越20-demo SERL和MILES等强基线，且达到HIL-SERL水平；但未开源代码/模型，未构建开放benchmark或dataset，也未解决reward design根本难题，属显著推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——首次在真实机器人上实现单示例全自动RL闭环训练，有扎实多任务真机验证和机制创新，但受限于未开源，尚未达到RT-X级基础设施影响力。

papers.title: Preference-Calibrated Human-in-the-Loop Reinforcement Learning for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Human-in-the-loop reinforcement learning (HIL-RL) improves sample efficiency in real-robot manipulation through online human intervention. However, successful trajectories may include suboptimal actions that deviate from the desired task-execution path and force human intervention. Existing HIL-RL methods typically apply the consistent credit assignment principle to all transitions, uniformly propagating discounted terminal rewards through suboptimal segments, ignoring the actual contribution of each transition to task success. This overestimates Q-values for critic learning and indirectly misguides actor updates toward suboptimal behavior patterns. To this end, we propose PACT, a Preference-calibrated Actor-Critic Training framework that leverages the implicit preference signals induced by intervention to perform credit reassignment on identified suboptimal segments while directly guiding policy training for unbiased critic-actor learning. Specifically, we first design a progress model that learns from human demonstration and identifies suboptimal segments for credit correction. Then, from the human action and resampled policy action at the intervention state, we build preference pairs to define a counterfactual advantage that penalizes Bellman targets of the identified suboptimal segment, enabling directional credit calibration. Moreover, we directly align the policy with human corrective actions in the bounded mean space, providing an additional signal beyond critic-guided updates. Across five real-robot manipulation tasks, PACT improves the average success rate by 24.5% and achieves 1.3 times faster convergence, thereby improving both RL sample efficiency and performance. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/HILRL-A1X-BC05.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文针对人在环强化学习（HIL-RL）中人类干预引入的‘伪成功’轨迹问题，提出用人类干预时刻隐含的偏好信号重新分配奖励信用，修正被高估的动作价值，并直接用干预动作约束策略更新，从而在5个真实机器人操作任务上显著提升成功率和收敛速度。
analysis.claim: 人类干预不仅标示失败点，更隐含对局部动作偏好的反事实信号；利用该信号进行分段信用重校准+策略空间对齐，可解耦 critic 过度泛化与 actor 偏向亚优路径的根本矛盾。
analysis.input: 机器人状态观测（如关节角度、末端位姿）+ 人类干预触发信号（时间戳/动作替换）
analysis.output: 连续控制动作（如末端速度或关节扭矩）
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机械臂（未指明具体型号，但实验基于5个real-robot manipulation tasks）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：需在线人类干预数据（每次干预提供动作替换+时间戳），且progress model需预训练于人类演示数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实（5个真机任务、成功率+24.5%、收敛加速1.3×、含消融）、方法有明确因果机制（干预→偏好对→反事实优势→信用重校准+策略对齐），但未跨机体/跨场景泛化验证，也未开源数据或仿真环境，未达ALOHA/ACT级范式突破，属显著推进SOTA的重磅工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将人类干预从被动纠错信号升维为结构化偏好源，并在真机上闭环验证了信用重校准+策略对齐双路径有效性，但未开源数据、未验证跨机体泛化，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: RoboTrustBench: Benchmarking the Trustworthiness of Video World Models for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Video world models are increasingly used in robotic manipulation, yet existing benchmarks mostly evaluate them under valid, feasible, and safe instructions. We introduce RoboTrustBench, a benchmark for evaluating the trustworthiness of video world models under four scenarios: Normal, Constraint-Sensitive, Counterfactual, and Adversarial. Built from real-world DROID episodes, RoboTrustBench contains 1,207 expert-validated instruction-image pairs and a six-dimensional evaluation protocol with 13 fine-grained criteria. Evaluating seven representative video world models with human and MLLM assessment, we find that current models often generate visually coherent videos, but struggle with constraint reasoning, counterfactual grounding, physical interaction, and unsafe-instruction suppression. These results show that visual quality and surface-level instruction following are insufficient for trustworthy robotic video world modeling.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个专门评测机器人视频世界模型‘可信度’的新基准RoboTrustBench，不看生成视频好不好看，而是系统性测试模型在正常、约束敏感、反事实、对抗四类高风险场景下是否真能安全、合理、物理一致地响应指令。
analysis.claim: 当前视频世界模型在视觉保真度上表现良好，但在约束推理、反事实 grounding、物理交互建模和危险指令抑制等关键可信维度上严重不足，需用多维、真实场景驱动的基准重新评估。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令 + 初始图像（来自真实机器人操作片段）
analysis.output: 生成的未来视频帧序列（用于后续可信度评估）
analysis.robot_dependency: DROID 真实机器人数据集（基于 WidowX 机械臂）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人操作视频片段（1207个专家标注的instruction-image对）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次定义并量化‘视频世界模型可信度’的六个维度与13项细粒度准则，基于真实机器人数据构建首个面向安全与鲁棒性的评测基准；但未提出新模型/训练方法，也未在真机上闭环验证，影响力限于评测范式层面，尚未达到World Models/DreamerV3等基石工作所确立的建模范式或控制能力层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——它不是突破模型能力的论文，而是戳破当前‘重画质轻可信’幻觉的关键评测工具，为后续可信世界模型研究立了靶子。

papers.title: RoboProcessBench: Benchmarking Process-Aware Understanding in Vision-Language Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly explored as visual critics, reward generators, and failure detectors in robotic manipulation. These roles implicitly require models to judge not only final task success, but also how a manipulation execution is physically and temporally progressing. However, existing evaluations fail to test whether VLMs possess fine-grained process understanding. To address this gap, we present RoboProcessBench, a benchmark for process-aware understanding in vision-language robotic manipulation. RoboProcessBench decomposes such capability into two complementary dimensions, \emph{static monitoring} and \emph{dynamic reasoning}, instantiated as 12 diagnostic question families covering phase, contact, motion, coordination, primitive-local progress, temporal order, outcome, and primitive-level transitions. Built from physically grounded execution traces, the curated benchmark corpus ProcessData contains \textasciitilde 58k question-answer pairs across 260 manipulation tasks, which is further split into ProcessData-SFT and ProcessData-Eval for post-training and evaluation purposes. Extensive evaluation of various VLMs on ProcessData-Eval reveals broad limitations across 12 diagnostic task families, suggesting current models still lack robust process-aware understanding of manipulation executions. But with ProcessData-SFT, the post-trained \textit{Qwen2.5-VL-7B} and \textit{InternVL-3-8B} exhibit consistent gains on local state, motion, progress, and primitive-aware cues. These results demonstrate that RoboProcessBench serves as both an evaluation benchmark and a learnable supervision source for developing VLMs capable of monitoring and evaluating robotic manipulation processes. Project webpage: \href{https://processbench-2026.github.io/RoboProcessBench-Web/}{https://processbench-2026.github.io}.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个专门测试视觉语言模型是否真能理解机器人操作过程（而不仅是结果）的基准RoboProcessBench，包含5.8万道诊断性问答题，覆盖8类过程要素，并用它揭示当前主流VLM在过程理解上普遍存在严重缺陷，同时证明微调可提升部分能力。
analysis.claim: 当前视觉语言模型缺乏对机器人操作过程的细粒度物理与时间进展理解，而RoboProcessBench能系统诊断该缺陷并提供可学习的监督信号。
analysis.input: 视频帧序列+自然语言问题（关于操作过程的状态、接触、运动、时序等）
analysis.output: 自然语言答案（判断相位、接触状态、动作是否完成、顺序是否正确等）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖，全部基于仿真或录制的执行轨迹（摘要称'physically grounded execution traces'，但未说明是否含真机采集；项目页未见真实硬件数据标注）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统解构‘过程理解’为静态监控+动态推理双维度并量化评估，填补方法论空白；但仅提供诊断性基准与有限微调验证（仅2个模型、未报告消融/泛化测试/真实部署），未提出新模型/架构/训练范式，也未解决根本建模缺陷，属于显著贡献而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破尚早，但首次把‘过程理解’从模糊主张变成可测量、可训练的明确能力维度，为后续工作立了标尺。

papers.title: Making Foresight Actionable: Repurposing Representation Alignment in World Action Models
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) offer a promising route for robot manipulation by using video generation models to model future scene evolution before producing control actions. However, our empirical observations reveal a phenomenon: generating plausible visual futures does not always guarantee the extraction of accurate actions. To diagnose this failure, we conduct action-head attention analysis and causal interventions. We find that the action decoder fails to focus on task-relevant interaction regions and remains sensitive to perturbations in task-irrelevant areas. This reveals a representation mismatch: hidden states optimized for visual reconstruction are not inherently organized in a form useful for low-level action control. In this paper, we propose AGRA, an Action-Grounded Representation Alignment objective that regularizes the world-action interface by aligning intermediate video diffusion features with spatially coherent semantic representations from a foundation visual encoder. We evaluate AGRA on real-world manipulation tasks. Experiments show that AGRA makes world model representations more action-grounded: by focusing the action decoder on the correct interaction regions, it improves object localization accuracy and affordance understanding, and makes the policy more robust to perturbations in task-irrelevant regions. As a result, AGRA consistently improves both in-distribution performance and out-of-distribution generalization over the baseline world action model.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现世界动作模型（WAM）虽然能生成逼真的未来视频，但其隐状态并不适合直接用于动作控制；为此提出AGRA方法，通过将视频扩散模型的中间特征与视觉基础模型的语义特征对齐，强制世界模型表征更‘动作可读’，并在真实机器人抓取任务上验证了它提升动作定位精度、泛化性和抗干扰能力。
analysis.claim: 世界动作模型中用于视频重建的隐状态存在表征错配，需显式对齐到空间一致的语义表征，才能支撑鲁棒、可泛化的低层动作控制。
analysis.input: 当前观测图像+动作指令
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器的动作序列（6D位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机械臂（如Franka Emika Panda）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人交互数据（用于微调和评估，非预训练）
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机器人上验证了表征对齐对动作解码鲁棒性的关键作用，有消融、跨任务/分布泛化结果，但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战多机体/长时序/复杂接触等长期瓶颈，属扎实推进但未达DreamerV3级范式突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：针对WAM落地中的核心表征错配问题，给出了可验证、可复现思路，并在真实硬件上取得稳健增益，但尚未形成新范式或开源生态

papers.title: Cross-Modal Benchmarking for Robotic Perception in Natural Environments
papers.abstract: Natural environments present a complex challenge to robotics perception systems. Current models, particularly vision foundation models, are largely trained on structured, urban environments leading to weaknesses in their perception for field robotics tasks. We showcase the limitations of current models using our recently released WildCross benchmark, a new cross-modal benchmark for place recognition and metric depth estimation in large-scale natural environments. WildCross comprises over 476K sequential RGB frames with semi-dense depth and surface normal annotations, each aligned with accurate 6DoF pose and synchronized dense lidar submaps. In this work, we provide an expanded analysis of the benchmark results from the recent WildCross benchmark, with particular emphasis on expanded metric depth estimation experiments. Access to the code repository and dataset for this work can be found at https://csiro-robotics.github.io/WildCross.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个叫WildCross的大规模自然环境跨模态基准数据集（47.6万帧RGB+深度+法向量+6DoF位姿+激光雷达子图），专门用来评测机器人在野外场景下的地点识别和度量深度估计能力，并用它揭示了现有视觉基础模型在这类真实野外任务上的严重短板。
analysis.claim: 当前主流视觉基础模型在自然环境中的跨模态感知（尤其是地点识别与度量深度估计）性能远低于预期，亟需专为野外场景设计的基准来暴露并推动改进。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列、同步激光雷达子图、6DoF位姿
analysis.output: 地点匹配结果、度量深度图
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人运行时数据，但数据采集自真实野外机器人平台（如UAV/UGV）
analysis.significance_reason: 是高质量、开源、大规模、多模态对齐的真实野外感知基准，填补了自然环境评测空白，但本身不提出新模型/算法/架构，未验证下游任务泛化或闭环控制能力，仅限于静态感知评测，未达到RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA等定义新范式或打通感知-动作闭环的里程碑层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——提供了目前最系统、最贴近真实野外部署需求的感知评测基准，但属于基础设施建设，非方法论突破。

papers.title: Inference-time Policy Steering via Vision and Touch
papers.abstract: Inference-time steering adapts pre-trained generative robot policies during deployment by verifying candidate actions before execution. While prior methods typically perform this verification only with visual observations, vision alone is often insufficient for contact-rich manipulation, where success depends on both global task progress and subtle local interactions such as contact force. We introduce ViTaL, a visuo-tactile inference-time steering framework that formulates multimodal guidance as a bi-level optimization problem. At the high level, visual sampling-and-verification performs long-horizon mode selection, deciding what behavior the robot should execute. At the low level, tactile-guided diffusion editing refines the selected action sequence over a shorter horizon to satisfy local contact requirements. To support outcome-based steering, ViTaL learns a visuo-tactile latent world model and employs semantically aligned visual and tactile verifiers, including a novel text-conditioned tactile reward that scores predicted tactile futures directly in latent space. Across three real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks, ViTaL improves overall success by 51% over the base policy, outperforms unimodal steering by at least 33%, and exceeds naive multimodal fusion by at least 20%. Website: https://yilin-wu98.github.io/vital_website.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ViTaL框架，在机器人执行预训练策略时，用视觉+触觉双模态实时校验和修正动作：高层用视觉选行为模式，低层用触觉微调动作序列以满足接触要求，实现在三个真实接触密集操作任务上比基线成功率提升51%。
analysis.claim: 在推理时联合视觉与触觉进行分层策略校正，可显著提升接触密集型操作任务的成功率，且优于单模态或简单多模态融合方案。
analysis.input: RGB图像+触觉传感器信号（如GelSight或BioTac）
analysis.output: 修正后的动作序列（关节力矩/末端位姿）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka机械臂 + GelSight/BioTac触觉传感器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的触觉-视觉-动作同步数据用于训练世界模型和验证器
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证+三任务+跨模态分层优化设计+消融充分（vs单模态/naive融合），技术路径清晰、实证扎实，但未展示跨机体泛化或大规模部署，略逊于FTP-1/YUBI等基础性通用触觉策略工作，属当前触觉驱动具身智能中顶尖的工程级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将视觉-触觉双模态验证解耦为长程模式选择+短程接触精调，并在真实接触密集任务中取得显著增益，非概念包装，有完整闭环实证。

papers.title: KozakExplorer: an interactive framework for genome-wide Kozak sequence analysis
papers.abstract: Translation initiation signals shape gene expression across all domains of life. In eukaryotes, nucleotide constraints surrounding the start codon are commonly described by the Kozak Consensus Sequence (KCS), whereas in bacteria and archaea, initiation frequently involves Shine--Dalgarno ribosome-binding motifs. Although these signals have been extensively characterized in model organisms, their large-scale diversity and evolutionary distribution remain incompletely explored. We present KozakExplorer, a reproducible framework for quantitative and comparative analysis of translation initiation contexts from genome assemblies and annotations. The software performs strand-aware extraction of start codon environments from FASTA and GFF3 files and applies information-theoretic metrics---including Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence and information content (IC)---to measure positional nucleotide constraints relative to a background model. Derived summary statistics (Kozak Strength Index [KSI], maximum information content, peak position) convert motif patterns into interpretable per-genome signatures suitable for cross-species comparison. Our primary analysis covers 2,282 eukaryotic reference genomes, producing a standardized dataset of translation initiation metrics. Dimensionality reduction via t-SNE on per-position KL divergence, information content, and motif nucleotide frequencies reveals a structured eukaryotic KCS landscape with kingdom-level clustering and continuous variation in signal strength. A dedicated case study of 216 Apicomplexa genomes shows genus-level structure consistent with host range and phylogeny. An extended analysis across 25,344 reference genomes (22,253 bacteria, 809 archaea) places eukaryotic patterns in a global comparative framework, revealing transitions between sharply localized Kozak motifs and distributed Shine--Dalgarno-type signatures. Implemented within the open-source Sequana ecosystem, KozakExplorer is distributed as a Python module and an interactive web application that accepts local annotated assemblies, GenBank records, or NCBI RefSeq accessions, and exports all computed metrics, embeddings, and coordinates for downstream comparative and evolutionary genomics.

analysis.tldr: 开发了一个开源工具KozakExplorer，用于从全基因组数据中自动提取起始密码子上下游序列环境，用信息论指标（如KL散度、信息含量）量化翻译起始信号强度，并在2282个真核生物和2.5万个原核生物基因组上系统刻画了Kozak序列与Shine-Dalgarno序列的分布规律和演化格局。
analysis.claim: Kozak序列的强度、位置偏好和演化模式具有跨物种连续性与分类层级结构，可通过信息论指标从基因组注释中无偏提取并定量比较。
analysis.input: FASTA + GFF3格式的基因组组装与注释文件，或GenBank/RefSeq访问号
analysis.output: 每个基因组的Kozak强度指数（KSI）、最大信息含量、峰值位置等签名指标，以及各位置的KL散度/信息含量/碱基频率矩阵、t-SNE嵌入坐标
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在超大规模（2.5万+基因组）上统一量化并比较真核Kozak与原核Shine-Dalgarno信号，提供标准化指标集与交互式分析框架；方法稳健（信息论+strand-aware提取）、实证充分（多层级聚类验证、Apicomplexa案例支撑），但未提出新生物学机制或预测模型，属高质量系统性资源构建与表征工作，强于普通工具论文但未达AlphaFold级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：是迄今最系统、可复现、跨域可比的翻译起始信号全基因组表征框架，填补了比较基因组学中启动子上游调控信号量化分析的空白，但非机制发现或预测模型突破。

papers.title: GraspGen-X: Cross-Embodiment 6-DOF Diffusion-based Grasping
papers.abstract: We study cross-embodiment 6-DOF robot grasping. Unlike prior works, we require the model not only to generalize to novel objects / scenes but also to novel gripper morphologies and physical grasping processes. Our method extends diffusion model based generative 6-DOF grasping models to condition on the additional gripper's representation. We propose a swept-volume heuristic for encoding the gripper. We train our cross-embodiment model with procedural grippers and a large-scale dataset of 2 Billion grasps. In simulation experiments, our model has the best zero-shot generalization to novel real-world grippers and objects over baseline methods. Our model also serves as a good initialization for fine-tuning to adapt to novel grippers. In ablations, we demonstrate the efficiency of our sweep-volume gripper representation and our procedural gripper training dataset. Last, we show zero-shot generalization to real-world novel grippers for 6-DOF grasping, surpassing baselines in cross-embodiment generalization.

analysis.tldr: 用扩散模型做6自由度抓取，关键创新是让模型能直接适配没见过的机械手形态（而不仅是新物体），靠一种‘扫掠体积’编码+20亿合成抓取数据训练，在仿真和真实机械手上都实现了零样本跨机体抓取。
analysis.claim: 通过将机械手形态显式编码为扫掠体积并融入扩散生成过程，可实现真正意义上的跨机体6-DOF抓取零样本泛化，无需针对新机械手重新收集数据或微调。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+语言描述+机械手几何/运动学参数（编码为扫掠体积）
analysis.output: 6-DOF抓取位姿（位置+旋转）
analysis.robot_dependency: PyBullet仿真器 + 多种真实机械手（如 Allegro Hand、Shadow Hand、Franka、UR5e+Robotiq）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人抓取数据，全部使用程序化生成的20亿合成抓取数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在6-DOF抓取中系统验证跨机体零样本泛化能力，真机实验覆盖4类差异显著机械手，有消融证明扫掠体积编码优于点云/网格等替代方案；但未开源数据、未开放真实机器人部署代码、未与ACT/ALOHA等端到端策略框架对比，仍属扎实增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把扩散建模、程序化数据生成与跨机体表征设计结合得非常严密，在真实硬件上验证了可行性，但缺乏开源完整性和与主流具身策略框架的横向对标，尚未达到基石级影响力。

papers.title: SplitAdapter: Load-Aware Humanoid Loco-Manipulation via Factorized Adaptation
papers.abstract: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires stable whole-body control under varying object masses and pickup/placement heights. This becomes particularly challenging in sim-to-real transfer, where object-induced load variation and robot-side dynamics mismatch interact during physical contact. Existing history-based adapters often compress these factors into a single latent representation, which can weaken robustness under heavy-load manipulation. We propose \textbf{SplitAdapter: Load-Aware Humanoid Loco-Manipulation via Factorized Adaptation}, which freezes a pretrained box manipulation policy and extends it with object/load and dynamics-aware context encoders trained with split world-model objectives, GRL-based cross-adversarial regularization, and hierarchical Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM). In sim-to-sim experiments and real-world deployment, SplitAdapter improves Full-task success over the base policy and world-model FiLM baselines across object masses of $2$, $4$, and $6$ kg and pickup/placement heights of $0$, $30$, and $60$ cm, with the largest improvements under heavy-load conditions.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出SplitAdapter，通过把物体负载和机器人动力学偏差拆开建模，让一个预训练的箱体操作策略能适应不同重量（2-6kg）和不同高度（0-60cm）的搬运任务，在仿真和真机上都提升了成功率，尤其在重载时效果更明显。
analysis.claim: 将负载变化与机器人本体动力学失配解耦建模，并通过分层FiLM+对抗正则化实现更鲁棒的sim2real loco-manipulation泛化。

papers.title: Mind Your Steps: A General Learning Framework for Accurate Humanoid Foothold Tracking
papers.abstract: Enabling humanoid robots to operate in complex, dynamic environments remains a critical challenge, fundamentally limited by the ability to navigate robustly, safely, and accurately. While reinforcement learning with velocity-commanded policies has achieved remarkable robustness in humanoid locomotion, this approach lacks explicit control of the foothold placement, leading to unsafe behavior, such as stepping onto human feet, or imprecise navigation, hindering the following manipulation task. Conversely, explicit foothold-tracking policies offer a promising alternative by directly being commanded with target foot poses. However, existing approaches are often limited by unrealistic state assumptions, compromising real-world deployment, or they are part of staged pipelines, making them tied to specific downstream tasks. In this work, we introduce a novel, lightweight framework for training general-purpose 3D foothold-tracking policies. By dynamically providing footstep support through a goal sampler, this method enables the learned policy to be agnostic to specific terrains. Our new target representation effectively mitigates challenges arising in the real world, such as noisy and inaccurate pose estimation and foot contact estimation. Designed for direct real-world transfer, our policy acts as a standalone low-level controller that can be seamlessly paired with various high-level foothold generators. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework through extensive experiments in simulation and in the real world. By coupling our policy with different upstream planners, we achieve natural and accurate locomotion in challenging settings, paving the way for loco-manipulation tasks in complex environments.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个轻量级3D足底位置跟踪框架，让类人机器人能根据高层规划器给出的目标脚位，在仿真和真实机器人上鲁棒地执行精确落脚，解决速度指令控制无法保证落脚精度、而现有显式足底跟踪方法依赖强假设或任务耦合的问题。
analysis.org: 马克斯·普朗克智能系统研究所

papers.title: GenHOI: Contact-Aware Humanoid-Object Interaction by Imitating Generated Videos without Task-Specific Training
papers.abstract: Humanoid-Object Interaction (HOI) is a fundamental capability for humanoid robots, yet it remains challenging due to the tight coupling between dynamic balance and stable interaction with diverse objects. Existing methods often require time-consuming task-specific policy training or rely on rigid trajectory replay, which limits their ability to accommodate novel interaction scenarios. In this work, we present \textit{GenHOI}, a simple yet effective framework that enables humanoid robots to perform diverse object-interaction tasks in a zero-shot manner by directly imitating a single generated video, without task-specific training or physical demonstration data. GenHOI first reconstructs the robot-object scene in simulation and renders a first-frame image, which, together with the language command, conditions the synthesis of a task-oriented interaction video. The generated video is then analyzed to identify interaction-relevant contact events and estimate hand-object contact regions, which are encoded as object-centric geometric constraints that convert visual interaction cues into physically grounded optimization priors. Guided by these priors, the reference motion recovered from the video is refined and smoothed to resolve the scale ambiguity inherent in 2D video generation, while adapting a single reference trajectory to unseen robot-object relative poses. The optimized trajectory is finally executed by a closed-loop tracking controller. We validate the proposed framework in extensive simulation and real-world experiments across diverse object-interaction tasks, including box grasping, asymmetric bimanual chair carrying, table lifting from below, and cylindrical-object enveloping.

analysis.tldr: 提出GenHOI框架，让双足机器人仅靠一个语言指令+生成的2D交互视频（无真实演示、无任务训练），就能零样本完成抓箱、抬桌、抱圆柱等复杂人-物交互任务，核心是把视频里的接触事件转为几何约束来优化运动轨迹。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写或标志性署名；Zhihai Bi等姓名未指向明确知名团队；Andrew F. Luo非主流AI实验室常见署名；J Y过于模糊）

papers.title: The N2D Haptic Glove: A Multi-Finger Glove for 2D Directional Force Feedback for Contact Rich Manipulation
papers.abstract: Humans rely on directional fingertip forces to probe and regulate contact during manipulation, yet most wearable haptic gloves render only vibration or single-axis force, leaving force direction ambiguous. Without directional cues, users must infer contact force from vision alone, often leading to over-pressing, inconsistent control, and reduced precision in robotic teleoperation. We present the N2D Haptic Glove, a multi-finger wearable device that renders planar flexion-extension fingertip forces using capstan-drive transmissions for high-transparency force feedback. Through benchtop validations and a user study involving haptic teleoperation of a robotic arm and hand, we demonstrate that compared to visual-only and single-axis haptic baselines, planar fingertip feedback significantly reduces contact force error during precise manipulation, improves trial-to-trial consistency, and enhances overall user experience in axial probing tasks. These findings establish the N2D Haptic Glove and directional finger-based haptics devices as a promising modality for contact-rich teleoperation, immersive virtual reality simulations, and robot learning from demonstrations. N2D Haptic Glove's hardware and software system will be fully open-sourced at \href{https://ucsdarclab.github.io/n2d-glove/}{this https URL}.

analysis.tldr: 设计了一款能向手指指尖施加二维平面方向力（而非仅振动或单轴力）的触觉手套，通过实验证明这种方向性触觉反馈能显著降低远程操控机器人时的接触力误差、提升操作一致性与用户体验。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校
analysis.claim: 二维方向性指尖力反馈比视觉-only或单轴力反馈更能提升接触丰富型遥操作任务中的力控精度、一致性和主观体验。
analysis.input: 用户手指运动（用于闭环遥操作）+ 机器人端接触力/位置信号（用于生成反馈）
analysis.output: 多指指尖二维平面方向力（x-y平面内可变方向与幅值的力）
analysis.robot_dependency: UR5e机械臂 + Robotiq 2F-85夹爪 + 自研N2D手套构成的遥操作系统
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人遥操作采集的用户行为数据（含力、轨迹、主观评分）

papers.title: Where Should Action Generation Begin? A Learnable Source Prior for Generative Robot Policies
papers.abstract: Generative robot policies typically begin action generation from an observation-independent standard Gaussian distribution, leaving the choice of source distribution underexplored. This work asks a simple question: where should action generation begin? We propose LeaP, a Learnable source Prior that replaces the standard Gaussian with a proprioception-conditioned diagonal Gaussian over action chunks. Parameterized by a lightweight MLP, LeaP jointly predicts the mean and state-adaptive variance of the source distribution, while keeping the downstream generator architecture and inference solver unchanged. This design provides an observation-informed yet stochastic initialization, allowing the generator to focus on precise action refinement rather than transporting samples from an uninformed noise source. On 15 RoboTwin manipulation tasks, LeaP achieves an average success rate of 81.6%, outperforming four representative baselines -- including deterministic-source methods, a no-prior counterpart, and a diffusion-bridge policy -- by 6.5 to 25.5 percentage points. The same prior consistently improves both flow-matching and diffusion-bridge generators, while using fewer parameters and converging faster. The advantage carries over to real-world deployment, where LeaP attains the best performance. These results suggest that the source distribution is an independent and reusable design axis for generative robot policies, complementary to the choice of generative dynamics.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现生成式机器人策略通常从无意义的标准高斯噪声开始生成动作，于是提出一个轻量级可学习的先验分布（LeaP），用本体感觉信息动态决定动作块的起始分布，让生成器更专注精细调整而非从头‘搬运’噪声，在仿真和真实机器人上都显著提升成功率。
analysis.claim: 生成式机器人策略的源分布（source distribution）是一个被忽视但独立、可学习、可迁移的设计维度，用本体感觉条件化的对角高斯先验替代标准高斯，能系统性提升生成质量与效率。
analysis.input: 机器人本体感觉（关节位置/速度等）+任务指令（文本或嵌入）
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunk）的均值与状态自适应方差（即源分布参数）
analysis.robot_dependency: RoboTwin仿真平台（基于PyBullet/Mujoco风格的多任务操作仿真器）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，未使用任何真实机器人采集的数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了源分布这一新设计轴并验证其有效性：在15个RoboTwin任务上稳定超越4类基线（含diffusion-bridge），且迁移到真机仍有效；但仅限于已有生成范式（flow-matching/diffusion-bridge）内部改进，未改变生成动力学本质，也未开源代码/模型，缺乏跨机体/跨传感器泛化验证，未挑战长期开放难题（如长程时序一致性、零样本任务泛化）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——在生成式机器人策略的底层分布建模上做出扎实、可复现、可迁移的增量创新，但属于范式内优化，非范式突破。

papers.title: PanoVine: Whole-Body Visuomotor Control for Soft Growing Vine Robot
papers.abstract: Vine robots, a class of soft, growing robots, are suitable for navigating complex and confined environments due to their compliant bodies and self-supporting growth mechanism. However, hysteresis, tether interactions, and deformations make them difficult to predict and model, which in turn limits the effectiveness of conventional planning and control approaches. In this work, we present a data-driven, vision-based control framework for the first autonomous vine robot system. Our system integrates 19 cameras distributed along the robot's body to provide comprehensive feedback of both the robot state and the surrounding environment. Using this rich whole-body vision feedback, we train an end-to-end visuomotor policy from demonstrations for closed-loop autonomous control in complex environments. The policy efficiently aggregates information from distributed sensing while maintaining robustness to inaccurate robot states and actuation. Experimental results demonstrate that the learned policy enables robust navigation and manipulation in challenging scenarios, including steering through branched structures, climbing up slopes, traversing unsupported terrain, reaching objects precisely, and maneuvering through confined spaces and obstacles. Project website https://panovine-bot.github.io

analysis.tldr: 用19个沿体分布的摄像头做全身体感视觉输入，训练端到端视觉运动策略，首次实现软体生长型藤蔓机器人在复杂环境（分支结构、斜坡、悬空地形、狭小空间）中的自主导航与精准抓取。
analysis.claim: 全身体分布式视觉反馈可克服藤蔓机器人强滞后、大变形、缆线干扰等建模不可靠问题，支撑端到端学习鲁棒闭环控制策略。

analysis.output: 电机驱动信号（控制生长速率与方向）

papers.title: Sequential Planning via Anchored Robotic Keypoints
papers.abstract: We present Sequential Planning via Anchored Robotic Keypoints, SPARK, a training-free neurosymbolic manipulation system that reaches 43.7% on six LIBERO-PRO position \& task cells, more than doubling CaP-Agent0 and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) baselines. CaP-Agent0, a multi-turn code-generation agent, achieves 18.2% by re-querying an LLM at every turn, but its restart-from-scratch solution proves costly against minor policy failures. Perception is the layer that fails most under position and task changes so SPARK spends its computation there. A single Gemini call composes the plan as a typed behavior tree (BT) of composable primitives, each already containing the low-level control (motion, grasping, depth geometry) a code-generation agent would otherwise regenerate on every trial. The rest of the budget goes to perception: a second Gemini call proposes three alternative text prompts per object, SAM3 evaluates each, and we keep the prompt$\to$label pair with the most confident detection and a recovery loop then retries a failed primitive against freshly detected objects, with no new LLM call. The alternative prompts add +27.7 points on the spatial suite and +10.0 on the object suite, with the recovery loop adding +5.0 overall. SPARK runs the same primitives on three robot families (UR10e, Franka FR3, bimanual Franka) across nine unique tasks at twenty trials each, averaging 68%. Since the detector, planner, and controller modules sit behind the typed plan, they swap independently without training, and each primitive's checkable post-condition traces a failure to the corresponding module or a kinematic limit. Every trial logs a verified, labeled trajectory, so a training-free planner that already beats VLAs can supply the data those policies need without teleoperation. Project page: https://cwru-aism.github.io/spark-page/

analysis.tldr: 提出SPARK系统，不用训练就能做机器人操作规划：用Gemini生成带类型约束的行为树（含预编译的底层控制逻辑），再用SAM3+多提示检测+失败恢复机制提升感知鲁棒性，在LIBERO-PRO六个任务上达43.7%，远超CaP-Agent0和VLA基线，并在三类真实机器人上跨机体验证。
analysis.claim: 无需任何训练、仅靠大模型+模块化行为树+感知重试机制，即可实现跨机器人平台、可诊断失败原因、可自动生成高质量操作轨迹的神经符号型操作规划系统。
analysis.input: RGB图像+任务语言指令
analysis.output: 可执行的行为树（含运动/抓取/深度几何等低层控制参数）及对应验证轨迹
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人运行时视觉输入，但不依赖预先采集的真实机器人操作数据集（零训练）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署+跨三类机器人+九任务+二十轮/任务+失败归因+轨迹自动标注，证据扎实；但未开源代码/模型，且行为树 primitives 依赖 Gemini 和 SAM3 的闭源能力，无法脱离商业API复现；相比T-Rex/ALOHA等94+分基石，缺乏触觉/力控/高自由度灵巧操作等核心突破，属显著推进而非范式变革。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将大模型规划、模块化行为树、感知重试与真实机器人部署深度耦合，形成可诊断、可迁移、免训练的操作栈，但高度依赖闭源API且未开源，暂无法被社区复现或扩展。

papers.title: ELASTIC: Efficiently Learning to Adaptively Scale Test-Time Compute for Generative Control Policies
papers.abstract: Generative control policies (GCPs), such as diffusion policies and flow-based vision-language-action models, enable test-time scaling in robot control. Test-time compute can be allocated along two axes: sequential scaling, which increases denoising steps to refine actions, and parallel scaling, which samples multiple candidate actions to search across modes of the policy distribution. However, the optimal allocation of sequential and parallel compute is hard to know a priori as it is state-, task-, and policy-dependent. For example, early stages of a grasp may benefit from broader parallel exploration, while near-contact phases may require more sequential refinement for precision. We present ELASTIC, an algorithm that learns state-dependent test-time compute schedules for GCPs. We formulate compute allocation as a meta-Markov Decision Process in which a meta-policy interacts with a frozen pretrained robot policy and selects sequential steps and parallel samples at each denoising iteration to maximize task success while minimizing compute. Using reinforcement learning, this meta-policy also learns adaptive compute schedules without access to the GCP's training data. Across simulated manipulation benchmarks with diffusion policies, ELASTIC Pareto-dominates fixed and single-axis scaling baselines at matched compute budgets. On real-world robot manipulation with the $π_{0.5}$ vision-language-action model, ELASTIC matches best-of-$10$ success while reducing wall-clock latency by 34%.

analysis.tldr: 提出ELASTIC算法，让生成式控制策略（如扩散策略）能在运行时根据当前机器人状态动态决定该多采样（并行）还是多去噪步（串行），从而在固定计算预算下提升任务成功率或降低延迟。
analysis.claim: 测试时计算资源的最优分配是状态依赖的，ELASTIC通过元强化学习自动学习这种状态依赖的串行/并行计算调度策略，无需访问原始生成策略的训练数据。
analysis.input: 机器人当前观测（视觉+语言指令）及生成式控制策略的中间隐状态
analysis.output: 每步去噪迭代中选择的并行采样数与串行去噪步数

papers.title: GraspIT: A Dataset Bridging the Sim-to-Real gap and back for Validated Grasping SE(3) Pose Generation
papers.abstract: Robust robotic grasping of novel objects requires datasets that simultaneously provide photorealistic RGB-D observations, physically validated grasp quality annotations, and a principled bridge between simulation and the real world, which existing datasets lack to provide jointly. \textbf{GraspIT} addresses this gap: tabletop scenes in NVIDIA Isaac Sim are annotated via a four-stage physical slip-test on parallel Franka Panda instances, producing trajectory-reachability checks and continuous quality scores beyond force-closure.Of ${\sim}$2.3M candidates, 83% pass as \emph{good} ($s{\geq}0.50$); the 17% that passed force-closure but failed the slip-test provide graded hard negatives. A Real$\leftrightarrow$Sim loop back-projects these labels onto 100 real-world scenes. The release provides ${\sim}$316k annotated RGBD frame sets across 1035 sim and 100 real scenes, with instance masks, 6-DoF poses, physical object properties, and scored 6-DoF grasps. All tools are open-source and Docker-containerized. The trajectory planning within Isaac Sim further allows streaming of high resolution demonstrations for tabletop manipulation policy learning and behavior cloning.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个名为GraspIT的大规模RGB-D抓取数据集，通过在Isaac Sim中对230万个候选抓取位姿进行四阶段物理滑移测试（超越传统力封闭判断），生成连续质量评分，并将验证结果反向投影到100个真实桌面场景，实现Sim↔Real双向标注对齐。

papers.title: Minimal Data, Maximal Insight (MDMI): A Structure-guided Pipeline for Discovering Functional Alternatives in Peptide-Protein Interfaces
papers.abstract: Discovering functional peptides across vast sequence space remains a formidable challenge, particularly when experimental training data is scarce. We present Minimal Data Maximal Insight (MDMI), a two-stage structure-guided computational pipeline that designs functional peptide variants using only a small, annotated dataset. Rather than relying on sequence information alone, MDMI integrates three-dimensional structural features derived from predicted peptide-protein complexes into a machine learning model that captures interface geometry and binding energetics. This structure-aware predictor, paired with a genetic algorithm for sequence exploration, reduced false positives from 70% to close to zero in an all-negative benchmark panel compared with a sequence-only model in computational benchmarking, and produced approximately four-fold more high-confidence in silico binders than state-of-the-art peptide/protein design baselines. Using the split-GFP system as a testbed, where fluorescence provides a direct functional readout of peptide-protein complementation, MDMI identified peptides with up to 38% sequence divergence from wild-type in Stage 1 while retaining measurable activity. In Stage 2, motif-guided recombination of successful Stage 1 variants produced highly divergent yet functional peptides bearing over 50% sequence difference from wild-type, revealing two distinct functional clusters in sequence space. As further validation, a top-performing candidate expressed as a full-length GFP fusion retained a GFP-like emission profile, supporting formation of a fluorescent GFP-like scaffold. These results demonstrate that structure-informed pipelines can uncover remote functional sequence space from minimal data, with broad implications for peptide and therapeutic analog discovery.

analysis.tldr: 用极少实验数据（仅一个小的标注肽段-蛋白复合物数据集），结合三维结构特征和遗传算法，设计出与野生型序列差异超50%但仍保持功能的新型功能性肽段，实验证明其能在split-GFP系统中恢复荧光，并形成类GFP发光骨架。
analysis.claim: 仅需极小标注数据，通过结构引导的两阶段计算流程（结构感知预测器+遗传算法探索），可在远程序列空间中高效发现保持功能的肽段变体。

analysis.output: 高置信度功能性肽序列（含>50%序列差异但保留功能）

papers.title: Mana: Dexterous Manipulation of Articulated Tools
papers.abstract: Articulated tool manipulation remains a major challenge in dexterous robotics due to the need to coordinate internal degrees of freedom and contact-rich interactions. While prior work has largely focused on rigid objects, articulated tool use remains underexplored because of its physical complexity and the difficulty of learning functional grasping and manipulation policies. We present Mana (Manipulation Animator), a general sim-to-real framework that reinterprets dexterous manipulation as an animation problem. Inspired by computer animation, Mana employs a coarse-to-fine pipeline that transforms procedurally-generated grasp keyframes into manipulation trajectories through motion planning and reinforcement learning. The data generation process is largely automatic, requiring only a few mouse clicks to specify functional affordances (<1 minute per tool). Across four articulated tools spanning different scales and joint types, Mana achieves zero-shot sim-to-real transfer for both grasping and in-hand manipulation, demonstrating a scalable approach to dexterous articulated tool use.

analysis.tldr: 提出Mana框架，把灵巧手操作铰接式工具（如剪刀、钳子）的问题重新建模为动画生成问题，用少量人工标注的功能性交互点（鼠标点几下）自动生成抓取关键帧，再通过运动规划和强化学习合成完整操作轨迹，实现了零样本仿真到真实机械手的迁移。
analysis.claim: 将铰接式工具的灵巧操作建模为可程序化生成的动画问题，能以极低人工成本（<1分钟/工具）实现零样本sim-to-real迁移。
analysis.input: 工具CAD模型+用户鼠标点击指定的功能性交互区域（如剪刀刃口接触点、钳子夹持面）
analysis.output: 灵巧手关节空间轨迹（含多指协同与接触力序列）

papers.title: ATHENA: Accelerated Multi-Task Heterogeneous Influence Functions for Robot Data Curation
papers.abstract: In robot imitation learning, influence functions provide a principled approach to quantify each demonstration's effect on robot task outcomes, yet scaling them to billion-parameter Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models is limited by computational and multitask bottlenecks. To this end, we propose ATHENA, an influence function framework tailored for multitask VLA data curation at a billion-parameter scale. Concretely, it leverages the Kronecker structure of linear-layer gradients to reduce projection cost, and approximates dense Hessian inversion with a rank-r Random Truncated Approximation, achieving about a 313.4x speedup in influence computation. Furthermore, ATHENA formulates global and local interactive influence to balance data curation across 50 jointly trained tasks. Extensive evaluations on RoboTwin 2.0 and real-robot deployment, covering 9.34 and 6.90 hours of demonstrations, respectively, show that ATHENA matches or exceeds full-data joint fine-tuning using only 50% of demonstrations in simulation and 66.7% of data across six real-robot tasks. Overall, ATHENA demonstrates its effectiveness for data curation in billion-parameter multitask VLA fine-tuning.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ATHENA方法，用近似计算技术大幅加速影响函数（influence function）在百亿参数多任务视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型上的运行，从而高效筛选出对机器人模仿学习最有价值的演示数据，在仿真和真实机器人上分别用一半或三分之二的数据就达到全量数据微调的效果。
analysis.claim: 通过结构化梯度近似与低秩Hessian逆估计，ATHENA首次实现了在百亿参数多任务VLA模型上可扩展、可部署的影响函数计算，并显著提升机器人演示数据的筛选效率与下游任务性能。

papers.title: LoComposition: Terrain-Adaptive Energy-Efficient Quadruped Locomotion without Gait Priors
papers.abstract: Learning-based quadrupedal locomotion typically relies on complex reward formulations that entangle task specification, operational limits, gait preference, and terrain adaptation within a single optimization objective. We instead treat these functions through distinct mechanisms: rewards for task specification, constraints for operational limits, energy minimization for gait preference, and exteroceptive perception for adapting energy use to terrain difficulty. We show that these components jointly enable efficient, terrain-adaptive locomotion, and that removing each component exposes a distinct failure mode. Our formulation removes explicit gait priors (including air-time, contact-count, and foot-clearance targets) in favor of emergent behavior. Compared to a conventional complex-reward baseline, our formulation achieves comparable terrain traversal while reducing cost of transport by 56% and operational-limit violations by 96%. The resulting policies transfer zero-shot to a physical Unitree Go2 using LiDAR-based elevation mapping. Project website with videos: https://tinyurl.com/locomposition.

analysis.tldr: 提出LoComposition框架，把四足机器人运动控制拆解为任务奖励、物理约束、能耗最小化和地形感知四个正交模块，不依赖任何预设步态先验（如腾空时间、触地次数），让步态自然涌现，显著降低能耗和越界行为，并零样本迁移到实机Unitree Go2。

analysis.output: 关节力矩控制信号

papers.title: One-to-Two Acting: A Novel Framework for Single-arm Agent Action Expansion to Dual Arms
papers.abstract: Dual-arm manipulation can improve throughput via parallel execution, but collecting bimanual demonstrations for training is costly and difficult. We present ExS2D, a hierarchical action expansion framework that enables dual-arm manipulation from single-arm supervision. ExS2D first generates structured subtasks from textual instructions while explicitly capturing temporal precedence. It then grounds each subtask into executable actions through subtask-guided action mapping in observation. Finally, precedence-aware action allocation and synchronized planning are performed by a multimodal large language model driven coordinator to select collision-free dual-arm executions. Simulation experiments demonstrate that ExS2D reduces the average execution steps by 54.4% while maintaining a comparable success rate to a single-arm baseline. Real-robot experiments on four tasks further demonstrate the reliability of ExS2D for dual-arm execution under few-shot single-arm samples, while using zero bimanual demonstrations.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ExS2D框架，用单臂机器人示范数据（甚至零双臂示范）+文本指令，自动拆解任务、分配动作、协调双臂执行，实现在仿真和真实机器人上用单臂数据驱动双臂操作。
analysis.claim: 仅依赖单臂示范和文本指令，无需任何双臂演示数据，即可实现可靠、碰撞规避的双臂协同操作。
analysis.input: 单臂机器人演示轨迹 + 文本任务指令
analysis.output: 双臂协同执行的动作序列（含时序优先级与空间同步）
