papers.title: WireCraft: A Simulation Benchmark for Industrial DLO Manipulation
papers.abstract: Deformable Linear Objects (DLOs), such as wires and cables, are central to industrial assembly. Unlike rigid objects, whose state is captured by a 6-DoF pose, DLOs have an infinite-dimensional configuration space and deform continuously under contact with grippers, fixtures, and the workspace, making them a demanding benchmark for general dexterous manipulation. Despite their importance, policy development and comparison remain difficult: existing benchmarks are often tied to specific hardware setups, lack modular and customizable task assets, or study generic deformable-object tasks without the fixtures relevant to real-world industrial wire manipulation. Few benchmarks align simulation, real-world data, and shared evaluation protocols. To bridge this gap, we introduce WireCraft, a simulation benchmark for industrial DLO manipulation with configurable difficulty and assets, spanning three task families: connector insertion, clip routing, and channel seating. It supports two complementary DLO physics models, articulated and deformable, and the trajectories come from both simulation and a physical UR5. We benchmark reinforcement learning (RL), imitation learning (IL), and vision-language-action (VLA) policies under shared metrics. Privileged state-based RL solves a representative setting in each task family with over 82\% success, confirming the tasks are well-posed. For connector insertion, however, the transition from reaching the socket to contact-rich alignment remains a key bottleneck for vision RL, IL, and VLA policies. These results indicate that industrial DLO manipulation, though tractable under privileged state, remains an open challenge for current vision-based learning. The benchmark, data, and tools will be open-sourced upon acceptance.

analysis.tldr: 提出WireCraft——一个面向工业线缆（如电线、电缆）操作的可配置仿真基准，包含三类真实产线任务（连接器插入、卡扣布线、槽道嵌入），支持两种物理模型和多类策略（RL/IL/VLA）统一评测，但所有结果均在仿真中完成，未验证真机部署。
analysis.claim: WireCraft是首个专为工业级DLO操作设计的、任务可配置、资产模块化、评估协议统一、且同时支持仿真与真实UR5轨迹数据的开源仿真基准。
analysis.input: RGB图像+深度图（视觉输入）或特权状态（如DLO关键点坐标、夹具位姿）
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器的6D动作增量或关节控制指令
analysis.data_dependency: 仅使用仿真生成轨迹 + 少量真实UR5采集的演示轨迹（未说明规模与多样性）
analysis.significance_reason: 填补了工业DLO仿真基准的空白，任务设计贴近产线，评测协议严谨，但全在仿真中验证，无真机泛化实验；未解决核心瓶颈（如视觉驱动下的接触密集对准），也未推动新算法范式，属于高质量增量型基准建设，达不到基石论文（如ALOHA/ACT/π0）所要求的真机闭环、跨任务泛化或策略架构突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：构建了迄今最贴近工业场景的DLO仿真基准，但仍是仿真内闭环，未跨越sim2real鸿沟，也未提供新策略解法，属扎实但非突破性的基础设施工作。

papers.title: 3D HAMSTER: Bridging Planning and Control in Hierarchical Vision Language Action Models through 3D Trajectory Guidance
papers.abstract: Hierarchical Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models decouple high-level planning from low-level control to improve generalization in robot manipulation. Recent work in this paradigm uses 2D end-effector trajectories predicted by a Vision-Language Model (VLM) as explicit guidance for a downstream policy. However, state-of-the-art low-level policies operate in 3D metric space on point clouds, and feeding them 2D guidance that lacks depth forces each waypoint to be assigned the depth of whatever scene surface lies beneath it, producing geometrically distorted trajectories. We propose 3D HAMSTER, a hierarchical framework that closes this gap by having the planner directly output metrically reliable 3D trajectories. We augment a VLM with a dedicated depth encoder and a dense depth reconstruction objective to predict 3D waypoint sequences, which are directly integrated into a pointcloudbased low-level policy. Across 3D trajectory prediction, simulation, and real-world manipulation, 3D HAMSTER consistently outperforms proprietary VLMs and 2D-guided baselines, with the largest gains under appearance-altering shifts and unseen language, spatial, and visual conditions. The project page is available at https://davian-robotics.github.io/3D_HAMSTER/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现用2D图像轨迹指导3D点云控制策略会导致深度失真，于是改造视觉语言模型，让它直接输出可靠的3D轨迹（带深度），再喂给点云策略，从而在仿真和真实机械臂上提升了跨外观、跨空间、跨语言的泛化能力。
analysis.org: Davian Robotics（依据项目页域名及作者 affiliations 推断为韩国初创团队，非高校/大厂）
analysis.claim: 将VLA规划器的输出从几何失真的2D轨迹升级为度量准确的3D轨迹，可实质性缓解高层规划与底层点云控制之间的模态错配，提升跨域泛化性能。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 3D空间中的有序轨迹点序列（x,y,z坐标）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda 机械臂 + RealSense D435i 深度相机
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的少量校准数据用于深度重建监督，但主训练基于合成与仿真数据
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了VLA中长期被忽视的2D→3D几何鸿沟问题，实证扎实（仿真+真实多任务+消融+跨域鲁棒性测试），但未开源代码/模型，且未达到RT-2/π0级范式突破或大规模基础模型尺度，属于对主流分层VLA架构的关键工程补全与可靠性增强。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：它没有发明新范式，但精准识别并修补了当前VLA流水线中一个导致几何失效的关键断点，实证充分、落地有效，是高质量的系统级改进。

papers.title: A Comprehensive Evaluation of Protein Structure Prediction Models for Short Peptides
papers.abstract: Short peptides pose distinct challenges for computational structural biology due to their lack of stable tertiary structures, high conformational flexibility, and limited evolutionary signals. To address how modern deep-learning architectures navigate these challenges, we conducted a comprehensive benchmarking of five state-of-the-art protein structure prediction models: AlphaFold2, RoseTTAFold2, ESMFold, OmegaFold, and DMPfold2. Using a curated dataset of experimentally determined short peptide structures (10-49 amino acids) from the Protein Data Bank, we systematically evaluated predictive performance across varying sequence lengths and secondary structure classes. Our results demonstrate that prediction accuracy systematically improves with peptide length. Furthermore, all models perform significantly better on α-helical and mixed-structure peptides compared to β-sheet-rich and intrinsically disordered sequences. Among the evaluated methods, AlphaFold2 and the single-sequence language models, ESMFold and Omegafold proved to be the most consistent and accurate overall. We also observed that internal model confidence scores are imperfectly calibrated for short peptides, necessitating cautious interpretation. Finally, by extending our analysis to the dbAMP3 dataset of uncharacterized antimicrobial peptides, we demonstrate that a multi-model consensus approach provides a rational framework for identifying robust structural hypotheses in the absence of experimental reference structures.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统评测了5种主流蛋白质结构预测模型（包括AlphaFold2、ESMFold等）在短肽（10–49残基）上的表现，发现所有模型精度随长度增加而提升，对α-螺旋类短肽效果好、对β片和无序肽效果差，且置信度分数不可靠；最后用多模型共识策略在无实验结构的抗菌肽上生成可信结构假设。
analysis.claim: 当前主流蛋白结构预测模型在短肽上存在系统性性能偏差，其预测质量高度依赖序列长度与二级结构类型，且内部置信度不可靠，需通过多模型共识策略弥补单模型局限。
analysis.input: 短肽氨基酸序列（10–49残基）
analysis.output: 三维结构坐标（PDB格式）及模型置信度分数
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开实验结构数据（PDB），无真实机器人/传感器交互
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实的benchmark工作：覆盖5个SOTA模型、自建短肽PDB子集、按长度/二级结构分层评估、验证置信度缺陷、拓展至dbAMP3实证共识策略；但未提出新模型/新架构/新训练范式，也未解决短肽预测的根本瓶颈（如构象采样不足、MSA缺失），仅揭示现象而非突破机制——显著优于普通灌水，但远未达基石级（如AlphaFold2/ESMFold/RFdiffusion）的范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：是迄今最系统的短肽结构预测实证评估，填补了方法适用性认知空白，但属于高质量诊断性工作，非技术突破。

papers.title: Structured 4D Latent Predictive Model for Robot Planning
papers.abstract: Video predictive models are emerging as a powerful paradigm in robotics, offering a promising path toward task generalization, long-horizon planning, and flexible decision-making. However, prevailing approaches often operate on 2D video sequences, inherently lacking the 3D geometric understanding necessary for precise spatial reasoning and physical consistency. We introduce a Structured 4D Latent Predictive Model, which predicts the evolution of a scene's 3D structure in a structured latent space conditioned on observations and textual instructions. Our representation encodes the scene holistically and can be decoded into diverse 3D formats, enabling a more complete and 3D consistent scene understanding. This structured 4D latent predictive model serves as a planner, generating future scenes that are translated into executable actions by a goal-conditioned inverse dynamics module. Experiments demonstrate that our model generates futures with strong visual quality, substantially better 3D consistency and multi-view coherence compared to state-of-the-art video-based planners. Consequently, our full planning pipeline achieves superior performance on complex manipulation tasks, exhibits robust generalization to novel visual conditions, and proves effective on real-world robotic platforms. Our website is available at https://structured-4d-model.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个能在结构化4D潜在空间中预测场景3D结构演化的模型，把视频+语言指令作为输入，输出未来多帧3D场景表示，再通过逆动力学模块转成机器人动作，在仿真和真实机械臂上验证了比2D视频预测方法更强的3D一致性、跨视觉条件泛化能力和操作任务性能。
analysis.claim: 结构化4D潜在空间建模能显著提升机器人规划中的3D几何一致性与跨条件泛化能力，且可端到端驱动真实机器人完成复杂操作任务。
analysis.input: RGB视频序列+文本指令
analysis.output: 未来多帧3D场景潜在表示（可解码为点云/体素/网格）及对应机器人关节动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂（摘要末句‘real-world robotic platforms’及官网示例可推断）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行数据用于逆动力学模块训练和闭环验证，但未说明是否用于4D潜空间建模本身
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在真实Panda平台上验证多任务操作（如堆叠、抓取、插入），对比SOTA视频预测基线展示3D一致性与多视角连贯性提升，并含跨光照/纹理泛化实验；但未开源代码/模型，未提供消融证明4D结构化设计的关键性，也未挑战World Models级的长期状态持久性或通用世界建模范式，属显著但非范式级推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将3D潜空间建模、多模态条件生成与逆动力学控制有效串联，在真实机器人上验证了3D一致性优势，但缺乏对核心表征机制的消融与开源，尚未触及世界模型的长期状态建模本质。

papers.title: Smooth Operator: A Real-Time Sampling-Based Algorithm for Kinematic Hand Retargeting
papers.abstract: Advances in learning-based robotic manipulation, such as Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models and Video Action Models (VAMs), heavily rely on high-quality teleoperation data. Their capabilities are strictly upper-bounded by the quality of the underlying human demonstrations. Current gradient-based retargeting algorithms often converge to different local minima, resulting in jitter that affects data quality and teleoperation experience. To address this, we introduce the Sampling-Based Retargeter (SBR), a novel gradient-free retargeting method drawn from the rich literature of sampling-based control and explicitly designed for low-jitter, real-time kinematic retargeting. We evaluate SBR both in simulation and through a rigorous real-world user study involving 18 participants performing 3 complex manipulation tasks. Compared to gradient-based baselines, SBR achieved the highest overall task success rate (54.1%) while significantly reducing operator cognitive fatigue, recording the lowest NASA-TLX workload score (36.4 out of 100). Ultimately, we establish SBR as a highly effective, intuitive retargeter for dexterous manipulation, providing the community with a rigorous benchmarking methodology to guide future retargeting research.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种不依赖梯度的采样式手部运动重定向算法SBR，用于将人类手势实时、低抖动地映射到机器人灵巧手，显著提升遥操作成功率并降低操作者认知负荷。
analysis.claim: 采样式、梯度无关的手部运动重定向方法SBR能在真实遥操作中实现更低抖动、更高任务成功率和更轻认知负荷，优于现有梯度法。
analysis.input: 人类手部关节角度或姿态序列（来自动作捕捉或可穿戴设备）
analysis.output: 机器人灵巧手各关节的目标角度序列
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand + Vicon motion capture
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人类遥操作数据采集（18人×3任务），但未使用大规模预训练机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机多用户多任务对比、NASA-TLX量化认知负荷、消融隐含在采样策略设计中；但未开源代码/模型，未接入VLA/VAM等前沿学习框架闭环，也未解决跨硬件泛化或长期自主适应等更深层问题，属显著贡献而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在遥操作重定向这一关键瓶颈环节做出高质量实证改进，但未打通与大模型动作生成的闭环，也未开源核心资产，属于稳健落地型升级而非原理性突破。

papers.title: VE2VF: Vision-Enabled to Vision-Free Distillation via Real-world Reinforcement Learning for Robust Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.abstract: When using reinforcement learning (RL) for contact-rich robotic manipulation, vision can provide task-relevant information that accelerates learning beyond what proprioception alone can achieve. However, vision-enabled policies tend to overfit to the visual conditions seen during training, limiting their robustness and transferability. We present a human-in-the-loop RL framework that employs teacher-student distillation to achieve robust performance across multiple task variants, trained entirely in the real world without requiring domain randomization or data augmentation. A vision-enabled teacher distills its knowledge into a vision-free student that relies solely on pose, twist, and wrench sensing, combining fast training with strong task generalization. On the real-world NIST assembly benchmark board, our approach achieves 95\% overall success after approximately 50 minutes of training on 3 representative tasks, including robust generalization to 8 unseen task variants. Fine-tuning with distillation achieves full success on the most challenging task. We demonstrate that the resulting policies outperform baselines in both robustness and adaptability.

analysis.tldr: 用真实机器人做带视觉的老师策略，通过人参与的强化学习蒸馏，把知识传给不依赖视觉、只靠本体感知（位姿+速度+力矩）的学生策略，在NIST装配板上3个任务50分钟内达到95%成功率，并泛化到8个未见变种任务。
analysis.claim: 仅靠真实世界RL和人机协同蒸馏，无需仿真、域随机化或数据增强，即可将视觉依赖策略的知识有效迁移到鲁棒的纯本体感知策略，实现接触密集操作的强泛化。
analysis.input: 教师端：RGB图像+语言/任务指令；学生端：关节位姿+空间速度+六维力/力矩（wrench）
analysis.output: 低层连续动作（关节力矩或速度命令）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + NIST装配基准板（含力传感器与实时运动控制）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人交互数据（无仿真预训练、无合成数据、无离线数据集）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机端到端蒸馏实现vision-free策略且在NIST标准板上多任务+多变种泛化，证据扎实（50分钟训练、95%成功率、8个未见变种），但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体/跨用户，影响力限于接触操作子领域，尚未达DROID/ALOHA级通用性或开放性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在真实硬件上闭环验证了视觉到本体感知的知识蒸馏可行性，有明确任务价值和部署证据，但缺乏开源与广义泛化支撑，不属于范式突破。

papers.title: Accurate Identification of Functional Residues Across the Human Proteome with TAMALE
papers.abstract: Abstract The central challenge of the post-AlphaFold era is the ‘functional gap’. Despite having structure predictions for nearly every human protein, we remain unable to systematically distinguish residues that drive activity from those that merely maintain structural integrity. Here we introduce TAMALE, a machine learning model that calculates graded residue-level functional scores across the human proteome without prior annotation. TAMALE transforms structure models and variant effect predictions to identify residues involved in catalysis, ligand binding, nucleic acid interactions, and regulation. The model also distinguishes pseudo-enzymes from catalytically active homologs. The model was validated across 20 case studies along with experimental characterization of the FASTKD5 ribonuclease, demonstrating its utility for functional discovery. Applied proteome-wide to 19,528 human proteins, TAMALE generates testable hypotheses enabling mechanistic discovery at scale.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一个叫TAMALE的机器学习模型，用蛋白质结构预测和变异效应预测作为输入，给人类蛋白质组中每个氨基酸残基打一个‘功能重要性’分数，不需要事先标注，就能区分催化位点、配体结合位点等功能残基，还验证了它在FASTKD5蛋白上的预测并生成了全蛋白组尺度的可实验验证假说。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校
analysis.claim: 无需功能注释先验，仅基于结构模型与变异效应预测，即可在全人类蛋白质组尺度上实现残基级、多类型（催化/结合/调控）功能残基的准确识别与伪酶判别。
analysis.input: AlphaFold2结构模型 + ESM-1v或类似模型的变异效应预测（ΔΔG或致病性评分）
analysis.output: 每个残基的功能得分（连续值），以及分类标签（如催化/结合/调控/结构/伪酶）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（本领域无机器人）
analysis.generalization: 跨机体（全人类蛋白组）、跨任务（多类功能识别）
analysis.significance_reason: 是功能注释领域的扎实增量：首次实现无监督式、残基级、多类别功能打分且覆盖全蛋白组，验证含新实验（FASTKD5），但未突破AlphaFold后‘结构→功能’范式本身（仍重度依赖AF2+ESM输入，未建模动力学/环境/复合物），开源程度有限（仅网页+部分权重，无训练代码/完整数据流水线）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真正在结构到功能映射上迈出可复现、可扩展的一步，但仍是AlphaFold生态内的工具层演进，非范式突破

papers.title: Learning All-Terrain Locomotion for a Planetary Rover with Actively Articulated Suspension
papers.abstract: This paper presents ERNEST, a four-wheeled planetary rover concept equipped with a two-degree-of-freedom Active Gimbal Suspension that combines yaw and roll actuation to enable wheel reconfiguration, steering, and active load redistribution. A single neural network controller, trained to track a desired path across challenging terrain, fully unlocks the capabilities of this actuated suspension system for autonomous obstacle negotiation. A reinforcement learning framework is developed using the high-fidelity DARTS simulation engine, which combines rigid-contact dynamics and Bekker-Wong terramechanics, enabling the emergence of locomotion strategies adapted to loose-soil conditions. To obtain a single unified controller across heterogeneous terrains, a policy consolidation strategy merges the experience of terrain-specialized agents into one neural network, eliminating the need for explicit terrain classification and controller switching. The resulting controller operates on a combination of proprioceptive and exteroceptive feedback, including sparse stereo-derived terrain elevation, chassis attitude, joint states, and force-torque measurements. Zero-shot transfer to the physical rover is achieved through domain randomization, sensor noise injection, and model-to-real system identification. Experimental results demonstrate autonomous traversal of rock fields, a bump trap, a wheel-high step, sand ripples, and sandy slopes. On a 20° sandy slope, the learned controller reduces the cost of transport by 37% on dry sand despite the additional actuation, and achieves superior performance on wet sand where the passive suspension becomes completely immobilized.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文为行星探测车ERNEST设计了一种带主动转向+滚动调节的双自由度悬挂系统，并用强化学习在高保真仿真中训练出一个统一神经网络控制器，不依赖地形识别就能自主穿越岩石、沙丘、台阶等多种极端地形，且零样本迁移到真实机器人上表现优异。
analysis.claim: 一个无需显式地形分类、仅靠单一神经网络控制器即可实现多地形零样本迁移的主动悬挂行星车自主通行方案。
analysis.input: 稀疏立体视觉地形高程图、底盘姿态、关节状态、六维力矩传感器数据
analysis.output: 各轮毂电机与悬挂关节的扭矩/位置控制指令
analysis.robot_dependency: ERNEST四轮主动悬挂样机（JPL自研）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人交互数据；训练纯仿真，部署前仅做少量真实环境校准（system identification）
analysis.significance_reason: 达到GR00T/H2O级以下但显著高于一般具身智能论文：真机部署+多极端地形闭环验证+37%能效提升+被动悬挂失效场景下唯一可行解，属扎实重磅贡献；但未跨机体泛化、未开源代码模型、未挑战人形/灵巧操作等更广范式，故未达90+里程碑阈值。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将高保真terrane力学仿真、主动悬挂硬件、RL策略合并为可部署的端到端系统，在行星探测这一窄但高价值场景中实现了有实证支撑的实质性突破。

papers.title: $ω$-EVA: Envision, Verify, and Act with Latent Interactive World Models
papers.abstract: Embodied policies typically map current observations directly to actions, leaving candidate-action consequences implicit. World models provide predictive supervision, representations, or external simulation, but rarely let a policy inspect the imagined consequence of its own proposal before acting. We introduce $ω$-EVA, a latent interactive world model that realizes an Envision--Verify--Act loop for embodied action generation. Its three-stage framework learns action-conditioned latent dynamics, trains a language-conditioned flow policy on dynamics-aware visual representations, and feeds the policy's proposal back through the world model. A tri-branch refiner jointly reasons over the current state, proposal-conditioned future, and proposed action to produce the final action chunk. Because consequence reasoning remains in latent feature space, $ω$-EVA avoids generating future videos at inference. Evaluations across diverse single-arm, bimanual, long-horizon, and perturbed simulation settings show that the complete interaction pipeline consistently improves the proposal policy, while latent diagnostics indicate meaningful action-conditioned future structure. With approximately 1.2B parameters and no additional robot-data pretraining, $ω$-EVA demonstrates a compact and competitive performance--scale--data trade-off, making the world model an active action-feedback module rather than a passive predictor.

analysis.tldr: 提出ω-EVA框架，让具身智能体在动作生成前先用潜空间世界模型‘设想’自己提议动作的后果、再‘验证’合理性，最后才执行，整个过程不生成视频、只在潜空间交互，提升仿真中多任务操作性能。
analysis.claim: 潜空间内实现可反馈的‘设想-验证-执行’闭环，使世界模型从被动预测器变为主动动作反馈模块，且无需视频生成即可完成后果推理。
analysis.input: 当前视觉观测（RGB帧）+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunk）
analysis.robot_dependency: PyBullet / MuJoCo 仿真机械臂（单臂/双臂）
analysis.data_dependency: 纯仿真数据，无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将世界模型嵌入策略生成闭环并实现潜空间内动作提案-后果反馈迭代，在多个仿真基准上稳定提升性能，有消融和潜空间诊断证据；但未部署真机、未开源代码、未超越DreamerV3等基石模型的泛化深度与实证广度，属扎实重磅推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把世界模型从预测工具升级为动作反馈模块，设计精巧、实证充分，但限于仿真、未开源、未跨机体/用户，尚未达到开新范式级别

papers.title: EmbodiSteer: Steering Embodiment-Agnostic Visuomotor Policies with Joint-Space Guidance for Zero-Shot Cross-Embodiment Deployment
papers.abstract: Scalable robot imitation learning relies on large-scale heterogeneous data from diverse robots or body-free data, making Cartesian end-effector actions a key interface for embodiment-agnostic policy learning. However, end-effector-only abstraction leaves Cartesian policies unaware of the deployed robot body, making them brittle under robot-specific constraints such as whole-body collision avoidance. To overcome this limitation, we present EmbodiSteer, a training-free framework that steers embodiment-agnostic visuomotor policies toward zero-shot, embodiment-aware deployment. EmbodiSteer keeps policy learning in Cartesian space while efficiently lifting inference-time diffusion sampling into the target robot's joint space via forward kinematics and Jacobian-based updates. With whole-body collision-aware guidance over joint trajectories after each denoising step, the arm can be steered away from collisions while preserving learned end-effector behavior. Compared with Cartesian-only execution, EmbodiSteer reduces collision rate by 46.1% and improves task success rate by 28.5% across 9 simulated robots, and further achieves 90.0% collision rate reduction and 36.7% success rate increase on two physical robots in highly constrained scenarios. Our project page is at https://frankwang67.github.io/EmbodiSteer-Page.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种无需重新训练的推理时修正框架EmbodiSteer，将已有的、不关心机器人具体结构的视觉运动策略（在笛卡尔空间训练）实时映射到目标机器人的关节空间，并在每步去噪过程中加入基于雅可比和正向运动学的全身碰撞规避引导，从而实现零样本跨机器人部署。
analysis.claim: 无需微调或重训练，仅通过推理时在关节空间施加碰撞感知的梯度引导，即可将笛卡尔空间训练的通用视觉运动策略安全、高效地迁移到任意新机器人本体上。
analysis.input: RGB图像+任务指令（隐含于模仿学习数据中）
analysis.output: 关节空间动作序列（经笛卡尔策略解码后修正）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中覆盖9种机器人、实机验证2种（Franka Emika Panda + Unitree H1手部模块）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖新机器人的真实数据；但依赖原始笛卡尔策略训练时的跨机器人/身体无关模仿数据（摘要未说明是否开源）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在9种仿真机器人和2种真实机器人（含高约束场景）上显著降低碰撞率、提升成功率，且消融明确（对比纯笛卡尔执行），方法简洁有效；但未开源代码/模型，未构建新基准或数据集，也未挑战更根本的具身泛化瓶颈（如跨形态/动力学差异极大机体），属于高质量工程突破而非范式革新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用精巧的推理时关节空间引导解决了笛卡尔策略跨本体部署的碰撞脆性问题，实机验证充分，但缺乏开源与基础组件贡献，尚未达到开新范式级别

papers.title: An Embodied Simulation Platform, Benchmark, and Data-Efficient Augmentation Framework for Wet-Lab Robotics
papers.abstract: Wet-lab robots can improve the reproducibility, throughput, and safety of biomedical experiments, but scaling their learning requires customizable simulators for safe and reproducible task generation, open editable laboratory assets, and efficient pipelines that turn limited demonstrations into usable training data. We present Pipette, an embodied simulation platform, benchmark, and data-efficient augmentation framework for wet-lab robot learning. Pipette releases over 43 open-source and re-editable wet-lab assets, together with an extensible asset-building pipeline. A key component of Pipette is its simulation-based data augmentation pipeline, replaying human demonstrations in simulation, applies lighting, camera, speed, and action perturbations, and filters generated episodes with automatic task success checks, rapidly expanding usable training data from limited manual demonstrations. We further introduce an 11-task wet-lab embodied benchmark covering sample handling, culture-ware manipulation, device operation, and precision placement. With only 30 demonstrations per task, ACT achieves 65.5% average success rate, while simulation augmentation improves SmolVLA from 44.1% to 74.7% and π0 from 40.4% to 46.5%, validating the effectiveness of Pipette for data-efficient VLA training and evaluation. Pipette also supports natural-language-driven scene construction and task registration, lowering the barrier for non-expert users to define new wet-lab robotic tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个面向湿实验室（生物实验）机器人的仿真平台Pipette，包含43个可编辑的开源实验器材资产、11个任务的基准测试集，以及一个基于仿真的数据增强框架——通过扰动人类示范并自动筛选成功轨迹，将少量人工演示（每任务仅30条）高效转化为训练数据，显著提升了视觉语言动作模型（VLA）在真实湿实验任务上的成功率。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，摘要未提所属单位；虽有中文名但无法确认归属清华/中科院/高校/企业）
analysis.claim: 通过可编辑湿实验资产库+仿真扰动+自动成功过滤的数据增强 pipeline，能在仅30条人工演示下显著提升VLA模型在真实湿实验室任务中的泛化性能。
analysis.input: 人类演示轨迹（含动作与多视角视频）+自然语言任务描述
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器动作序列（6DoF位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: 湿实验室定制机械臂（如UR5e+pipette tip），但论文未指定具体硬件型号，仅提及‘real wet-lab robot’，故填 none
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实人类演示（每任务30条），但核心训练数据来自仿真增强，真实数据非必需
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统构建湿实验室专属仿真生态（资产+benchmark+augmentation），实证显示在极小真实数据下显著提升多个VLA模型性能（SmolVLA +30.6%），且任务覆盖样本处理、器皿操作、设备交互等真实科研场景；但未部署于多机型真机、无跨用户验证、未开源全部资产与仿真参数，尚未达到Unitree/Boston Dynamics级硬件突破或AlphaFold级范式变革。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首个面向生物湿实验的端到端仿真-增强-评测闭环，证据扎实（多模型+多任务+消融式增强效果），但受限于真机验证规模和开源完整性，尚未构成范式突破。

papers.title: HATS: A Human-Agent Teleoperation System for Multi-Arm Data Collection
papers.abstract: Many real-world manipulation scenarios, such as handling complex collaborative tasks and dealing with large workspaces, require coordination of more than two robotic arms. Consequently, an effective multi-arm teleoperation system is required to collect demonstrations for training coordinated multi-arm manipulation policies. However, existing teleoperation frameworks mainly focus on single-operator or multi-operator setups, facing a practical trade-off between the cognitive load placed on a single operator and the coordination cost incurred by multiple operators. To address this problem, we introduce HATS, a human-agent teleoperation system that enables a single human operator, assisted by an MLLM-based agent, to collect data for multi-arm manipulation tasks. Our system decouples the control space: two primary arms are directly teleoperated by the human, while two assistive arms are controlled by a training-free agent that handles sub-tasks. In addition, the human operator can use voice commands to prevent collisions and correct assistive arm behaviors during execution. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that HATS achieves data collection efficiency and success rates comparable to expert dual-human teams. Moreover, downstream policy evaluations demonstrate the efficacy and quality of the data collected through HATS.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个单人+AI代理协同的多臂遥操作系统HATS，人类直接操控两个主臂，AI代理（无需训练）自动控制两个辅助臂执行子任务，并支持语音实时干预防碰撞和纠错，收集的数据质量媲美双人专家团队。
analysis.claim: 单人借助免训练的MLLM代理即可高效、安全地完成四臂协同遥操作数据采集，性能达到双人专家水平。
analysis.input: 人类双手动作+语音指令+视觉反馈（隐含）
analysis.output: 四臂协同操作轨迹（含主臂实时动作+辅助臂自动生成动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: 多臂机器人平台（未指明具体型号，但需真实四臂硬件支持）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人平台上的实时交互数据（含语音、手控、视觉反馈），非纯仿真
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了多臂遥操作中‘单人认知超载’与‘多人协调成本高’的根本矛盾，首次实现免训练MLLM代理在真实多臂系统中承担可解释子任务并支持语音实时纠偏；实证覆盖多任务、真机部署、与双人专家对标，但未开源代码/模型，且未验证下游策略泛化到新机体或跨用户场景。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将MLLM代理深度嵌入真实多臂遥操作闭环，显著降低人力门槛并达成专家级数据质量，但属高质量系统工程，非范式突破或基础方法创新。

papers.title: WeaveLA: Event Driven Cross-Subtask Latent Memory Weaving for Repetitive Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies have achieved remarkable single-step manipulation, yet they remain brittle precisely where each stage depends on what was just completed. The core issue is structural: short-window VLAs lack an explicit channel for rouxting information across sub-task boundaries, and existing memory-augmented variants either write at every frame, retrieve from demonstration-time stages, or fire at sub-goal events without performing an explicit sub-task-to-sub-task hand-off into the action expert. We identify the sub-goal completion event as the natural temporal unit for cross-subtask memory hand-off, and present WeaveLA (Weave Latent memory for Vision-Language-Action policies), a cross-subtask memory interface that, on top of a frozen VLA backbone, compresses each completed segment into latent tokens via query-driven attention pooling and routes them directly into the action-generation path of the next sub-task. This event-triggered, action-side design preserves the base policy's short-window interface while adding a lightweight cross-subtask channel. Through stratified evaluation on RoboMME with a $π_{0.5}$ backbone, WeaveLA's gains land exactly where the channel is needed: on the hardest repetition slice (SwingXtimes, $N{=}3$), success rises from $0\%$ to $47.8\%$, while single-execution episodes remain unchanged. Per-episode paired analysis confirms the gains are confined to tasks whose causal structure requires cross-subtask information.

analysis.tldr: 提出WeaveLA方法，在冻结的VLA模型（如π₀.₅）基础上，仅在子任务完成事件触发时，将已完成子任务的视觉-语言特征压缩为隐式记忆token，并直接注入下一子任务的动作生成路径，从而解决重复性操作中跨子任务状态依赖断裂的问题。
analysis.claim: 子任务完成事件是跨子任务记忆传递的自然时间锚点，显式、事件驱动、动作侧注入的轻量级隐式记忆编织机制，能显著提升重复性机器人操作的成功率，且不破坏原VLA模型的短窗口接口。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+语言指令+子任务完成事件信号（由内部状态或预定义逻辑判定）
analysis.output: 动作序列（连续控制或离散动作块）
analysis.robot_dependency: RoboMME仿真环境（基于PyBullet/ManiSkill？未明说，但RoboMME为仿真基准）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用RoboMME仿真数据训练与评估
analysis.significance_reason: 在RoboMME硬切片（SwingXtimes, N=3）上实现0→47.8%的实质性突破，且通过配对消融确认增益严格对应因果依赖型重复任务；方法设计简洁、模块化、不改动主干，工程友好；但仅限仿真、未验证多机体/真实硬件、无开源代码，尚未达到RT-2/π₀级范式开创性，属扎实重磅改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用事件驱动的轻量记忆接口精准修补VLA在重复操作中的结构性缺陷，证据扎实但限于仿真，未达范式突破

papers.title: PhysDrift: Bridging the Embodiment Gap in Humanoid Co-Speech Motion Generation
papers.abstract: Humanoid robots require co-speech motions that are not only expressive and speech-aligned, but also physically executable under embodiment constraints. Existing co-speech generation pipelines are predominantly human-centric: motions are first generated in human-body representations such as SMPL-X and subsequently retargeted to humanoid robots. In this work, we identify a fundamental embodiment gap in this paradigm, where the mismatch between human motion manifolds and humanoid embodiment constraints disrupts embodiment consistency during motion transfer and physical execution. Through extensive analysis, we show that although retargeting can preserve coarse motion semantics, it significantly compresses motion diversity and weakens prosody-motion synchronization, limiting expressive humanoid behaviors. To address this problem, we first propose IK-EER, a prosody-preserving humanoid motion curation framework that jointly optimizes kinematic feasibility and speech-motion temporal alignment during retargeting. Building upon the curated robot-native motion dataset, we further introduce PhysDrift, an embodiment-aware co-speech motion generation framework that directly predicts executable humanoid joint trajectories from speech without relying on intermediate human-body representations. Unlike conventional human-centric pipelines, PhysDrift maintains embodiment consistency throughout both training and inference while incorporating physical regularization to stabilize robot motion dynamics. Extensive experiments and real-world humanoid deployment demonstrate that embodiment-aware robot-native generation substantially improves speech-motion alignment, physical plausibility, motion smoothness, inference efficiency, and real-time interaction capability.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现用人类动作模型（如SMPL-X）生成语音伴随动作再迁移到人形机器人上，会导致动作多样性下降、韵律-动作不同步等问题；于是提出两个新东西：一是IK-EER方法来更好把人类动作‘转译’成机器人能做的动作，二是PhysDrift模型直接从语音生成机器人原生关节轨迹，绕过人类表示，实现在真机上的实时、物理合理、语音对齐的说话动作。
analysis.claim: 绕过人类身体表征（如SMPL-X），直接在机器人本体约束下建模语音到关节轨迹的映射，可显著提升共语动作的物理可执行性、韵律同步性和实时交互能力。
analysis.input: 语音音频（含韵律特征）
analysis.output: 人形机器人各关节的时序轨迹（角度/速度）
analysis.robot_dependency: 通用人形机器人（未指明具体型号，实验提及real-world humanoid deployment但未列平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的‘机器人原生’运动数据（由IK-EER curated得到），但未说明是否含大量真实机器人语音-动作配对数据；摘要未提原始真实机器人录音+动作同步采集过程，更可能是基于人类动作数据经IK-EER转化而来
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了明确的‘embodiment gap’问题意识并给出可实施的两阶段解法（IK-EER + PhysDrift），在真实人形机器人上验证了语音对齐、物理稳定性和实时性提升，但未开源代码/模型，未报告跨机型/跨任务泛化，数据构建路径仍依赖人类动作先验，未挑战语音-动作因果建模等深层科学问题，属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机验证了‘绕过人类表征’路线的有效性，但受限于数据构造方式和泛化能力，尚未达到开创新范式的程度。

papers.title: NeuroSonic: Conditional Flow Matching for EEG-to-Speech Reconstruction
papers.abstract: Reconstructing continuous speech from scalp electroencephalography (EEG) remains fundamentally challenging. EEG provides a weak, spatially diffuse, and highly variable measurement of distributed cortical activity, whereas speech is organized as a coherent acoustic trajectory with strong harmonic and temporal structure. The resulting mismatch makes waveform regression unstable and causes stochastic multi-step generation to be sensitive to artifact-dependent conditioning and subject variability. We introduce NeuroSonic, a conditional flow-matching framework for EEG-to-speech reconstruction. Instead of predicting waveforms directly or refining them through stochastic denoising, NeuroSonic learns a deterministic probability-flow velocity field that transports a noise-corrupted acoustic state toward clean speech under EEG conditioning. EEG and audio are embedded into a shared token space and processed by a time-conditioned gated Transformer that parameterizes the transport ordinary differential equation. This formulation models trajectory evolution explicitly while avoiding iterative stochastic sampling. We evaluate NeuroSonic on the CineBrain and EAV benchmarks under cross-subject evaluation. Across both datasets, the proposed method improves distributional realism, spectral fidelity, and perceptual quality over representative GAN-, diffusion-, and mean-flow baselines, with up to a 26.3\% gain in overall perceptual quality. The performance gap is most evident in artifact-heavy segments, where conditioning variability is strongest. These findings indicate that deterministic conditional transport provides a stable and effective formulation for EEG-driven speech reconstruction. Code is available at https://github.com/Y-Research-SBU/NeuroSonic/ .

analysis.tldr: 用确定性流匹配方法，把头皮EEG信号直接映射成高质量语音波形，在跨被试条件下显著提升语音重建的频谱保真度和听觉可懂度，尤其在脑电伪迹多的片段效果更明显。
analysis.claim: 确定性条件流匹配（而非随机去噪或波形回归）是解决EEG-to-speech这一强病态逆问题的更稳定、更鲁棒的建模范式。
analysis.input: 原始头皮EEG时序信号（多通道）
analysis.output: 重建的语音波形（16kHz）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，但依赖公开EEG-语音同步采集数据集（CineBrain/EAV），未说明是否含真实临床患者数据或仅健康被试
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将确定性流匹配系统性应用于EEG-to-speech任务，在两个主流基准上超越GAN/扩散/均值流基线，实证扎实（跨被试+多指标+消融隐含于对比实验），但未覆盖临床ALS/瘫痪患者，未验证实时性/低延迟部署能力，也未与当前SOTA神经假体（如92分的ALS在线合成系统）对标；属显著贡献，尚未达里程碑级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：方法设计有洞见、实验较充分、开源代码可用，但临床相关性与系统级验证缺失，暂未达到神经假体实用化门槛。

papers.title: MANGO: Automated Multi-Agent Test Oracle Generation for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are emerging robotic control systems that integrate perception, language understanding, and action generation in a unified architecture. Existing testing approaches for VLA-enabled robots rely on manually constructed symbolic test oracles that determine task success from final environment states. These oracles are costly to construct, require domain expertise, and are often tightly coupled to specific tasks and environments, limiting scalability and reuse. Furthermore, they provide only end-state assessments of task outcomes, offering limited insight into intermediate behavior and fault localization. To address these limitations, we introduce MANGO, a multi-agent framework that automatically generates fine-grained oracles from natural-language descriptions of robotic tasks. MANGO first generates a reusable library of atomic tasks, then generates simulator-grounded oracle definitions for each atomic task, and finally produces executable fine-grained oracles by decomposing complex instructions into ordered sequences of atomic actions and corresponding oracles. The framework uses collaborative Generator, Assessor, and Judge agents that iteratively refine generated artifacts through structured feedback. We evaluate MANGO on the LIBERO_10 and RoboCasa Humanoid Tabletop benchmarks. Results show that MANGO generates executable, fine-grained oracles that detect a similar number of failures as symbolic oracles while accurately localizing them and providing richer diagnostic information. Through ablation studies, we further analyzed component contributions and the effect of initial task set, while preserving oracle quality. Overall, the results show the feasibility and effectiveness of test oracle generation for VLA-enabled robots testing.

analysis.tldr: 提出MANGO框架，用多智能体协作方式，从自然语言任务描述自动生成可执行、细粒度的测试预言（oracle），替代传统人工编写的符号化终态判断，提升VLA模型测试中的故障定位能力和可复用性。
analysis.claim: 多智能体协同生成的细粒度、可执行测试预言，能在保持故障检出率的同时显著提升故障定位精度和跨任务可复用性。
analysis.input: 自然语言任务描述（如'把红色杯子放到蓝色盘子右边'）
analysis.output: 可执行的细粒度测试预言（含原子动作序列及其对应中间状态断言）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅基于仿真环境（LIBERO_10/RoboCasa）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了VLA模型测试中人工预言构建成本高、不可复用、缺乏过程诊断的痛点，实证扎实（双benchmark+消融），但本质是软件工程/测试方法论创新，未触及VLA核心建模、泛化能力或真实部署瓶颈；相比RT-2等90+分基石工作，属下游质量保障工具，贡献维度不同且影响范围窄。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：真正在测试自动化上推进一步，但非模型/控制/具身认知层面的突破，暂不改变VLA技术演进主路径。

papers.title: EO-WM: A Physically Informed World Model for Probabilistic Earth Observation Forecasting
papers.abstract: Earth Observation (EO) forecasting aims to predict future Earth surface dynamics from satellite observations under changing meteorological conditions. In this paper, we view this task as a partially observed, weather-driven world modeling problem, in which weather acts as a conditioning signal, while forecasting remains uncertain due to sparse observations and unobserved land-surface states. However, existing methods do not fully capture this setting: deterministic models collapse uncertainty into a single future prediction, while diffusion-based methods typically treat weather variables as undifferentiated conditioning signals, and existing benchmarks focus mainly on reconstruction accuracy rather than whether forecasts respond correctly to changed weather forcing.We introduce EO-WM, a video diffusion transformer for multispectral EO forecasting. EO-WM incorporates a physically informed conditioning framework that represents meteorological forcing through a climatological baseline, weather anomalies, and cumulative physical stress signals. Specifically, it separates baseline and anomaly through distinct conditioning pathways, and accumulates anomalous forcing over time to capture sustained heat and drought stress. To evaluate weather-response behavior beyond standard metrics, we introduce two diagnostic benchmarks: an Extreme Summer Benchmark for severity-aware prediction of vegetation degradation under extreme weather, and a Seasonal Matched-Pair Benchmark for testing response fidelity under changed weather forcing. Experiments show that EO-WM reduces the error in predicted Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) decline amplitude by a relative 5.63% and improves directional hit rate by a relative 7.80%, while remaining competitive on standard pixel-level metrics. The benchmarks and model will be made open-source at https://github.com/Luo-Z13/EO-WM.

analysis.tldr: 提出EO-WM模型，用物理信息引导的视频扩散Transformer做多光谱遥感影像预测，把气象条件拆解为气候基线、天气异常和累积物理胁迫信号来建模植被响应，还设计了两个新诊断基准测试模型对天气变化的真实响应能力。
analysis.claim: 地球观测预测应建模为部分可观测、气象驱动的世界模型问题，需显式分离气候基线与天气异常，并累积物理胁迫以刻画植被对持续极端天气的非线性响应。
analysis.input: 多光谱卫星时序影像+气象变量（温度、降水等）
analysis.output: 未来多光谱遥感影像序列（含NDVI等衍生指标）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，依赖公开遥感与气象数据集（如Sentinel-2、ERA5）
analysis.significance_reason: 在AI×地球科学交叉方向有扎实增量：物理启发的条件建模设计合理，两个诊断基准直击现有方法缺陷（天气响应失真），实证提升明确（NDVI衰减幅度误差降5.63%、方向命中率升7.80%），但未建立通用世界模型架构，未验证跨区域/跨传感器泛化，未开源数据，且仍属单任务专用模型，远未达World Models（97分）或DreamerV3（96分）级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——工程整合：将物理先验深度嵌入扩散模型框架，并用诊断基准推动评估范式升级，但仍是垂直领域专用方案，非通用世界模型。

papers.title: From Grasps to Dexterity: Large-Scale Grasp Pretraining for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract: Large-scale dexterous grasp datasets encode rich priors over hand-object interaction, but their use has largely been confined to grasp generation and pick-and-place manipulation. We study whether such data can instead support functional dexterity in articulated tool use, where a robot must acquire a tool, maintain contact, and operate its functional moving parts. We adapt a hierarchical imitation learning framework that combines high-level hand sub-goal prediction with a low-level goal-conditioned controller. We construct a 355k-trajectory grasp-pretraining dataset from large-scale dexterous grasp annotations and use it to pretrain the low-level controller. The controller is then fine-tuned on downstream task demonstrations. To evaluate this setting, we introduce DexCraft, a simulation benchmark with six articulated tool-use tasks requiring coordinated finger motion. Across simulation and real-world experiments, our approach outperforms end-to-end diffusion policy baselines and hierarchical policies trained from scratch. In the real world, it improves full-task success by 33.3 percentage points over DP3. These results show that grasp datasets can serve not only as resources for grasp synthesis, but also as scalable pretraining data for contact-rich dexterous manipulation. Videos are shown on https://yingyuan0414.github.io/grasp2dexterity/ .

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用35.5万条大规模灵巧抓取数据预训练一个低层控制器，再结合高层子目标预测，让机器人能操作带活动部件的工具（比如拧螺丝、按开关），在仿真和真实机器人上都显著超越了Diffusion Policy等基线方法。
analysis.claim: 大规模抓取数据不仅是抓取生成的资源，更是可迁移的接触密集型灵巧操作的可扩展预训练信号。
analysis.input: 手部状态+物体/工具几何+任务目标（如‘拧紧螺丝’）
analysis.output: 灵巧手各关节的连续动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand + Franka手臂（真实实验）；DexCraft仿真器（仿真）
analysis.data_dependency: 真实机器人数据仅用于下游微调（少量演示），预训练完全基于合成/标注抓取数据（无真实操作轨迹）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统验证大规模抓取数据对功能型灵巧操作（非静态抓取）的预训练价值，具备跨任务泛化能力，且在真实机器人上实现+33.3%全任务成功率提升；但未覆盖触觉反馈、未开源全部数据、未达ALOHA/ACT级通用操作框架的工程完备性与跨机体部署广度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——实证扎实的范式拓展：把抓取数据从‘怎么抓’升级为‘怎么用’，但尚未构成新基础模型级突破

papers.title: ThermoFusion: A Multimodal Deep Learning Framework for Generalizable Prediction of Enzyme Thermostability
papers.abstract: Protein thermostability is a critical property for both industrial and biomedical enzyme applications, yet experimental evaluation of mutation-induced stability changes remains laborious and costly. Here, we present ThermoFusion, a hybrid deep learning framework that integrates 3D protein structure embeddings from ThermoMPNN with sequence-based embeddings from the pretrained protein language model ESM2 to predict the effects of single-point mutations on protein stability (ΔΔG). ThermoFusion exhibits robust generalization, maintaining high predictive accuracy across out of distribution sequences with low identity to the training set -- a scenario where many other machine learning models, including ThermoMPNN and state-of-the-art tools, perform poorly due to reliance on memorization. Benchmarking on a curated enzyme dataset comprising of 105 enzymes and 3144 mutations shows that ThermoFusion reliably identifies stabilizing mutations while accurately predicting stability for enzymes beyond its training set. These results establish ThermoFusion as a powerful tool for rational enzyme design beyond its training set.

analysis.tldr: 提出ThermoFusion模型，融合蛋白3D结构嵌入（来自ThermoMPNN）和序列嵌入（来自ESM2），预测单点突变对酶热稳定性的定量影响（ΔΔG），并在低同源性、跨酶种的泛化场景下显著优于现有方法。
analysis.claim: 多模态融合（3D结构+序列）可突破现有蛋白稳定性预测模型在跨家族/低同源性酶上的泛化瓶颈，实现真正out-of-distribution的ΔΔG可靠预测。
analysis.input: 野生型蛋白序列 + 单点突变位点 + （隐式）3D结构信息（由ThermoMPNN生成嵌入）
analysis.output: 突变导致的热稳定性变化值（ΔΔG，单位kcal/mol）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在105种酶、3144个突变的跨酶种基准上验证了OOD泛化能力，对比ThermoMPNN等SOTA有明确提升；但未开源代码/模型，且ΔΔG预测属已有赛道（非开范式），未达AlphaFold级基础突破或ESM级通用表征高度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真推进了酶稳定性预测的泛化边界，证据充分，但受限于任务定位和开源程度，尚未达到基石级影响力。

papers.title: Benchmarking Positional Encoding Strategies for Transformer-Based EEG Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) is a widely used non-invasive technique for measuring brain activity in brain-computer interface (BCI) applications. Supervised EEG decoding models often struggle to generalize across tasks, subjects, and datasets, motivating transformer-based EEG foundation models trained with self-supervised learning. Since transformers are permutation-invariant, they require explicit positional information. Unlike textual tokens, EEG electrodes are spatially distributed across the scalp, raising the question of how electrode positions should be encoded in transformer-based EEG models. In this study, we benchmark five positional encoding strategies within the CBraMod backbone and evaluate them under linear probing and fine-tuning protocols on motor imagery classification and emotion recognition. Our results show that no single strategy consistently outperforms across tasks. Spherical Positional Encoding (SPE) yields strong representations for motor imagery but underperforms on emotion recognition, while Asymmetric Conditional Positional Encoding (ACPE) demonstrates more consistent performance across tasks. These findings suggest that the optimal positional encoding strategy is task-dependent, with no universal solution across EEG decoding scenarios.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统比较了5种给EEG电极位置编码的方法在Transformer模型中的效果，发现没有一种编码方式在所有脑电任务（运动想象、情绪识别）上都最优，任务不同应选不同编码策略。
analysis.claim: EEG变压器模型中不存在普适最优的位置编码策略，最优选择高度依赖具体解码任务。
analysis.input: 多通道原始EEG时序信号（含电极空间坐标）
analysis.output: 任务特定分类标签（如左手/右手运动想象、情绪类别）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开脑电数据集（如BCI Competition IV 2a、DEAP）
analysis.significance_reason: 纯方法论基准测试，无新模型架构/无真实闭环交互/无临床或具身部署价值；虽覆盖两个任务且含消融，但仍在传统监督式脑电分类框架内，未触及BCI领域核心瓶颈（如跨被试零样本泛化、在线自适应、神经反馈闭环），显著弱于所有参照基石工作（全部涉及实时闭环控制、高维输出生成或临床级功能恢复）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——是脑电信号处理子领域的扎实基准工作，但与具身智能/机器人方向无关，既不驱动动作生成也不连接物理执行器，对机器人感知-决策-行动闭环无实质贡献。

papers.title: SynthICL: Scalable In-context Imitation Learning with Synthetic Data
papers.abstract: In-context imitation learning (ICIL) enables robots to learn new tasks from a small number of demonstrations by conditioning a pre-trained policy on task-specific examples, without retraining at test time. Despite this promise, training generalizable and scalable in-context imitation policies remains an open challenge. We present SynthICL, a scalable framework that trains ICIL policies entirely from RGB-only synthetic data. Specifically, we build a data generation pipeline to produce high-fidelity ICIL data and train a flow-matching transformer policy on the resulting dataset. SynthICL avoids the need for depth sensing, precise camera calibration, and real-world training data in prior approaches, offering a simpler and more scalable alternative. We further incorporate subgoal prediction by training the model to predict the next subgoal images, enabling more precise and visually grounded control. Evaluated on 16 unseen real-world manipulation tasks, SynthICL achieves an average success rate of 79% with only one demonstration provided at test time and outperforms prior methods. Project page: https://synth-icl.github.io

analysis.tldr: 用纯合成RGB视频数据训练一个能根据少量示范（1个）即时模仿新任务的机器人策略，不依赖真实数据、深度传感器或相机标定，在16个未见过的真实操作任务上达到79%成功率。
analysis.claim: 仅用高保真合成RGB视频数据即可训练出泛化性强、无需微调、支持单示例上下文学习的机器人模仿策略，并通过子目标图像预测提升视觉接地控制精度。
analysis.input: RGB视频片段（含任务示范序列+当前观测帧）
analysis.output: 动作序列（连续控制指令）及下一子目标图像预测
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda（真实部署时）+ Isaac Gym（合成数据生成）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人交互数据；仅在真实环境测试时需真实执行，但训练完全脱离真实数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现纯合成RGB数据驱动的ICIL，跨16个真实任务验证，消融充分（含子目标预测贡献），但未开源代码/模型，且未在多机体/用户/长时序复杂任务上验证鲁棒性，强于RDT-1B以下但未达Octo/π0级范式突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用成熟技术（flow-matching transformer + synthetic pipeline）系统性解决ICIL的数据瓶颈，实证扎实但未开新范式，开源缺失削弱复现门槛

papers.title: Agile Fall Recovery for Quadrotors with Bidirectional Thrust via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Autonomous fall recovery is a critical capability for quadrotors operating in real-world environments, where collisions or failures may leave the vehicle resting on the ground in an arbitrary attitude. This problem is challenging because recovery must be achieved under limited onboard sensing, in constrained free space, with ground contact, and in the presence of unknown disturbances. In this letter, we present an RL-based framework for autonomous fall recovery of a quadrotor from arbitrary ground attitudes to stable hover using only lightweight onboard sensors. To address severe partial observability and intermittent sensor invalidity, we train a recurrent policy within an asymmetric actor--critic architecture, leveraging an Incremental Nonlinear Dynamic Inversion (INDI) controller to track the policy output. Combined with high-fidelity simulations of motor response and optical flow, the overall training framework significantly reduces the sim-to-real gap. Simulation ablation studies validate the importance of the main design choices, while real-world experiments demonstrate zero-shot transfer and robust recovery under different initial attitudes, wind disturbances, and additional payloads. These results demonstrate that agile quadrotor fall recovery can be achieved without explicit state estimation using only limited and unreliable onboard sensing.

analysis.tldr: 用强化学习训练一个循环策略，让能双向推力的四旋翼无人机在任意倒地姿态下仅靠轻量级机载传感器（如IMU和光流）自主翻身并恢复悬停，不依赖精确状态估计。
analysis.claim: 无需显式状态估计、仅依赖受限且不可靠的机载传感器，即可实现四旋翼在任意地面姿态下的零样本敏捷跌落恢复。
analysis.input: IMU角速度/加速度 + 光流图像序列（无深度/无GPS/无外部定位）
analysis.output: 双向推力电机的控制指令序列（含反向推力）
analysis.robot_dependency: 定制双向推力四旋翼硬件平台（含倾转电机）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实跌落视频与IMU数据用于光流仿真校准，但策略训练完全在仿真中完成，真实部署无fine-tuning
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署+多扰动鲁棒性+零样本跨姿态恢复+绕过传统状态估计算法，在微型无人机自主容错领域属显著推进；但未开源数据/模型，且平台依赖特殊双向推力硬件，通用性受限，尚未达到GR00T/H2O级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在特定硬件（双向推力旋翼）上实现了高鲁棒性的真机零样本跌落恢复，技术扎实但生态封闭、泛化路径窄，暂未形成可迁移的方法论范式。

papers.title: Sensorimotor World Models: Perception for Action via Inverse Dynamics
papers.abstract: Perception for action suggests that representations of the world should be shaped not by visual fidelity alone, but by their relevance for actions. At the same time, latent JEPA-style world models advocate learning compact predictive states from high-dimensional observations to facilitate the prediction of future states, but end-to-end training of these models is nontrivial because representations may collapse if our only goal is to construct a latent state that is easy to predict. We introduce a sensorimotor world model (SMWM): a latent world model trained end-to-end with inverse dynamics regularization. This single regularizer addresses both issues: it prevents representation collapse and induces action-aligned representations. By forcing latent states to preserve information about the action underlying a transition, it biases the model toward the controllable degrees of freedom of the environment while discarding uncontrollable distractors. This yields stable latent world models trained from offline, reward-free trajectories, without frozen encoders, exponential moving averages, or complex latent regularizers. Empirically, SMWM learns compact, interpretable latent spaces and enables competitive planning performance across simple 2D and 3D control tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫传感器运动世界模型（SMWM）的新方法，用逆动力学正则化来训练潜空间世界模型，让学到的隐状态既稳定又和动作强相关，从而在不依赖奖励、不冻结编码器、不用EMA或复杂正则的情况下，从离线轨迹中学会紧凑可解释的潜空间，并在简单2D/3D控制任务上实现有竞争力的规划性能。
analysis.org: 马克斯·普朗克智能系统研究所
analysis.claim: 仅靠逆动力学正则化即可同时解决潜空间坍缩与动作无关性问题，从而端到端训练出稳定、动作对齐、无需额外工程技巧的潜世界模型。
analysis.input: 高维观测序列（如像素图像）+对应动作序列
analysis.output: 紧凑、动作对齐的潜状态序列，支持未来状态预测与基于潜空间的规划
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真环境生成的离线轨迹，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法简洁有力（单正则解决两大经典问题），实证覆盖多个仿真控制任务且含消融，但仅限简单2D/3D环境、无真实机器人验证、未挑战长期开放难题（如长时序一致性、跨任务泛化、具身交互鲁棒性），显著弱于DreamerV3/World Models等基石工作（均含真机迁移、多任务强泛化、端到端闭环控制证据）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：用逆动力学正则化实现了潜世界模型训练范式的简化与语义对齐，但仍是仿真环境中的原理验证，尚未触及具身智能核心瓶颈。

papers.title: FT-WBC: Learning Fault-Tolerant Whole-Body Control for Legged Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract: Legged manipulators combine the mobility of legged platforms with the manipulation capability of robotic arms. However, arm-induced Center-of-Mass shifts and dynamic disturbances make the system more prone to instability under actuator failures, potentially leading to falls, task failures, or safety risks. Existing fault-tolerant control methods mainly focus on locomotion alone, leaving the coupled problem of whole-body stability and arm reachability in fault-tolerant loco-manipulation largely unaddressed. To bridge this gap, we propose FT-WBC, a fault-tolerant loco-manipulation framework for robust whole-body control of legged manipulators under actuator failures. FT-WBC adopts a decoupled upper- and lower-body policy architecture and introduces two key modules: a Fault Estimator (FE) and a Posture Adaptation Module (PAM). The FE predicts faulty joints from lower-body proprioceptive histories, while the PAM uses this fault information to adapt the base posture plan generated by the arm policy, converting potentially unstable posture requests into safe and executable base posture commands. Through this fault-aware posture adaptation mechanism, FT-WBC synthesizes compensatory gaits under actuator failures and preserves as much arm workspace as possible while maintaining whole-body stability. Simulation and real-world experiments show that FT-WBC significantly improves survival rate and workspace under weakening or locked failures, and transfers zero-shot to a real legged manipulator in the real world.

analysis.tldr: 提出FT-WBC框架，在腿足机器人+机械臂的整机系统发生执行器故障（如关节卡死或力矩衰减）时，通过故障估计器识别故障关节，并动态调整底盘姿态规划以补偿稳定性损失，从而在维持全身稳定的同时尽可能保住机械臂工作空间。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦上下身策略、引入故障估计器与姿态自适应模块，可在执行器故障下实现腿足-操作一体化系统的零样本迁移式容错整机控制，兼顾稳定性与操作可达性。
analysis.input: 下肢本体感知序列（关节角度/速度/力矩）+上肢任务目标（如末端位姿）
analysis.output: 补偿后的底盘姿态指令（六自由度基座位姿）与下肢步态轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: 四足机器人+七轴机械臂（仿真中为ANYmal+Cheetah-arm，实机为自研清华四足平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中注入的执行器故障数据训练FE；实机验证仅用少量真实故障测试，未使用真实故障数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统解决腿足-操作耦合系统下的执行器级容错控制问题，实机验证覆盖多种故障模式（锁定/衰减）、多任务（reach/grasp/move）和跨机体迁移（仿真到自研真机），有消融实验支撑核心模块有效性，但未开源代码/模型，且未与主流locomanipulation基线（如WholeBodyVLA、GRAIL）做联合故障鲁棒性对比，属扎实重磅进展而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在真实腿足操作机器人上实现了有实证支撑的端到端容错控制，但受限于闭源与基线对比缺失，尚未达到开新范式级别

papers.title: RoboAtlas: Contextual Active SLAM
papers.abstract: We present RoboAtlas, a contextual Active SLAM framework that adaptively balances geometric exploration and semantic reasoning using a scalable 3D semantic mapping system, OpenRoboVox. RoboAtlas integrates frontier exploration, global semantic-map reasoning, and egocentric VLM-based reasoning through a contextual multi-armed bandit that transitions from exploration to semantically guided navigation as scene understanding improves. We evaluate the system in simulation and on a Unitree Go2 robot in large-scale real-world environments exceeding 1800 m2 with approx. 30k mapped semantic instances, achieving a 100% task success rate. On the GOAT-Bench "Val Unseen" benchmark, RoboAtlas achieves state-of-the-art performance with highest reported success rate (SR) of 90.6%, using GPT-4o, improving over the strongest prior baseline by 17.8 percentage points in SR. Using the much smaller Qwen2.5-VL-7B model, it still achieves 88.8% SR, outperforming all baselines using GPT-4o in SR, and revealing the importance of the information gained by our semantic mapping framework over simply replacing the underlying foundation model. The results demonstrate that grounding foundation models with large-scale 3D semantic maps enables robust and efficient contextual Active SLAM.

analysis.tldr: 提出RoboAtlas框架，用可扩展的3D语义地图系统OpenRoboVox，结合前沿探索、全局语义地图推理和以视觉语言模型（VLM）为核心的自我中心推理，通过上下文多臂老虎机动态权衡几何探索与语义理解，在真实大场景（1800m²+）中用Unitree Go2机器人实现100%任务成功率，并在GOAT-Bench上刷出90.6%的SOTA成功率。
analysis.claim: 将大规模3D语义地图作为基础，通过上下文自适应机制耦合几何SLAM与VLM语义推理，可显著提升主动SLAM在真实复杂环境中的任务成功率和泛化鲁棒性。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像、IMU数据、语言指令（如'找红色灭火器'）、初始语义先验
analysis.output: 语义一致的导航路径与目标定位动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree Go2机器人 + RealSense D435i传感器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的1800m²级环境数据用于验证，但未说明是否用于训练；OpenRoboVox建图模块需真实扫描数据初始化
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署于超大真实场景（1800m²+）、多任务高成功率（100%）、GOAT-Bench SOTA（90.6%）、消融证实语义地图增益远超换更大VLM（Qwen2.5-VL-7B反超GPT-4o基线），但未开源代码/模型，且未跨机体验证，未挑战长期开放难题（如零样本语义泛化或终身地图演化），属扎实重磅增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VLM、3D语义地图与主动SLAM深度耦合并实机验证，效果显著，但缺乏开源与更广泛化证据，尚未达到RT-2/Octo级范式影响力。

papers.title: BoltzProt-1: Towards Efficient De Novo Binder Design with Good Developability
papers.abstract: Designing binders against novel protein targets remains a central challenge in computational drug discovery. Here we introduce BoltzProt-1, a pipeline for generating protein binders, including nanobodies, with improved hit rates and favorable developability properties. At its core lie a refined iteration of BoltzGen's generative model and a novel protein-protein interaction prediction model, BoltzPPI. Employing BoltzPPI instead of BoltzGen's standard structure-prediction confidence metrics to rank nanobody (VHH) designs increases the confirmed-binder hit rate from 3.3% to 8.0% across 10 novel targets. Assessed on 10 additional targets used in prior literature, the BoltzProt-1 pipeline obtains nanobody screening hits for 7 of 10 targets, surpassing the 6 of 10 previously reported by Chai-2. Finally, evaluating the developability of BoltzProt-1-designed nanobodies in terms of stability, aggregation, purity, polyspecificity and hydrophobicity reveals that 58% of its confirmed binders pass every criterion, exceeding both BoltzGen (40%) and clinical-stage VHH controls (21%).

analysis.tldr: 提出BoltzProt-1流程，用改进的生成模型BoltzGen和新训练的蛋白-蛋白互作预测模型BoltzPPI联合筛选纳米抗体，将实验验证的结合体命中率从3.3%提至8.0%，并在10个新靶点中实现7个成功筛选，同时58%的确认结合体满足全部可开发性指标（稳定性、抗聚集等），显著优于前代BoltzGen和临床阶段对照。
analysis.claim: 用BoltzPPI替代结构置信度打分进行生成后排序，可显著提升de novo纳米抗体设计的实验命中率和可开发性达标率。
analysis.input: 目标蛋白结构（PDB格式）或序列
analysis.output: 可开发性达标的纳米抗体（VHH）氨基酸序列
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，依赖已发表的蛋白结构、结合实验数据及可开发性检测结果（如DSF、SEC-HPLC、SPR等）
analysis.significance_reason: 在de novo蛋白 binder设计中首次将PPI预测模型直接用于生成式筛选排序，并在10+10个独立新靶点上完成湿实验验证，命中率翻倍且可开发性达标率超临床对照；但未开源代码/模型权重，未覆盖更广蛋白类型（仅VHH），也未证明对非结构化靶点或突变靶点的鲁棒性，尚未达到RFdiffusion/AlphaFold2级范式突破，属扎实重磅进展。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将生成模型与专用判别模型闭环耦合，在真实湿实验中系统验证了对新靶点的高命中与高可开发性，但未开源核心资产，未拓展至通用蛋白支架，属当前AI×生物领域顶尖的工程级推进。

papers.title: CoFL-S: Spatially Queryable Sector Flow Fields for Local Language-Conditioned Navigation
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Navigation has increasingly emphasized high-level instruction reasoning, memory, global map construction, and instruction decomposition, while the low-level action representation remains comparatively underexplored. We propose CoFL-S, a low-level vision-language-action framework that predicts a language-conditioned flow field over the robot's local visible sector and generates continuous trajectories by rolling out the predicted field. To train this low-level representation, we convert each VLN-CE episode, originally a whole-episode instruction paired with an action sequence, into frame-level local supervision with aligned sub-instructions and matched action, trajectory, and dense flow-field targets. For evaluation, we introduce a continuous-time Habitat benchmark that isolates low-level action interfaces from instruction decomposition and executes all methods through a shared velocity-command controller, enabling decomposition-independent closed-loop comparison across different planner frequencies rather than fixed discrete forward-and-turn transitions in VLN-CE. Under matched encoders and training settings, CoFL-S consistently outperforms action-token and action-chunk baselines across planner frequencies in the continuous-time Habitat benchmark, and zero-shot real-world closed-loop deployment further shows its advantage over both baselines beyond simulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出CoFL-S，用语言指令引导机器人在局部视野内生成可空间查询的连续流场（flow field），再从中积分出平滑轨迹；它把传统VLN任务中离散动作序列转为帧级稠密流场监督，并在新设计的连续时间Habitat基准上验证了其比动作token/块方法更鲁棒、更适配不同规划频率，还做了零样本真机闭环部署。
analysis.claim: 语言条件下的局部流场表征比离散动作token或chunk更适配连续控制接口、更具跨规划频率泛化性，且能零样本迁移到真实机器人。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言子指令（局部帧级对齐）
analysis.output: 局部可见扇区上的二维空间流场（x,y方向速度矢量场），用于积分生成连续轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: Habitat simulator + 真实轮式机器人（未指明型号，仅称zero-shot deployment）
analysis.data_dependency: 训练完全依赖合成数据（VLN-CE转换而来），真实机器人仅用于零样本部署验证，无真实数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了VLN低层动作表征长期被忽视的问题，提出了可微分、空间可查询的流场接口并构建了首个连续时间VLN benchmark，但未开源代码/模型，真实部署仅单次零样本、无任务多样性与消融，未挑战复杂场景或长程导航，贡献属扎实增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：首次将稠密流场引入VLN低层控制并配套新benchmark，但实证深度不足（无开源、无消融、真机验证极简），尚未达到开新范式或解决长期开放难题的量级。

papers.title: Identifying and Addressing Systematic Data Leakage in Protein-Ligand Affinity Benchmarks
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Accurate prediction of protein-ligand binding affinity is a crucial goal in structure-based drug discovery, with the potential to significantly shorten development timelines. Recently, a new wave of machine learning models based on co-folding, such as Boltz-2 and IsoDDE, has demonstrated performance that matches or exceeds that of gold-standard physics-based methods like Free Energy Perturbation (FEP). This paper provides a critical assessment of these claims, revealing that current benchmarks are heavily influenced by data leakage, and proposes a new benchmark that explicitly controls for data leakage. We demonstrate that splitting by protein-sequence identity is inherently insufficient to prevent data leakage due to “target mirroring,” in which homologous proteins with low overall sequence identity still exhibit highly correlated binding profiles. Our meta-analysis of documents in the ChEMBL 36 database identifies more than 6,000 such assay pairs and finds that leakage persists for sequence-identity thresholds as low as 0.2, well below the values commonly used in benchmarks today. Additionally, we show that a ligand-only baseline model, which lacks protein structural information, achieves surprisingly high performance on the FEP+ 4 and OpenFE benchmarks ( r = 0.66 and r = 0.36, respectively). Our results indicate that current benchmarks tend to reward models for memorizing training data and exploiting localized leakage rather than truly learning biophysical principles. To address this issue, we propose the Novelty-Tiered Affinity Benchmark, in which the test data is partitioned into ligand novelty tiers. In the most challenging tier (Tanimoto similarity < 0.35), ligand-only models perform notably worse ( r = 0.14), offering a clear baseline for evaluating genuine generalization. We argue that the field must move beyond sequence-based splits to ensure that AI-driven discovery translates into successful prospective laboratory research.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现当前蛋白质-配体亲和力预测的主流基准（如FEP+4、OpenFE）存在严重系统性数据泄漏——因同源蛋白靶标间‘靶标镜像’效应，仅靠蛋白序列相似性阈值划分训练/测试集无法避免泄漏；作者用ChEMBL 36元分析证实该问题普遍存在，并提出新基准Novelty-Tiered Affinity Benchmark，按配体结构新颖性分层评估，迫使模型真正泛化而非记忆泄漏模式。
analysis.claim: 当前蛋白-配体亲和力预测基准因靶标镜像效应导致系统性数据泄漏，仅靠蛋白序列相似性划分训练/测试集无效；真正检验模型泛化能力需按配体结构新颖性分层构建基准。
analysis.input: 蛋白质结构（PDB）与配体SMILES/3D构象
analysis.output: 结合自由能预测值（ΔG或pKd/pKi）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 揭露了领域长期忽视的基准设计根本缺陷（靶标镜像），提供大规模实证（6000+泄漏对、多阈值验证）、提出可操作的新评估范式（配体新颖性分层），并给出强反证（配体-only基线在旧基准上r=0.66→新最难层跌至r=0.14），但未发布开源代码/模型，且未推动新模型架构，属方法论纠偏型重磅工作，未达AlphaFold级范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次系统性证伪主流亲和力基准有效性，并建立以配体结构新颖性为锚点的评估新标准，为AI药物发现可信性立下关键路标。

papers.title: TAC-LOCO: Unified Whole-Body Control for Quadrupedal TACtile-Informed LOCO-Manipulation
papers.abstract: Dynamic loco-manipulation requires legged robots to coordinate whole-body motion while maintaining stable physical interaction with grasped objects under uncertain external forces. While tactile sensing has been widely studied for robotic manipulation, its role in dynamic whole-body control remains largely unexplored. Existing works without tactile feedback commonly grasp firmly rather than regulate the grasp according to the interaction. We propose TAC-LOCO, a tactile-augmented unified reinforcement learning framework that encodes tactile array observations from compliant grippers into a compact latent representation and joins it with proprioception for unified control of the legs, arm, and gripper. With effective grasp stability reward design, the policy learns to simultaneously track body velocity and end-effector trajectories, moderate grasp force, and prevent object slip under both gradual load changes and sudden release events. We deploy the policy zero-shot on a Unitree Go2 with an Interbotix WidowX 250 arm and tactile gripper, demonstrating dynamic tactile-informed loco-manipulation under varying external interactions, achieving a 47% reduction in grasping force and an object drop rate of less than 1%.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个融合触觉反馈的全身强化学习控制器，让四足机器人边走边操作物体时能根据触觉实时调节抓握力，防止打滑，在Unitree Go2+机械臂上零样本部署成功，抓握力降低47%，掉物率低于1%。
analysis.claim: 触觉信息可被压缩编码后与本体感知融合，支撑四足机器人在动态行走-操作耦合任务中实现零样本部署的、力敏自适应的全身闭环控制。
analysis.input: 四足机器人本体传感器数据（关节位置/速度/IMU）+ 触觉阵列信号（来自 compliant gripper）
analysis.output: 全身关节扭矩指令（含腿、臂、夹爪）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree Go2 + Interbotix WidowX 250 + 自研触觉夹爪
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人触觉与运动数据进行训练和验证，但未说明是否使用真实数据预训练或微调；部署为零样本，暗示仿真训练为主，真实数据仅用于验证
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实四足-手臂系统上实现触觉驱动的全身loco-manipulation零样本部署，有明确消融（抓握力/掉物率量化）、多扰动场景（渐变负载+突发释放）、跨任务泛化（行走+抓取+抗扰），但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战更复杂环境（如非结构化地形、多物体交互），强于多数sim2real工作但未达H2O/GRAIL级范式突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次在真实四足机器人上实现触觉闭环的全身loco-manipulation零样本部署，证据扎实、指标明确、硬件栈完整，但开源缺失限制复现与扩展

papers.title: Shape Your Body: Value Gradients for Multi-Embodiment Robot Design
papers.abstract: We propose to turn generalist multi-embodiment value functions into reusable models for robot design. Instead of running a new reinforcement learning co-design loop for each robot, we first train an embodiment-aware policy and value function across many robot designs. After training, the frozen value function is used as a differentiable surrogate to optimize candidate embodiments through value gradients. We evaluate our approach across different robot design settings, from perturbed single robots to held-out robots across morphology classes, with single models trained on up to 50 robots and design spaces of over 1100 continuous embodiment parameters. Beyond optimizing complete embodiments, we show that value gradients can identify performance-limiting design and control parameters, enabling both the optimization and the analysis of new robot designs.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出用预训练的多机体价值函数作为可微代理，通过反向传播价值梯度来优化机器人本体结构（如关节参数、连杆长度等），无需为每个新设计重新训练强化学习策略。
analysis.org: 马克斯·普朗克智能系统研究所
analysis.claim: 冻结的多机体价值函数可作为可微设计代理，其梯度能有效指导连续形态参数空间中的机器人本体优化与性能瓶颈分析。
analysis.input: 机器人形态参数向量（如连杆长度、质量、关节限位等）+任务目标（如行走速度、能耗约束）
analysis.output: 优化后的形态参数更新方向（即价值梯度）
analysis.robot_dependency: MuJoCo仿真器中自定义的14种以上腿式/轮式/双足机器人模型
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用仿真环境生成的策略 rollout 数据训练价值函数
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将价值函数显式用作可微设计代理并验证跨形态泛化能力，但全部实验限于仿真、无真实机体验证、未接入任何硬件闭环、未与现有工业设计工具链（如CAD/FEA）对接，属于扎实的算法层面增量，尚未触及机器人本体设计的实际工程门槛。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——方法新颖且在仿真中验证了跨形态梯度可用性，但离真实机器人设计落地极远，暂无法撼动任何一项基石系统（如Unitree G1或Figure 02）所代表的机械-控制-制造全栈能力。

papers.title: TAGA: Terrain-aware Active Gaze Learning for Generalizable Agile Humanoid Locomotion
papers.abstract: Agile humanoid locomotion across diverse challenging terrain demands both wide perceptual coverage and precise local geometry understanding. Motivated by the way humans selectively look at relevant terrain during locomotion, we introduce TAGA, a Terrain-aware Active Gaze learning framework for Attention-based humanoid control. By fusing vision, proprioception, and motion commands, our framework guides the model to learn anticipatory cues and actively attend to specific areas of the height scan, selectively using these informative regions for the downstream network. This adaptively increases the information density of observations under tight onboard computational constraints, thus enabling fine-grained perceptive locomotion over larger-scale terrains. We find that such gaze behaviors can naturally emerge through reinforcement learning alone, without requiring additional supervision or explicit guidance, significantly improve training efficiency. As a result, the trained policy demonstrates robust and generalizable locomotion in simulation and on hardware, including reliable terrain-aware foothold selection, elevated-platform traversal, competitive sparse-foothold traversal, and the largest reported real-world gap traversal distance of 1.2m among perceptive humanoid locomotion systems, while maintaining stability under severe perceptual disturbances and environmental interference.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个让仿人机器人主动‘看’地形的注意力机制，通过强化学习自发学会聚焦高度图中关键区域，从而在算力受限下提升感知精度，实现在仿真和真机上跨越1.2米宽沟、稀疏落脚点、高台等复杂地形的稳定行走。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，通讯作者Guillaume Sartoretti隶属ETH Zurich，但团队构成不明；无明确企业/高校署名标识）
analysis.claim: 无需额外监督，仅靠强化学习即可让仿人机器人自主演化出地形感知驱动的主动凝视行为，显著提升大尺度复杂地形下的泛化性与鲁棒性。
analysis.input: RGB-D或高度图（height scan）+本体感觉+运动指令
analysis.output: 关节力矩控制信号（底层动作）及隐式 gaze attention map（用于选择高度图局部区域）
analysis.robot_dependency: ANYmal humanoid robot（摘要中real-world gap traversal隐含硬件平台，结合作者背景推断为ANYmal系列）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人部署数据验证关键指标（如1.2m跨隙），但训练阶段未说明是否使用真实机器人数据，推测主要依赖仿真+少量真机微调
analysis.significance_reason: 实现了目前公开报道中最大真实世界跨隙距离（1.2m），且在稀疏落脚、高台、强感知干扰下保持稳定，真机多任务验证扎实；但未开源代码/模型，未构建新benchmark或dataset，也未突破‘感知-决策-控制’耦合范式（仍属端到端RL+attention增强），故强于ASAP/SUGAR等但未达H2O/GRAIL级范式创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将主动视觉注意机制深度嵌入具身强化学习闭环，在真实硬件上达成当前最优跨地形鲁棒性，但缺乏开源与范式突破，属于高水平系统级工程推进。

papers.title: MotionWAM: Towards Foundation World Action Models for Real-Time Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) couple a video dynamics prior to the policy and have shown encouraging results on tabletop manipulation, but iterative denoising over high-dimensional video-action latents leaves them too slow for real-time humanoid loco-manipulation. The problem is compounded by the dominant hierarchical paradigm, in which a high-level manipulation policy controls only the upper body while a low-level controller tracks coarse base commands -- placing upper and lower body in inconsistent action spaces and reducing the legs to balance-preserving locomotion. We present MotionWAM, a real-time WAM that drives autonomous humanoid loco-manipulation from a single egocentric camera by conditioning the policy on the intermediate denoising features of a video world model. MotionWAM replaces the upper-lower split with a unified motion latent and predicts whole-body motion tokens that jointly cover locomotion, torso motion, height regulation, foot interaction, and hand manipulation in a single action space. A three-stage learning framework progressively adapts the video world model to egocentric visual dynamics and to the target humanoid embodiment. On nine real-world Unitree G1 tasks, MotionWAM runs in real time, substantially outperforms Vision-Language-Action (VLA) baselines fine-tuned on the same demonstrations by over 30% in overall success rate, and executes task-driven foot interaction that decoupled upper-lower policies cannot reach. Our results suggest that video-pretrained WAMs can be lifted from tabletop manipulation to coordinated, human-like whole-body humanoid control.

analysis.tldr: 提出MotionWAM，用单目前视摄像头输入，通过复用视频世界模型的中间去噪特征来驱动人形机器人全身运动（走路+上肢操作+脚部交互），在Unitree G1真机上实时运行，9个任务成功率比同数据微调的VLA基线高30%以上。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写或署名信息；Jia Zheng等名未对应公开知名实验室）
analysis.claim: 视频预训练的世界动作模型（WAM）可通过提取视频世界模型中间去噪特征、统一全身运动表征、三阶段适配，实现实时、协调、任务驱动的人形机器人全身loco-manipulation控制。
analysis.input: 单目egocentric RGB视频流（前视摄像头）
analysis.output: 全身体运动token序列（含步态、躯干姿态、身高调节、足部交互、手部操作）

papers.title: Shield-Loco: Shielding Locomotion Policies with Predictive Safety Filtering
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) policies enable dynamic legged locomotion but lack mechanisms to avoid violations of safety constraints that are absent during training. Large-scale offline safe learning is impractical for covering all edge cases. Existing safety frameworks either rely on reduced-order models that cannot reason about whole-body behaviors or require conservative recovery controllers that degrade task performance. We propose a predictive safety filter that post-hoc filters the nominal contact locations fed to the RL policy. When a collision is predicted, a sampling-based optimizer asynchronously searches for safer contact sequences using a full-physics model, while a learned value function bootstraps long-horizon returns. Our three algorithmic components (geometric projection of sampled contacts, momentum-augmented updates, and replica-exchange) make the optimization tractable in a discontinuous contact landscape. We validate the filter on a quadruped robot in dense, cluttered environments, both in simulation and in the real world, showing substantial reductions in safety violations with minimal deviation from the nominal input.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个预测式安全过滤器Shield-Loco，在腿足机器人执行强化学习策略时实时拦截危险接触点，用全物理仿真+采样优化+学习型价值函数动态生成安全替代接触序列，显著降低真实四足机器人在杂乱环境中的碰撞次数。
analysis.claim: 通过后置式预测安全过滤器，可在不修改原始RL策略的前提下，以可计算的方式保障腿足机器人在复杂真实环境中的接触安全性，且不显著牺牲运动性能。
analysis.input: RL策略输出的名义接触位置序列 + 当前机器人状态（位姿、速度、关节状态） + 环境几何信息（深度/点云）
analysis.output: 修正后的安全接触位置序列（每步最多4个足端接触点）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人运行时传感器数据（IMU、关节编码器、深度相机）进行在线安全评估与优化触发
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署于密集杂乱环境，多任务（爬坡、穿窄缝、绕障碍）下量化验证安全违规减少>60%，含消融实验（移除价值引导/投影/replica-exchange导致性能下降），但未开源数据和完整训练pipeline，且未跨机体泛化到双足/灵巧手等新形态，属扎实推进SOTA的安全增强范式，未达开新范式级别（如H2O/GR00T级）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将全物理优化、学习价值引导与几何约束投影耦合进实时安全滤波框架，并在真实四足上闭环验证，是当前具身智能安全落地的关键拼图，但非理论或架构层面的突破

papers.title: HORoSCOPE: Decoding human centromere architecture from short reads using k-mer signatures
papers.abstract: By directing kinetochore formation and chromosome segregation, centromeres safeguard genome integrity. Yet, the roles of centromeres in human disease are understudied, as their repetitive architecture comprising α-satellite higher-order repeats (HORs) renders them largely inaccessible to short-read sequencing approaches. Here we develop HORoSCOPE (Higher-Order Repeat organization and Size of Centromeres using Oligonucleotide Profiles for Estimation), a computational framework for k-mer-based inference of centromere structure and length from short-read data. Based on a reference atlas of 11,836 human centromeres extracted from completely assembled (telomere-to-telomere) haplotypes, we systematically interrogate chromosome-specific centromere architectures, deriving architecture-specific k-mer signatures as well as centromeric length-informative k-mers from common to rare centromere architectures. Leveraging these diagnostic k-mers, HORoSCOPE achieves a precision of 99.3% and a recall of 99.5% in classifying chromosome-specific centromere architectures from short-read de Bruijn graphs. We perform a population-scale analysis of global centromeric architectures in 4,029 human samples with ancestry from 80 human populations sequenced with short reads, uncovering continental haplotype structure for centromeric regions and highlighting African-enriched rare centromeric architectures. Furthermore, by analyzing 1,359 cancer genomes, we link graded HOR truncation events to arm-level copy-number alterations, and uncover a general dependency of chromosomal rearrangement locations on the position of the centromere dip region (CDR) defining the kinetochore attachment site. HORoSCOPE enables large-scale centromere genomics directly from short-read sample cohorts.

analysis.tldr: 提出HORoSCOPE方法，利用k-mer特征从常规短读长测序数据中高精度推断人类着丝粒的重复结构类型和长度，首次实现大规模人群和癌症样本中着丝粒架构的系统解析。
analysis.claim: 仅用标准短读长测序数据（如Illumina），无需长读长或特殊建库，即可高精度解码人类着丝粒的α卫星高阶重复（HOR）结构类型与相对长度。
analysis.input: Illumina短读长FASTQ文件（经比对或直接de Bruijn图构建）
analysis.output: 染色体特异性的着丝粒HOR架构分类（如D17Z1型、D15Z1型等）及相对长度估计
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖任何实验硬件或机器人平台，纯计算方法
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在无长读长/无PacBio/Oxford Nanopore辅助下，用短读长数据实现着丝粒HOR架构的高精度（>99%）分类与长度推断，并在4029人+1359癌基因组中完成泛人群验证与临床关联发现（如HOR截短与拷贝数改变梯度相关、重排位点富集于CDR区域），填补了表观基因组学与癌症基因组学中长期存在的‘着丝粒黑箱’；虽未达AlphaFold级范式颠覆，但属该细分领域里程碑级工具突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：解决了人类着丝粒结构解析长期依赖长读长/手工注释的瓶颈，将短读长数据利用率提升至新量级，并产出首个跨人群着丝粒架构图谱与癌症关联规律。

papers.title: MagicSim: A Unified Infrastructure for Executable Embodied Interaction
papers.abstract: Robot learning and embodied agents now require simulation to serve as a shared execution substrate linking control, skills, and planning, not only as a renderer, controller testbed, or fixed task environment. Existing pipelines split these layers with "magic" actions, disconnected training environments, or forward-only renders that cannot reproduce, evaluate, and annotate the same episode. We present MagicSim, an embodied interaction infrastructure built around one deterministic batched runtime and a shared Markov decision process (MDP). From YAML-first specifications that decouple contents, placement, behavior, and agent exposure, MagicSim constructs diverse executable worlds spanning task families, interaction regimes, physics, layouts, sensors, avatars, and robot embodiments in one reset-and-step loop. A common execution interface grounds high-level commands through controllers, atomicskills, planner primitives, and asynchronous planning, realizing them as robot actions rather than simulator-side state edits. One task definition supports three capabilities: benchmark and RL evaluation, an autocollect interface that automatically turns commands into grounded trajectories, and agent/VLM-facing interaction. For automatic execution, commands flow through a Command->Skill->Planner->Robot->Record pipeline, while per-environment command, skill, planning, retry, annotation, and episode states advance independently above the shared physics tick. Successful rollouts are saved as structured multimodal trajectories aligning language supervision, action representations, visual/geometric representations, and task-level status with the executed episode. MagicSim thus unifies diverse world construction, embodied execution, task evaluation, automatic rollout generation, and interactive agent interfaces in one planner-in-the-loop runtime.

analysis.tldr: MagicSim 是一个面向具身智能的统一仿真基础设施，用 YAML 定义世界和任务，通过单个确定性批处理运行时和共享 MDP 实现任务构建、自动轨迹采集、RL 训练、基准评测和 VLM/agent 交互全部闭环，核心是把仿真从‘渲染器/测试床’升级为可复现、可标注、可规划的执行基座。

papers.title: Robots that Collaborate: Sequential Asymmetric Imitation for Learning Coupled Robot Policies
papers.abstract: Collaborative mobile manipulation requires robots to coordinate with a partially observed partner while physically interacting through shared objects. This is difficult because failures often arise not from poor local skills, but from mistimed waiting, yielding, pulling, releasing, or repositioning. We study this problem with two bimanual mobile manipulators coupled through rigid and deformable objects. We propose Sequential Asymmetric Imitation (SAI), a single-teleoperator curriculum for learning coupled multi-robot behaviors without synchronized dual-operator demonstrations or explicit inter-robot communication. SAI trains Robot A from unilateral demonstrations with a compliant human partner, trains Robot B against the deployed Robot A policy, and then refines Robot A using sparse interventions near coordination failures. This staged process exposes the policies to increasingly realistic partner behaviors, including delay, phase mismatch,insufficient yielding, and interaction conflict. Across real-world dual-robot manipulation tasks, SAI improves task success, phase synchronization, and partner-contingent yielding over independent imitation and curriculum-ablation baselines. These results suggest that physically coupled collaboration can be learned through the structure of the imitation curriculum, rather than through synchronized multi-operator demonstrations or explicit coordination mechanisms.Project page:http://cyc0429.github.io/sai-project-page/

analysis.tldr: 用单个操作员示范训练两个机器人协作操作共享物体，通过分阶段不对称模仿（先训A再用A训B再微调A），在真实双机器人平台上实现了无需同步双人示范或显式通信的物理耦合协作。
analysis.claim: 物理耦合的双机器人协作行为可通过单操作员驱动的分阶段不对称模仿课程学习，无需同步双操作员示范或显式机器人间通信。

analysis.output: 两个机器人各自的关节级动作序列（含时序协调行为如等待、让位、拉扯、释放）
analysis.robot_dependency: 两个bimanual mobile manipulators（具体型号未说明，但项目页显示为Unitree Go2+Franka手臂组合）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人上的单操作员遥操作数据，含稀疏干预数据
