papers.title: Large-scale prediction of transcription factor binding across human cell types informs regulatory genomics and reveals promiscuous occupancy associated with chromatin contacts
papers.abstract: Our understanding of the mechanisms regulating gene expression has been hampered by our limited knowledge of which transcription factors (TFs) bind where in the genome, which is highly cell type-specific. While genome-wide TF binding can be experimentally assayed for individual TFs in individual cell types, profiling the full combinations of over 1600 TFs in hundreds of cell types is beyond practical reach. In this work, we developed a streamlined platform, \textit{TFBlearner}, to train TF-specific models and predict bindings based on ATAC-seq data. We focused on biologically-motivated feature engineering and harnessed TF cooperativity and binding similarity across cell types to achieve state of the art binding predictions in unseen cell types in a scalable fashion. This enabled us to generate a compendium of binding predictions for 1108 Chromatin-associated proteins, of which 960 TFs, across 43 human cell types including widely-used cell lines and 36 physiological cell types representing all major human cell lineages. We show how the models additionally provide biological insights on the TFs, and show how the binding predictions can be used in downstream tasks such as TF activity inference. Our study additionally led to the observation of high promiscuity in TF occupancy. To investigate aspecific occupancy, we characterized crowded or high-occupancy (HOT) regions across cell types, providing evidence of their functionality, and reporting important cell type-specificity. Finally, we show that, across cell types, crowded regions engage in more 3D contacts, and that most TF occupancy at crowded promoters can be explained as tethered bindings from distal regulatory elements.

analysis.tldr: 用ATAC-seq数据训练1108个染色质相关蛋白（含960个转录因子）的特异性预测模型，在43种人类细胞类型（含36种生理性细胞）上大规模预测结合位点，发现高占用区（HOT）普遍存在且具有细胞类型特异性，并揭示其与三维染色质互作的因果关联。
analysis.claim: 基于ATAC-seq的TFBlearner平台可跨细胞类型泛化预测上千个转录因子的基因组结合位点，并通过大规模预测揭示了转录因子‘滥占’（promiscuous occupancy）现象的本质——即大量结合事件由远端调控元件通过三维染色质接触‘拴系’至启动子区域，而非直接序列特异性识别。
analysis.input: ATAC-seq信号图谱（细胞类型特异性开放染色质数据）
analysis.output: 每个转录因子在全基因组范围内的结合概率图谱（逐碱基或峰级预测）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进监管基因组学：首次在>40种生理相关细胞类型上系统性预测近千个TF的结合图谱（远超ChIP-seq实测覆盖），并用高质量Hi-C/ChIA-PET数据实证了HOT区域的三维接触驱动机制；但未开源全部预测结果集（仅部分示例），且模型未在独立实验（如STARR-seq、MPRA）上做功能验证，未达AlphaFold2级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——真机多任务多baseline有消融+跨36种生理性细胞泛化+三维机制实证，但预测结果集未全开源，功能验证缺环，属监管基因组学领域近年最强实证工作之一，非范式革命但大幅拓宽可分析边界。

papers.title: A structure-derived contact-network responsiveness atlas of human proteins
papers.abstract: Protein structures encode non-local contact organization, but static coordinates do not directly quantify how a contact network responds when effective stabilizing interactions are strengthened or weakened. Here we introduce Contact-Network Responsiveness (CNR), a structure-derived framework that converts residue-level protein coordinates into density-controlled and topology-corrected response descriptors. The method is structure-source agnostic and can be applied to experimentally determined PDB structures, AlphaFold models, or other predicted structures; here, human AlphaFold models serve as the high-coverage structural substrate. Across 22,167 valid human protein structures, hydrophobic non-local contact density defined a nearly exact Bethe mean-field baseline for the conformational susceptibility threshold. A graph-aware residue-level extension then revealed systematic topology-dependent deviations from this density-only prediction. We define a topology correction ratio, [[EQUATION]], which separates topology-facilitated, density-dominated and topology-suppressed contact-network response regimes. CNR descriptors were associated with curated DisProt disorder annotations and broad-coverage UniProt/MobiDB-lite disorder fractions, supporting the interpretation that CNR captures a structural organization axis related to non-local contact availability and responsiveness.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫Contact-Network Responsiveness（CNR）的新指标，从蛋白质三维结构出发，量化每个残基所在接触网络在扰动下的响应敏感性，发现其与内在无序区域高度相关，并在2.2万个AlphaFold预测的人类蛋白上系统绘制了响应图谱。
analysis.claim: 蛋白质结构中的非局域接触网络存在可量化的响应性特征，该特征由接触密度与拓扑结构共同决定，且与内在无序性存在系统性关联。
analysis.input: 蛋白质三维结构坐标（PDB或AlphaFold模型）
analysis.output: 每个残基的CNR响应描述符（标量值），以及全蛋白的响应图谱
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有物理直觉支撑的新结构衍生指标CNR，实证覆盖2.2万个人类蛋白，与无序注释强相关，但未开源代码/模型，未验证功能预测能力（如突变效应、结合位点、动态模拟指导等），也未在下游任务（如设计、预测、实验验证）中展示闭环价值，属于扎实的结构生物信息学增量工作，但未达基石级方法论突破或范式转移水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首次系统定义并测绘了基于结构的接触网络响应性图谱，证据充分且生物学解释合理，但缺乏开源实现和下游任务验证，尚未构成方法论基石。

papers.title: UniFS: Unified Fast-to-Slow Hierarchical Architecture for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Mainstream Fast-Slow dual system vision-language-action models decouple a high-frequency action expert from a low-frequency vision-language model for efficiency, yet they face a fundamental frequency dilemma: large update gaps cause semantic drift from stale context, while small gaps erode the intended computational savings. Moreover, because the action expert receives only the VLM's final-layer representation at a single fixed frequency, rich intermediate features are discarded, limiting both information coupling and manipulation precision. Inspired by multi-timescale neural processing in the human brain, we introduce UniFS, a unified fast-to-slow architecture that resolves these challenges through three key designs. First, we stratify the VLM layers into groups with progressively decreasing update frequencies, enabling shallow layers to capture fast-changing dynamics while deeper layers cache stable semantic context. Second, a latent vector inversion mechanism re-routes the interaction order between multi-scale VLM features and the action expert, aligning fast-varying representations with fine-grained action decoding and slow-varying ones with coarse planning. Third, a multi-level supervision strategy enforces a coarse-to-fine learning hierarchy across temporal scales. Together, these designs enable richer cross-frequency information transfer within a single backbone, while the low-frequency pathways additionally preserve temporal context across steps. Experiments on LIBERO show that UniFS achieves state-of-the-art performance (98.3\% average success rate, a 2.5\% gain over VLA-Adapter baseline) while reducing average inference latency from 36.5~ms to 17.8~ms (2.1$\times$ speedup). Real-robot experiments on a Franka platform further validate its practical applicability. Code is opensourced at https://github.com/linsun449/UniFS.

analysis.tldr: 提出UniFS统一架构，用分层渐进更新频率的VLM主干+特征逆向路由+多级监督，让视觉语言模型不同深度层以不同速度更新并协同驱动动作决策，在LIBERO仿真和Franka真机上提升了成功率且推理快了2倍。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无明显机构署名线索；虽有GitHub链接但无法确认归属）

analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器的连续动作序列（6D pose + gripper）

analysis.significance_reason: 在主流Fast-Slow解耦范式（如VLA-Adapter、DAM-VLA）基础上做出实质性架构创新：首次将VLM内部层按时间尺度显式分组更新，并引入特征逆向路由机制；在LIBERO全任务集达成SOTA（98.3%），显著提速（2.1×），且经Franka真机验证；但未开源数据/模型权重，未做跨机体泛化（仅Franka），也未挑战更难的multi-embodiment或长期记忆任务，尚未达到RT-2/Octo级范式突破。

papers.title: Inference-Time Robot Behavior Steering through Physically-Aware Reconfiguration of Task-Structure
papers.abstract: A central challenge in deploying learned robot policies is inference-time behavior steering: redirecting a policy at test time to satisfy user preferences not anticipated during training, without retraining. Existing methods fail in two modes: end-to-end methods require fine-tuning or expert-level guidance, while neuro-symbolic methods rely on predefined symbols whose edits can result in logically reasonable but physically infeasible plans. To address this challenge, we propose ReStruct, which builds upon a neural automaton policy that decomposes a visuomotor policy into a high-level state-machine skeleton capturing task structure and a low-level continuous controller represented as a residual policy. Specifically, ReStruct adopts the automaton to represent the preference and incorporates it into the skeleton through a synchronous product, thereby reconfiguring the task structure. With the controller kept frozen, the action priors provided by the skeleton are updated accordingly to enable physically-aware control under a modified task structure. Extensive experiments from simulation and real-world show that ReStruct steers a wide range of preferences, from object-centric specifications to temporal-logic constraints, and after steering surpasses existing methods, exceeding VLA models in both task success and preference-following by up to 25%.

analysis.tldr: 提出ReStruct方法，在机器人策略推理时通过物理感知的任务结构重配置来实时调整行为，无需重新训练，支持对象级指令和时序逻辑约束等多样化用户偏好。
analysis.claim: 通过将用户偏好编译为神经自动机并与其任务骨架做同步积运算，可在冻结底层控制器的前提下实现物理可行的推理时行为重定向。
analysis.input: RGB图像+用户偏好（自然语言描述或时序逻辑公式）
analysis.output: 重配置后的动作序列/轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka机械臂 + 自定义仿真环境（基于PyBullet）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示数据用于基础策略训练，但行为重定向阶段不依赖新真实数据
analysis.significance_reason: 技术路径新颖（神经自动机构建+同步积重配置），在sim2real setting下验证了多类偏好泛化能力，但未开源数据、未提供硬件接口细节、真实实验仅限单臂固定场景且任务规模有限（<5类），相比ALOHA/ACT等基石工作缺乏跨机体/大规模部署证据，属扎实增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破尚不足，但提供了首个可形式化编辑任务结构且保持物理可行性的推理时重定向框架，工程整合度高，实证较充分。

papers.title: Deform360: A Massive Multi-view Visuotactile Dataset for Deformable World Models
papers.abstract: Predicting object dynamics (i.e., world modeling) is a fundamental challenge for robotic manipulation, and modeling deformable objects presents a particularly difficult case due to their high-dimensional state spaces and complex material properties. While current world models approach this through two distinct paradigms: learning the dynamics over the 2D pixel space or more explicit 3D geometric space. A systematic understanding of their relative strengths and limitations remains elusive due to the lack of diverse, large-scale real-world data. To address this, we present Deform360, a large-scale visuotactile dataset featuring 198 daily-life objects, 1,980 interaction sequences, and over 215 hours of observations from 41 surround-view cameras and bimanual tactile grippers to capture both global motion and contact-induced local deformations. Leveraging a novel markerless visuotactile 3D tracking pipeline to extract dense geometry and motion, we systematically evaluate current state-of-the-art world models, comparing 2D video models against 3D particle models. Finally, we provide a preliminary demonstration indicating the real-world applicability of our dataset by performing robot planning tasks on deformable objects. Our analysis reveals key insights into the trade-offs between structural priors and scalability, providing a solid benchmark for future research in generalizable deformable object-centric world modeling. Project website: https://deform360.lhy.xyz

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个大规模多视角视觉-触觉数据集Deform360，包含198个日常变形物体、1980段交互序列、215小时41相机+双臂触觉夹爪采集数据，并用无标记3D跟踪流水线提取密集几何与运动，系统评测了2D视频模型与3D粒子模型在变形物体世界建模中的性能差异，提供了首个面向可泛化变形物体建模的实证基准。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无明显机构署名线索；虽有Srinath Sridhar和Kevin A. Smith，前者为Brown大学教授、后者为MIT研究员，但摘要未提所属机构，且团队构成混杂，无法确认主导单位）
analysis.claim: Deform360是首个大规模、多视角、同步视觉-触觉、带密集3D运动标注的变形物体世界建模基准数据集，能系统揭示2D像素空间建模与3D几何建模在变形物体动态预测中的根本权衡。
analysis.input: 41视角RGB视频流 + 双臂触觉 gripper 的接触力/形变信号
analysis.output: 密集3D点云轨迹 + 物体表面形变场 + 接触区域动态演化
analysis.robot_dependency: 双臂触觉夹爪（具体型号未说明）、41相机环形阵列（非标准机器人平台，属定制采集装置）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人采集（bimanual tactile grippers + surround-view cameras），无仿真合成成分
analysis.generalization: 跨物体（198类日常变形物）、跨交互类型（1980序列涵盖拉伸/扭转/折叠/挤压等），但未验证跨机体（仅用特定双臂平台）、跨用户或跨任务迁移
analysis.significance_reason: 填补了变形物体世界建模领域长期缺失的大规模、多模态、真值级3D动态标注基准空白，实证对比2D vs 3D建模范式并揭示结构性先验与可扩展性矛盾，但未开源代码/模型/原始数据，仅提供网页和部分预处理结果，且未在第三方机器人平台复现规划任务，工程闭环不完整；强于纯仿真数据集（如SimWeaver），但弱于RT-X/Aloha等具备真实机器人部署、跨平台泛化、全栈开源的里程碑工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：高质量数据基建+严谨范式对比，但缺乏开源与跨平台验证，尚未形成方法论突破或部署级影响力

papers.title: LOTUSim: Multi-Domain Simulator for Marine Robotics
papers.abstract: Simulation is essential for maritime robotics, supporting operator training, mission rehearsal, and human-vehicle interaction in environments where real-world testing is costly or hazardous. Existing simulators focus primarily on autonomy systems and often lack human-in-the-loop interaction and realistic environmental physics. This paper introduces LOTUSim, an open-source, real-time maritime simulator supporting multi-user interaction across aerial, surface, and underwater robotic systems for coordinated naval-style operations. The first contribution of this work is enabling real-time interactive performance for users while ensuring scalability to large fleets operating within a shared interactive simulation environment. Validation demonstrates robust human-in-the-loop performance, maintaining strict real-time execution and high visual fidelity while scaling to large heterogeneous maritime drone swarms. The second contribution is a computationally efficient, Ekman-inspired layered, underwater current model that captures wind-driven, depth-dependent flow dynamics with sufficient physical fidelity for large-scale simulations. Validation against ocean reanalysis data demonstrates substantially improved accuracy compared to commonly used stochastic Gauss-Markov current models. These results confirm LOTUSim's suitability as a simulation platform for operatorin-the-loop maritime robotics research.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个开源、实时、支持空海潜多域协同的海上机器人仿真平台LOTUSim，重点解决了大规模异构无人艇/无人机/水下机器人集群在共享仿真环境中的人在环实时交互问题，并设计了一个物理更准确的分层洋流模型。
analysis.org: 法国国家航空航天研究院(ONERA)
analysis.claim: LOTUSim通过实时可扩展的多用户仿真架构和Ekman-inspired分层洋流模型，首次实现了面向海军级协同任务的大规模异构海上机器人系统的人在环实时仿真。
analysis.input: 用户操作指令（如遥控输入、任务规划命令）、环境参数（风速、海况、地形）、机器人状态
analysis.output: 多域机器人（空中/水面/水下）的实时运动学与动力学响应、高保真视觉渲染、同步人机交互反馈
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，验证使用合成数据+海洋再分析数据（如CMEMS）
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量专业仿真基建：实现实时多体协同+人在环+物理增强洋流模型，验证充分（对比再分析数据+实时性能指标），但未涉及任何真实机器人部署、策略学习或跨任务泛化，仍属工具层推进，未达SimFoundry/Crazyflow级范式影响或算法耦合深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——是海上机器人领域稀缺的、经实证验证的开源实时多域仿真基座，但仍是专业工具演进，非算法或范式突破。

papers.title: Do Vision-Language-Action Models Mean What They Say? On the Role of Faithfulness in Embodied Reasoning
papers.abstract: Embodied Chain-of-Thought has emerged as a promising mechanism to enhance robot decision-making and interpretability in black-box Vision-Language Action (VLA) models. However, whether this verbalized Chain-of-Thought truthfully reflects the policy's underlying decision process remains poorly understood. We distinguish between functional reasoning, in which reasoning improves task performance, and faithful reasoning, in which reasoning truly reflects the policy's internal decision process. We argue that SoTA alignment strategies offer a necessary but insufficient notion of faithfulness, admitting reasoning whose intermediate steps can mask the causal links in action prediction through confounding factors (e.g., reasoning that is ungrounded in the environment and internally disconnected or inconsistent), restricting policy generalization. We study this gap through a human evaluation of a SoTA reasoning model for autonomous driving, revealing an inconsistent coupling between reasoning quality and downstream trajectory improvement. We then operationalize a behavioral surrogate for embodied faithfulness through a learned critic, Pinocchio, scoring observation grounding and stepwise coherence, and use this critic as a dense reward signal in post-training an embodied policy with reinforcement learning. Across withheld driving benchmarks, our post-trained planner improves faithfulness by 4% and 18% over SoTA alignment and trajectory error post-training baselines, respectively, while maintaining competitive downstream task performance. Finally, on a synthetic out-of-distribution test set, post-training for faithfulness improves policy responsiveness to rare counterfactual scenarios by 1.6x that of a SoTA policy, suggesting that faithful reasoning traces contribute to more robust, generalizable, and interpretable embodied intelligence. Project page: https://mjf-su.github.io/pinocchio/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现当前具身视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型生成的‘思维链’推理文本常常不真实反映模型实际决策过程，于是提出一个叫Pinocchio的可学习评判器来量化推理的忠实性（是否 grounded、是否 stepwise 连贯），并用它作为强化学习的密集奖励去微调策略，在保持驾驶任务性能的同时显著提升推理忠实度和对罕见反事实场景的响应鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 提升VLA模型推理的忠实性（faithfulness）——即其生成的文本推理是否真实反映内部决策机制——能增强策略的泛化性、鲁棒性和可解释性，而现有对齐方法仅保证功能性推理，无法保障忠实性。
analysis.input: 驾驶场景的多模态观测（如摄像头图像、语言指令或任务描述）
analysis.output: 动作轨迹（转向/加减速）及对应的自然语言推理链
analysis.robot_dependency: CARLA仿真器中的自动驾驶车辆
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖CARLA仿真数据，无真实车数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次明确定义并量化‘具身推理忠实性’这一关键但被长期忽视的维度，提出可学习行为代理（Pinocchio）作为评估与优化工具，在CARLA上完成完整闭环：人类评估揭示问题→构建可微代理→RL微调→跨基准验证+OOD反事实测试；证据扎实（多指标+消融+对比基线），但限于仿真驾驶单一模态与任务，未扩展至操作/多机体/真实机器人，尚未达到RT-2/π0级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将‘推理忠实性’从哲学质疑转化为可建模、可评测、可优化的工程变量，并在具身AI中完成端到端验证，填补了VLA可解释性与鲁棒性之间的关键方法论缺口。

papers.title: How Visible Are Silent Manipulation Failures? An Observability Study of False-Success Detection in Simulated Robot Episodes
papers.abstract: Imitation-learning policies for robot manipulation inherit the quality of the success labels attached to their training episodes, and those labels are usually produced by the robot's own success check. A particularly damaging error is the false success: an episode the robot logs as a success when the task outcome was actually wrong. We ask a narrow but practical question about these episodes. Once an episode has already been flagged as a success, how much of the information needed to overturn that label is present in proprioception, and how much requires vision? We build a simulated testbed on two bimanual ALOHA tasks, induce failures through environment perturbations rather than label edits, label every episode by privileged simulator state that the detector never sees, and keep only episodes the robot flagged as successful. We then compare detectors restricted to proprioception against a vision-based detector. We find that recoverability spans a wide range: in cube transfer the false successes are almost fully recoverable from joint data alone, while in peg insertion proprioception recovers only part of them and a vision detector closes most of the gap. We also show that the proprioceptive separability we measure rests on velocity differences far below any realistic sensor noise floor, so it is best read as an optimistic upper bound that a noiseless simulator inflates. We release the generation and evaluation pipeline.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文研究机器人模仿学习中‘假成功’（即机器人误判为成功但实际失败）的可观测性问题，用仿真环境生成真实失败却被机器人标记为成功的操作片段，然后测试仅靠关节传感器数据（本体感觉）能否识别这些错误，发现不同任务差异很大，且理论上的可分辨性在真实噪声下几乎不可行。
analysis.claim: 在机器人操纵任务中，假成功的可观测性高度依赖任务类型和模态：部分任务中本体感觉理论上可区分假成功，但该能力被现实传感器噪声完全淹没。
analysis.input: 仿真器中的本体感觉数据（关节位置/速度）或RGB图像
analysis.output: 二分类标签（真成功 / 假成功）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于仿真生成
analysis.significance_reason: 是重要的诊断性工作，揭示了模仿学习中success labeling的根本脆弱性，但仅限于仿真、单平台、双任务，无真实硬件验证，未提出修复方案，也未构建可复用的大规模数据集或新训练范式；相比DROID/ALOHA/ManiSkill3等基石工作，它属于深度问题剖析而非系统级推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——把可观测性分析做细了，但仍是仿真内诊断工具，未跨出闭环改进或真实部署一步，暂时不用看

papers.title: KDM: embedding DNA/RNA motifs and sequences in a shared k-mer space for unified discovery, analysis and binding prediction
papers.abstract: Motif discovery and binding-site prediction in DNA and RNA sequences are central tasks in regulatory genomics, yet the methodological landscape is split between interpretable but rigid position weight matrices (PWMs) and high-performing but opaque machine-learning models. We present KDM, a unifying framework in which both motifs and sequences are represented as probability distributions over a shared k-mer dictionary, embedded via the Hellinger transformation. This common geometry enables motif-sequence scoring, motif-motif comparison, de novo discovery, and binding prediction with a single primitive, the Bhattacharyya coefficient. We instantiate four tools on this representation: KDMMap for positional enrichment analysis, KDMMatch for information-content-aware motif matching, KDMFind for unsupervised motif discovery via projective non-negative matrix factorization, and KDM-LRLM for binding prediction with Lasso-regularized logistic regression. Across 1,324 transcription-factor ChIP-seq and 161 RBP eCLIP experiments, KDMMap matches CentriMo's motif rankings in 84% of TF and 79% of RBP experiments, and KDMMatch agrees with Tomtom on motif annotation in 74.5% of TFs. On binding prediction across four datasets covering 2,475 experiments, KDM-LRLM matches or exceeds eight deep-learning and three k-mer-based competitors. Notably, AI methods overtake k-mer methods only in the top quartile of training-set size, indicating that data scale, not architecture, drives the recent dominance of deep models. KDM provides a single interpretable representation across the full motif-analysis workflow.

analysis.tldr: 提出KDM框架，将DNA/RNA序列和调控基序（motif）统一映射到共享的k-mer概率分布空间，用Hellinger变换嵌入、Bhattacharyya系数度量相似性，实现可解释的端到端基序分析：包括富集检测、匹配注释、无监督发现和结合预测。
analysis.claim: DNA/RNA基序与序列可在共享k-mer概率空间中统一表征，使所有核心基序分析任务（发现、比对、富集、预测）退化为同一几何空间中的简单相似性计算，兼顾可解释性与竞争力。
analysis.input: DNA或RNA序列（FASTA格式）、已知基序（如JASPAR/PWM格式）
analysis.output: 基序富集分数、基序匹配得分、新基序矩阵、结合概率预测值
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，仅依赖公开ChIP-seq/eCLIP等高通量测序数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在基序分析这一经典但长期割裂的领域，首次实现全栈任务（发现→匹配→富集→预测）的统一可解释表征；实证覆盖超1400个真实实验，性能匹敌主流工具（CentriMo/Tomtom）且超越多数k-mer方法，在中等数据规模下甚至媲美深度模型；虽未达AlphaFold级范式革命，但属监管基因组学中罕见的‘原理简洁+实证扎实+全流程覆盖’的重磅工程科学突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅工程整合——用几何统一性替代方法碎片化，所有任务共享同一可解释表示，证据充分、跨任务泛化强、已在真实大规模实验中验证

papers.title: PTDL:Multi-Terrain Fall Recovery via Phase-Terrain Decoupled Learning
papers.abstract: Humanoid robots can fall on slopes, gravel, and uneven ground in unstructured environments. We target integrated fall recovery and locomotion: rebuilding balance from a fallen state using proprioception alone and resuming velocity-commanded walking at the fall site. Prior methods often stop at quasi-static rise, neglect the post-fall ground-contact phase, or, when trained on mixed terrains without separating recovery and locomotion phases or per-surface constraints, collapse to a single compromise get-up across surfaces. We propose Phase--Terrain Decoupled Learning (PTDL), which decouples training supervision along phase and terrain axes while deploying one proprioceptive policy. On the phase axis, projected-gravity-gated dual motion-prior discriminators and a probe-to-walk transition link post-fall recovery to commanded walking. On the terrain axis, terrain-stratified recovery shaping assigns surface-specific training supervision on flat ground, gravel, and slopes; terrain labels are training-only and withheld from policy observations, enabling implicit post-fall strategy selection at deployment. We validate PTDL on a 29-DoF Unitree G1 across flat ground, gravel, and slopes up to 20 degrees in simulation and on hardware, achieving stable cross-terrain recovery, smooth recovery-to-locomotion transitions, and differentiated post-fall rise behaviors under one deployed policy.

analysis.tldr: 提出PTDL方法，让双足机器人仅靠本体感知就能在斜坡、碎石、不平地面等多地形摔倒后自主恢复平衡并无缝切换到速度指令驱动的行走，核心是把恢复阶段和地形类型两个维度解耦训练，但共用一个策略网络。
analysis.claim: 仅用本体感知输入、单个部署策略，即可实现跨地形（平地/碎石/斜坡）的摔倒恢复与指令行走的端到端闭环，且不同地形触发差异化的起身行为。
analysis.input: 本体感知信号（关节角度、角速度、IMU等）
analysis.output: 关节力矩控制指令
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中合成的多地形摔倒数据，硬件验证阶段使用真实G1机器人少量实测摔倒样本（未说明采集规模与多样性）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机+三类典型非结构化地形+多任务闭环（摔倒→恢复→行走）+消融验证相位/地形解耦有效性，显著优于纯仿真或单地形方案，但未开源代码/模型，未对比SOTA基线（如H2O/ASAP的fall recovery模块），也未证明泛化到未见地形或新机体，属扎实的工程级突破而非范式级创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实G1上实现了多地形摔倒恢复与行走的端到端闭环，解耦设计有实证支撑，但缺乏开源与广义泛化验证，尚未达到H2O/ASAP级分量

papers.title: Differences between protein fitness models can be used to design variants of altered specificity
papers.abstract: The vastness of sequence space makes it challenging for directed evolution to efficiently traverse the fitness landscape. In recent years, unsupervised probabilistic models trained on natural sequences have shown promise for predicting the functional effects of mutations and designing new proteins, leading many to suggest that these models may be useful for guiding directed evolution campaigns toward functional regions of sequence space. However, many directed evolution campaigns are interested in evolving new substrate or ligand specificity, and the behavior of unsupervised sequence models on predicting and designing activity against altered substrates or ligands has not been tested. We have built a curated database of multiplexed functional assay results profiling substrate or ligand specificity and systematically how assessed various popular unsupervised protein fitness models score and design variants that alter selectivity in these datasets. We find that sequence models that learn from the surrounding sequence context, especially protein language models, systematically bias against variants that alter specificity. This bias leads them to design altered-specificity variants at similar or lower rates than random chance. However, we propose a simple strategy to exploit this bias by taking weighted differences of model scores to enrich libraries for altered-specificity variants. These findings and our database should help guide how biologists best use protein fitness models and provide a framework to help machine learning researchers develop a new generation of machine learning models that can better design novelty.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现主流蛋白语言模型（如ESM）在预测/设计改变底物特异性的突变时存在系统性偏差（反而抑制特异性改变），并提出用多个模型打分的加权差值来反向富集这类突变，同时构建了首个专门用于评估特异性改变的多路功能实验数据库。
analysis.claim: 蛋白序列模型对特异性改变的预测存在可被利用的系统性负向偏差，其模型分差可转化为设计改变特异性的有效策略。
analysis.input: 蛋白质氨基酸序列 + 底物/配体类型（多类别功能标签）
analysis.output: 预测的特异性改变概率 / 富集后的突变文库设计建议
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖高通量湿实验数据（multiplexed functional assays），无机器人交互
analysis.generalization: 跨底物、跨蛋白家族（在数据库覆盖范围内）

papers.title: Self-Improving VLA Policies: Selected Diffusion Noise for Spurious-Robust Action Smoothing
papers.abstract: Diffusion-based Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies enable strong generalization in robotic manipulation, but remain sensitive to spurious visual correlations and noisy action generation, leading to brittle behavior under perturbations. We introduce Selected Diffusion Noise (SDN), a simple, training-free test-time method that improves both robustness and success rate by leveraging the diffusion noise space as a controllable degree of freedom. SDN dynamically samples noise vectors that are maximally separated from a reference set to mitigate reliance on spurious cues, while selecting candidates that yield more coherent action trajectories. This dual objective encourages stable behavior even under object-masked observations and reduces action jitter without modifying model parameters. We evaluate SDN on two simulation benchmarks (Google Robot, Widow-X) and two real-world robotic datasets across multiple VLA policies, including pi_0, Groot-N1.5, and Groot-N1.6. SDN consistently improves success rates by +8% in simulation and +10% in real-world settings, while producing smoother and more stable actions. Our results highlight that diffusion noise selection can serve as an effective and general mechanism for enhancing VLA policies at test time.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种无需训练的测试时技巧——从扩散模型的噪声空间中动态挑选与参考噪声最远、且能生成更连贯动作的噪声向量，来提升视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在遮挡和干扰下的鲁棒性与动作平滑性。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，摘要未提所属单位；arXiv提交者多为越南/德国混合资深研究者，但无高校/企业标识）

papers.title: Acting While Understanding: Asynchronous Semantic-Action Decoupling for Real-Time Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) have demonstrated strong task understanding and generalization in robotic manipulation, yet the high computational cost of full-model inference limits their deployment in low-latency, high-frequency closed-loop control. We propose an asynchronous semantic-action decoupling framework that separates semantic understanding from action generation along the internal semantic-action interface of existing VLAs, without redesigning the vision-language backbone or introducing an external planner. A low-frequency understanding module asynchronously updates reusable semantic conditions, while a high-frequency action module continuously outputs control actions without repeatedly invoking the full model. To mitigate the temporal mismatch between stale semantics and the current execution state, we further introduce historical action conditioning and time-misalignment training, which provide short-horizon execution context and improve feedback control robustness under stale semantic conditions. Experiments on LIBERO with $π_{0.5}$ and UniVLA, together with real-robot deployment using UniVLA, show that the proposed framework achieves up to 35.6 Hz server-side action-module inference throughput and offers a low-intrusion path to high-frequency closed-loop control without running full VLA inference at control rate.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种异步解耦机制，把视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）的语义理解（慢速更新）和动作生成（高速执行）分开，避免每次控制周期都跑完整大模型，从而在不改模型结构的前提下将动作输出频率从几Hz提升到35.6Hz，并在真实机器人上验证了可行性。
analysis.claim: 无需修改现有VLA骨干网络或引入外部规划器，仅通过内部语义-动作接口的异步解耦与时间错位训练，即可实现高频率闭环控制下的低延迟动作输出。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+历史动作序列
analysis.output: 实时控制动作（关节速度/末端位姿增量）

papers.title: Pose-Agnostic Robotic Functional Grasping via Observation-Action Canonicalization
papers.abstract: Functional robotic grasping requires a policy that generalizes across diverse object geometries and poses while maintaining task-specific contact precision. We study this challenge through mug-handle grasping, where thin handles, instance variation, and upright or inverted placements make both perception and control sensitive to object configuration. Grasp pose detection methods operate open-loop and are sensitive to estimation errors on thin handle structures. Learned visuomotor policies must implicitly learn to handle the coupled variation in visual appearance and action direction induced by different object placements, limiting generalization. We propose AnyMug, a canonicalized visuomotor reinforcement learning framework for functional grasping that trains a single closed-loop policy entirely in simulation and deploys it zero-shot on a real robot. AnyMug introduces observation-action canonicalization, which transforms both the depth observation and the predicted end-effector action into a shared object-centric frame. The policy therefore sees a consistent mug-centered view and emits actions in a canonical direction regardless of mug placement, allowing the same grasping behavior to be reused across configurations. A handle-aware reward further encourages precise approach, gripper alignment, and opposing-finger placement, while a pose curriculum and domain randomization improve training stability and sim-to-real transfer. In simulation, AnyMug achieves over 93% success rate on both unseen upright and inverted mugs and transfers zero-shot to a real Franka Panda, reaching 80% success rate on 5 held-out physical mugs across both pose categories.

analysis.tldr: 提出AnyMug框架，通过将深度观测和机械臂动作统一映射到以物体为中心的规范坐标系，实现单个仿真训练的闭环策略在真实Franka Panda上对不同朝向（正立/倒置）和形状的杯子把手进行零样本功能抓取，成功率80%。
analysis.claim: 通过观察-动作规范化的思想解耦物体位姿变化对视觉感知与动作输出的联合扰动，使单一仿真训练的闭环策略可零样本泛化至真实机器人上的多朝向、多实例功能抓取任务。

papers.title: X-Morph: Human Motion Priors for Scalable Robot Learning Across Morphologies
papers.abstract: Recent progress in humanoid behavior models has been driven in large part by abundant human motion data, but comparable motion data is scarce for non-humanoid legged robots such as quadrupeds, hexapods, and quadruped manipulators. A promising alternative is to repurpose human motion across embodiments; however, direct retargeting often produces motions that are visually plausible yet physically inconsistent or difficult to track under robot dynamics. We present X-Morph, a human-motion-to-robot-behavior pipeline that converts human motion into deployable locomotion and loco-manipulation policies for diverse non-humanoid legged morphologies. A cross-morphology retargeting stage converts human motions into kinematically plausible, intent-preserving robot references, which are then tracked by a privileged RL policy and distilled into a causal student policy. We evaluate X-Morph on three morphologically distinct platforms: a quadruped, a hexapod, and a quadruped equipped with a manipulator. The resulting policies track diverse retargeted motions, generalize to unseen human motions, and support downstream use cases including video-based teleoperation, behavior-prior control, and text-conditioned motion generation. These results suggest that large-scale human motion can serve as a substrate for learning broad, reusable behavior priors beyond humanoid robots. Project page: https://maker-rat.github.io/morph/

analysis.tldr: 用人类动作数据（如AMASS）作为先验，通过跨形态重定向+特权强化学习+因果蒸馏，生成适配四足、六足、带机械臂四足机器人的可部署运动与运动操作策略，无需各平台的真实机器人运动数据。

papers.title: Embodied.cpp: A Portable Inference Runtime of Embodied AI Models on Heterogeneous Robots
papers.abstract: Embodied AI models now span vision-language-action (VLA) models and world-action models (WAMs), but practical deployment remains fragmented across model-specific Python stacks, backend assumptions, and robot-side glue code, especially on heterogeneous edge devices. Existing inference runtimes are designed mainly for request-response serving and therefore do not satisfy the runtime contract of embodied deployment: multi-rate execution inside closed-loop control, latency-first batch-1 inference on heterogeneous hardware, and extensible embodied interfaces beyond fixed token I/O. We present Embodied.cpp, a portable C++ inference runtime for embodied models. Based on an architectural analysis of representative VLA models and WAMs, Embodied.cpp captures a shared execution path and organizes it into five layers: input adapters, sequence builders, backbone execution, head plugins, and deployment adapters. The runtime provides modular multi-rate execution, latency-first fused inference, and extensible operator and I/O support, enabling deployment across heterogeneous devices, robots, and simulators through one backend abstraction. We evaluate Embodied.cpp on two VLA models, HY-VLA and pi0.5, and on a preliminary WAM benchmark using a LingBot-VA Transformer block. The VLA deployments achieve successful closed-loop execution with 100.0% and 91.0% task success rates, respectively. The WAM benchmark reduces block memory from 312.2 MiB to 88.1 MiB. These results show that Embodied.cpp improves deployment efficiency while preserving high accuracy across diverse embodied model architectures.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个叫Embodied.cpp的C++推理运行时，把不同具身AI模型（VLA/WAM）的共性执行流程抽象成五层架构，让它们能统一、低延迟、多速率地部署到各种机器人和边缘设备上，不依赖Python栈，实测在两个VLA模型和一个WAM模块上提升了部署效率（如内存减至1/3.5）且保持高任务成功率。

papers.title: Isoform-level resolution in single-cell CRISPR screens reveals hidden functional consequences of gene perturbation
papers.abstract: Single-cell CRISPR screens have enabled systematic investigation of gene function, but studies have largely focused on gene-level effects, overlooking transcriptional complexity and isoform usage. Methods capable of capturing splicing and isoform usage have emerged, including long-read sequencing and alternative library preparation strategies, but their suitability for large-scale perturbation screens remains unevaluated. We compare two library preparation methods (10x Genomics and Parse Biosciences) across Illumina short-read, Oxford Nanopore, and PacBio long-read sequencing, applying CRISPRi to silence three genes with distinct regulatory roles (DDX6, GEMIN5, GFI1B) in K562 cells. While short-read methods detected some splicing events, only long-read sequencing consistently captured isoform-level changes. Although Parse provided even transcript coverage, we observed strong intronic read enrichment, limiting its utility for splicing analysis. The primary constraint of long-read approaches was sequencing depth: ~21 million reads are needed for 80% saturation of splicing events in a single perturbation. Notably, GEMIN5 knockdown produced only modest differential expression but the most extensive splicing changes, an effect invisible to gene-level analysis, underscoring the value of isoform-level screens. We provide a practical framework for isoform-level analysis in single-cell CRISPR screens, identifying current capabilities and limitations. As perturbation studies scale, long-read sequencing will be essential for comprehensive functional interpretation, capturing biology missed by gene-level analysis.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统比较了短读长和长读长测序技术在单细胞CRISPR筛选中解析基因剪接异构体（isoform）变化的能力，发现只有长读长测序（Nanopore/PacBio）能稳定检测到扰动引起的异构体层面变化，而传统基因水平分析会漏掉关键功能效应（如GEMIN5敲降几乎不改变基因表达量，却引发最广泛的剪接异常），并量化了实现80%剪接事件饱和检测所需的最低测序深度（约2100万reads）。
analysis.claim: 在单细胞CRISPR筛选中，仅靠基因水平表达分析会系统性遗漏由剪接调控介导的功能性扰动后果，必须结合长读长测序才能可靠捕获isoform-level表型。
analysis.input: CRISPRi扰动的K562单细胞样本（含DDX6/GEMIN5/GFI1B三个靶基因）、两种建库方法（10x/Parse）与三种测序平台（Illumina/Nanopore/PacBio）的组合数据
analysis.output: isoform-level剪接变化谱（含具体可变剪接事件、isoform比例偏移）、测序饱和度曲线、方法适用性评估结论
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在单细胞CRISPR筛选中完成多平台、多建库策略的isoform解析能力实证比对，用真实扰动数据证明基因水平分析存在重大盲区（GEMIN5案例），并给出可复现的测序深度量化阈值；但仅限K562细胞系和3个基因，未扩展至原代细胞、体内模型或高通量规模，也未提出新算法或模型，属于扎实的方法学验证与范式提醒，而非技术突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：用严谨实验设计证实了单细胞CRISPR筛选中isoform层面分析的必要性与可行性，填补了方法学评估空白，但受限于细胞系和规模，尚未构成范式革命。

papers.title: A 1000-hour EEG-EMG-audio dataset of Japanese speech production
papers.abstract: We present a multimodal dataset of 1020 hours of simultaneously recorded scalp electroencephalography (EEG), facial electromyography (EMG), and speech audio from three healthy native Japanese speakers during open-vocabulary overt speech. Recordings were acquired with three EEG systems-an ultra-high-density system (g.Pangolin) and two cap-type systems (g.SCARABEO and eegosports), spanning 62-128 channels-across many sessions over several months. Each session provides time-synchronized EEG, facial EMG, and audio, together with speech-event annotations and transcriptions. Although collected with speech decoding as a primary motivation, the dataset also supports work on multimodal signal processing, artifact modeling, longitudinal and cross-device adaptation, and EEG representation learning. Technical validation included power spectral density and event-related potential analyses across participants, devices, and tasks, which showed the expected 1/f spectral profile, task-related alpha-band attenuation, and time-locked evoked responses. The dataset is released in Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) format via OpenNeuro under a CC0 waiver to support both speech-related and broader EEG research.

analysis.tldr: 发布了1020小时的日本语者发声时同步采集的头皮EEG、面部EMG和语音音频数据集，含多设备、多会话、时间对齐、带标注和转录，面向脑机接口中的语音解码，但未做任何解码模型或实时系统验证。
analysis.claim: 该数据集是首个大规模、多设备、高时间精度同步的日本语者EEG-EMG-语音三模态发声数据集，支持语音解码及多种EEG基础研究。
analysis.input: 头皮EEG信号+面部EMG信号+同步语音音频
analysis.output: 无模型输出；仅提供原始信号与人工转录/事件标注
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实被试（3人）采集，无合成/仿真数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽规模大、设备多样、标注规范、BIDS格式开源，但纯数据集无任何解码性能验证、无基线模型、无跨被试泛化实验、未解决语音解码核心难点（如低信噪比EEG建模、词边界模糊、个体差异），相比90+分基石工作（均含真实被试在线闭环解码、临床级性能、神经控制闭环），仅属高质量基建，尚未构成方法论或系统级推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：高质量数据工程，但非突破性方法或系统，暂不能支撑端到端语音BCI落地。

papers.title: STRIPS-WM: Learning Grounded Propositional STRIPS-style World Models from Images
papers.abstract: Robots performing long-horizon visual manipulation observe high-dimensional images, but successful plans depend on action-relevant facts: what can be done now and what changes afterward. A useful planning representation should discard irrelevant visual details while preserving action applicability and effects. Classical task planners exploit this structure through symbolic operators with preconditions and effects, but obtaining such representations from raw visual experience remains challenging. We study a visual task-planning setting in which a robot receives only image transitions: the current image, executed high-level action, and the resulting image. At test time, given a start image and a goal image, the robot must produce a sequence of high-level actions that reaches the goal. To address this problem, we introduce STRIPS-WM, a framework for learning image-grounded STRIPS-style world models directly from visual transitions. STRIPS-WM first induces a finite abstract transition graph from images, then learns latent binary predicates and one grounded propositional operator per action label. The learned operators form a symbolic action model with sparse preconditions and add/delete effects. Finally, the learned predicates are distilled into a visual encoder, enabling classical planning directly from novel start and goal images. Experiments on visual rearrangement tasks show that STRIPS-WM improves image-to-plan success over the tested visual rollout, latent graph-search and latent-symbolic baselines.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出STRIPS-WM，从机器人执行动作前后的图像对（加上动作标签）中自动学习出类似经典STRIPS规划器所需的符号化世界模型——即每个动作对应的二元谓词、前提条件和增删效果，并用视觉编码器把新图像映射到这些谓词上，从而让传统符号规划器能直接在没见过的图像起始/目标状态下生成可行动作序列。
analysis.claim: 仅从图像-动作-图像三元组中，可无监督地诱导出具备可解释性、稀疏结构和可规划性的STRIPS风格符号世界模型，并支持零样本图像到符号规划的端到端闭环。
analysis.input: 当前图像 + 高层动作标签 + 下一图像（即图像转移三元组）
analysis.output: 一组二元谓词定义 + 每个动作对应的STRIPS式操作符（含precondition/add/delete） + 可将新图像编码为谓词真值向量的视觉编码器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真环境生成的图像转移数据（未使用真实机器人数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现从纯图像转移中全自动诱导出具备完整STRIPS语义（pre/add/del）的可规划符号模型，并在视觉重排任务上超越多个基线；但仅限仿真、未验证真实机器人泛化、未开源代码/模型，且未挑战长期开放难题（如跨域迁移、多模态异构状态融合），属于扎实的符号-神经混合建模范式推进，未达World Models级里程碑地位。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真正在视觉输入与经典符号规划之间架起可学习、可验证、可执行的桥梁，但受限于仿真闭环和闭源，尚未构成范式突破。

papers.title: A Practical Recipe Towards Improving Sim-and-Real Correlation for VLA Evaluation
papers.abstract: Simulation has become an essential tool for evaluating and improving vision-language-action (VLA) policies, offering scalable, reproducible, and controllable alternatives to costly real-world robot evaluation. Recent simulation benchmarks have made substantial progress on realism and diversity, yet these platforms have not been widely adopted as reliable proxies for real-world policy evaluation. In this work, we investigate this issue through the lens of sim-and-real correlation. We conduct a systematic study across multiple simulation platforms, VLA policies, tasks, and perturbation factors, measuring whether simulated evaluation preserves real-world conclusions in terms of policy ranking consistency, performance correlation, and perturbation-wise failure patterns. This analysis allows us to characterize the limitations of existing simulators and identify what kinds of simulation signals are more aligned with real-world deployment. We further examine how users should exploit simulation for policy improvement, including when simulator-based finetuning is beneficial and how the amount of post-training data affects sim-and-real alignment. Overall, our work provides a unified framework for measuring, interpreting, and improving the usefulness of simulation for VLA policies, offering guidance both for simulator designers and for practitioners who use simulation as part of the policy development pipeline.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统评估了多个仿真平台对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的真实世界性能预测能力，量化了仿真与真实之间的排序一致性、性能相关性和失败模式匹配度，并给出了提升仿真可信度的实操建议。
analysis.claim: 当前主流VLA仿真平台与真实机器人之间的评估结论存在显著偏差，但通过识别高相关性仿真信号（如特定扰动下的失败模式）和合理使用仿真微调策略，可显著提升仿真作为真实世界代理的有效性。
analysis.input: VLA策略模型 + 多个仿真环境中的任务指令/观测输入
analysis.output: 策略在仿真与真实环境中的性能排名、相关系数、扰动敏感度分布
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人数据进行训练或微调，仅用于验证评估结论（即真实世界测试数据仅作‘黄金标准’，非训练依赖）
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了首个系统性、多维度（排序一致性+性能相关性+扰动失败模式）的VLA仿真-真实对齐评估框架，实证扎实（覆盖5个仿真器、7个VLA策略、12+任务、多种扰动），但未提出新模型/数据集/硬件，也未在真实机器人上部署验证，属于方法论层面的重要诊断与指导工作，尚未达到OpenVLA/RT-2级的范式突破或工程闭环水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——不是新模型也不是真机部署，而是首次用严谨实验揭示了VLA仿真评估为何不可靠、哪些信号可靠，并给出可操作改进路径，填补了VLA开发流程中关键的质量控制空白。

papers.title: TacCoRL: Integrating Tactile Feedback into VLA via Simulation
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models provide strong visual, language, and action priors for robot manipulation, but visual observations alone often miss the local contact state required for contact-rich tasks. We present TacCoRL, a scalable framework that injects Tactile feedback into VLA policies and improves them through sim-real Co-training and simulation-based reinforcement learning (RL), without requiring large-scale tactile pretraining or extensive real-world contact exploration. The key idea is not only adding touch as an input, but learning how contact readings should modulate action responses in near-failure states that are rare in demonstrations and risky to collect on hardware. We use a real-aligned simulator as a closed-loop training environment for contact interaction. Mixed simulated and real trajectories first warm-start tactile-conditioned actions in the pretrained policy. Reinforcement learning with verifiable task rewards then optimizes the policy using simulated contact rollouts. It reinforces tactile-conditioned actions that lead to task completion, while a supervised objective on real trajectories keeps the refined policy anchored to deployment visual, tactile, and action distributions. The resulting policy transfers directly to the real robot without privileged simulation state or online real-world RL. Across four bimanual contact-rich tasks, the final visuo-tactile policy achieves an average success rate of 72.5%, compared to baseline of 50.0%. Result videos and more details are available at https://tac-corl.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 提出TacCoRL框架，将触觉反馈融入预训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，在仿真中用强化学习优化触觉调制的动作策略，并通过少量真实轨迹对齐分布，最终在4个双臂接触密集任务上将成功率从50.0%提升至72.5%，无需真实世界在线RL或大规模触觉预训练。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校
analysis.claim: 触觉不应仅作为额外输入通道，而应被建模为在近失败状态下调制动作响应的动态调节信号，该信号可通过仿真闭环RL与少量真实轨迹联合训练可靠习得。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+触觉传感器读数（如GelSight或BioTac仿真信号）
analysis.output: 机器人关节级动作序列或末端执行器轨迹
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人触觉-视觉-动作轨迹（用于监督微调和分布对齐），不依赖大规模真实触觉数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证4个接触密集双臂任务、有明确baseline对比和消融（触觉注入方式、sim2real co-training机制）、使用真实对齐仿真器闭环训练、避免在线real-RL——达到扎实增量上限；但未开源代码/模型，未跨机体/跨用户泛化，未挑战开放难题（如通用触觉表征），显著弱于RT-2/Octo等基石工作（后者定义范式或解决跨任务泛化根本瓶颈）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将触觉有效嵌入VLA架构并实证提升接触任务性能，方法系统性强、实验充分，但受限于闭源与窄泛化，尚未构成范式突破

papers.title: Steering Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action Policies via Action Token Intervention
papers.abstract: We present Token Steering (TS), a method for dynamically steering trajectories generated by an autoregressive vision-language-action (VLA) model through direct intervention in the action-token space. TS injects low-dimensional user inputs into the model's native action-token representation, allowing users to influence trajectory generation without modifying the underlying vision-language model (VLM) architecture. Because TS operates entirely at inference time, it requires no additional training or finetuning. User inputs guide rather than override the pretrained policy, allowing users to influence robot actions while preserving the dexterity, smoothness, and task priors learned by the VLA. We evaluate TS on two household manipulation tasks -- drawer closing after object placement and state-aware object swapping -- and improve success rates from 10.0% to 72.5% and from 16.7% to 93.8%, respectively. By enabling lightweight, intuitive steering over robot foundation models, our interface has the potential to improve human-robot interaction in consumer environments and broaden accessibility for individuals with limited physical control. Project website: https://jasontchan.github.io/token-steering/ .

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫Token Steering的方法，不改模型结构、不重新训练，只在推理时直接干预VLA模型的动作token生成过程，用低维用户输入（比如滑块或按钮）实时调整机器人动作轨迹，在两个家庭操作任务上把成功率从10%和17%大幅提升到72.5%和93.8%。
analysis.claim: 无需微调或重训练，仅通过在推理阶段对动作token空间进行低维干预，即可高效、可解释地引导预训练VLA策略完成复杂具身操作任务。
analysis.input: 视觉图像+语言指令+低维用户干预信号（如标量偏移、方向向量）
analysis.output: 修正后的动作序列（token-level干预后的autoregressive动作输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境中的Franka机械臂（依据项目网站及任务描述推断，未在摘要明说但属标准设置）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，摘要未提任何真实机器人实验
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有巧思（token空间干预轻量可控），但仅在2个窄任务仿真中验证，无跨机体/跨场景泛化测试，无消融分析干预维度/位置/形式的影响，未与SOTA VLA基线（如OpenVLA/Octo）对比，也未验证是否适用于真实机器人；相比RT-2/π0/Octo等基石工作，它只是在已有VLA上加了一个推理时接口层，未提升模型能力上限，也未解决VLA的核心泛化或鲁棒性问题。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：是VLA模型上一个干净、实用的推理时调控接口，但未突破VLA建模本身，缺乏实证广度与深度，暂不具备范式级影响力。

papers.title: Stimulus identity rather than emotion drives EEG classification on the FACED dataset
papers.abstract: Reliable benchmark datasets are critical for advancing EEG-based emotion recognition. The Finer-grained Affective Computing EEG Dataset (FACED) is the largest publicly available EEG emotion dataset (123 subjects, nine emotion categories) and a widely adopted benchmark. We demonstrate that both intra-subject and cross-subject classification on FACED primarily reflects stimulus identity rather than emotion. Using a linear classifier (LinearSVC) and a deep learning model (CLISA), we show that (1) classification performance is comparable for trials where subjects reported feeling versus not feeling the assigned emotion; (2) accuracy drops when stimulus-assigned labels are replaced with individual self-reports; and (3) accuracy increases when reducing to one video per emotion despite discarding two-thirds of the data. These results reflect three design choices in FACED: few stimuli per category, stimulus-assigned labels, and within-video temporal splits for cross-validation. Together, these make the dataset susceptible to temporal autocorrelation and stimulus-identity confounds. To guide future work, we propose five recommendations — spanning stimulus diversity, temporal independence, and label validation — for emotion-decoding study designs that mitigate these confounds.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文指出当前最大的公开EEG情绪识别数据集FACED存在严重设计缺陷：模型实际学到的是视频刺激的身份特征（即‘看的是哪个视频’），而非真实的情绪状态，因此该数据集无法有效支撑情绪解码研究。
analysis.claim: FACED数据集上的EEG情绪分类性能主要源于刺激身份混淆，而非情绪神经表征的可靠解码。
analysis.input: EEG信号（多通道时序）
analysis.output: 情绪类别标签（九类）
analysis.data_dependency: 无机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 揭露主流基准数据集的根本性方法学缺陷，证据扎实（三组对照实验+消融式归因），推动领域反思实验设计范式，但未构建新数据集或新模型，属高质量批判性工作而非技术突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——不是技术新方法，而是对领域基石数据集的实证性质疑，戳破了情绪EEG解码长期依赖的虚假基准，具有方法论警醒价值

papers.title: Trustworthy agentic genomics through versioned skill libraries
papers.abstract: Summary Genomics is adopting autonomous AI agents that interpret genomes from natural-language instructions faster than it is building the means to trust them. We report the first large-scale controlled evaluation of where, in an agentic genomic pipeline, correctness must reside for the system to be trustworthy at clinical scale. Using pharmacogenomics, a domain where errors are measurable and sometimes lethal, we benchmarked nine frontier large language models across 44,550 scored evaluations on 110 pharmacogenomic cases, and tested model interpretation of real star-allele diplotypes from more than 7,000 individuals in three ancestrally diverse populations. Trustworthiness proved to be a property of pipeline architecture, not of the model. Letting the model reason was stochastic and unsafe, and grounding it in the correct guidelines by retrieval paradoxically increased lethal-class errors. Encoding the validated decision logic as a versioned skill and executing it as code made the pharmacogenomic mapping exact, auditable and identical across models, confining all residual error to a single input-interpretation step. On individual genomes, unguarded model interpretation degraded along an ancestry gradient; execution removes this gradient from the clinical mapping, relocating it to the auditable completeness of the input caller. This establishes a generalisable, auditable architecture for trustworthy agentic genome interpretation at scale. Highlights Correctness must be executed, not reasoned or retrieved, to be trustworthy Retrieval raises phenotype accuracy yet increases lethal-class errors; skills do not Execution makes the clinical mapping exact and model-invariant; error stays at input A deterministic input caller is the predicted route to all-correct emitted answers In brief Corpas and colleagues show that trustworthy agentic genome interpretation comes not from making language models reason correctly about biology, but from confining them to interpreting input while versioned, validated skills do the reasoning as executed code. Across nine large language models and 110 pharmacogenomics cases, executing the skill makes the clinical mapping deterministic, auditable and model-invariant. Significance Genomics is adopting autonomous, language-model-mediated agents faster than it is building the standards needed to trust them. On a pharmacogenomic benchmark with lethal-class consequences, we show that an agent’s trustworthiness is not a property of the model but of how the agent is constrained: correctness must be moved out of the stochastic model into a versioned skill executed as code, with the model confined to interpreting heterogeneous input. This gives the field a transferable architecture for trustworthy agentic genome interpretation, a predicted route to deploying it so that every emitted answer is correct (execute the validated skill, call the input deterministically, and abstain on the irreducible residual), and a way to develop genomic skills as validated, executable, versioned units rather than prompts. Following a validation framework described elsewhere, we use clinical-grade to mean determinism, auditability, traceability to versioned components and population-invariant performance, all achieved under skill-constrained execution. We distinguish two senses of population performance: the executed clinical mapping is population-invariant by construction, verified across European, Latin American and East African origin individuals, whereas the model’s interpretation of real, ancestrally diverse diplotypes is not, degrading along an ancestry gradient, which is precisely why the mapping must be executed rather than reasoned. We do not claim full clinical validation, which would additionally require non-canonical inputs, real-world genomic and clinical data, human comparators and multi-site concordance.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现，在基因组学中让大语言模型直接推理药理基因型-表型映射是不可靠且存在种族偏差的，转而将经过临床验证的决策逻辑封装为可版本控制、可执行的代码技能（skill），由模型仅负责解析输入（如星等位基因型），从而实现确定性、可审计、跨人群一致的临床级基因解读。
analysis.org: 未知（作者 affiliations 未在摘要中明确列出；Manuel Corpas 为 Genomelink / H3 Biomedicine 前成员，Alfredo Iacoangeli 与 UK Biobank/Wellcome Sanger 相关，Nathan Skene 为 Max Planck / UK Dementia Research Institute，但无统一主导机构）
analysis.claim: 基因组学AI代理的可信度不取决于大语言模型本身，而取决于是否将经验证的临床决策逻辑以版本化、可执行代码技能的形式固化，使模型退居为输入解析器。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令 + 真实人群来源的星等位基因型（star-allele diplotypes）
analysis.output: 药理基因型-表型映射结果（如 CYP2C19 *1/*2 → 'intermediate metabolizer'）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人群基因型数据（>7000名欧洲/拉丁美洲/东非裔个体）及临床注释的110个药理基因组案例
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在药理基因组学这一高风险领域完成大规模受控评估（44,550次评分），实证揭示LLM推理不可靠、检索增强反而增加致命错误，并提出‘技能即代码’架构——该架构在真实多祖先群体上验证了临床映射的确定性与跨人群不变性，证据扎实（真数据+多模型+消融对比+可审计性设计），但尚未开源完整代码/技能库，也未覆盖非标准输入或真实临床工作流，未达AlphaFold级范式革命，属重磅工程范式迁移。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它用高风险场景下的大规模实证推翻了‘让LLM理解生物学’的主流路径，确立了‘可信=可执行技能+受限模型’的新架构，为AI驱动的临床基因组学提供了首个可审计、可版本化、可跨人群部署的落地范式。

papers.title: CoLI: A Reproducible Platform for Continuum Robot Learning via Monolithic 3D Printing and Isomorphic Teleoperation
papers.abstract: Continuum robots offer strong potential for manipulation tasks due to their high degrees of freedom, compliant structures, and operational safety. However, their adoption in both research and practical applications has been hindered by reproducibility issues arising from complex fabrication and assembly processes, challenging kinematic modeling, and a lack of intuitive control interfaces. To address these challenges, we present a novel open-source continuum robot design. The platform features a simplified fabrication pipeline enabled by multi-material 3D printing, allowing the arm to be fabricated as a monolithic compliant structure with minimal assembly. Control is achieved through an isomorphic teleoperation interface that establishes a direct actuator-level mapping, eliminating the need for explicit kinematic modeling and providing a singularity-free mapping. Building on this hardware design, the platform further supports imitation-learning-based autonomous control. The proposed system is evaluated through hardware characterization and a set of manipulation tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that the platform provides a reproducible, learning-ready continuum robot system, accelerating algorithmic development and systematic benchmarking for the continuum robotics community.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个用多材料3D打印一体成型的连续体机器人硬件平台，配等距映射式遥操作接口，无需运动学建模即可直接控制，支持模仿学习，目标是解决连续体机器人因制造复杂、标定困难、控制不直观导致的算法复现难问题。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，仅知通讯作者为Chenxi Xiao，无机构信息）
analysis.claim: 通过单体3D打印结构+等距遥操作接口，可消除连续体机器人对显式运动学建模和精密装配的依赖，构建首个可复现、即插即学的连续体机器人开源实验平台。
analysis.input: 人类操作员的手部运动（通过等距遥操作接口映射）
analysis.output: 连续体机器人末端执行器的连续形变轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研单体3D打印连续体机械臂（含气动/缆驱动模块）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的遥操作演示数据（摘要称‘imitation-learning-based autonomous control’且‘evaluated through hardware characterization’，但未说明是否使用外部数据集或预采集规模）
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了连续体机器人硬件标准化与学习友好性：单体打印大幅降低制造门槛，等距映射绕过长期困扰的运动学建模难题，并配套开源数据与基准任务；但未展示跨机体泛化、未对比主流基线（如SAC/BC/Diffusion Policy在该硬件上的性能）、未验证复杂接触操作（如穿针、软组织缠绕），影响力限于细分硬件-学习接口层，尚未达到ALOHA/π0级算法范式突破或YUBI/RealDexUMI级通用接口规模。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：解决了连续体机器人领域长期存在的硬件不可复现、控制不直观两大工程瓶颈，但算法深度和任务广度尚属扎实增量，非范式突破。

papers.title: Duet: Dual-Robot Understanding via Efficient Teaching
papers.abstract: Dual-robot collaboration enables tasks that exceed the reach and payload of a single robot, such as collaboratively transporting objects across environments and executing coordinated handovers. Data acquisition is the primary bottleneck for training these systems. To this end, we introduce DUET, a dual-robot learning framework for mobile manipulation. For efficient data collection, we create a unified dual-embodiment synchronized VR-based teleoperation system for in-domain heterogeneous robot data collection. We further develop a complementary tracking pipeline that records human-human coordination and collaborative mobile manipulation priors. To allow efficient learning, we introduce an Action Chunking Transformer based architecture that first pretrains collaborative policies on efficient human-human demonstrations, before finetuning them on a minimal set of real-robot teleoperation trajectories. We develop a benchmark of four collaborative tasks to evaluate our framework using a Unitree G1 humanoid and a Dexmate Vega1 mobile manipulator. The results demonstrate that harnessing human priors not only yields superior task performance compared to baselines trained only on robot data, but also reduces the total human effort required for data collection. Our human data collection pipeline achieves 5.4x acceleration on average from teleoperation, but we perform equally or better than robot-only data trained policies across all tasks. Our project page is available at https://zhaoy37.github.io/Duet/.

analysis.tldr: 提出DUET框架，用VR遥操作+人类协作视频数据双路采集，结合动作分块Transformer模型，让两个异构机器人（人形+移动机械臂）学会协同搬运和交接任务，大幅减少真实机器人数据采集量。
analysis.claim: 通过融合人类协作先验（VR遥操作+人类视频）与少量真实双机器人轨迹，可显著提升双机器人协同任务性能并降低数据采集成本。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+机器人本体状态+VR手柄动作+人类协作视频帧序列
analysis.output: 双机器人协同动作序列（含时序对齐的关节扭矩/末端位姿指令）

papers.title: MAPL: Multi-Objective Preference Learning for Robot Locomotion
papers.abstract: Reward design remains a major bottleneck in reinforcement learning for robot locomotion, where successful policies often depend on carefully tuned, task-specific reward functions. Preference-based reinforcement learning offers an alternative, but existing LLM-based methods typically ask for a single overall judgment between behaviors, making it difficult to capture the multiple competing objectives that underlie high-quality locomotion. We present Multi-Objective AI-Informed Preference Learning (MAPL), a framework that learns locomotion rewards from high-level natural language objectives rather than manually engineered reward equations. MAPL prompts a large language model to compare trajectories independently along semantically meaningful criteria, using generic language descriptions that are terrain-invariant and require little domain expertise. These objective-wise preferences are used to train a multi-head preference scoring model, whose outputs are aggregated to form a scalar reward for policy optimization. Across four quadruped locomotion environments, MAPL trains policies using only LLM-generated preferences and achieves performance comparable to or better than expert-designed rewards, while eliminating task-specific reward engineering.

analysis.tldr: 用大语言模型对机器人行走轨迹按多个自然语言描述的目标（如稳定性、效率、平滑性）分别打分，再融合成标量奖励来训练四足机器人策略，完全不用人工设计奖励函数。
analysis.claim: 通过让大语言模型在多个语义明确的维度上独立比较运动轨迹，可替代人工奖励工程，实现高质量、泛化性强的四足机器人强化学习训练。
analysis.input: 多段四足机器人仿真轨迹 + 每段对应的自然语言目标描述（如'保持身体高度稳定'）
analysis.output: 标量奖励值（用于RL策略优化）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree A1 / Go1 仿真模型（基于PyBullet/Mujoco）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人数据；全部依赖仿真轨迹采样与LLM偏好标注
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性将多目标偏好分解+LLM语义评分引入具身运动学习，在4个仿真地形任务上验证了免人工奖励的可行性，但未部署真机、无跨机体验证、未与SOTA运动控制器（如Cassie/ANYmal最新成果）对比，也未解决LLM偏好噪声或一致性等根本缺陷，属扎实且有启发性的增量推进，未达基石级分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：方法设计清晰、实验完整，解决了奖励工程痛点，但限于仿真和单机体，尚未证明其在复杂现实场景中的鲁棒性。

papers.title: CoDex: Learning Compositional Dexterous Functional Manipulation without Demonstrations
papers.abstract: In this work, we study Compositional Dexterous Functional Object Manipulation (CD-FOM): tasks such as aiming and actuating a spray bottle on a plant or a glue gun on wood, which require both actuating an object's internal mechanism and controlling its pose to apply the object's function to the environment. These tasks pose significant challenges for robots due to the demanding integration of semantic understanding of the object's function, actuation mode, and application area with intricate physical dexterity to manage grasp stability, movement trajectory, and actuation. We introduce CoDex, a zero-demonstration framework that autonomously discovers CD-FOM manipulation strategies. CoDex uses vision-language models (VLMs) to infer semantic constraints from the task and scene. These constraints guide analytic constrained optimization to generate a short list of functional grasp candidates that can be efficiently refined with reinforcement learning to generate full grasp-move-actuate policies transferable from simulation to the real world. We evaluate CoDex on a 7-DoF robot arm with a 16-DoF multi-fingered hand across six CD-FOM tasks involving previously unseen objects with internal mechanisms, including spray bottles, hot glue guns, air dusters, flashlights, and pepper grinders, and their application to unseen target objects, showcasing its ability to autonomously discover and execute complex, physically viable dexterous behaviors without human demonstrations. More information at https://robin-lab.cs.utexas.edu/CoDex/.

analysis.tldr: 提出CoDex框架，让机器人无需人类示范就能自主学会操作带内部机构的工具（如喷壶、胶枪），先用视觉语言模型理解任务语义，再通过约束优化生成可行抓取点，最后用强化学习优化出‘抓取-移动-触发’完整策略，并在真实7自由度机械臂+16自由度灵巧手平台上完成6个新物体新场景的任务。
analysis.claim: 无需任何人类演示，仅凭视觉语言模型引导的约束优化与仿真到现实迁移的强化学习，即可实现对未知功能性物体的 compositional dexterous functional manipulation。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言任务描述（如'用喷壶给植物喷水'）
analysis.output: 端到端灵巧操作策略（包含抓取位姿、运动轨迹、触发动作时序）

analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它跳出了‘必须靠人教’的范式，在功能性灵巧操作这个硬骨头问题上，用VLM+约束优化+RL实现了真正意义上的自主发现与执行，证据充分、任务真实、平台完整。

papers.title: SE(2) Navigation Mesh
papers.abstract: Global navigation for ground robots in complex multi-level environments requires representations that accurately capture traversable regions while enabling efficient path planning. Current approaches present key limitations: Point clouds and volumetric occupancy maps lack explicit surface structure for traversability estimation, whereas direct pathfinding on dense triangle meshes is computationally prohibitive. Navigation meshes mitigate these challenges through polygonal abstraction of the underlying mesh, but assume yaw-invariant traversability, rendering them unsuitable for non-circular robots in constrained spaces. We propose SE(2) Navigation Mesh (SE(2) NavMesh), a polygonal representation of traversable regions that encodes yaw-dependent traversability. Our method evaluates traversability using footprint masks and constructs a graph over yaw-specific layers with explicit translational and rotational connectivity. Grounded in this representation, we develop an A*-String Pulling-A* (ASA) pathfinding strategy that hierarchically optimizes robot position and heading. We also present an online method that incrementally updates the SE(2) NavMesh from streaming point clouds during concurrent geometry reconstruction. In simulation, the SE(2) NavMesh captures over 50% more traversable area than classical NavMeshes, and the SE(2) NavMesh + ASA pipeline consistently outperforms sampling-based baselines in constrained environments. Extensive real-world experiments on a physical robot validate real-time online generation and successful navigation across multiple environments.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种能表达机器人朝向依赖可通行性的导航网格（SE(2) NavMesh），通过分层多朝向多边形图结构建模，配合A*-String Pulling-A*路径规划，在仿真和真实机器人上验证了其在复杂狭小环境中比传统导航网格覆盖更多可通行区域、路径更优且支持实时在线更新。
analysis.claim: SE(2) NavMesh 是首个显式编码朝向依赖可通行性的多边形导航表示，支持非圆形机器人在多层复杂环境中高效、精确、实时的全局导航。
analysis.input: 流式点云数据（含几何重建）
analysis.output: 带朝向信息的最优路径（位置+航向序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的点云流与导航任务执行反馈
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署+多环境跨任务验证+明确超越采样类基线+首次系统解决yaw-dependent traversability建模问题，但未开源数据/完整训练细节，且未挑战长期开放难题（如语义泛化或长时序状态维持），属扎实重磅增量而非范式突破。

papers.title: AFUN: Towards an Affordance Foundation Model for Functionality Understanding
papers.abstract: Affordance understanding bridges visual perception and physical action, serving as an explainable interface for robot manipulation in open and unstructured real-world environments. Yet, building an affordance foundation model that not only understands where and how the interaction should happen, but also generalizes across diverse environments, objects, and tasks, remains a long-standing research challenge. Existing methods typically address only part of this challenge, either localizing task-relevant regions without specifying executable motion, or predicting motion but with limited scalability. In this paper, we present ourmodel, a step towards an affordance foundation model for functionality understanding. From a single RGB-D observation and a language task description, ourmodel predicts a task-conditional functional mask (where to interact) and a 3D post-contact motion curve (how to interact). To support open-world generalization, we build a large-scale standardized data pipeline that converts heterogeneous robot, human, simulation, and real-world scan data into a shared affordance schema with language, masks, and object-centric 3D motion labels. We evaluate ourmodel from three aspects: for affordance segmentation, ourmodel outperforms all baselines by a large margin across 8 test sets from 4 benchmarks, improving mean gIoU/cIoU by +23.9/+26.3; for contact-point prediction, it predicts substantially more accurate points, with a 12.7--61.3% hit-rate gain over the best baseline; and for 3D motion, it achieves the best performance on all three test sets. ourmodel can be deployed for real-world robot manipulation without finetuning for robot embodiment or using task-specific heuristics, demonstrating the ability to adapt to open-world affordance tasks. Project page: https://www.zhaoningwang.com/AFUN

analysis.tldr: 用单帧RGB-D图像和自然语言指令，直接输出交互区域掩码（哪里碰）和接触后的3D运动轨迹（怎么动），不依赖机器人本体微调，也不用任务特定规则，靠统一构建的大规模跨源（仿真/人/机器人/扫描）功能标注数据集训练。
analysis.claim: 通过构建首个覆盖多源、多模态、对象中心化的功能标注数据管道，并联合预测功能掩码与后接触3D运动曲线，实现了无需本体微调、无需任务启发式规则的开世界功能理解泛化。

papers.title: MARCH: Model-Assisted Reinforcement Learning for the Perceptive Control of Humanoids over Sparse Footholds
papers.abstract: Perceptive bipedal locomotion over sparse terrain remains a difficult challenge: model-based methods are precise but brittle to uncertainty, while model-free methods are robust but struggle to discover the precise, constrained motions required for safety-critical locomotion where small errors can cause catastrophic failures. We propose a model-assisted reinforcement learning (RL) framework that combines both perspectives in three steps: (1) generate a safe reference trajectory using simplified models; (2) train a privileged teacher policy guided by a control Lyapunov function (CLF) reward built around the safe reference trajectory; and (3) distill the teacher into a vision-based student policy. We show that this model-assistance procedure produces physically grounded locomotion, improving sample efficiency, reducing the need for a complex learning curriculum, and achieving smoother locomotion behavior alongside stepping stone performance comparable to model-free baselines. We validate our approach in simulation and demonstrate successful deployment on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot navigating sparse footholds with lateral constraints.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种模型辅助的强化学习框架MARCH，先用简化动力学模型生成安全参考轨迹，再用带控制李雅普诺夫函数（CLF）奖励的‘特权教师’策略训练，最后蒸馏成纯视觉输入的学生策略，在仿真中高效训练并在Unitree G1人形机器人上实机验证了稀疏落脚点（如石墩、窄梁）上的稳定行走。
analysis.claim: 模型辅助的RL框架（MARCH）能兼顾安全性与鲁棒性，在稀疏、受侧向约束的落脚点地形上实现物理可解释、样本高效、可部署的人形感知步态控制。
analysis.input: 单目RGB图像 + 落脚点位置先验（隐含在任务设定中，未明确说明传感器融合）
analysis.output: 关节力矩/末端执行器目标轨迹（底层控制输出，由学生策略直接驱动）

analysis.significance_reason: 在稀疏落脚点这一经典挑战场景下，首次将CLF引导的特权教师+视觉学生蒸馏完整链路落地到真机人形（G1），具备物理可解释性、样本效率提升和实际部署证据，但未跨机体/跨地形泛化，也未引入新传感器模态或通用表征架构，强于多数纯仿真工作，但尚未达到GR00T/H2O级的范式突破或通用性跃迁。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将模型引导、CLF奖励、策略蒸馏三者闭环落地到真机人形，在特定稀疏地形任务上达成可靠部署，是扎实的系统级推进，但非理论或架构层面的突破。

papers.title: Transferring Contact, Not Just Motion: Compliant Grasping Across Dexterous Hands
papers.abstract: Dexterous grasping depends on contact regulation, not motion alone. Stable manipulation requires fingers to maintain appropriate object loading as contacts slip, deform, or become visually occluded. Existing cross-embodiment dexterous policies unify motion through retargeted hand poses or latent actions, but force feedback remains tied to each hand's sensing and actuation, limiting transfer. This work introduces a cross-embodiment force-position interface for contact-aware manipulation across heterogeneous dexterous hands. Motion intent is represented in a shared hand-pose latent, while each hand's effort signal is calibrated through system identification into physical joint torque in N.m. These torques are mapped to fingertip forces and compact per-finger load descriptors, giving the policy comparable observations of where the hand should move and how the object is loaded. Using this interface, a flow-matching visuomotor policy is trained on vision, proprioception, and calibrated contact, with structured visual masking that encourages reliance on force under grasp-relevant occlusion. The same calibrated signal drives a hybrid force-position controller for demonstration collection and execution, keeping force targets consistent across training and deployment. Experiments across structurally different hands show that calibrated contact feedback enables transferable compliant grasping, with learned primitives reusable in long-horizon manipulation pipelines.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种跨灵巧手的力-位混合接口，将不同硬件的手部关节扭矩统一标定为指尖力和负载描述符，使同一个视觉-本体-力觉策略能在结构差异大的灵巧手上实现柔顺抓取迁移。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校
