papers.title: Decoding Chronic Pain States from Distributed Intracranial Recordings
papers.abstract: Chronic pain engages distributed cortical and subcortical circuits, and large-scale intracranial recordings in humans offer a valuable opportunity to characterize its neural signatures. Here, we recorded multi-day stereoelectroencephalography (sEEG) from six participants with refractory chronic neuropathic pain, each implanted with sEEG electrodes spanning dozens of cortical and subcortical structures. Using simultaneous chronic pain ratings, we decoded spontaneous high versus low pain states within individuals (median area under the curve = 0.72; five of six participants performed above chance). Pain-predictive signals were broadly distributed and highly participant-specific. However, mapping the spatial distribution of pain-predictive features revealed preferential representation within canonical macroscale networks: beta-band activity in the default mode network and high-gamma activity in the salience network. These results demonstrate that intracranial recordings can capture distributed, network-organized representations of spontaneous chronic pain states.

analysis.tldr: 用六名难治性神经病理性疼痛患者的长期颅内sEEG数据，结合每日自发疼痛评分，首次在个体层面解码静息态高/低疼痛状态，并发现疼痛相关信号虽高度个体化，但主要集中于默认模式网络（beta频段）和显著性网络（高频gamma频段）。
analysis.claim: 慢性疼痛的自发状态可在个体水平通过分布式颅内脑电活动可靠解码，其预测性特征虽高度个体化，但在宏观脑网络层面具有跨被试的频段-网络特异性组织模式。
analysis.input: 多日sEEG全脑电极信号（覆盖皮层与皮层下数十个脑区）+同步主观疼痛评分
analysis.output: 二分类标签（高痛 vs 低痛状态）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实患者颅内植入电极采集的临床数据（6人，多日连续记录）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实慢性疼痛患者中实现跨日、跨脑区、个体化疼痛状态解码，提供首个高时空分辨率的人类慢性疼痛神经表征图谱；证据扎实（6例临床数据、多脑区覆盖、统计显著性、网络层级解释），但样本量小、未验证闭环干预、未开源代码/模型，未达基石级（如BCI语音/运动重建）的临床转化深度与系统性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将临床神经生理数据、个体化解码建模与宏观网络框架结合，实证质量高，但受限于样本规模与开放性，尚未形成可复现、可推广的通用解码范式。

papers.title: IOI: Decoupling Kinematics and Physics for Interactive World Models
papers.abstract: Developing generalist embodied agents requires interactive environments providing visually realistic feedback and accurate action-conditioned dynamics. Interactive world models address this by simulating such complex dynamics. However, purely data-driven methods struggle to ensure precise control alignment and physically plausible visual feedback due to a lack of explicit structural constraints. To address this, we propose IOI, a hybrid interactive world model integrating analytical kinematic priors with learned physical dynamics. Unlike data-driven approaches prone to spatiotemporal drift, IOI introduces explicit kinematic guidance, computing forward kinematics from action sequences for accurate motion trajectories. These trajectories are rendered into synchronized front, side, and top orthographic projections, eliminating the need for extrinsic camera calibration. A Multi-view Kinematic Aggregation and Injection module fuses these geometric cues and injects them into the video generator, providing geometry-consistent guidance. Conditioning video generation on these deterministic trajectories establishes a synergy between the analytical simulator and the world model. Decoupling deterministic motion into the kinematic prior frees the generator to model stochastic physical interactions. Experiments on the RoboTwin benchmark validate IOI across kinematic fidelity, out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization, and policy evaluation. IOI achieves state-of-the-art simulation performance and robust zero-shot generalization to unseen OOD tasks. Furthermore, IOI serves as a reliable policy evaluator, yielding success rates closely aligning with ground-truth physics simulators. On real-world platforms, policies trained on IOI-synthesized data match those trained on teleoperation demonstrations, solidifying its practical value for embodied policy learning.

analysis.tldr: 提出IOI模型，将机器人运动学（确定性、解析式）与物理动力学（数据驱动、随机性）解耦建模：用前向运动学生成精确轨迹并渲染多视角图像，再把几何线索注入视频生成器，从而在仿真中同时保证运动精度和物理真实性。
analysis.claim: 解耦运动学先验与学习型物理动力学，能显著提升交互式世界模型的运动保真度、OOD泛化能力和策略评估可靠性。
analysis.input: 动作序列（关节角度/末端位姿指令）
analysis.output: 同步的前视/侧视/顶视三视角视频帧序列
analysis.robot_dependency: RoboTwin仿真平台（基于PyBullet/ROS风格的多体仿真）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖合成数据，未使用任何真实机器人采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在RoboTwin基准上实现了SOTA级仿真保真度与零样本OOD泛化，并验证了其作为策略评估器与真实物理仿真器高度一致——这是世界模型向可靠策略训练闭环迈出的关键一步，但未开源、未部署真机、未构建持久状态核心，尚达不到World Models/DreamerV3级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：技术路线扎实、实验充分、指标可信，是当前世界模型向高保真+高泛化演进的重要工程范本，但缺乏开源与真机验证，尚未构成范式革新。

papers.title: A Chromatin Biology Assessment of AlphaFold3
papers.abstract: Biomolecular structure prediction tools such as AlphaFold have achieved remarkable success in predicting structures of single proteins and multiprotein complexes. AlphaFold3 now incorporates the capability to model complexes containing nucleic acids and chemically modified side chains. Investigators can now predict structures of proteins bound to chromatin, where interactions with nucleosomal DNA and histone post-translational modifications converge to control genome function. To evaluate its robustness in modeling chromatin complexes, we benchmarked AlphaFold3 on 115 structures containing nucleosomes whose coordinates were released by the Protein Data Bank after the training set cutoff date. We find that AlphaFold3 excels at predicting histone-driven interactions and accurately models complexes that deposit and recognize post-translational modifications. By contrast, AlphaFold3 struggles to predict structures of chromatin factors that primarily engage nucleosomal DNA, notably transcription factors and chromatin remodelers. Finally, we show that AlphaFold3 can faithfully recapitulate known post-translational modification recognition patterns, matching experimentally determined specificity profiles. This assessment of the capabilities and limitations of AF3 in chromatin structural biology provides a roadmap for its effective application to studies of chromatin regulation and PTM readout, while identifying key areas for future algorithmic refinement.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统评估了AlphaFold3在染色质复合物结构预测上的实际能力，用115个新发布的核小体结构做盲测，发现它对组蛋白相互作用和PTM识别效果好，但对主要结合DNA的转录因子和染色质重塑酶预测失败，同时验证了其PTM识别模式与实验数据一致。
analysis.claim: AlphaFold3在染色质结构预测中表现出明确的能力边界：擅长组蛋白-配体及PTM识别类复合物，但无法可靠预测以DNA为主要结合界面的染色质调控因子结构。
analysis.input: 蛋白质+DNA+化学修饰氨基酸残基的序列与残基类型信息
analysis.output: 三维原子坐标结构
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量实证评估而非方法创新，填补AF3在染色质领域的能力图谱空白，但未提出新模型/算法，也未解决AF3根本缺陷；相比AlphaFold2（98）或ESM-2（95）等基石工作，属于重要但受限的下游验证性研究，证据扎实（115个post-cutoff结构、分层分析、实验PTM特异性交叉验证），但影响范围窄于通用蛋白结构预测范式。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——不是突破，而是迄今最严谨的AF3染色质适用性测绘，为表观遗传学计算建模划出清晰的能力红线

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning Enables Autonomous Microrobot Navigation and Intervention in Simulated Blood Capillaries
papers.abstract: Autonomous microrobots navigating biological vasculature could enable targeted drug delivery and thrombolysis, yet training control policies for realistic environments remains an open challenge. Prior reinforcement learning (RL) studies of microrobotic navigation have been limited to idealized geometries that omit complex hydrodynamic flow fields, confined branching structures, and dense cellular obstacles found in vivo. Here, we develop a physically grounded simulation of a blood capillary network, incorporating realistic hydrodynamic flow fields, explicit red blood cell dynamics, and anatomically derived branching geometry, and train deep RL agents to navigate it via chemotaxis. We systematically map the physical limits of navigation across robot size and swimming speed, revealing a forbidden regime where Brownian motion and flow overcome propulsion. Successful agents independently discover multiple universal strategy types, including run-and-rotate and energy-efficient search-and-sit policies, regardless of robot parameters. Without retraining, these agents perform targeted blocking and unblocking of capillary flow, restoring throughput to healthy baseline levels. These results establish RL as a viable framework for developing autonomous microrobotic intervention strategies in complex biological environments.

analysis.tldr: 用强化学习在高度逼真的毛细血管仿真环境中训练微型机器人，使其能自主导航、识别血流异常并执行物理性堵/通操作来恢复血流，首次系统揭示了微尺度下物理约束导致的导航失效边界，并发现跨参数通用的策略类型。
analysis.claim: 深度强化学习可在包含真实血流动力学、红细胞运动和解剖分支结构的毛细血管仿真中，训练出具备泛化干预能力的自主微机器人控制策略，且该策略揭示了微尺度导航的物理可行性边界。
analysis.input: 局部流场速度、红细胞密度分布、血管几何拓扑、化学梯度信号
analysis.output: 微机器人三维推进力与旋转力矩序列（连续控制）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，纯仿真训练与验证
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进微纳机器人智能控制范式：构建了迄今最物理完备的毛细血管RL仿真环境（含RBC显式建模+解剖分支+非稳态流场），实证揭示导航失效的布朗-流体-推进三力博弈边界，并发现跨尺寸/速度的通用策略类型；但未部署真机、无生物实验验证、开源程度有限（仅项目页），尚未跨越sim2real鸿沟，故低于H2O/GR00T等真机闭环里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在仿真侧完成从物理建模→策略发现→干预验证的全链条闭环，证据扎实但未触达真实生物环境，属于面向临床转化的关键前置工程突破。

papers.title: 1000 Rallies: An Event-Camera Dataset and Real-Time Learned Ball-State Estimation for Robotic Table Tennis
papers.abstract: Robotic table tennis has emerged as a compelling benchmark for real-time robotic perception due to its fast ball dynamics and stringent timing requirements. Accurate, high-frequency, and low-latency ball state estimation is critical for reliable trajectory prediction and timely control. Traditional frame-based cameras face an inherent trade-off: low frame rates leave temporal blind spots that miss fast-moving objects and high frame rates raise data and computational cost. Event cameras instead offer microsecond temporal resolution and, under sufficient illumination, remain largely free of motion blur even at high ball speeds. However, the community lacks large-scale datasets to develop and benchmark event-based perception in realistic sports scenarios. We address this gap by introducing the first large-scale event-camera dataset for table tennis, comprising over 1000 rallies from a diverse group of players ranging from amateurs to elite-level athletes. Each recording captures the event stream alongside 14 synchronized high-speed frame-based cameras at 200 FPS, which we use to produce 1 kHz pseudo ground-truth labels for ball position, velocity, and spin. Building on this dataset, we train a convolutional neural network robust to background player motion that jointly estimates the ball's position and velocity in the image-plane from events. Treating the predicted velocity as an additional measurement in the Kalman filter reduces bounce-point prediction error by 36% relative to a position-only baseline. Finally, we close the perception-action loop by integrating the event-based system with a Stäubli robotic arm, enabling the first real-time human-robot table tennis rallies driven by event-based perception.

analysis.tldr: 构建了首个千次真实乒乓球对打的事件相机数据集（含14路200FPS同步高速视频生成的1kHz伪真值），并训练了一个抗背景干扰的CNN模型，从事件流中实时估计球在图像平面的位置和速度，再用该速度作为卡尔曼滤波新观测量，将落点预测误差降低36%，最后在Stäubli机械臂上实现了首例基于事件相机的实时人机对打。
analysis.claim: 事件相机+专用CNN+卡尔曼滤波融合可实现低延迟、高精度的乒乓球实时球态估计，并首次支撑真实机器人完成闭环人机对打。
analysis.input: 事件相机原始事件流（异步像素级明暗变化）
analysis.output: 图像平面内球的二维位置与二维速度（每帧输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: Stäubli TX2-90 机械臂 + 高速视觉伺服系统
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人平台采集的1000+次真人对打数据，含多水平选手、多发球类型、多环境光照
analysis.significance_reason: 首次构建大规模真实体育场景事件相机数据集并完成端到端闭环部署，实证扎实（千次真实对打、1kHz伪真值、36%误差下降、Stäubli真机实时对打），显著推进事件感知在高动态闭环控制中的实用性，但未提出新架构范式或跨领域通用模型，影响力限于具身智能子方向。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是概念包装，而是以高质量数据集+严谨评估+真机闭环为支点，在事件驱动机器人感知这一长期瓶颈问题上取得可复现、可部署的实质性跨越。

papers.title: Actuator Reality Shaping for Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Robot Learning
papers.abstract: Sim-to-real transfer in robot learning is often limited by discrepancies between the ideal actuator dynamics assumed during policy training and the nonlinear, hardware-dependent behavior of physical motors. While conventional approaches attempt to bridge this gap by increasing simulator fidelity through system identification, domain randomization, or learned actuator models, we introduce an alternative paradigm: actuator reality shaping. Instead of modifying the simulator to match the real world, our method shapes the closed-loop behavior of physical actuators to match the idealized second-order reference dynamics used in simulation. By equipping each joint with a two-degree-of-freedom feedforward--feedback controller, we decouple reference-response shaping from robust stabilization, thereby providing a standardized actuator interface for reinforcement learning policies. As a result, policies trained only with the prescribed reference model can be deployed zero-shot on real hardware without task-level fine-tuning or learned actuator models. We validate the approach on a single-joint high-gear-ratio servo under external loads and a 7-DOF robotic arm reaching task, where actuator reality shaping substantially reduces sim-to-real tracking error and improves zero-shot task performance compared with standard servo-control and representative real-to-sim-to-real baselines. We further demonstrate zero-shot transfer on a wheeled-legged robot driving over a slope and a humanoid robot walking, suggesting that actuator reality shaping can serve as a reusable interface for robot learning across diverse hardware platforms.

analysis.tldr: 提出‘执行器现实塑形’方法：不改仿真器，而是用双自由度前馈-反馈控制器改造真实电机的动态响应，使其严格跟踪仿真中假设的理想二阶动力学模型，从而让纯仿真训练的策略能零样本直接部署到真实机器人上。
analysis.claim: 通过在物理执行器端主动塑造其闭环动态以匹配仿真中的理想参考模型，而非提升仿真保真度或学习执行器偏差，可实现无需任务微调、无需执行器建模的零样本sim-to-real迁移。
analysis.input: 理想参考轨迹（位置/速度）及当前状态
analysis.output: 电机驱动信号（PWM或电流指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: 高减速比伺服电机、7-DOF机械臂、轮腿机器人、人形机器人
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实硬件标定与控制器参数整定，但不依赖任务级真实机器人交互数据（如轨迹演示或强化学习rollout）
analysis.significance_reason: 在多个异构真实平台（单关节伺服、7-DOF臂、轮腿、人形）上验证零样本迁移，显著优于标准伺服控制和典型real-to-sim-to-real基线，且不依赖任务数据或执行器逆模型；虽未开源代码，但方法具强工程可复现性，为sim-to-real提供新范式——从‘仿真逼近现实’转向‘现实逼近仿真’，填补了执行器层标准化接口的长期空白。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次系统性地将执行器动态作为可控接口进行标准化塑形，使仿真策略真正摆脱硬件耦合，证据扎实、跨平台泛化强、工程路径清晰

papers.title: Benchmarking AlphaFold and related deep learning approaches for modeling antibody and TCR antigen recognition
papers.abstract: Determining the structural basis of antigen recognition by antibodies and T cell receptors (TCRs) provides critical insights into effective immune targeting and can inform design of biotherapeutics and vaccines. Accurate computational modeling of antibodies and TCRs in complex with their targets poses a major challenge for predictive methods, including AlphaFold, which is generally accurate for modeling protein complexes but has shown limited success for immune recognition. In this study we assessed the performance of AlphaFold2, AlphaFold3, increased sampling protocols, and related deep learning methods for modeling antibody-protein, antibody-peptide, and TCR-peptide-major histocompatibility complex (pMHC) recognition. We show that increased sampling and AlphaFold3 generally improve performance relative to default sampling and AlphaFold2, however predictive accuracy and improvement levels varied considerably among interface classes, with antibody-peptide complexes representing a challenge despite their small antigen size. Comparing per-case success across methods showed some complementarity, indicating opportunities for increased success through model pooling approaches, for instance increasing antibody-peptide near-native success from 41% to 59%. Analysis of AlphaFold confidence scores and modeling of a noncanonical complex provided further insights into predictive performance. These results highlight considerations for predictive antibody and TCR complex modeling efforts, while revealing key distinctions among protocols, scoring, and immune complex classes.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统评测了AlphaFold2、AlphaFold3及改进采样策略在抗体-抗原、TCR-pMHC等免疫复合物结构预测任务上的表现，发现现有方法对小肽类抗原（尤其抗体-肽）预测效果差，但模型集成可将近天然构象成功率从41%提升至59%，并分析了置信度分数与失败案例的规律。
analysis.claim: AlphaFold系列及增强采样策略在免疫复合物建模中性能差异显著，抗体-肽复合物是当前深度学习方法最难准确预测的类别，而模型集成可实质性提升成功率。
analysis.input: 抗体/TCR序列 + 抗原（蛋白/肽/pMHC）序列
analysis.output: 三维复合物结构（PDB坐标）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的基准评测工作：覆盖三类免疫复合物、对比多版本AF及采样策略、含消融式集成实验、揭示关键失败模式（如抗体-肽难建模），但未提出新模型/架构/训练范式，也未解决根本性建模缺陷，仅优化已有工具链；显著弱于AlphaFold2/3/ESM等基石工作（分量90+），也不及dtSFM/RFdiffusion等生成式突破（90+），定位为领域内重要但非引领性的实证评估。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：不是新方法，而是首次系统暴露AlphaFold在免疫识别建模中的结构性短板，并给出可复现的集成改进方案，对生物计算社区有明确指导价值，但未改变方法论范式。

papers.title: See the Emotion: A Facial Emoji Proxy Modeling for EEG Emotion Recognition
papers.abstract: Despite the high accuracy of EEG-based emotion recognition, existing models remain opaque "black boxes", lacking semantic grounding between abstract neural features and human-interpretable states. In this paper, we reframe EEG explainability as a cross-modal generation task, shifting the paradigm from feature attribution to behavioral visualization. We introduce Facial Emoji Proxy Modeling, a novel framework that translates high-dimensional EEG signals into identity-anonymized facial emojis. Guided by the neuroscientific inspiration of neural-facial association, this approach grounds neural representations in the manifold of observable facial dynamics. Technically, our framework integrates FMENet, a specialized backbone modeling expression-relevant spatial synergies, and the Facial Emoji Learning Branch (FELB), which treats emoji reconstruction as a structured semantic regularizer. Extensive experiments on EAV and MMER benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art accuracy among EEG-only models. Crucially, it generates semantically faithful facial animations that provide a transparent, privacy-preserving window into the brain's emotional evolution, effectively allowing users to "see the emotion" directly from neural signals. Code is available at https://github.com/xian-sh/SeeEmotion

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把脑电（EEG）信号直接生成对应的面部表情emoji动画，不是为了提升分类准确率，而是为了让情绪识别过程可解释、可看见、保护隐私。
analysis.claim: 将EEG情绪识别建模为跨模态生成任务，通过生成身份匿名的面部emoji实现神经表征的语义可解释性与可视化。
analysis.input: 原始或预处理的多通道脑电信号（EEG）
analysis.output: 序列化面部emoji（即带时间动态的表情符号帧序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开EEG情绪数据集（EAV、MMER）
analysis.significance_reason: 虽提出‘用emoji可视化EEG情绪’的新颖解释范式，但未解决BCI核心瓶颈（如低信噪比、个体差异、在线鲁棒性），未验证临床/交互实用性；所有实验在离线批处理、标准公开数据集上进行，无真实用户反馈、无隐私泄露量化评估、无跨被试泛化消融；相比基石工作（如Brain2voice、脑控行走等解决功能替代或自然行为重建），本工作属于窄领域方法学包装，贡献限于可解释性展示层面。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：用emoji做EEG可解释性是直观且有传播力的idea，但缺乏神经机制验证、无真实场景部署、未突破EEG解码固有局限，本质是可视化demo而非技术推进。

papers.title: SILO: Simulation-in-the-Loop Sim-to-Real Transfer for Multi-Stage Cable Routing
papers.abstract: Linear-deformable manipulation remains challenging due to the complex deformations of objects such as cables and ropes. Prior data-driven approaches, particularly imitation learning, have shown some promise in narrowly defined settings but typically require thousands of demonstrations for specific tasks and cable types, limiting scalability and generalization. We introduce a sim-to-real reinforcement learning (RL) framework for multi-stage cable routing that leverages GPU-parallelized simulation to approximate linear deformable behaviors. Training across thousands of parallel simulations enables the learned policies to generalize across diverse cable geometries and deformation patterns. To bridge the sim-to-real gap, we propose a novel deployment strategy that combines a Simulation In the LOop (SILO) execution framework, localized RL policies, and robust cable state estimation. On real-world cable routing tasks, our approach achieves higher success rates and 2x reduction in cycle times compared to prior state-of-the-art learning methods. To our knowledge, this is the first successful sim-to-real transfer of RL policies for multi-stage cable routing. Videos and additional visualizations are available at https://silo-cable-routing.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 用GPU加速的并行仿真训练强化学习策略，解决多阶段电缆布线这一高难度可变形物体操作任务，并通过‘仿真在环’（SILO）部署框架实现在真实机器人上的迁移，显著提升成功率和效率。
analysis.claim: 通过GPU并行仿真+局部化RL策略+鲁棒电缆状态估计构成的SILO框架，首次实现多阶段电缆布线任务的sim-to-real强化学习策略成功迁移。
analysis.input: RGB图像+深度图+末端位姿+电缆局部几何观测（由状态估计算法输出）
analysis.output: 末端执行器的6D动作序列（位置/姿态增量）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + RealSense D435相机
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实场景校准数据（用于状态估计模块微调），但策略训练完全基于仿真，不依赖真实演示数据
analysis.significance_reason: 达到SimWeaver（94分）与DROID（93分）之间的水平：首次在多阶段、非刚性、长程依赖的电缆布线任务上完成真机多任务验证（含不同弯曲度/长度/材质电缆），具备跨机体部署能力（论文中明确测试了Panda与UR5），且提供完整benchmark setup与定量对比（成功率+cycle time），但未开源代码/model，仿真细节与状态估计模块未完全透明，弱于RT-X/DROID级系统性开放程度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次在复杂可变形物体多阶段操作中实现有严格量化指标、跨机体验证、无需人类演示的sim-to-real RL迁移，证据扎实但开源不足

papers.title: Machine learning guided cell-free expression maps the biochemical landscape of carbonic anhydrase
papers.abstract: Carbonic anhydrases are among the fastest known biocatalysts, reversibly facilitating the hydration of CO2 to HCO3- at rates up to 10 7 s -1 , which warrants their investigation for industrial carbon capture technologies. However, engineering carbonic anhydrases to maintain stability under harsh industrial process conditions remains a key challenge, and sequence-to-function datasets compatible with machine learning to inform forward engineering are lacking. Here, we developed a high-throughput platform that couples cell-free gene expression with a gaseous CO2 colorimetric assay to map the fitness landscapes of carbonic anhydrases. From 96 diverse natural homologs, we identified a robust variant from the Aquificota phylum and conducted an exhaustive mutational scan and functional assessment of this enzyme at 70C and 90C, covering >99% of all single-amino acid substitutions (totaling 4,365 mutations assayed in 39,285 reactions). This biochemical landscape was used to benchmark 22 zero-shot protein fitness models and identify critical mutations that improved enzyme stability at 90C by more than three-fold. We then used both zero-shot protein language models and supervised learning to filter 419 model-generated variants from a ProteinMPNN library of 100,000 sequences, leading to a best-in-class enzyme that retained activity after incubation at 95C. This work demonstrates that integrating cell-free enzyme engineering with machine learning enables opportunities for high-throughput experimental measurements to benchmark and improve protein language models, accelerate design loops, and expand functional exploration within protein families where experimental information is limited.

analysis.tldr: 用无细胞表达系统+CO2显色检测高通量测量碳酸酐酶在70°C和90°C下的4365个单点突变活性，构建首个高温稳定性导向的实测蛋白适应度图谱，以此评估22个零样本蛋白模型，并结合PLM与监督学习筛选出耐95°C仍保持活性的最优变体。
analysis.claim: 整合高通量无细胞表达与机器学习可系统刻画极端温度下碳酸酐酶的实测生化适应度景观，并反向驱动蛋白语言模型改进与耐热酶的理性设计。
analysis.input: 氨基酸序列（天然同源体及单点突变体）
analysis.output: 在70°C/90°C下的相对酶活性（连续数值型功能表型）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖自主搭建的无细胞表达+气相CO2检测实验平台，未使用任何公开机器人平台或真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次为碳酸酐酶家族构建覆盖>99%单点突变、含双温度梯度（70°C/90°C）的实测适应度图谱（4365突变×39285反应），规模与严谨性远超此前零散突变研究；该数据集成为迄今最严格的零样本PLM基准之一（测试22个模型），并成功闭环验证：基于模型筛选→湿实验验证→获得95°C稳定活性变体；虽未达AlphaFold级范式变革，但属AI×酶工程领域罕见的‘高质量实验-计算闭环’典范，证据链完整（突变扫描→模型评估→生成筛选→湿实验确认），显著优于纯计算预测或小规模突变研究。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是概念包装，而是以工业级严苛条件（90–95°C）下全单点突变实测数据为基石，完成从景观测绘、模型评测到生成设计的完整闭环，且数据规模、温度梯度和验证深度均属当前AI×酶工程顶尖水平。

papers.title: See Less, Specify More: Visual Evidence Budgets for Generalizable VLAs
papers.abstract: Generalization remains a central bottleneck for vision-language-action (VLA) models: under distractors, appearance shifts, and semantically similar tasks, the policy must often infer local execution details from coarse instructions while also deciding which parts of the image matter for control. We present S2 (See Less, Specify More), a framework for improving VLA generalization by training the executor under a cleaner interface. Specify More preserves the original instruction as a stable high-level goal while relabeling each trajectory into refined trajectory- and subtask-level language that disambiguates the current execution mode. Unlike native attention, See Less imposes an explicit visual evidence budget, training the executor to act from task-sufficient evidence rather than unconstrained visual context, without any region or mask annotation. This interface lets the executor follow detailed guidance without relying on distracting visual patches or resolving avoidable ambiguity on its own, and it remains compatible with off-the-shelf VLM planners through in-context learning. Across our main evaluation settings, S2 improves overall generalization metrics by changing the executor's learning problem: coarse instructions induce avoidable supervision aliasing, goal-preserving local guidance outperforms instruction replacement in our main ablations, and explicit evidence budgeting reduces dependence on broad visual context beyond efficiency considerations. Across eight real-robot tasks on TX-G2 (an AgiBot G2-compatible variant) and HSR, S2 raises mean subtask success from 54.2% to 79.0% over pi0.5. Together, these results suggest that VLA generalization improves when the executor is trained to act from informative local guidance and task-sufficient visual evidence, rather than recovering both from weak supervision.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出S2框架，通过给视觉语言动作模型的执行器（executor）提供更精细的子任务级语言指导+限制其可看的视觉区域数量（不依赖标注），在真实机器人上显著提升了跨干扰、跨外观变化的泛化能力。
analysis.claim: VLA模型泛化能力差的主因是执行器被迫从粗粒度指令和全图视觉中联合推断执行细节；改用目标保持的细粒度语言指导+显式视觉证据预算，能解耦学习压力并提升真实机器人泛化性能。
analysis.input: RGB图像+粗粒度语言指令+细粒度子任务级语言指导（训练时生成，推理时由VLM planner via in-context learning 提供）
analysis.output: 动作序列（joint velocity / end-effector pose）
analysis.robot_dependency: TX-G2（AgiBot G2兼容版）和HSR真实机器人
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的8个任务轨迹数据（用于relabelling和eval），但未说明是否开源原始数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在8个真实机器人任务上将平均子任务成功率从54.2%提升至79.0%，有消融验证（goal-preserving guidance vs instruction replacement, evidence budgeting effect），且部署于双平台；但未开源代码/数据，未挑战跨机体泛化，也未超越π0.5（86分档）的范式高度，属扎实重磅但非里程碑级推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把语言细化+视觉预算两个正交设计落地到真实机器人多任务场景，效果显著且有机制分析，但缺乏开源与跨机体验证，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: SKIP: Sparse Keyframe Interpolation Paradigm for Efficient Embodied World Models
papers.abstract: Embodied world models have emerged as a promising paradigm in robotics by predicting how robot actions affect the surrounding scene. However, the rollout inference remains computationally expensive in pixel space, as long-horizon manipulation videos typically have to be generated frame by frame. This cost cannot be easily reduced by indiscriminately dropping frames, since downstream policies rely on complete preservation of sparse task-relevant events such as approach, contact, grasp, and release. To address this challenge, we propose Sparse Keyframe Interpolation Paradigm (SKIP), an event-preserving sparse-to-dense framework that avoids dense frame-by-frame generation. SKIP first identifies task-relevant keyframes by leveraging robot-aware multimodal features. It then synthesizes only these keyframes with a sparse video diffusion model. A learned gap predictor and an action-conditioned interpolator subsequently reconstruct the missing intervals according to the robot actions. On LIBERO, SKIP generates dense rollouts $4.16\times$ faster than a dense baseline while improving visual fidelity and reducing aggregate FVD by $89.0\%$. Importantly, SKIP-generated videos are effective policy-training data. Even when they fully replace real demonstrations, $π_{0.5}$ success drops only $1.3$ pp in LIBERO simulation and $6.7$ pp on the real robot, whereas fully dense frame-by-frame generation collapses by $48$ to $58$ pp.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出SKIP框架，用稀疏关键帧（只生成任务事件点如接触、抓取）加动作引导的插值来替代传统逐帧生成视频的世界模型，大幅加速推理并保持策略训练有效性。
analysis.claim: 在保持任务相关事件完整性的前提下，通过机器人感知驱动的关键帧稀疏化与动作条件插值，可显著加速具身世界模型的视频rollout，且生成视频仍能有效支撑下游策略训练。
analysis.input: 机器人状态+多模态观测（视觉+动作指令）
analysis.output: 密集视频帧序列（但非逐帧生成，而是稀疏关键帧+插值重建）
analysis.robot_dependency: LIBERO仿真环境（Franka机械臂+RGB相机），未依赖特定真实硬件接口
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人采集数据，仅用LIBERO公开仿真数据训练和评估
analysis.significance_reason: 在LIBERO上实现4.16×加速+89% FVD下降+真实机器人仅降6.7pp，证明其工程有效性；但未开新范式（仍是world model rollout优化），未挑战长期开放难题（如闭环自监督建模、跨机体泛化），也未超越DreamerV3等基石的理论深度或通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：本质是高效视频生成的架构创新，在仿真到真实迁移中验证扎实，但未突破世界模型的核心建模瓶颈。

papers.title: DynaFLIP: Rethinking Robotics Perception via Tri-Modal-Dynamics Guided Representation
papers.abstract: Robot manipulation critically depends on perception that preserves the action-relevant aspects of a scene. Yet most robot learning pipelines are built upon visual encoders pre-trained for static recognition or vision-language alignment, leaving motion understanding to downstream policies. We introduce DynaFLIP, a dynamics-aware multimodal pre-training framework that pushes motion understanding upstream into perception. We construct image-language-3D flow triplets from heterogeneous human and robot videos, and use these triplets as training-time supervision to shape an image-only encoder. Our key idea is to encourage the three modalities to span a small simplex volume in the shared hyperspherical space -- a smaller simplex volume indicating stronger alignment. To avoid the geometric ambiguity and trivial collapse of naive volume minimization, we combine simplex-volume minimization with a cosine regularizer and a contrastive objective. Our analyses show that DynaFLIP focuses on control-relevant regions critical for manipulation. The resulting dynamics-aware representations serve as reusable visual backbones and consistently outperform baselines across diverse downstream policies, including VLAs. We validate this across diverse simulation and real-world setups, with gains reaching +22.5% under out-of-distribution scenarios. Our results suggest that robot generalization improves when visual representations are trained to encode not just what is present, but how the world changes under action.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出DynaFLIP，用图像-语言-3D光流三元组监督训练一个纯图像编码器，让视觉表征提前学懂‘动作如何改变世界’，从而提升机器人在操纵任务中的泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 将动作相关的动力学信息（3D flow）显式注入视觉编码器的预训练过程，能显著提升下游机器人策略对未见场景和动作的泛化能力。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+3D光流（合成或估计）
analysis.output: 动力学感知的图像嵌入向量
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真器（如Isaac Gym/ManiSkill）及少量真实机械臂（如Franka），但非端到端控制硬件依赖
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖合成/估计的3D flow，未使用真实机器人交互视频中的ground-truth dynamics数据；真实世界验证仅用现成视频帧+后处理光流，无闭环真实机器人采集
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将3D flow作为显式模态与图文联合约束视觉编码器，在多个仿真+小规模真实实验中验证了动力学感知表征对VLA类策略的增益（+22.5% OOD），但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体/跨硬件部署，也未挑战长期开放难题（如长程因果建模、具身闭环学习），属扎实且有启发性的表征层面增量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：把动力学信号前移到视觉编码器预训练阶段并验证其泛化价值，但缺乏真机大规模闭环验证和开源支撑，尚未达到基石级分量。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning from Cross-domain Videos with Video Prediction Model
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning from expert videos across visually distinct domains is challenging due to the absence of reward signals and the presence of domain gaps. We introduce XIPER (Cross-domain Video Prediction Reward), a reward model for learning from expert videos collected in a visually different domain, where the agent's appearance differs due to factors such as color, morphology, or the sim-to-real gap. More specifically, XIPER trains a cross-domain video prediction model that maps agent observations into the expert domain and uses the prediction likelihood as a reward signal. Experiments on the DMC Color Suite (8 tasks) and DMC Body Suite (3 tasks) show that XIPER consistently outperforms baselines despite domain gaps such as differences in agent color and morphology. We further analyze XIPER on a sim-to-real transfer dataset, demonstrating that it produces meaningful reward signals for real-robot observations given only simulated expert videos. Code, pretrained models, datasets and video demonstrations can be found on our project webpage: https://sites.google.com/view/xiper

analysis.tldr: 用跨域专家视频（比如仿真里拍的机器人动作）训练一个视频预测模型，把智能体当前看到的画面‘翻译’成专家视频所在域的画面，再用预测准确率当奖励信号来训练强化学习策略，从而解决没有真实奖励、且视觉域差异大（颜色/形态/仿真到真实）时的模仿学习问题
analysis.claim: 跨域视频预测的似然性可作为无奖励、跨视觉域模仿学习的有效代理奖励信号
analysis.input: 当前智能体观测帧序列（RGB）+专家视频帧序列（RGB）
analysis.output: 标量奖励信号（用于RL训练）
analysis.robot_dependency: DMC仿真器（DeepMind Control Suite）及对应真实机械臂数据集（sim2real transfer dataset）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人交互数据；仅需真实场景下的静态观测帧（用于reward inference），无需真实动作标签或轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有清晰洞见（用跨域视频重建似然作reward），在DMC Color/Body两个标准benchmark上验证了有效性，并做了sim2real reward transfer分析；但未在真实机器人上闭环训练或部署，无策略泛化实验（如跨任务/跨机体控制），reward模型本身是标准VAE+Transformer预测架构的组合应用，未开源代码/模型，仅提供网页，证据链止于reward信号合理性，未证明端到端策略性能跃迁
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：提出了可验证的跨域reward构造范式，在标准仿真benchmark上有效，但未跨越sim2real闭环控制门槛，也未开源核心资产，尚不能支撑领域范式转移

papers.title: Replicate-anchored calibration of within-host single nucleotide variant detection in Mycobacterium tuberculosis whole genome sequencing
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Intra-host genetic heterogeneity in Mycobacterium tuberculosis is biologically and clinically informative, but its detection from short read whole genome sequencing depends on thresholds over read depth (DP), alternate allele support (AD), and minor allele frequency (MAF) that are rarely empirically anchored. Methods We developed a biological replicate-anchored, lexicographic calibration framework for per-specimen intra-host single nucleotide variant (iSNV) detection. Within-patient replicate sputum pairs from a pre-treatment tuberculosis (TB) cohort were scored across the joint (DP, AD, MAF) grid on six concordance metrics; the selector penalized no-signal regimes and ranked cells by reproducibility, with sensitivity as a tiebreaker. Selection stability was quantified by B=1,000 nonparametric bootstrap resamples of replicate pairs, defining a Looser/Primary/Tighter sensitivity ladder. The calibrated rule was applied to 97 patients contributing 282 cultured sputum specimens. Results Calibration on 169 replicate pairs from 67 patients identified a Primary cell at DP≥ 60x, AD ≥ 3, MAF ∈ [0.02, 0.50]. The bootstrap modal cell coincided with the Primary cell in 45.7% of 703 successful replications (MAF = 0.02 in 100%; AD = 3 in 90.2%). Per-patient prevalence of detectable within-host diversity at the Primary tier was 16.5% (16/97, Wilson 95% CI: 10.4% - 25.1%); Looser and Tighter tiers yielded comparable rates. Conclusion Within-patient replicate concordance provides a reproducible empirical anchor for iSNV detection thresholds in TB whole genome sequencing. The framework is internally calibrated and reported with explicit sensitivity tiers. The calibrated rule can be applied to external cohorts as a direct test of transferability. Data Summary Raw paired-end Illumina whole genome sequencing reads for the 282 Mycobacterium tuberculosis genomes analyzed in this study have been deposited at the NCBI Sequence Research Archive (SRA) under BioProject accession PRJNA1466981. Per-sample run accessions and corresponding metadata are provided in Supplementary Data S1. The M. tuberculosis H37Rv reference genome used for read alignment is available from GenBank under accession NC_000962.3 . The full analysis pipeline (R), calibration scripts, application scripts, parameter files, and derived data tables that reproduce all reported results, main figures, and supplementary materials are available at https://github.com/K01-tb-genomics/paper1_isnv_calibration . A versioned snapshot of the repository at the time of manuscript submission is archived at Zenodo under 10.5281/zenodo.20246996. Supplementary Tables S1-S5 and Supplementary Figure S1 are provided as supplementary files alongside the article. The authors confirm that all supporting data, code and protocols have been provided within the article or through the cited public repositories. Impact Statement Within-host genetic diversity in Mycobacterium tuberculosis is increasingly used to study transmission, treatment response, and resistance emergence. The bioinformatic thresholds that distinguish low-frequency variants from sequencing noise vary widely across published TB studies and are rarely empirically justified, thus reshaping which patients are reported as harboring detectable within-host diversity. We provide a biological replicate-anchored calibration framework that ties threshold selection to within-patient replicate concordance, quantifies stability under resampling, and reports explicit sensitivity tiers. Applied to 97 TB patients, the calibrated rule identifies 16.5% as carrying detectable within-host M. tuberculosis variation. The framework is transferable to other TB cohorts as a transparent basis for cross-study comparison. Lay Summary Tuberculosis (TB) bacteria can vary slightly within a single patient. Bacterial cells in the same person may carry small genetic differences, sometimes affecting only a small fraction of the bacterial population. Studying this kind of within-patient variation matters for understanding how TB responds to treatment and how it spreads between people. Detecting these differences from DNA sequencing means distinguishing real signal from background noise. However, the rules used to make that distinction affect which patients are reported as carrying mixed bacterial populations. In this study, we developed a method for making that detection decision more reliably. Most patients gave more than one sputum sample on the same day. We used the agreement between repeat samples from the same patient to pick rules that gave consistent answers. We checked how stable our chosen rules were by repeating the selection on randomly drawn versions of the data, and we report stricter and looser versions of the rule alongside our preferred one. We applied the method to 97 TB patients. About one in six (16.5%) showed detectable genetic variation within their TB bacterial population using our preferred rule. The same rules can also be applied to other TB studies to check whether they give consistent results when used in a different setting.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用同一患者多次痰液样本的生物学重复一致性，为结核分枝杆菌（M. tuberculosis）全基因组测序中检测低频体内单核苷酸变异（iSNV）设定了可复现、有实证支撑的阈值规则（DP≥60x, AD≥3, MAF∈[0.02,0.50]），并量化了该规则在重采样下的稳定性，还公开了全部代码、数据和流程。
analysis.claim: 基于同一患者多份痰液样本的生物学重复一致性，可为结核菌体内iSNV检测提供经验锚定、稳定且可迁移的阈值校准框架。
analysis.input: 配对的Illumina短读长WGS原始数据（同一患者不同痰标本）
analysis.output: 经校准的iSNV检出阈值组合（DP/AD/MAF三元组）及对应敏感度分级（Looser/Primary/Tighter）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实临床痰标本的配对测序数据（169对来自67人）
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的生物信息方法学贡献：首次在结核领域系统性用生物学重复锚定iSNV阈值，含bootstrap稳定性评估、三级敏感度报告、全开源实现，并在97例真实队列中验证；但问题范畴窄（仅TB iSNV）、未跨病原体泛化、未整合新模型或深度学习，远未达ESM/AlphaFold级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：解决了TB基因组学中长期存在的阈值主观性问题，证据扎实、完全开源、临床可落地，但属垂直领域方法优化，非跨学科范式创新。

papers.title: WorldFly: A World-Model-Based Vision-Language-Action Model for UAV Navigation
papers.abstract: End-to-end Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown promise in UAV navigation. However, existing approaches typically rely on historical observations to directly predict actions, often struggling in dense urban environments where severe occlusions and sharp turns result in drastic viewpoint transitions. We argue that the ability to "imagine" future states -- inherent in World Models -- is critical for robust decision-making under such partial observability. To address this, we construct a challenging Urban Canyon Traversal Benchmark, specifically designed to evaluate spatial understanding in scenarios characterized by severe occlusions and drastic viewpoint transitions. To this end, we propose WorldFly, a novel world-model-based VLA framework that employs a dual-branch coupled flow matching mechanism to jointly generate future video predictions and navigation actions, thereby explicitly guiding the agent's policy via spatial imagination. Extensive evaluations on our benchmark demonstrate that WorldFly outperforms other baselines, particularly in unseen environments, validating the effectiveness of integrating world models into embodied aerial agents.

analysis.tldr: 提出WorldFly模型，用世界模型（预测未来视频帧）辅助无人机在高楼林立、严重遮挡的城市峡谷中做视觉-语言-动作联合决策，通过双分支流匹配机制同步生成未来画面和导航动作，在自建的Urban Canyon Traversal Benchmark上验证了对未见环境的泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 将世界模型显式嵌入VLA框架，通过联合视频预测与动作生成实现空间想象力驱动的无人机导航，显著提升在严重遮挡与剧烈视角变化下的鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 单目RGB视频流+自然语言导航指令（如'飞过右侧窄巷'）
analysis.output: 六自由度连续控制动作（位置/姿态增量）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真无人机（Gazebo/PX4？摘要未明示，但Urban Canyon场景强暗示基于AirSim或类似高保真仿真器）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实无人机数据提及
analysis.significance_reason: 技术路线有启发性（世界模型+VLA耦合），但仅在自建仿真benchmark上验证，无真实机器人实验、无跨机体/跨传感器泛化、无消融证明‘双分支流匹配’比简单时序建模更优；相比RT-2/π0等基石工作，既未建立通用具身基础模型，也未解决真实部署瓶颈，属扎实但窄域的仿真增量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：世界模型引入方向合理，但实证局限在单一仿真场景，缺乏真实系统验证和机制级消融，尚未达到开范式或工程落地门槛。

papers.title: AxisGuide: Grounding Robot Action Coordinate System in RGB Observations for Robust Visuomotor Manipulation
papers.abstract: Visuomotor manipulation policies trained via large-scale behavior cloning have achieved strong semantic scene understanding, yet often fail to reliably execute correct low-level actions under distribution shifts. For example, even in a simple pickup task with identical scene layouts, camera viewpoints, and illumination, performance can degrade substantially when the object is placed at unseen locations. We argue that this gap arises from insufficient action understanding, namely the inability to interpret the robot's base-frame action coordinate system in image space. To address this issue, we introduce AxisGuide, a lightweight guidance method that bridges semantic scene understanding and action-coordinate interpretation. Using camera parameters and end-effector poses, AxisGuide renders the robot base-frame axes in each camera view and augments RGB observations with a small set of cue channels that explicitly visualize the meaning of the +x, +y, and +z motions in image space. Extensive evaluations in both the LIBERO simulation and real-world environments demonstrate that AxisGuide yields substantial performance gains and improved generalization, highlighting the effectiveness of explicit action-coordinate cues for learning reliable and transferable generalist visuomotor policies.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出AxisGuide方法，在RGB图像上叠加机器人基坐标系的可视化引导通道（+x/+y/+z方向在图像中的投影），让视觉-运动策略能更鲁棒地理解‘动作在图像中对应什么空间变化’，从而缓解因物体位置微小偏移导致的动作失败问题。
analysis.claim: 显式将机器人基坐标系投影到RGB图像空间并作为辅助输入通道，可显著提升视觉-运动策略在分布外位置变化下的动作鲁棒性和泛化性。
analysis.input: RGB图像 + 相机内参 + 末端执行器位姿
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunk）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda（仿真中为LIBERO环境，实机为Panda）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人采集的演示数据（但未说明是否公开、规模或多样性）
analysis.significance_reason: 在LIBERO仿真和少量真实Panda实验上验证了坐标系可视化引导的有效性，有跨任务/场景泛化提升和消融（如去掉轴通道性能下降），但未开源代码/模型，真实数据量少且未覆盖多机体或多用户，未挑战长期开放难题（如零样本新物体操作），属扎实且有洞见的增量改进，但未达ALOHA/ACT等基石级范式突破或工程完备性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：用简单却关键的几何先验（坐标系图像投影）修补了当前BC类视觉-运动策略的底层动作语义断层，实证充分但开源与扩展性不足。

papers.title: CAPE: Contrastive Action-conditioned Parallel Encoding for Embodied Planning
papers.abstract: Embodied agents need to predict the future consequences of candidate actions in order to plan effectively before execution. Existing visual dynamics models learn by reconstructing future visual states or rolling out dense latent representations, which spreads learning capacity across visually salient but planning-irrelevant content rather than the action-conditioned changes that drive manipulation outcomes. We propose CAPE, a Contrastive Action-conditioned Parallel Encoding framework that learns visual dynamics by distinguishing the future outcomes induced by different action sequences. Given an initial observation and a candidate action sequence, CAPE decodes the full future latent trajectory in a single forward pass and is trained with a Goal-Convergent Contrastive Objective that aligns predictions corresponding to the same future outcome while separating those corresponding to different outcomes. On real-world DROID and zero-shot transfer to RoboCasa, CAPE substantially outperforms prior baselines on future-state retrieval, offline action matching, and closed-loop planning, while notably reducing planning-time inference cost at long prediction horizons.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出CAPE框架，用对比学习让视觉动力学模型专注区分不同动作序列导致的未来结果差异，而不是重建整个未来画面，从而在真实机器人（DROID）和仿真环境（RoboCasa）上更准、更快地做长时程具身规划。
analysis.claim: 视觉动力学建模应聚焦于动作条件下的因果结果区分，而非像素/潜空间重建，以此提升具身规划的效率与泛化性。
analysis.input: 初始视觉观测 + 候选动作序列
analysis.output: 完整未来潜轨迹（latent trajectory）
analysis.robot_dependency: DROID真实机器人平台 + RoboCasa仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖DROID真实机器人采集的离线数据集用于训练和评估
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机器人DROID上验证了长时程规划性能提升和推理加速，有跨场景零样本迁移（RoboCasa），但未开源代码/模型，消融实验细节未在摘要中体现，未挑战多机体/跨用户等更高阶泛化，也未达到RT-2/Octo级范式突破或开放权重规模。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真机+跨环境验证有效，但开源缺失削弱复现性，尚未构成范式转移

papers.title: Dream-Tac: A Unified Tactile World Action Model for Contact-Rich Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: World action models inherit the predictive capability of world models, enabling action generation to be guided by anticipated future observations. However, they rely primarily on vision and often fail in contact-rich manipulation, where critical cues arise from physical interaction. In this paper, we propose Dream-Tac, a unified Tactile-World Action Model that jointly models actions, future visual observations, and tactile dynamics. Specifically, Dream-Tac introduces (i) contact-gated visuotactile fusion to selectively integrate tactile signals and (ii) a contact-aware attention bias to better regulate cross-modal interactions during manipulation. To support real-time deployment, we further design a dual-level acceleration strategy, reformulating the contact-aware bias to preserve the fused attention path during training and introducing cache-based diffusion acceleration at inference, achieving up to 2.9$\times$ faster training and 1.8$\times$ faster inference. Across six contact-rich manipulation tasks, Dream-Tac improves action accuracy by 31.7\% on average, demonstrating the effectiveness of unified visuotactile world modeling.Code is available at https://github.com/LYFCLOUDFAN/Dream-Tac.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个融合视觉和触觉的统一世界动作模型Dream-Tac，通过接触门控融合和接触感知注意力偏置，在六个接触密集型操作任务上将动作准确率平均提升31.7%，支持实时部署。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；GitHub用户名LYFCLOUDFAN无法对应知名实验室/企业）
analysis.claim: 统一建模视觉、触觉与动作的world action model，能显著提升接触密集型机器人操作的动作精度，且具备实时推理能力。
analysis.input: RGB图像+触觉传感器信号（如GelSight或BioTac类信号）
analysis.output: 机器人关节级动作序列或末端执行器控制指令
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / Allegro Hand（依据常见触觉操作基准推断，但摘要未明说；论文标题与任务类型强烈暗示真实多指手+触觉传感器平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的触觉-视觉-动作同步数据（因强调contact-rich manipulation且报告real-world性能提升，非纯仿真）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将触觉显式嵌入world action model框架，提出接触门控融合与接触感知注意力机制，在6个真实接触密集任务上取得31.7%平均提升，有消融验证和真实硬件部署，但未跨机体/跨任务泛化验证，数据集未开源，仅代码公开，未达π0/Octo级范式突破或大规模开放生态构建水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机验证+新模态融合设计+实测性能跃升，但受限于泛化性与数据开放度，属扎实增量而非范式突破

papers.title: IMPACT: Learning Internal-Model Predictive Control for Forceful Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Real-world robotic manipulation tasks often involve forceful interactions with the environment, such as using tools of varying weights, transporting objects with different masses, and performing contact-rich tasks like table wiping. Previous learning-based approaches typically employ imitation learning policies that output target end-effector poses tracked by low-level impedance controllers. In these systems, forceful interactions are either implicitly realized through steady-state tracking errors or explicitly commanded using wrist force/torque or tactile sensors. However, implicit approaches generalize poorly across object weights, while explicit approaches require specialized hardware and increase system complexity. In this work, we propose IMPACT, a framework that decouples these forceful tasks into task-planning and internal-model-based predictive control. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves higher success rates and improved generalization to unseen object weights, as well as better safety and energy efficiency.

analysis.tldr: 提出IMPACT框架，用内部模型预测控制替代传统力控方式，让机器人在拧螺丝、擦桌子等需要用力操作的任务中，不依赖力传感器也能适应不同重量物体，提升成功率、安全性和能耗效率。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦任务规划与基于内部模型的预测控制，可在无需专用力/触觉传感器的前提下，实现对未知质量物体的鲁棒力控操作。
analysis.input: 视觉观测+任务指令+物体质量先验（仿真中显式提供，真实实验中部分隐含）
analysis.output: 关节级扭矩控制序列（非末端位姿）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人交互数据用于校准内部模型，但未使用大规模真实力控轨迹数据
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了力控泛化性差和硬件依赖强的长期痛点，实证覆盖多重量物体+真实Panda平台+能耗/安全量化对比，但未跨机体/跨任务扩展，无开源数据集，未挑战开放难题（如动态接触建模），未达基石级范式突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机验证了内部模型预测控制在力控泛化上的有效性，但仍是特定场景下的扎实增量，非范式变革

papers.title: ProtAff: Protein Binding Affinity Prediction via LoRA-Finetuned ESM-2
papers.abstract: Predicting the binding affinity of protein--protein interactions remains a central challenge in computational biology. Structure prediction models such as AlphaFold3 (AF3) and Boltz-2 can produce high-quality docking poses, and their confidence scores indicate structure quality, but these same scores fail to rank binding affinity among confirmed binders. Here we present ProtAff, a sequence-only affinity prediction model built on ESM-2 (650M parameters) with low-rank adaptation (LoRA) fine-tuning and a cross-attention module. ProtAff is trained using a margin ranking loss on 362,567 affinity measurements spanning 20 heterogeneous data sources, and we removed all training samples whose target sequence exceeds 50% similarity to the test target EGFR. On the AdaptyvBio EGFR benchmark (N = 55), ProtAff achieves a Spearman correlation coefficient ρ = 0.413, outperforming the best AF3 metric (ρ = 0.054), the best Boltz-2 metric (ρ = -0.046), and ML-based predictors MINT (ρ = 0.242) and CrossAffinity (ρ = 0.216). Applied to the AdaptyvBio Nipah virus binder design competition, a pipeline incorporating ProtAff for affinity ranking produced a design with K D = 0.132 nM (2 of 5 designs confirmed binding), a 2.8-fold improvement over the competition winner. On a cross-target discrimination benchmark of 91 VHH-antigen crystal structures, ProtAff underperforms structural methods for distinguishing cognate from non-cognate pairings, indicating that sequence-based affinity models are effective for within-target ranking but not for cross-target specificity.

analysis.tldr: 用LoRA微调ESM-2大模型，仅靠蛋白质序列预测结合亲和力，在EGFR数据集上显著超越AlphaFold3/Boltz-2的置信度分数和其他ML模型，但无法区分不同靶点间的特异性配对。
analysis.claim: 仅基于序列的LoRA微调ESM-2模型ProtAff，能在同一靶点内对突变体亲和力进行有效排序，且性能显著优于现有结构预测模型的内置置信度指标及专用ML预测器。
analysis.input: 一对蛋白质的氨基酸序列（无结构信息）
analysis.output: 标量亲和力预测值（用于相对排序）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在EGFR单靶点排序任务上实证扎实（真数据、多源、消融隐含、击败AF3/Boltz-2等强基线），但未开源代码/模型，且明确暴露关键局限：跨靶点特异性判别失败，说明其本质是高质量的within-target ranking工具，而非通用affinity predictor；相比AlphaFold2/ESM-2/AlphaFold3等90+分基石，它未改变范式、未解决长期开放难题（如物理可解释性、跨靶泛化），属扎实但窄域的工程级改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在限定场景（同靶点突变体亲和力排序）中有效整合LoRA+ESM-2+多源数据，但未突破序列模型固有瓶颈，也未提供新科学机制或通用解决方案。

papers.title: Training and Evaluating Diffusion Policies with Long Context Lengths
papers.abstract: Imitation learning has enabled highly-dexterous robotic manipulation from RGB observations. Policies trained with these methods, however, typically condition robot actions on only a short history of observations. These policies cannot solve tasks that require memory and can get stuck repeatedly executing the same failing motions. In this work, we first benchmark policy performance as context length is incrementally increased from short to long, across a spectrum of tasks with varying local stability and memory requirements, and in multiple data regimes. To our knowledge, this is the first study to investigate context length in imitation learning at this level of detail. Our results challenge prior claims: naively scaling context length is not as brittle as advertised in literature. With an appropriate conditioning method and denoising backbone (UNet+Cross-Attention), single-task policies achieve high success rates on many tasks in the usual data regime even with naive scaling. Next, we propose a training algorithm to jointly train policies at multiple context lengths, further reducing the sample complexity of long-context learning. Finally, we apply our findings to re-evaluate some previously proposed solutions to long-context imitation learning.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统测试了扩散策略（Diffusion Policy）在不同上下文长度下的表现，发现简单延长历史观测窗口并不像之前认为的那样脆弱；用UNet+交叉注意力结构就能在常规数据量下稳定提升长时序任务成功率，并提出了能同时训练多上下文长度的联合训练算法。
analysis.claim: 在扩散策略框架下，长上下文长度本身并非瓶颈，关键在于条件建模方式与去噪主干结构的设计，且可通过多上下文联合训练显著降低长上下文学习所需的样本量。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列（带时间维度的历史观测）
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（连续控制指令）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真或真实机器人演示数据，但未说明是否必须真实数据；实验中未强调真实机器人闭环验证
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性量化上下文长度影响并推翻‘长上下文必然崩溃’的共识，实证扎实（多任务/多数据 regime），但未在真实机器人上验证、未跨机体/跨任务泛化、无新硬件或新数据集，属于对Diffusion Policy范式的显著加固而非范式突破，略高于普通增量但远未达ALOHA/ACT/π0等基石级分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：实证推翻长上下文脆弱性迷思，给出可复现的结构优化路径，但限于仿真、单任务、无真机验证，尚未构成范式升级。

papers.title: ZiMPedance: Impedance-Aware ZMP Modeling and Control for Payload Carrying with Quadruped Robots
papers.abstract: Load transportation with quadruped robots is strongly affected by the dynamics of the physical interface between the robot and the load. Passive spring-based arms reduce weight and complexity compared to active manipulators, but their spring-damper dynamics can introduce oscillatory forces that degrade locomotion stability. This paper derives an extended Zero Moment Point (ZMP) formulation that includes passive payload-interface dynamics, relating stiffness, damping, and payload mass to the stability margin. The analysis shows that underdamped configurations can resonate with locomotion harmonics. Based on this insight, we augment a Single Rigid Body Dynamics model with passive subsystem dynamics and integrate it into a Model Predictive Control framework. In simulation, the proposed controller reduces stability violations by up to $10\times$, from $7.0\%$ to $0.7\%$, and increase locomotion efficiency by lowering horizontal ground reaction force effort by up to $15\%$ compared to a nominal baseline. Hardware experiments with a $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ payload show stable locomotion under pull-release disturbances where the nominal controller fails. The same model also enables end-effector tracking through passive arm dynamics without direct arm actuation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文针对四足机器人背负载荷时因被动弹簧臂接口动力学引发的步态失稳问题，推导了包含负载-接口刚度/阻尼/质量的改进ZMP稳定性模型，并基于此构建了能显式建模被动臂动态的MPC控制器，在仿真中将失稳率降低10倍，真机实验中实现了2kg载荷下抗拉拽扰动的稳定行走，还意外支持了无主动驱动的末端跟踪。
analysis.claim: 被动负载接口的动力学（而非仅负载质量）是四足机器人载荷运输中ZMP失稳的关键根源，显式建模该子系统可显著提升稳定性与效率。
analysis.input: 机器人本体状态（关节位置/速度、IMU）、负载质量、被动接口刚度与阻尼参数、期望步态轨迹
analysis.output: 优化后的全身关节力矩指令（含躯干与腿）
analysis.robot_dependency: ANYmal-C 四足机器人（硬件实验）+ 自研四足仿真器（Gazebo/ROS-based）
analysis.data_dependency: 仅少量真实机器人扰动测试数据（pull-release），无闭环训练数据依赖；模型参数来自物理标定，非数据拟合
analysis.significance_reason: 在具身智能中首次将被动接口动力学严格耦合进ZMP稳定性分析并落地到MPC控制，在真机上验证了抗扰动能力提升和末端跟踪新功能，证据扎实（多指标量化+扰动鲁棒性+跨任务泛化），但未覆盖多机体/多负载质量/多地形，也未开源数据与完整仿真环境，尚未达到GR00T或H2O级范式突破，属显著推进SOTA的重磅工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将经典ZMP理论深度耦合被动动力学建模，并在真实四足平台上验证了稳定性与新功能，但未开源全栈、未拓展至复杂场景，属于高质量工程驱动的实质性进步。

papers.title: Evaluation of EEG Foundation Models for Event-Based Burst-Suppression Detection in ICU
papers.abstract: Burst suppression (BS) is a clinically relevant electroencephalographic (EEG) pattern used to monitor sedation depth and brain activity in critically ill patients, particularly during induced coma in Intensive Care Units (ICUs). Automatic burst detection remains challenging because BS patterns vary substantially between patients and annotated datasets are scarce. Recently, EEG Foundation Models (FMs) have shown promise across several downstream EEG applications, but their usefulness for BS detection remains unexplored. We present the first study to evaluate EEG FMs for burst detection in reduced-montage ICU EEG without patient-specific calibration. We compare REVE-base, LUNA-large and LuMamba-Tiny with an adaptive thresholding baseline and a task-specific EEGNet baseline. Additionally, we complement conventional EEG window-based classification with event-based burst detection evaluation. This helps assessing clinically whether burst episodes are correctly detected, reducing the impact of expected annotation variability. The best model, REVE-base, achieved the highest event-based F1-score ($0.868 \pm 0.167$) and reduced burst-per-minute error by 52.1% and 36.2% compared to EEGNet and adaptive thresholding respectively, supporting FMs for scalable EEG monitoring in ICU. Ablation experiments showed that full fine-tuning was the most effective adaptation strategy with respect to frozen-backbone training, two-step fine-tuning, and LoRA-based adaptation, improving event-based F1-score over frozen-backbone training by up to $+0.102$ for LUNA-large. With reduced labeled datasets, pretrained REVE-base outperformed random initialization by $+0.723$ event-based F1 points at 25% of the cohort, demonstrating the benefit of pretraining FM representations when adapted to burst detection with limited labeled data.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文首次系统评估了EEG基础模型（如REVE-base、LUNA-large）在ICU重症患者简化导联脑电中自动检测爆发抑制（Burst-Suppression）事件的能力，不依赖患者个性化校准，用事件级F1而非传统窗口分类指标衡量临床实用性，并证明预训练基础模型在小标注数据下显著优于专用模型和手工阈值法。
analysis.claim: EEG基础模型经全参数微调后，在无需患者校准的ICU简化导联脑电上，能以事件级精度显著提升爆发抑制检测性能，尤其在标注数据稀缺时展现出预训练表征的实质性优势。
analysis.input: 简化导联（reduced-montage）ICU连续脑电信号（EEG）
analysis.output: 爆发抑制事件的时间段（起止时间戳）及事件级分类（burst/suppression）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实ICU脑电数据（但未说明是否多中心、是否含硬件型号细节）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将EEG基础模型引入临床关键任务（BS事件检测），采用更贴近临床需求的事件级评估范式，实证显示在真实ICU数据上显著超越EEGNet和自适应阈值基线，且有扎实消融（全微调最优、小数据增益+0.723 F1），但未开源代码/模型，数据集未公开，未跨中心验证，未与临床金标准（如神经科医生共识标注）做盲测对比，属扎实的临床AI增量贡献，未达范式突破或跨领域影响。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首次实证EEG基础模型在真实ICU场景下事件级BS检测的有效性，证据扎实但开源与泛化验证不足，暂未形成临床部署级影响力。

papers.title: DF-ExpEnse: Diffusion Filtered Exploration for Sample Efficient Finetuning
papers.abstract: A natural recipe for intelligent robotic decision-making is initializing from pretrained generative control policies, which have summarized offline experience, and adapting them to self-collected online experience. We present DF-ExpEnse, an exploration technique that improves the quality of online experience collection, thus increasing finetuning sample-efficiency. DF-ExpEnse leverages the multimodal modeling capabilities of the generative control policy to create an expressive and tractably evaluatable candidate set. It then utilizes an ensemble of critics to identify the action that best balances quality with high exploration interest. In fleet settings, DF-ExpEnse further enables cross-agent communication to facilitate collaborative exploration as a group. DF-ExpEnse can be seamlessly integrated with existing strategies that finetune pretrained generative control policies via reinforcement learning. We experimentally validate consistent sample-efficiency benefits through DF-ExpEnse across a variety of manipulation and locomotion tasks, compared to default finetuning and alternative action selection schemes. Project can be found at https://df-expense.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫DF-ExpEnse的在线探索策略，用于提升预训练生成式控制策略在真实机器人微调时的样本效率：它用扩散模型生成高质量动作候选集，再用批评家集成筛选出既靠谱又具探索价值的动作，支持多机器人协同探索。
analysis.claim: 通过扩散过滤+批评家集成的双阶段动作选择机制，可显著提升生成式控制策略在真实机器人在线微调中的样本效率，且支持跨机器人协作探索。
analysis.input: 预训练生成式控制策略的隐空间表征 + 当前观测（RGB/状态）
analysis.output: 高探索性且高置信度的动作
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机器人平台（未指明具体型号，但实验含 manipulation 和 locomotion 任务）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人在线交互数据用于微调，但不依赖大规模真实机器人预训练数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计有清晰创新点（扩散过滤+critic ensemble），在多个真实机器人操作与运动任务上验证了样本效率提升（相比默认finetuning和替代动作选择），但未开源代码/模型，缺乏消融实验细节、未报告绝对性能（仅相对增益）、未验证跨形态泛化极限（如从机械臂到四足），整体属扎实增量而非范式突破，明显弱于DROID/ALOHA/RT-X等基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程整合——将扩散建模、critic集成与在线探索有机耦合，在真实机器人上实证了样本效率提升，但开源不足、分析深度有限，尚未达到开新范式或解决长期开放难题的量级。

papers.title: NeuraDock Visual Cognitive Load Agent Tutorial: A Quality-Gated Open-Source EEG Workflow for Alpha Dynamics and Real-Time Applications
papers.abstract: This tutorial paper provides a step-by-step, reproducible walkthrough of NeuraDock Agent, an open-source EEG agent focused on Alpha dynamics and visual cognitive-load analysis. The goal is practical: a reader should be able to install the agent, run EEG preprocessing and quality control, generate Alpha dynamics figures, perform within-subject Rest/Task visual cognitive-load comparison, run the public mini-dataset analyses and compare them with the reference validation summary, start an online dashboard, call the real-time API from an external application, and use the LLM interpretation layer to explain quality risks. Existing EEG toolkits provide excellent offline analysis, but assembling a real-time, quality-gated cognitive-load pipeline often requires manually bridging acquisition, custom QC, Alpha feature extraction, and a web API; this tutorial closes that offline-to-online gap. The tutorial uses a quality-gated workflow: downstream Alpha and workload metrics are computed only after preprocessing and QC gating rather than directly from raw EEG. In the included mini-dataset validation, the agent processed 18 recordings, generated 10 within-subject comparisons, observed task-related posterior Alpha suppression in 7 of 10 contrasts, estimated initial evidence of within-subject repeatability, and benchmarked local online API latency. The tutorial is intended for researchers, developers, and applied teams who want a transparent path from EEG files to real-time visual cognitive-load prototypes.

analysis.tldr: 这篇教程论文提供了一个开源的EEG分析工作流NeuraDock Agent，聚焦于Alpha波动态和视觉认知负荷评估，支持从原始EEG数据预处理、质量控制、Alpha特征提取、组内Rest/Task对比，到实时API调用和LLM解释的端到端流程。
analysis.claim: 通过质量门控（quality-gated）的端到端开源EEG工作流，首次将离线Alpha分析与实时认知负荷监测、可解释性LLM层无缝集成，填补了现有工具链中‘离线分析→在线部署’的工程断点。
analysis.input: 原始EEG信号（含电极位置信息）、视觉任务刺激标记、用户ID
analysis.output: Alpha功率时空图、Rest/Task对比统计结果、实时API返回的认知负荷指数、LLM生成的质量风险解释文本
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅需标准EEG采集设备输出的通用格式（如EDF）
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量工程整合型教程：完整开源、实测18例EEG、含mini-dataset验证与API延迟基准，但未提出新神经指标、新解码模型或新范式；Alpha抑制效应为经典现象复现，LLM解释层属应用级封装，无临床或BCI范式突破，远低于分量标尺中任意一项（最低90分档均为临床级闭环神经接口或高保真脑-语/脑-字重建）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把已有EEG分析模块、QC规则、Alpha特征提取和轻量API打包成可复现流水线，对应用开发者实用，但无科学或范式层面新发现

papers.title: ViTL: Temporal Logic-Guided Zero-Shot Natural Language Navigation via Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Enabling robots to follow natural language commands to complete zero-shot long-horizon tasks remains challenging. It requires extracting implicit temporal and logical constraints from natural language commands and executing multiple sub-tasks accordingly. Recent zero-shot object navigation methods use vision-language models (VLMs) to guide frontier-based exploration in unknown environments, but they are limited to single-target tasks. Real-world commands such as "Clean either the chair or the couch, then turn on the tv." require navigating to multiple targets in a temporally constrained order, which no existing zero-shot system can handle. We present ViTL, a framework that addresses this gap at two levels. At the task level, we use a large language model (LLM) to compile natural language commands into Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) formulas, which are then converted into Deterministic Finite Automata~(DFA) that coordinate multi-channel value maps and trigger dynamic replanning when new objects are detected. At the navigation level, we introduce directional score: rather than producing a direction-agnostic value across the entire field of view, we label frontier directions on the observation image and extract per-direction scores from the VLM. Experiments on Habitat-Matterport 3D (HM3D) show that the full framework enables zero-shot long-horizon completion of natural language navigation tasks with temporal constraints, and that directional score improves single-target navigation accuracy and efficiency over the baseline.

analysis.tldr: 提出ViTL框架，用大语言模型把自然语言指令编译成时序逻辑公式（LTL），再转为自动机来调度多目标导航；同时改进视觉语言模型的输出方式，让其对每个观测方向打分而非全局打分，从而支持零样本、长程、有时序约束（如‘先A后B’）的导航任务。
analysis.claim: 通过将自然语言指令形式化为线性时序逻辑并耦合方向感知的视觉语言评分机制，可实现无需训练即可完成含显式时间逻辑约束的零样本长程导航。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令 + RGB观测图像
analysis.output: 导航动作序列（隐式，由DFA驱动价值图与重规划生成）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用HM3D仿真环境
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将LTL编译+DFA调度引入零样本NL导航，理论整合有启发性，但仅在HM3D仿真中验证单/双目标简单时序（如A→B），无真实机器人实验、无跨机体/跨用户泛化、未对比主流VLA基线（如RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA）、代码未开源，属扎实但窄域的算法拓展，远未达基石级（90+）所要求的范式突破或系统级鲁棒性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把LTL编译和方向化VLM评分拼接成新流程，在仿真中跑通了带‘then’/‘either…or’的指令，但缺乏真机验证、消融不全、未开源，属于有想法的模块组装，不是范式突破

papers.title: EvoPlan: Evolutionary Neuro-Symbolic Robot Planning with Spatio-Temporal Guarantees
papers.abstract: LLM-based robot planners are fluent but cannot guarantee that their plans are executable or safe. Classical PDDL planners can guarantee these properties, but only after the problem is fully specified, and they make poor use of an LLM's ability to read context and repair plans. This paper presents a neuro-symbolic framework with three parts. All LLM calls use a locally-hosted open-weight model, so the pipeline can be deployed on-robot with no cloud dependency. First, an offline procedure that mines a single global Signal Temporal Logic (STL) constraint on mobility from demonstration data. The procedure recovers codified rules (e.g., stopping at red lights, mined from nuPlan driving logs) or population preferences (e.g., social-navigation comfort, mined from SCAND teleoperation), depending on what the demonstrations encode. Because the demonstrations are a one-class signal, we generate the missing negatives with counterfactual perturbations and an LLM violation generator and then fit the constraint by evolutionary search. We use the mined constraint to shield a vision-language driving policy on Bench2Drive and two discrete-action navigation policies on HA-VLN-CE. Second, an evolutionary PDDL planner: an LLM proposes and repairs plans, programmatic validators decide which ones survive, and the validated portion of the plan grows over iterations. We test the planner on the open-world ALFWorld Text benchmark, where it beats strong baselines and stays robust when the goal vocabulary does not match the action-model vocabulary. Third, a constrained execution loop: the planner's plan is compiled into waypoints, the waypoints are checked against the mined constraint, and the planner re-plans on a violation. We illustrate the full pipeline via demonstrations using the Gazebo simulator.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个三阶段神经符号机器人规划框架EvoPlan：先用进化算法从单类演示数据中自动挖掘时空逻辑约束（STL），再用LLM生成+程序化验证器迭代进化PDDL规划，最后在执行环中实时用约束检查并触发重规划，全程离线运行、不依赖云。
analysis.claim: 通过将LLM的上下文理解能力与STL约束挖掘、进化式PDDL验证和约束驱动的闭环执行相结合，首次实现端到端可部署、具时空可证安全性且无需人工编码规则的神经符号机器人规划。
analysis.input: 自然语言任务指令 + 视觉观测（Bench2Drive/HA-VLN-CE）或文本环境状态（ALFWorld）
analysis.output: 满足STL时空约束的PDDL动作序列 + 可执行的路径/导航指令
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖nuPlan驾驶日志、SCAND teleoperation数据等真实人类演示数据用于约束挖掘，但未使用真实机器人执行数据
analysis.significance_reason: 技术组合有创新性（STL挖掘+进化PDDL+约束闭环），在ALFWorld/Bench2Drive/HA-VLN-CE三个基准上验证了鲁棒性和泛化性，但全部实验限于仿真，无真实机器人验证，约束挖掘依赖特定格式演示数据，开源程度仅限项目页，未达‘显著推进SOTA且证据扎实’门槛（缺真机、缺消融、缺完整代码模型）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：整合了神经与符号方法，在多个文本/视觉导航基准上实现了可验证的安全规划，但因纯仿真验证和有限开源，尚未构成真突破

papers.title: Structure-guided design of a CD81-binding mini-protein that blocks hepatitis C virus entry
papers.abstract: Despite the success of direct-acting antivirals, preventing hepatitis C virus (HCV) reinfection remains a critical global challenge. To address this, we leveraged deep learning-based de novo protein design to engineer mini-proteins targeting the large extracellular loop (LEL) of the HCV co-receptor CD81. These mini-proteins are predicted to precisely dock into CD81-LEL, occluding the critical binding interface required for the HCV E2 glycoprotein. Through biophysical screening, we identified mini-19, a lead candidate with sub-nanomolar affinity (KD = 0.5 nM) and high thermostability up to 95°C. Flow cytometry and super-resolution imaging confirmed that mini-19 specifically recognizes the native topology of CD81 on cells and extracellular vesicles. Functionally, mini-19 neutralized HCVcc infection (IC50 = 1.2 nM). Molecular dynamics simulations demonstrated that mini-19 acts as a structural clamp, restricting the fusogenic conformational plasticity of the receptor. By targeting a conserved host factor rather than the rapidly mutating viral envelope, mini-19 provides a high genetic barrier to resistance. Beyond offering a prophylactic strategy against HCV, our findings establish a stable biologic platform for targeting tetraspanin-enriched microdomains and modulating host-pathogen interactions.

analysis.tldr: 用深度学习从头设计出一个能高亲和力结合CD81蛋白、阻断丙肝病毒入侵细胞的迷你蛋白mini-19，实验证明它在纳摩尔浓度下就能中和病毒，且因靶向宿主蛋白而非病毒，不易产生耐药性。
analysis.org: 韩国科学技术院（KAIST）/首尔国立大学（联合署名中多位作者隶属KAIST与SNU，KAIST在结构生物学与计算设计方面主导性更强）
analysis.claim: 基于结构引导的深度学习从头设计可高亲和力、高稳定性结合CD81-LEL并有效阻断HCV进入的迷你蛋白，其作用机制是通过构象钳制抑制受体的融合前动态可塑性。
analysis.input: CD81大胞外环（LEL）三维结构 + 约束性对接与稳定性优化目标
analysis.output: 可合成、可表达、具高亲和力与热稳定性的迷你蛋白序列及三维结构
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 属AI×生物领域扎实的端到端生成-实验验证闭环：用DL模型设计→体外亲和力/热稳定性实测→细胞水平结合成像→功能中和实验→分子动力学机制解析；但靶点单一（仅CD81）、未展示泛化到其他tetraspanin或病原体，且未开源代码/模型权重，未构建通用平台，故强于多数药物设计论文但未达RFdiffusion/ESM3级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将现有深度学习蛋白设计能力精准落地到一个有临床意义的抗病毒靶点，全流程证据链完整，但未拓展方法论边界或建立通用技术平台。

papers.title: RoboSemanticBench: Diagnosing Semantic Grounding in Action Prediction for VLA Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are built on the premise that semantic understanding from pretrained language or vision-language backbones should guide robot action prediction. Yet robot fine-tuning is optimized as imitation over task-specific action distributions, and many evaluations can be solved through visual or instruction-action shortcuts. We introduce RoboSemanticBench (RSB), an embodied benchmark for diagnosing semantic grounding in action prediction: whether post-trained VLA models can use complex instruction semantics to select and manipulate the correct physical target. In each episode, a robot receives a multiple-choice math or general-knowledge question, observes candidate answer blocks, and must grasp the block corresponding to the correct answer. RSB covers controlled arithmetic, grade-school mathematical understanding, and commonsense or factual understanding under four-choice and ten-choice suites. Across representative VLA models, we find that many policies learn to grasp candidate blocks but select the semantically correct block at near-random or below-random rates after controlling for grasp success, revealing a persistent gap between backbone-level semantic competence and action prediction.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文没提新模型或新训练方法，而是构建了一个叫RoboSemanticBench的诊断型基准——让机器人读数学题或常识题，再从多个候选积木块里抓取正确答案对应的那一个，专门检测VLA模型是否真能把语言语义‘落地’成正确动作，结果发现主流VLA模型在语义选择上基本靠猜。
analysis.claim: 当前主流VLA模型虽具备语言/视觉骨干的语义能力，但在动作预测阶段无法可靠地将复杂指令语义映射到正确的物理操作目标上。
analysis.input: 多选题文本（数学/常识）+ RGB观测图像（含候选答案块）
analysis.output: 单步抓取动作（对应正确答案块的6D位姿）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真机械臂（未明说但benchmark默认基于PyBullet/Mujoco等标准仿真器）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，纯合成任务生成
analysis.significance_reason: 是首个聚焦‘语义到动作映射失效’的诊断型基准，设计精巧、有实证支撑（多模型在控制抓取成功率后仍随机选答案），但仅限仿真、无真实机器人验证、未提出任何修复方案，属于高质量增量诊断工具，未达基石级（如RT-2/π0等需同时推进建模、训练、部署闭环）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把语义理解与动作解耦诊断做得扎实，但仍是评估工具而非解决方案，不改变VLA建模范式。

papers.title: RescueBench: Can Embodied Agents Save Lives in the Wild ?
papers.abstract: Search-and-rescue (SAR) requires embodied agents to explore unfamiliar environments under multimodal uncertainty, perform multi-stage interactions, and retrieve spatial memory over long horizons. Existing benchmarks typically evaluate these capabilities in isolation, leaving unclear how failures compound when they must be composed in realistic workflows. We introduce RescueBench, a photo-realistic diagnostic benchmark that instantiates SAR as a four-stage pipeline: multimodal exploration, target rescue, memory-guided return, and final handoff. By combining sequential task composition with stage-level evaluation, RescueBench enables analysis of how exploration and memory failures propagate through embodied rescue workflows. It contains five progressive difficulty levels that vary in environmental complexity, clue ambiguity, and spatial hierarchy, along with an automatic episode generation and annotation pipeline for scalable evaluation and training. We evaluate seven baselines, an oracle reference, and human players, showing that no baselines complete the full task at the greatest difficulty. Stage-level diagnosis identifies autonomous exploration as the dominant failure mode and spatial memory as a second, independent bottleneck, suggesting that these limitations are not resolved by current topological visual-language navigation or map-based methods. Code is available in https://github.com/wukui-muc/RescueBench

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个面向野外搜救任务的、分阶段诊断型仿真基准RescueBench，用以暴露现有具身智能在多阶段组合任务中（探索→救援→记忆返回→交接）的级联失败问题，核心发现是自主探索和空间记忆是两个独立且未被解决的瓶颈。
analysis.claim: 当前具身智能方法在真实搜救工作流中失败的根本原因不是单一模块缺陷，而是多阶段任务组合下自主探索能力不足与空间记忆能力薄弱的双重、独立瓶颈，且二者无法被现有拓扑导航或地图方法缓解。
analysis.input: RGB-D观测+语言指令+环境线索（如声音/文本提示）
analysis.output: 动作序列（移动/交互/抓取/放置）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真机器人（基于Unity/Unreal的自定义具身代理，无指定硬件）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，纯仿真生成
analysis.significance_reason: 是高质量、结构清晰、有诊断深度的benchmark工作，但属于领域基础设施建设而非范式突破；未涉及真实机器人、未提出新模型/算法/架构，所有结论止步于对现有方法的归因分析，且7个基线中无一个SOTA级具身VLA模型（如RT-2、VoxPoser、OpenVLA等），评估广度与前沿性不足。
