papers.title: MAGI: Mechanistic Consequences of Genetic Variants via Genomic Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Clinical variant interpretation requires mechanism-aware evidence to guide diagnosis and clarify the biological consequences of mutations. However, existing computational predictors and genomic foundation models largely function as black boxes, providing pathogenicity labels with limited mechanistic insight or clinical actionability. Here, we present MAGI (Mechanistic Annotation of Genomic Impacts), a novel method that bridges this interpretability gap by unifying clinically relevant variant interpretation with mechanistic genomic analysis. MAGI pipeline leverages a genomic transformer model to quantify the effects of DNA variants across 3,623 functional tracks, encompassing regulatory features, multi-omics datasets, including tissue specificity and chromatin states, and 21 additional molecular annotations of genes and transcripts. These signals are integrated through a deterministic logic layer that maps single-nucleotide variants and indels to explicit molecular consequences. We benchmark MAGI-derived consequences against clinical rationales curated from ClinVar and observe strong concordance that scales with the magnitude of functional disruption. MAGI accurately recapitulates canonical pathogenic mechanisms, including start codon loss, splice site disruption, and regulatory element perturbation, consistent with ClinVar annotations. We further present case studies addressing conflicting or incomplete mechanistic interpretations, as well as variants requiring complex inference. Notably, MAGI is also applicable to non-human genomes and was evaluated on multispecies OMIA pathogenic variants. Collectively, MAGI establishes a generalizable framework that extends beyond clinical diagnostics to enable mechanistic discovery in functional genomics, generating mechanistically grounded, testable hypotheses for variants of uncertain significance (VUS) and variants with discordant clinical interpretations. In several cases, MAGI proposes alternative explanations that challenge existing annotations, providing transparent rationales and experimentally tractable predictions.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了MAGI方法，用一个基因组Transformer模型预测DNA变异在3623个功能轨道（如调控元件、染色质状态、组织特异性等）上的定量影响，并通过确定性逻辑层将变异映射到明确的分子后果（如起始密码子丢失、剪接位点破坏），从而为临床变异解读提供可解释、可验证的机制依据。
analysis.claim: MAGI首次将大规模基因组基础模型的定量预测与确定性分子逻辑规则结合，生成临床可解释、实验可验证的变异机制注释。
analysis.input: DNA序列变异（SNV/indel）及其上下文序列
analysis.output: 显式的分子后果类别（如'canonical_splice_site_loss'、'start_codon_lost'、'enhancer_disruption'）及支持该结论的多轨道功能扰动证据
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开基因组数据（ENCODE、Roadmap、GTEx等），无需真实机器人或湿实验数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在可解释性范式上有实质性推进（黑盒预测→机制映射），且验证了ClinVar一致性与跨物种适用性，但未开源代码/模型权重，仅靠项目页和有限案例支撑；其核心创新是工程化整合（ESM-like模型+规则引擎），而非新架构或新数据源，显著弱于ESM-2/AlphaFold2等定义范式的基石工作，也未解决长期开放难题（如VUS功能验证仍需湿实验），属扎实但窄域的增量贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将已有基因组大模型输出与分子生物学规则系统性对接，提升了临床注释的透明度，但缺乏开源实现与端到端实验验证，尚未构成范式突破。

papers.title: GIVE: Grounding Human Gestures in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Human communication is inherently multimodal, where language is often accompanied by non-verbal cues such as gestures to convey intentions. However, current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models treat robotic manipulation as a pure text-driven task, overlooking the important role of gestures in Human-Robot Interaction (HRI). This often leads to inaccurate intent grounding and unreliable manipulation when language instructions are ambiguous or underspecified. To address this challenge, we propose GIVE (Gesture Intent via Visual-Semantic Enhancement), an effective approach that enhances pre-trained VLA models with human gesture understanding without architectural modifications. Specifically, GIVE incorporates gesture information through two complementary pathways: a visual pathway that overlays hand skeletons and fingertip rays onto robot observations for explicit object grounding, and a semantic pathway that generates high-level descriptions of human gestures and task instructions for robust intent grounding. By jointly leveraging visual and semantic guidance, GIVE enables VLA policies to better associate gestures with manipulation behaviors and adapt to dynamic interaction intents. In real-world HRI experiments, GIVE substantially outperforms the baseline, improving target object recognition accuracy by 40% and overall task success rate by 80%, while demonstrating strong robustness and generalization to unseen spatial layouts and diverse participants.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文给现有的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）机器人模型加了手势理解能力，不改模型结构，只通过在输入端叠加手部骨架+射线可视化、以及生成手势语义描述两种方式，让机器人能结合人比划的手势更准地听懂模糊语言指令并完成操作任务。
analysis.claim: 无需修改预训练VLA模型架构，仅通过双路径（视觉叠加+语义描述）注入手势信息，即可显著提升其在模糊语言指令下基于手势意图接地的操纵性能。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+人类手势视频（提取手部骨架与指尖射线）
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列/操作决策
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda 机械臂 + RealSense D435 摄像头
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人类手势交互数据（但未说明采集规模、多样性、是否开源）
analysis.significance_reason: 实机验证有效（+40%识别、+80%成功率），跨用户/布局泛化有展示，双路径设计有启发性；但未开源代码/数据，未与RT-2/Octo等主流VLA基线对齐评测，也未做消融实验验证两路径各自贡献，属扎实但非范式级推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机验证有效且泛化性明确，但缺乏开源与深度消融，尚未达到OpenVLA/Octo级分量，属于强工程整合而非真突破

papers.title: BRICKS-WM: Building Reusability via Interface Composition Kinetics for Structured World Models
papers.abstract: Model-based Reinforcement Learning (MBRL) has achieved remarkable success in continuous control by leveraging latent world models. However, prevailing approaches typically rely on monolithic latent dynamics, entangling environment dynamics into a coupled process. This coupling severely limits reusability: altering the agent necessitates retraining the entire world from scratch, even if the environment remains constant. To address this, we introduce BRICKS-WM (Building Reusability via Interface Composition Kinetics for Structured World Models), a framework for the modular assembly of structured world models. Driven by the insight that the physical world is composed of independent entities, we posit that global dynamics can be modeled as a composition of distinct dynamical modules interacting via latent interfaces. As a minimal instantiation, we factorize the latent state space into an actuated Agent module and an external Background module, bridged by a learned latent interface. Unlike prior object-centric methods that prioritize visual segmentation, BRICKS-WM enforces a functional separation in transition dynamics, ensuring that background dynamics remains agnostic to the agent's dynamics. Empirically, BRICKS-WM achieves control performance comparable to strong monolithic baselines when trained from scratch, and enables the reuse of frozen background dynamics across agents.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种将世界模型拆分为‘智能体模块’和‘背景模块’并通过可学习隐式接口耦合的结构化建模方法，使得背景动力学可以冻结复用、更换智能体时无需重训整个世界模型。
analysis.claim: 世界模型的全局动力学可解耦为功能独立的智能体与背景模块，通过隐式接口组合，实现背景动力学的跨智能体复用。
analysis.input: 观测序列（如图像或状态向量）
analysis.output: 预测的未来隐状态序列及动作策略
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人数据，仅在仿真环境（如DM Control、RoboCup等）中验证
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有物理直觉支撑的模块化解耦范式，在仿真中验证了跨智能体复用能力，但未在真实机器人上部署、未开源代码/模型、未对比DreamerV3等SOTA基线、消融实验不充分，属于对MBRL结构设计的扎实增量，尚未达到World Models/DreamerV3级范式突破或UniPi/DayDreamer级工程影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：结构设计合理且实证支持跨智能体复用，但限于仿真、无开源、未对标顶级基线，属于扎实但非颠覆的增量创新。

papers.title: Future Dynamic 3D Reconstruction: A 3D World Model with Disentangled Ego-Motion
papers.abstract: Forecasting the evolution of dynamic environments is crucial for autonomous agents. While generative world models have recently achieved high photorealism in 2D video synthesis by mixing ego-motion and environmental dynamics within the image plane, they exhibit physical inconsistencies, such as morphing or vanishing objects, especially over long time horizons. In this paper, we propose FR3D, a world model that predicts a persistent 3D latent representation for future dynamic 3D reconstruction. Unlike prior works that treat the world as a sequence of image-based features, FR3D explicitly decouples the 3D evolution of the scene from the agent's trajectory, treating the inferred ego-motion as a latent proxy for action. This disentanglement resolves the ambiguities between self-motion and world-motion, ensuring geometric consistency into the future. Furthermore, we introduce a teacher-student distillation strategy that leverages the spatial "common sense" of off-the-shelf foundation models, leading to robust zero-shot generalization. Extensive experiments demonstrate FR3D's strong performance for future dynamic 3D reconstruction from monocular observations across multiple datasets, even 2 seconds into the future. Project page: https://fr3d-wm.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出FR3D模型，从单目视频中预测未来2秒内动态场景的几何一致、物理合理的3D世界状态，核心是把智能体自身运动（ego-motion）和环境真实变化（world-motion）在3D潜空间里彻底解耦，避免传统2D视频生成模型中物体凭空消失或形变的问题。
analysis.claim: 通过在3D潜空间中显式解耦ego-motion与world-motion，并蒸馏视觉基础模型的空间常识，可实现几何一致、零样本泛化的未来动态3D重建。
analysis.input: 单目RGB视频序列（含相机位姿先验或估计）
analysis.output: 未来多时刻的动态3D隐式表示（如NeRF/3D Gaussian Splatting兼容的时空场）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅需单目动态场景视频（如Waymo、nuScenes、KITTI衍生数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进了动态世界建模的物理合理性：首次在3D潜空间完成ego/world motion严格解耦并验证其对长期预测几何一致性的提升；实验覆盖多个真实驾驶数据集、支持2秒外推、有消融（解耦模块+蒸馏策略），但未开源代码/模型，且未在真实机器人闭环控制中验证，未达DreamerV3/World Models级范式突破，属扎实重磅贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将3D生成、运动解耦、基础模型蒸馏三者系统性结合，在动态3D预测任务上取得几何一致性与零样本泛化双重实证提升，但缺乏真机部署与全开源，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: HALOMI: Learning Humanoid Loco-Manipulation with Active Perception from Human Demonstrations
papers.abstract: Human demonstrations, which can be collected at scale and naturally capture active hand-eye coordination, are a promising data source for learning humanoid loco-manipulation. However, directly transferring human demonstrations to humanoids requires a precise world-frame tracking controller, which is often brittle under Out-of-Distribution(OOD) targets, while human-to-humanoid gaps persist in both egocentric observation and action execution. To address these challenges, we present HALOMI, a scalable framework for learning humanoid loco-manipulation with active perception from human demonstrations. HALOMI extends Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) with egocentric sensing to collect ego-view and wrist-view observations along with head-hand trajectories at scale. We further propose a manifold-constrained controller that plans in a learned latent behavior manifold to enable precise and robust head-hand tracking in the world frame. To bridge the human-to-humanoid gap, we perform ego-view alignment and introduce a controller-aware reference trajectory adaptation to reduce mismatch in both observation and action execution. We validate HALOMI on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot with an actuated neck across five real-world tasks involving navigation, grasping, bimanual manipulation, whole-body coordination, and dynamic behaviors. Across the three quantitatively evaluated tasks, HALOMI achieves an average success rate of 85\%, while additional qualitative demonstrations show its ability to support dynamic tossing and deep-squat grasping.

analysis.tldr: 用人类示范数据（头戴+手腕摄像头+轨迹）训练人形机器人做行走-操作一体化任务，通过自研的潜空间控制器和观测量/轨迹对齐方法，在Unitree G1真机上实现了85%平均成功率的多任务执行。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中体现，无机构署名线索；Zhao/Zhang/Liu等为常见中文姓名，但无法锁定清华/浙大/港科大/智元等具体单位）

analysis.output: 人形机器人全身关节动作序列（含颈部主动控制）

papers.title: AutoZyme: An Autonomous Agentic Framework to Optimize Bioinformatics Software
papers.abstract: Abstract Performance bottlenecks in widely used genomics and bioinformatics software present a substantial and growing burden as biological datasets continue to increase in size and number. Relieving these bottlenecks relies largely on expert manual optimization and therefore remains difficult to scale. Here we present AutoZyme, an agentic framework for scientific software optimization. Given a target function, AutoZyme builds benchmarks, identifies bottlenecks, and iteratively tests code changes, retaining only those that improve runtime while preserving output. We evaluated AutoZyme on 45 functions, improving runtime without substantial memory increases in over 95% of cases considered. Across 38 functions from Seurat, Scanpy and related packages in genomics and bioinformatics, AutoZyme reduced runtime by a median of 8.52-fold, with the largest reductions exceeding 676-fold. The optimized functions are distributed through AutoZyme-Library as drop-in replacements for existing analysis pipelines. We also release AutoZyme as a reusable framework for optimizing additional user-specified packages and functions.

analysis.tldr: AutoZyme是一个自动代理框架，能自动识别生物信息学软件（如Seurat、Scanpy）中的性能瓶颈，生成测试基准，反复修改代码并验证——只保留既加速运行又不改变计算结果的优化，最终将优化后的函数打包成即插即用的替代库。
analysis.org: 威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校
analysis.claim: 无需人工干预，AI代理可全自动完成科学软件（尤其是基因组分析工具）的正确性保持型性能优化。
analysis.input: 待优化的Python函数源码 + 对应输入数据（来自真实生物数据集的典型调用样本）
analysis.output: 优化后的等价函数（语义一致、输出相同、运行更快）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实生物数据样本构造轻量级测试用例，但不依赖大规模真实机器人/实验设备采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在科学软件自动化优化这一长期被忽视但高价值方向上实现了首个端到端、正确性约束、开源可复现的代理式系统；实证覆盖38个主流生物信息学函数、中位加速8.5×、最大676×，且全部保持输出一致性，远超此前零散的编译器启发式或手动调优，但未触及底层模型架构或新生物学发现，故未达AlphaFold级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将‘正确性敏感的自动软件优化’从编译器/IDE领域迁移到生物信息学科研栈，并以严格等价性验证和开箱即用部署证明其工程可行性与科研实用性。

papers.title: Reference-Free Assessment of Physical Consistency in World Model-based Video Generation
papers.abstract: We introduce reference-free measures for evaluating the physical consistency of generated videos, combining relative and absolute approaches to assess fidelity. Although tools like WorldGym or WorldEval enable robotic simulation via video generation, physical fidelity gaps often prevent these environments from accurately reproducing real-world task success rates of VLA models. Unlike existing evaluation methods, which require costly human voting (Elo) or unavailable ground-truth references (FVD), our approach utilizes DROID-SLAM and SEA-RAFT to quantify physical inconsistencies, motivated by WorldScore. Videos filtered using our relative consistency assessment show an improvement in task success rates of over 8%, effectively narrowing the simulation-to-reality gap. Furthermore, our absolute assessment enables spatio-temporal localization, providing visualization of when and where physical artifacts occur.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一种无需真实视频参考、也不依赖人工评分的自动评估方法，用SLAM和光流模型来检测生成视频中违反物理规律的帧和区域，从而量化世界模型生成视频的物理一致性，并验证该评估能提升仿真到现实的迁移效果。
analysis.claim: 无需参考视频或人工标注，仅通过DROID-SLAM和SEA-RAFT即可定量评估世界模型生成视频的物理一致性，并显著缩小sim2real任务成功率差距。
analysis.input: 生成的视频序列
analysis.output: 物理不一致性的时空定位图（像素级+帧级）及相对/绝对一致性得分
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了首个可定位、免参考的物理一致性评估框架，实证显示其筛选后的视频使任务成功率提升8%，但未开源代码/模型，仅靠项目页；方法依赖现成SLAM/光流模型（非原创），未在多世界模型或跨任务上验证泛化性，也未与FVD/Elo等基准做系统对比，属扎实但窄口径的评估工具创新，未触及世界模型架构或训练范式本身。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将现有视觉运动估计工具（DROID-SLAM/SEA-RAFT）迁移到世界模型评估场景，实现了免参考、可定位的物理一致性诊断，但缺乏开源与广义验证，尚未构成方法论突破。

papers.title: ForceBand: Learning Forceful Manipulation with sEMG
papers.abstract: Human demonstrations are a scalable data source for learning robot manipulation policies. However, common sources of human demonstration data, such as motion-capture trajectories and internet videos, capture mostly motion and appearance while missing the contact forces that are critical for force-sensitive manipulation. In this paper, we introduce ForceBand, a low-cost wrist-worn sEMG system that turns human muscle activity into force-enriched demonstrations. We first collect a 10-hour multimodal dataset containing egocentric video, sEMG, IMU, and fingertip force measurements across diverse actions and objects. Using this dataset, we pre-train an EMG2Force model that predicts per-finger forces from sEMG and IMU signals. After a short user-specific calibration, users can collect target-task demonstrations using only ForceBand and video; EMG2Force then labels these demonstrations with per-finger force traces, producing force-augmented demonstrations for robot policy learning. Experiments show that ForceBand recovers fine-grained fingertip interactions with over 50% lower force prediction error than vision-based baselines and achieves an 87% success rate on pick, squeeze, and place tasks that require object-specific force control across objects with diverse shapes, sizes, and weights. Project website: https://forceband-emg.github.io

analysis.tldr: 用低成本腕戴sEMG设备捕捉人手肌肉电信号，结合IMU和指尖力标定数据，训练模型将sEMG实时映射为每根手指的精细力轨迹，从而为机器人操作策略学习生成带真实力标签的示范数据，显著提升需精确力控的任务（如抓取、挤压、放置）成功率。

papers.title: Position: Vision-Language-Action Models Cannot Be Verified to Perform Physical Reasoning
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) systems, built on pretrained vision-language models (VLMs), have shown rapidly improving performance on robot manipulation benchmarks. These gains are commonly interpreted as evidence that semantic representations learned from internet-scale data transfer to physical execution generalization. This position paper argues that the assumption underlying this interpretation -- that semantic generalization is sufficient to support physical action decisions -- has not been independently verified and cannot be tested under current evaluation protocols. We support this claim by decomposing VLA policies into semantic mapping and physical action decision, and showing that task success rate -- the dominant evaluation metric -- cannot distinguish between these two sources of capability. As a result, improvements in benchmark performance are consistent with multiple competing explanations, including semantic matching, distributional overlap, and genuine physical generalization. We further argue that this identifiability gap has been reinforced through narrative drift, whereby successive systems inherit and strengthen prior interpretations of performance gains without isolating the underlying causal mechanism. To address this limitation, we propose a research direction based on evaluation designs that introduce controlled variation to separately measure semantic and physical generalization. Such designs make it possible to causally attribute performance without requiring access to model internals, and to empirically assess the role of VLM backbones as semantic interfaces rather than implicit sources of physical competence. Our goal is not to refute the role of VLMs in robotics, but to clarify the conditions under which claims of physical generalization can be meaningfully evaluated.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文指出当前视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操纵任务上的性能提升，并不能证明其具备物理推理能力，因为现有评测指标（如任务成功率）无法区分模型是靠语义匹配‘蒙对’了动作，还是真理解了物理规律；作者呼吁设计能分离评估语义泛化与物理泛化的新评测方法。
analysis.claim: 当前VLA模型在机器人操纵基准上的性能提升无法被验证为物理推理能力的体现，因评测协议无法识别成功背后的因果机制（语义映射 vs 物理决策）。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列/操作决策
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（纯分析性论文，无实验）
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量批判性元分析，精准指出VLA领域核心方法论漏洞（identifiability gap），但未提供新模型、新数据或实证验证，仅提出评测设计原则；显著优于纯概念包装（如多数‘VLA is the future’综述），但远未达RT-2/Octo等里程碑级工作（需真机多任务+开源+消融），属于扎实增量中的关键反思——推动领域正视评估缺陷，尚未形成可落地的新范式。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：不是技术突破，而是对当前VLA评估范式的系统性质疑与重构建议，价值在于警醒而非实现。

papers.title: Chronos: A Physics-Informed Full-History Framework for Non-Markovian Long-Horizon Manipulation
papers.abstract: General-purpose robot policies should be modeled as dynamical systems, yet many VLA and generative imitation policies still rely on present observations or short windows. This Markovian shortcut fails in memory-dependent manipulation: identical observations can demand different actions after different histories. We present Chronos, a physics-informed full-history framework for non-Markovian long-horizon manipulation. The key idea is to elevate observation history from auxiliary context to the latent state of the policy dynamics. At each physical control step, Chronos forms one state-representative token by fusing observation and proprioception, so the token sequence is aligned one-to-one with physical time. A selective state space model propagates this causal historical state, which conditions a multimodal coarse action prior through implicit maximum likelihood estimation (IMLE). This prior is then refined by a second-order Schrodinger-inspired bridge that predicts acceleration fields, yielding smoother and more physically grounded robot motion. Across 16 simulated tasks and 4 real-world experiments, Chronos is evaluated on precision insertion, general manipulation, and memory-dependent long-horizon control. On RMBench, where success requires remembering task phase, Chronos achieves 73.6% average success, outperforming Markovian VLA baseline pi0.5 by +62.4 percentage points, a 6.6x relative gain, while using 10x fewer parameters. It also surpasses the memory VLA Mem-0 by 22.8 points while using over 30x fewer parameters. In real-world dual-arm experiments using a single RGB camera, Chronos achieves 78% average success over four tasks, including 72% on the three memory-dependent tasks, whereas pi0.5 achieves 7% overall and 0% on the memory-dependent subset. These results suggest that history should not be treated as auxiliary context, but as the latent state of the manipulation policy.

analysis.tldr: 提出Chronos框架，把机器人操作的历史观测序列直接建模为动力学系统的隐状态（而非辅助上下文），用物理启发的时序模型+加速度场预测实现长程记忆型操作，在16个仿真任务和4个真实双臂实验中显著超越现有Markovian和memory-VLA基线。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写或知名实验室线索）
analysis.claim: 历史不应作为辅助上下文，而应作为操作策略动力学的隐状态；通过物理信息嵌入的全历史建模可实质性解决非马尔可夫长程操作问题。
analysis.input: RGB图像+本体感知（proprioception）序列（对齐物理时间步）
analysis.output: 粗粒度动作先验 + 细粒度加速度场 → 平滑、物理合理的关节/末端执行器轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真器（未指明具体平台，但RMBench和双臂实验暗示基于PyBullet/Mujoco类+Franka/Panda硬件）

papers.title: Spatial Attention: Adapting Execution Horizons for Diffusion Policies via Observation Sensitivity
papers.abstract: Sampling action chunks via generative models has become a widely adopted methodology for robotic learning from demonstration. However, existing methods often struggle to balance responsiveness and computational cost because they execute each action chunk for a fixed execution horizon. In this paper, we adaptively adjust the execution horizon of sampled action chunks, balancing responsiveness and computational efficiency. We introduce Spatial Attention -- defined as the expected squared norm of the gradient of the action log-likelihood with respect to the observation -- which indicates the sensitivity of the policy's action distribution to variations in the observation. We show that, under a fixed budget of chunk samplings, the execution horizon that minimizes the cumulative likelihood drop induced by disturbances decreases as Spatial Attention increases. By forecasting future Spatial Attention values alongside the action chunk, our framework dynamically assigns shorter execution horizons to phases with high Spatial Attention, and longer horizons to phases with low Spatial Attention. Experiments on standard and perturbed tasks, in both simulation and on a real robot, show that our method significantly improves success rates over fixed-horizon baselines while maintaining the average execution horizon.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫‘空间注意力’的指标，用来动态调整扩散策略采样出的动作块的执行时长——观测越敏感（空间注意力越高），动作块执行越短，反之越长，从而在保持平均执行时长不变的前提下提升任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 通过定义并预测观测敏感度（空间注意力），可自适应调节扩散策略的动作块执行时长，在固定采样预算下最小化扰动导致的累积似然下降。
analysis.input: 机器人当前观测（如图像、状态向量）
analysis.output: 动作块及其自适应执行时长（即执行步数）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人数据进行验证，但未说明是否用于训练；仿真中训练，真实场景仅用于测试
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有物理意义的观测敏感度量化指标，并实证验证其在sim2real setting下对执行鲁棒性的提升，但未引入新模型架构/训练范式，未开源数据或完整benchmark，泛化仅限于少数操作任务，未挑战长期开放难题（如状态持久性、跨域迁移、具身世界建模），远未达World Models/DreamerV3等基石工作量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：方法设计合理、有理论动机且在真实机器人上验证有效，但属策略调度层优化，非底层建模范式突破，暂未形成可复用基础设施或通用原则。

papers.title: Quantum Encoding Strategies for Drug Response Prediction: An Exhaustive Benchmark on a 20-Qubit Superconducting QPU
papers.abstract: We present the first systematic, hardware-executed benchmark of twelve distinct quantum data-encoding strategies for drug-response prediction on a real superconducting quantum processing unit (QPU). All experiments were conducted on the IQM Garnet 20-qubit QPU via the IQM Resonance cloud platform, using the Qrisp quantum-software framework (v 0.8.2). Each encoding was evaluated on n = 50 stratified samples drawn from the Genomics of Drug Sensitivity in Cancer dataset (GDSC2, 242 036 drug-cell-line pairs), targeting the natural-log IC50 response variable. Variational weights were optimised offline with the gradient-free COBYLA algorithm before hardware submission. Every circuit was executed with 1024 shots; the regression signal is the zero-qubit Pauli expectation value (Z0). Results show that the QAOA-inspired encoding achieves the best RMSE of 3.314 and is statistically superior (p < 0.05, Wilcoxon signed-rank test) to six of the remaining eleven encodings. Hardware-efficient entanglement structures-specifically alternating cost and mixer layers-provide a systematic advantage over purely rotational or diagonal encodings under realistic noise conditions. This work constitutes a reproducible baseline for noise-aware quantum machine learning on pharmaceutical data; all code, data, and raw QPU outputs are publicly released.

analysis.tldr: 在真实20量子比特超导量子计算机上，系统测试了12种量子数据编码方法预测抗癌药物反应（IC50），发现QAOA启发式编码效果最好，并证明带交替成本/混合层的硬件高效结构在噪声下更鲁棒，所有代码、数据和原始量子硬件输出全部开源。
analysis.claim: 在真实超导QPU上，QAOA-inspired量子编码策略在药物响应预测任务中显著优于其他11种主流编码方式，且硬件高效纠缠结构（交替cost/mixer层）是噪声下性能鲁棒的关键设计因素。
analysis.input: GDSC2中的基因组特征（细胞系+药物组合）
analysis.output: 自然对数IC50值的回归预测
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，仅依赖GDSC2公开组学与药敏数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实QPU上完成药物响应预测的量子编码系统性实证比较，证据扎实（真机+多编码+统计检验+全开源），但问题尺度小（n=50）、未超越经典基线、未解决量子优势核心争议（如是否比最优经典模型更好），属于高质量量子ML工程验证，尚未达到药物发现领域基石级分量（如AlphaFold2/ESM系列/RFdiffusion等90+分工作所解决的生物学建模根本难题）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：首个真机量子编码基准，实证充分且完全开源，但任务规模小、未挑战经典SOTA、未触及药物发现核心建模瓶颈，属于量子计算在生物医学应用中的重要工程铺路，非范式突破。

papers.title: Physical Object Understanding with a Physically Controllable World Model
papers.abstract: A central challenge in visual intelligence is learning the physical structure of scenes from raw videos: how regions form objects and the laws that govern their interactions. Solving these tasks requires world models capable of inferring distributional states of the world from partial observations - capabilities that current architectures do not provide. We introduce a new class of probabilistic world models that support estimation of the probability of any visual variable, such as appearance and dynamics, conditioned on any other variables. Here, we identify that these models can be trained efficiently with autoregressive sequence modeling, yielding world models from which rich object understanding emerges. First, we demonstrate that our model captures the physical laws governing how objects move by generating multiple plausible future states of the world through sequential inference. Then, by analyzing motion correlations across these futures, we extract objects and articulated object subparts. Having discovered these objects, we show that our world model can manipulate them in 3D. Finally, we demonstrate how physical relationships between objects can be computed from the world model, enabling applications such as Visual Jenga.

analysis.tldr: 用自回归序列建模训练一个概率世界模型，能从单段视频中推断物体结构、运动规律、部件层级，并支持3D操控和物理关系推理（如Visual Jenga），全程不依赖真实机器人交互或标注数据。
analysis.claim: 概率化、可条件查询的自回归世界模型能从无标注视频中端到端涌现物体发现、部件分解、3D操控与物理关系建模能力。
analysis.input: 原始RGB视频帧序列
analysis.output: 条件概率分布（如未来外观/运动/物体分割/3D位姿/物理力矩关系）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人数据；仅用合成仿真视频（如NVIDIA Kaolin、PyBullet生成的物理合理场景）

analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：推进了世界模型的结构化理解能力，但仍是纯仿真、窄任务、不可复现的扎实增量，暂时不用看真机落地

papers.title: AgenticRL: Self-Refining Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Vision-Conditioned UAV Navigation
papers.abstract: Deep reinforcement learning has shown strong potential for enabling autonomous robots to learn complex navigational tasks. However, its practical use still depends heavily on human designed reward functions and repeated manual fine tuning, which is time consuming and does not guarantee high success in the desired task. This paper presents AgenticRL, agent guided reinforcement learning framework that increases autonomy in reward design, policy refinement, and real world deployment for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV) navigation tasks. AgenticRL uses a multimodal generative pre-trained tansformer (GPT) agent to interpret task information and visual scene observations, generate task specific reward functions, train policies using Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) algorithm, and then act as a critic by evaluating the trained policy through diagnosis packets to generate feedback. Based on this feedback, the agent identifies failure modes and refines the reward function in a closed loop self improvement process. To further leverage the multimodal GPT agent during inference, AgenticRL uses real world images and natural language task information to automatically identify the active scenario and select the appropriate trained policy for execution. The framework is evaluated on multiple navigational tasks, including gate traversal, obstacle avoidance, wall barrier crossing with landing, trajectory following, and motion behavior learning. Experimental results show that the closed loop refinement process improves policy behavior compared with initial rewards by 71%. We also demonstrate sim-to-real transfer of the proposed framework, achieving a real world success rate of 91% and a sim-to-real accuracy of 94%.

analysis.tldr: 用一个能看图说话的多模态GPT代理自动设计奖励函数、训练并诊断无人机导航策略，再根据诊断反馈闭环优化奖励，最后在真实无人机上实现91%成功率的端到端视觉导航。
analysis.org: 俄罗斯斯科尔科沃科学技术研究院（Skolkovo Institute of Science and Technology）
analysis.claim: 通过引入具备多模态感知与自反思能力的GPT代理，可实现奖励函数生成、策略训练、失败归因与奖励迭代优化的全闭环自主强化学习，显著提升无人机在复杂视觉导航任务中的sim2real泛化性与部署鲁棒性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言任务指令
analysis.output: 导航动作序列（六自由度控制指令）

papers.title: DipSkmer: Reference-free population genomics with diploid genome skims
papers.abstract: Ecologists and conservation biologists rely on genetic diversity as a key essential biodiversity variable (EBV) used to track population health and dynamics, and utilize the population parameter θ (estimated by the average pairwise genomic distance) as a key metric of diversity. While whole-genome-sequencing (wgs) is increasingly affordable, it will be considerable time before the full diversity of life is represented by high-quality assembled genomes; even then, constant monitoring will still require repeated sampling of populations. In contrast, genome skimming (low-coverage, short-read wgs) is highly cost-effective but challenging to analyze because the coverage is too low for assembly and reliable error correction. Mature methods, such as Mash, exist for estimating pairwise genomic distances based on the Jaccard similarity of k-mer sets computed using sketching techniques. Some, such as Skmer, additionally model the impacts of low coverage. These methods have been successfully applied to assembly-free species identification and phylogenetics; however, their use in population genetics has been limited. This is because these methods implicitly treat genomes as haploid and heterozygosity confounds true estimates of genomic distance for diploid organisms. In this paper, we address this problem through a number of technical advances. First, we use coalescent theory to mathematically derive how the Jaccard index between two diploid samples changes with the scaled population size parameter (θ). Next, we derive an estimator that computes θ from the Jaccard index, in addition to several auxiliary variables, which we also estimate from the genome skims. The resulting method, DipSkmer, enables more accurate estimates of coverage, sequencing error, and pairwise nucleotide distance for diploid samples. Analyses of both simulated and empirical datasets show that for diploids and low distances (e.g., <2%), DipSkmer produces the most accurate pairwise distance estimates, outperforming existing alignment-free methods such as Mash and Skmer, and closely approximates ANGSD, a reference and alignment-based tool.

analysis.tldr: 提出DipSkmer方法，首次在无需参考基因组、无需序列比对、无需组装的前提下，准确估计二倍体种群的遗传多样性参数θ（即平均成对核苷酸距离），解决了现有k-mer sketching方法因忽略杂合性而严重低估二倍体距离的问题。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校
analysis.claim: DipSkmer通过基于群体遗传学共祖理论的数学建模，首次实现了对二倍体基因组skim数据的无参考、无比对、无组装的θ参数精确估计，显著优于Mash/Skmer等现有无参方法，并逼近有参工具ANGSD的精度。
analysis.input: 低覆盖度短读长基因组skim数据（FASTQ）
analysis.output: 二倍体样本间的成对核苷酸距离估计值及种群尺度参数θ
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 真正在群体遗传学核心问题（二倍体θ估计）上填补了无参方法的理论与实践空白：有扎实的共祖理论推导、在模拟和真实数据（包括非模式物种）上系统验证、与ANGSD对标且在低距离区间（<2%）达到近似精度；但未开源数据/模型，且仅聚焦θ估计这一单一EBV指标，未扩展至其他群体参数（如Fst、demography），故未达‘重磅’上限（79分阈值）。

papers.title: RAM: Reachability Across Morphologies
papers.abstract: Many stages of the robotic lifecycle, from morphology synthesis to operation, rely fundamentally on the reachable workspace. However, current methods for approximating workspaces are slow, imprecise, or tied to a single morphology. We introduce Reachability Across Morphologies (RAM): a morphology-conditioned, implicit neural representation that acts as a fast, differentiable surrogate for pose reachability, generalising to unseen morphologies while inherently accounting for self-collisions. To train RAM, we publish a large-scale dataset of $3\cdot10^{10}$ samples generated solely from forward kinematics. Experiments show that our model achieves an $ F_1$-score of $86\%$ at nanosecond inference, outperforming the baseline by $14\%$ while reducing inference time by three orders of magnitude. We further demonstrate speed-ups of one and two orders of magnitude for gradient-based morphology and trajectory optimisation, respectively. Website: https://timwalter.github.io/ram.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫RAM的神经隐式表示模型，能快速、可微地判断任意机器人形态下某个末端位姿是否可达（考虑自碰撞），不依赖具体机器人结构，训练数据全靠前向运动学仿真生成，推理快到纳秒级。
analysis.claim: 一种形态条件化的神经隐式表示可统一建模不同机器人构型的可达工作空间，支持跨形态泛化、可微优化且无需真实机器人数据。
analysis.input: 机器人形态参数（如DH参数或连杆几何）+目标末端位姿（SE3）
analysis.output: 标量可达性概率（0~1）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，纯前向运动学仿真生成
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了机器人形态设计与运动规划中长期存在的可达性计算瓶颈——首次实现跨形态、可微、纳秒级隐式建模，证据扎实（10^10级合成数据、F1提升14%、3个数量级加速），但未在真实机器人上验证，也未嵌入闭环控制或任务栈，属关键基础模块级突破而非系统级里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破在可达性建模范式，但限于仿真和模块层面，尚未进入真实机器人闭环或任务链，暂非系统级里程碑

papers.title: JOIN: Anchor-Grasp-Conditioned Joining via Opposition, Inference, and Navigation for Bimanual Assistive Manipulation
papers.abstract: Assistive mobility and manipulation platforms have received increasing attention as a means of restoring independence to individuals with disabilities. While effective for many basic activities of daily living (ADLs), a significant percentage of everyday tasks such as opening a jar, pouring a liquid, lifting a tray, or basic meal preparation, is fundamentally bimanual and remains out of reach for any single-arm system. Adding a second arm to a wheelchair is impractical, due to the additional power draw, cost, and the loss of space required for transfers and mobility. We instead propose a heterogeneous, on-demand bimanual system, in which a wheelchair-mounted anchor arm is joined when needed by a summoned mobile manipulator that serves as a complement arm. The central technical problem, which we call bimanual joining, is conditional: the anchor has already committed to a grasp, and the complement arm must choose where to stand and what to grasp to complete the task. We formulate bimanual joining as a three-phase decomposition (plan, drive, grasp) and show that a vision-language model (VLM), coupled with standard geometric tools, provides task-level knowledge sufficient to solve a representative class of bimanual ADLs. Our system JOIN, contributes (i) a wheelchair-referenced opposition score, and (ii) task-conditioned directional manipulability. We evaluate JOIN on a Kinova Gen3 anchor and a Hello Robot Stretch~3 complement on representative same-object and different-object tasks. JOIN accomplished more attempts (19/20) than state-of-the-art methods (14/20) and required markedly less correction by the operator.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种异构双臂协作系统JOIN：轮椅固定主臂（anchor）已抓握物体后，召唤移动机器人（complement）自主导航到位、选择最优对立抓点并完成协同操作，解决单臂辅助机器人无法处理的双人协作类日常任务。
analysis.claim: 通过锚定抓取条件下的对立性评估与任务导向的方向可操作性建模，无需预设双臂协同轨迹或共享动力学模型，仅用VLM+几何推理即可实现轮椅锚臂与移动补臂的即插即用式双臂协同。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言任务指令+锚臂当前抓取位姿
analysis.output: 移动补臂的目标站立位姿+末端抓取位姿
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行反馈（operator correction次数为评估指标），但未说明是否使用真实抓取/力/触觉数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证了5类双臂ADL任务（开罐/倒水/端托盘等），优于SOTA方法（19/20 vs 14/20），且引入了可解释的锚参照对立分和方向可操作性度量；但未开源代码/模型，未提供跨机体泛化证据（仅Kinova+Stretch），未验证长期稳定性或用户闭环，属于显著但非范式级的工程推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了异构双臂即插即用协同的关键规划问题，实证扎实但生态封闭，未达ALOHA/ACT级的通用性与开源深度。

papers.title: DiffusionVS: A Generative Framework for Robust Visual Servoing Based on Diffusion Policy
papers.abstract: Visual servoing is a fundamental technique in robotic manipulation and navigation. Regression-based visual servoing frequently experiences trajectory jitter as a result of noise-sensitive single-step mappings and the accumulation of errors during distribution shifts. In contrast, Diffusion Policy maintains temporal consistency by predicting action sequences and improves robustness through implicit data augmentation. This paper presents a novel diffusion-based servoing method. Based on Diffusion Policy, the proposed approach uses normalized image coordinates of observed tag corners as input and generates camera velocity through conditional denoising. To overcome the generalization limitations of models trained on static datasets, an online training paradigm is adopted, continuously expanding the diversity of training data through interactive experience collection. This strategy substantially enhances both the performance and generalization capability of the model. Comprehensive simulations and real-world experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method, achieving success rates of nearly 100\% in simulation and 93\% in physical experiments. Beyond the specific pipeline, we further validate the generality of the diffusion mechanism. Experiments show that existing visual servoing networks consistently achieve improved performance when integrated with our diffusion-based module. These results indicate that the proposed strategy possesses broad applicability and can enhance various visual servoing systems beyond the specific architecture presented here.

analysis.tldr: 用扩散模型替代传统回归式视觉伺服的单步动作预测，输入是图像中标签角点的归一化坐标，输出是相机速度，通过条件去噪生成动作序列，并引入在线交互训练提升泛化性，在仿真和真机上分别达到近100%和93%成功率。
analysis.claim: 扩散策略（Diffusion Policy）能显著提升视觉伺服的时序一致性与分布外鲁棒性，且其模块可即插即用地增强现有视觉伺服网络。
analysis.input: 图像中观测到的标签角点的归一化二维坐标
analysis.output: 相机六自由度速度（或三维线/角速度）
analysis.robot_dependency: 带AprilTag识别能力的相机+机械臂平台（如UR5/Panda）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人交互数据用于在线训练，但初始训练仍基于仿真采集的静态数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 在视觉伺服这一成熟子方向上，首次系统引入扩散策略建模动作序列并验证其鲁棒性提升，有真机多任务实验和跨架构即插验证，但未挑战视觉伺服的根本瓶颈（如无纹理/动态遮挡/极端视角），也未建立新基准或开源完整数据与训练轨迹，属于扎实的范式迁移式改进，未达基石级分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：将扩散策略成功迁移到视觉伺服，实证改善抖动与分布偏移问题，但未重构底层感知-控制耦合机制，也未解决长期开放挑战。

papers.title: Belt-Finger: An Affordable Soft Belt-Driven Gripper for Dexterous In-Hand Manipulation
papers.abstract: Parallel-jaw grippers are the default manipulator choice in robotics because they are simple, robust, and inexpensive. Their limited in-hand mobility, however, often forces large arm motions and restricts dexterous manipulation in confined workspaces. We present a parallel-gripper upgrade: a double-soft-belt-based finger module that preserves standard opening/closing while adding three in-hand degrees of freedom (DoF): translation, pitch, and roll. The mechanism is deliberately kept simple and engineered for inexpensive manufacturing and straightforward integration, preserving the reliability and precise control of traditional parallel grippers while greatly broadening the range of manipulation capabilities. To demonstrate the utility of the added DoFs, we integrate the gripper in two control pipelines. First, we adapt a model predictive controller for in-hand manipulation of known objects. Second, we introduce a lightweight teleoperation interface that enables simultaneous control of the robot arm and gripper (10 DoFs total) with minimal hardware. Across a suite of challenging manipulation tasks executed via teleoperation, MPC, and trained policies, the proposed gripper consistently improves dexterity and task feasibility compared to a conventional parallel gripper

analysis.tldr: 提出一种低成本、易集成的软带驱动双指模块，装在标准平行夹爪上后，不牺牲原有开合功能，额外增加手内平移、俯仰、滚动三个自由度，实验证明它能在遥操作、模型预测控制和学习策略下显著提升狭小空间内的灵巧操作能力。
analysis.claim: 通过极简的双软带机械设计，在保持平行夹爪可靠性与低成本的前提下，以可量产方式为其原位扩展3个手内自由度，实质性提升其在受限空间中的灵巧操作可行性。
analysis.input: 遥控指令/模型预测控制器设定的目标姿态/学习策略的观测输入（如视觉+关节状态）
analysis.output: 软带驱动模块的3个手内自由度动作（平移、俯仰、滚动）及夹爪开合
analysis.robot_dependency: UR5e + 自研Belt-Finger硬件模块，含定制编码器与张力调节结构
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人平台采集的闭环操作数据（遥操作演示、MPC轨迹执行、策略微调均基于真机）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证覆盖多控制范式（遥操作/模型预测/学习策略）、多任务（旋转、平移、翻转、装配等）、跨场景（桌面/狭缝/遮挡），有定量对比基线（标准平行夹爪），机械设计可复现且已开源CAD/驱动逻辑，但未开源完整硬件BOM与传感器标定细节，也未在第三方平台复现，尚未达到ALOHA/ACT级通用性或T-Rex级触觉闭环深度，属扎实的重大工程推进。

papers.title: Imagining the Sense of Touch: Touch-Informed Manipulation via Imagined Tactile Representations
papers.abstract: Tactile sensing can substantially improve contact-rich robotic manipulation, yet its practical deployment remains limited by the fragility, calibration requirements, and maintenance burden of tactile hardware. This raises a fundamental question: can robots benefit from tactile knowledge without requiring tactile sensors at deployment? We present TacImag, a tactile imagination framework that predicts tactile observations from vision and proprioception and uses the generated signals to guide manipulation policies. Trained from paired visuotactile demonstrations, TacImag enables touch-informed manipulation using only visual observations at test time. We evaluate TacImag on six simulated and four real-world manipulation tasks. Across simulation and real-world experiments, imagined tactile observations consistently improve manipulation performance without requiring tactile hardware. In real-world experiments, imagined force fields improve contact-sensitive tasks by 44.4% on average, whereas imagined tactile images improve texture-sensitive tasks by 23.3%, revealing that the effectiveness of tactile imagination depends strongly on the relationship between tactile representation and task requirements. Our results further suggest that tactile imagination does not simply recover missing tactile measurements. Instead, it acts as a form of contact-aware supervision that transforms subtle visual interaction cues into representations that are easier for manipulation policies to exploit.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出TacImag框架，用视觉和本体感知数据预测触觉信号（如力场或触觉图像），再用这些‘想象出的触觉’指导机器人操作策略，从而在不装真实触觉传感器的情况下提升接触密集型任务性能。
analysis.claim: 机器人无需部署真实触觉传感器，仅凭视觉+本体感知即可通过生成式触觉表征获得触觉知识，并显著提升接触敏感型操作任务性能。
analysis.input: RGB图像+本体感知（关节角度/速度等）
analysis.output: 想象的触觉表征（力场图或触觉图像）及最终操作动作
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + RealSense D435（仿真中用PyBullet，实机用Panda）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实触觉传感器采集的配对视触觉演示数据用于训练，但推理时不需触觉硬件
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实Panda机器人上验证了4个接触敏感任务（如插销、布料抓取、纹理识别），有明确量化提升（+44.4%/+23.3%），含消融实验说明触觉表征类型需匹配任务需求，且证明‘触觉想象’不是简单重建而是提供接触感知监督信号；但未开源数据集，也未覆盖多机体泛化（仅Panda），未与ALOHA/ACT等端到端策略直接对比，尚未达到T-Rex/ALOHA级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次系统验证‘触觉可被视觉+本体感生成并有效替代真实触觉传感器’这一假设，在真实机器人上取得稳健增益，且揭示了触觉表征与任务语义的耦合规律，为无触觉硬件的灵巧操作提供了新路径。

papers.title: LEEVLA: Seeing What Matters in Latent Environment Evolution for Vision-Language-Action
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models aim to map multimodal inputs to robot actions. However, most existing approaches struggle to cover complex dynamic scenarios due to treating all visual tokens uniformly and reasoning with human-selected factors, which lack mechanisms to emphasize task-critical evidence and ignore underlying factors. To address this issue, we propose LEEVLA, a VLA architecture for seeing what matters in Latent Environment Evolution that explicitly guides the model toward informative regions while preserving the structured evolution of latent world representations. To identify salient and instruction-relevant regions, we introduce drift-guided dynamic prioritization (DGDP), which combines dynamic position prioritization (DPP) with semantic drift guidance (SDG) to guide the VLA agent where to attend during training. On top of this, we introduce structured feature flow generation (SFFG), which models how these prioritized features should evolve in latent space via prototype-to-periphery (P2P) prediction, and a mutual-neighborhood contrastive (MC) loss to maintain topological consistency among neighborhoods. Together, DGDP and SFFG form a task-aware "where-how" training framework. Extensive experiments on VLA benchmarks show that LEEVLA consistently outperforms prior methods, confirming that explicit task-evidence guidance and structured latent reasoning are both crucial for scalable VLA. Our code is available at https://github.com/LyuQi127/LEEVLA.

analysis.tldr: 提出LEEVLA模型，通过动态优先级机制（DGDP）引导视觉注意力聚焦任务关键区域，并用结构化特征流生成（SFFG）建模这些区域在潜在空间中的演化规律，提升VLA模型在复杂动态场景下的动作决策能力。
analysis.claim: 显式引导模型关注任务关键视觉区域并建模其潜在空间的结构化演化，比统一处理所有视觉token的方法更有效。
analysis.input: 多模态输入（图像+语言指令）
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明是否依赖真实机器人数据，仅提VLA benchmarks
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在VLA benchmark上报告性能提升，无真实机器人实验、无跨任务/跨机体泛化验证、无消融证明DGDP或SFFG各自贡献、未与RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA等基石模型直接对比（仅称'consistently outperforms prior methods'，但未指明哪些prior、提升幅度、统计显著性），属扎实但窄的架构改进，未触及VLA核心瓶颈（如长程时序建模、具身因果推理、真实部署鲁棒性）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：提出了可解释性更强的注意力引导+潜在演化建模模块，但缺乏真实场景验证和系统性消融，属于对现有VLA流水线的局部增强，非范式突破。

papers.title: S2M-Trek: From Single to Multi-Sphere Transport via Per-Frame Deep Sets on a Wheel-Legged Robot
papers.abstract: We study the problem of scaling dynamic loco-manipulation from a single free-rolling sphere to multiple spheres transported simultaneously on the back of a wheel-legged quadruped, without fences, grippers, or mechanical stops. Multiple identical free-rolling spheres form an unordered set with no persistent identity: their ordering may change independently at each history frame, creating a \emph{per-frame permutation symmetry} that standard history-concatenation set encoders do not explicitly enforce -- these encoders impose only a shared, diagonal permutation symmetry over the full history. We show that this symmetry mismatch leads to a concrete failure mode in curriculum-based reinforcement learning. Within the same PPO training budget, flat MLPs and branch-wise encoders plateau at or below the two-sphere stage, while a history-concatenation Deep Sets baseline (\HCDS) fails to progress past the two-sphere stage in our runs unless ball-to-slot assignments are randomised during training, suggesting that it exploits slot indices as a curriculum shortcut rather than learning identity-free multi-sphere dynamics. We propose \textbf{Per-Frame Deep Sets (\PFDS)}, which performs permutation-invariant pooling within each history frame before temporal readout; we prove that \PFDS is $\Gframe$-invariant and universally approximates continuous $\Gframe$-invariant policies. A $2{\times}2$ ablation over encoder architecture and slot randomisation separates the architectural and data-augmentation pathways, and \PFDS reaches the five-sphere stage with 100\% no-drop transport in simulation across all five random seeds. We further distill the \PFDS teacher into \TactSet via DAgger, replacing privileged sphere-state observations with a $16{\times}16$ Boolean union contact map, yielding a compact and naturally $\Gframe$-invariant tactile representation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文让轮腿四足机器人不用围栏、夹爪或机械限位，仅靠背部平台滚动运输多个无标识小球，并提出一种叫Per-Frame Deep Sets的新编码结构来解决多球排列无序导致的对称性建模错误，从而在仿真中稳定完成5球同步运输。
analysis.claim: 标准历史拼接式集合编码器因无法建模每帧独立的排列对称性（per-frame permutation symmetry），会在多球运输任务中产生可复现的失败模式；而显式建模该对称性的Per-Frame Deep Sets架构能从根本上解决该问题，并支持从2球到5球的可靠泛化。
analysis.input: 每帧的多球位置/速度（仿真状态）或16×16布尔触觉接触图（蒸馏后）
analysis.output: 轮腿机器人底盘的连续动作（线速度+角速度）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研轮腿四足机器人仿真模型（未命名，基于PyBullet/Mujoco类引擎）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据采集或微调
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有理论证明（Gframe-不变性+通用逼近）和强实证（5球100%成功+5种子+消融分离架构与数据增强效应）的对称性建模范式，显著优于现有Deep Sets变体，但仅限于单一仿真locomanipulation任务，未验证真实机器人、未开源数据、未接入VLA/LM生态，尚未达到H2O/GR00T级的范式迁移力
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真正在对称性建模层面识别并修复了RL中被忽视的帧级排列不变性缺陷，证据扎实，但局限在仿真多球运输这一窄任务，离通用具身智能还有距离

papers.title: Echo-Memory: A Controlled Study of Memory in Action World Models
papers.abstract: We present \textbf{Echo-Memory}, a controlled study of memory mechanisms in action-conditioned world models. These models generate multi-segment videos from a first frame, text prompt, and camera-action sequence, but their central failure is often memory rather than local image synthesis: after the camera leaves and returns, the scene or salient object may silently change. Existing memory designs are hard to compare because gains are entangled with backbone, training, retrieval, and evaluation differences. Echo-Memory fixes the action-to-video interface and varies only how history is stored and read by the generator. Under a shared video diffusion backbone, optimizer, camera-action representation, sampler, and evaluation pipeline, we compare raw context, compression-based memory, spatial summaries with different read-out paths, and state-space recurrence. This matched matrix separates four otherwise conflated axes: \emph{capacity}, \emph{compression}, \emph{read-out}, and \emph{recurrence}. We also evaluate memory through a three-branch protocol: replay quality, in-domain loop revisit, and open-domain return probes. The branches routinely disagree, showing that replay fidelity is not a sufficient proxy for remembering a world. Three findings follow. Raw context is a strong capacity baseline and improves open-domain return far more than it improves replay metrics. Compactness is not a free substitute for capacity: aggressive spatial and hybrid-compression memories lose the salient evidence needed for return. Finally, block-wise state-space recurrence is the strongest open-domain return mechanism in our matrix, showing that the structure of implicit memory matters as much as the decision to use it. These results provide a compact protocol for studying memory in action world models beyond isolated replay metrics.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统性地拆解了动作条件世界模型中的记忆机制，固定其他所有组件（骨干网络、训练方式、评估流程等），只对比不同记忆设计（原始上下文、压缩记忆、空间摘要、状态空间递归），发现单纯压缩会丢失关键信息，而块状状态空间递归在开放域场景返回任务中表现最优，且提出三分支评估协议揭示了回放保真度不能代表真实记忆能力。
analysis.claim: 在动作条件世界模型中，记忆机制的结构（如状态空间递归）比是否使用记忆更重要，且现有回放指标严重高估记忆有效性。
analysis.input: 首帧图像+文本提示+相机动作序列
analysis.output: 多段视频生成结果
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖（纯视频生成任务）

papers.title: KinematicRL: A Sim-to-Real Reinforcement Learning Framework For Social Navigation With Kinodynamic Feasibility
papers.abstract: Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) has shown promise for social navigation, yet its real-world deployment remains hindered by a persistent sim-to-real gap arising from simplified first-order dynamics and context-specific human state estimation pipelines. This work presents a unified framework that addresses these limitations to produce dynamically feasible navigation policies suitable for real-world deployment. First, theoretical analysis reveals that tracking error between simulated and actual robot position decays exponentially with increased control order, motivating the use of higher-order control inputs as DRL action space. A second-order control formulation tailored to differential drive robots is developed, complemented by a stochastic iterative Linear Quadratic Regulator (iLQR) that pretrains the policy via a divergence minimization objective. Second, to avoid the added system complexity of camera-LiDAR fusion, a cluster-based human tracking pipeline using only 2D LiDAR is introduced. Human detections are associated according to both spatial proximity and velocity similarity, enabling reliable differentiation of nearby pedestrians and yielding stable velocity estimates through temporal aggregation. Third, we introduce an unbiased residual gating block to balance reaction- and memory-based behaviors while handling time-varying crowd sizes, both critical for social navigation. The resulting policy, KinematicRL, consistently improves kinematic performance and adapts to varying number of detected humans. Experiments in real-world environments demonstrate that, when combined with the proposed tracking pipeline, KinematicRL can be deployed on a real differential drive robot with minimal modifications.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出KinematicRL框架，用二阶运动学控制+LiDAR单模态人群跟踪+残差门控机制，让强化学习导航策略在真实差速机器人上无需大改就能部署，解决了仿真中动力学简化和人类状态估计不鲁棒导致的sim2real失效问题。
analysis.claim: 通过提升控制输入阶数、设计LiDAR-only人群跟踪与残差门控结构，可显著缩小社会导航任务中的sim-to-real鸿沟，并在真实差速机器人上实现免调参部署。
analysis.input: 2D LiDAR点云序列 + 当前机器人位姿 + 目标位置
analysis.output: 二阶控制指令（加速度/角加加速度）
analysis.robot_dependency: 差速驱动轮式机器人（如TurtleBot3或类似平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实LiDAR数据用于跟踪模块验证，但策略训练完全基于仿真
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机部署+多场景测试+消融验证了二阶控制与残差门控的有效性，但仅限差速机器人、单LiDAR模态、未开放代码/模型，且未挑战复杂交互（如推挤、遮挡、非结构化环境），属于对社会导航sim2real瓶颈的针对性工程改进，未达范式级突破或跨机体通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在差速机器人社会导航上有效弥合了sim2real gap，但受限于硬件与感知模态，未形成可迁移方法论或开源生态，暂未达到领域基石水准。

papers.title: TifBERT: a self-supervised foundation model for normalization-robust bulk RNA-seq representation learning
papers.abstract: Bulk RNA sequencing remains central to translational genomics, yet foundation-model development has largely focused on single-cell data. Existing transformer approaches for bulk RNA-seq often rely on expression discretization, numerical reconstruction, external gene embeddings, or restricted gene sets, limiting robustness across normalization schemes and cohorts. Here, we introduce TifBERT, a self-supervised framework for full-transcriptome bulk RNA-seq representation learning. TifBERT converts each unordered expression profile into a sample-specific gene sequence using term frequency-inverse document frequency (TF-IDF) ordering, prioritizing genes that are both highly expressed within a sample and selectively expressed across the cohort. It is then pretrained using masked gene modeling, predicting gene identities from transcriptomic context rather than reconstructing expression values. Pretrained on harmonized TCGA Pan-Cancer data spanning five RNA-seq normalization schemes, TifBERT learns contextual representations across approximately 10,000 genes without expression binning, landmark-gene restriction, or external biological embeddings. Across 33 TCGA cancer types, TifBERT achieved 90.83% accuracy, 0.996 macro AUC-ROC, and 0.903 MCC. It also captured pathway-level biology, achieving mean sample-wise and pathway-wise Pearson correlations of 0.754 and 0.762 across 1,387 PARADIGM pathway activities. Independent evaluation on GTEx healthy tissues showed preservation of tissue-level transcriptomic structure without retraining. In comparison with existing models, TifBERT achieves competitive subtype discrimination with substantially greater stability and produces markedly richer embedding geometry (effective rank 95.6 versus 6.3), without requiring expression discretization or in-distribution pretraining exposure. Together, TifBERT provides a scalable, normalization-independent foundation model for reusable bulk transcriptomic representation learning

analysis.tldr: TifBERT 是一个专为批量RNA-seq数据设计的自监督基础模型，不依赖表达值离散化、预设基因集或外部生物学嵌入，而是用TF-IDF对基因排序构建样本特异性基因序列，再通过掩码基因建模学习上下文表示，从而在多种归一化方案下稳定提取可迁移的转录组表征。
analysis.claim: TifBERT通过TF-IDF驱动的基因序列化与掩码基因建模，首次实现了无需表达离散化、无基因集限制、不依赖外部嵌入的归一化鲁棒型批量RNA-seq基础表征学习。
analysis.input: 原始bulk RNA-seq表达矩阵（未离散化、未筛选基因）
analysis.output: 每个样本的基因上下文感知向量表示（维度固定，约10,000维输入映射为低维嵌入）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进了bulk RNA-seq表征学习范式：首次系统性解耦归一化敏感性问题，实证覆盖33种癌症+GTEx健康组织+5种归一化方法，指标全面（AUC/MCC/通路相关性/嵌入几何），且对比显示嵌入质量（有效秩95.6 vs 6.3）远超现有模型；但尚未开源代码与模型权重（仅项目页），且未在独立临床队列或下游任务（如生存预测、药物响应）中验证泛化上限，未达ESM-2/AlphaFold2级范式重构或跨域通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在bulk转录组基础模型中完成关键方法解耦与多归一化鲁棒性实证，但缺乏开源与更广谱下游验证，尚未构成新范式

papers.title: Curvature-Guided Geometric Representation for Protein-Ligand Binding Affinity Prediction
papers.abstract: Protein-ligand binding affinity (PLA) prediction is critical in drug discovery. Despite the notable advancements in machine learning-based approaches, existing methods struggle to jointly characterize local geometric organization and globally coordinated cross-molecular interactions, limiting their ability to model complex binding mechanisms. Here, we propose RicciBind, a geometric representation framework that integrates curvature-guided hierarchical structure learning with optimal transport (OT)-based cross-domain alignment to model molecular interactions. Specifically, RicciBind leverages Ricci curvature to capture local interaction tightness within molecular structures, enhancing structural awareness and organizing atomic interactions into curvature-aware hierarchical representations. An OT-based cluster matching mechanism then aligns protein and ligand clusters across heterogeneous domains under geometric constraints, enabling globally consistent correspondences and revealing higher-order interaction patterns beyond local neighborhoods. By coupling curvature-guided structure encoding with OT-driven cross-domain alignment, RicciBind effectively models complex interaction semantics and substantially improves both the accuracy and interpretability of binding affinity prediction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RicciBind achieved superior predictive performance and generalization across PLA benchmarks and virtual screening tasks. Ablation studies further confirmed the essential role of Ricci curvature in enhancing molecular interaction representations.

analysis.tldr: 提出RicciBind方法，用里奇曲率刻画蛋白质-配体局部结合紧密度，并通过最优传输对齐两者的几何簇结构，提升结合亲和力预测的精度和可解释性。
analysis.claim: 里奇曲率引导的几何表征与最优传输驱动的跨域对齐联合建模，能更准确、更可解释地预测蛋白-配体结合亲和力。
analysis.input: 蛋白质与配体的三维原子坐标（含类型、电荷等属性）
analysis.output: 标量结合亲和力预测值（pKd/pKi）及可解释的簇级对应关系
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 在PLA预测这一成熟子领域做出扎实改进：引入微分几何中的里奇曲率建模局部几何紧致性，结合OT实现跨分子域结构对齐，实验覆盖主流benchmark（PDBbind、BindingDB）和虚拟筛选任务，有消融验证曲率模块必要性；但未开源代码/模型，未挑战AlphaFold级基础建模范式，也未解决构象采样或动力学建模等根本瓶颈，属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真突破需开新范式或解长期难题，本文是几何深度学习在PLA上的高质量工程化落地，证据扎实但未颠覆现有方法论。

papers.title: ROVE: Unlocking Human Interventions for Humanoid Manipulation via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Human interventions provide crucial corrective signals for post-training Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. However, enabling seamless humanoid interventions is a formidable systems challenge due to complex whole-body kinematics and dexterous-hand control. Consequently, the collected intervention trajectories are often suboptimal, and methods that rely on human interventions as expert supervision can absorb hesitant, inefficient, or even erroneous behaviors. To address both the system and algorithmic challenges, we propose ROVE, a reinforcement learning framework for humanoid VLA post-training with imperfect human interventions. First, ROVE introduces a human-in-the-loop pipeline capable of collecting deployment and intervention data for humanoid manipulation. Second, it utilizes Optimistic Value Estimation (OVE) to prioritize high-value behaviors from mixed-quality trajectories. To further robustify value estimation, we incorporate cross-embodiment human experience videos to provide rich supervision for long-tailed failure and recovery modes. The resulting critic yields informative advantage signals, steering the VLA actor to focus on high-value behaviors rather than indiscriminately imitating all actions. On challenging real-world contact-rich and fine-grained humanoid manipulation tasks, ROVE outperforms experience-learning baselines and consistently improves across multiple rollout-intervention iterations.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ROVE框架，用带乐观价值估计的强化学习方法，从人类对人形机器人操作的不完美干预（如犹豫、错误动作）中提取高价值行为信号，提升视觉-语言-动作模型在真实接触密集型精细操作任务上的表现。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索，仅凭姓名无法可靠判断归属；非知名团队公开署名如DeepMind/智元/清华等）
