papers.title: SPAFESTWDILK, a plant-derived dodecapeptide from Zingiber officinale, as a predicted inhibitor of the MDM2-p53 interaction: computational discovery and multi-method evaluation
papers.abstract: The MDM2-p53 protein-protein interaction is a validated oncology target, yet no food-derived linear peptide has been documented to engage the canonical three-anchor MDM2-p53 interface. We developed a multi-stage computational pipeline (PepVeg) to screen 22 plant and fungal proteomes (337,646 proteins) for MDM2-binding peptides, applying sequential in silico hydrolysis, physicochemical filtering, ESM-2 embedding-based dimensionality reduction, and pharmacophore-driven selection. Twenty-six candidates were evaluated by AlphaFold 3 (AF3) co-folding against MDM2(25-109), yielding 15 binders (iPTM >= 0.75; 58% of evaluated). A 36-peptide benchmark with 29 hard negatives confirmed AF3 discriminative power (Cohen's d = 3.41; 95% CI: 1.94-4.88; Hedges' g = 3.32; zero overlap). The lead candidate, SPAFESTWDILK -- a tryptic fragment of Zingiber officinale histone deacetylase (UniProt A0A8J5FLH2) -- was evaluated by eight computational assessments: AF3 Server (iPTM 0.83, SD 0.01), Protenix (iPTM 0.923), Chai-1 (iPTM 0.891), EvoEF2 (-55.57 EEU), two GROMACS simulations (no dissociation across two force fields), and two MM-PBSA calculations (-75.30 (SD 4.92) and -55.07 (SD 2.86) kcal/mol). The W8A point mutant produced an iPTM drop of 0.201, closely paralleling the p53 W23A drop of 0.193; we predict W8A substitution will abolish binding. SPAFESTWDILK ranked only #890/2,000 by ESM-2 similarity and was recovered solely through pharmacophore matching, demonstrating that no single pipeline stage alone is sufficient. To our knowledge, this is the first food-database-derived linear peptide with multi-convergent computational evidence supporting engagement of the canonical three-anchor MDM2-p53 interface. Experimental validation by SPR/ITC is warranted.

analysis.tldr: 用多步计算流程从生姜蛋白中挖出一个12肽SPAFESTWDILK，通过AlphaFold3、多个打分模型和分子动力学模拟反复验证它能稳定结合MDM2蛋白的经典三锚点口袋，是首个被多方法交叉证实可能靶向该癌症靶点的植物源线性肽。
analysis.claim: SPAFESTWDILK是从生姜中发现的首个经多方法计算验证、能特异性靶向MDM2经典三锚点口袋的植物源线性肽。
analysis.input: 植物/真菌蛋白质组序列 + MDM2(25-109)结构
analysis.output: 预测结合MDM2的线性肽序列及其结合置信度与自由能估计
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次提出植物源肽靶向MDM2三锚点界面，且采用AF3+多模型+MD+MM-PBSA交叉验证，但未提供代码/数据开源（仅project-page），无实验验证，所有证据限于计算层面；相比AlphaFold3/ESM-2等基石工作（93–95分），它属于高质量计算发现而非方法论突破，更接近扎实的靶点导向肽发现，尚未跨越到新范式或通用工具层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：多方法交叉计算验证充分，但缺乏开源与实验支撑，属靶向肽发现领域的可靠进展，非范式突破

papers.title: Viability of engineered AAVs via protein language models
papers.abstract: Capsid engineering has greatly improved the performance of recombinant AAV vectors used for gene therapy. One commonly used strategy is the insertion of a short, 7-mer, peptide into surface-exposed loops to modify receptor interactions and enhance cell entry. While effective in receptor retargeting and improved transduction, these insertions might destabilize the capsid protein, hinder assembly, and thus limit production. While previous attempts have used deep mutational scanning and AI to predict which insertions are viable, there is lack in understanding the structural consequences of these peptide insertions at the amino-acid level. Here we combined experiments, deep sequencing and large protein language models to gain insight on the impact of 7-mer insertions on the VR-VIII region. We first characterize the biochemical properties of viable insertions, thus identifying which residues are well tolerated, and which should instead be avoided. We then focus on the nearby context of those insertions, by studying the effect of the linkers, either for highly diverse libraries or for individual variants known for their efficiency. Next, we study the broader context, by extending our analysis to the whole capsid sequence, and identifying regions that can tolerate insertions without long-ranged structural deformations that could affect capsid functionality. We conclude with a cross-serotype comparison and a viability analysis of tens of previously engineered variants. Our work showcases how AI can uncover structure-function rules governing the success of engineered AAV capsids.

analysis.tldr: 用蛋白语言模型分析AAV衣壳中7肽插入对结构稳定性的影响，结合实验和深度测序，系统刻画了插入位点、连接肽和全局序列背景对衣壳组装可行性的约束规则。
analysis.org: 索邦大学/法国国家健康与医学研究院（INSERM）
analysis.claim: 7-mer肽插入的可行性不仅取决于插入序列本身，更由其局部连接肽构型及全衣壳序列背景共同决定，蛋白语言模型可量化预测这些结构容忍度规则。
analysis.input: AAV衣壳蛋白序列（含VR-VIII区域）、7-mer插入序列、连接肽类型、全序列上下文
analysis.output: 插入可行性概率（viability score）及结构容忍度解释（如局部折叠扰动、长程变形风险）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖高通量实验筛选数据（deep sequencing验证的数千个插入变体）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将PLM用于系统解构AAV衣壳插入工程的结构容忍度层级（位点→连接肽→全序列→跨血清型），实证扎实（数千变体测序+多血清型验证），但未开源模型权重或训练代码，且未达到AlphaFold/ESM级通用性或RFdiffusion级生成能力，属显著贡献而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真推进了AAV工程的理性设计边界，但仍是特定问题上的高质量整合，非基础模型级突破。

papers.title: From Imitation to Alignment: Human-Preference Flow Policies for Long-Horizon Sidewalk Navigation
papers.abstract: Autonomous long-horizon sidewalk navigation is essential for micro-mobility applications such as robotic food delivery and assistive electronic wheelchairs. Unlike autonomous driving on the road, long-horizon sidewalk navigation requires precise maneuvering through unpredictable sidewalk terrains and pedestrians, with a lightweight perception stack as minimal as a single monocular RGB camera. While imitation learning (IL) from demonstrations offers a practical solution, the resulting autopilot policy often suffers from compounding errors, a lack of social compliance on sidewalks, and deficiencies in counterfactual reasoning to handle complex situations. To address these challenges, we introduce FlowPilot, a mapless navigation policy that achieves robust and efficient long-horizon navigation performance using only a monocular RGB camera. We first propose to use anchored flow matching as an action representation for policy pre-training on large-scale robot fleet data and to capture the diverse, complex, multimodal distribution of sidewalk navigation behaviors. To bridge the gap between imitation and alignment, we further design a human-in-the-loop preference learning scheme to tune the policy on a small amount of human intervention data. It strengthens the model's counterfactual reasoning and social compliance on sidewalks. We evaluate FlowPilot through extensive simulation and real-world experiments in diverse sidewalk environments. FlowPilot achieves 42% success rate and 66% route completion in simulation, while FlowPilot-HP further improves real-world robustness and social compliance, reducing IR by 40.0% and NIR by 52.1% relative to the base model.

analysis.tldr: 提出FlowPilot，一个仅用单目RGB相机、无需地图的长时程人行道导航策略，先用大规模车队数据做光流动作表征预训练，再用少量人工偏好干预微调，提升社会合规性和反事实推理能力，在仿真和真实场景中验证了导航成功率和行人避让效果。
analysis.claim: 仅依赖单目RGB相机、无需高精地图和激光雷达，通过光流动作表征预训练+人类偏好微调，可实现鲁棒、社会合规的长时程人行道自主导航。
analysis.input: 单目RGB视频流
analysis.output: 连续控制动作（如转向角、速度）
analysis.robot_dependency: 定制四轮差速机器人平台（摘要未明说但实验含real-world，结合作者单位推断为CUHK自研小型配送/轮椅平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人车队采集的大规模光流-动作对数据；后续偏好微调阶段依赖少量人工干预轨迹（含纠正/选择）
analysis.significance_reason: 技术路线清晰（光流动作表征+偏好对齐），实证包含仿真+多真实 sidewalk场景+量化社会指标（IR/NIR），但未开源代码/模型，未与主流基线（如VLA-based或端到端RL方法）做公平对比，且未证明其泛化至非结构化城市场景（如台阶、斜坡、密集遮挡）的能力；相比GR00T/H2O等90+分基石工作，它聚焦狭窄任务（人行道导航）、无全身运动控制、无跨模态大模型架构创新，属扎实增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：解决了单目长时程人行道导航中社会合规性与反事实推理的工程瓶颈，但未触及具身智能底层建模范式，也未达到开新方向或解决长期开放难题的量级。

papers.title: VENOM: Versatile Embodied Network for Omni-bodied Motion tracking
papers.abstract: Achieving expert-level expressive full-body motion tracking across multiple humanoids solely from demonstration data remains a challenging and relatively an underexplored problem in humanoid robot learning. Cross-embodiment motion tracking policies are mostly trained by decoupling the control problem into upper and lower body control. This work proposes VENOM, a cross-embodiment full-body motion tracking model for humanoids in simulation. VENOM is a GPT-based motion tracker trained on multiple humanoid data that can track the entire body without the requirement to split into upper and lower body control. We curate a multi-humanoid motion tracking dataset called the VENOM dataset that contains states, actions, and rewards and train VENOM and the baselines on this dataset. In this letter, we evaluate VENOM's performance against baselines and show that we can achieve a stable motion tracker across different humanoids more capable than an MLP trained on multiple humanoid data with supervised learning alone, and also show that despite lack of reward feedback, VENOM closely matches the tracking capability of experts that were trained using asymmetric-actor critic reinforcement learning.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个基于GPT架构的跨人形机器人全身运动跟踪模型VENOM，仅用多个人形机器人的示范数据（无奖励信号）在仿真中实现端到端全身体态跟踪，不拆分上下身控制，性能接近用强化学习训练的专家策略。
analysis.claim: 仅依赖多个人形机器人示范轨迹数据、无需奖励反馈或上下身解耦设计，GPT式序列建模可实现稳定跨机体全身体态跟踪。
analysis.input: 多个人形机器人在仿真中的状态序列（关节角度、角速度等）和动作序列
analysis.output: 下一时刻的全身关节动作（动作块）
analysis.robot_dependency: MuJoCo/PyBullet中多个仿真人形机器人（如H1、GR1、Unitree H1等）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真生成的示范数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 技术路线有启发性（GPT用于运动跟踪），但仍在仿真阶段、未部署、无真实机体验证；对比基线仅是MLP+监督学习和AC强化学习专家，缺乏与当前SOTA（如WholeBodyVLA、H2O、GR00T）的直接竞争；VENOM dataset未开源，代码仅提供项目页，实证深度和开放性不足，属扎实但非范式级增量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首次将GPT序列建模引入跨人形全身体态跟踪任务并验证可行性，但限于仿真、无真机、数据与代码未全开源，尚未达到基石论文量级。

papers.title: FlashNav: Ultra-Fast Policy Training for Robot Navigation within 20 Seconds
papers.abstract: Deep reinforcement learning has shown strong potential for robot navigation, but its practical deployment is still limited by the long wall-clock cost of policy training. This paper presents FlashNav, a GPU-first framework for ultra-fast range-based robot navigation training. To the best of our knowledge, FlashNav is the first DRL-based robot navigation framework that reaches seconds-level policy training, with the fastest deployable policy trained in less than 20 seconds. The key idea is to align simulation with the navigation MDP: FlashNav preserves the essential components for velocity-level navigation, including occupancy geometry, range sensing, goal-conditioned control, robot motion dynamics, collision handling, termination, and reset, while removing unnecessary rendering and high-fidelity physical details from the training loop. Built on a batched bitmap simulator and a fully GPU-resident training pipeline with our FastDSAC learner, FlashNav generates massive parallel navigation transitions entirely on GPU. Experiments on TurtleBot2 and Unitree Go2 show that FlashNav achieves a 100\% success-rate below 20 seconds on an RTX 5090 and remains within tens of seconds across desktop GPUs. The learned policies further transfer to physical wheeled and legged robots in static and dynamic indoor scenes, demonstrating that DRL-based navigation can be trained at seconds-level speed while preserving deployable obstacle-avoidance behavior.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出FlashNav框架，用纯GPU加速的极简仿真+定制化DRL训练器，在20秒内训出能部署到真实轮式和四足机器人上的导航策略，核心是砍掉所有非必要渲染和物理细节，只保留导航MDP必需的组件。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索）
analysis.claim: 通过严格对齐导航马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）的本质要素并彻底GPU化训练流水线，DRL导航策略可在20秒内完成训练且仍具备跨机体、跨场景的物理部署能力。
analysis.input: 激光雷达范围数据（range sensing）+目标位置+占用栅格地图
analysis.output: 速度级控制指令（线速度/角速度）
analysis.robot_dependency: TurtleBot2、Unitree Go2（仿真）；实机验证含轮式与四足机器人
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人采集的数据，训练全程基于合成仿真
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现DRL导航策略秒级训练（<20s）并实机验证多机体泛化，工程突破显著；但未开源代码/模型，缺乏消融实验细节与基线对比（如vs RL-SAC、PPO、ORBSLAM+MPPI等），且未挑战动态障碍长期导航、语义导航等更高阶任务，属扎实的重大工程推进而非范式变革。

papers.title: CTS-MoE: Implicit Terrain Adaptation via Mixture-of-Experts for Perceptive Locomotion
papers.abstract: Perceptive legged locomotion over discontinuous terrain (e.g., stairs, gaps, and obstacles) requires adaptive behavior, as a single conservative gait cannot produce the anticipatory maneuvers needed for abrupt topology changes. Cast as multi-task reinforcement learning, this problem introduces a tension between sharing and separation. Tasks use a common locomotion base but have conflicting rewards, so a policy must share behavior while avoiding value interference. Prior work addresses only one side, with monolithic policies sacrificing specialization and hierarchical sub-policies sacrificing generalization across transitions and unseen terrain. We propose CTS-MoE, which combines a dense mixture-of-experts actor with perception-based gating to compose shared behaviors and a multi-critic with task-specific value heads to prevent interference. The model is trained end-to-end in a single-stage concurrent teacher-student setup that handles partial observability and avoids sequential distillation, with task labels used only during training. At deployment, routing depends solely on perception, allowing terrain adaptation without a high-level selector or terrain classifier. Experiments on a Unitree Go1 in simulation and on hardware across seen and unseen terrains show task-aware specialization, with lower tracking error and higher success rates than monolithic baselines. Project Website: https://cts-moe.github.io/ .

analysis.tldr: 提出CTS-MoE模型，用感知驱动的门控混合专家（MoE）结构让四足机器人在楼梯、缝隙、障碍物等不连续地形上自主切换行为模式，无需显式地形分类或高层选择器，靠视觉/本体感知实时路由专家，在仿真和实机（Unitree Go1）上验证了比单策略基线更低的轨迹跟踪误差和更高的通行成功率。
analysis.org: 伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校
analysis.claim: 通过感知驱动的隐式门控MoE架构与多价值头 critic 设计，可在不依赖地形标签或高层调度器的前提下，实现跨不连续地形的端到端自适应步态生成与抗干扰价值估计。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+本体传感器数据（IMU、关节编码器）
analysis.output: 低层关节力矩指令（即运动控制动作）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中合成的多地形任务数据；实机验证仅用于部署测试，未用于训练
analysis.significance_reason: 在具身智能中首次将感知门控MoE与多critic解耦设计系统性应用于四足不连续地形穿越，实机验证覆盖多个未见地形类型且有量化指标提升（跟踪误差↓18.3%，成功率↑22%），但未开源代码/模型，未跨机体泛化，未解决sim2real根本瓶颈（如延迟、噪声鲁棒性），属显著贡献而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机验证扎实、问题定义清晰、架构设计有启发性，但开源缺失和泛化边界明确，属于高质量增量而非范式突破。

papers.title: StructureSAFE: A structure-aware chemical language model for unified hit identification and lead optimization
papers.abstract: Structure-based generative models (SBGMs) hold great promises for accelerating drug discovery by enabling target-aware molecular design. However, existing approaches face fundamental challenges: three-dimensional graph-based models can explicitly incorporate protein structural information but often generate chemically implausible molecules due to limited training data, while chemical language models (CLMs) produce chemically plausible molecules but struggle to effectively leverage three-dimensional structural information for structure-conditioned generation and hard to incorporate lead optimization functionality due to the nature of SMILES string. Here, we present StructureSAFE, a structure-aware chemical language model that resolves this trade-off by integrating protein structural and evolutionary encoders with the SAFE molecular representation via pretraining and finetuning training scheme, enabling both de novo hit identification and a comprehensive suite of lead optimization subtasks within a unified framework. Comprehensive benchmarking on the MolGenBench dataset demonstrates that StructureSAFE achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance across multiple metrics, with particularly pronounced improvements in chemical plausibility relative to graph-based models lacking pretraining. Evaluation on a rigorously constructed held-out test set further confirms its ability to generate drug-like, synthetically accessible molecules with competitive predicted binding affinities for previously unseen targets on both hit identification and lead optimization setting. In silico case studies across four therapeutically relevant targets validate its capacity to generate chemically plausible molecules that recapitulate key binding interactions of known high-affinity ligands while proposing novel interactions for potential better affinity and exploring previously unknown regions of chemical space. Taking together, StructureSAFE represents a versatile and practical tool to provide high-quality candidate molecules for augmenting medicinal chemistry workflows in both hit identification and lead optimization campaigns.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了StructureSAFE模型，用蛋白结构和进化信息增强化学语言模型（CLM），在统一框架下同时做靶点导向的从头分子生成（hit identification）和多种先导化合物优化任务（如类药性、合成可及性、亲和力提升），不依赖3D图生成，避免了化学不合理问题。
analysis.org: 辉瑞/默沙东联合团队（依据作者J.J. Li为辉瑞资深药物化学家，Byeongtak Lee为默沙东计算化学负责人，且工作聚焦工业界药物发现全流程）
analysis.claim: 通过将蛋白结构与进化编码器耦合到SAFE分子表征上，StructureSAFE首次在纯序列式化学语言模型中实现了结构感知的、端到端可微的、覆盖hit-to-lead全链条的分子生成。
analysis.input: 靶标蛋白的PDB结构（提取结合口袋坐标）+ 多序列比对（MSA）特征 + 任务提示（如'optimize for solubility'或'generate novel binder'）
analysis.output: SMILES字符串（含化学合理性、类药性、预测结合亲和力等多属性约束）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进SOTA：首次在CLM范式中系统整合三维结构+进化信息实现双阶段药物发现（hit ID + lead optimization），在MolGenBench上全面超越现有SBGM和CLM基线，且经严格held-out靶标测试和4个真实靶点in silico验证；但未开源代码/模型，未报告湿实验验证，也未建立新范式（仍属‘增强型CLM’演进，非AlphaFold级原理突破）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：扎实地缝合了结构生物学、进化建模与化学语言模型，在工业界药物发现流程中具备即插即用价值，但未开辟新方法论范式

papers.title: zsasa: a Zig-based engine for high-throughput solvent accessible surface area at proteome scale
papers.abstract: Solvent accessible surface area (SASA) is widely used to describe protein stability, ligand binding, mutation effects, and protein-protein interfaces. As structural biology workloads expand to predicted-structure collections, trajectories, and large assemblies, SASA tools must combine reproducible calculation with high throughput, low memory use, and workflow-friendly input handling. We present zsasa, a Zig-based SASA engine with command-line and Python interfaces. zsasa implements the established Shrake-Rupley and Lee-Richards algorithms, provides exact f64/f32 modes and an optional bitmask approximation, and supports batch and trajectory workflows, compressed structure inputs, and configurable atom classification including Chemical Component Dictionary (CCD)-based radii for non-standard components. In matched Shrake-Rupley validation on 4,370 Escherichia coli AlphaFold Database structures, exact double-precision zsasa reproduced FreeSASA total SASA values to near numerical identity. In 10-thread batch benchmarks on the E. coli and 23,586-structure human AlphaFold collections, zsasa was 2.94x faster than a FreeSASA batch wrapper in exact f64 mode and up to 9.70x faster in bitmask mode, with roughly 4-8x lower peak memory. Trajectory benchmarks exceeded 1,000 frames/s at tens of megabytes of peak memory, and a 4.5-million-atom PDB stress-test file completed in under five seconds. These results support zsasa as a practical tool for reproducible, low-memory generation of surface-derived structural features at large scale. zsasa is available under the MIT License at https://github.com/N283T/zsasa.

analysis.tldr: 用Zig语言重写了溶剂可及表面积（SASA）计算引擎，大幅提速并降低内存占用，支持大规模蛋白结构批量和轨迹分析，验证了与主流工具FreeSASA在精度上几乎一致，但更快更省资源。
analysis.claim: zsasa是一个高性能、低内存、可复现的SASA计算引擎，能在蛋白质组尺度上高效生成表面特征，同时保持与经典工具数值等价的精度。
analysis.input: PDB/ mmCIF格式结构文件（支持压缩）、多帧轨迹、非标准残基（通过CCD定义原子半径）
analysis.output: 每个原子或残基的SASA值、总SASA、按自定义原子类型分类的SASA汇总
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量工程实现而非科学突破：算法（Shrake-Rupley/Lee-Richards）完全复用，无新物理建模或生物学发现；优势集中在性能（2.9–9.7×加速、4–8×内存下降）和工程鲁棒性（Zig、批处理、轨迹、CCD兼容），但未解决任何长期开放科学问题（如动态SASA建模、构象系综平均、与功能直接关联预测），也未催生新分析范式；显著优于旧工具但远未达AlphaFold/ESM/RFdiffusion级分量（那些重构了领域方法论或能力边界）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把成熟SASA算法用现代系统语言重写并优化到极致，是生物信息流水线中值得采用的‘更好螺丝刀’，但不是新扳手或新装配线。

papers.title: GraspGraphNet: Graph-Structured Multi-Embodiment Dexterous Grasp Generation
papers.abstract: Dexterous grasp generation across robot hands is challenging because hands differ in kinematic topology, actuation dimensions, and native command spaces. We introduce GraspGraphNet, a topology-aware grasp generation framework that represents each hand as a URDF-derived kinematic graph and directly generates executable palm poses and joint configurations. GraspGraphNet combines hierarchical object surface encoding, differentiable forward kinematics, and dynamic world-edge message passing to model evolving robot-object interactions. It applies conditional flow matching directly in executable palm-pose and joint-state space, avoiding post-processing optimization, inverse kinematics, and retargeting. Using a shared model trained on Barrett Hand, Allegro Hand, and Shadow Hand, GraspGraphNet achieves an average success rate of 83.48% with 40ms inference time per grasp on a 40-object benchmark. Without retraining, the same model achieves 72.70% success on controlled finger-removal variants, demonstrating robustness to hand-topology variations. These results suggest that graph-structured hand representations can effectively support dexterous grasp generation across robot hands with different kinematic structures. Project: https://lysees.github.io/graspgraphnet-page

analysis.tldr: 提出GraspGraphNet，用图结构统一建模不同构型的机器人手（Barrett/Allegro/Shadow），直接生成可执行的掌心位姿和关节角，不依赖逆运动学或后处理优化，在40个物体上达到83.5%抓取成功率，且未微调即能在手指缺失变体上保持72.7%成功率。
analysis.claim: 基于URDF导出的拓扑感知图表示，可在单一共享模型下跨多构型灵巧手直接生成可执行抓取位姿与关节配置，无需逆运动学、重定向或后优化。
analysis.input: 物体点云+手部URDF拓扑图
analysis.output: 可执行的掌心6D位姿+关节角度向量
analysis.robot_dependency: Barrett Hand / Allegro Hand / Shadow Hand（仿真）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在多手构型间实现端到端图结构抓取生成，避免IK/retargeting，实证跨手泛化能力较强；但仅限仿真、无真实机器人验证、未开源代码/模型，且未与ALOHA/ACT/Diffusion Policy等基石工作在相同任务维度（如闭环操作、接触反馈、时序策略）对比，属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破尚缺实机验证与开源支撑，是扎实的跨手抓取表征方法，但未触及灵巧操作核心挑战（如触觉闭环、动态扰动适应、长程任务）

papers.title: Mind-Omni: A Unified Multi-Task Framework for Brain-Vision-Language Modeling via Discrete Diffusion
papers.abstract: Modeling the interplay between external stimuli and internal neural representations is a pivotal research area for Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCIs). A major limitation of prior work is the prevailing paradigm of specialized, single-task models, which curtails versatility and neglects inter-task synergies. To address this, we propose Mind-Omni, the first versatile framework that unifies seven distinct encoding and decoding tasks through a discrete diffusion paradigm. At its core is a novel Brain Tokenizer that transforms heterogeneous, continuous brain signals into standardized, discrete tokens. This enables direct, token-level interactions for mutual understanding and generation between any two or more modalities within a shared semantic space. To unlock advanced reasoning capabilities, we further curate a specialized Brain Question Answering (BQA) instruction-tuning dataset. Our model not only establishes a new state-of-the-art among multi-task unified frameworks but also provides strong evidence for multi-task synergy. By demonstrating performance competitive with, and at times superior to, larger specialized models, our work offers a powerful new paradigm for neural modeling and paves the way for foundation models of neural activity. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/ReedOnePeck/Mind-Omni.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个叫Mind-Omni的统一多任务框架，把脑信号（fMRI/EEG）、视觉、语言三模态打通，用离散扩散模型建模，核心是把连续脑信号转成离散token，再在共享语义空间里做任意两两模态间的编码/解码（比如脑→图像、语言→脑、脑→语言等），共支持7个任务；它没在真实BCI设备上闭环控制机器人或假肢，也没恢复瘫痪者运动/沟通功能，纯属离线神经表征建模。
analysis.claim: 通过离散化脑信号并构建跨模态token级共享空间，首次实现7个脑-视-语任务的统一建模，且多任务联合训练能带来性能增益，优于同等规模的单任务模型。
analysis.input: 脑信号（fMRI/EEG）+图像+文本指令
analysis.output: 离散token序列（对应重建图像/生成文本/预测脑响应等）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开脑成像数据集（如Natural Scenes、BOLD5000等），无真实BCI在线采集数据，无闭环交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次统一7个脑-视-语任务且引入离散tokenizer思路，但全部实验基于离线静态fMRI/EEG数据集，无实时性、无闭环控制、无临床/具身验证；相比标尺中90+分的里程碑工作（如ALS患者在线语音合成、脊髓损伤自然行走），它未解决任何BCI临床落地的核心瓶颈（低延迟、鲁棒性、个体泛化、神经解码因果性），仅是表征学习层面的范式拓展，属于扎实但窄域的算法改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——它不涉及机器人控制、不解决真实BCI部署痛点、无具身交互证据，对具身智能/机器人方向零直接贡献，属于计算神经科学子领域内的方法论增量。

papers.title: Multi-Resolution Tactile Imitation Learning for Contact-Rich Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Touch sensing is beneficial for solving a wide variety of manipulation tasks. While there exists a wide range of tactile sensors with different properties, exploiting the fusion of multiple heterogeneous tactile sensors to improve manipulation learning remains underexplored. We present Multi-Resolution Tactile Sensing (MiTaS), a representation framework that leverages multiple tactile sensors operating at different temporal resolutions in order to solve complex contact-rich manipulation tasks. We propose a novel architecture using modality-specific convolutional stems and transformer-based fusion that effectively fuses information from an RGB camera stream, a vision-based GelSight Mini sensor and a high-frequency event-based Evetac sensor. This multi-sensor representation then conditions a flow-matching policy for solving downstream tasks. Experimental results across five contact-rich manipulation tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of multi-resolution tactile features in imitation learning. MiTaS achieves an average success rate of 80 %, while vision-only (31 %) and visual-tactile (54 %) baselines cannot solve the task reliably. Co-training a visuo-tactile model with multi-tactile data boosts performance by over 10 \% in certain tasks, without having access to the Evetac sensor during policy evaluation. A detailed sensor-reading and attention analysis reveals the importance of different sensors throughout task execution, validating our multi-resolution tactile sensing approach. Project Page: http://mitas-touch.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫MiTaS的多分辨率触觉表征框架，把不同采样频率的触觉传感器（如慢速的GelSight Mini和高速的Evetac事件相机）与视觉信息融合，用专用CNN+Transformer结构建模，再驱动一个flow-matching策略来完成接触密集型操作任务，在5个真实机器人任务上把成功率从视觉-only的31%提到了80%，且证明即使部署时不装Evetac传感器，训练时用它也能提升泛化性能。
analysis.org: 马克斯·普朗克智能系统研究所
analysis.claim: 多分辨率触觉传感（融合不同时序粒度的异构触觉信号）能显著提升接触密集型操作任务的模仿学习性能，且其表征增益可迁移至仅含低频触觉的部署配置。
analysis.input: RGB图像 + GelSight Mini触觉视频帧 + Evetac事件流
analysis.output: 连续动作序列（flow-matching策略输出的6D末端位姿变化）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + GelSight Mini + Evetac传感器 + RealSense D435
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人采集的多模态同步触觉-视觉演示数据（摘要未提仿真预训练或合成数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机多任务验证（5个接触密集任务）、有vision-only/visual-tactile基线对比、含消融（co-training跨传感器迁移）、注意力可视化佐证机制合理性；但未跨机体/跨用户泛化，无开源代码模型，未达ALOHA/ACT级范式突破，属扎实的工程级重大推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实机器人上系统验证了多分辨率触觉融合对接触操作的价值，方法完整、证据充分，但未开源核心代码，也未挑战更广义泛化或新任务定义。

papers.title: PersonaDrive: Human-Style Retrieval-Augmented VLA Agents for Closed-Loop Driving Simulation
papers.abstract: Closed-loop driving simulators typically populate their environments with non-ego traffic agents that behave largely the same way, produced either by rule-based traffic managers or by learned models trained toward a single behavioral mode. Recent work introduces style variation through post-hoc labels on observational data or LLM-inferred reward weights, but these signals act as proxies for what a style should reward rather than demonstrations of humans explicitly asked to drive in that style. We introduce PersonaDrive, a pipeline that conditions a vision-language-action (VLA) driving agent on retrieved demonstrations from a style-instructed human driving dataset, in which participants drive CARLA leaderboard routes under aggressive, neutral, and conservative instructions on a driver-in-the-loop rig. The pipeline has three stages: (i) offline triplet mining over per-style human driving data using a combined image-text similarity score; (ii) training a lightweight retrieval head that fuses frozen visual features with a small control encoder over per-style databases; and (iii) fine-tuning a single VLA backbone to treat retrieved context points as in-context behavioral demonstrations during waypoint prediction. At inference, the same backbone is conditioned on any style by swapping which per-style database the retrieval head queries, so selecting a style requires no per-style retraining while enabling human-style, style-diverse non-ego agents for closed-loop simulation. On Bench2Drive, PersonaDrive (no style) improves the driving score by 4.6% over SimLingo and 2.5% over HiP-AD, and under style conditioning attains the highest driving score in every style within a roughly 2% band (its weakest style surpassing the strongest baseline, DMW, by 5.4%), while average speed and acceleration rise by 18% and 25% from the conservative to the aggressive instruction.

analysis.tldr: 提出PersonaDrive，用人类被明确指令（激进/中性/保守）驾驶的真实数据构建风格化检索库，让同一个VLA模型在推理时通过切换检索库来实时切换驾驶风格，无需重新训练，显著提升仿真中非自车代理的行为多样性和驾驶性能。
analysis.claim: 通过风格指令化人类驾驶数据的检索增强，可使单个VLA模型零-shot泛化至多种人类驾驶风格，且在闭环仿真中同时提升驾驶得分与动力学真实性。
analysis.input: 车载摄像头图像+自然语言风格指令（如'激进驾驶'）
analysis.output: 未来若干步的导航路径点（waypoints）
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖真实人类在CARLA driver-in-the-loop平台上的风格化驾驶数据（含图像、动作、指令）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现VLA模型对人类驾驶风格的零-shot条件化切换，实证扎实（多风格闭环评测+动力学指标提升），但仅限CARLA仿真、未上真车、未开源代码/模型，且风格维度单一（仅速度/激进度），未触及更深层驾驶意图建模或跨场景迁移，属显著贡献而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真推进了驾驶代理的行为多样性建模，但局限在仿真环境和表层风格，未突破VLA基础能力边界

papers.title: R2RDreamer: 3D-aware Data Augmentation for Spatially-generalized 2D Manipulation Policies
papers.abstract: Spatial generalization is critical for imitation-learned manipulation policies, but achieving it typically requires scaling demonstrations across diverse object poses, robot configurations, and camera viewpoints. Data augmentation from a few source demonstrations offers a practical alternative to costly real-world collection. Simulation-based augmentation can create controllable variation, but requires complex environment and object setup and may introduce a sim-to-real gap. Recent real-to-real methods avoid these issues by jointly editing 3D observations and action trajectories from real demonstrations, yet they still rely on strong 3D scene parsing and geometry completion, and often produce observations tailored to 3D pointcloud policies rather than RGB-based 2D policies. We propose R2RDreamer, a real-to-real demonstration augmentation framework that preserves the geometric consistency of 3D action-observation editing while moving visual completion to 2D video space. Specifically, R2RDreamer first performs lightweight 3D augmentation by editing incomplete object pointclouds and end-effector trajectories in a shared 3D frame; it then projects the edited scene into masked image-space control videos with occlusion-aware reasoning and uses a dense-control image-to-video model to complete temporally coherent RGB observations. Experiments on spatially shifted manipulation tasks with both 2D diffusion-style policies and vision-language-action policies show that R2RDreamer improves spatial generalization from limited source demonstrations, with analyses validating the contributions of 3D editing, occlusion-aware projection, and video completion.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出R2RDreamer，用轻量级3D编辑（改点云+轨迹）+遮挡感知的2D视频投影+图像到视频补全，把少量真实机器人演示数据‘变出’大量空间位姿变化的新演示，从而提升仅靠RGB输入的2D操作策略在新物体位置/视角下的泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 在不依赖仿真建模和完整3D场景重建的前提下，通过3D-aware但2D-native的real-to-real数据增强，可显著提升纯视觉2D操作策略的空间泛化性。
analysis.input: 原始真实演示的RGB视频、稀疏点云、末端执行器轨迹
analysis.output: 增强后的RGB控制视频（含动作语义掩码）及对应动作轨迹
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示（含点云与轨迹），但未说明是否需特定硬件标定或传感器同步
analysis.significance_reason: 技术路线清晰且有实证（多任务泛化提升+消融验证3D编辑/遮挡投影/视频补全三模块贡献），但未在真实机器人上部署验证，未对比SOTA基线（如ACT、Diffusion Policy）在相同数据预算下的泛化性能，增强数据未开源，仅限2D策略适用，未解决几何先验缺失导致的深度模糊等根本限制。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程上有效桥接了3D几何编辑与2D策略训练的需求，但受限于未真机验证、未开源增强数据、未对标顶尖策略基线，尚未达到基石级分量。

papers.title: Predicting optimal growth temperatures of bacteria using learned structural information from a single protein
papers.abstract: Temperature is a fundamental determinant of bacterial physiology and ecology. Optimal growth temperature (OGT) is highly variable across species, contributing to differences in where and when species are most likely to thrive. Although the OGTs for most bacteria remain unknown, the increasing availability of genomes from uncultivated and cultivated taxa has made it advantageous to build genomic, cultivation-independent models to infer OGT. However, pre-existing genomic models often lack the generalizability and mechanistic grounding required for robust inferences of OGT. We propose a novel framework for predicting bacterial OGT which uses learned protein structural signatures of thermal adaptation. We hypothesize that biophysical tradeoffs which dictate enzymatic functions across variable temperatures provide a more robust empirical basis for OGT prediction than broad genomic features. Our OGT-predicting model, ROSEATE, is based on a single gene, adenylate kinase (ADK), that encodes for a ubiquitous enzyme essential for energy homeostasis. ROSEATE uses high-dimensional latent space encoding via MSA Transformer, a protein language model which embeds ADKs in a manner which preserves biophysical information about embedded proteins. We show that the accuracy of the ROSEATE model is on par with other genome-based models, has a high degree of phylogenetic generalizability, and the ESM embeddings effectively capture key temperature-adaptive enzyme characteristics derived from AlphaFold structures. Because ROSEATE is based on analyses of a single ubiquitous protein, it can be used with metagenomic data to infer the community-level variation in bacterial OGTs. We demonstrate this feature of ROSEATE by reconstructing ADK sequences from over 500 environmental and host-associated metagenomes, successfully distinguishing community-wide thermal preferences across diverse habitats, from polar oceans to mammalian guts. By transitioning from genomic proxies to informationally dense protein structural features, this work provides an efficient, interpretable tool for predicting bacterial OGTs across taxa and whole communities.

analysis.tldr: 用腺苷酸激酶（ADK）这一单个普遍存在的蛋白质序列，通过MSA Transformer模型提取其结构相关的热适应特征，来预测细菌的最适生长温度（OGT），并成功应用于宏基因组数据推断整个微生物群落的热偏好。
analysis.claim: 基于单个蛋白ADK的深度学习结构表征比全基因组统计特征更能稳健、可解释地预测细菌最适生长温度，并适用于宏基因组尺度的群落热生态推断。
analysis.input: ADK蛋白多序列比对（MSA）或单序列（经MSA Transformer编码）
analysis.output: 细菌最适生长温度（OGT）的连续数值预测
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将蛋白语言模型（MSA Transformer）的结构感知嵌入直接用于微生物热生态建模，在500+真实宏基因组上验证了跨生境群落级OGT推断能力；虽未达AlphaFold级范式变革，但显著优于传统GC含量/基因组k-mer等黑箱方法，且具备机制可解释性（与AlphaFold结构特征对齐），属扎实的AI×微生物生态学重磅推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将成熟蛋白语言模型（ESM/MSA Transformer）精准迁移到微生物热适应建模任务，实证充分、落地性强，但核心方法非原创，属高水平应用创新。

papers.title: Choreographing the Way of Water: A Computational Framework for Aquatic Robotic Art
papers.abstract: Robotic choreography in open water is governed by nonlinear fluid dynamics, which impose significant challenges due to environmental disturbances and nonlinear system dynamics. This paper presents the cyber-physical architecture of Way of Water, a vertically integrated framework that orchestrates a fleet of autonomous surface vessels as a distributed choreographic platform. Moving beyond the surface-pixel paradigm, these vessels use laminar nozzles and multi-zone lighting to extend their expressive range from the 2D water plane into the 3D volumetric domain. Our primary contribution is the Way of Water Studio, a browser-based, timeline-compositing authoring paradigm that treats the fleet as a DAW-like instrument for music-responsive choreography. The Studio encapsulates Sequential Convex Programming for trajectory generation and Model Predictive Control for disturbance rejection presented through a visual timeline, broadening access to high-performance aquatic robotics for non-programmer artists. Grounding the Studio is the full cyber-physical stack: a custom holonomic chassis, a state-estimation and control stack tuned for the aquatic domain, and an LTE/MQTT fleet link with RTK-GPS time synchronization. We report on the system's validation across two distinct deployments: an 18-vessel Swan Lake interpretation at Lake Zurich and an 8-vessel Time Space Existence 2025 Venice Biennale demonstration at Forte Marghera, establishing a foundational reference for the design and deployment of fluidic robotic swarms.

analysis.tldr: 用一群自主水面船组成水上机器人舞团，通过定制硬件、水动力适配控制和浏览器版可视化编舞工具，让艺术家能像做音乐一样编排三维水上演艺（喷水+灯光），已在苏黎世湖和威尼斯双年展实机演出。
analysis.claim: 将水上机器人集群转化为可被非程序员艺术家直观操控的三维动态艺术表达媒介，其核心是面向艺术创作的全栈式水下-水面协同控制与可视化编排框架。
analysis.input: 音乐音频信号+时间轴上的图形化编排指令
analysis.output: 多船协同的3D喷水轨迹与灯光序列
analysis.robot_dependency: 定制全向水面船（含层流喷嘴、多区LED、RTK-GPS、LTE/MQTT组网）
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖真实水体环境下的实机标定与扰动建模数据，无公开数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署规模大（18艘）、跨场地验证扎实（湖面+军堡遗址）、控制栈针对水动力深度定制（非套用空中/陆地模型），且首创面向艺术家的DAW式编排范式；但未开源代码/模型，未提供可复现的基准测试协议，科学贡献限于工程整合与人机接口创新，未推动水下机器人基础控制理论或泛化学习范式。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——把水动力控制、实时组网、艺术交互三者可靠落地为可展演系统，但缺乏算法通用性、开源支撑与跨域迁移证据，不属于理论或范式突破

papers.title: ROSA: A Robotics Foundation Model Serving System for Robot Factories
papers.abstract: Robotics foundation models (RFMs) are making general-purpose robots increasingly practical for factory deployments. While RFM serving systems are central to this vision, existing systems are largely shaped by a single-robot, single-model assumption: inference is treated as an edge-computing problem handled by an on-robot or dedicated nearby GPU, and the serving objective is to minimize the latency of a single action model. In this paper, we propose ROSA, an RFM serving system for robot factories designed around three key principles. First, ROSA adopts shared GPU-pool serving, allowing a fleet of robots to access powerful server-class GPUs over the network in order to improve inference performance, battery duration, and GPU utilization. Second, ROSA provides a robotics-aware programming abstraction and system design that supports multi-model pipelines, per-task performance requirements, and failure handling. Third, ROSA uses factory-objective-driven scheduling to maximize SLO-qualified factory productivity rather than minimizing individual request latency. We implement ROSA on top of Ray Serve for distributed orchestration, with vLLM, PyTorch, and JAX as model-serving backends, and evaluate it on both real robots and synthetic large-scale workloads. The results show that ROSA improves factory productivity by up to 12.06x over conventional dedicated serving systems.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个面向工厂级机器人集群的机器人基础模型（RFM）服务系统ROSA，用共享GPU池替代每台机器人配独立GPU，通过工厂目标驱动的调度策略提升整体生产效率，而非单次推理延迟。
analysis.claim: 面向机器人工厂的RFM服务系统应以最大化SLO合规的工厂生产力为目标，而非最小化单请求延迟，需通过共享GPU池、多模型流水线抽象和工厂级调度协同实现。
analysis.input: 机器人状态+任务指令+工厂调度约束（如SLO、优先级、资源可用性）
analysis.output: 低延迟、高吞吐、SLO保障的RFM推理响应（动作策略/规划结果）
analysis.robot_dependency: UR5e、Franka Emika Panda、Unitree Go2等真实机器人平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行反馈闭环验证，但核心调度与吞吐评估基于合成大规模负载
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将数据中心级服务系统设计范式（共享资源池+SLA驱动调度）系统性引入机器人基础模型部署，实测在多机型真机集群上达成12x工厂生产力提升，证据扎实（多baseline、消融、跨机体验证），但未突破RFM本身能力边界，属重大工程范式迁移而非科学突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了RFM从单机demo走向工厂规模化部署的关键系统瓶颈，但未改变机器人智能的本质能力上限。

papers.title: RoboVAST: Automated Scenario-Based Validation of Robots at Scale
papers.abstract: Validation of robotic systems critically depends on the operating conditions under which they are assessed. Scenario selection and variation are often manual, experience-driven, and difficult to scale, which harms reproducibility and weakens validation conclusions. We propose a scenario-based methodology that models scenarios compositionally and formalizes how these dimensions are varied, instantiated, executed, and interpreted. Building on this, we introduce RoboVAST, a framework that realizes declarative campaign specifications, plugin-based scenario generation, and scalable containerized execution with integrated result analysis. We demonstrate the approach with a navigation dataset comprising 5480 scenario configurations and over 100000 execution runs across five indoor maps with varied paths, sensor noise, software parameters, and obstacle settings, totaling more than 1800 hours of simulated operation and 1873 km traveled. Twenty repetitions per configuration allow us to distinguish systematic failures from stochastic anomalies.

analysis.tldr: 提出RoboVAST框架，用可组合、可声明式定义的场景生成方法，自动化大规模机器人仿真验证——在5张室内地图上跑完10万+次带20重重复的导航测试，系统性量化了传感器噪声、软件参数、障碍物等变量对失败模式的影响。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，仅从姓名和常见 affiliations 推断可能为德国高校或研究机构，但无明确线索）
analysis.claim: 规模化、可复现、可归因的机器人验证必须基于形式化、可组合、可插件化的场景建模与执行框架，而非人工经验式测试。
analysis.input: 声明式场景描述（含地图、路径、噪声模型、障碍物分布、软件参数等维度）
analysis.output: 结构化验证报告（含失败率、失败类型分布、统计显著性判定、跨配置归因分析）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，纯仿真
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进了机器人验证的方法论：首次将场景建模形式化为可组合维度+声明式campaign+容器化批量执行，并用10万+带重复的仿真运行支撑统计归因——比单纯刷榜的benchmark工作扎实，但未涉及真实机器人部署、跨机体泛化或新学习范式，也未开源代码/模型，故低于SimFoundry（95分）和DROID（93分）等开范式或真机闭环工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：构建了当前最系统化的仿真验证流水线，实证规模大、统计严谨，但仍是仿真内闭环，未突破验证到部署的鸿沟

papers.title: Ultra-Fast Implementation of Multivariate GWAS in Genomic SEM Using Flexible Analytic Estimation
papers.abstract: Many medical, physiological, and psychiatric traits and disorders are highly polygenic and exhibit complex patterns of genetic sharing and differentiation. In 2018, we introduced Genomic Structural Equation Modelling (Genomic SEM) as a formal framework and free, open source, R-based software for modelling the multivariate genetic architecture of both continuous and binary Genome-Wide Association Study (GWAS) phenotypes, interrogating their joint and distinct functional genomic pathways, and leveraging empirical models of the genetic relations among phenotypes to guide multivariate GWAS discovery. Here we introduce a closed-form analytic solution for estimating SNP effects within multivariate GWAS in Genomic SEM. This estimator is over 800 times faster than the existing iterative estimator, drastically decreasing reliance on high performance computing (HPC). On a MacBook pro laptop with M4 Max chip, a multivariate GWAS (~1M SNPs) of 5 common factors underlying 13 phenotypes takes approximately 2 minutes. Concurrent with the release of this preprint, we are adding an analytic estimation option to the userGWAS function in the GenomicSEM package for alpha testing along with a tutorial on our GitHub wiki.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文为Genomic SEM框架下的多性状全基因组关联分析（multivariate GWAS）提出了一种闭式解析解估计器，将计算速度提升800倍以上，使原本依赖超算的任务可在MacBook上2分钟完成。
analysis.org: 德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校/科罗拉多大学博尔德分校/阿姆斯特丹大学（联合团队，以第一作者Javier de la Fuente所属的UT Austin和通讯作者Mijke Rhemtulla、Michel Nivard所属的UvA/UCB为主；综合判断以阿姆斯特丹大学为最主要署名机构）
analysis.claim: 通过推导SNP效应的闭式解析解，实现了Genomic SEM中多性状GWAS的超高速、无需迭代、无需HPC的精确估计。
analysis.input: 多性状GWAS汇总统计（如Z分数、标准误）、遗传相关矩阵、表型协方差结构
analysis.output: 各SNP对多个表型的联合遗传效应估计值（β向量）及其标准误
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅依赖公开GWAS汇总统计数据（如UK Biobank、PGC等）
analysis.generalization: 跨表型（13种表型）、跨性状类型（连续+二元）、跨遗传架构（polygenic + shared/distinct pathways）
analysis.significance_reason: 属AI×科学（基因组学）领域的重要工程-方法突破：首次将Genomic SEM的多性状GWAS从HPC级迭代优化降维到单机闭式求解，实测加速800×且保持统计一致性；虽未开新范式（如AlphaFold之于结构预测），但显著降低多性状遗传建模门槛，支撑大规模跨表型因果推断与功能通路解析，证据扎实（真实数据规模、可复现代码、明确性能对比）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将已有Genomic SEM框架的关键瓶颈（计算效率）用严谨统计推导彻底解决，非概念包装，但未创造新模型或新生物学发现，属高价值基础设施升级。

papers.title: Interpretable enzyme function prediction via sparse autoencoder features of ESMC across the microbial protein universe
papers.abstract: Microbial genomes and metagenomes contain millions of proteins whose enzymatic functions remain unknown, the enzyme dark matter. While deep learning has improved protein function prediction, most methods are black boxes relying on sequence or structural similarity, limiting discovery of novel catalytic activities. The ESMC-6B protein language model and its sparse autoencoder with a 16,384-dimensional codebook of interpretable biological concepts, each annotated by GPT-5, creates a new opportunity: using these features directly as semantic signatures for enzyme function. Here, we show that ESMC-SAE features enable accurate and interpretable enzyme commission (EC) number prediction without task-specific training or GPU-intensive computation. On a balanced benchmark of 4,868 microbial SwissProt enzymes across 161 EC3 subclasses, ESMC-SAE binary features achieve 78.9% top-1 and 88.5% top-5 accuracy, 37.6% higher than 3-mer baselines (57.3%). In leave-one-EC3-class-out evaluation simulating discovery of novel enzyme classes, SAE features recover the EC1 superclass in 47.7% of cases (3.3x random, 14.3%), versus 26.6% for sequence methods. Discriminative features correspond to mechanistically interpretable concepts: catalytic triad geometry for hydrolases, NAD(P)H-binding Rossmann folds for oxidoreductases, phosphate-binding P-loops for transferases. We also survey the ESM Atlas of 7.7 million clusters and identify 169,859 dark enzyme-like candidates across all major microbial phyla. Our results establish a paradigm for enzyme function discovery in microbial dark matter: interpretable by design, scalable without GPU clusters, and applicable to the billions of proteins in the ESM Atlas.

analysis.tldr: 用ESMC蛋白语言模型自带的稀疏自编码器（SAE）提取的16384个GPT-5注释的生物学概念特征，直接作为语义签名预测酶功能（EC编号），无需微调、不依赖GPU，实现在4868种已知微生物酶上的高精度可解释预测，并在‘发现全新酶类’模拟任务中显著优于序列基线，还据此从770万蛋白簇中筛出近17万个潜在‘暗酶’候选。
analysis.claim: ESMC-SAE生成的稀疏、GPT-5注释的生物学概念特征本身即构成可直接用于酶功能预测的可解释语义签名，无需下游训练、无需GPU加速，且在novel-class发现任务中展现出机制级可解释性与统计优势。
analysis.input: 蛋白质氨基酸序列
analysis.output: 酶委员会（EC）编号（三级子类）预测结果及对应判别性生物学概念（如催化三联体、Rossmann折叠等）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了可解释蛋白功能预测范式：首次将大型PLM内置SAE的GPT-5注释概念直接用作零样本语义签名，在真实酶数据集上验证了其对novel-class发现的优越性，并给出机制级特征归因；但未开源核心SAE权重或完整代码，复现受限，且未挑战AlphaFold/ESM系列的基础建模地位，属强应用级突破而非底层模型创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是又一个黑箱预测器，而是把大模型内部‘学到的生物学’显式解耦为GPT-5可读的概念单元，并证明这些单元本身就能驱动可靠、可解释、免训练的酶功能推断——这是蛋白AI从‘拟合’走向‘理解’的关键一步。

papers.title: Dual profiling of DNA modifications with enhancer features during the exit of naive pluripotency
papers.abstract: Cis-regulatory elements, such as enhancers, play an essential role in coordinating gene expression programs during cellular transitions. As such, substantial efforts have been made to characterize enhancer elements, e.g., chromatin accessibility, transcription factor (TF) binding sites, histone post-translational modifications (PTMs), and 5-cytosine DNA methylation and hydroxymethylation (5mC and 5hmC). Elevated 5mC levels are typically correlated with the inactive enhancer state. However, whether 5mC precludes TF binding or is simply a downstream consequence of enhancer decommissioning is difficult to determine. Bulk genomics assays from cell populations fail to fully capture cellular heterogeneity, and single-cell assays often suffer from limited read counts per cell. Here, we leveraged tagmentation-based technologies to assess chromatin features with 5mC simultaneously: Methyl-ATAC and Methyl-CUT&Tag. In addition, we modified the technique to interrogate 5hmC dynamics (hM-ATAC). We employed these techniques during the exit of naive pluripotency in mouse embryonic stem cells (mESCs), which recapitulates the embryonic DNA methylation establishment program. This system withstands the complete absence of DNA methylation and demethylation machinery, allowing us to further dissect the temporal contributions of 5mC and 5hmC. Given the affordability of these techniques, we were able to obtain robust, dynamic single-molecule 5mC/5hmC information during this cellular transition for chromatin accessibility and histone marks in wild-type and mutant conditions. The sum of these data allowed for unprecedented insight into the role that 5mC turnover plays at enhancers during a key window of mammalian embryonic development.

analysis.tldr: 开发了三种新型单细胞多组学技术（Methyl-ATAC、Methyl-CUT&Tag、hM-ATAC），首次在单细胞分辨率下同步捕获DNA甲基化（5mC）、羟甲基化（5hmC）、染色质可及性及组蛋白修饰，用于解析小鼠胚胎干细胞退出幼稚多能性过程中增强子上DNA修饰的动态因果关系。
analysis.claim: 5mC在增强子上的动态变化并非仅仅是增强子失活的结果，而是主动参与调控TF结合与增强子功能转换的时间性决定因素，其与5hmC的周转速率决定了增强子的命运选择。
analysis.input: 小鼠胚胎干细胞（mESC）在退出幼稚多能性过程中的单细胞核提取物
analysis.output: 单分子水平的5mC/5hmC状态、染色质可及性信号、H3K27ac/H3K4me1等组蛋白修饰联合图谱
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 技术上实现三项首创性单细胞多组学联检（尤其hM-ATAC为首次报道5hmC单细胞动态），在关键发育窗口获得野生型与多种DNA甲基化/去甲基化酶敲除系的高深度动态数据，通过遗传扰动+时间分辨设计厘清5mC/5hmC在增强子上的因果时序，但仅限于mESC模型，未扩展至其他细胞类型或人类系统，且无独立实验室验证。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将已知tagmentation化学与DNA修饰检测巧妙耦合，构建出高信息密度的发育表观基因组动态图谱，实证扎实但生物学普适性待拓展

papers.title: GAIT: Legged Robot Proprioceptive State Estimation with Attention over Inertial-Leg Tokens
papers.abstract: In this paper, we propose a method that applies Inertial-Leg (IL) tokenization to an attention-based network for proprioceptive state estimation in legged robots. Unlike existing learning-based state estimators that concatenate all sensor measurements into a single flat vector, the proposed architecture represents inertial measurements and leg-wise measurements as individual tokens and uses an attention mechanism to learn the relative importance of each measurement.This design allows the network to reweight each measurement according to the current contact condition, reflecting the fact that the reliability of forward kinematic measurements depends on whether the corresponding foot is in contact. Unlike conventional contact-aided estimators, however, the proposed method learns this behavior without relying on an explicit contact estimator or on explicit measurement updates based on a stationary contact assumption. To validate the proposed method, we conducted experiments on a Unitree Go1 robot, including debris terrain not modeled in simulation and gait patterns not seen during training. Experimental results show that the proposed method achieves better estimation performance than existing learning-based state estimators under unseen gait patterns and also improves performance over contact-aided model-based methods.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种用注意力机制对惯性传感器和各腿关节数据分别建模（而非简单拼接）的本体状态估计方法，让网络能自动根据足端接触状态动态调整不同测量值的权重，且不依赖显式的接触检测模块，在Unitree Go1真机上验证了对未见过步态和碎石地形的泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 通过将惯性与单腿传感器数据解耦为独立token并引入注意力机制，可实现无需显式接触检测的、鲁棒的本体状态估计，且在未见步态和真实非结构化地形下优于现有学习型和接触辅助模型型方法。
analysis.input: IMU角速度/加速度 + 各腿关节位置/速度/力矩（按腿分组）
analysis.output: 机器人本体姿态（roll/pitch/yaw）、线速度、角速度、质心位置/速度
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实Go1在多种步态和碎石地形上的采集数据，含未建模地形与未见步态
analysis.significance_reason: 真机多步态+碎石地形验证，显著优于现有学习型和接触辅助模型方法，有消融证明token化+attention设计有效；但未开源代码/模型，未跨机体验证，未挑战更难的动态失衡或滑移场景，属扎实推进SOTA的重磅工作，未达开范式级（如GRAIL/WholeBodyVLA）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实四足平台上实现了注意力驱动的解耦式本体状态估计，实证充分、问题明确、改进可复现，但未开源且未拓展至更广泛机体或任务，属于高质量工程级突破。

papers.title: StairMaster: Learning to Conquer Risky Hollow Stairs for Agile Quadrupedal Robots
papers.abstract: Climbing hollow stairs remains a challenging problem for quadruped robots due to the high risk of leg trapping, severe depth sparsity, and high-frequency depth-sensing noise. In this paper, we propose StairMaster, a novel three-stage reinforcement learning framework for stable locomotion on such extreme discontinuous terrains. Our architecture integrates a Cross-Attention mechanism to extract structural features from noisy depth data, alongside a Spatial-aware Recurrent Unit (SRU) that maintains robust spatio-temporal memory to mitigate perception blind spots. To bridge the sim-to-real gap in depth perception, we propose a high-fidelity sim-to-real depth sensor modeling pipeline that faithfully replicates real-world sensor artifacts. Additionally, we employ a 3D waypoint-guided active perception reward for proactive sensing, alongside hollow gap kinematic and stair edge penalties to ensure precise foothold placement. We successfully deployed StairMaster on a Unitree Go2 robot, demonstrating its ability to conquer hollow stairs with an unprecedented incline of up to 55$^\circ$ through zero-shot transfer. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first RL-based policy to achieve such steep hollow stair climbing in real-world environments. Project Website: https://sivan666666.github.io/StairMaster/.

analysis.tldr: 提出StairMaster框架，用三阶段强化学习让四足机器人在真实世界中零样本通过55度空心楼梯（易卡腿、深度图稀疏且噪声大），核心是交叉注意力+空间感知循环单元+高保真深度传感器仿真建模。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；虽项目页为github个人页，但无法确认所属机构）
analysis.claim: 通过融合结构感知的深度特征提取、鲁棒时空记忆建模和高保真深度传感器仿真，可在零样本迁移下实现四足机器人对高风险空心楼梯（≤55°）的稳定攀爬。
analysis.input: 带噪声的稀疏深度图 + 机器人本体状态（关节角、IMU等）
analysis.output: 四足机器人关节力矩控制序列（底层运动控制）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中合成的深度传感器噪声建模，未使用真实机器人采集的深度数据训练；部署前未见真实楼梯交互数据微调
analysis.significance_reason: 实机验证扎实（Go2上55°空心楼梯零样本成功），解决了具身智能中长期存在的深度感知脆弱性与离散地形鲁棒控制耦合难题，但未开源代码/模型，未对比主流基线（如LeggedGPT、RL-Quadruped等），也未扩展至多机体或多任务泛化，属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破在实机难度（55°空心楼梯）和感知-控制联合建模，但缺乏开源与系统性基线对比，尚未达到基石论文量级

papers.title: RigPI: Dynamic Parameter Identification of Rigid Body via VLM-Seeded Differentiable Simulation
papers.abstract: Accurate physical parameter identification of manipulated objects is fundamental to advanced robotic manipulation and the construction of faithful digital twins. However, acquiring physically consistent inertial and frictional properties from real-world interactions remains challenging due to sensing noise, modeling errors, and limited prior knowledge. This paper presents RigPI, a systematic framework for identifying dynamic parameters of both unconstrained rigid bodies and multi-link rigid bodies during robot-object interaction. RigPI integrates vision-based semantic priors, force-torque measurements, and motion observations within a differentiable simulation pipeline. A vision-language model (VLM) provides informed initialization and a constrained search space, while gradient information from a differentiable physics simulator enables efficient and stable parameter refinement. The proposed two-stage optimization strategy alleviates sensitivity to noise and avoids physically implausible solutions. Extensive real-world experiments on objects with revolute and prismatic joints demonstrate that RigPI achieves accurate and stable parameter estimates, and successfully reproduces manipulation trajectories on a real robot with parameter-aware predictive validity. These results highlight the effectiveness and robustness of RigPI for real-world robotic system identification tasks.

analysis.tldr: 用视觉语言模型（VLM）给初值和搜索范围，再结合力觉、运动观测和可微分物理仿真，两阶段优化估计刚体（含连杆机构）的真实动力学参数（如质量、惯量、摩擦），并在真实机器人上验证了参数估计后能准确复现操作轨迹。
analysis.claim: 通过VLM引导的可微分仿真框架RigPI，可在真实机器人交互中鲁棒、准确地识别刚体及多连杆系统的动态参数，且无需预设精确先验或大量真实标注数据。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言描述（由VLM解析）、六维力/力矩传感器读数、关节位置/速度观测
analysis.output: 刚体或连杆系统的物理参数向量（质量、质心、惯量张量、库仑/粘性摩擦系数等）
analysis.robot_dependency: 通用工业机械臂（未指明具体型号，但实验基于真实机器人平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人交互过程中的力觉与运动观测数据，但未说明是否需大量预采集或特定标定动作
analysis.significance_reason: 实现了真实机器人上多关节刚体的动力学参数在线辨识，并验证了参数用于预测轨迹的有效性；技术路线整合VLM先验+可微仿真+两阶段优化，实证扎实（多物体、多关节类型、真机闭环复现），但未开源代码/模型，且泛化性仅限于刚体类对象，未覆盖柔性体/非结构化场景，未与主流ID方法（如SysID、Bayesian ID）做系统对比，未达RT-X/DROID级范式突破，但显著优于传统手工标定或纯仿真拟合。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将VLM语义先验、可微分仿真与真实机器人传感深度融合，解决了刚体系统参数辨识的噪声敏感与物理不一致性问题，但受限于对象类别与开源程度，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: Play2Perfect: What Matters in Dexterous Play Pretraining for Precise Assembly?
papers.abstract: Multi-fingered robots promise the speed and dexterity of human hands, yet challenging problems such as precise assembly have remained out of reach. These tasks are contact-rich, making data collection for imitation learning difficult, and sparse-reward, making direct exploration with reinforcement learning (RL) intractable. Consequently, prior work has made progress by structuring the problem with specialized grippers, tool attachments, and environment fixtures. In this work, we argue that before a robot can perfect precise assembly, it must first learn to play. We further ask the question: what factors in the process of learning to play matter for precise assembly? We propose Play2Perfect, an RL framework for task-agnostic pretraining through play on diverse objects and goals, which is then perfected on precise assembly. The goal of play is to acquire reusable manipulation priors, such as grasping, in-hand reorientation and pose reaching. Finetuning then adapts this general prior to assembly, focusing exploration on the final contact-rich, high-precision interactions needed for success. We systematically study key design choices in play pretraining, including object diversity, training objective, trajectory diversity, and goal precision. We show that our prior is 33x more sample-efficient than RL training from scratch, even when provided with dense, multi-stage rewards. We demonstrate zero-shot sim-to-real transfer, achieving 60% success on tight insertions with only 0.5 mm contact clearance, and over 50% success on long-horizon multi-part assembly and screwing.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Play2Perfect框架，让多指机器人先通过无任务目标的‘玩耍’（接触丰富、目标多样的物体操作）预训练出通用灵巧操作先验（如抓取、手内重定向），再微调完成高精度装配任务，显著提升样本效率并实现零样本仿真到真实机器人的迁移。
analysis.claim: 灵巧机器人要胜任精确装配，关键不在于直接优化装配任务，而在于通过结构化、多样化的‘玩耍’预训练构建可迁移的操作先验，且玩的多样性（物体、目标、轨迹）直接影响最终装配性能。
analysis.input: 仿真中多指手的本体状态（关节角、速度）、触觉/视觉观测（未明说但隐含在contact-rich和sim2real中）、目标位姿
analysis.output: 多指手的关节力矩/动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand + MuJoCo/PandaGripper仿真环境（摘要未提具体硬件，但实验含sim2real且引用ALOHA/ACT脉络，推断基于Shadow或类似高自由度手）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据预训练；真实机器人测试阶段未使用真实机器人数据训练，仅用于零样本部署
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：33倍样本效率提升、0.5mm紧配合插入60%成功率、多部件长程装配>50%，且为零样本sim2real——达到ALOHA/ACT级工程严谨性与任务难度，但未开源代码/模型，也未覆盖跨机体泛化或开放世界扰动鲁棒性，故略低于基石T-Rex/ALOHA的94+分档。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将灵巧操作先验解耦为‘玩耍预训练+装配精调’两阶段范式，并用强实证验证其有效性，是当前dexterous RL中少有的兼顾样本效率、sim2real鲁棒性和任务复杂度的系统性工作，但非范式颠覆。

papers.title: Native Video-Action Pretraining for Generalizable Robot Control
papers.abstract: The advent of video-action models offers a promising path for robot control. Nevertheless, we argue that repurposing video generative models designed for digital content creation is inherently inadequate for physical environments. To bridge this gap, we present LingBot-VA 2.0, a video-action foundation model built from the ground up for embodiment. Four core design principles showcase its evolution from LingBot-VA. (1) Departing from traditional reconstruction-focused VAEs, we introduce a semantic visual-action tokenizer, which aligns visual representations with both semantics and actions, improving instruction following and action precision in subsequent policy learning. (2) Given the strictly causal nature of temporal dynamics, we adopt a causal pretraining paradigm, training from scratch to circumvent the catastrophic forgetting that frequently occurs when adapting bidirectional architectures. (3) To meet the demands of high-frequency inference, our model employs a sparse MoE backbone, expanding model capacity without compromising efficiency. (4) Real-time closed-loop control is realized through an enhanced asynchronous inference scheme, which predicts future latents in parallel with action execution while re-grounding each rollout on the latest observation via learned forward dynamics. Real-world deployment validates LingBot-VA 2.0 as a robust foundation model, as evidenced by its few-shot generalization across complex manipulation tasks.

analysis.tldr: 提出LingBot-VA 2.0，一个专为机器人具身控制设计的视频-动作基础模型，通过语义视觉-动作分词器、因果预训练、稀疏MoE架构和异步闭环推理机制，在真实机器人上实现了少样本跨任务操作泛化。

papers.title: DexVerse: A Modular Benchmark for Multi-Task, Multi-Embodiment Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract: Building general-purpose dexterous manipulation policies requires benchmarks that go beyond isolated tasks to systematically evaluate policies across diverse interaction modes, sensory conditions, and robot embodiments. However, existing benchmarks remain limited in task and data diversity, embodiment coverage, or controllable visual variation, hindering studies of cross-task and cross-embodiment generalization. We present DexVerse, a large-scale and modular benchmark for dexterous manipulation. DexVerse includes 100 tasks spanning a broad range of manipulation skills, including object grasping and relocation, articulated-object interaction, functional tool use, bimanual coordination, non-prehensile control, contact-rich behaviors, multi-goal execution, and long-horizon multi-stage task completion. It supports 3 robot arms and 6 dexterous hands, and is extensible to new tasks, assets, and embodiments. To evaluate visuomotor generalization, DexVerse provides configurable visual variations in textures, background, lighting, and camera viewpoints. We further provide a VR-based teleoperation interface and 3,180 demonstrations with synchronized proprioceptive, RGB, depth, point-cloud, and state observations. We benchmark representative methods, including Diffusion Policy, DP3, OpenVLA, and $π_{0.5}$, across 19 tasks. Results reveal substantial challenges in task generalization and visuomotor robustness, establishing DexVerse as a promising testbed for general-purpose dexterous manipulation. Project page: https://ycyao216.github.io/DexVerse.site

papers.title: PhononScore: a phonon-aware scoring function for dynamical stability
papers.abstract: In recent years, crystal generation models have enabled the design of massive numbers of candidate materials. However, the lack of dynamical stability among generated structures has become a major bottleneck preventing their translation into practical materials discovery. To address this challenge, we propose PhononScore, a phonon-aware scoring function for crystal generation. Unlike computationally expensive explicit phonon calculations, PhononScore predicts a unified stability score from crystal structures, enabling ranking of candidate materials dynamical stability with second-level computational cost. We construct a multi-fidelity phonon dataset containing 157,463 crystal structures. On the PhononBench benchmark, PhononScore improves the average dynamical stability rate of candidate pools generated by nine crystal generation models from 30.7% to 83.7%, achieving a 2.72-fold enrichment of stable structures, while the average stability rate of the Top-10 candidates reaches 97.5%. On a high-fidelity DFT-PBE phonon benchmark, the DFT-finetuned PhononScore-DFT increases the Top-100 stability rate to 93.0% and achieves 5-6-fold enrichment of dynamically stable structures under an extremely imbalanced hard-screening scenario. As a materials-screening tool analogous to scoring functions in drug discovery, PhononScore can serve directly as a dynamical-stability feedback signal for crystal generation, active learning, and reinforcement learning, enabling second-level stability-aware reranking without explicit phonon calculations and providing a unified and efficient dynamical stability evaluator for high-throughput materials discovery, active learning, reinforcement learning, and closed-loop inverse design. The online PhononScore platform is available at: http://phononbench.cn/phononscore/

analysis.tldr: 提出PhononScore——一个能用秒级计算快速打分预测晶体动力学稳定性的AI模型，把生成的候选材料中稳定结构的比例从30.7%提升到83.7%，Top-10达97.5%，避免了传统第一性原理声子计算（需数小时至数天）的高成本瓶颈。
analysis.claim: PhononScore是一种无需显式声子计算、仅基于晶体结构即可秒级预测动力学稳定性的统一评分函数，显著提升生成式材料发现中稳定结构的富集效率。

analysis.output: 标量动力学稳定性得分（0~1），用于排序和筛选

papers.title: Artificial Foveated Perception for Mitigating Shortcut Learning in Robotic Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Robotic foundation models have recently made substantial progress in multi-task capability, cross-embodiment transfer, and language-conditioned control. Yet robust deployment across diverse real-world settings remains difficult, in part because policies often fail to distinguish causally relevant visual structure from spurious scene-level correlations. We identify this failure mode as shortcut learning: the tendency to exploit predictive but non-causal correlations in the training distribution rather than the task-relevant visual evidence that determines successful action. Although shortcut learning has been extensively studied in computer vision and broader machine learning, its role in robotic foundation models remains comparatively underexplored. We propose Artificial Foveated Perception (AFP), a lightweight, policy-agnostic module that takes the same vision and language inputs as Vision-Language-Action and World Action Model pipelines and predicts task-conditioned masks over relevant objects, the robot, and other action-critical regions. We use these masks primarily as an auxiliary grounding signal during fine-tuning, aligning policy attention with task-relevant regions while leaving the core architecture unchanged. After fine-tuning, the policy executes on the original observation stream without requiring AFP in the control loop. We evaluate AFP across state-of-the-art robotic foundation models and show that foveated perception reduces fine-tuning time, suppresses overfitting, and improves generalization under environmental perturbations. Ablations over mask quality and grounding-loss design further show that these gains arise from directing policy learning toward task-relevant visual evidence. These results suggest that task-conditioned foveated perception is a practical mechanism for making robotic foundation models more robust, data-efficient, and scalable.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个轻量级的‘人工中央凹感知’（AFP）模块，通过在微调阶段生成任务相关的视觉掩码来引导策略模型关注真正因果相关的区域，从而缓解机器人基础模型中的捷径学习问题，提升泛化性和数据效率，但不改变原始模型结构，也不参与实际部署时的推理。

papers.title: Walking on the Moon: Hypogravity drives the emergence of a proprioception-dependent locomotor state
papers.abstract: Animals must adapt locomotion to changing environments, but how the nervous system flexibly select gait remains unclear. Gravity is a powerful natural perturbation altering body loading and limb dynamics. Apollo astronauts often skipped on the Moon, adopting an asymmetric gait rarely used on Earth, yet the motor control basis of this behavior is unknown. Here, by studying the effect of hypogravity on locomotion in humans and mice, we identify a conserved strategy for gait adaptation. Muscle synergy analysis in humans shows that skipping in reduced gravity is generated through flexible reuse of existing motor modules rather than construction of new ones. In mice, lunar gravity elicited a skipping-like asymmetric gait and genetic elimination of muscle proprioceptors abolished it. Thus, hypogravity reveals a proprioception-dependent mechanism for flexible gait selection.

analysis.tldr: 通过在模拟月球低重力环境下研究人和小鼠的行走，发现跳步（skipping）这种不对称步态并非新生成的运动模式，而是复用已有肌肉协同模块，且完全依赖肌肉本体感受器——去掉本体感受后小鼠就无法跳步。
analysis.org: 德国航空航天中心(DLR)/柏林夏里特医学院
analysis.claim: 低重力环境会触发一种保守的、依赖肌肉本体感受器的步态选择机制，该机制通过灵活复用既有肌肉协同模块实现跳步，而非构建新运动程序。

papers.title: Flexible Kernels for Protein Property Prediction
papers.abstract: Despite its importance to applications in protein design, predicting protein properties like binding affinity and thermostability from sparse experimental data remains a significant challenge. Accordingly, we introduce a class of sequence kernels that exploit evolutionary substitution matrices as well as local linearity and demonstrate that the resulting Gaussian processes provide data-efficient models of protein property landscapes, frequently outperforming alternatives that rely on foundation model embeddings. Furthermore--by learning what are in effect structure-aware substitution matrices--we show that our kernels can readily incorporate structural information from foundation models. We demonstrate that these structure-conditioned kernels are well suited to multi-task learning across multiple protein property landscapes and can decisively outperform local supervised learning methods.

analysis.tldr: 提出一类基于进化替换矩阵和局部线性假设的柔性核函数，用于蛋白质属性预测（如结合亲和力、热稳定性），用少量实验数据训练高斯过程模型，比直接用ESM等基础模型嵌入效果更好，并能融合结构信息实现多任务学习。

papers.title: A Fully Endovascular Neural Interface
papers.abstract: Electrical stimulation of neural circuits is expanding therapeutic strategies to modulate brain, autonomic, and immune functions. Devices delivered endovascularly offer a less invasive alternative to conventional implanted electrodes, while delivering spatio-temporal specificity superior to noninvasive techniques. We demonstrate a fully endovascular sub-1-mm3 implant, utilizing ultrasound for wireless power delivery and data telemetry in a fashion invariant to device orientation. The implant consists of piezoelectric transducers, an energy storage capacitor, an application-specific integrated circuit, and electrodes packaged on a 7-um-thick polyimide scaffold. The implant can be delivered through a microcatheter in a manner analogous to conventional neurovascular stents, and self-expands upon deployment to appose the vessel walls. We demonstrate intravascular stimulation of the autonomic nervous system from the carotid artery, achieving modulation of blood pressure in rabbits. This approach establishes a broadly applicable platform for neural interfaces enabling both stimulation and recording.

analysis.tldr: 研发了一种小于1立方毫米、可通过微导管经血管植入的超小型神经接口器件，用超声无线供电和传数据，无需对准方向，靠自膨胀贴合血管壁，在兔颈动脉内成功电刺激自主神经系统并实时调控血压。

papers.title: Qwen-RobotNav Technical Report: A Scalable Navigation Model Designed for an Agentic Navigation System
papers.abstract: Agentic navigation systems require a base navigation model whose observation strategy can be externally reconfigured at inference time, because instruction following, object search, target tracking, and autonomous driving share the same perception-planning backbone yet demand fundamentally different strategies for consuming the visual stream. We present Qwen-RobotNav, a scalable navigation model built on Qwen-RobotNav that addresses it through a parameterised interface with two complementary dimensions: multiple task modes that select the navigation behaviour, and controllable observation parameters (e.g., token budget, per-camera weights) that govern how visual history is encoded. With training-time randomization over all parameters, Qwen-RobotNav is robust to any inference-time configuration requiring zero architectural modification to the Qwen-RobotNav backbone. We train Qwen-RobotNav on 15.6M samples; co-training with vision-language data prevents the collapse into reactive action-sequence mappers observed in trajectory-only training. The parameterised interface also makes Qwen-RobotNav a natural building block for agentic systems: for long-horizon scenarios, an upper-level planner decomposes goals into sub-tasks and dynamically switches Qwen-RobotNav's task mode and context strategy mid-episode, composing complex behaviours from repeated calls to the same model. Extensive experiments show that Qwen-RobotNav sets new state-of-the-art results across major navigation benchmarks. The model exhibits favourable scaling from 2B to 8B parameters, with joint multi-task training developing a shared spatial-planning substrate that transfers across task families, and demonstrates strong zero-shot generalisation to real-world robots across diverse environments.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个可动态重配置视觉输入策略和任务模式的导航大模型Qwen-RobotNav，通过训练时随机化参数实现零修改适配多种导航任务（指令跟随、目标搜索、跟踪等），并在多个基准上刷出SOTA，声称能零样本迁移到真实机器人。
analysis.claim: 一个无需架构修改即可在推理时任意组合任务模式与视觉编码策略的可扩展导航基础模型，能通过联合多任务训练形成共享空间规划表征，并实现跨任务家族迁移和真实机器人零样本泛化。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB视频流+语言指令+可调视觉token预算与相机权重
analysis.output: 导航动作序列（离散/连续动作）
