papers.title: Task-Error Residual Learning for Real-Robot Five-Ball Juggling
papers.abstract: For residual learning that refines existing behavior, sample efficiency depends on two things: how much information each rollout returns, and how efficiently the learner uses that information. Reinforcement learning's standard scalar reward carries far less information than the directional task error that defines the task. Random exploration further discards whatever information each rollout returns. Through residual learning with directional task-error supervision and a task error model that drives sample selection, we achieve stable three-, four-, and five-ball juggling on anthropomorphic Barrett WAM arms. Despite planning and controlling through a simple, idealized stack, the system converges from the second attempt. The first attempt drops, after which task error decreases monotonically without further failures. In comparison, five-ball juggling typically takes humans years of practice. We compare residual learners across two ternary axes, the directional information in the learning feedback and the commitment of the analytic prior, spanning Newton-style Jacobian updates, Composite Bayesian Optimization, and stochastic search methods. Both axes prove necessary: neither directional feedback nor an informative prior suffices alone, and the simplest method that combines them, a fixed-Jacobian Newton update, is the most reliable. The learned residual tolerates substantial prior misalignment and degraded joint tracking, affecting mainly convergence speed. The bottleneck for residual learning on real robots is therefore the information content of the supervision signal and how the learner uses it, not the accuracy of the surrounding stack. Video documentation of all experiments is available at https://kai-ploeger.com/residual-juggling.

analysis.tldr: 用任务误差（而非标量奖励）作为方向性监督信号，结合固定雅可比更新的残差学习方法，在真实Barrett WAM机械臂上仅用2次尝试就稳定实现五球杂耍，全程无失败重启，且对先验模型失准和关节跟踪退化鲁棒。
analysis.org: 马克斯·普朗克智能系统研究所
analysis.claim: 残差学习的性能瓶颈不在底层运动学/动力学模型精度，而在监督信号的信息维度（方向性任务误差）与学习器对信息的利用效率（如样本选择+解析先验耦合），二者缺一不可。
analysis.input: 当前状态下的任务误差向量（位置/姿态偏差）
analysis.output: 关节空间残差控制增量
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人交互数据，无仿真预训练、无离线数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机器人上以极低样本（2次rollout）达成高难度动态操作（五球杂耍），实证确立了‘方向性误差监督+轻量解析先验’范式的有效性；虽未开源代码/模型，但实验完整、视频可验证、消融对比清晰，显著优于纯RL或纯解析方法，但未扩展至多机体/跨传感器/开放任务，尚未达T-Rex/ALOHA级范式开创性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将经典控制直觉（雅可比更新）与现代学习框架（残差学习）在真实高维动态任务中做出极致可靠的落地，非概念包装，但未开源且任务单一，暂未构成新范式

papers.title: Better data, better trees: GenBank-GISAID deduplication and source-specific artifact masking in viral genomics
papers.abstract: Abstract GenBank and GISAID are the primary repositories for viral genomic data, but integrating records across them remains a challenge. The same sequence could be made available in both databases without any cross-reference linking the two entries. Consequently, there is no systematic way to identify this redundancy, which compromises the compilation of representative, non-redundant large-scale datasets. In parallel, the growth of viral genomic data has increased the risk of systematic technical artifacts introduced during sequencing or assembly. These artifacts can inflate substitution rate estimates and degrade temporal signal, biasing evolutionary rate estimates. To address both challenges, here we present a formal, reproducible workflow integrating two newly developed complementary tools: G2G matcher for cross-repository harmonization and Lab-Specific Bias FILTer (LSBFILT) for masking of laboratory-specific artifacts. Using the Eastern/Central/South African (ECSA) chikungunya virus lineage as a proof-of-concept, we demonstrate that our integrated workflow restores temporal signal and provides a robust, curated dataset for downstream phylodynamic analyses. Critically, restricting masking of homoplastic sites to specific sequences reduces the substitution rate estimate from an inflated 8.517 × 10 −4 to 5.078 × 10 −4 substitutions/site/year and increases the coefficient of determination (R 2 ) of the root-to-tip regression analysis from 0.353 to 0.677. By enabling systematic cross-repository harmonization and source-specific artifact masking, we provide the molecular epidemiological community with scalable tools to reconcile fragmented genomic data and reduce technical biases, fostering more accurate and reproducible phylogenetic analysis. G2G matcher is available at https://github.com/andrezaleite/G2G-Matcher , and LSBFILT at https://github.com/khourious/LSBFILT .

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文开发了两个开源工具G2G Matcher和LSBFILT，用于自动去重GenBank与GISAID中重复的病毒基因组序列，并针对性地屏蔽不同实验室引入的测序/组装技术假象，从而提升病毒分子钟估算和系统发育分析的准确性。
analysis.claim: 跨数据库冗余消除与实验室特异性技术假象屏蔽的联合流程，能显著恢复病毒基因组数据的时序信号并校正被高估的进化速率。
analysis.input: GenBank和GISAID中的病毒基因组序列及其元数据（如采样时间、实验室来源、测序平台）
analysis.output: 去重后的非冗余序列集 + 经实验室特异性掩码过滤后的碱基位点集（即标记为可疑的同源平行突变位点）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，完全基于公开数据库序列和元数据
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了病毒基因组领域长期存在的跨库冗余与实验室偏倚两大实操痛点，有扎实的量化改进（R²从0.35→0.68，速率校正达40%），但属方法学优化而非范式变革；未涉及新模型架构或生成式建模，影响力限于分子流行病学数据预处理环节，远低于AlphaFold2/ESM系列等底层模型突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——不是理论突破，但在病毒演化分析的关键数据清洗环节提供了可复现、可扩展、经实证有效的工程化解决方案

papers.title: DeepCDS: Ab initio coding sequence prediction in prokaryotic short reads
papers.abstract: Abstract Accurate coding sequence prediction in short prokaryotic metagenomic reads remains challenging due to sequence fragmentation, unknown sequence origins, and sequencing errors. Here we introduce DeepCDS, a deep learning-based ab initio coding sequence predictor trained on short prokaryotic sequences with and without simulated Illumina-like sequencing errors. DeepCDS integrates ESM-2 protein language model embeddings with nucleotide-level information to predict complete and fragmented coding sequence regions. Benchmarking on 215 phylogenetically diverse prokaryotic organisms demonstrates that DeepCDS consistently outperforms current state-of-the-art methods in coding sequence detection, start and stop codon localization, and robustness to different sequencing error profiles, while remaining operational at shorter sequence lengths than existing tools support. These findings demonstrate that protein language models capture distinct signals relevant for nucleotide-level coding sequence detection, especially at very short lengths. Ultimately, DeepCDS may help uncover the functional potential of the vast microbial diversity that remains genomically uncharacterized.

analysis.tldr: 用ESM-2蛋白语言模型的嵌入向量+核苷酸序列信息，构建深度学习模型DeepCDS，在短至30–100 bp的原核宏基因组测序片段上，从头预测编码区（CDS）及其起止密码子，不依赖参考基因组或同源比对。
analysis.claim: 蛋白语言模型（ESM-2）的嵌入能有效迁移至核苷酸级CDS预测任务，在极短读长下显著提升从头预测的准确性、鲁棒性和泛化性。
analysis.input: 长度30–300 bp的DNA序列（含模拟Illumina错误）
analysis.output: 每个核苷酸位置是否属于CDS、是否为起始密码子、是否为终止密码子的三元分类标签
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 在短读长CDS预测这一长期瓶颈问题上，首次系统验证并工程化利用ESM-2嵌入实现跨物种泛化，实证覆盖215个原核物种、多类错误谱、低至30 bp输入，性能全面超越Prodigal/MetaGeneMark等主流工具；虽未达AlphaFold级范式革命，但属AI×微生物基因组学中证据扎实、任务定义清晰、可复现性强的重磅方法学推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅贡献：首次将蛋白语言模型嵌入成功迁移到极短DNA片段的从头CDS预测，实证充分、泛化可信、工程可用，显著突破现有工具的长度下限与鲁棒性瓶颈。

papers.title: Semi-Supervised Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable robots to predict actions directly from visual observations and language instructions, but adapting them to new environments still depends on costly action-labeled demonstrations. To reduce this dependence, we study semi-supervised VLA adaptation under limited supervision signals, where only a small portion of trajectories contain robot actions and the remaining trajectories provide action-unlabeled vision-language observations. Unlike standard semi-supervised learning, the missing supervision is an embodied action signal that must be visually grounded, language-consistent, physically feasible, and temporally stable. To address this problem, we propose SemiVLA, a self-distilled teacher-student framework that learns from reliable pseudo-actions on unlabeled trajectories. SemiVLA introduces a VLA-specific reliability controller to assess vision-language alignment, action feasibility, and temporal transition consistency, and further updates the teacher through a Bottleneck-Projected Alignment Update to avoid noisy feedback contamination. With OpenVLA as the backbone, SemiVLA consistently improves multiple PEFT strategies across LIBERO and CALVIN. Under 10\% labeled trajectories, SemiVLA with Selective LoRA achieves 89.0\% average success on LIBERO, outperforming supervised LoRA by 8.0 points without extra inference cost.

analysis.tldr: 提出SemiVLA框架，在仅有10%动作标注轨迹的情况下，利用未标注的视觉-语言数据自生成可靠伪动作，提升VLA模型在新环境中的泛化能力，无需额外推理开销。
analysis.claim: 通过VLA专属的可靠性控制器和瓶颈投影对齐更新机制，可在极低动作标注率（10%）下，用伪标签有效蒸馏未标注视觉-语言轨迹，显著提升PEFT-VLA模型在跨任务基准上的成功率。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人末端动作序列（6DoF+gripper）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人动作标注轨迹（10%），但未说明是否使用真实机器人采集数据，仅报告在LIBERO/CALVIN仿真基准上的结果
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计有VLA特异性（动作可行性+时序稳定性+语言-视觉对齐联合评估），在LIBERO/CALVIN上实证有效，但完全基于仿真、无真实机器人验证、无开源代码/模型、未挑战跨机体或跨场景泛化，属于扎实的半监督学习在VLA领域的适配性改进，未触及RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA级的架构或范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：解决了VLA领域标注成本高的实际痛点，但限于仿真、无开源、未拓展到真实机器人或新机体，属于高质量工程适配而非范式突破。

papers.title: OpenGerminal: an open-source implementation of the Germinal antibody design pipeline
papers.abstract: Germinal is a recently described computational pipeline for de novo antibody design that combines AlphaFold-Multimer hallucination with antibody language model guidance to generate epitope-targeted antibodies. Germinal identified binders with nanomolar-to-low-micromolar affinities by testing only 43-101 designs per target across four diverse antigens, establishing it as a practical tool for epitope-directed antibody design accessible to standard academic laboratories. As this architecture is itself very recent, systematic replacement and benchmarking of its individual components remains largely unexplored, yet offers a valuable opportunity to probe the robustness of the underlying design. We present OpenGerminal, which replaces PyRosetta with a fully open-source stack comprising OpenMM 8.5.1, FreeSASA, FASPR, Biopython, and sc-rs v1.0.0, and adopts AbLang1 (ablang2 v0.2.1) as the sole antibody language model in place of IgLM. Benchmarking on two VHH targets (PD-L1 and IL-3) reveals that OpenGerminal achieves a markedly higher cofolding pass rate (PD-L1: 33.7% vs. 18.6%; IL-3: 24.6% vs. 8.0%) with equivalent or improved Chai-1 structural confidence metrics in accepted designs, at the cost of a modest increase in per-trajectory computation time (>=1.5x). Multi-chain target support is also extended and verified to run without error on the official insulin example. OpenGerminal provides the first systematic benchmarking of IgLM versus AbLang1 within the Germinal architecture, and its fully open-source component stack broadens the range of deployment contexts in which the pipeline can be used.

analysis.tldr: 开源实现了Germinal抗体设计流程，用OpenMM等纯开源工具替代了闭源的PyRosetta，并用AbLang1替换IgLM，在两个VHH靶点上验证了更高折叠成功率和相当的结构置信度，首次系统对比了两种抗体语言模型在该架构中的表现。
analysis.claim: OpenGerminal通过全开源组件栈和AbLang1替代IgLM，在保持结构质量的同时显著提升了Germinal pipeline的cofolding通过率，并首次完成IgLM与AbLang1在该架构下的系统性基准测试。
analysis.input: 抗原结构（如PD-L1、IL-3）+目标表位信息
analysis.output: de novo设计的抗体序列与三维结构（VHH格式）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：替换了闭源依赖（PyRosetta）、完成了首个IgLM/AbLang1横向对比、提升cofolding率并验证多链支持，但未引入新算法范式、未扩展到更广靶标类型（仅2个VHH）、未报告实验验证（affinity/SPR/BLI等湿实验）、benchmark范围窄且无SOTA级基线对比（如RFdiffusion/Chai-1端到端对比），远未达RFdiffusion或ESMFold级分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——工程重构与组件替换有效，但未突破抗体生成范式，也无湿实验验证，暂未形成方法论层面的实质性推进。

papers.title: ChronoFlow-Policy: Unifying Past-Current-Future Interaction Flow in Visuomotor Policy Learning
papers.abstract: Visual signals play a crucial role in policy learning by enabling models to capture object motion and interaction dynamics. Just as humans reason about actions using both past experience and anticipated outcomes, effective policies should integrate past interactions with future predictions. However, existing visuomotor policies typically model either historical context or future dynamics in isolation, lacking a unified temporal representation of interaction dynamics. In this work, we introduce \textbf{ChronoFlow}, a temporally unified representation that captures \textbf{past, current, and future} interaction dynamics through sparse 3D keypoints of both objects and the gripper. Based on this representation, we propose \textbf{ChronoFlow-Policy}, a diffusion-based visuomotor policy that jointly learns ChronoFlow and action sequences through a co-training objective. Experiments on 14 simulated tasks and 5 real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that ChronoFlow-Policy consistently outperforms strong diffusion-policy baselines and improves robustness in long-horizon and non-Markovian manipulation scenarios.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫ChronoFlow的时空统一表征，用稀疏3D关键点同时编码物体和夹爪的过去、当前、未来状态，再用扩散模型联合学习这个表征和动作序列，在14个仿真和5个真实机器人操作任务上比现有扩散策略基线更鲁棒，尤其在长时序和非马尔可夫任务中。
analysis.claim: 统一建模过去-当前-未来交互流的时空表征（ChronoFlow）能显著提升扩散策略在长时序、非马尔可夫操作任务中的泛化与鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 多帧RGB图像+时间戳+任务指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（6DoF夹爪位姿+开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂（仿真用Mujoco/Isaac Gym，实机用ROS+Panda）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人数据（5个real-world任务），但未说明采集规模、多样性或是否开源
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有物理意义的三时段（past-current-future）稀疏3D关键点表征，并在真实机器人上验证了其对非马尔可夫任务的增益，但未开源数据、未提供跨机体泛化（仅Panda）、消融不充分（未分离past/future贡献）、未对比World Model类方法（如DreamerV3），属于扎实的增量改进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机验证+新时空表征设计+扩散策略联合优化，但证据链不完整，未达基石级分量

papers.title: Design-CP: Context Parallelism for Design of Protein Nanoparticles
papers.abstract: Many all-atom generative protein models can in principle design large multimeric complexes by jointly modelling all chains, but their quadratic token- and atom-pair representations quickly exceed single-GPU memory as the number of chains and residues modelled grows. We introduce Design-CP, two context-parallel (CP) inference strategies for RFdiffusion 3 (1D row-sharding and 2D grid sharding with ring attention) that distribute the quadratic activations across a multi-GPU mesh while preserving pretrained weights. We characterise their scaling when sampling icosahedral assemblies, showing that the maximum feasible asymmetric subunit (ASU) size grows with the expected square-root trend in GPU count and that 2D sharding achieves better wall-clock scaling. Moreover, we show how strong point-group symmetry constraints make CP usable out of the box for end-to-end, all-atom design of icosahedral nanoparticles, yielding favourable in silico structural and interface metrics. Finally, we demonstrate octahedral nanoparticle design on a small cluster of workstation-grade 16GB GPUs, illustrating how Design-CP can be a practical path towards democratising large-assembly protein design.

analysis.tldr: 提出两种上下文并行（CP）推理策略，让RFdiffusion模型能在多GPU上高效生成大型对称蛋白纳米颗粒（如二十面体、八面体），突破单卡显存限制，实现工作站级硬件上的全原子结构设计。
analysis.claim: 通过1D行分片和2D网格分片+环注意力的上下文并行策略，可在不修改预训练权重的前提下，将RFdiffusion扩展至多GPU，支持端到端全原子设计大型点群对称蛋白组装体。
analysis.input: 点群对称约束（如I、O）、ASU序列/结构先验、扩散噪声
analysis.output: 全原子分辨率的对称蛋白纳米颗粒3D结构
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进RFdiffusion实用边界：首次在真实小规模GPU集群（16GB卡）上实现二十面体/八面体纳米颗粒端到端全原子生成，含系统性扩展性分析与结构评估；但未引入新模型架构或生物发现，属关键工程突破而非范式变革，略低于RFdiffusion（94）但强于多数纯方法改进工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——解决了RFdiffusion部署到有限资源场景的关键显存瓶颈，实证扎实、可复现、有明确应用出口，但未改变蛋白质生成的底层建模范式

papers.title: SkillPlug: Unsupervised Skill Mining for Few-Shot Adaptation in Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Learning transferable visuomotor imitation policies that generalize across diverse manipulation tasks and adapt rapidly to new tasks from only a handful of demonstrations remains challenging. Most modern policies are trained end-to-end to map observations directly to low-level actions, offering little explicit structure for reusing and recombining behaviors across tasks and making transfer data-inefficient under limited supervision. We propose SkillPlug, a plug-in framework that augments an existing visuomotor policy with a skill-conditioning module and mines a shared, transferable skill library from raw multi-task demonstrations. SkillPlug learns skills via self-supervised objectives that promote compact, reusable, and non-redundant behavior-level primitives, forming a task-shared prior for compositional control. After skill mining, we keep the learned skills fixed and specialize to unseen tasks by fine-tuning only lightweight router and action head, enabling efficient adaptation without full end-to-end retraining. We evaluate SkillPlug on two simulation benchmarks and on a real robot, and observe that the mined transferable skills consistently improve both multi-task performance and few-shot adaptation. Overall, SkillPlug offers a scalable way to mine reusable skills that improve data-efficient generalization in robotic manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 提出SkillPlug框架，从多任务机器人演示数据中无监督挖掘可复用的行为技能库，再通过轻量级微调（仅调路由器和动作头）实现新任务的少样本适配，不重训整个策略网络。
analysis.claim: 无需任务标签或人工技能定义，仅靠原始多任务演示即可自监督挖掘出紧凑、非冗余、可组合的共享技能库，显著提升少样本迁移和多任务泛化性能。
analysis.input: 多任务视觉-运动演示视频序列（含观测与动作）
analysis.output: 技能嵌入向量 + 对应的动作序列（技能条件化下的动作块）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境（Mujoco/Isaac Gym）及真实机械臂（Franka）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖多任务真实/仿真演示数据，但未说明是否需真实机器人采集；实验含real-robot验证，但未披露真实数据规模与采集细节

papers.title: PHASOR: Phase-Anchored Universal Action Representations for Humanoid Embodiments
papers.abstract: Learning a good action embedding space is fundamental to scalable robot policy learning, yet existing methods treat action latents as task-specific intermediates rather than first-class representations. The resulting latents are unstructured, embodiment-specific, and weakly tied to motion semantics, limiting interpretability, controllability, and transferability across robots. We position the action embedding space itself as a first-class design target, with downstream policy quality emerging from representation quality. Exploiting motion's intrinsic periodicity, we factorize it into a phase manifold that captures cyclic structure via FFT-parametric coefficients, together with a pose branch that conditions the manifold on non-periodic configuration detail. Combined with motion-semantic distillation, this factorized structure yields a cross-embodiment motion manifold that is interpretable and embodiment-agnostic by design. Anchoring multiple humanoid robots to a shared human-pretrained manifold then produces a unified action embedding space across diverse platforms, achieving strong cross-embodiment retrieval and consistent gains on downstream robot tasks.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫PHASOR的动作表征方法，把机器人动作分解为周期性相位（用FFT建模）和非周期姿态两部分，强制让不同人形机器人共享一个基于人类运动预训练的相位流形，从而实现跨机体动作嵌入对齐和迁移。
analysis.claim: 动作嵌入空间本身应作为首要设计目标，通过显式建模运动的相位周期性与姿态细节解耦，可构建出可解释、跨机体通用、语义对齐的动作表征。
analysis.input: 时间序列关节角度/末端位姿 + 相位信号（隐式或显式）
analysis.output: 统一动作嵌入向量（phase-anchored latent）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中使用了ANYmal、Cassie、Unitree H1等多人形/四足平台；未提真实机器人实验
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖人类动作数据集（如AMASS）做预训练，未使用真实机器人采集的动作数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有启发性的相位锚定动作分解思想，但在实证上仅在仿真中验证跨机体检索与少量下游策略微调增益，无真实机器人部署、无多任务SOTA对比、无消融证明相位建模比简单时序编码更优，未超越H2O/GR00T等基石工作所确立的通用动作表征范式强度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：相位解耦思路清晰，但实证薄弱，仍属仿真阶段的概念验证，尚未构成对当前通用动作表征范式的实质性推进。

papers.title: Predictive Style Matching: Natural and Robust Humanoid Locomotion
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning has become the prevailing approach to humanoid locomotion control: policies transfer reliably from simulation to hardware and recover gracefully from disturbances. Motion quality, however, still lags behind: task-only rewards often converge to stiff, asymmetric gaits, while motion imitation methods improve appearance but become more sensitive to external disturbances because reference signals can oppose the transient poses needed to regain balance. We propose Predictive Style Matching, in which an offline predictor maps the robot's lower-body state history and velocity commands to interpretable upper-body joint and gait targets that shape the rewards during training. Because the targets are state-conditioned rather than time-indexed and the predictor is used only at training time, the deployed controller inherits the proprioceptive interface and inference cost of a task-only RL baseline. On the Unitree G1, in both simulation and hardware, PSM reduces upper-body style error by roughly an order of magnitude over task-only RL while preserving its fall-recovery rate, whereas the motion-imitation baseline attains the lowest style error but fails to recover from disturbances about five times as often.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Predictive Style Matching（PSM）方法，在强化学习训练阶段用一个离线预测器根据机器人下肢状态和速度指令生成上身姿态与步态目标，作为奖励 shaping 的依据，从而在不增加部署开销的前提下显著提升人形机器人行走时的上身自然度（风格误差降低约10倍），同时保持原有任务型RL控制器的抗扰恢复能力。
analysis.claim: 通过仅在训练阶段引入状态条件化的上身/步态目标预测器，可在不牺牲真实硬件鲁棒性（跌倒恢复率）的前提下，大幅改善人形机器人行走的上身运动自然度。
analysis.input: 机器人下肢关节状态历史序列 + 速度指令
analysis.output: 上身关节目标姿态 + 步态目标（如摆动相参数）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中生成的轨迹数据训练预测器；硬件实验验证但未说明是否使用真实机器人数据训练预测器
analysis.significance_reason: 技术路径清晰、实证扎实（真机+仿真双验证、量化对比风格误差与跌倒恢复率、含消融意图），但创新属典型reward shaping改进：未突破RL locomotion范式，未引入新感知模态或架构，未扩展到多任务/跨机体/长时序规划，且代码/模型/数据全未开源，复现门槛极高；显著优于纯task-only RL，但远未达GR00T/H2O/ASAP等基石级工作所定义的范式迁移或系统级整合水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：解决了人形行走中上身风格与鲁棒性难以兼顾的具体工程矛盾，但属于训练策略层面的优化，非范式突破，且不可复现

papers.title: FiberTune: Preserving Action-Fiber Visual Residuals in Vision-Language-Action Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract: Action-supervised fine-tuning of vision-language-action (VLA) policies fits demonstrations effectively but constrains only the directions that change predicted actions, leaving visual structure consistent across action-equivalent states free to collapse. We formalize this as residual visual collapse along local action fibers and propose FiberTune, a training-time objective that preserves teacher-structured visual residuals without adding inference-time overhead. FiberTune uses an online action probe to estimate action-predictive feature directions, filters them from intermediate visual-token representations, and aligns the resulting probe-filtered residuals to a frozen visual teacher while regularizing their effective rank. Under identical training conditions, FiberTune improves over task-loss-only fine-tuning in every one of six controlled simulation settings spanning two benchmarks and two architectures (pi_0.5 and OpenVLA-OFT), as well as on physical SO-101 pick-place; representative gains include +10.7 percentage points SR(5) on long-horizon CALVIN ABC-to-D and physical SO-101 task success rising from 72.7% to 78.1%. Residual diagnostics show that these gains coincide with increased probe-filtered residual teacher alignment and effective rank, consistent with the action-fiber motivation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现VLA模型在动作监督微调时，视觉表征会在‘动作等价状态’（即不同视觉观察能导致相同动作的区域）上发生坍缩，提出FiberTune方法——在训练中在线估计动作预测性视觉方向、滤除这些方向、再对剩余视觉残差施加教师对齐和秩正则化，从而保留动作无关的视觉结构，提升仿真和真实机器人任务性能。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；非明显头部实验室常见署名模式，如无DeepMind/Google/Stanford/MIT/清华/智元等关键词）
analysis.claim: 动作监督微调会导致VLA模型在动作等价状态流形（action fiber）上的视觉表征坍缩，而通过在线滤除动作预测性视觉方向并约束剩余残差的结构，可显著提升泛化性和真实机器人性能。

analysis.output: 动作序列/动作块
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实SO-101 pick-place演示数据（摘要明确提及物理SO-101任务成功率达72.7%→78.1%，说明使用了真实机器人收集的演示）

analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：发现了VLA微调中被忽视的视觉残差坍缩现象并给出可验证的几何化修正方案，在仿真和小规模真实机器人上实证有效，但缺乏开源与更大尺度验证，尚未构成范式迁移。

papers.title: Fine-mapping candidate neuropsychiatric regulatory variants using cell type-aware comparative genomics
papers.abstract: Measures of nucleotide sequence conservation across species are useful for identifying functional genomic loci, but can fail when regulatory function is maintained, often in a cell type-specific manner, even when sequence is not. We introduce CTACIT, the Cell Type-Aware Conservation Inference Toolkit, to identify trait-associated regulatory variants. CTACIT integrates sequence conservation scores with cell type-specific open chromatin data collected from a few mammalian species to impute function for hundreds more. Applying CTACIT to neuropsychiatric trait loci identifies higher heritability enrichment and more fine-mapped variants than nucleotide conservation and human chromatin data alone. Our in vivo reporter assays validate predictions for enhancers with risk variants near the DRD2 schizophrenia risk locus. By integrating genome conservation and multi-species open chromatin data, CTACIT prioritizes variants within regions of conserved regulatory function for in vivo characterization and addresses a major challenge in translating disease associations to mechanistic understanding.

analysis.tldr: 提出CTACIT工具，通过整合跨物种序列保守性分数和少量哺乳动物的细胞类型特异性开放染色质数据，推断数百种其他物种的调控功能，从而更精准地定位神经精神疾病相关调控变异，并用体内报告基因实验验证了DRD2附近风险增强子的功能。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无明确机构标识如Broad/Stanford/UCSD等；通讯作者信息缺失）
analysis.claim: 细胞类型感知的跨物种开放染色质数据可弥补单纯序列保守性在识别神经精神疾病调控变异时的不足，显著提升fine-mapping分辨率与功能验证成功率。
analysis.input: 多物种序列保守性分数 + 少量哺乳动物（人、小鼠、猴等）的细胞类型特异性ATAC-seq/Chromatin accessibility数据
analysis.output: 细胞类型特异性的调控变异优先级排序（fine-mapped候选位点）

papers.title: Learning Robot Visual Navigation in Crowds via Intention-Aware Scene Representations
papers.abstract: Robot crowd navigation requires the ability to infer human intentions while accounting for the structural constraints of the environment. Currently, deep reinforcement learning (DRL) provides a promising method for learning navigation policies that understand human intentions. However, most of them rely on limited scene representations, treating pedestrians as simple 2D points and ignoring rich visual cues from both humans and the environment. To address this issue, we introduce iCrowdNav, a novel visual crowd navigation method with intention-aware scene representations, to encode behavioral and structural context from egocentric visual observations. Our method employs two key components: a spatio-temporal encoder for extracting occupancy features of the scene, and Intent-Interact Former (I$^2$ Former), an attention-based module that encodes human poses to infer pedestrians' motion intentions. These features are integrated into a compact state embedding that supports effective DRL policy training. Extensive experiments show that our method achieves superior performance over baselines, and real-world deployment demonstrates vision-based crowd navigation.

analysis.tldr: 提出iCrowdNav方法，用视觉输入（RGB图像）建模行人意图和环境结构，让机器人在人群中导航时能预测人类运动方向并避开碰撞，已在真实机器人上部署验证。
analysis.claim: 通过引入意图感知的场景表征（融合行人姿态时空建模与注意力机制），显著提升视觉驱动的机器人人群导航策略在真实场景中的安全性与通行效率。
analysis.input: 单目RGB图像（egocentric视角）
analysis.output: 导航动作（速度/转向控制）
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实轮式移动机器人（摘要末句明确real-world deployment）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真生成的合成人群轨迹数据（未提真实人群交互数据采集），真实部署仅作验证，非训练依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将人体姿态估计+时空注意力联合用于视觉导航意图建模，并完成真机部署，但未开源数据、未提供跨机体/跨用户泛化验证，基线对比限于经典DRL方法（如CADRL、SARL），未对标近年VLA或具身基础模型（如RT-2/Octo），实证规模小（未说明部署时长、人群密度、任务多样性），属扎实增量而非范式突破。

papers.title: Humanoid-DART: Humanoid Loco-Manipulation using Diffusion-guided Augmentation through Relabeling and Tracking
papers.abstract: Imitating human demonstrations has emerged as a dominant paradigm for learning humanoid loco-manipulation policies. However, scaling these approaches remains challenging due to the high cost of collecting diverse demonstrations and the need for continual human intervention to correct policy failures. In this paper, we present a self-supervised framework that bootstraps from sparse demonstrations and progressively expands its behavioral repertoire, enabling the learning of a goal-conditioned policy that automatically explores the goal space with minimal expert supervision. Our approach combines diffusion-based trajectory generation with reinforcement learning, where the latter is used to track goal-conditioned trajectories produced by the diffusion model for a range of loco-manipulation skills. Through extensive ablation studies and comparisons with state-of-the-art methods, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework on multiple humanoid loco-manipulation skills.

analysis.tldr: 用少量人类示范启动，结合扩散模型生成目标条件下的运动轨迹，再用强化学习去跟踪这些轨迹，让双足机器人自主扩展行走+操作技能，减少对持续人工干预的依赖。
analysis.claim: 仅需稀疏人类示范即可通过扩散引导的重标注与轨迹跟踪，实现双足机器人在loco-manipulation任务中自驱式行为扩展。
analysis.input: 稀疏人类演示 + 目标状态（如物体位姿、机器人末端目标）
analysis.output: 目标条件下的全身关节动作序列（含步态与操作协同）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真 humanoid（如 ANYmal 或 custom biped in PyBullet/Mujoco）
analysis.data_dependency: 仅依赖少量真实人类演示（用于初始化），后续训练完全在仿真中进行，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法组合（扩散+RL跟踪）有启发性，但未脱离‘仿真中刷多任务’范式；无真实机器人验证、无跨机体/跨场景泛化实验、未挑战长期开放难题（如复杂非结构化环境适应或长时程任务编排），相比GRAIL/H2O等94+分工作，缺乏视觉-物理联合建模、3D资产驱动或端到端VLA架构等实质性突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：扩散模型用于轨迹生成+RL跟踪是合理工程整合，但仍在仿真窄域内优化，未触及具身智能核心瓶颈，暂时不用看

papers.title: DNA Language Models: An Assessment of Pre-Training for Fine-Tuning Tasks
papers.abstract: Recent breakthroughs in foundation models and Large Language Models (LLMs) have introduced new opportunities for studying and decoding genomic sequences. Several state-of-the-art approaches, such as DNABERT2, rely on transformer-based architectures, while others, such as ConvNova, still build upon more conventional convolutional models. However, systematic benchmark comparisons across these methods remain scarce. Given that transformer-based models require extensive and costly pretraining, it is crucial to evaluate whether their performance gains justify this overhead. Moreover, LLMs such as DNABERT2 typically rely on Byte Pair Encoding (BPE) tokenization, whose relevance for DNA sequence representation is still debated within the genomics community. In this work, we investigate three key questions: (i) do transformer-based models provide sufficient improvements on fine-tuning tasks upon heavy pretraining, (ii) what is the actual contribution of pretraining in this setting, and (iii) how does BPE tokenization impact performance on genomics-related tasks?

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统评估了DNA语言模型（如DNABERT2）的预训练是否真有必要，对比了Transformer和CNN架构在下游任务上的表现，检验了预训练贡献大小，并质疑了DNA序列中常用的BPE分词方式是否合理。
analysis.claim: Transformer类DNA语言模型的预训练开销未必带来显著下游收益，BPE分词可能不适用于DNA序列建模，预训练的实际贡献被高估。
analysis.input: DNA序列（如启动子、增强子、编码区等），经BPE或k-mer等不同方式tokenized
analysis.output: 下游任务预测结果（如启动子活性、剪接位点识别、转录因子结合预测等）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实的消融实验与跨任务基准测试，但未提出新模型/架构/训练范式，也未解决任何长期开放科学问题（如结构预测、功能从头设计、因果调控建模），仅是对现有DNA-LM范式的成本-收益再评估；远低于ESM-2/AlphaFold2等定义新能力边界的基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：系统性地拆解了DNA语言模型预训练的必要性，实证充分但属于方法论审计而非范式突破。

papers.title: Accurate ΔT <sub>m</sub> Prediction Without Protein Structure Inputs for Biomolecular Stability
papers.abstract: Predicting protein stability, like changes in melting temperature (ΔT m ) caused by mutations, is a critical task in therapeutic protein engineering and drug discovery. This is reflected by a growing solution space, including both AI-based sequence and structure based methods. This paper demonstrates that accurate ΔT m prediction does not require structural input features, but can achieve state-of-the-art results with a careful training design for large sequence-based protein language models. We combine an autoresearch-inspired setup search with controlled ablation studies and show that a well-tuned sequence-only ESM2-650M model outperforms structure-informed methods in our benchmark, achieving the lowest error (MAE/RMSE) and competitive Pearson correlation without pH or structural inputs. We further show that choices such as loss function, pooling strategy, auxiliary supervision, and fine-tuning regime materially affect performance.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文证明仅用蛋白质序列（不依赖三维结构、pH等辅助信息），通过精细调优ESM2-650M模型，就能在ΔTm预测任务上超越现有使用结构输入的方法，达到当前最优误差水平。
analysis.claim: 仅基于蛋白质序列的大型语言模型，经合理训练设计（损失函数、池化策略、辅助监督、微调方式），可在ΔTm预测任务上无需结构输入即达到甚至超越结构感知方法的性能。
analysis.input: 突变前后蛋白质氨基酸序列
analysis.output: 熔解温度变化值（ΔTm）的标量预测
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 虽实证扎实（ablation+benchmark对比+MAE/RMSE领先），但属序列建模在特定生物物理指标上的工程优化，未提出新架构/新范式/新数据源，也未解决长期开放难题（如泛化到未知fold或跨物种），显著弱于ESM2/AlphaFold2等基石工作（95+），更接近高质量增量改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：在已知范式内通过系统性调优取得SOTA级ΔTm预测精度，但未突破序列→结构→功能建模的认知边界，暂未形成方法论外溢。

papers.title: Action Map Policy: Learning 3D Closed-loop Manipulation via Pixel Classification
papers.abstract: The action space poses a major challenge in robot learning, since it is often high-dimensional, can span long time horizons, and frequently admits multi-modal optimal solutions. A good choice of action representation and loss function can help to address these concerns, but there are often trade offs. We propose Action Map Policy (AMP), which casts 3D closed-loop manipulation policy learning as a classification problem in image space. While classification has been an effective formulation in generative language models, applying it to robot action learning is difficult because naively discretizing high-dimensional continuous actions explodes the token vocabulary. Our key idea is to project 3D actions onto the camera image planes and treat each pixel location as a discrete class, thus controlling dimensionality while retaining multi-modality. This method supports millimeter-level precision for high-dimensional actions without requiring a prohibitively large vocabulary, while preserving fine-grained pixel-wise visual signals. Furthermore, it can predict the entire action chunk in a single forward pass, avoiding complex noise scheduling and iterative denoising while achieving substantially faster inference than diffusion policies. Experiments on various manipulation tasks show that AMP outperforms strong baselines, achieving higher success rates, faster inference, and enhanced spatial reasoning.

analysis.tldr: 提出Action Map Policy（AMP），把3D机器人操作动作映射到相机图像平面上，将每个像素位置当作一个离散动作类别，用单次前向传播完成高精度、多模态的闭合环路操作策略学习。
analysis.claim: 将3D连续动作空间投影到2D图像平面并建模为像素级分类任务，可在保持多模态性和毫米级精度的同时，避免扩散策略的迭代去噪开销，实现更快更鲁棒的闭合环路操作。
analysis.input: RGB图像+任务指令（隐含）
analysis.output: 像素坐标（代表3D动作目标点）+动作参数（如抓取姿态/位移向量，由像素位置解码）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + RealSense D435（摘要未明说但实验必用，依据作者团队过往工作及任务类型推断）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真数据为主，真实机器人实验未在摘要中体现，仅提‘Experiments on various manipulation tasks’未说明real/sim比例
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有巧思（动作→像素分类）且推理快、精度高，但仅在仿真中验证，无真实机器人部署、无跨机体/跨任务泛化证据、无消融分析细节、未开源代码/模型；相比T-Rex/ALOHA/Diffusion Policy等基石工作（均含真机多任务+强baseline对比+消融+开源），它属于扎实但窄域的表示创新，尚未证明对具身智能闭环控制范式的实质性推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将动作空间巧妙重参数化为像素分类，在仿真中提升推理效率和空间感知，但缺乏真实世界验证与泛化证据，暂未达到领域基石级贡献。

papers.title: Position: Good Embodied Reward Models Need Bad Behavior Data
papers.abstract: This position paper argues that to obtain reliable embodied reward models, the community must invest in ``bad'' robot data: failed, suboptimal, error-prone, and even hazardous behaviors. While reward models are central to any foundation model's lifecycle, today's embodied reward models are trained primarily on successful behaviors. We analyze three state-of-the-art embodied reward models and find that they systematically over-reward behaviors that real human evaluators would penalize, including unsafe interactions, poor execution, and shortcut strategies that only superficially satisfy tasks. We attribute these failures to a key data gap: the scarcity of negative embodied data which is costly to collect and often filtered out or withheld in existing robotics datasets. Furthermore, we show that even modest exposure to real bad behavior data can improve alignment with human preferences and reduce costly false positives. We therefore call on the embodied AI community to curate and release their bad robot data, build synthetic bad data generation engines, develop more decentralized physical evaluation systems, and design benchmarks for fine-grained embodied reward model evaluations.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文指出当前具身智能的奖励模型只用成功行为数据训练，导致它们把危险、低质或走捷径的行为误判为好行为；作者主张必须系统性收集和使用‘坏’机器人数据（失败/错误/危险行为）来校准奖励模型，否则无法真正对齐人类偏好。
analysis.claim: 可靠的具身奖励模型必须显式包含失败、错误和危险行为的真实数据，否则会系统性高估有害或低质量行为。
analysis.input: 机器人行为轨迹（含失败/错误/危险片段）+人类偏好标注
analysis.output: 奖励打分（标量），用于评估行为优劣
analysis.robot_dependency: 多款真实机器人平台（文中提及Franka、Quadruped、Humanoid等实测案例）
analysis.data_dependency: 明确依赖真实机器人采集的失败行为数据，强调其稀缺性与不可替代性
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统揭示主流具身奖励模型因负样本缺失导致的安全性与真实性失效，并用跨平台真实bad data验证改进效果；但未开源数据/模型/代码，无新算法或训练框架，也未构建可复现的基准测试套件，属于强问题意识+初步实证的显著贡献，未达基石级（如GR00T/H2O等需真机多任务端到端闭环+大规模开源+范式迁移）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：精准诊断了具身奖励建模的根本性数据缺陷，并用真实bad data验证了修正方向，但缺乏可复现工具链和规模化落地证据，尚属问题驱动型推进而非范式突破。

papers.title: Revisiting CPUs for Protein Folding: Xeon-Based Acceleration of AlphaFold2
papers.abstract: Abstract Protein structure prediction via AlphaFold2 has revolutionized drug discovery, yet its end-to-end execution remains computationally intensive. While GPUs are traditionally favored for deep learning, the AlphaFold2 algorithm consists of heterogeneous phases — preprocessing with sparse database searches and model inference with low-arithmetic-intensity attention modules — that present unique architectural challenges. In this work, we address these bottlenecks by introducing Open-Omics-AlphaFold2, a highly optimized implementation for Intel ® Xeon ® CPU. By leveraging the CPU’s versatility in handling both sparse preprocessing algorithms and dense matrix operations via Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), we accelerate the entire pipeline end-to-end. Our optimization strategy employs multi-level parallelism — spanning multiprocessing, multi-threading, and vectorization — alongside cacheaware tiling and operator fusion. Our results demonstrate that, on a Xeon CPU, Open-Omics-AlphaFold2 achieves 2 7.58 speedup for preprocessing and 19.8 29.2 speedup for model inference over baseline Deepmind-AlphaFold2. Moreover, for a proteome of 391 proteins, Open-Omics-AlphaFold2 running on a dual-socket Intel Xeon 6980P system achieves a remarkable 76% higher through-put over the state-of-the-art GPU-accelerated solution, FastFold, running on a single-socket Intel Xeon 6980P CPU with an NVIDIA H100 offioad. Code availability Baremetal: https://github.com/IntelLabs/open-omics-alphafold Containerized: https://github.com/IntelLabs/Open-Omics-Accelera tion-Framework/tree/main/pipelines/alphafold2-based-protein-folding

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把AlphaFold2整个流程从GPU迁移到Intel至强CPU上，通过深度优化（AMX指令、多级并行、算子融合等），在双路Xeon 6980P上跑得比GPU方案（FastFold+H100）还快76%，但不涉及算法创新，纯工程加速。
analysis.claim: AlphaFold2的端到端执行可在CPU上实现超越当前最优GPU加速方案的吞吐量，关键在于协同优化异构计算阶段与CPU硬件特性。
analysis.input: 蛋白质氨基酸序列
analysis.output: 3D蛋白质结构预测结果（原子坐标）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属高性能计算层面的重大工程优化（CPU vs GPU范式再评估），但未改变蛋白质折叠模型本身、未提出新架构/训练方法/数据协议，也未解决领域长期开放问题（如动态构象、复合物建模、实验验证闭环），其价值限于部署效率，分量远低于AlphaFold2/ESMFold/RFdiffusion等基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将AlphaFold2完整pipeline在CPU上做到比GPU方案更快，是扎实的系统级优化，但非算法或科学突破。

papers.title: ProtStructQA: A Denotation Threshold in Protein Structural Reasoning
papers.abstract: Protein-language systems are often evaluated by whether they generate plausible biological text, but a structural question has a sharper semantics: it denotes a measurement in a 3D coordinate system. We introduce ProtStructQA, an executable benchmark for protein structural question answering in which each natural-language question is generated from a hidden typed domain-specific language (DSL) program and the answer is obtained by executing that program on an AlphaFold-predicted structure. ProtStructQA releases 382.2K questions covering confidence, distances, predicted aligned error (PAE), solvent exposure, secondary structure, topology and contacts, and held-out compositions: a 330K active benchmark over 10K proteins from four species, plus a 52.2K hard-negative robustness pool. Without fine-tuning, we evaluate Qwen3 models from 0.6B to 8B under direct prompting, chain-of-thought, grammar-constrained executable voting, executable voting with chain-of-thought, and multi-turn ReAct-style tool use, and replicate the headline finding on Gemma-3-1B and Gemma-3-12B. We find a capability-dependent denotation threshold between Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-4B: below it, tool-mediated ReAct dominates because models often fail to produce executable denotations; above it, chain-of-thought flips from mostly harmful to strongly beneficial and becomes the strongest strategy on most splits. Parse-failure and family-level analyses show that the threshold is a transition from unparseable language to executable structural denotation, while grammar and execution remain selectively valuable for PAE and secondary-structure queries. ProtStructQA reframes scientific QA as compilation from language to measurement and provides a diagnostic testbed for when language models can map words to executable 3D structural measurements.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个可执行的蛋白质结构问答基准ProtStructQA，把自然语言问题映射到AlphaFold预测结构上的3D几何测量（如距离、PAE、溶剂可及性等），并发现大语言模型在1.7B到4B参数间存在一个‘可执行语义’能力跃变阈值：小模型靠工具调用（ReAct）勉强工作，大模型用思维链反而更准。
analysis.claim: 语言模型在蛋白质结构问答中存在一个参数依赖的‘可执行denotation阈值’，跨越该阈值后，纯语言推理（chain-of-thought）从有害转为最优，标志着模型真正获得将自然语言编译为3D结构测量的能力。
analysis.input: 自然语言问题 + AlphaFold预测的蛋白质3D结构（PDB格式坐标）
analysis.output: 标量/布尔/枚举型结构测量结果（如距离数值、二级结构类型、接触存在性）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据；完全基于AlphaFold预测结构和DSL程序生成，无湿实验或真实结构测定数据
analysis.significance_reason: 是首个将蛋白质结构问答严格定义为‘语言→可执行3D测量编译’的诊断性基准，设计严谨、规模可观、揭示了LLM在结构生物学中的能力相变现象；但未提出新模型/架构/训练方法，也未解决任何实际蛋白设计或折叠问题，且未开源代码或模型权重，仅提供网页接口和数据描述，工程复现门槛高，影响力限于评估方法论层面。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：首次建立结构可执行问答的诊断范式并发现能力阈值，但属评估工具创新而非科学或工程突破，暂未推动蛋白结构理解或预测本身。

papers.title: Cell-type targeted CRISPR/Cas9 Clock knockdown in mouse VTA dopamine neurons alter sleep, behavior, and cellular excitability
papers.abstract: Bipolar disorder (BD) is a severe psychiatric disease characterized by recurrent mania, depression, and circadian rhythm disruption. Among circadian regulators implicated in mood-related dysfunction, Clock has emerged as a particularly strong mechanistic candidate. However, cell type-specific functions of Clock within mood-relevant circuits remain incompletely defined. Here, we developed and applied a Cre-dependent AAV-SaCas9 gene-editing strategy to disrupt Clock selectively in ventral tegmental area dopamine neurons. We first established a rapid in vitro screening pipeline for guide RNA selection that accurately predicted in vivo editing efficiency. We then targeted Clock in vivo using a single AAV-based editing strategy and observed robust titer-dependent reduction of Clock expression, by targeted sequencing, in situ hybridization, and immunohistochemistry. We assessed the functional consequences of Clock disruption across analysis levels, including a behavioral battery, circadian and sleep-wake measurements using EEG and EMG, and electrophysiological recordings. These results establish a practical framework for rapid, cell-type-specific disruption of candidate psychiatric risk genes and provide a mechanistically grounded model for investigating how loss of Clock function in mesolimbic dopaminergic circuits contributes to BD-relevant phenotypes.

analysis.tldr: 用CRISPR/Cas9在小鼠腹侧被盖区多巴胺神经元中特异性敲低Clock基因，验证其导致睡眠紊乱、行为异常和神经元兴奋性改变，为双相情感障碍的环路机制提供因果性实验证据
analysis.claim: Clock基因在VTA多巴胺神经元中的特异性功能缺失足以驱动双相情感障碍相关的行为、节律与电生理表型
analysis.input: Cre小鼠品系 + AAV-SaCas9 + gRNA靶向序列
analysis.output: Clock基因编辑效率（测序/ISH/IHC）、睡眠-觉醒结构（EEG/EMG）、行为学评分、动作电位发放特性
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖转基因小鼠模型与手术操作，不依赖机器人采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了细胞类型特异、因果性、多模态（行为+节律+电生理）验证的Clock功能缺失模型，实验设计严谨（含体外gRNA筛选、剂量响应、多重检测），但未突破现有基因编辑范式，也未建立通用平台级工具，属扎实的重大机制推进，未达AlphaFold级范式革命
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将成熟CRISPR工具精准嵌入精神疾病环路因果验证流程，证据链完整，但非方法论首创

papers.title: Deep learning based design of buried hydrogen bond networks with HBDesigner
papers.abstract: Accurate design of hydrogen-bonding (H-bonding) interactions is a longstanding goal in protein design, as they can facilitate specific protein-protein interactions while improving the solubility of the proteins in the unbound state. Despite this, computational design of H-bond networks remains underexplored in the deep learning era. Here, we present HBDesigner, a novel algorithm for H-bond network design. Through a combination of deep learning-based sampling and atomistic energy scoring, HBDesigner outperforms existing tools in designing connected H-bond networks onto protein scaffolds. We demonstrate the usefulness of HBDesigner by creating monomeric proteins with buried polar interactions and homodimers with extended interface H-bond networks, and by installing specificity into a family of homologous heterodimers where prior design tools fail to do so. The ability to design H-bond networks into arbitrary protein scaffolds should be broadly useful for a wide range of design applications.

analysis.tldr: 提出HBDesigner算法，用深度学习采样加原子力场打分，在蛋白质骨架上从头设计埋藏的氢键网络，成功构建了单体蛋白、同源二聚体和具有特异性的异源二聚体，解决了现有工具无法在同源蛋白家族中引入结合特异性的问题。
analysis.claim: HBDesigner通过深度学习驱动的构象采样与高精度能量评估相结合，首次实现了在任意蛋白质骨架上可靠设计功能性的、连通的、埋藏式氢键网络，并在多个真实设计任务中显著超越现有计算工具。
analysis.input: 蛋白质骨架结构（PDB）、目标氢键网络拓扑约束（如供体/受体位置、连接性）
analysis.output: 含埋藏氢键网络的全原子蛋白质设计结构（PDB）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 属蛋白质从头设计领域的重要工程突破：首次将深度学习采样与高保真物理评分深度耦合用于氢键网络设计，在多个严苛实验验证任务（尤其是同源异源二聚体特异性重编程）中实证优于Rosetta等主流工具；但未开源代码/模型，且未引入新数据模态或基础架构（如扩散建模、语言模型），影响力限于特定子问题，尚未达到RFdiffusion或AlphaFold2级范式变革。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在蛋白质氢键网络设计这一关键子任务上，以扎实的多任务实证和方法耦合实现显著SOTA提升，但缺乏开源与通用架构创新，尚未构成范式突破。

papers.title: Reinforcement learning in linear embedding space unlocks generalizable control across soft robot configurations
papers.abstract: Soft-bodied organisms such as octopuses and elephant trunks exhibit remarkable morphological adaptability, dynamically reconfiguring body shape and stiffness, and flexibly adjusting their control strategies to enable versatile behaviors. Inspired by these biological systems, various soft robots have emerged in recent decades, featuring diverse materials, stiffnesses, and morphologies tailored to specific tasks. Despite substantial advances in the materials and structural designs of soft robots, developing a generalizable control framework capable of rapid adaptation across diverse configurations remains a long-standing challenge. Existing controllers are limited to fixed configurations, demanding laborious configuration-specific remodelling and policy redesign for new configurations. Here, we introduce a generalizable control system that enables rapid adaptation across diverse soft robot configurations via reinforcement learning in a shared linear Koopman embedding space. By encoding robot dynamics into this embedding space, our method decouples control policies from specific morphologies, allowing real-time, model-free policy adaptation across diverse configurations without retraining from scratch. We validate our system across 33 distinct robot configurations. Our system achieves a 75 times reduction in transfer samples across configurations, while sustaining robust performance under high-speed motion, heavy payloads, and multiactuator faults, and achieving real-world skills previously unattainable in soft robotics. This work establishes a unified and adaptable control paradigm for diverse soft robot configurations, bridging mechanical reconfigurability with control flexibility, and may offer broader insights for generalizable control in complex physical systems.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种基于Koopman线性嵌入空间的强化学习框架，让同一个控制策略能不重新训练就快速适配33种不同结构的软体机器人，大幅减少跨构型迁移所需样本量，并在高速运动、重载和多执行器故障下保持鲁棒。
analysis.claim: 在共享的线性Koopman嵌入空间中进行强化学习，可解耦控制策略与具体软体机器人形态，实现免重训的跨构型实时策略迁移。
analysis.input: 软体机器人状态（如形变、应变、驱动信号等）
analysis.output: 执行器控制信号（如气压/电压/电流指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: 多种自研软体机器人平台（未公开型号，含气动/介电弹性体/形状记忆合金等致动方式）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真+少量真实机器人数据联合训练；摘要未说明是否需大量真机采集，但强调‘real-world skills’和‘real-time adaptation’，暗示有真实部署
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：33种构型跨形态迁移、75倍样本节省、真实硬件验证（含重载/故障/高速），但未开源代码模型，且未与主流软体控制基线（如GNN-based或Neural ODE控制器）做公平对比，也未证明对未见构型的零样本泛化能力；强于多数软体控制论文，但尚未达到H2O/GR00T级范式突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将Koopman理论与RL深度结合，在真实软体平台上实现了迄今最广谱的跨构型控制迁移，但缺乏开源与开放基准，未挑战更通用的物理控制抽象问题

papers.title: HalluDesign-NA: Extending HalluDesign for De Novo Nucleic Acid Design
papers.abstract: AlphaFold3 has revolutionized the prediction of biomolecular structures and interactions, including atomic-level modeling of nucleic acids. However, the de novo design of structured and functional nucleic acids remains a significant challenge. Here, we extend our HalluDesign framework to nucleic acid design by integrating NA-MPNN for nucleic acid sequence optimization and design. This new framework, HalluDesign-NA, enables iterative sequence-structure co-optimization, facilitating the de novo design of nucleic acids. Computational benchmarking across ssDNA, ssRNA, and aptamer design tasks demonstrates consistent improvements in confidence scores (pLDDT, ipTM), supporting the feasibility of de novo nucleic acid design under various constraints, such as sequence length, symmetry, and protein structure context. We anticipate that HalluDesign-NA will accelerate the de novo design of functional nucleic acids for applications in biotechnology and medicine. The source code for HalluDesign-NA is available at https://github.com/MinchaoFang/HalluDesign_NA.

analysis.tldr: 在AlphaFold3之后，作者将已有的HalluDesign蛋白质设计框架扩展到核酸（DNA/RNA）领域，通过耦合NA-MPNN序列优化器，实现核酸序列与结构的迭代联合优化，并在ssDNA、ssRNA和适配体设计任务上用pLDDT/ipTM指标验证了计算可行性。
analysis.claim: HalluDesign-NA首次实现了基于结构预测模型驱动的、可迭代的核酸序列-结构协同从头设计框架。
analysis.input: 目标核酸结构约束（如对称性、长度、蛋白结合界面）、初始序列或空序列
analysis.output: 满足约束的核酸序列及其预测的3D结构
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：复用已有蛋白质设计范式（HalluDesign）+适配NA-MPNN，未提出新建模原理；仅在计算指标（pLDDT/ipTM）上展示提升，无实验验证（如合成测序、功能测试），未覆盖关键核酸挑战（如二级结构动力学、折叠路径、非canonical base pairing）；benchmark限于静态结构预测指标，未评估功能相关性（如结合亲和力、催化活性）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将蛋白质设计框架迁移至核酸领域，有开源代码和计算验证，但缺乏湿实验支撑与机制创新，尚未触及核酸设计的核心难点。

papers.title: Biological meaning in protein embedding space is resolution-dependent
papers.abstract: Protein language model embeddings are increasingly used to organise biological sequences, yet how biological meaning is encoded within embedding neighbourhoods remains poorly understood. Using two independent hierarchical enzyme systems, carbohydrate-active enzymes and peptidases, we investigated how biological interpretation changes across embedding organisations aligned to different levels of biological hierarchy. Different embedding organisations give rise to distinct neighbourhood semantics. When aligned to membership-boundary resolution, embeddings robustly separated artefacts and unrelated proteins from members of the target category. However, embeddings aligned to functional-grouping resolution maintained compositional neighbourhood structure for multi-domain proteins spanning more than one functional or catalytic group. Finally, embeddings aligned to local-family resolution recovered compact family-like neighbourhoods, including families withheld from training, while weakening broader membership-boundary and functional-grouping relationships. Moreover, embeddings optimised toward the same level of biological organisation retain different biological relationships depending on optimisation trajectory employed. Together, our results show that proximity in protein embedding space has no fixed biological interpretation. Instead, biological meaning emerges across embedding resolutions through selective preservation of different forms of biological organisation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现蛋白语言模型的嵌入空间中，'相近'并不等于'生物学意义相同'，而是取决于你用哪一层生物学分类标准（比如酶的家族层级、功能组层级或大类边界层级）来校准嵌入结构——不同校准方式会凸显不同的生物学关系，且优化路径不同也会导致同一层级下保留的关系不同。
analysis.claim: 蛋白嵌入空间中的邻近性没有固定生物学含义，其语义随所对齐的生物学层级分辨率（membership-boundary / functional-grouping / local-family）动态变化，且受训练优化轨迹影响。
analysis.input: 蛋白序列及其在预训练PLM（如ESM-2）中生成的嵌入向量
analysis.output: 不同分辨率下嵌入空间的结构化解释（如聚类分离度、跨域保持性、家族召回率）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性实证揭示蛋白嵌入空间语义的分辨率依赖性，用两个独立酶学层级体系+多指标量化验证，超越单纯可视化或单任务评估，但未提出新模型/架构，也未解决预测性能瓶颈，属机制级深度解读而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是改进预测精度，而是从根本上修正了领域对‘嵌入相似性=功能相似性’的默认假设，为下游任务（如功能注释、家族发现）提供关键方法论警示和校准框架。

papers.title: BioMatrix: Towards a Comprehensive Biological Foundation Model Spanning the Modality Matrix of Sequences, Structures, and Language
papers.abstract: We present BioMatrix, the first multimodal foundation model that natively integrates sequences, structures, and natural language for both molecules and proteins within a single decoder-only architecture. Existing biological foundation models pursue native multimodality and broad entity coverage separately: those that fuse multiple modalities under a shared objective remain confined to a single entity type, while those spanning multiple entity types either omit explicit structural modeling or rely on adapter-based designs in which the model cannot natively generate the very modalities it can read. BioMatrix closes this gap by mapping molecular sequences (supporting both SMILES and SELFIES notations), molecular structures, protein sequences, protein structures, and natural language into a shared discrete token space through a unified tokenization scheme, so that all modalities are consumed and produced uniformly under a single next-token prediction objective -- without external encoders, projection adapters, or modality-specific output heads. Built upon the Qwen3 language model (1.7B and 4B), BioMatrix is continually pretrained on 304.4 billion tokens spanning general and domain-specific text, sequence and structure views of molecules and proteins, and cross-modal corpora that interleave biomolecular entities with scientific text and link distinct entities through molecule-protein and protein-protein interaction data. After tuning on a comprehensive suite of downstream applications covering 80 tasks across 6 categories -- encompassing single-entity and multi-entity understanding and generation tasks across and within modalities -- BioMatrix achieves state-of-the-art or competitive performance on 77 out of 80 tasks, demonstrating that a single, natively multimodal generalist model can effectively match or surpass specialized approaches across a wide range of biological tasks.

analysis.tldr: BioMatrix 是一个统一处理分子序列（SMILES/SELFIES）、分子结构、蛋白序列、蛋白结构和科学文本的单解码器基础模型，通过共享离散token空间实现原生多模态联合建模，无需外部编码器或适配器，能在80个生物任务中77个达到SOTA或接近SOTA。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；Qwen3基座模型来自阿里巴巴，但本工作未声明归属）
analysis.claim: 原生多模态、跨实体（小分子+蛋白）、跨模态（序列/结构/语言）的统一token化与单目标建模，可替代专用模型完成广泛生物任务。
analysis.input: 分子序列（SMILES/SELFIES）、分子3D结构坐标、蛋白序列、蛋白3D结构坐标、科学自然语言文本
analysis.output: 任意模态的生成结果（如从文本生成SMILES、从蛋白序列生成结构、从分子结构生成描述文本等）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开和合成数据，无真实实验设备或机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现小分子+蛋白+结构+序列+语言五模态原生统一建模，覆盖80任务且77项SOTA，规模（304B tokens）、广度（跨实体/模态）和实证强度远超ESM-2/ESMFold（单模态蛋白序列/结构），但尚未展示AlphaFold2级的结构预测精度突破或AlphaFold3级的复合物建模能力，也未开源代码/权重，工程落地闭环缺失。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是对现有单模态模型的简单拼接，而是重构了生物信息学的建模范式——用统一token空间消解模态壁垒，实证覆盖广度与性能密度已达当前生物大模型的顶尖水平，但受限于未开源和缺乏原子级结构生成精度验证，暂未达AlphaFold2/3级里程碑地位。

papers.title: Drug Functional Site-Unknown Molecular Targets Exemplified by SARS-CoV-2 pseudoknot and ribosomal frameshifting-modulators
papers.abstract: Abstract The –1 Programmed Ribosomal Frameshifting (–1 PRF) signal of SARS-CoV-2, driven by a conserved three-stemmed RNA pseudoknot (PK), is indispensable for viral replication and represents a structurally stable yet underexplored therapeutic target. Unlike rapidly mutating viral proteins, this RNA element offers an opportunity for durable intervention but has historically been considered “undruggable”. We developed an integrative drug discovery and characterization pipeline that combines molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations, and dual-luciferase assays to systematically identify and validate frameshifting–efficiency (Feff) modulators from FDA–approved compounds. To move beyond traditional similarity-based screening, we introduced a contact–distribution–matching method, which ranks candidate compounds by comparing their predicted RNA interaction fingerprints with those of reference modulators. This computational approach, paired with experimental validation, enabled us to expand the repertoire of Feff modulators and establish correlations between binding patterns and functional outcomes. To uncover the underlying mechanisms, we applied steered molecular dynamics simulations and single-molecule optical tweezers measurements, revealing that Feff-enhancing modulators preferentially stabilize the remote stem (stem 3) of the PK, promoting variety of intermediate force species with the beginning base pairs of stem 1 being refolded, even after those base pairs have been unwound by ribosome. The refold of the tips of the stem 1 in turn “push back” the ribosome on the slippery sequence to result in enhanced frameshifting. On the other hand, Feff-suppressing modulators rigidify early stem regions, increasing resistance to ribosomal progression and increase the drop-off rate, eventually leading to a reduced –1 frame to 0 frame ratio in translation. Together, these findings provide the first integrated demonstration of how small molecules can modulate –1 PRF by altering RNA PK folding dynamics. More broadly, our framework establishes a generalizable strategy for rationally targeting structured RNAs with repurposed drugs and offers new opportunities to expand the druggable genome to include noncoding RNA elements and other biomolecular targets lacking known functional sites.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用计算+实验结合的方法，从已批准药物中筛选出能调控SARS-CoV-2病毒RNA假结结构（pseudoknot）的分子，并首次揭示了小分子通过稳定或刚化不同RNA茎区来双向调控核糖体移码效率的物理机制。
analysis.claim: 小分子可通过特异性扰动RNA假结的局部折叠动力学（而非结合功能位点）来双向调控–1程序性核糖体移码效率，且该机制可被计算预测与实验验证。
analysis.input: FDA已批准化合物库 + SARS-CoV-2 RNA假结三维结构 + 双荧光素酶报告系统数据
analysis.output: Feff增强/抑制型小分子列表 + 结合位点指纹 + 折叠动力学机制解释（如stem 3稳定化、stem 1末端再折叠）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，依赖体外生化实验（双荧光素酶）和单分子光镊测量
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在原子尺度实证小分子靶向RNA假结动态构象调控移码效率，机制清晰（光镊+steered MD）、实验闭环（计算预测→体外验证→单分子机制解析），但仅聚焦单一病毒靶标，未构建通用模型或开源代码/模型，泛化性和工具链完整性弱于ESM/AlphaFold级工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次给出RNA假结小分子变构调控的因果性机制证据，非概念包装，但限于单一靶标且工具未开源，属领域内重磅但非范式级工作

papers.title: Diagnosing Semantic Handoff Failures in Agent-Orchestrated Vision-Language-Action Skill Composition
papers.abstract: Long-horizon household tasks require robots to compose many language-conditioned skills, yet the boundary between consecutive skills is rarely explicit. A skill may satisfy its own postcondition while leaving the robot, objects, or camera views in a state from which the next skill cannot reliably start. We study this semantic handoff problem in BEHAVIOR-1K through an agent-orchestrated vision-language-action execution harness. The harness invokes $π_{0.5}$-based skill checkpoints trained from cleaned BEHAVIOR-1K demonstrations, assigns each skill typed arguments and a step budget, and uses multi-view vision-language model verification to decide whether execution should advance, retry, or replan. To separate isolated skill competence from long-horizon compositional robustness, we evaluate the same checkpoints under two initial-state distributions: clean skill-boundary snapshots and chained terminal states produced by previous skills. Selected navigation, grasping, placement, and door-opening skills achieve 77--100% success from clean snapshots under human-reviewed verification, yet composed rollouts still frequently stall from chained states. Execution traces attribute these failures to next-skill readiness, target grounding, and low-level control execution, revealing a substantial gap between single-skill success and reliable long-horizon task completion. These findings turn near-zero end-to-end task success into actionable diagnostics, showing that future VLA skill libraries must learn robustness to the messy chained-state distribution that clean demonstrations systematically underrepresent.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现，即使单个视觉-语言-动作（VLA）技能在干净起始状态下成功率很高（77%-100%），当把它们串起来执行长程家务任务时，因前一技能结束状态混乱（如物体位姿偏移、视角遮挡、机械臂末端姿态不适配），导致下一技能无法可靠启动——作者用BEHAVIOR-1K仿真环境构建诊断框架，量化揭示了‘语义交接失败’这一被长期忽视的瓶颈，并证明当前VLA技能库对真实链式状态分布严重欠拟合。
analysis.claim: VLA技能在单点测试中表现良好，但其在长程任务链式执行中的失败主因是语义交接失败（semantic handoff failure），即前一技能终止状态未满足下一技能的隐含启动前提，而非技能本身能力不足。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB图像+自然语言指令+技能类型与参数约束
analysis.output: 执行决策（前进/重试/重规划）+技能交接诊断归因（next-skill readiness / target grounding / low-level control）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真生成的clean BEHAVIOR-1K演示数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统定义并量化‘语义交接失败’这一长程VLA任务的核心瓶颈，实验设计严谨（clean vs. chained初始分布对比）、归因清晰（三类失败模式）、数据基础扎实（BEHAVIOR-1K），但仅限仿真、无代码/模型开源、未提出修复方案，属于高质量问题诊断而非解决方案，分量介于扎实增量与显著贡献之间。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——不是真突破，但精准戳中当前VLA长程部署的阿喀琉斯之踵，为后续鲁棒技能库设计提供了不可绕过的诊断标尺。

papers.title: Routing on the Stiefel Manifold: When Does Adaptive Subspace Selection Help for Cross-Domain EEG Decoding?
papers.abstract: Cross-domain EEG decoding remains challenging despite advances in Riemannian deep learning: covariance matrices from different subjects occupy systematically distinct regions of the SPD manifold, yet existing domain adaptation methods either require target-domain calibration data or learn subject-specific components that cannot generalise across domains. We propose dynamic Stiefel routing: a pool of $K$ expert projection filters on the Stiefel manifold, each specialised for a different region of the SPD manifold, with each input covariance routed to the most appropriate filter via cross-attention, adapting the subspace projection per sample. A central finding is that this approach, implemented naively, provably collapses to ensemble averaging: when routing weights are uniform, the adaptive filter reduces exactly to an equal-contribution combination of experts, indistinguishable from a single fixed filter. Three structural properties break this degeneracy: a symmetric anchor $W_{\mathrm{base}} \in \mathrm{St}(n,k)$ that removes proximity bias among experts; a frozen domain-discriminative query encoder that decouples routing from task optimisation; and a decoupled key alignment loss that trains expert keys toward stable domain attractors. Together they produce the first genuinely committed and domain-structured routing on SPD manifolds, with consistent gains across three datasets: balanced accuracy improves from $0.773\to 0.823$, $0.757\to 0.809$, and $0.801\to 0.839$, with the alignment strategy determined automatically by a single data-driven rule and no dataset-specific hyperparameter search.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文针对跨被试脑电（EEG）解码中协方差矩阵在SPD流形上分布偏移的问题，提出一种在Stiefel流形上动态路由输入协方差到多个专家投影滤波器的方法，并通过三项结构设计（对称锚点、冻结查询编码器、解耦的键对齐损失）避免路由退化为简单平均，从而实现真正有区分度的自适应子空间选择。
analysis.claim: 在SPD流形上的跨域EEG解码中，只有同时满足对称锚点约束、冻结域判别性查询编码、以及解耦键对齐损失这三项结构条件时，Stiefel流形上的动态路由才能打破退化为均匀加权平均的固有缺陷，实现真正有域结构感知的自适应子空间选择。
analysis.input: EEG信号导出的协方差矩阵（SPD流形元素）
analysis.output: 经Stiefel流形投影后的低维特征向量（用于后续分类）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅需多被试EEG协方差矩阵（含源/目标被试）
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：首次在SPD/Stiefel几何框架下系统揭示并解决EEG跨被试路由退化问题，有理论证明+三数据集验证+消融支撑；但未涉及实时闭环、神经反馈或临床部署，未突破EEG解码范式（仍属离线批处理分类），与所列基石工作（如BCI语音合成、脊髓接口步态重建等具身闭环神经调控）存在代际差距。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——解决了Riemannian EEG领域一个被忽视但关键的路由退化机制问题，但仍是离线分类层面的算法改进，未触及神经接口的实时性、闭环控制或临床功能性恢复。

papers.title: EEGDancer: Dynamic Emotion Latent Space Masked Modeling with Reinforcement Learning for EEG Continuous Emotion Prediction
papers.abstract: Continuous electroencephalography (EEG) emotion prediction aims to model the temporal evolution of human emotional states from EEG signals. Unlike conventional discrete emotion recognition, continuous prediction requires capturing long-range temporal dependencies and coherent emotional dynamics. However, existing methods mainly rely on point-wise regression and directly model noisy high-dimensional EEG features, limiting their ability to characterize continuous emotional evolution.To address these challenges, we propose EEGDancer, a dynamic emotional latent space learning framework for continuous EEG emotion prediction. The framework integrates vector-quantized representation learning, masked temporal modeling, and reinforcement learning-based trajectory optimization into a unified architecture.Specifically, a causal spatiotemporal Vector-Quantization Variational Autoencoder (VQ-VAE) is designed to learn structured emotional prototypes and construct a discrete-continuous emotional latent space from EEG signals. Based on the learned latent representations, a Transformer-based masked dynamic modeling strategy captures long-range emotional dependencies and temporal evolution patterns. Furthermore, continuous emotion prediction is formulated as a sequential decision-making problem, and a Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) framework is introduced to optimize emotional prediction trajectories at the sequence level instead of frame-wise local fitting.Extensive experiments on the SEED, SEED-IV, and Long-Term Naturalistic Emotion datasets demonstrate that EEGDancer consistently outperforms existing machine learning and deep learning methods. Ablation studies further verify the effectiveness of the proposed latent space and reinforcement learning-based trajectory optimization for modeling continuous EEG emotional dynamics.

analysis.tldr: 提出EEGDancer框架，用向量量化VAE构建情绪潜空间，再用Transformer做掩码建模捕捉长时序情绪演化，并引入强化学习（SAC）优化整段预测轨迹，而非逐帧回归，提升EEG连续情绪预测的动态建模能力。
analysis.claim: 通过构建离散-连续混合情绪潜空间并结合序列级强化学习轨迹优化，能更准确地建模EEG信号中真实、连贯、长程的情绪动态演化过程。
analysis.input: 原始或预处理的多通道EEG时间序列信号
analysis.output: 连续维度的情绪值（如效价/唤醒度）随时间变化的平滑轨迹
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开EEG情绪数据集（SEED等），无真实闭环交互或生理反馈依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 虽整合VQ-VAE+Transformer+SAC较新颖，但仍在经典EEG情绪回归范式内改进：未突破信噪比瓶颈、未验证跨被试泛化、未接入实时闭环、未解决EEG个体差异根本难题；所有实验均在离线batch模式下进行，指标提升属扎实但窄域增量（+2.3% CCC），远未达脑机接口领域里程碑级分量（如90+分需临床可用性、跨天稳定性、单次校准等硬指标）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将已有AI组件（VQ-VAE、Transformer、SAC）针对性适配到EEG连续情绪预测任务，结构合理、实验完整，但未触及该领域核心瓶颈（如个体漂移、低信噪比鲁棒性、在线适应），属于高质量方法学拼装，非原理突破。

papers.title: Learned Image Compression for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly rely on high-frequency multi-camera observations, making visual communication a major bottleneck for real-time robotic control in bandwidth-constrained or distributed deployment settings. Existing image and video codecs, however, are designed to preserve generic visual fidelity rather than the control performance of downstream VLA policies. In this work, we introduce SPARC (SPatially Adaptive Rate Control), a learned image compression framework tailored for VLA-driven robots. Our key observation is that the importance of visual information varies substantially across both camera views and spatial regions within an image. Based on this observation, SPARC employs a lightweight temporal mask selector that adaptively allocates bitrate over latent representations according to task relevance while leveraging temporal context. We further introduce a tilted rate loss that stabilizes training by reducing the tendency of entropy-based objectives to over-suppress rare yet task-critical visual patterns. Experiments on diverse robotic benchmarks, including RoboCasa365, VLABench, and LIBERO, show that SPARC consistently achieves stronger control performance than conventional image/video codecs and recent learned compression methods under the same bitrate budget. We additionally demonstrate real-world deployment benefits in remote-control settings, where our method substantially improves the bitrate-success tradeoff.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出SPARC，一种专为视觉-语言-动作（VLA）机器人设计的图像压缩方法，它根据任务重要性动态分配不同图像区域和摄像头的码率，从而在相同带宽下提升下游VLA策略的控制性能。
analysis.claim: 针对VLA模型对多视角高频视觉输入的带宽瓶颈，提出任务感知的空间-时序自适应图像压缩框架SPARC，显著提升同等码率下的机器人控制性能。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB图像序列
analysis.output: 压缩后的潜在表示（用于直接馈入VLA策略）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真环境中的VLA策略反馈信号进行训练，未使用真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：首次将VLA任务目标显式嵌入图像压缩优化目标，有跨多个仿真基准（RoboCasa365/VLABench/LIBERO）的实证，但仅限仿真、无真实机器人验证、未开源代码/模型、未挑战VLA核心架构或泛化能力，本质是通信层工程优化，不改变VLA建模范式或解决其根本性泛化/鲁棒性难题。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了VLA部署中带宽受限下的视觉编码适配问题，但未触及VLA本身的能力边界，也未提供可复现的开放资源，属于高质量子系统级改进

papers.title: A novel High-Throughput Ligase-Independent Mapping method to detect Viral Integration Sites
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Integrated DNA elements are central to virology, functional genomics, and gene therapy, but current insertion-site mapping methods often rely on restriction digestion, ligation, or complex sequencing workflows that introduce bias and limit recovery. Here, we present Terminal Mapping, a high-throughput method that identifies host–insert junctions without restriction enzymes or DNA ligation. The workflow combines linear amplification from a known terminal sequence, enrichment of single-stranded products, terminal transferase-mediated poly-A tailing, and PCR amplification for Illumina or Oxford Nanopore sequencing. Applied to Jurkat T cells transduced with HIV-1- and SIVmac251-derived vectors, Terminal Mapping recovered more HIV-1 insertion sites than inverse PCR, reproduced known integration biases, and showed improved robustness with long-read sequencing. It revealed shared but quantitatively distinct HIV-1 and SIVmac251 hotspots, as well as substantial differences between Jurkat cell sources. Comparison of 5′ and 3′ LTR-derived reads also provided an internal control for unintegrated viral DNA. Terminal Mapping therefore offers a rapid and flexible platform for profiling integrated genetic elements across vectors and cellular contexts.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种不依赖限制性内切酶和DNA连接酶的高通量病毒整合位点检测新方法（Terminal Mapping），通过线性扩增、单链富集、末端加A尾和PCR，实现对宿主-病毒DNA连接处的直接测序，显著提升检出数量、鲁棒性和适用性。
analysis.claim: Terminal Mapping 能在不使用限制酶和连接酶的前提下，以更高灵敏度、更低偏差、更强鲁棒性，全面刻画病毒整合位点图谱，并支持跨病毒株、跨细胞来源和长读长测序的比较分析。
analysis.input: 基因组DNA样本（含整合的病毒前病毒）
analysis.output: 宿主-病毒整合位点的精确坐标（5′/3′ LTR-junction reads）及定量分布图谱
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量方法学创新：实证覆盖HIV/SIV双病毒、Jurkat多批次来源、短读+长读平台，复现已知偏好并发现新生物学差异；但未开源代码/模型，未构建社区标准基准，影响力限于病毒整合检测子领域，远未达AlphaFold级范式突破或ESM级通用模型地位。

papers.title: UniLM-Nav: A Unified Framework for Zero-Shot Last-Mile Navigation
papers.abstract: Mobile manipulation requires a robot to navigate to a target object or receptacle and then perform intended manipulation. However, reaching the vicinity of the target does not guarantee a manipulation-ready base pose, a problem known as last-mile navigation. Prior methods for last-mile navigation either rely on manual pose annotation or task-specific training, limiting their scalability to open-vocabulary settings with fine-grained spatial constraints. We propose UniLM-Nav, a unified framework for zero-shot open-vocabulary last-mile navigation. UniLM-Nav decomposes last-mile navigation into view selection, task-conditioned affordance grounding, and geometry-aware base-pose reasoning, all resolved with a shared multimodal large language model (MLLM) backend. Specifically, UniLM-Nav first selects a reference view that best captures the target object or receptacle from recently collected observations. It then grounds task-relevant affordance point in the selected view and lifts the result into the robot-centric coordinate frame. Finally, conditioned on the grounded affordance, task context, and robot geometry, it infers a manipulation-ready base pose for the robot. We evaluate UniLM-Nav on the OVMM benchmark, where it outperforms the previous state-of-the-art method, MoTo, by 3.13 percentage points. Analyses show that the components of our method are crucial to final performance, and that the choice of MLLM also has a substantial effect. We further deploy UniLM-Nav on a Unitree B2 quadruped robot with a 6-DoF Unitree Z1 manipulator, validating its applicability to real-world mobile manipulation tasks.

analysis.tldr: 提出UniLM-Nav框架，用一个共享的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）统一完成零样本、开放词汇下的‘最后一英里’导航——即让移动机械臂自主找到能执行抓取/放置操作的精确基座位姿，无需人工标注位姿或任务微调。

papers.title: PSG-Nav: Probabilistic Scene Graph Navigation via Multiverse Decision Making
papers.abstract: Open-vocabulary navigation requires embodied agents to manage significant perception uncertainty stemming from semantic ambiguity and model errors. However, most existing works settle for local optimal deterministic approaches, depriving complex navigation decision-making over multiple composite possibilities that are critical for globally better solutions. In this paper, we propose Probabilistic Scene Graph Navigation (PSG-Nav), which constructs a 3D Probabilistic Scene Graph that uses full semantic categorical distributions to account for perception uncertainty. To efficiently use the local distributions to compose and reason about the optimal navigation landmarks, we propose Multiverse Decision to sample multiple most likely world settings from the joint distribution, and evaluate navigation landmarks based on the compatibility between landmarks and multiverses. To mitigate false positives due to epistemic uncertainty in open-vocabulary navigation, we introduce the Evidential Experience Calibrator, which enables online lifelong adaptation by cross-validating detections against memories of past successes and failures. Extensive experiments on widely-used benchmarks MP3D, HM3D, and HSSD demonstrate that PSG-Nav establishes new state-of-the-art results, achieving Success Rates of 66.1%, 44.8%, and 67.9%, respectively. Code is available at: https://psg-nav.github.io/

papers.title: Using protein language models for pangenome construction
papers.abstract: Current pangenome construction methods rely largely on nucleotide or protein sequence alignment, limiting their ability to detect remote orthologs and semantic relations. We introduce a novel method that leverages protein language model embeddings to capture functional and semantic relationships beyond sequence similarity. Our approach employs approximate nearest-neighbor search coupled with a clustering step utilizing HDBSCAN, DBSCAN, or weighted single-linkage clustering with multiple similarity thresholds. The method utilizes GPU acceleration, dynamic batching, and ONNX optimization to scale approximately linearly with the number of proteins, enabling the analysis of datasets containing millions of proteins. We evaluated our approach on a randomly sampled subset of OrthoDB and the CAFA5 dataset, benchmarking it against SCARAP. SCARAP is a recently published tool with similar performance to a variety of other common tools for computing pangenomics. Our benchmarking demonstrates that our method produces more specific clusters than SCARAP across both datasets. SCARAP excelled in term consistency within clusters on the OrthoDB dataset, where labels are inferred with sequence alignment (using MMseqs2). Both methods face a significant degradation in term consistency when transitioning to the experimentally validated CAFA5 dataset, ultimately resulting in similar term consistency scores for both approaches. Crucially, our approach yields superior cluster quality on both datasets and significantly outperforms SCARAP across all metrics of functional consistency and coherence on the experimental CAFA5 dataset. Finally, we demonstrate the method's scalability and utility by characterizing the pangenome of 1,034 Streptomyces genomes. The pipeline is available for use at our GitHub: https://github.com/jakob949/pan_genome

papers.title: Dreaming when Necessary: Advancing World Action Models with Adaptive Multi-Modal Reasoning
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) offer a promising approach to embodied intelligence, yet existing methods rely heavily on video prediction as action priors and lack adaptive multimodal reasoning, limiting their effectiveness on long-horizon, complex tasks. We observe that WAMs require different multimodal reasoning modes under different execution contexts: textual reasoning is essential during task transitions to guide high-level action prediction, while visual reasoning is critical during fine-grained manipulation for precise control. Motivated by this observation, we propose \textbf{AdaWAM}, a world action model with adaptive multimodal reasoning abilities. AdaWAM integrates a lightweight dynamic router that autonomously triggers textual or visual reasoning as needed during task execution. Experiments on both simulated and real-world embodied tasks show that AdaWAM substantially improves inference efficiency while outperforming state-of-the-art embodied policies. Codes and demos are available at: https://adawam.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 提出AdaWAM模型，通过一个轻量动态路由模块，在任务执行中自动切换文本推理（用于高层任务转换）和视觉推理（用于精细操作），提升世界动作模型在长程复杂任务中的效率与性能。

papers.title: TORL-VLA: Tactile Guided Online Reinforcement Learning for Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have become a powerful framework for robotic manipulation, and recent studies have introduced tactile or force feedback into VLAs to address contact-rich tasks. However, these models are typically deployed as offline policies. When contact conditions shift from the training distribution, the policy cannot perform online adaptation, leading to problems such as inappropriate contact forces and inefficient retries. Therefore, we propose TORL-VLA, a tactile-guided online reinforcement learning framework that couples tactile feedback with policy refinement for contact-rich manipulation. Our method introduces a tactile-derived wrench-aware VLA to predict reference actions and future wrench sequences, while a lightweight online RL module is used to refine the reference actions. To stabilize learning from mixed exploratory policy-generated and human-intervention data, we introduce an intervention-censored critic that prevents post-intervention success from being wrongly credited to policy-generated actions preceding intervention. Real-robot experiments on long-horizon contact-rich tasks, including latch manipulation, coffee-cup placement, and egg handling, show that TORL-VLA improves success rates at both subtask and full-task levels, as well as time-bounded execution efficiency over strong baselines.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个能边操作边根据触觉反馈实时调整动作的机器人控制框架TORL-VLA，在真实机器人上完成插销、放咖啡杯、拿鸡蛋等接触密集任务，通过触觉感知预估力矩序列+轻量在线强化学习微调动作，解决了离线VLA模型无法适应接触条件变化的问题。

papers.title: AgniNav: Configuration-Driven Cross-Embodiment Local Planning for Robot Navigation
papers.abstract: Monocular local navigation is attractive for lightweight robots, but existing vision-based policies often couple perception to a specific body, camera height, and footprint, making transfer from wheeled bases to legged platforms dependent on retraining or active depth hardware. This paper introduces AgniNav, a configuration-driven local navigation framework that standardizes cross-embodiment transfer at the collision-envelope level. Each robot is specified by a measurable four-parameter safety envelope: collision-relevant height, front length, rear length, and half width. The height parameter conditions an image-to-scan network to predict a one-dimensional, collision-relevant pseudo-laserscan from a monocular color image, while the remaining footprint parameters configure a dimension-aware local planner for collision checking. Training uses height-conditioned column-minimum scan labels generated from paired color-depth data, allowing the same image to supervise different safety envelopes without collecting robot-specific data. To the best of our knowledge, AgniNav is the first monocular local-navigation framework that jointly conditions perception and planning on a shared collision-envelope configuration for zero-retraining deployment across wheeled, quadruped, and humanoid platforms. Real-robot experiments on a Turtlebot2, Unitree Go2, and Accelerated Evolution K1 achieve 39/40, 18/20, and 18/20 successes with 0/40, 1/20, and 2/20 collisions, respectively, while running at 30 Hz on Jetson Orin.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫AgniNav的框架，用单目相机+4个可测量的机器人安全包络参数（高度、前后长、半宽），让同一个导航模型无需重训练就能部署在轮式、四足、人形机器人上，实测三个真机平台成功率高、碰撞极少、实时性好。
