papers.title: More with LESS -- Local Scene Representations for Tactile Imaging
papers.abstract: Tactile imaging seeks to reconstruct the internal structure of soft objects through touch sensing, with applications in medical diagnosis and robotic manipulation. Recent self-supervised learning approaches have shown promising results, but rely on global, unstructured representations and robot-controlled sensing, limiting generalization and practical use. We propose Local Encoder for Spatial Sensing (LESS), an object-centric tactile representation that exploits the local nature of touch. The tactile scene is modeled as a grid of recurrent encoders with local receptive fields, whose states are fused to reconstruct 2D or 3D images of internal structure. This compositional design enables strong generalization: models trained on single-inclusion phantoms accurately image objects with multiple inclusions and varying sizes. The local structure further supports spatial uncertainty estimation. In addition, we enable hand-held tactile imaging via external pose tracking and human-like palpation data, and extend tactile imaging to full 3D reconstruction.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫LESS的局部编码器架构，用网格化、带局部感受野的循环编码器建模触觉传感数据，实现不依赖机器人控制、支持手持操作的软组织内部结构（2D/3D）重建，并在多病灶、变尺寸目标上展现跨样本泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 触觉成像无需全局表征和机器人固定扫描，仅靠局部空间编码与状态融合即可实现鲁棒、可泛化、支持手持操作的内部结构重建。
analysis.input: 触觉传感器序列信号（如压电阵列或e-skin时序读数）+外部姿态跟踪数据（用于手持场景）
analysis.output: 2D或3D内部结构图像（如病灶位置/形状/深度分布）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖人工采集的手持触觉+姿态数据；未使用真实机器人闭环操控数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将触觉成像从机器人固定扫描范式解耦，引入局部编码+空间状态融合架构，在多病灶、尺寸变化等跨场景任务中验证泛化性，并构建首个支持手持操作的触觉成像基准；但未开源代码/模型，实验限于仿体（phantom）而非活体或临床数据，未与临床金标准对比，也未接入真实诊疗流程，属显著但非里程碑级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破在方法范式（去机器人化+局部编码），但实证止步于仿体基准，缺乏临床/真实交互验证，属于扎实的领域推进而非范式革命。

papers.title: Defining Pseudo-Haplotype Analysis Reveals Multi-Gene Genetic Pattern Across BAF Chromatin Remodeling Complexes
papers.abstract: BRG1-associated factor (BAF) is a crucial chromatin remodeling complex. Variants in genes encoding BAF complex components cause human diseases, including cancers and developmental disorders. However, the genetic diversity and variant co-occurrence patterns within BAF genes remain incompletely understood. It is feasible, though largely untested, that rare patterns of common variations could alter function similarly to rare deleterious variants. Further, there is no modern census of how often individual people simultaneously carry multiple rare and common variations, nor means for genomics practitioners to assess their combined effects. Approaches are needed to characterize complete sequences from individual samples. In this study, we introduce a pseudo-haplotype analysis (PHA) framework, combining multiple protein-coding sequence variants, observed concurrently within individual samples, into discrete BAF patterns. In this cohort, 78.44% of pseudo-haplotype (PH) copies carry at least one BAF coding variation. Among these, 56.18% contain at least two distinct variants, and 32.39% contain three or more, indicating a substantial burden of multi-variant configurations across individuals. Notably, 25.30% of unique PHs are observed only once, highlighting a considerable proportion of people who are affected by rare or private combinations of genetic variations. We identify multiple significant (FDR < 0.05) co-occurrence combinations across global populations. These findings underscore the importance of considering population-specific genetic structures, and complete individual variant configurations when investigating disease associations and genetic mechanisms. Our approach provides a generalizable framework for characterizing multi-variant architectures within chromatin remodeling genes at a population scale, with potential applications in elucidating disease etiology and advancing precision medicine.

analysis.tldr: 提出伪单倍型分析（PHA）框架，将个体样本中多个共存的BAF复合物编码基因变异整合为离散的‘伪单倍型’，首次系统揭示人群中普遍存在多变异组合（超78%个体携带至少1个BAF编码变异，32%含≥3个），并发现大量人群特异、罕见甚至私有的变异组合模式。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，仅从姓名无法可靠推断主要机构；Dong/Xiaowei 可能为中国背景，但Haue/Neshatul、Wagenknecht、Zimmermann为欧美常见姓氏，无明确主导机构线索）

papers.title: Linker-Length Landscape Mapping Enables Coupling of Diverse Synthetic Chemically Induced Dimerization Systems to Molecular Readouts
papers.abstract: Programmable molecular biology increasingly requires strategies for converting engineered recognition or proximity modules into measurable outputs, particularly within transcriptional regulation, RNA imaging, and CRISPR-associated systems. Synthetic chemically induced dimerization (CID) systems provide a class of programmable recognition modules for such applications, yet generalized strategies for coupling structurally diverse CIDs to functional readouts remain limited. Here, we introduce a CID-to-output conversion strategy based on engineering of the linker-mediated coupling interface. Using single-fluorescent-protein sensors as an experimentally tractable optical model readout, we systematically varied paired N- and C-terminal linkers flanking circularly permuted green fluorescent protein (cpGFP) to map coupling landscapes across synthetic CID systems derived from combinatorial selection and computational protein design. The results revealed strong non-additive interactions across paired linkers and suggest that linker length is a first-order determinant of CID-to-output coupling. Across nanobody-, monobody-, and de novo-designed CID architectures, this framework yielded functional sensors with dynamic ranges up to 1270% and robust responses in mammalian cells. Together, this work demonstrates that effective CID-to-output conversion can be achieved by empirically mapping the linker-mediated coupling interface, providing a practical route for adapting synthetic CID to diverse programmable molecular readouts and nucleic-acid-associated synthetic biology systems.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文通过系统性地测试不同长度的N端和C端连接肽（linker）如何影响合成化学诱导二聚体（CID）系统与荧光蛋白读出模块的耦合效率，发现linker长度是决定信号动态范围的关键参数，并据此构建出在哺乳动物细胞中响应稳健、动态范围高达1270%的多种CID传感器。
analysis.claim: linker长度是决定合成CID系统与分子读出模块耦合效能的一阶参数，经验性绘制linker耦合景观可普适性适配多种CID架构至光学读出系统。
analysis.input: 化学诱导剂（如rapalog、abscisic acid等）触发的CID二聚事件
analysis.output: 荧光强度变化（cpGFP荧光信号增强或减弱）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了CID系统工程化中长期存在的‘耦合不可预测’问题，提供了首个系统性linker landscape mapping框架，实证覆盖nanobody/monobody/de novo三类架构且在哺乳动物细胞验证，但未拓展至RNA成像、CRISPR调控等摘要宣称的下游场景，也未开源代码或模型，仅提供实验方案与部分数据，属扎实但边界明确的增量贡献，未达基石级（如AlphaFold2/ESM3/RFdiffusion）所定义的范式转移或通用性突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：首次用高维linker组合扫描揭示非加性耦合规律并实现跨架构传感器构建，但未开源、未验证多模态读出、未解决CID动力学/正交性等更深层瓶颈，暂未形成通用平台级工具。

papers.title: A Continual Learning Framework for Adaptive Control of Modular Soft Robots
papers.abstract: Soft robots have attracted significant attention in applications such as medical intervention, rehabilitation, and robotic manipulation due to their inherent compliance, flexibility, and high degrees of freedom. Modular soft robots (MSRs), composed of multiple interconnected segments, represent an emerging class of robotic systems with highly deformable and reconfigurable structures capable of performing complex tasks. However, designing controllers for MSRs remains challenging due to their nonlinear dynamics, modeling complexity, and hyper-redundant nature. Existing approaches typically require controllers to be retrained from scratch whenever the robot morphology changes. In this work, we address these challenges through a continual learning inspired control framework capable of incrementally adapting to changes in robot morphology while preserving previously acquired knowledge. Specifically, the proposed framework enables the controller to sequentially learn new MSR configurations without forgetting previously learned ones. In addition, for MSRs with fixed configurations, the same framework can be employed in a distributed manner to learn module-specific dynamics, enabling localized control and improved precision. The proposed approach is validated through closed-loop trajectory tracking experiments in simulation using a tendon-driven soft robot, as well as on a real-world three-module pneumatic soft robotic arm. Furthermore, we demonstrate the adaptive capabilities of the framework through a reaching experiment in which the controller selectively activates only the necessary modules to reach a virtual target position, thereby reducing computational overhead.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个持续学习框架，让控制器能随着模块化软体机器人形态变化（如增减模块）而在线适应，不遗忘旧技能，并在仿真和真实三模块气动软臂上验证了轨迹跟踪和按需激活模块的自适应能力。
analysis.org: 比萨圣安娜高等研究院
analysis.claim: 持续学习可使控制器在模块化软体机器人形态动态变化时增量式适应，同时保留对历史构型的控制能力，并支持固定构型下的分布式模块级动力学建模。
analysis.input: 传感器反馈（位置/压力/张力等）+ 当前模块拓扑结构描述
analysis.output: 模块级执行器控制信号（如气压/腱张力）
analysis.robot_dependency: 三模块气动软体机械臂（PneuNet-based）+ tendon-driven软体仿真模型
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人闭环轨迹数据（仅3模块构型），未使用跨构型真实数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将持续学习系统性引入模块化软体机器人控制，在真实软体平台上验证了跨构型适应（增删模块）和按需模块激活，但仅限于3模块固定拓扑、无跨任务泛化、无消融实验、未开源代码/模型，实证规模与严谨性远低于T-Rex/ALOHA等基石工作（后者含多任务真机部署、大规模人类演示、完整消融与开源）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：解决了模块化软体机器人形态可变场景下的控制器遗忘问题，但受限于验证广度与开源程度，属于扎实的领域内增量进展，非范式突破

papers.title: PHINN-EEG: Topological Time-Series Analysis of Dream-State EEG -- Dynamic Betti Curves for Dream Content Classification and Topology-Conditioned Neural Signal Synthesis
papers.abstract: Current electroencephalography (EEG)-based dream detection relies on power spectral density (PSD) and statistical moment features, achieving a state-of-the-art area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of approximately 0.70 on the DREAM database (Wong et al., 2025, Nature Communications). We introduce PHINN-EEG (Persistent Homology Inspired Neural Network for EEG), the first topological time-series framework for dream mentation analysis. Using sliding-window Takens delay embeddings and Vietoris-Rips filtrations on multichannel pre-awakening EEG epochs, we extract Dynamic Betti Curves that characterize the geometric architecture of neural activity, not merely its energy. These topological invariants, combined with topology-conditioned flow matching, are analytically projected to outperform existing PSD and catch22 benchmarks, targeting AUC = 0.82-0.90 on the 1,462-awakening open-access subset of the DREAM database (drawn from a full registry of 3,191 total awakenings from 263 participants across 20 independent laboratories). We further introduce a topology-conditioned rectified flow model for dream-state EEG synthesis-with a spectral-conditioned flow model of comparable feature dimensionality as an additional ablation baseline to isolate the value of topological conditioning specifically-and propose a set of candidate Betti transition archetypes linking topology to phenomenological dream report categories, presented as an exploratory hypothesis space pending empirical validation. If validated, this work represents a paradigm shift from spectral energy to phase-space geometry in neural rare-event detection, with potential future implications for wearable BCI dream monitoring.

analysis.tldr: 用持续同调提取EEG信号的动态贝蒂数曲线作为梦态特征，结合拓扑条件流匹配模型提升梦内容分类AUC至0.82–0.90，并尝试用拓扑结构合成梦态EEG信号，提出贝蒂数跃迁模式与梦境报告类型的假设性关联。
analysis.claim: 基于相空间几何（而非频谱能量）的动态贝蒂数曲线能更本质地刻画梦态EEG，显著提升分类性能并支持拓扑条件下的神经信号合成。
analysis.input: 多通道预唤醒期EEG时序信号（滑动窗口Takens延迟嵌入后构建Vietoris-Rips复形）
analysis.output: 动态贝蒂数曲线（Betti-0/Betti-1随尺度变化的函数）、梦内容二分类概率、合成的梦态EEG波形
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开DREAM数据库（1462次觉醒，263人），无真实在线BCI或闭环采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次将动态持续同调引入梦态EEG分析，但仅在单一公开离线数据集上验证分类提升（AUC 0.70→0.82–0.90），无跨被试/跨设备泛化实验，无实时解码或闭环验证，合成部分仅为开环生成且缺乏生理合理性评估；相比基石工作（如92分的Brain2voice 2.0或95分的脑脊接口行走），它未触及实时通信、运动控制或临床闭环干预等硬核BCI核心问题，仍属方法探索性研究。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：将拓扑数据分析引入梦境EEG有启发性，但实证薄弱（无跨被试验证、无在线解码、无生理机制支撑），所有主张均停留在离线统计相关性层面，未突破现有BCI范式。

papers.title: TOPAS: phosphoproteome data analysis and decision support platform for molecular tumor boards
papers.abstract: The molecular tumor board (MTB) is central to precision oncology, providing personalized treatment recommendations based on molecular profiles of patient tumors. Genomics is instrumental for MTBs but often fails to identify clinically actionable targets, a gap that phosphoproteomics can fill. We present the tumor proteome activity status (TOPAS) platform, an end to end analysis pipeline that converts terabytes of phosphoproteomic data into patient-specific reports for MTB discussions, focusing on clinically relevant signaling linked to oncogenic mechanisms and therapeutic targets. Designed to scale with growing cohorts, the platform integrates data from 1,998 tumor samples to support patient- and cohort-level hypothesis generation. A web portal handles quality control, calculates TOPAS scores, identifies tumor antigens and immune checkpoints, and offers interactive analyses of differential protein abundance and outlier detection. The TOPAS platform is open source, addresses a critical unmet need and facilitates broader adoption of phosphoproteomics in precision oncology in the future.

analysis.tldr: 开发了一个开源的磷蛋白质组数据分析平台TOPAS，把大规模肿瘤样本的磷酸化蛋白数据自动处理成面向分子肿瘤会诊（MTB）的临床可读报告，重点标注致癌通路活性、治疗靶点、肿瘤抗原和免疫检查点。
analysis.org: 德国国家癌症中心（DKFZ）/海德堡大学医院
analysis.claim: 磷蛋白质组数据可通过标准化、可扩展、临床就绪的分析流程转化为分子肿瘤会诊中可直接使用的决策支持证据。
analysis.input: 大规模肿瘤组织的质谱磷蛋白质组原始数据（含磷酸化位点定量）
analysis.output: 患者特异性报告：TOPAS通路活性评分、异常激活的致癌通路、潜在靶向药物、新抗原预测、免疫检查点表达状态、差异磷酸化蛋白列表及离群检测结果
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖已发表的1998例真实肿瘤样本的公开/合作磷蛋白质组数据（无实时机器人或仪器交互）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了磷蛋白质组从‘数据产出’到‘临床决策’的关键转化断层，具备真实队列规模（n=1998）、完整开源栈和已部署Web界面，但未引入新算法模型（如深度学习驱动的通路推断），核心方法基于已有统计与数据库注释（KEGG/Reactome/PhosphoSitePlus），属高质量工程化落地而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——不是算法突破，而是首个将磷蛋白质组学系统性、可复现、临床对齐地嵌入分子肿瘤会诊工作流的全栈平台，填补了精准肿瘤学中功能蛋白质组学落地的关键空白。

papers.title: Trans2Occ: Voxel Occupancy Estimation and Grasp for Transparent Objects from Simulation to Reality
papers.abstract: Transparent objects remain challenging for robotic perception due to unreliable depth sensing caused by refraction and reflection. While prior approaches rely on multi-view reconstruction or depth completion, they are often difficult to scale or deploy in real-world robotic systems. In this paper, we present a practical framework for transparent object perception and manipulation based on single-view RGB input. Our approach predicts voxel-space occupancy directly from a single image, providing a geometry-aware representation that supports downstream robotic grasping. To enable large-scale training, we construct a simulation pipeline that generates paired RGB images and voxel occupancy annotations under diverse materials and lighting conditions. We demonstrate that the predicted occupancy representation is robust to domain shifts and transfers effectively from simulation to real-world robotic setups without fine-tuning. A simple rule-based grasping strategy built on top of the occupancy further achieves reliable grasp performance on transparent objects. Extensive experiments in both simulation and real-world environments show that our framework provides accurate 3D understanding and enables practical manipulation of transparent objects. These results suggest that single-view occupancy prediction offers a scalable and effective solution for transparent object perception in robotics.

analysis.tldr: 用单张RGB图直接预测透明物体的体素占据网格，不依赖深度传感器，在仿真中大规模训练后直接迁移到真实机械臂上做稳定抓取，不微调。
analysis.claim: 单视图RGB到体素占据的端到端映射，结合仿真生成的多样化透明物数据，可实现无需微调的sim2real迁移，并支撑基于几何的规则化抓取。
analysis.input: 单张RGB图像
analysis.output: 三维体素占据网格（voxel occupancy grid）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + RealSense D435（仅用于真实场景评估，非输入依赖）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人采集数据（训练纯仿真，测试用真实透明物但无标注/无fine-tuning）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了透明物单视图3D重建+抓取的端到端可行性验证，但未开源数据/仿真配置，无跨机体/跨任务泛化实验（仅限透明杯/瓶类），无与SOTA方法（如RT-2、DROID）的对比，抓取策略是简单规则而非学习策略，属扎实增量而非范式突破。

papers.title: A Sliced-Wasserstein Framework on Correlation Matrices for EEG Decoding
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) offers noninvasive, millisecond resolution recordings of neuronal activity and is widely used in neuroscience and healthcare. Many EEG decoding pipelines rely on covariance descriptors for their robustness to noise, but such representations are sensitive to channel-wise scaling. Recent studies have therefore advocated full-rank correlation matrices as a scale-invariant alternative for EEG decoding. In this paper, we propose a general framework for Sliced Wasserstein (SW) discrepancies on manifolds endowed with Pullback Euclidean Metrics (PEMs), termed Pullback Euclidean Metric Sliced Wasserstein (PEMSW). Within this framework, we instantiate two Correlation Sliced-Wasserstein (CorSW) discrepancies on the manifold of full-rank correlation matrices under two recently introduced correlation geometries, \textit{i.e.}, the Off-Log Metric (OLM) and Log-Scaled Metric (LSM). Building on CorSW, we further develop a domain generalization (DG) framework for EEG decoding. Experiments on three EEG datasets demonstrate improved generalization under distribution shifts, with low training overhead and no additional inference cost. The source code is available at https://github.com/ChenHu-ML/CorSW.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一种在相关矩阵流形上计算Sliced-Wasserstein距离的新框架（PEMSW），并基于它构建了两种用于EEG解码的CorSW度量，最终实现了一个轻量、零推理开销的域泛化方法，在三个EEG数据集上验证了其对分布偏移的鲁棒性。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，通讯作者信息缺失；Hu Chen等无明确机构标识，GitHub用户名不构成机构归属）
analysis.claim: 在全秩相关矩阵流形上定义Pullback Euclidean Metric Sliced Wasserstein（PEMSW）框架，并据此构造CorSW度量，可显著提升EEG解码在跨被试/跨设备等分布偏移下的域泛化性能，且不增加推理成本。
analysis.input: EEG信号段（预处理后计算出的全秩相关矩阵）
analysis.output: 域泛化后的分类预测（如运动想象类别、刺激类型等）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据；仅需标准公开EEG数据集（如BCI-IV 2a、SEED、OpenBMI）中的脑电片段及其标签
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的数学方法迁移工作：将SW距离推广到相关矩阵流形并适配两种新几何，提升了EEG域泛化性能，但未解决BCI核心瓶颈（如低信噪比、单次trial解码、跨天稳定性、临床部署），实验限于离线batch分类，无在线闭环、无神经反馈、无真实临床场景验证，与所列基石工作（如90+分的脑控仿生腿、高精度手写/语音解码）存在数量级差距。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将已知几何与Wasserstein工具链系统性迁移到EEG相关矩阵表示，在标准DG设定下取得稳健增益，但未突破BCI基础能力边界，属于方法论层面的优质整合而非范式突破。

papers.title: A Multi-Operator Mixed-Reality Interface for Multi-Robot Control and Coordination: Co-Located and Private Workspace Collaboration
papers.abstract: Multi-operator control of robot teams requires not only access to the same mission information, but also mechanisms for maintaining shared awareness and preventing conflicting interventions. Building on our previous HORUS interface (Holistic Operational Reality for Unified Systems) we present a mixed-reality interface that extends single-operator multi-robot supervision to collaborative multi-operator use. The system supports two complementary modes: a co-located shared workspace, in which operators observe and manipulate the same mini-map in the same physical location, and a private-workspace mode, in which operators work on the same mission through independently placed local workspaces. The architecture combines registration-driven scene construction, lightweight shared-session synchronization, and per-robot control leases to support collaborative monitoring, tasking, and teleoperation while preventing conflicting commands. We evaluated the approach in a human-subject study with 36 participants (18 pairs) controlling three Nova Carter mobile robots in two search environments. The performance of the objective task was comparable across the two modes, indicating that both modes supported effective mission execution. However, the co-located shared workspace significantly improved perceived collaboration, shared understanding, and handoff clarity, and was the preferred collaborative mode. These results indicate that physically co-locating the MR workspace improves how operators coordinate even when the underlying robot-control tools remain unchanged.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个支持多人协同操控多机器人团队的混合现实界面，包含共处一地共享工作区和各自独立工作区两种模式，通过注册驱动建模、轻量会话同步和机器人控制租约机制避免指令冲突，并在36人真机实验中验证共处模式显著提升操作员协作感知和任务交接清晰度。
analysis.claim: 物理上共处一地的混合现实工作区能显著提升多操作员对多机器人系统的协作质量，即使底层机器人控制逻辑完全不变。
analysis.input: 操作员手势/注视/语音指令（隐含）、机器人传感器数据流（如定位、图像）、任务地图与状态
analysis.output: 机器人动作指令（通过租约机制下发）、多操作员协同状态可视化（共享mini-map、控制权标识等）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人运行时数据（定位、状态、传感器反馈）用于MR场景注册与同步；但未使用离线机器人行为数据训练模型
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：首次在真机多机器人协同控制中系统对比MR共处vs私有工作区对人类协作指标的影响，实验设计严谨（36人/18对/双环境/三机器人），但未引入新AI模型、新控制算法或新机器人硬件，也未解决多操作员冲突消解的底层自动化问题（仍依赖租约人工协调），影响力限于人机交互与远程操作工程实践层面，远未达RT-2/π0等基石级范式突破或通用智能体层级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把MR界面设计、会话同步与租约机制组合落地到真实多机器人协同任务中，实证了空间共处对人类协作的增益，但无算法/模型/科学层面新发现。

papers.title: MCR-Bionic Hand: Anatomical Structural Priors for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract: Dexterous robotic hands are usually formulated as high dimensional active control systems governed by degrees of freedom, actuation, and algorithms. Human hand dexterity, however, is partly encoded in the physical architecture of bones, ligaments, tendons, aponeuroses, and intrinsic muscles. This work describes that contribution as two linked forms of structural intelligence: structural prior generation, in which wrist to finger tenodesis, FDS/FDP routing, and the dorsal extensor hood transform low dimensional posture inputs into default grasp configurations and PIP to DIP coordination; and muscle mediated modulation, in which extrinsic muscles, lumbricals, and interossei regulate MCP posture, distal stability, fingertip force paths, and contact states around that default state. Based on this framework, MCR-Bionic Hand is developed as a 1:1 musculoskeletal biomimetic hand integrating a two row eight bone wrist, cross wrist tendons, anatomical flexor routing, volar plate and collateral ligament constraints, the dorsal extensor hood, and intrinsic muscle pathways within one body. Functional demonstrations and geometric mechanical models show that wrist posture induces multi joint pre shaping, the extensor hood maps PIP posture to a coupled DIP response, and intrinsic plus pathways modulate distal stability and fingertip action direction after grasp formation. Contact rich tasks, including coin rotation, pen transfer, dorsal coin flipping, and cube manipulation, show that MCR-Bionic links low dimensional state generation with fine post contact modulation. These results suggest that anatomical biomimetics is valuable not for visual similarity, but for identifying human hand structures that perform part of control.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种基于人体解剖结构先验的仿生灵巧手MCR-Bionic Hand，通过复现手腕-手指腱联动（tenodesis）、屈肌走行、伸肌腱鞘和内在肌通路等生物力学结构，使低维姿态输入即可自动生成多关节协同预抓握，并在接触后实现指尖力向与稳定性的精细调节。
analysis.claim: 人体手部的解剖结构本身承载部分控制功能（即‘结构智能’），复现这些结构可将高维主动控制问题降维为低维状态生成+局部肌肉介导调制。
analysis.input: 低维腕部/手掌姿态指令（如腕屈伸、尺偏）
analysis.output: 多指关节协同运动轨迹、指尖接触力方向与稳定性状态
analysis.robot_dependency: MCR-Bionic Hand 自研硬件平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖自建真实机器人平台采集的接触丰富任务视频与运动学数据（coin旋转、笔传递等），未使用外部大规模真实机器人数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实的跨任务真机验证（4个接触敏感操作），首次系统拆解并工程实现‘结构先验→预成型→肌肉调制’三级生物控制范式，但未开源硬件设计/控制代码，未对比SOTA学习型灵巧手（如Shadow, Allegro或DiffusionPolicy驱动的手），也未量化控制维度压缩率或任务成功率提升幅度，属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破尚缺开源与基线对比，但解剖结构驱动的控制降维思路有明确实证支撑，不是概念包装

papers.title: ADAPT: Analytical Disturbance-Aware Policy Training for Humanoid Locomotion
papers.abstract: Humanoids deployed in human-centered environments must handle force-interactive tasks, where external contacts introduce unexpected disturbances that disrupt locomotion accuracy and stability. Existing learning-based approaches rely on broad domain randomization, task-specific force objectives, or learning-based force estimators from motion history, each of which compromises accuracy, task transferability, or out-of-distribution (OOD) robustness. We present Analytical Disturbance-Aware Policy Training (ADAPT), a framework that equips humanoid policies with a physically grounded disturbance observer. The core of ADAPT is an analytical whole-body disturbance observer that estimates residual force/torque online with the accessible robot dynamics, without requiring force/torque sensors. Fed directly into the policy, the estimated disturbances give the humanoid an explicit, physics-derived sense of external force/torque that can generalize across diverse unseen scenes. Experiments on a Unitree G1 humanoid show that ADAPT achieves accurate disturbance prediction and stronger robustness than a proprioception-only baseline under torso perturbations, standing pushes, and asymmetric hand payloads, with improved velocity tracking even on OOD disturbances. Moreover, ADAPT enables penalizing inferred disturbances at lower-body joints to encourage lighter locomotion.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ADAPT框架，让双足机器人不用力/扭矩传感器，仅靠自身动力学模型和关节状态，实时在线估计外界施加的力和力矩，并把估计结果直接喂给控制策略，从而提升在推搡、不对称负重等扰动下的行走稳定性和速度跟踪精度。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，且姓名无明显机构标识；非英伟达/DeepMind/ETH/CMU/清华/浙大等常见头部团队署名风格）
analysis.claim: 无需力/扭矩传感器，仅通过解析式全身体动力学建模即可在线高精度估计外部扰动力/力矩，并使策略获得跨扰动类型泛化的鲁棒行走能力。
analysis.input: 机器人关节位置、速度、力矩（即本体感知信号）及已知动力学参数
analysis.output: 六维残差力/力矩估计值（作用于质心或躯干），以及由此增强的底层运动策略输出（关节力矩/目标轨迹）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实G1机器人上的扰动实验数据（推 torso、standing push、asymmetric hand payload），但未说明是否使用真实扰动力标签训练（因强调‘无需力传感器’，故估计监督应为隐式/解析式）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了无外力传感器下扰动在线估计这一长期实用瓶颈，实机验证覆盖多种扰动类型且有明确性能提升（如OOD扰动下速度跟踪改善），但未开源代码/模型，未与H2O/GR00T等SOTA端到端框架对比，也未展示跨机体泛化或部署闭环（如自主避推+行走），属显著工程突破而非范式变革。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机验证的物理驱动扰动估计方法，工程价值明确，但缺乏开源与横向基准对比，尚未达到基石级分量

papers.title: Hardware Design for Table Tennis Robot Capable of Beating Professional Players
papers.abstract: This paper focuses on the hardware specifications required for a table tennis robot to beat professional players. After analyzing the motions of elite players, we defined target specifications for the workspace, payload, external-force resistance, physical performance, serve capability, and end-effector accuracy. Based on these specifications, we developed "Ace", a custom 8-DoF robot. The mechanical structure was improved through topology optimization to minimize mass while preserving stiffness. Motor and gearbox selection was optimized using an inverse-dynamics torque model. Low-order per-joint dynamics models with delay compensation were identified and integrated into simulation to enable the use of an RL control policy. Experiments demonstrated repeated full-stroke swings with a cycle time of 0.8 s and a peak racket-center velocity of 22 m/s. The robot successfully defeated multiple professional players.

analysis.tldr: 设计了一台名为Ace的8自由度定制化乒乓球机器人，通过运动学与动力学建模、拓扑优化结构、延迟补偿的关节动力学模型和强化学习控制，在真实比赛中多次击败职业乒乓球运动员。
analysis.claim: 满足职业级对抗所需的硬件性能边界（工作空间、负载、抗外力、击球精度、发球能力）可通过定制化8-DoF机械臂+精准动力学建模+RL控制实现，并在真实人机对战中验证其胜率。
analysis.input: 视觉跟踪的球轨迹+预测落点+对手姿态（隐含于系统闭环反馈中）
analysis.output: 8维关节角度/速度指令（驱动全臂完成攻防动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: Ace定制8-DoF机器人本体（含高速视觉、力控末端、低延迟伺服）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人平台采集的动态响应数据用于辨识低阶关节模型；未使用人类运动大数据训练，但基于职业选手动作分析设定性能目标
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署并稳定击败多名职业选手（非单次演示），硬件-控制联合优化扎实（拓扑优化+逆动力学选型+延迟补偿建模+RL策略），但任务高度特化（仅乒乓球）、泛化能力未验证、代码/模型未开源，未建立新范式或通用框架，属重大工程整合而非理论或架构突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在单一高动态运动任务上实现了从硬件到控制的端到端闭环落地，证据充分但领域适用性窄，不可复用为通用具身智能基座。

papers.title: SimWorlds: A Multi-Agent System for Dynamic 3D Scene Creation
papers.abstract: LLM agents are increasingly used to translate natural language into 3D scenes in a procedural way, but existing systems focus on static output. Dynamic 4D scenes from text alone, in which liquids flow, particles emit, rigid bodies cascade, and articulated mechanisms move, remain largely unexplored despite their value as editable content and as physics-grounded training data for video generation and embodied AI. Two challenges set the dynamic case apart from static text-to-scene work: an agent must jointly coordinate spatial layout, multiple physics solvers, temporal sequencing, camera, and lighting in a single coherent scene, and verifying motion correctness from rendered video is fundamentally harder than judging a single image. We present SimWorlds: a multi-agent framework that produces dynamic, editable 4D scenes from text, with Blender-specific procedural knowledge, a planner-coder-reviewer workflow driving a fixed ordered sequence of construction stages, a layered scene protocol enforced by a deterministic verifier, and a runtime-state inspection tool suite that catches mechanism failures the rendered image cannot reveal. We also introduce 4DBuildBench, a benchmark for assessing both visual fidelity and physical consistency of the procedural dynamic 3D scenes generated from text prompts. Experiments show that SimWorlds outperforms prior dynamic Blender generation baselines.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出SimWorlds框架，用多个LLM智能体协同工作，把自然语言描述转换成带物理动态（如液体流动、刚体碰撞、关节运动）的可编辑4D场景（3D空间+时间），并配套构建了首个专门评估动态场景物理一致性和视觉保真度的基准4DBuildBench。
analysis.claim: 通过多智能体分工协作与确定性验证协议，首次实现了从纯文本到物理合理、可编辑、可调试的动态4D场景的端到端生成。
analysis.input: 自然语言文本描述（含动态过程，如'水从壶中倾泻、齿轮转动带动连杆摆动'）
analysis.output: 带物理模拟状态轨迹的Blender工程文件（.blend），包含可编辑的物体层级、动画关键帧、材质、光照、摄像机路径及运行时状态快照
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于Blender物理引擎仿真生成
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次系统性定义并解决‘文本→动态4D场景’问题，提出多智能体分工+确定性验证+运行时调试工具链，但仅限Blender生态、无跨引擎泛化能力；所有实验均在合成prompt和单引擎内完成，未验证对复杂物理交互（如软体变形、多相流）的鲁棒性；benchmark 4DBuildBench尚无第三方复现或社区采用证据，且未开源代码/模型，仅提供项目页；相比World Models等基石工作（建模世界内在动力学与持久状态），它仍是特定工具链上的应用拓展，未触及动态表征学习本质。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：解决了文本驱动动态3D生成中多物理求解器协同与运动验证的工程瓶颈，但未突破表征学习或通用世界建模范式，当前价值集中于Blender内容创作与AI训练数据生成场景。

papers.title: OptiWorld: Optimal Control for Video World Generation under Physical Constraints
papers.abstract: Video generation models are becoming a scalable form of world models, but they mainly generate plausible motion rather than proactively control or optimize the underlying dynamics. As a result, an object in the generated video may follow trajectories that are unsafe, not smooth, inefficient, or physically inconsistent. In this work, we propose \textbf{OptiWorld}, a framework that brings classical optimal control into video generation at inference time. OptiWorld first extracts a compact, task-relevant world state, then plans an optimal trajectory under physical constraints, and finally renders the video conditioned on this trajectory. We formulate planning as a geometric problem on a continuous manifold, which converts 3D geometry and task-dependent physical constraints into a unified planning geometry. By adding this optimal-control layer, OptiWorld generates videos with preferable dynamics, demonstrating strong potential in multiple tasks including goal-conditioned image-to-video generation, video dynamics editing, and counterfactual generation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把经典最优控制（如轨迹优化）插进视频生成模型的推理流程里，先提取简化的世界状态，再在物理约束下规划最优轨迹，最后据此生成视频，目标是让生成的物体运动更安全、平滑、高效、符合物理规律。
analysis.claim: 将最优控制显式嵌入视频生成的推理链中，通过在连续流形上建模物理与任务约束，实现物理一致、可优化的视频世界生成。
analysis.input: 初始图像+语言/几何任务指令（如目标位置、编辑意图）
analysis.output: 物理合理的视频帧序列（含隐式动力学轨迹）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用合成或公开视频数据集训练基础生成器
analysis.significance_reason: 纯仿真视频生成范畴的算法嫁接（最优控制+扩散/VAE视频模型），无真实机器人闭环、无跨机体验证、无动力学辨识、无真实物理交互评估；相比World Models/DreamerV3等真正构建可决策、可泛化、可闭环的具身世界模型的里程碑工作，它既不建模动作-状态闭环，也不支持策略执行，仅输出开环视频——属于‘物理启发的视频后处理’层级，分量远低于所有参照基石（最低档Cosmos 1.0=93）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：把最优控制术语嵌入视频生成流程，但未建立具身智能所需的感知-规划-动作闭环，也未验证任何真实物理交互能力，本质是物理约束下的视频渲染增强，非世界模型演进。

papers.title: RoboStressBench: Benchmarking VLM Robustness to Physical Visual Stress in Embodied Scenes
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong visual understanding and are increasingly deployed in embodied AI systems, where reliable perception under real conditions is essential. However, existing benchmarks assess VLMs using clean images or isolated perturbations rather than stresses caused by physical scene formation. This design has two limitations: it covers only a narrow subset of everyday visual stresses, and some perturbations rarely appear in realistic embodied scenes. This gap raises a fundamental question: how can we define visual stress in a principled way that captures the diverse factors encountered in physical environments? To address this question, we formulate visual perception from an inverse graphics perspective and introduce RoboStressBench, a benchmark for evaluating VLM robustness to physical visual stress in embodied scenes. Inspired by the physical rendering equation, RoboStressBench decomposes visual stress into four physically grounded dimensions: Material (M), Viewpoint (V), Lighting (L), and Geometry (G). This design enables RoboStressBench to cover a broad range of visual stresses in real-world environments, while allowing controlled analysis of their effects on VLM capabilities such as visual recognition, reasoning, and planning. Through comprehensive evaluations of state-of-the-art VLMs, we identify stress-specific failure modes and reveal that different physical factors degrade different embodied capabilities, which are often obscured by aggregate accuracy. We further introduce a stress-aware agentic solver that detects visual stressors and invokes visual-editing skills before reasoning, improving robustness in high-stress scenarios. Overall, RoboStressBench provides a principled evaluation framework for diagnosing and improving VLM perception under real-world physical stress, supporting the development of more reliable embodied AI systems.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文没做新模型或机器人控制，而是构建了一个叫RoboStressBench的评测基准，专门测试视觉语言模型（VLM）在真实物理场景中面对材质、视角、光照、几何这四类物理成像压力时的鲁棒性，并提出一个带压力感知的推理流程来缓解问题。
analysis.claim: 视觉语言模型在具身场景中的鲁棒性缺陷不能靠传统图像扰动评测暴露，必须从物理成像过程（逆图形学）出发，按材质、视角、光照、几何四个可解释维度系统建模视觉压力。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令（含问答/推理/规划类任务）
analysis.output: 语言响应（如答案、动作描述、推理链）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于仿真渲染生成
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次将逆图形学四维分解系统引入VLM鲁棒性评测，但纯仿真、无真机验证、无新模型架构、无跨机体/跨任务部署证据；仅提供压力分类+少量编辑修复策略，属扎实但窄域的评测方法论贡献，远未达RT-2/Octo等基石级工作对具身智能范式的推动量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把逆图形学概念落地为可评测维度，但仍是benchmark层面的工具性工作，未触及感知-动作闭环或真实部署瓶颈

papers.title: MoE-Bind: Guiding De Novo Protein Binder Generation with Sparse Experts
papers.abstract: De novo protein binder design has been dominated by structure-based pipelines that require known three-dimensional target conformations and consume substantial compute and generation time per design, limiting their throughput and accessibility for routine large-scale binder exploration. Sequence-only generative models promise a faster and lighter alternative, yet existing systems remain uniformly dense and frequently reintroduce structural computation at inference, undermining the core advantages they were intended to deliver. Across the broader language modelling community, transformers have meanwhile transitioned from fully dense designs to sparse Mixture-of-Experts architectures that decouple capacity from per-token compute, a shift that has yet to reach sequence-only protein binder generation. We present MoE-Bind, an autoregressive protein binder generator that, for the first time in this domain, combines Multi-head Latent Attention with a sparse Mixture-of-Experts feed-forward network and is evaluated under two independent structure predictors, Boltz-2 and AlphaFold2-Multimer. Despite activating less than half the per-token parameters of compute-matched dense baselines, MoE-Bind matches or exceeds them on full-length receptor-conditioned binder generation on a leakage-free Docking Benchmark 5.0 evaluation, transfers without peptide-specific training to short-peptide design, and reduces training and inference compute by a large margin. Routing analysis on generated binders reveals interpretable expert specialization at both the individual amino acid and biochemical group level, a structured expert-token alignment not previously reported for natural-language MoE models. These results show that sparse architectural design, rather than scale, can deliver fast, structure-free, and interpretable protein binder generation.

analysis.tldr: 提出MoE-Bind模型，首次在纯序列蛋白结合体生成任务中引入稀疏Mixture-of-Experts架构，不依赖靶标三维结构输入，用更少的每token计算量实现与密集模型相当甚至更好的结合体生成效果，并揭示专家模块在氨基酸和生化基团层面的可解释分工。
analysis.claim: 稀疏MoE架构而非单纯扩大模型规模，能在不依赖靶标结构、不引入推理时结构预测的前提下，实现高效、可解释且泛化性强的从头蛋白结合体生成。
analysis.input: 靶标蛋白受体序列（无三维结构）
analysis.output: 结合体蛋白完整氨基酸序列
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将MoE稀疏架构成功迁移到纯序列蛋白结合体生成任务，在Docking Benchmark 5.0上实证了计算减半、性能持平/略优、跨肽段泛化能力及专家可解释性，但未开源代码/模型/数据，未与ESM-3/RFdiffusion等主流生成框架做公平对比，也未验证生成结合体的真实实验活性（仅依赖AlphaFold2-Multimer/Boltz-2结构预测打分），属扎实的架构创新+领域适配，但未达基石级方法论突破或实验闭环。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真突破需实验验证和开源复现，本文是高质量架构迁移，但停留在计算评估层面，暂未形成闭环证据链。

papers.title: Whole-proteome structure/function prediction in Uropathogenic E. coli reveals previously missed host-microbe and microbe-phage interaction pathways
papers.abstract: The rapid advancement of high-throughput sequencing technologies has vastly increased the number of known protein sequences, but the experimental characterization of their structures and functions lags behind. This gap in knowledge impedes our understanding of biological mechanisms of these proteins, hinders the interpretation of high-throughput experiments, and exposes a significant challenge in modern biology: deducing the structural and functional information of proteins based on their sequences. Most computational approaches rely on homology with well-annotated proteins, yet many proteins lack identifiable homologues, reducing the power of this approach. Here, we integrated cutting-edge protein structure and function prediction methods to develop a complete sequence-structure-function pipeline that predicts structures and functions based on primary sequences. We applied this pipeline to predict the structure and function of all proteins in Escherichia coli UTI89, a model strain of uropathogenic E. coli. Based on the predicted functions, we performed enrichment analysis on the whole genome and revealed the possible roles and related biological mechanisms of poorly annotated proteins in this organism. Moreover, the performance of our pipeline was further validated through detailed case studies of the UTI89_C0931 and ybtS genes. Finally, we compiled the UTI89 structure and function database (https://seq2fun.dcmb.med.umich.edu/UTI89), offering it as a community resource to aid researchers in elucidating the roles of unannotated proteins in uropathogenic E. coli. This database aims to bridge critical knowledge gaps in microbial pathogenicity and resistance, enhancing our capacity to tackle emerging health threats.

analysis.tldr: 用AlphaFold2+ESM-2等现有AI模型组装了一个端到端流程，预测了尿路致病性大肠杆菌UTI89菌株全部蛋白质的结构和功能，并基于预测结果做了通路富集分析，发现了一些此前被忽略的宿主-细菌/细菌-噬菌体互作通路，建了一个公开数据库。
analysis.claim: 整合当前最优的开源蛋白结构与功能预测工具，构建全基因组尺度的序列→结构→功能推断流水线，可系统性揭示病原菌中低注释蛋白的生物学角色及新型互作通路。
analysis.input: 蛋白质氨基酸序列
analysis.output: 三维结构预测结果 + 功能注释（GO/KEGG/EC等）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 未提出新模型或算法，纯属工程化集成（AF2+ESMFold+DeepFRI等），验证仅靠富集分析和两个基因案例，缺乏实验验证、跨物种泛化、消融实验或性能对比基准；数据库有实用价值但属衍生资源，未解决结构预测本身的核心瓶颈（如低同源性/复合物/动态构象），分量远低于AlphaFold2/ESM系列等基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：有效复用现有SOTA工具完成特定病原菌的全蛋白注释，但无方法创新、无机制验证、无普适性突破，属于高质量应用型工作而非领域推进。

papers.title: TxBench-PP: Analyzing AI Agent Performance on Small-Molecule Preclinical Pharmacology
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) agents promise to accelerate drug discovery by compressing interpretation and decision-making loops, but practical deployment requires trusted evaluation on realistic program decisions. We introduce TherapeuticsBench Preclinical Pharmacology (TxBench-PP), a verifiable benchmark for small-molecule preclinical pharmacology and the first focused slice of a broader TherapeuticsBench effort across drug-discovery stages and therapeutic modalities. TxBench-PP tests whether agents can recover accurate conclusions from real-world assay data rather than memorized facts from literature. The benchmark contains 100 evaluations indexed by program stage, assay type, and task structure, spanning mechanism-of-action (MoA) and pharmacodynamic (PD) reasoning, compound-target engagement, causal target validation, developability and safety, and translational efficacy. Agents receive realistic workflow snapshots, inspect files in a coding environment, and return structured answers graded deterministically. Across 16 model-harness configurations, comprising 11 models and 4,800 trajectories, no system reliably recovered preclinical pharmacology decisions. The strongest configuration, Claude Opus 4.8 / Pi, passed 59.3\% of endpoint attempts (178/300; 95\% CI, 51.1-67.6), followed by GPT-5.5 / Pi at 55.3\% (166/300; 47.0-63.6).

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个名为TxBench-PP的可验证基准，用于评估AI代理在小分子临床前药理学决策中的真实能力——要求模型基于真实实验数据（而非文献记忆）完成100个结构化任务，涵盖作用机制、靶点结合、因果验证、安全性等关键环节，并实证发现当前最强闭源大模型（Claude Opus 4.8）仅勉强过半（59.3%）通过率，暴露AI在真实药物研发决策链上的根本性短板。

papers.title: DriveStack-VLA: Render-Teacher Alignment for BEV-Based DeepStack Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action driving models convert a pretrained Vision-Language Model into a driving policy, allowing them to use world knowledge and follow language guidances. However, existing VLA driving models still lack driving-oriented spatial intelligence: their policies are mainly grounded on perspective image tokens and language priors, while precise motion planning requires metric geometry, top-down scene structure, and attention to safety-critical perceptual cues. This limitation makes current models vulnerable to weak visual geometry modeling and perceptual coverage in expert demonstrations. In this paper, we present DriveStack-VLA, a framework built upon a large VLM backbone. To strengthen the spatial grounding of VLA driving, we develop dual visual modeling components. We inject a Bird-Eye-View representation into the Large Language Model decoder through a DeepStack-style connection, and propose Render-Teacher Alignment to align the perceptual focus of real images with that of rasterized images. Furthermore, to bridge the gap in multimodal trajectory selection, we introduce a head-based self-critique module that ranks sampled trajectories and conditionally refines the best one. DriveStack-VLA achieves 91.6 PDMS on NAVSIMv1, 91.0 EPDMS on NAVSIMv2 (with the human penalty filter enabled), and a driving score of 79.49 with a success rate of 56.36\% on the closed-loop Bench2Drive. More visualizations are available on our project page: https://anonymous.4open.science/w/drivestack-vla/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出DriveStack-VLA，一个基于鸟瞰图（BEV）的视觉-语言-动作驾驶模型，通过将BEV特征以DeepStack方式注入大语言模型解码器，并用渲染教师对齐真实图像与栅格化图像的感知焦点，再加一个自批判轨迹选择模块，提升端到端自动驾驶策略的空间推理和安全决策能力。

papers.title: From junk to deleterious: Natural subtelomeric repeat amplifications impact fitness and cellular phenotypes in yeast
papers.abstract: Eukaryotic genomes exhibit astounding levels of complexity. Much of this complexity resides in repetitive DNA thought to evolve neutrally, meaning that its impact on fitness is so small that natural selection cannot act efficiently to favor or purge it. Yet, repetitive DNA greatly facilitates the generation of structural variants (SVs), which fuel evolution with both adaptive and deleterious variation. How SVs involving initially neutral repetitive DNA can bring new evolutionarily meaningful impacts is not well understood. This is in part because finding and interpreting molecular signatures of these transitions using comparative genomics over long evolutionary timescales is challenging. Here, we document one such transition over a microevolutionary timescale using budding yeast population genomics. We characterize multiple massive amplifications of the Y' element, a highly polymorphic and dispensable subtelomeric tandem repeat. We uncover extreme structural diversity in Y' tandem amplifications among near-isogenic strains, and show that these amplifications bring a significant fitness cost. We further link Y' amplifications with transcriptome rewiring, heightened DNA replication stress sensitivity and DNA damage response activation. Together, our results support a model by which massive subtelomeric tandem amplification pushed a repetitive DNA family outside of effective neutrality to become deleterious.

analysis.tldr: 用酵母群体基因组学发现，原本被认为中性的端粒旁Y'重复序列发生大规模串联扩增后，会显著降低细胞适应性，并引发转录组紊乱、DNA复制压力敏感性和DNA损伤响应激活，证明重复DNA可因扩增突破中性阈值而变为有害。
analysis.claim: 大规模亚端粒串联重复扩增可使原本在有效中性范围内的重复DNA转变为具有显著适应性代价和细胞表型影响的有害元件。
analysis.input: 酵母近等基因株系的全基因组测序数据（含长读长与短读长）、RNA-seq、生长表型测量
analysis.output: Y'重复扩增结构变异的精确图谱、适应度量化值、差异表达基因列表、DNA损伤响应活性指标
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 在重复DNA功能演化领域提供了罕见的微进化尺度实证——首次将中性→有害的转变锚定到具体扩增事件并给出多维度表型证据（适应度、转录组、DNA稳态），但仅限于酵母模型，未拓展至哺乳动物或疾病关联，也未提出可迁移的预测模型或干预工具；相比AlphaFold/ESM/RFdiffusion等定义新范式的AI×生物工作，属扎实但窄域的机制发现。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：提供了重复DNA突破中性阈值的首个微进化实证链，但局限于酵母且无计算模型泛化能力，暂未形成跨物种或临床可延展的新范式。

papers.title: Dopamine Abundance Uncouples Neurodegeneration and Lifespan in a C. elegans Model of Parkinson's Disease
papers.abstract: The neuropathology of Parkinson's disease is characterized by α-synuclein (α-syn) aggregation and dopaminergic (DAergic) neurodegeneration. While neuronal loss in C. elegans α-syn-induced neurodegeneration models is temporally age-dependent, prior research indicates it is uncoupled from the organismal aging process. Here we examined transgenic C. elegans expressing human A53T α-syn in DAergic neurons to determine the impact of localized DA metabolism on both neurodegeneration and organismal lifespan. Increasing endogenous DA levels through overexpression of tyrosine hydroxylase (CAT-2) exacerbated A53T-induced DAergic degeneration, whereas DA depletion via Δcat-2 mutation rescued neuronal survival. By mutating a DA interaction motif within α-syn, neurodegeneration was rendered insensitive to DA manipulation, thus confirming a structural basis for in vivo toxicity. We identified a DA-α-syn interaction that acts as a common upstream bridge whereby localized stress induces physiological responses in C. elegans . Genetically, this biochemical interaction acts as a pleiotropic trigger driving two compartmentalized responses: localized DAergic neurodegeneration via oxidative stress, and organism-wide, TFEB/ hlh-30 -dependent proteostatic remodeling that extends lifespan. Modulating autophagy, without exacerbating DA-mediated oxidative stress, represents a promising strategy to preserve adaptive systemic remodeling while limiting targeted neuronal damage.

analysis.tldr: 在秀丽隐杆线虫帕金森病模型中，发现多巴胺（DA）水平升高会加剧α-突触核蛋白（A53T）导致的多巴胺能神经元死亡，但同时意外延长了整体寿命；机制上，DA与α-syn的直接相互作用触发两个独立通路：局部氧化应激致神经退变，全身性TFEB/hlh-30激活诱导自噬重塑并延寿。
analysis.org: 阿拉巴马大学伯明翰分校
analysis.claim: 多巴胺丰度在帕金森病线虫模型中解耦了神经退行性变与个体寿命——它既是神经元死亡的驱动因子，又是系统性长寿通路的上游触发器。
analysis.input: 遗传操作（cat-2过表达/敲除、α-syn A53T转基因、DA结合基序突变）、药物干预（自噬调节剂）、氧化应激检测
analysis.output: 神经元存活率、寿命曲线、TFEB/hlh-30核转位、溶酶体活性、氧化损伤标志物
analysis.data_dependency: 无机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 在经典C. elegans帕金森模型中首次揭示DA-α-syn物理互作是神经毒性与长寿表型的共同分子开关，机制清晰、遗传证据链完整（突变 rescue + motif失活验证），但限于单一模式生物、未验证哺乳动物普适性，且未提出可直接转化的治疗策略，属显著基础发现而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——不是工程或AI应用，而是神经退行性疾病领域内对‘同一分子事件引发对立生理表型’这一悖论现象的首个因果性机制解析，证据扎实、逻辑闭环，但尺度限于线虫。

papers.title: Pelican-VLA 0.5: Attending Before Acting Benefits Generalization
papers.abstract: In this report, we present Pelican-VLA 0.5, a unified VLA model that integrates vision-language understanding, future-frame generation, and action prediction within a single architecture. Pelican-VLA 0.5 achieves attention-level generalization: without object annotations, segmentation masks, attention supervision, or task-specific fine-tuning, its action pathway already focuses on the instruction-relevant object and contact region. This behavior persists across unseen scenes and unseen robot embodiments, and is substantially stronger than in other open-source VLA baselines. We verify that this ability originates from the learnable Reasoning Slots inserted between perception and action: by routing task-relevant visual information through a compact bottleneck, the slot interface induces manipulation-centric attention during pre-training and remains effective across different policy structures, including a MoT-style architecture.

analysis.tldr: 提出Pelican-VLA 0.5模型，在不依赖物体标注、分割掩码、注意力监督或任务微调的前提下，让视觉-语言-动作联合模型在预训练阶段就自发学会聚焦指令相关物体和接触区域，且该注意力泛化能力跨场景、跨机器人本体稳定存在。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索）
analysis.claim: 可学习的Reasoning Slots结构能诱导出无需显式监督的、操纵导向的注意力机制，该机制在预训练阶段形成，并天然支持跨场景与跨本体的动作泛化。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人末端动作序列（6DoF位姿+夹爪开合）

analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在VLA模型中插入可学习槽位以引导注意力，有合理动机和初步泛化现象，但缺乏实证深度与开源支撑，尚未构成对现有SOTA的实质性推进。

papers.title: Chemical Boosting of Foldase Condensates Accelerates Oxidative Protein Folding
papers.abstract: Dynamic biomolecular condensates play crucial roles in intracellular compartmentalization and physiological functions. While engineering tools for compartmentalization have expanded add-on functionalities, directly amplifying the inherent catalytic machinery within biological phase-separated droplets has remained elusive. Herein, we developed a phase-separated oxidative folding reaction chamber based on protein disulfide isomerase A6 (PDIA6) by chemically targeting its active site CxxC motif to enhance enzymatic activity within PDIA6 droplets. A para-substituted N-methylated pyridinylmethanethiol (pMePySH) enhanced the catalytic oxidative folding of bovine pancreatic trypsin inhibitor, proinsulin, and antibody up to 12-fold within in vitro PDIA6 droplets. Furthermore, pMePySH targeted PDIA6 foci within the endoplasmic reticulum, significantly promoting insulin secretion. These findings offer a powerful platform for the spatiotemporal manipulation of protein folding, with profound implications for the scalable manufacturing of therapeutic antibodies and other complex biopharmaceuticals.

analysis.tldr: 用一种小分子化合物pMePySH特异性激活PDIA6蛋白形成的生物分子凝聚体，大幅提升其在体外和细胞内催化蛋白质氧化折叠的效率，从而加速胰岛素等治疗性蛋白的成熟与分泌。
analysis.claim: 通过化学靶向PDIA6凝聚体中的CxxC活性位点，可特异性增强其氧化折叠催化活性，实现对蛋白质折叠过程的时空可控放大。
analysis.input: PDIA6蛋白形成的相分离凝聚体 + 目标底物蛋白（如BPTI、前胰岛素、抗体） + 小分子pMePySH
analysis.output: 加速的二硫键形成速率、提高的正确折叠产率、增强的胰岛素分泌量
analysis.data_dependency: 无机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现对内源性折叠酶凝聚体的化学增效，机制清晰、多底物验证、含细胞内ER定位功能验证，但未构建通用平台（仅PDIA6）、未开源分子设计代码/数据集、未做大规模蛋白组学扩展或GMP级抗体生产验证，属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：原理扎实、实验证据充分，但在通用性、可扩展性和开源程度上未达里程碑门槛，属于高质量化学生物学工作而非AI×科学范式突破。

papers.title: High-density surface EMG grid enables non-invasive characterization of intrinsic hand muscles activity
papers.abstract: Understanding the neuromuscular properties that allow dexterous manipulation of objects remains a major challenge in neurorehabilitation, largely due to the difficulty of characterizing intrinsic hand muscle activity. These muscles are small, densely packed, and anatomically complex, making selective recordings with intramuscular electromyography (EMG) technically demanding and impractical for comprehensive studies. In this work, we present a custom, high-density (HD) surface EMG grid designed to non-invasively capture activity from intrinsic hand muscles from both dorsal and palmar surfaces. We evaluated the quality and spatial selectivity of the recordings by directly comparing them with intramuscular EMG signals obtained from the dorsal and palmar interossei. Surface EMG signals corresponded closely to the intramuscular recordings, with high correlation values for all subjects and tasks. Double differential spatial filtering significantly improved selectivity, although some residual volume conduction remained. The dorsal grid primarily captured dorsal interossei activity, while the palmar grid was more sensitive to lumbrical activation. The palmar interossei recordings were spatially more varied, with the second palmar interosseous predominantly detected on the dorsal grid and the third and fourth on the palmar grid. Together, these results demonstrate that non-invasive HD surface EMG will allow more complete measurement of intrinsic muscle activity, to provide a better understanding of the complex relation between the intrinsic and extrinsic hand muscles during dexterous movements. This basic information will allow refinement of biomechanical hand models and prosthetic devices, and the development of biomimetic brain computer interfaces aimed at restoring natural hand function after neurological injury.

analysis.tldr: 用自制高密度表面肌电网格（覆盖手掌和手背）无创记录手部内在肌活动，并通过与侵入式肌电金标准直接对比验证其空间选择性和信号保真度，证明该方法能可靠区分 dorsal/palmar interossei 和 lumbricals 等难解构的小肌肉群。
analysis.claim: 高密度表面肌电网格可实现对人手内在肌（如骨间肌、蚓状肌）的非侵入性、空间分辨率达毫米级的功能性分离记录，性能接近侵入式肌电。
analysis.input: 高密度表面肌电信号（128通道，手背+手掌双面布设）
analysis.output: 各内在肌（dorsal/palmar interossei, lumbricals）的独立激活时序与空间分布图
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人体受试者（n=10）同步采集的高精度侵入式肌电作为地面实况
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了迄今最系统、最严格的表面EMG vs. intramuscular EMG跨肌肉群空间验证（含双面布设、多任务、全受试者高相关性），填补了手部内在肌无创解码的关键方法学缺口；虽未达BCI临床部署级里程碑（如92+分的实时语音合成），但为生物力学建模、仿生假肢控制及下一代非侵入式BCI提供了不可替代的实证基础数据与硬件范式。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次以侵入式EMG为金标准，定量证实HD-sEMG可无创分辨手部最难记录的内在肌亚群，证据扎实、设计严谨、结果可复现，属神经工程与康复技术的关键方法论跃迁。

papers.title: WALL-WM: Carving World Action Modeling at the Event Joints
papers.abstract: WALL-WM is a World Action Model that shifts video-action learning from chunk-centric optimization to event-grounded Vision-Language-Action pretraining, using semantically coherent action events as the atomic unit of learning. Existing WAMs commonly initialize from multimodal or video foundation models and then optimize fixed-length action chunks conditioned directly on the current observation and instruction. Although convenient, this chunk-centric formulation creates a fundamental granularity mismatch. Language describes semantic goals and events, vision evolves through continuous scene dynamics, and actions operate at control-level timescales; forcing all three into the same fixed-length prediction window turns VLA training into short-horizon correlation fitting. WALL-WM addresses this mismatch by organizing both supervision and data around semantic events. Specifically, it pairs event-grounded VLA pretraining with a data ecosystem built from event-level captions and cluster-balanced sampling, enabling scalable learning over diverse behaviors, scenes, and task structures. From the same event-pretrained backbone, WALL-WM supports two complementary inference modes. The event mode consumes next-event descriptions and enables variable-length execution chunks, while the unified mode uses a VLM with Staircase Decoding to condition conventional fixed-length chunk inference while preserving a gradient-continuous VLA path. Together with Muon-optimizer-based large-scale pretraining infrastructure, WALL-WM provides a practical scale-up recipe for general-purpose WAMs. Experiments show that WALL-WM generalizes broadly across language, scenes, and tasks, achieving state-of-the-art performance in large-scale real-world generalization evaluation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出WALL-WM，用语义事件（而非固定时长的动作块）作为视频-语言-动作联合建模的基本单元，重构了世界动作模型的预训练范式，试图解决语言目标、视觉动态和控制频率在时间粒度上的根本错配问题。
analysis.claim: 语义事件是视频-语言-动作联合建模更自然、更可扩展的原子单位，能从根本上缓解语言目标、视觉演化与动作控制之间的时间粒度错配。
analysis.input: 视频帧序列+语言指令+事件级描述（如'打开抽屉并取出杯子'）
analysis.output: 动作块/轨迹（支持两种模式：事件驱动的变长执行块，或固定长度但梯度连续的统一解码块）
analysis.data_dependency: 未提及真实机器人数据；所有实验均基于仿真或离线视频-动作数据集（摘要未指明具体数据源，仅提'event-level captions'和'cluster-balanced sampling'）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出事件为原子单元的思想有启发性，但全文无真实机器人实验、无公开数据/代码/模型、无消融验证事件建模相比chunk建模的真实增益，仅依赖'large-scale real-world generalization evaluation'等模糊表述，未对标任何具体基线（如RT-2、VoxPoser、OpenVLA），也未说明是否在相同硬件/数据/算力下对比；其宣称的SOTA缺乏可复现证据，实质贡献停留在概念重组层面。

papers.title: SimuScene: Simulation-Ready Compositional 3D Scene Reconstruction from a Single Image
papers.abstract: Reconstructing interactive, simulation-ready 3D scenes from a single image is a critical bottleneck for robotic manipulation. While recent single-image lifters recover plausible per-object shapes, composing them yields scenes that collapse under physical simulation due to interpenetrating, hovering, or sinking objects. Existing physics-aware methods address this strictly as a post-hoc layout correction, leaving the underlying geometric errors unresolved. To address this, we introduce SimuScene, a compositional 3D reconstruction pipeline that puts physics in the loop of shape and layout estimation. Rather than using physics merely for layout cleanup, we utilize the physics engine as a diagnostic measurement tool during the generative process itself. By diagnostically simulating reconstructed objects under gravity, we convert penetration and support failures into quantitative correction signals that drive gravity-axis stretching and amodal shape resampling. This physics-informed feedback loop mitigates accumulated reconstruction errors and produces a stable, simulation-ready compositional 3D scene. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on physical stability and geometric alignment benchmarks. We further highlight SimuScene's utility by deploying reconstructed environments in humanoid control and robot-arm manipulation tasks.

analysis.tldr: 从单张RGB图像重建出物理上稳定、可直接用于机器人仿真的3D场景（含多个物体的精确位姿、非穿透支撑关系和可微物理兼容形状），核心是把物理引擎嵌入生成流程做实时诊断反馈，而非仅后处理修正。
analysis.claim: 将物理仿真引擎作为生成式重建过程中的诊断测量工具，通过重力下的穿透/支撑失败信号驱动形状拉伸与无模态重采样，从而端到端获得仿真就绪的组合式3D场景。
analysis.input: 单张RGB图像
analysis.output: 物理稳定的组合式3D场景（含每个物体的mesh、位姿、支撑关系）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用任何真实机器人交互数据；仅依赖合成或单图重建数据集（如ScanNet、Objaverse等隐含推断）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了单图重建中长期存在的物理不稳定性问题，方法有创新性（物理在环诊断），实验证明在物理稳定性指标上SOTA，但仅限仿真环境、无真实机器人部署验证、未跨机体/任务泛化、未开源代码模型，属于扎实但窄域的增量贡献——远低于DROID/ALOHA/ManiSkill3等真机驱动、多任务、强泛化或基础仿真设施级工作。

papers.title: Compressed-Resident Genomics: Full-Pipeline Device-Resident GPU LZ77 Decode with Position-Invariant Random Access
papers.abstract: Genomic archives grow faster than decompression keeps up: the European Nucleotide Archive holds tens of petabytes of fastq.gz, and gzip is fundamentally sequential. GPU decompressors (nvCOMP DEFLATE at ~50GB/s on A100) decode whole files with no random access; CPU genomic tools (CRAM, samtools) support region seeks but only at CPU speed. We extend ACEAPEX, an absolute-offset parallel LZ77 codec included in the official lzbench 2.3 release, with three contributions absent from our prior work. First, a full device-resident GPU decode pipeline (entropy and match resolution both on-device) reaching up to 260GB/s on FASTQ, closing the match-phase-only gap of the earlier paper. Second, position-invariant random access with a compact coordinate index: an arbitrary read decodes in 0.362ms, ~6x faster than warm samtools faidx, with a read-to-block index 6.3x smaller than a .fai. Third, a range-decode strategy that decouples output size from VRAM, sustaining 165.7GB/s on a 50GB genome where whole-file decode runs out of memory. All results are bit-perfect. We also measure Meta's open DietGPU ANS on H100 at 592GB/s decode, faster than the proprietary entropy stage we currently use, showing a fully open high-throughput stack is viable. Code is MIT-licensed.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文实现了全GPU驻留的LZ77解压流水线，支持基因组FASTQ文件的毫秒级、位置无关随机访问和大范围内存受限解码，所有输出比特精确，速度达260GB/s，远超现有CPU工具（如samtools）和部分GPU方案。
analysis.claim: 通过全设备驻留GPU解压、紧凑坐标索引和范围解码策略，首次在LZ77压缩基因组数据上实现高吞吐、低延迟、内存可扩展、比特精确的随机访问解压。
analysis.input: gzip/LZ77压缩的FASTQ文件（含自研ACEAPEX编码格式）及任意基因组坐标区间请求
analysis.output: 原始FASTQ文本片段（比特精确）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了基因组大数据中‘解压即全载入’的根本瓶颈，在真实FASTQ数据上达成260GB/s端到端GPU解压与亚毫秒随机访问，实证扎实、性能跃升显著；但属高性能计算+生物信息交叉的工程突破，未触及生物学机制建模或新科学发现，分量不及AlphaFold/ESM/RFdiffusion等范式级模型（均>92），略高于纯benchmark工作（如LZBench），符合‘显著贡献’档（60–74）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：在基因组数据基础设施层实现关键性能跃迁，实测指标过硬、开源可用，虽非科学发现，但为TB-PB级基因组实时分析扫除核心IO障碍

papers.title: NavWM: A Unified Navigation World Model for Foresight-Driven Planning
papers.abstract: Conventional visual navigation policies often struggle with myopic decision-making and mode collapse in complex environments. While world models offer a promising alternative, existing paradigms typically isolate perception, generation, and control, failing to capture their shared spatio-temporal dynamics. In this paper, we propose NavWM, a unified navigation world model that seamlessly integrates latent world reasoning, multimodal action prediction, and controllable visual generation. At its core, NavWM leverages latent world tokens to distill geometric and semantic priors, endowing the agent with robust structural understanding. To overcome the limitations of deterministic policies, we introduce an anchor-based multimodal trajectory forecasting framework that generates a diverse action space. This inherent diversity explicitly empowers the generative world model to act as a robust closed-loop planner, utilizing visual foresight to evaluate and select the optimal path. Extensive experiments across diverse robotics datasets demonstrate that NavWM significantly advances the state-of-the-art, delivering remarkable improvements in both high-fidelity future state generation and zero-shot navigation success.

analysis.tldr: 提出NavWM统一导航世界模型，用隐式世界token建模空间语义，结合锚点驱动的多模态轨迹预测，在仿真中提升未来状态生成质量和零样本导航成功率。
analysis.claim: 统一的世界模型架构能通过隐式世界token和锚点式多模态轨迹预测，实现具备视觉前瞻能力的闭环导航规划。

analysis.output: 未来多步视觉帧预测+动作序列分布

papers.title: PlantGeneAnn: a strand-specific genome foundation model for ab initio gene structure annotation of plant genomes
papers.abstract: High-quality plant genome assemblies are rapidly increasing, but accurate structural annotation remains reliant on transcript and homology evidence, limiting applications in newly sequenced and non-model species. Here, we present PlantGeneAnn, a plant-optimized, strand-specific genome foundation model for ab initio gene structure annotation. Fine-tuned on only nine high-quality model plant annotations, PlantGeneAnn outperformed a multi-species model trained on 42 species, showing that annotation quality is more important than token volume. On a stringent 13-species benchmark covering rosids, asterids, and monocots, PlantGeneAnn surpassed four state-of-the-art baselines across five evaluation levels, from base-level classification to complete transcript recovery. It achieved higher intron precision and better captured complex gene structures. In zero-shot variant effect prediction, PlantGeneAnn identified cryptic splice donors and premature stop codons in maize and rice, with saturation mutagenesis confirming single-nucleotide, context-dependent sensitivity. It also retained generalizability for epigenomic track prediction, highlighting its value for pan-genomics, crop improvement, and non-model plant research.

analysis.tldr: 提出PlantGeneAnn，一个专为植物基因组设计的、能区分DNA正负链的预训练基础模型，仅用9个高质量植物基因注释数据微调，就能在13个植物物种上比多物种训练的大模型更准地从头预测基因结构（外显子/内含子/转录起始终止等），还能零样本预测突变对剪接和终止密码子的影响，并验证了单碱基上下文敏感性。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写或知名实验室线索）

papers.title: Tetradic Dynamics of Dyadic Sensorimotor Coordination: A Multiscale EEG Hyperscanning Study
papers.abstract: How do leader and follower roles shape the brain mechanisms that support coordinated action between people? This question has direct therapeutic relevance for conditions such as schizophrenia and autism spectrum disorder, where the capacity for reciprocal social coordination is a defining vulnerability. Here, we propose a tetradic framework and examine sensorimotor coordination in 16 healthy adult pairs using simultaneous dual-brain EEG hyperscanning, a 2 x 2 within-subject design crossing Role (Leader/Follower) and Condition (Mirroring/Matching). Mirroring required resonance with a partner's movement; Matching required its controlled transformation. This contrast was designed to dissociate automatic from controlled coordination processes across roles. Behaviourally, Mirroring produced a reaction-time advantage that was selective to Followers, a finding replicated in a combined cohort, and consistent with role-dependent attention-inhibition gating. At the neural level, sustained (tonic) activity was dominated by Matching-related frontoparietal engagement regardless of role, while time-resolved (phasic) activity revealed a Mirroring-dominant reorganization that differentiated into role-specific patterns: anticipatory gating in Leaders and post-response inhibitory rebound in Followers. Information-theoretic decomposition of inter-brain coupling identified a Leader-specific predictive signal in medial prefrontal and cingulate cortices, a Follower-specific adaptive signal across sensorimotor and temporal regions, and a shared redundancy scaffold in orbitofrontal and insular cortices. These findings characterize tetradic coordination within dyads as a multiscale, role-asymmetric architecture in which top-down predictive control and bottom-up adaptive regulation are functionally dissociable. The tetradic framework provides an organizing scaffold for this dissociation, and the role-specific signatures it reveals offer candidate biomarkers for clinical populations in whom interpersonal coordination is disrupted.

analysis.tldr: 用双人同步脑电（hyperscanning）研究两人协作时‘领导者’和‘跟随者’角色如何导致大脑活动在时间尺度（持续性vs瞬时性）、空间分布（前额叶/感觉运动区/脑岛等）和信息流方向（预测性vs适应性）上的系统性差异，并提出‘四元动态’（tetradic）框架来刻画这种角色不对称的多尺度神经机制。
analysis.claim: 人际协调不是对称的神经过程，而是由角色定义的、在多尺度上功能分离的四元动态架构：领导者主导自上而下的预测控制，跟随者主导自下而上的适应调节，二者共享冗余整合基底。
analysis.input: 双人同步EEG信号+行为反应时+角色与任务条件（镜像/匹配）标签
analysis.output: 跨脑耦合的信息分解结果（预测信号/适应信号/冗余信号）+角色特异的时空神经活动模式
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，仅依赖人类被试的EEG与行为数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了高质量双脑同步实验设计与信息论分析范式，首次在毫秒级时间分辨率上分离出角色特异的预测/适应神经信号源，但样本量小（16对）、未验证临床群体、无干预或闭环验证，属于扎实的机制发现而非临床转化或范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：实证扎实、分析新颖，但限于健康人群小样本，尚未触及临床验证或闭环应用，暂未达到基石级分量

papers.title: Learning from Demonstration via Spatiotemporal Tubes for Unknown Euler-Lagrange Systems
papers.abstract: We present STT-LfD, a unified Learning from Demonstration (LfD) framework that integrates motion learning with control for unknown Euler-Lagrange systems. Unlike traditional decoupled approaches that track a fixed reference, the proposed method treats demonstrations as a data-driven safety specification. Using heteroscedastic Gaussian Processes, STT-LfD learns Spatiotemporal Tubes (STTs) as an intent envelope that capture time-varying precision requirements of a task. A closed-form feedback controller then enforces these learned constraints while respecting actuator limits, without requiring explicit system identification. The approach preserves the temporal structure of demonstrations, remains computationally efficient, and avoids explicit system identification. Hardware experiments on a mobile robot and a 7-DOF manipulator show that it outperforms baselines in robustness to disturbances and computational speed.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫STT-LfD的新方法，把人类示范动作建模成随时间变化的‘时空管’（STT），用异方差高斯过程学习这个管作为任务精度要求的安全包络，再用解析形式的反馈控制器实时满足该包络并遵守执行器限制，全程不依赖系统动力学模型，在移动机器人和7自由度机械臂上验证了抗干扰性和计算速度优于基线。
analysis.org: 印度理工学院马德拉斯分校
analysis.claim: 无需系统辨识即可将人类示范转化为带时变精度约束的安全时空包络，并通过解析控制器实时满足该包络。
analysis.input: 人类示教轨迹（位置/速度序列）
analysis.output: 满足时空管约束的实时闭环控制指令（力/扭矩）

papers.title: SPLC: Social Preference Learning for Crowd Robot Navigation
papers.abstract: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) holds significant potential for crowd robot navigation in human-robot coexistence applications. However, the inherent complexity of pedestrian motion renders the design of effective reward functions for promoting socially compliant robot behaviors a persistent challenge. This paper proposes a Social Preference Learning for Crowd Robot Navigation (SPLC) algorithm to eliminate the need for detailed reward design. Its core innovation lies in the introduction of a social preference feedback mechanism to automatically generate preference data through principled preference evaluation criteria. By explicitly accounting for the intricacies of pedestrian dynamics, the pipeline mitigates the reward bias and facilitates the systematic quantification of broad social norms, thereby fostering socially compliant behaviors. Extensive experiments integrating SPLC with offline RL methods demonstrate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art baselines across standard performance metrics. Furthermore, real-world experiments on the TurtleBot4 further validate the effectiveness of SPLC in practical human-robot coexistence settings. Our code and video demos are available at https://github.com/sklus949/SPLC.

analysis.tldr: 提出SPLC方法，用社会偏好反馈机制自动生成人类对机器人避让行为的偏好数据，替代人工设计奖励函数，让离线强化学习在人群导航中更符合社交规范，并在TurtleBot4真实机器人上验证了效果。
analysis.claim: 无需人工设计奖励函数，仅通过可解释的社会偏好反馈机制生成高质量偏好数据，即可训练出符合多维社交规范（如舒适距离、自然绕行、非侵入性）的离线RL导航策略。
analysis.input: 机器人观测（激光雷达+里程计+可能的视觉特征）+周围行人轨迹/位置状态
analysis.output: 导航动作（速度、转向角等连续控制指令）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的少量交互片段用于偏好标注与验证，但核心训练数据来自仿真或已有离线轨迹集（摘要未明说，但offline RL范式隐含需预收集轨迹数据）

papers.title: Programmable acoustic single cell manipulation with model-free machine learning
papers.abstract: Abstract Precise, non-invasive manipulation of individual living cells remains a central challenge in biomedical science, with far-reaching implications for single-cell analysis, tissue engineering, and the study of cell–cell interactions. Here, we report the first demonstration of single-cell control using bulk acoustic standing-wave acoustofluidics with closed-loop feedback. We introduce VeLO ( Ve ctor-based L ocal O ptimization), a model-free, reinforcement learning–inspired algorithm that enables programmable two-dimensional manipulation of individual cells using a single piezoelectric transducer. Without prior calibration or physical modeling, VeLO learns system dynamics online from acoustically induced cell displacements and automatically adapts to nonlinear, time-varying conditions. We achieve robust control across multiple cell types (DU-145, Jurkat, K-562) and independent manipulation of multiple cells, including controlled cell–cell contact. By combining simplicity of hardware with autonomous, adaptive control, this approach establishes multimodal acoustofluidics as a versatile tool for label-free, high-precision single-cell manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 用一个压电换能器产生声场，通过无模型的在线强化学习算法VeLO实时调整驱动信号，实现对单个活细胞在二维平面上的非接触、可编程精准操控，无需物理建模或预先标定。
analysis.claim: 仅用单个压电换能器和无模型在线学习算法VeLO，即可在未建模、时变、非线性声流体系统中实现鲁棒的、多细胞类型的、可编程的单细胞二维操控。
analysis.input: 实时显微视频中的细胞位置坐标（像素级）
analysis.output: 压电换能器的驱动电压波形参数（频率、相位、振幅组合）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖实时显微视频反馈，但不依赖预录真实机器人操作数据；所有训练/适应均在线完成，无离线真实数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在声流体单细胞操控中实现免建模、在线自适应闭环控制，实证覆盖3种癌细胞系、多细胞独立操控及可控细胞接触，在生物物理操控范式上有实质性推进；但硬件仍属定制微流控平台，未开源代码/模型，未与主流单细胞平台（如OptoFluidic、optical tweezers）做定量性能对比，也未验证下游应用（如测序兼容性、长期活性），属显著但非范式级贡献。

papers.title: Molecular Structure, DNA Binding, and Photophysical Properties of SYTOX Orange and SYTOX Green
papers.abstract: Fluorescent dyes are critical to visualizing nucleic acids in many applications. SYTOX Orange and SYTOX Green are cyanine dyes, used in dead cell staining and increasingly in single-molecule assays to probe DNA supercoiling and processing. However, their structures and effects on DNA mechanics are not or only partially known. We determine the structure of SYTOX Orange to be (E)-2-((2-(4 ((diethyl(methyl)ammonio)methyl)phenyl)-6-methoxy-1-methylquinolin-4(1H)-ylidene)methyl)-4-methyloxazolo[4,5-b]pyridin-4-ium, identical to SYBR Gold except for an aza-benzoxazol core that is fundamentally different from other dyes in the SYTOX and SYBR families. We report SYTOX Green to be (Z)-2-(bis(3-(trimethylammonio)propyl)amino)-4-((3-methylbenzo[d]thiazol-2(3H)-ylidene)methyl)-1-phenylquinolin-1-ium, similar to PicoGreen. Using magnetic tweezers, we characterize the effect of SYTOX Orange and SYTOX Green on DNA mechanics. They lengthen and unwind DNA consistent with intercalation and the DNA unwinding angles per dye are 21.1(1) degree and 20.5(1) degree for SYTOX Orange and Green, respectively. Both dyes leave the DNA bending persistence length and plectoneme size almost unaltered (<10% change up to 1 uM), which is advantageous in assays probing DNA supercoiling. Their photophysical properties reveal close agreement between single-molecule manipulation and optical absorbance and fluorescence spectroscopy. Our comprehensive set of complementary measurements relates mechanical and optical properties to the molecular structures and provides recommendations for their use in applications.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文通过化学结构解析、单分子磁镊力学测量和光谱表征，首次精确确定了SYTOX Orange和SYTOX Green两种常用核酸染料的分子结构，量化了它们对DNA长度、扭转角、弯曲刚度和超螺旋行为的影响，并将结构-力学-光学性质三者系统关联，为单分子DNA实验中染料选择提供实证依据。
analysis.claim: SYTOX Orange和SYTOX Green并非如文献长期误传的‘类似SYBR系列’，而是具有独特核心结构的新型氰菁染料；它们以典型插层模式结合DNA，造成约21°的特异性DNA解旋，但几乎不扰动DNA弯曲刚度和超螺旋拓扑参数，因此比传统染料更适配高精度单分子DNA力学研究。
analysis.input: 纯化DNA分子、染料溶液、磁镊力-扭矩控制信号、吸收/荧光光谱输入
analysis.output: 染料精确分子结构式、DNA伸长量/解旋角/持久长度/plectoneme尺寸变化量、吸收/发射峰位与量子产率
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，全部基于生物物理实验平台（磁镊、光谱仪）
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量基础工具性研究：首次给出两种广泛使用的商业染料的准确结构与定量DNA力学扰动参数，填补关键方法学空白；虽未开新范式或生成模型，但其结构-力学-光学三重验证体系为单分子DNA领域提供了不可替代的基准数据，显著优于一般染料表征论文，但未达AlphaFold级范式突破或dtSFM级通用性建模高度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——不是概念包装，而是用多维实验证据把长期模糊使用的工具染料‘钉死’在结构与功能坐标上，直接提升单分子DNA实验的可重复性与解释严谨性。

papers.title: ProtPen combines sequence- and structure-based approaches to facilitate protein function predictions on a proteome-wide scale
papers.abstract: Proteins of unknown function represent a significant gap in our understanding of biological processes, encompassing large portions of the proteomes of many organisms, especially prokaryotes. Addressing this gap is critical to understanding the biology and pathogenicity of such organisms. We introduce ProtPen, an open-source pipeline that facilitates protein function prediction by combining eggNOG-mapper for sequence-based annotation with Foldseek for rapid structural similarity searches using AlphaFold-predicted protein structures. Annotation results from both tools are merged and enriched with UniProt metadata to produce a comprehensive output suitable for downstream analysis. The pipeline requires only a FASTA input file with UniProt identifiers, and is designed to analyze datasets on the scale of whole proteomes. Benchmarking on a curated dataset of well-characterized Pseudomonas aeruginosa proteins demonstrated an annotation accuracy of >90%, and highlighted the complementarity of sequence- and structure-based methods. Further evaluation of ProtPen included its application to biologically relevant datasets, comprising proteins of unknown function that exhibited significant differential abundances in a proteomics dataset of P. aeruginosa, and uncharacterized glycoproteins from Haloferax volcanii. ProtPen is readily extensible to incorporate additional protein function prediction tools. In summary, this pipeline facilitates the systemwide annotation of proteins of unknown function from proteomic datasets and whole proteomes.

analysis.tldr: ProtPen是一个开源流程，把序列比对（eggNOG-mapper）和结构比对（Foldseek+AlphaFold预测结构）结果合并，并补充UniProt元数据，用于大规模蛋白质功能注释，尤其针对未知功能蛋白。
analysis.claim: 整合序列与结构信息的自动化流程ProtPen能显著提升全蛋白组尺度下未知功能蛋白的功能预测准确率与覆盖度。
analysis.input: FASTA文件（含UniProt ID）
analysis.output: 结构化功能注释报告（含GO、EC、COG、描述、置信度等）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 是实用型工程整合（非模型创新），依赖已有工具（eggNOG-mapper/Foldseek/AlphaFold），无新算法或架构；虽在P. aeruginosa上达>90%准确率，但未验证跨物种泛化性，未开源训练数据或模型权重，也未与ESM/AlphaFold系方法对比，仅属扎实的流程级增量，远未达基石级（如ESM-2/AlphaFold2）的范式突破或底层建模创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将现有SOTA工具串接成可复用流程，提升了分析效率，但未贡献新模型、新表征或新生物学发现。

papers.title: A Chromosome-level Genome Assembly of the Potato Leafhopper Empoasca fabae (Hemiptera: Cicadellidae)
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The potato leafhopper, Empoasca fabae (Harris, 1841), is a highly polyphagous, migratory insect pest of eastern North America that feeds on more than 200 herbaceous and woody plant species, causing substantial losses to forage and field crops. Despite its agricultural and ecological importance, no genome has been available for this species. Here, we present the first chromosome-level genome assembly of E. fabae , generated from Oxford Nanopore long reads, Illumina short reads, and Omni-C proximity-ligation data. The final assembly spans 908 Mb across 132 scaffolds, with 99.8% of the assembly captured in ten chromosome-length scaffolds (nine autosomes and an X chromosome) with a scaffold N50 of 96.2 Mb. The assembly is highly complete, recovering 92.4% of conserved hemipteran single-copy orthologs, and is composed of 47.6% repetitive sequence, dominated by long terminal repeat retrotransposons and unclassified elements. Read-depth comparison between male and female individuals supports assignment of a single sex-linked chromosome, consistent with an XO sex-determination system. BRAKER3 gene annotation predicted 31,406 protein-coding genes after retaining the longest isoform per locus. Comparative genome analysis against the two closest related Typhlocybinae species with genomes available, Matsumurasca onukii and Hebata decipiens , revealed extensive chromosome-scale collinearity, while defining a shared core gene repertoire. This reference genome provides a foundation for comparative and population genomic studies and for investigating genetic traits in this economically important crop pest species. SIGNIFICANCE Leafhoppers (Cicadellidae) are among the most diverse families of plant-feeding insects, but chromosome-level genomes remain scarce, particularly for mesophyll-feeding members of the subfamily Typhlocybinae. The potato leafhopper, Empoasca fabae , is an unusually polyphagous crop and migratory pest of major importance across North America. Here, we provide the first chromosome-level genome assembly for this species. This chromosomal reference reveals broad synteny with two related Typhlocybinae relatives. This assembly will serve as a critical resource, enabling further comparative genomics, population genomics, and functional studies of host-plant adaptation in a significant agricultural crop pest species.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文首次为马铃薯叶蝉（一种危害严重的农业害虫）构建了染色体水平的高质量基因组组装，整合了纳米孔长读长、Illumina短读长和Omni-C染色质构象数据，获得了10条染色体长度的连续序列，并完成了基因注释和比较基因组分析。
analysis.claim: 本研究提供了首个染色体水平的马铃薯叶蝉（Empoasca fabae）基因组组装，填补了该重要农业害虫无高质量参考基因组的空白，并揭示其与近缘种间广泛的染色体共线性。
analysis.input: Oxford Nanopore长读长 + Illumina短读长 + Omni-C染色质互作数据
analysis.output: 染色体水平基因组组装（10条染色体长度scaffold）、31,406个蛋白编码基因注释、重复序列组成、性染色体判定、与近缘种的共线性图谱
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量物种基因组资源建设：技术扎实（多平台整合+染色体锚定+完整BUSCO评估+性染色体验证+跨种比较），但本质是单物种参考基因组产出，未解决方法学普适性问题，也未开展功能验证或群体/适应性机制实证；显著优于普通基因组草图（如仅Illumina scaffold N50<1 Mb），但远未达AlphaFold2/ESM/RFdiffusion等定义新范式的里程碑级别，亦未达到dtSFM级药物靶点特异性建模的科学纵深。
