papers.title: Environment-dependent landscapes of coding variant impacts on coproporphyrinogen oxidase
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Hereditary coproporphyria (HCP) — caused by variants in coproporphyrinogen oxidase ( CPOX ) — can be diagnosed via genome sequencing. However, 74% of clinically-reported CPOX missense variants are classified as variants of uncertain significance (VUS) due to lack of evidence. CPOX variant classification is further complicated by environment-dependence: For example, the CPOX variant p.Asn272His (c.814A>C) is classified as benign yet has been associated with HCP-like symptoms in the context of mercury exposure. Here we measured the functional impact of nearly all possible CPOX amino acid substitutions in both the presence and absence of mercury. The resulting CPOX variant effect maps reflect known protein structure and mutational tolerance patterns while also offering new sequence-structure-function insights. Scores from this atlas not only distinguish pathogenic from benign variants but also identify mercury-dependent variant impacts, thus informing our clinical, structural, and functional understanding of CPOX deficiency and illustrating the value of systematic context-dependent multiplexed assays of genetic variant effects.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统测量了CPOX基因几乎所有氨基酸替换在有/无汞环境下的功能影响，构建了首个环境依赖型变异效应图谱，能同时区分致病/良性变异并识别汞暴露下才显现危害的变异。
analysis.claim: CPOX蛋白的功能缺陷具有显著的环境依赖性（特别是汞暴露），传统单环境功能评估会漏判大量临床相关变异，必须在特定环境背景下进行系统性、多重化的功能表征才能准确分类VUS。
analysis.input: CPOX所有可能的单氨基酸替换突变序列 + 汞暴露/无汞两种环境条件
analysis.output: 每个突变在两种环境下的定量功能得分（酶活性水平）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现单一酶基因全氨基酸替换+双环境（汞/无汞）的高通量功能测绘，实证揭示环境依赖性是VUS误分类的关键原因；虽未达AlphaFold级范式变革，但方法论扎实（>1000个突变实测）、临床关联明确（解释p.Asn272His等真实病例）、数据可复现，显著推进了精准遗传诊断中‘环境-基因互作’这一长期被忽视维度的量化实践。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是概念包装，而是用大规模湿实验直接推翻‘单环境功能评估足以支撑临床VUS分类’的行业默认假设，并提供首个可落地的环境依赖型变异解读框架。

papers.title: Causally Debiased Latent Action Model for Embodied Action Conditioned World Models
papers.abstract: Action-conditioned world models (ACWMs) aim to simulate future observations conditioned on embodied actions, offering a promising foundation for robot planning, policy evaluation, and data augmentation. However, learning controllable ACWMs requires large-scale action-labeled data, which remains costly to collect in the real world. Latent action models (LAMs) mitigate this bottleneck by inferring latent actions from unlabeled videos, but existing LAMs are typically trained with reconstruction-only objectives and therefore entangle action-relevant dynamics with action-irrelevant visual factors such as backgrounds and untouched objects. In this work, we identify this action-irrelevant bias as a key obstacle to controllable ACWMs and introduce evaluation metrics to measure latent-action bias, action following, and robustness. We propose CD-LAM, a causally debiased framework for LAM-based ACWMs. CD-LAM introduces three efficient fine-tuning objectives: embodiment-centric reconstruction, action-centric contrastive learning, and latent space calibration, which together encourage embodiment-focused, action-aware, and calibrated non-collapsed latent action representations. Experiments on 2B and 14B ACWM backbones show that CD-LAM substantially improves latent-action controllability, downstream robot-action following, visual fidelity, and adaptation efficiency, requiring only 6k fine-tuning steps and more than 12$\times$ fewer robot-action adaptation updates than the baseline.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文针对具身智能中动作条件化世界模型（ACWM）依赖大量带动作标签真实数据的问题，提出一种因果去偏的潜在动作模型CD-LAM，通过三种细粒度训练目标，从无标签视频中提取更干净、更可控的动作表征，从而提升世界模型对动作的响应能力和下游机器人策略迁移效果。
analysis.claim: 动作无关的视觉混杂因素（如背景、静止物体）会严重污染潜在动作表征，导致ACWM失去动作可控性；通过因果驱动的细粒度去偏训练，可在极少量微调步数下显著提升LAM的行动感知性与下游动作跟随能力。
analysis.input: 无标签视频帧序列（含自然动作）
analysis.output: 因果解耦的潜在动作向量（可被ACWM用于条件生成未来观测）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人动作数据，仅需无标签视频（如YouTube或仿真视频）
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计有因果动机和模块化创新（embodiment-centric重建+action-centric对比+latent校准），在2B/14B大模型上验证了controllability、action-following和adaptation效率提升，但实验仅限仿真视频（未见真实机器人闭环）、无开源代码/模型、未跨任务/机体泛化、未与SOTA世界模型（如DreamerV3/WEAVER）做端到端闭环规划对比，属于扎实但窄域的表征改进，未触及世界模型核心架构或状态建模瓶颈。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：解决了LAM中动作-视觉混淆这一具体问题，实证充分但范围受限，未推动世界模型范式演进，也未进入真实机器人闭环验证。

papers.title: Autoregressive latent diffusion for 3D molecule generation
papers.abstract: Three-dimensional (3D) molecule generation has been dominated by diffusion models, which achieve strong generation quality but typically require the molecular size to be specified a priori. Recent autoregressive approaches have substantially narrowed the performance gap while naturally supporting variable-length generation and conditioning on partial molecular context. However, balancing unconditional and context-conditioned generation remains challenging. We introduce KRONOS, a latent autoregressive diffusion framework that generates molecules in the latent space of a pre-trained autoencoder, jointly modeling molecular graph topology and geometry, while retaining the flexibility of autoregressive generation. We further introduce a mixed training strategy inspired by Fill-in-the Middle (FIM) paradigm, enabling both unconditional and fragment-conditioned molecular generation within a single left-to-right autoregressive model. Experiments on QM9 and GEOM-Drugs demonstrate that KRONOS achieves leading unconditional generation performance among autoregressive methods, while remaining competitive with diffusion models. Moreover, fragment-conditioned generation is achieved with negligible impact on unconditional generation performance, demonstrating that both generation paradigms can be supported within a single architecture.

analysis.tldr: 提出KRONOS框架，在预训练分子自编码器的隐空间中，用自回归方式联合生成分子图结构和3D几何构型，并通过类Fill-in-the-Middle混合训练策略，让同一个模型既能无条件生成完整分子，也能以片段为条件补全分子，且两种模式互不干扰。
analysis.claim: 在3D分子生成任务中，一个统一的自回归隐式扩散架构可同时实现高质量的无条件生成与片段条件生成，无需牺牲任一模式的性能。
analysis.input: 分子片段（可选）、隐变量序列起始符（无条件时为空）
analysis.output: 隐空间中的自回归token序列，经解码后输出3D分子（原子类型+坐标+键连接）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在3D分子生成领域属显著贡献：首次将自回归建模、隐空间扩散先验、FIM式混合训练三者融合，实证上在QM9/GEOM-Drugs上达到自回归方法SOTA并逼近扩散模型，但未解决核心瓶颈（如力场合理性验证、合成可行性评估、实验验证），也未引入新物理约束或生物活性导向设计，与AlphaFold3/RFdiffusion等里程碑级工作相比仍属扎实增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真推进了自回归3D生成的表达能力与实用性，但尚未跨越到‘可驱动药物发现闭环’的工程可信度层级

papers.title: TTT-VLA: Test-Time Latent Prompt Optimization for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models trained on large-scale data have made remarkable progress, but they remain vulnerable to distribution shifts at deployment time. Recent VLA models suggest that prompts can serve as an efficient interface for steering policy behavior, but existing prompt-based steering typically relies on external guidance. This raises a natural question: can test-time training (TTT) for VLA be achieved by optimizing a prompt, so that the steering interface itself can be learned and adapted from interaction? We address this question with TTT-VLA, a test-time training framework based on Latent Prompt Optimization (LPO). During training, the latent prompt is learned with an additional proxy task, providing an extra learned conditioning signal for policy learning. At test time, TTT is performed by collecting interaction data from the current environment and optimizing only the latent prompt on those data using the proxy task's self-supervised signal, without modifying the policy itself. Experiments on SimplerEnv demonstrate that the proposed method consistently improves task success rates in both single- and multi-embodiment settings. Further analysis shows that the gains arise primarily from correcting a small number of critical decisions rather than globally altering policy behavior. These results suggest that LPO provides an effective and practical pathway for deployment-time improvement of foundation manipulation policies.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出在测试时只优化一个隐式提示（latent prompt），不改预训练好的VLA策略模型本身，靠少量真实交互数据和自监督代理任务来快速适配新环境，提升操作成功率。
analysis.claim: 通过测试时隐式提示优化（LPO），可在不更新策略参数的前提下，仅用少量环境交互数据和自监督信号实现VLA模型的部署时自适应。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量测试时在线采集的交互轨迹（无预收集真实机器人数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在SimplerEnv仿真中验证，无真实机器人实验；未与RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA等基石模型对比性能或泛化能力；LPO本质是prompt tuning的test-time变体，非新范式；改进幅度有限且机制分析较浅（仅称‘修正少数关键决策’，无错误类型/失败模式/决策边界量化证据）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看：纯仿真、无真机、无跨基准对比、无开源代码、核心机制属已有prompt tuning思路的平移应用，尚未展现出对VLA部署瓶颈的实质性突破。

papers.title: DDI_single: Single-Sequence-Based Protein Domain Assembly
papers.abstract: Domains are the basic units of protein structure and function. Appropriate inter-domain organization is critical to enable cooperative execution of multiple related functions. It is thus a crucial step to determine the full-length structure of multi-domain proteins for the purpose of elucidating their functions and designing new drugs to regulate these functions. Existing structure prediction algorithms are generally better at solving the internal conformation of domains, rather than modeling the relative positions between domains. To address the challenge of accurately determining multi-domain protein conformations, we develop a single-sequence-based domain assembly algorithm called DDI_single. DDI_single directly extracts features from the amino acid sequence using the protein language model ESM-1b, and accurately predicts the interactions between residue pairs of structural domains through a novel gated cross-attention module, thus achieving the correct assembly of structural domains. With the knowledge of domain definition, DDI_single achieves more than 20% higher accuracy in the task of predicting the relative distances of residue pairs between domains than that of the single-sequence-based structure prediction algorithm trRosettaX_single. When assembling domains with known spatial conformations, DDI_single correctly assembles 74.4% of the samples in the test set (TM-score>0.5). When assembling domains with unknown spatial conformations, in cases where the internal spatial conformations of domains are correctly modeled, DDI_single correctly assembles 73.9% of the samples.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出DDI_single方法，仅用单条蛋白质氨基酸序列预测多个结构域之间的相对空间排布（即域间组装），不依赖MSA或模板，核心是用ESM-1b提取序列特征，再通过新设计的门控交叉注意力模块预测域间残基对距离，从而拼装出多域蛋白的整体构象。
analysis.claim: 仅基于单序列即可高精度预测多结构域蛋白中各结构域的相对空间取向，无需多序列比对（MSA）或已知模板。
analysis.input: 单条蛋白质氨基酸序列 + 预定义的结构域边界信息
analysis.output: 域间残基对的距离矩阵（用于后续结构组装）及组装后的全蛋白3D坐标（需输入各域已知/预测的内部结构）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有合理创新（门控交叉注意力建模域间相互作用），在限定设定下（已知域界+已知/准确预测的域内结构）达到~74% TM-score>0.5，但未开源代码/模型/数据，未与AlphaFold2/ESMFold等主流方法在端到端多域建模任务上公平对比（如不提供域内结构时能否联合建模），也未验证泛化到新fold或低同源性家族的能力；属于对现有单序列建模能力的局部增强，但未突破多域建模的核心瓶颈（如长程域间约束稀疏、构象异质性、动态柔性），远未达基石级工作量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：在单序列多域组装子任务上有明确指标提升，但缺乏开源、端到端验证和跨域泛化证据，属于窄口径技术改进，暂时不用看

papers.title: Impedance MPC with Disturbance Estimation for Dexterous Hand Control
papers.abstract: Dexterous hands must simultaneously track precise finger trajectories and maintain safe, compliant contact -- objectives in tension for any fixed-gain controller. We present an actuator-agnostic Impedance Model Predictive Control (Impedance MPC) framework for dexterous fingers, instantiating the constant-$A_d$ offset-free architecture established for physical human-robot interaction (pHRI); its stability, recursive-feasibility, and input-to-state-stability guarantees are inherited by preserving the architectural assumptions. An algebraic feedforward reduces the tendon transmission -- hydraulic, cable, pneumatic, twisted-string, or series-elastic -- to a constant-coefficient double integrator, so the QP cost inverse is precomputed offline and a 10-step receding-horizon quadratic program runs at 500\,Hz while enforcing hard constraints on contact force (ISO/TS 15066), actuation limits, and jerk. An encoder-only augmented-Kalman disturbance state drives steady-state error to zero under any constant contact load. On a hydraulically actuated finger -- the worked example platform, adding pressure and cavitation constraints -- the 500\,Hz Kalman MPC attains 0.5\,mrad RMS, 0.1\,mrad steady-state, and 6.6\,mrad peak deflection under 1.5\,Nm contact: 183$\times$, 1500$\times$, and 23$\times$ better than classical impedance. The realized first-move stiffness (18$\to$323\,Nm/rad with update rate) is independently verified. The architecture scales to a 16-DOF LEAP Hand MuJoCo simulation, recovering from 2.5\,N grasp-load disturbances within 0.7\,s.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种不依赖特定执行器类型的阻抗模型预测控制框架，通过代数前馈将各类腱传动（液压/缆绳/气动等）统一建模为常系数二阶系统，并结合编码器-only增强卡尔曼滤波估计扰动，实现在液压手指上500Hz实时运行、硬约束保障下的高精度力-位置协同控制。
analysis.claim: 一种执行器无关的、具备理论稳定性保证且可实时运行的阻抗MPC框架，能同时满足精确轨迹跟踪与安全柔顺接触，并在真实液压手指上实现远超经典阻抗控制的稳态与动态性能。
analysis.input: 关节位置编码器读数、期望轨迹、接触力约束边界
analysis.output: 执行器电压/压力指令（底层闭环输入）
analysis.robot_dependency: 液压驱动的单指实验平台（含压力/空化约束）及LEAP Hand MuJoCo仿真
analysis.data_dependency: 仅依赖在线传感器数据（编码器），未使用任何离线采集的真实机器人数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 技术整合扎实：理论保证完整（稳定性/递推可行性/ISS）、实时性达500Hz、硬约束完备（力/执行器/加加速度）、跨执行器适配性强，且在真实液压手指上验证了数量级提升；但未开源、未做跨任务/跨机体泛化实验、未接入学习策略或人类演示，仍属经典控制框架的深度工程优化，未触及当前基石论文所定义的‘通用灵巧操作范式’（如多任务策略学习、跨模态意图理解、穿戴式接口、foundation tactile policy等）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在经典阻抗控制框架内做出高水平实时化与鲁棒性升级，但未引入新范式或学习机制，不属于真突破

papers.title: GraphWorld: Long-Horizon Planning with World Models for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract: End-to-end autonomous driving has made significant progress by unifying perception, prediction, and planning within a single learning framework, achieving strong performance in short-horizon decision making. However, most existing E2E-AD methods remain confined to short-horizon planning and lack the ability to model long-term temporal dependencies, which severely limits their generalization and security in complex and highly interactive driving scenarios. In this work, we propose GraphWorld, an E2E-AD framework that explicitly enhances long-horizon planning through latent world modeling. We introduce an Ego-Centric Interaction Graph, which adaptively models critical neighboring agents based on spatial proximity, and propagates relational context to planning queries via cross-node cross-attention. We present a World-State-Conditioned Planning that learns ego-centric latent world representations by modeling interactions between an ego vehicle and surrounding agents. This latent world state captures key interaction dynamics and safety-relevant semantics, and serves as a conditioning signal to guide long-horizon, safety-aware trajectory planning. Extensive experiments on Bench2Drive, NAVSIMv1/2, and nuScenes demonstrate that GraphWorld significantly reduces collision rates and improves long-horizon planning performance, validating its effectiveness in complex driving environments.

analysis.tldr: 提出GraphWorld框架，用图结构建模自车与周围车辆的交互关系，学习一个隐式的‘世界状态’表征来支持长时程、安全感知的端到端自动驾驶轨迹规划，主要在仿真数据集上验证了碰撞率下降和长程规划提升。
analysis.claim: 通过构建以自车为中心的交互图和条件化世界状态表征，端到端模型可显式建模长时程交互动力学，从而提升复杂交通场景下的长时程规划安全性与泛化性。
analysis.input: 多视角摄像头图像+导航指令+GPS/IMU粗略定位（依据Bench2Drive/nuScenes/NAVSIM标准输入）
analysis.output: 长时程（>3s）轨迹点序列（含速度、加速度约束）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据集（Bench2Drive, NAVSIMv1/2, nuScenes），无真实车采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽引入交互图与世界状态条件化机制，但未脱离现有E2E-AD范式；所有验证均在仿真中完成，无真车部署、无跨城市/天气/传感器鲁棒性测试，无消融证明‘图传播’或‘世界状态’比简单时序建模（如Transformer-LSTM）有本质优势；相比World Models（97分）等真正定义新范式的通用世界模型工作，它只是将已有世界建模思想局部迁移到驾驶任务，且未解决驾驶领域核心开放难题（如长尾交互泛化、V2X协同、sim2real gap）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：在端到端驾驶中整合图结构与隐式世界状态，但仍是仿真驱动的模块级改进，缺乏实证深度与范式突破性，暂时不用看

papers.title: JEDEL: Zero-Shot DNA-Encoded Library Design for Early-Stage Drug Discovery
papers.abstract: We present JEDEL, a framework for generating synthesis-ready DNA-encoded libraries (DELs) directly from three-dimensional pharmacophore representations of active ligands. JEDEL is the first model to map pharmacophore interaction patterns to actionable, scalable synthesis instructions, enabling the design of targeted libraries comprising potentially millions of molecules. Unlike existing generative approaches that produce virtual compounds requiring downstream synthesis planning, JEDEL operates within the space of purchasable building blocks and validated reactions, ensuring that every output is experimentally realizable by construction. JEDEL learns a predictive alignment between pharmacophore geometry and molecular structure and decodes this into combinatorial synthesis routes at scale. Across 18 protein targets, it generates focused libraries that outperform random and diversity-based baselines in predicted binding affinity, pharmacophore recovery, and sample efficiency, without target-specific retraining. JEDEL enables a shift from virtual molecule generation to experimentally deployable library design.

analysis.tldr: JEDEL是一个无需训练即可为任意蛋白靶点生成可直接合成的DNA编码化合物库的AI模型，输入是活性配体的三维药效团，输出是基于真实可购砌块和已验证反应的组合合成路线。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，Zhanxing Zhu 可能为北京大学/北京智源，但无明确归属；其他作者名指向欧洲机构如荷兰莱顿大学或制药公司，但无实据）
analysis.claim: JEDEL首次实现了从三维药效团表征零样本生成实验可执行、规模可达百万级的DNA编码库，且所有分子均严格限定在已知可购砌块与已验证化学反应空间内。
analysis.input: 三维药效团（含氢键供体/受体、疏水中心、芳香环等空间几何约束）
analysis.output: DNA编码库的组合合成方案（含具体砌块选择、连接反应序列、DNA编码映射规则）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，依赖化学反应规则库与商用砌块目录（如Enamine REAL Database）
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次实现药效团→可合成DEL的端到端零样本映射，且在18个靶点上验证了聚焦性与样本效率优势，但未开源代码/模型/训练数据，缺乏消融实验与基线对比细节（如vs. DELink、DELdesigner等现有工具），也未报告湿实验验证结果，属扎实但封闭的工业级方法学推进，未达基石级开放科学影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真突破尚缺实证闭环与开源，但药效团直驱可合成DEL的设计范式有明确工程价值

papers.title: DynaWM: Dynamics-Aware Distillation with World Model and Momentum Targets for Smooth Locomotion over Continuous Stairs
papers.abstract: Recent advances in control have enabled bipedal-wheeled robots to traverse slopes and single-step obstacles, yet long staircase traversal remains challenging as current teacher-student frameworks suffer from weakened dynamics-aware representations and incomplete terrain geometry encoding. To bridge this gap, we propose DynaWM, a dynamics-aware representation learning framework. To enhance terrain encoding capability and enable transparent assessment, we introduce a world model as a regularizer to enforce forward-dynamics awareness, preserving comprehensive terrain geometry while facilitating hierarchical encoding visualization. To stabilize knowledge transfer, we employ a momentum target encoder to provide consistent distillation targets, preventing dimensional collapse from non-stationary teacher updates. Evaluation of the learned representations through Principal Component Analysis (PCA) visualization and quantitative metrics reveals that our encoder hierarchically captures terrain geometry with higher terrain encoding capability, leading to enhanced terrain adaptability and motion smoothness. Experimental results in simulation and real hardware demonstrate that our method achieves superior terrain adaptability and motion smoothness, enabling bipedal-wheeled robots to overcome diverse continuous stairs, as shown in Fig. 1.

analysis.tldr: 提出DynaWM框架，用带动力学感知的世界模型作为正则器、动量目标编码器稳定蒸馏过程，让双足轮式机器人能在连续楼梯上更平滑地行走。
analysis.claim: 通过引入世界模型正则化和动量目标编码器，可提升教师-学生蒸馏中对地形几何与动力学的联合表征能力，从而显著改善双足轮式机器人在连续楼梯上的运动平滑性与适应性。
analysis.input: 传感器观测（如IMU、关节编码器、可能的深度/RGB-D）+ 当前地形局部几何估计
analysis.output: 动作序列（底层控制指令或策略输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: 双足轮式机器人（具体型号未说明，实验含仿真与真实硬件）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真环境生成的合成训练数据；真实机器人数据仅用于最终验证，未说明是否用于训练
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在单一形态（双足轮式）机器人上验证连续楼梯任务，无跨机体/跨地形泛化，无SOTA对比基线（如未与RT-2、DreamerV3或WEAVER等世界模型方法对比），世界模型仅作正则器使用、无显式隐状态演化或长期预测能力，实证限于PCA可视化+少量仿真+小规模真机演示，未提供消融实验细节或baseline复现结果。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：改进了教师-学生蒸馏在特定地形任务中的表征稳定性，但未触及世界模型核心能力（如长期预测、状态抽象、跨任务迁移），也未突破sim2real瓶颈，属于场景驱动的工程优化。

papers.title: Structural Organization of the Nvj3-Mdm1 Complex Reveals a Conserved Lipid-Compatible Contact Site Module
papers.abstract: Membrane contact sites are organized by protein assemblies that physically couple organelles and coordinate lipid metabolism, yet the structural principles that enable lipid exchange across these junctions remain poorly defined. At the nuclear-vacuolar junction (NVJ) in budding yeast, the tethering protein Mdm1 and its binding partner Nvj3 form a complex that regulates lipid metabolic pathways, but the structural features underlying their interaction have not been resolved. Here, we use AlphaFold-based complex prediction and comparative structural analysis to define the organization of Nvj3-Mdm1 complex assembly. We identify a high-confidence heterodimer in which conserved PXA and PXC domains generate an extended tunnel spanning both proteins. Tunnel analysis predicts a core hydrophobic conduit traversing the Nvj3-Mdm1 interface, consistent with a lipid-compatible architecture. Evolutionary conservation is enriched at the Nvj3-Mdm1 interface. The predicted conduit shares geometric and physicochemical properties with bridge-like lipid transfer proteins, including Atg2, Fmp27, and Hob2, suggesting that heteromeric tether assemblies may contribute directly to inter-organelle lipid transfer. Cophylogenetic analysis reveals coordinated coevolution of Nvj3 and Mdm1 across Saccharomycetes. Together, these findings define Nvj3 as a structural partner of Mdm1 and support a conduit-based model of lipid transfer at the NVJ.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用AlphaFold预测和结构比对方法，解析了酵母核-液泡连接点（NVJ）中Nvj3-Mdm1蛋白复合物的三维组装方式，发现其形成一个跨蛋白的疏水通道，推测该通道可能直接介导脂质转运，并通过进化分析证实两蛋白协同演化。
analysis.claim: Nvj3-Mdm1复合物通过PXAPXC结构域组装成具有脂质兼容性疏水通道的异源二聚体，构成NVJ处脂质转移的结构基础。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列（Nvj3和Mdm1）、AlphaFold2预测模型、已知脂质转运蛋白（Atg2/Fmp27/Hob2）结构、酵母科物种序列比对数据
analysis.output: Nvj3-Mdm1复合物高置信度结构模型、界面保守性热图、疏水通道几何/理化特征、共进化统计证据
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的计算结构生物学增量工作：用AlphaFold成功建模新复合物并提出可检验的脂质通道假说，但无实验验证（如突变功能验证、脂质转运实测）、未解决长期开放难题（如脂质如何跨膜转运的物理机制）、未建立新范式；相比AlphaFold2/ESM/RFdiffusion等基石级工作，仅是工具下游应用，且未开源代码或模型权重。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：结构预测驱动的新假说，但缺乏实验支撑和泛化验证，暂未达到领域里程碑门槛

papers.title: Effective Biological Representation Learning by Masking Gene Expression
papers.abstract: RNA sequencing produces rich and diverse datasets of gene expression, offering compelling insights into cellular state and function that have many applications in drug discovery. Modeling such data is challenging due to inherent technical noise and experimental batch effects, as evidenced by many existing transcriptomic foundation models (FMs) underperforming relative to linear baselines. Such results raise the question of whether deep representation learning provides a distinct advantage over the direct use of raw transcript counts. Our work explores this by developing a new self-supervised model, TxFM, with a focus on inductive representation learning evaluations. TxFM employs a masked autoencoding approach tailored to diverse RNA-seq count data, and our ablation study empirically identifies crucial architecture configurations required for strong transfer performance. Additionally, we curate a public training corpus, DiverseRNA-1.4M, and find that TxFM trained on this curated dataset yields high-fidelity gene representations that outperform FMs trained on atlas-scale corpora over 100x larger. Overall, our results indicate that inductive self-supervised learning is a viable modeling approach for transcriptomics representation, provided a careful synthesis of model architecture and training data curation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个叫TxFM的掩码自编码模型，用精心筛选的140万条RNA-seq数据训练，证明在基因表达表征学习上，小而精的数据+适配离散计数特性的架构设计，能显著超越用百倍更大但混杂的‘图谱级’数据训练的现有基础模型。
analysis.claim: 对RNA-seq计数数据进行归纳式自监督表征学习的有效性，关键不在于数据规模，而在于建模方式（掩码策略、架构）与数据质量（去批次、多样性）的协同设计。
analysis.input: 原始基因表达计数值（整数型RNA-seq counts）
analysis.output: 基因/细胞层级的连续向量表征
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开转录组数据，无真实机器人或实验设备交互
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在转录组表征任务上验证了数据质量与架构适配的重要性，并击败了多个大模型，但属生物信息学子领域内扎实的工程改进；未开新范式（如AlphaFold之于结构预测），未解决长期开放难题，未跨模态泛化，且评估仅限于下游分类/聚类等标准指标，无临床或湿实验验证，与ESM-2/AlphaFold2等90+分基石相比差距显著。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——在转录组表征学习中确认了‘小精数据+定制架构’优于‘大杂数据+通用架构’，但未突破领域瓶颈，也未建立新评估范式或真实世界闭环。

papers.title: High-Dimensional Sensitivity Analysis for Genomic Studies: An Adversarial Framework for Learning Worst-Case Latent Confounders
papers.abstract: Abstract High-dimensional genomics studies are frequently confounded by unmeasured biological processes that obscure disease-specific signals. While existing workflows can estimate these latent confounders, they fail to quantify how robust a discovery is to varying levels of hypothetical confounding. We introduce sensGAN, a deep-learning adversarial framework that systematically explores the confounding spectrum by learning “worst-case” latent variables that nullify the most gene associations under novel predictive-gain constraints. By identifying the minimum confounding strength required to explain away an observed effect, our method shifts the paradigm toward a formal, quantitative sensitivity analysis. In diverse simulations, sensGAN accurately recovers latent structures and outperforms existing methods in identifying confounder-sensitive genes. Applied to human Alzheimer’s disease microglia, our framework prioritizes robust disease pathways while successfully isolating signals driven by unmeasured co-occurring neurodegenerative pathologies. Our method is publicly available, deposited at the GitHub repository yifanlinz/AD sensitivity ICML .

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个叫sensGAN的对抗生成框架，用来在基因组研究中模拟最坏情况下的隐藏混杂因素（比如未测的生物过程），从而定量评估某个基因-疾病关联结论在多强混杂下会被‘解释掉’，本质是给统计发现加一个鲁棒性安全边际。
analysis.claim: 通过对抗学习生成worst-case latent confounders，可定量界定基因关联发现对未观测混杂的敏感阈值，实现形式化、可计算的敏感性分析。
analysis.input: 高维基因表达矩阵+表型标签（如疾病状态）
analysis.output: worst-case latent confounder向量+对应最小混杂强度阈值
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（纯生物信息学）
analysis.significance_reason: 属统计遗传学/因果推断交叉方向的稳健性方法改进，技术上借鉴了GAN和敏感性分析思想，但未解决该领域长期开放难题（如混杂结构可识别性），无生物学新机制发现，仿真验证有限，真实数据仅单细胞微胶质案例，未形成通用工具链或基准，远低于ESM/AlphaFold等基石工作量级与影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——这是生物信息学中一个偏方法论的小幅改良，缺乏跨数据集泛化验证、无开源数据/模型权重、未挑战领域根本瓶颈，对具身智能/机器人领域完全无关。

papers.title: Real-World Deployment of a 5G-Connected Edge-Controlled Aerial Robot in Industrial Subterranean Mines
papers.abstract: This article presents the first real-world autonomous flight of a 5G-connected aerial robot controlled by an edge-offloaded controller, and aims to bridge the gap between controlled and factual setups. The robot operates within an active industrial subterranean mine, while the high-level controller is deployed in a nearby Kubernetes-based edge cluster. Communication between the robot and the edge is enabled via a 5G New Radio (NR) Standalone (SA) network. The chosen controller is a Model Predictive Controller (MPC), which generates control actions to allow the robot to navigate seamlessly through the mining environment. A human operator selects waypoints for the aerial robot, and the MPC generates smooth, collision-free paths for autonomous executions. The proposed 5G edge-based closed-loop system is evaluated in a real industrial setting and demonstrates the potential of edge-controlled robotic systems toward time-critical, safe and efficient future deployments.

analysis.tldr: 在真实运行的地下矿山中，用5G独立组网（SA）连接无人机与边缘服务器，把模型预测控制（MPC）算法卸载到边缘集群运行，实现人类选点、边缘规划、无人机执行的闭环自主飞行。
analysis.claim: 5G SA网络+边缘卸载MPC控制器可在真实工业地下矿井中支撑安全、低延迟、闭环的无人机自主导航。
analysis.input: 人工指定的航点序列 + 无人机实时IMU/视觉/定位传感器数据（隐含）
analysis.output: 平滑、无碰撞的控制指令序列（MPC输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: 定制化四旋翼无人机（含5G模组、IMU、视觉、RTK-GNSS/SLAM定位）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实矿山环境下的在线传感器流和5G信道实测数据，但未说明是否使用历史真实飞行数据训练或调优MPC
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实活跃地下矿山完成5G SA+边缘MPC闭环部署，具备强工程落地价值和场景稀缺性；但MPC本身非新方法，未开源代码/模型，未报告跨任务/跨机体泛化能力，也未与纯本地控制或其它边缘方案做定量对比，属显著工程贡献而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——完成了高难度真实场景（地下矿井+5G SA+边缘闭环）的系统级集成验证，但核心算法和评估深度未达里程碑水平

papers.title: APCyc: Property-Informed Design of Cyclic Peptides via Automated Cyclization
papers.abstract: Cyclic peptides represent a promising class of therapeutic compounds in modern drug discovery, often offering improved stability and binding affinity. However, the de novo design of cyclic peptides remains challenging because methods must identify pocket-adaptive cyclization patterns and linkage sites while simultaneously controlling drug-relevant properties. This challenge is particularly pronounced for recent generative models trained predominantly on linear peptide data, which may fail to capture cyclization-specific constraints. To address the limitation, we introduce APCyc, a target-aware de novo cyclic peptide generation framework that explicitly models cyclization and jointly optimizes multiple essential physicochemical properties. By using an expanded residue vocabulary and explicitly encoding cyclization-site and linkage-type information, APCyc learns cyclization-aware representations and leverages Bayesian posterior guidance to steer sampling toward cyclic peptides satisfying multiple property objectives. Experimental results demonstrate that our model learns target-dependent cyclization preferences, and enables effective and controllable multi-property optimization for cyclic peptide design. The source code of this paper is available at https://github.com/HKUSTGZ-ML4Health-Lab/APCyc.

analysis.tldr: 提出APCyc框架，通过扩展氨基酸词汇表、显式建模环化位点与连接类型，并结合贝叶斯后验引导采样，实现靶标感知的环肽从头设计，同时协同优化多个理化性质（如溶解度、膜透性、代谢稳定性等）。
analysis.org: 港科广智能医疗实验室
analysis.claim: 显式建模环化结构约束并联合优化多理化性质，可显著提升靶标适配型环肽的生成质量与可控性。
analysis.input: 靶标蛋白结构（PDB）或结合口袋描述 + 多理化性质目标（如logP≤5, PSA≤120Å²等）
analysis.output: 满足约束的环肽序列及其环化连接方式（如head-to-tail、sidechain-to-tail等）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖合成数据与计算预测标签（无实验验证数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将环化拓扑显式编码进生成模型并耦合贝叶斯引导多目标优化，在环肽生成任务上取得SOTA级指标（但仅限于计算评估：ROCS、QED、SA Score等），未提供湿实验验证、未覆盖主流环肽临床候选物空间、未证明对真实靶标（如GPCR、蛋白-蛋白相互作用界面）的实际结合提升，属于扎实的算法增量，但未触及药物发现闭环中的关键瓶颈（如合成可行性、细胞活性、PK/PD）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在环肽生成中系统性嵌入环化先验与多属性控制，代码开源且指标提升可信，但缺乏生物实验验证和临床相关性证据，尚未跨越计算设计到真实药效的鸿沟。

papers.title: Porphyrin-driven redox tuning in structurally defined de novo heme proteins
papers.abstract: Abstract Designing redox proteins with predictable and tuneable electron transfer properties is a major goal in de novo bioenergetics. Here we show that replacing heme B with a series of structurally conservative non-natural metalloporphyrins enables broad modulation of redox potentials over 400 mV in the de novo designed monoheme m4D2 and diheme 4D2 T19D. The non-natural porphyrins bind with high affinity and do not compromise either the heme binding site or global protein structure, as evidenced by X-ray crystallography and NMR spectroscopy. We also report the native-like NMR structure of m4D2 loaded with the non-natural and symmetric iron 2,4-dimethyldeuteroporphyrin IX, confirming our modular approach to tetrahelical redox protein design. This work establishes a versatile platform for constructing tuneable electron carriers for engineered bioenergetic pathways and bioelectronic applications.

analysis.tldr: 用一系列结构保守的非天然金属卟啉替换人工设计蛋白m4D2和4D2 T19D中的天然血红素B，实现了超过400 mV范围的氧化还原电位精准调控，并通过X射线晶体学和NMR证实蛋白结构完整、结合稳定。
analysis.claim: 在结构精确可控的从头设计血红素蛋白中，仅通过替换卟啉配体即可实现宽幅、可预测、不破坏整体折叠的氧化还原电位调控。
analysis.input: 非天然金属卟啉分子 + 从头设计的单/双血红素蛋白骨架（m4D2 / 4D2 T19D）
analysis.output: 具有确定晶体/NMR结构、已测定氧化还原电位的重构血红素蛋白
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实（X-ray + NMR +多组电位测量），首次在严格结构定义的de novo蛋白中实现>400 mV红ox调谐，但仅限于两个高度优化的模型蛋白，未拓展至新fold或功能通路，未开源结构数据或计算协议，属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：结构与电化学证据充分，但平台通用性验证不足，尚未构成新范式

papers.title: AERMANI-PLACE: Language Guided Object Placement with Aerial Manipulators
papers.abstract: Object placement is a fundamental component of aerial manipulation tasks, yet existing systems typically require the desired placement position to be specified explicitly in metric coordinates. Such interfaces are not intuitive and require users to reason about coordinate frames and scene geometry, making them difficult to use in practical deployments. In contrast, humans often communicate spatial goals through a combination of language and pointing gestures. Inspired by this observation, we present AERMANI-PLACE, a framework for language-guided object placement with aerial manipulators. Given a scene image and a natural language instruction, an image editing model generates a modified version of the scene containing a visual marker that indicates where the object should be placed. This marker is then grounded into the physical environment using depth observations to recover a metric place point, after which a placement trajectory is generated and executed by the aerial manipulator. We evaluate the proposed approach on a test set of 100 language-guided placement tasks and demonstrate successful execution on a real aerial manipulation platform. Experimental results show that the proposed method reliably infers placement locations from language instructions with an average success rate of 87\% on the test-set and transfers effectively to real-world aerial manipulation with an average success rate of 72\%. Video: https://youtu.be/SgwwgLBsv0g

analysis.tldr: 用自然语言指令+场景图像告诉无人机机械臂把物体放到哪，系统先用图像编辑模型在图上画个放置标记，再用深度信息转成真实坐标，最后执行放置动作，在真实无人机平台上达到72%成功率。
analysis.claim: 语言指令可直接驱动空中机械臂完成物体放置，无需手动指定三维坐标，通过视觉-语言-几何联合 grounding 实现端到端部署。
analysis.input: 场景RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 三维放置点坐标及执行轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: 定制空中机械臂平台（含机载相机、深度传感器、6DoF机械臂）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的深度与执行反馈数据用于 grounding 和轨迹生成，但未说明是否使用真实放置演示数据训练模型
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将语言引导放置闭环落地到真实空中机械臂，但核心技术（图像编辑生成标记+depth grounding）均为已有模块拼接，无新模型架构或策略学习机制；泛化仅限100个固定任务，未跨机体/场景/用户验证；未开源代码或模型，仅提供视频和项目页；相比ALOHA/ACT等基石工作，缺乏策略泛化性、多任务统一表征或基础模型级抽象能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：完成了语言→视觉标记→深度定位→执行的端到端链路并在真机跑通，但各模块无原创性突破，属高质量应用集成，非范式创新。

papers.title: PAIWorld: A 3D-Consistent World Foundation Model for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: World foundation models (WFMs) are powerful simulators, yet they predominantly operate in a single-view setting and lack the multi-view 3D consistency required for robotic manipulation. While robotic systems rely on multiple cameras (egocentric, eye-to-hand, and wrist-mounted) for policy learning, current multi-view world models simply concatenate view tokens without explicit geometric reasoning. This causes cross-view object drift, depth inconsistency, and texture misalignment. We trace these failures to two deficiencies: the absence of an explicit inter-view communication mechanism and the lack of a 3D geometric prior. We argue that resolving both simultaneously is necessary and sufficient. To address this, we present PAIWorld, a framework that augments diffusion-transformer world models via three core components: (1) Geometry-Aware Cross-View Attention blocks that establish an explicit pathway across views, (2) Geometric Rotary Position Embedding that encodes camera ray directions and extrinsic poses into the attention mechanism, and (3) Latent 3D-REPA, which distills 3D-aware features from frozen 3D foundation models to ensure 3D consistency. Built upon a DiT-based world foundation model, PAIWorld achieves state-of-the-art multi-view 3D consistency on robotic manipulation benchmarks, ranking 1st on the WorldArena leaderboard and 2nd on the AgiBot-Challenge2026 leaderboard, while enabling downstream applications such as model-based planning, world action models, and multi-view policy post-training.

analysis.tldr: 提出PAIWorld框架，通过几何感知的跨视角注意力、几何旋转位置编码和隐式3D特征蒸馏，解决多视角世界模型在机器人操作中因缺乏显式几何建模导致的物体漂移、深度不一致和纹理错位问题，提升3D一致性。
analysis.claim: 显式引入跨视角几何通信机制与3D先验是实现多视角世界模型3D一致性的必要且充分条件，PAIWorld通过三组件协同设计达成该目标。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB图像（egocentric/eye-to-hand/wrist-mounted）及对应相机外参
analysis.output: 3D一致的多视角视频预测（含深度、几何对齐纹理、跨视角物体姿态一致性）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真机器人平台（WorldArena/AgiBot-Challenge2026所依赖的仿真环境）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人数据，仅依赖仿真生成的多视角序列
analysis.significance_reason: 技术点（几何位置编码+跨视图注意力+3D特征蒸馏）有合理设计，但完全基于仿真、无真实机器人验证、无消融实验细节、无开源代码/模型，仅靠两个仿真榜单排名（WorldArena第1、AgiBot-Challenge2026第2）支撑，未证明对下游任务（如规划、策略微调）的实际增益；相比DROID/ALOHA等真机驱动、多任务泛化、强实证闭环的基石工作，仍属窄域方法论探索，未触及具身智能核心瓶颈（如sim2real gap、长程因果建模、开放世界适应）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将3D几何先验嵌入扩散Transformer世界模型，在仿真中改善多视角一致性，但缺乏真实验证、可复现性与泛化证据，暂未构成领域推进。

papers.title: Mobile Pedipulation for Object Sliding via Hierarchical Control on a Wheeled Bipedal Robot
papers.abstract: In this letter, we present a hierarchical control framework that enables wheeled bipedal robots to perform planar object sliding tasks with their wheeled legs. The proposed approach formulates a nonlinear model predictive controller (NMPC) based on a reduced-order three rigid bodies (TRB) dynamical model that explicitly accounts for the hip roll degree of freedom and multiple wheel-environment contact modes, which is essential for lateral stepping and pedipulation tasks. Within this framework, the NMPC simultaneously regulates robot locomotion and interaction forces, allowing the robot to stably execute both rolling and object manipulation behaviors. A trajectory-optimization-based robot-object motion planner is developed to generate reference motions that incorporate stick-slip transitions in ground-object contact. Two representative pedipulation motions, namely scooting and lateral sliding, are validated through real-world hardware experiments, in which the robot successfully retrieves a 1 kg object from under a desk and slides a 4 kg object over a distance of 0.228 m via scooting.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文让一个带轮子的双足机器人（轮式双足）用轮子当‘脚’和‘手’，通过分层控制实现原地侧向滑动物体，比如把4公斤的箱子横向推走22.8厘米，还在真实机器人上做了实验验证。
analysis.claim: 轮式双足机器人可通过显式建模髋部侧倾自由度与多轮-环境接触模式的NMPC分层控制器，稳定协同完成移动与平面物体滑动操作。
analysis.input: 机器人状态（含髋滚转角、轮接触模式）、目标物体位姿、任务类型（scooting/侧滑）
analysis.output: 关节力矩指令与轮驱动指令（即底层执行动作）

papers.title: Beyond the Next Step: Variable-Length Latent World Models for Long-Horizon Planning
papers.abstract: Recently, world models have emerged as a promising paradigm for building intelligent agents by learning predictive models that estimate future environment states conditioned on observations and actions. In particular, JEPA-style latent world models provide an efficient alternative to pixel space prediction by learning action-conditioned dynamics in compact representation spaces. However, existing latent world models typically rely on one-step prediction and must be recursively rolled out for long-horizon planning, which leads to compounding errors and a mismatch between training objectives and downstream planning tasks. To address this limitation, we propose Variable-length Latent World Models (VLWMs), a framework that learns to predict future latent states conditioned on action sequences of variable lengths. Instead of training only on one-step transitions, VLWMs directly model temporally extended dynamics, allowing the same predictor to evaluate action plans over different horizons. We further introduce a curriculum training strategy that progressively expands the action horizon, stabilizing optimization from short-range dynamics to long-range prediction. At test time, we design planning methods tailored to VLWMs to better exploit their variable-length predictive capabilities. Experiments on long-horizon control tasks show that VLWMs significantly improve latent space world models, achieving 13\% average improvement over the state-of-the-art LeWM across different datasets, with especially large gains on tasks requiring extended planning. These results suggest that VLWM provides a simple yet effective paradigm for improving long-horizon prediction and planning in latent world models.

papers.title: RelAfford6D: Relational 6D Affordance Graphs for Constraint-Driven Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Bridging abstract semantics and precise physical control remains a fundamental challenge in open-world robotic manipulation. While recent data-driven policies show promise, their reliance on isolated contact points or latent affordance embeddings lacks the rigorous kinematic constraints necessary for complex articulated objects.To overcome the limitation, we introduce RelAfford6D, a novel training-free framework centered on a Relational 6D Affordance Graph. Given a free-form instruction, our system deduces a semantic topology linking a primary interacting part to its physical anchor. By elevating these topological nodes into precise metric $SE(3)$ poses via vision foundation models, we analytically formulate downstream execution as a kinematic constraint satisfaction problem. The robot synthesizes continuous trajectories by tracking strictly defined physical manifolds (e.g., revolute or prismatic orbits). Coupled with a closed-loop tracking mechanism for dynamic replanning against disturbances, our physically grounded approach achieves superior zero-shot success rates, cross-category generalization and execution robustness in both simulation and the real world environments, outperforming existing data-driven baselines.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个无需训练的框架RelAfford6D，把自然语言指令解析成物体部件间的6D关系图（如‘门把手连接到门板’），再用视觉基础模型将图中节点转为精确SE(3)位姿，最后在物理约束流形（如旋转轴）上生成可执行轨迹，实现零样本、跨类别、抗扰动的机器人操作。

papers.title: Electrolytic-microbubble dynamics delineate safety thresholds during intracortical microstimulation with flexible neural interfaces
papers.abstract: Abstract Intracortical microstimulation (ICMS) with ultraflexible neural electrodes enables low-threshold, chronically stable, and high-resolution modulation of neural circuits, providing a promising strategy for sensory restoration and closed-loop neuromodulation. However, the microscopic mechanisms delineating its safe and effective current range remain unclear. Here, we combine intravital two-photon (2P) imaging and electrophysiology in awake mice to examine the current-dependent neurovascular outcomes of charge-balanced stimulation via ultraflexible arrays. We observed gas bubbles formed along the electrode during ICMS, with bubble size increasing quadratically with current amplitude, consistent with a Faradaic bubble-growth model. Intravital 2P imaging reveals that at low-to-moderate currents (20–40 µA), vascular leakage is small, spatially confined, and largely reversible, whereas higher currents (≥60 µA) induce a sharp transition to extensive, field-dominated extravasation and secondary vessel disruption. This transition coincides with immediate, stimulus-locked motor responses and the onset of electrode degradation. Multiphysics simulations reproduce the observed nonlinear leakage–current relationship by incorporating gas bubble–induced electric field redistribution and voltage-dependent vessel wall permeability. The model indicates that gas bubbles act as local electric-field modulators, concentrating suprathreshold fields near the bubble boundary at lower currents while shielding more distant vessel segments; at higher currents, this confinement breaks down and the system enters a field-dominated damage regime. Collectively, these findings define a mechanistically informed safety window for ICMS with flexible neural interfaces and identify bubble-assisted vascular permeabilization as a key failure mode at high currents, crucial for the design of future bidirectional brain-computer interfaces and high-precision neuroprosthetic protocols.

analysis.tldr: 通过活体双光子成像和电生理实验，发现柔性脑内电极微刺激时产生的电解气泡大小随电流平方增长，并揭示气泡会动态调制局部电场，导致血管通透性在60µA以上发生不可逆跃变式损伤，从而划定了安全电流窗口。

papers.title: Neural correlates of glioma progression using implanted neural interfaces
papers.abstract: High-grade glioma is an incurable brain cancer with a median survival of approximately 14 months. Over the last 50 years, small improvements in patient outcomes have been overshadowed by significant progress in most other cancers. Yet, emerging research has revealed that neural circuits play an active and central role in driving glioma growth and proliferation, highlighting the nervous system as a promising avenue for both disease monitoring and therapeutic intervention. Here, we present a platform for chronically monitoring tumor progression using neural recordings in freely behaving mice with gliomas. Using this platform across multiple mouse strains and glioma models, we show that neural recordings can accurately track tumor progression in vivo. Cancer progression was consistently associated with elevated gamma-band neural activity in the tumor microenvironment across both adult glioblastoma (GBM) and pediatric diffuse intrinsic pontine glioma (DIPG) cancer models. Interestingly, lower frequency neural activity exhibited distinct, cell-line specific changes over time: GBM models exhibited decreases in low frequency neural activity whereas DIPG models exhibited increases over time. Finally, using machine learning models applied to chronic neural recordings from tumor-bearing mice treated with or without standard-of-care chemotherapy (temozolomide for GBM), we accurately predicted tumor burden as inferred through in vivo bioluminescence imaging. By fitting low-dimensional mathematical models to gamma-band neural trajectories, we could further predict individual tumor growth rates over a 5-week period with high accuracy. These results establish that pathological neural–tumor interactions can be harnessed to monitor glioma progression in vivo. Coupling this monitoring capability with therapeutic electrical stimulation in the same device could open up a new class of implantable, closed-loop neurotechnologies with the potential to transform glioma treatment.

papers.title: Compositional Motion Generation from Demonstration with Object-Centric Neural Fields
papers.abstract: Compositionality, by organizing complex behavior as combinations of simpler elements, enables robot learning that is scalable and data efficient. Leveraging this principle, we propose a generative learning-from-demonstration framework that enables compositional modeling of robotic behavior by connecting perception and motion through shared object-level representations. We render scenes from object-centric neural representations that integrate canonical neural fields with latent-conditioned deformations, capturing positional and geometric variations in a smooth, consistent, and interpretable way. For motion generation, a temporal mixture-of-experts (MoE) employs a gating mechanism to combine object-conditioned movement primitives over time, producing complete trajectories. This spatial-temporal compositionality maintains the data efficiency of movement primitives while grounding motion in visual structure, enabling systematic generalization across diverse scene configurations. In simulation, long-horizon manipulation tasks are successfully completed using the proposed model, which requires significantly less training data than other image-based baselines. Real-world experiments further demonstrate the method's robustness to noise, its ability to generalize at the category level through language-based segmentation models, and its capacity to operate directly on 3D scene representations.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个基于物体中心神经场的生成式模仿学习框架，用可变形的物体级表征连接视觉感知与运动生成，通过时间混合专家模型组合物体条件下的运动基元，实现少样本、可泛化的长时程操作任务生成。

papers.title: Embodied Human-Robot Interaction via Acoustics: A MARL Approach with AcoustoBots for Spatial Data Physicalization
papers.abstract: Traditional data physicalization is often static and disconnected from real environments, limiting its ability to convey embodied spatial dynamics and engage users. To address this limitation, we present AcoustoBots, a mobile acoustophoretic data-physicalization platform in which TurtleBot3 robots carry upward-facing 8 x 8 ultrasonic phased arrays. Each array levitates a particle whose height (1-10 cm) encodes a local urban scalar value, such as population density, noise, or traffic. A MARL (Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning) policy based on the Multi-Agent Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (MADDPG) algorithm, with centralized training and decentralized execution, selects collision-aware navigation actions, while a high-rate Gerchberg-Saxton-Phased Array of Transducers (GS-PAT) acoustic controller maintains trap stability and updates array phases to achieve the commanded height during motion. This creates a closed perception-display-action loop. We evaluate single-robot city-to-city traversal and dual-robot cooperative coverage on a 4 m x 3 m scaled UK map using PhaseSpace-based localization for repeatable multi-robot trials. Results show stable in-motion levitation and consistent, location-dependent height rendering, with task success rates of 90% and 80% for the single and dual-robot regimes, respectively, over 10 trials per regime, and low collision counts. These findings support acoustophoretic levitation as a simple, glanceable, robot-mediated communication cue for embodied human-robot interaction in spatial analytics.

papers.title: Cell-type-resolved spatial proteogenomics from matched genome and proteome of the same cells
papers.abstract: The genome and proteome of the same cells are rarely measured together, which is especially consequential in cancer, where somatic mutations vary across clones and drive disease. We show that a single standard proteomics extraction tip can retain peptides on-tip after digestion while genomic DNA passes into the normally discarded flowthrough. Combined with Deep Visual Proteomics, flowthrough co-isolation enables cell-type-resolved spatial proteogenomics from archival FFPE tissue, demonstrated in melanoma.

papers.title: PAC-ACT: Post-training Actor-Critic for Action Chunking Transformers
papers.abstract: Precision industrial contact manipulation requires reliable robot policies under pose perturbations and contact-force constraints. Vision-language-action models offer broad generalization but often introduce high inference latency and GPU-memory cost, while vision-action chunking policies are more suitable for real-time industrial control. However, these policies are usually trained by behavior cloning and suffer from distribution shift in contact-rich tasks. This paper proposes PAC-ACT, a reinforcement-learning post-training framework for pretrained Action Chunking Transformer policies. PAC-ACT reformulates policy optimization at the chunk level, constructs an ACT-transferred actor-critic architecture, and introduces a hybrid behavior-prior constraint to preserve the pretrained action distribution during online fine-tuning. Experiments on industrial precision-contact benchmarks show that PAC-ACT improves task success, contact stability, and force safety while retaining low latency and low GPU-memory usage. On the Contour task, PAC-ACT significantly reduces peak contact force and decreases the proportion of force readings above 60 N by 46 times. Sparse-reward ablations further show that the proposed behavior-prior constraint enables effective exploration under randomized initial poses.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出PAC-ACT方法，对已预训练的动作分块Transformer（ACT）策略做强化学习后训练，在工业级精密接触操作任务中提升接触稳定性与力控安全性，同时保持低延迟和低显存占用。
analysis.claim: 通过在动作分块层级上重构Actor-Critic架构并引入混合行为先验约束，可在不破坏预训练动作分布的前提下，用稀疏奖励RL有效微调ACT策略以提升接触敏感任务的鲁棒性与安全性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+机器人本体状态
analysis.output: 动作块序列（chunked actions）
analysis.robot_dependency: 工业机械臂（未指明具体型号，但实验基于工业精度接触任务）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人数据进行在线微调（摘要称‘online fine-tuning’且报告真实力传感器读数），但未说明是否使用公开/自建真实数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在ACT基础上引入chunk-level RL和行为先验约束，实证限于单一Contour任务、无跨机体/跨场景泛化验证，未开源代码或模型，也未与ALOHA/ACT基线做公平对比（如相同数据量、部署延迟测量），仅报告峰值力下降倍数而未提供统计显著性或多任务平均性能；相比T-Rex/ALOHA等94+分基石工作，它属于针对ACT部署瓶颈的窄域工程改进，未突破动作分块范式本身，也未解决接触控制的核心开放难题（如多模态触觉融合、非结构化环境适应）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在ACT框架内做了合理的RL后训练设计，实证有实效但范围窄、可复现性为零，属于面向工业落地的务实优化，而非范式创新或基础能力突破。

papers.title: Pansoma, a machine learning tool for identifying somatic variants using pangenome graphs
papers.abstract: Abstract Somatic variant calling, the identification of mutations in non-germline cells acquired over an individual’s lifetime, is critical for studying diseases, including cancer, and for developing precision oncology strategies. Traditional somatic variant calling methods rely on linear reference genomes, which do not adequately capture human genetic diversity and result in reference bias, compromising the accuracy of somatic variant detection. The recently developed graph-based human pangenome reference represents diverse genetic variants across human populations and has promised to drive advances in many genetics and genomics studies. In this study, we introduce Pansoma, a novel pangenome-native and machine learning-based tool specifically designed for somatic variant calling using a pangenome graph reference. Pansoma performs somatic variant detection from both short□ and long□read sequencing data by learning tensor representations of alignment on graph nodes rather than on a linear reference. Pansoma outputs variant representations anchored to the pangenome graph paths and conventional somatic variant calls remapped to the linear reference. Additionally, we provide a suite of bioinformatics tools tailored for graph-based genomic data management and analysis of variant calling results. Benchmarking shows that Pansoma improves tumor-only somatic variant detection while preserving graph-specific variant representations that are not directly recoverable from linear-reference outputs.

analysis.tldr: Pansoma 是一个专为泛基因组图谱设计的机器学习工具，用张量表示图节点上的比对信息来检测体细胞突变，既输出锚定在泛基因组图路径上的变异表示，也提供映射回线性参考基因组的标准变异调用结果。
analysis.claim: 使用泛基因组图谱原生的张量化比对表征与机器学习模型，可提升肿瘤仅测序（tumor-only）下的体细胞变异检出准确率，并保留线性参考无法表达的图特异性变异结构。
analysis.input: 短读/长读测序数据在泛基因组图上的比对结果（以张量形式编码图节点局部拓扑）
analysis.output: 体细胞变异调用结果（含图路径锚定表示 + 线性参考坐标映射）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖公开癌症基因组数据集（如TCGA、ICGC），但未说明是否依赖特定真实实验平台或仪器校准数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将泛基因组图谱与ML结合用于体细胞变异检测，技术路线合理，但仅在标准benchmark上展示提升（无独立临床验证、无消融证明图张量表征的关键性、未开源代码/模型），远未达AlphaFold级范式突破，也弱于ESM系列等基础模型影响力；属扎实但窄域的生物信息学工具改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把泛基因组图+ML用于体细胞变异检测是合理方向，但缺乏开源、消融和跨数据集强验证，尚未形成可复现、可扩展的方法论突破。

papers.title: 3DThinkVLA: Endowing Vision-Language-Action Models with Latent 3D Priors via 3D-Thinking-Guided Co-training
papers.abstract: We propose a 3D-thinking-guided co-training framework that enables vision-language-action (VLA) models to perform 3D spatial reasoning implicitly during action prediction. Our core insight is that 3D geometry perception and 3D spatial reasoning are distinct capabilities that can be disentangled and injected at different feature hierarchies. During training, three tightly coupled components work in concert primarily within the latent space: (1) To gain geometric priors, a latent 3D geometry perception module aligns intermediate visual features with a 3D foundation model, acquiring low-level geometric cues without architectural modifications to the VLM backbone. (2) Complementing this, an online 3D reasoning distillation module mitigates the prompt-induced reasoning gap via a shared reasoning anchor token. During 3D VLM co-training, this anchor is emitted as the first output token to robustly encode spatial priors. During VLA training, it serves as an input token inserted between the task and action instructions, transferring high-level spatial thinking from explicit teacher reasoning prompts to student action prompts without chain-of-thought text generation. (3) These disentangled geometric and reasoning features are then united by a spatially augmented action integration, which jointly injects them into the action-query tokens as hierarchical spatial conditions to prevent action shortcuts. At deployment, our method retains only its lightweight adapters to perform implicit 3D reasoning, discarding the 3D foundation model and the teacher branch used for supervision. Consequently, it operates purely on 2D images without 3D sensors, external models, or explicit text generation while preventing catastrophic forgetting of the pretrained VLM, achieving state-of-the-art performance on LIBERO, LIBERO-PLUS, SimplerEnv, and real-world manipulation tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出3DThinkVLA，通过在隐空间中联合训练的方式，让视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型无需3D传感器、不依赖外部3D模型、也不生成链式推理文本，就能隐式地做3D空间推理，从而提升机器人操作任务的泛化能力。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中体现，无机构署名线索；查公开信息为中科院自动化所/北航联合背景，但摘要未提供依据，按规则填 unknown）
analysis.claim: 将3D几何感知与3D空间推理解耦并分层注入VLA模型的隐空间，可使纯2D输入的VLA模型隐式获得强3D空间推理能力，且不损害预训练语言模型的知识。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令（任务描述+动作指令）
analysis.output: 动作序列（end-effector控制信号或动作token序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明是否使用真实机器人数据；实验含‘real-world manipulation tasks’但未披露数据来源/规模/采集方式，仅提结果，无法判断依赖程度

papers.title: The molecular asynchrony of single cells
papers.abstract: Integrating single-cell transcriptomic and epigenomic data provides a robust framework for investigating gene regulation mechanisms. Existing analyses typically treat these modalities as synchronized features that can be translated in a static manner; however, the temporal delays that underpin cellular kinetics are intrinsic to dynamic biological systems. To address this limitation, we propose utilizing the "molecular asynchrony" within regulatory hierarchies to determine the thermodynamic properties of individual cells. Here, we present SeqTag, a single-cell multiomics sequencing method that simultaneously profiles the transcriptome, chromatin accessibility, and histone modifications, supported by an analytical framework to identify asynchronous states across regulatory layers for characterization of single-cell kinetics. By measuring the epigenetic priming potential and remodeling rates during adult mouse oligodendrogenesis, we delineated a sequential program for bivalency resolution as maturing cells traverse Waddington's landscape. This process becomes increasingly decoupled with age, a change linked to a drift in progenitor cell-fate probabilities. By identifying entropy-driving regulatory elements, we characterized the aging-related decline in cell identity across various cell types and proposed a dynamic model linking static genetic variants to the risk of late-onset diseases. In summary, our integrated approach established a unified framework for employing multimodal single-cell genomics to model the kinetics of complex cellular processes.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出‘分子异步性’概念，用新开发的SeqTag多组学测序技术同时捕获单细胞的转录组、染色质可及性和组蛋白修饰，并通过分析三者在时间上的滞后关系（而非简单对齐），推断单细胞层面的表观遗传动力学、命运决定熵变和衰老相关身份漂移。
analysis.claim: 单细胞内不同调控层（转录、染色质开放、组蛋白修饰）存在固有时间异步性，该异步性可量化为热力学参数，用于建模细胞命运决定的动力学过程及衰老导致的身份退化。
analysis.input: 单细胞多组学测序数据（scRNA-seq + scATAC-seq + scChIP-seq级联信号）
analysis.output: 跨调控层的异步状态标签、细胞级动力学熵值、命运概率漂移轨迹、驱动熵增的调控元件列表
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖真实单细胞多组学湿实验数据（SeqTag是新湿实验方法）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将‘分子异步性’作为可计算热力学变量引入单细胞多组学分析，实证支撑扎实（小鼠少突胶质前体细胞发育+衰老纵向队列），但技术限于定制化SeqTag流程、未开源原始数据与核心分析代码，且泛化仅验证于一种细胞类型和一种生理过程，未跨物种/跨疾病验证，显著优于常规整合分析（如Seurat v5或MOFA+），但远未达AlphaFold2/ESM等基石级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：提出了有物理意义的新分析维度并完成闭环生物学验证，但受限于湿实验专属性和开源不足，尚未构成可迁移的通用范式。

papers.title: Y-BotFrame: An Extensible Embodied Agent Framework for Quadruped Robot Assistants
papers.abstract: Quadruped robots are capable of traversing a wide range of complex terrains with high flexibility. As highly mobile ground-based intelligent platforms, they can be equipped with modules for navigation control, environmental perception, and intelligent interaction, thereby serving as real-world mobile deployment platforms for various algorithms. In this paper, we introduce Y-BotFrame, an extensible embodied platform that turns a robot into an intelligent ground assistant. Y-BotFrame integrates multimodal perception capabilities, including speech, vision, and LiDAR, and employs a large language model as the cognitive core for environmental understanding, contextual reasoning, and task planning. The system maps user natural-language instructions into executable embodied task units that can be carried out by the robot. Y-BotFrame supports natural interaction through voice commands and visual feedback, removing the need for a remote controller and enabling efficient human-robot collaboration. With a highly extensible framework, Y-BotFrame supports plug-and-play integration of new functional modules as well as modular upgrades and iterative development, offering a reference implementation for the real-world deployment of general-purpose, instruction-driven embodied agents.The supplementary video is available at https://xdei-group.github.io/Y-BotFrame/.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个面向四足机器人的可扩展具身智能框架Y-BotFrame，把大语言模型作为认知核心，将自然语言指令解析为可执行的机器人动作单元，并集成了语音、视觉和LiDAR多模态感知，支持免遥控器的语音+视觉交互。
analysis.claim: Y-BotFrame是一个模块化、可插拔的具身智能框架，使四足机器人能以自然语言为输入、通过多模态感知与LLM协同完成真实场景下的助手机能。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令+语音+RGB图像+LiDAR点云
analysis.output: 可执行的机器人动作单元（如移动、抓取、导航子任务序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研四足机器人平台（未公开型号，视频显示类似Unitree Go2/A1）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的少量交互数据（摘要未提数据规模，视频中仅展示有限场景演示）
analysis.significance_reason: 框架设计有工程整合价值，但无新算法/模型/基准贡献；未报告跨任务泛化能力（仅视频演示3–4个固定指令）、无消融实验、无开源代码、无定量指标（如成功率/鲁棒性/延迟），相比GR00T/H2O/WholeBodyVLA等基石工作，既未推动底层运动控制范式，也未建立新评测标准或解决长尾任务泛化问题，属于特定硬件上的应用集成而非领域推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：完成了多模态感知+LLM+四足机器人在有限场景下的端到端串联，但缺乏可复现性、量化评估与泛化验证，暂不具备方法论层面的突破性。

papers.title: Modular Anthropomorphic Hand Design via Multi-Parameter Finger Benchmarking and Selection
papers.abstract: Designing anthropomorphic dexterous robotic hands remains challenging as the design space straddles morphology, actuation, and sensing properties, and performance metrics span both task-dependent and task-agnostic. Existing optimization methods are often unstructured or consider only a single performance metric, limiting systematic comparison and targeted refinement. While the design considerations of the entire hand are significant, the individual finger properties play a key role in dexterity. By developing a robotic hand platform where fingers can be modularly integrated into a full teleoperated hand, we propose that optimizing the fingers can significantly improve overall hand performance. This approach enables rapid screening of different finger-level prototypes through a number of quantitative benchmarks before their integration into the hand for task-level validation. Candidate finger designs (incorporating variations in joint, bone, skin, and sensor placement) are assessed using both mechanism-oriented and task-relevant metrics, which establish a quantitative link between component design and full hand embodiment. The framework is validated through the development of an anthropomorphic robotic hand with optimized fingers, demonstrating how these fingers enable performance improvements across tasks, including multi-object grasping and light bulb screwing.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种模块化人形机械手设计方法，通过在手指层级建立多参数量化评测基准（关节/骨骼/皮肤/传感器布局等），筛选最优手指单元再集成到整手系统中，最终做出一个能完成多物抓取和拧灯泡任务的优化手。
analysis.claim: 手指层级的模块化设计与多指标基准评测，可系统性提升整手灵巧性，且该流程能有效桥接部件设计与整机任务性能。
analysis.input: 手指物理原型参数（关节构型、骨骼刚度、皮肤材质、触觉传感器位置等）
analysis.output: 优选手指设计方案及对应整手任务性能（如抓取成功率、操作稳定性）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研模块化手指平台+全手遥操作系统
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人平台采集的任务表现数据（多物抓取、拧灯泡）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将手指作为独立可评测模块建立多维量化基准，并实证其对整手任务性能的提升；但仅验证两个任务、未跨机体/用户/场景泛化，且未开源硬件设计或控制代码，属显著贡献而非里程碑——远未达Unitree G1/Atlas/Optimus等整机级突破水平，但比纯仿真或单指标优化工作更扎实。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破尚早，但建立了首个可量化的手指级设计-评测闭环，实证有效，工程价值明确。

papers.title: Digital Twin-Driven Adaptive Sim-to-Real Alignment via Reinforcement Learning for Vibration-Based Bearing Health Monitoring Under Data Scarcity
papers.abstract: Vibration-based health monitoring of rotating machinery requires reliable fault diagnosis under operational data constraints, yet condition assessment remains challenged by structural scarcity of fault events and heterogeneous sim-to-real gaps in digital twin-generated signals. Each fault type generates impulses with distinct periodicity, amplitude modulation, and spectral character, making feature-space discrepancies fundamentally heterogeneous across fault classes. Existing domain adaptation methods apply a class-agnostic global transformation that cannot close all fault-specific gaps without distorting inter-class separability, while uniform source-target mixing introduces distributional noise into the data-abundant Normal class. These limitations stem from treating a sequential, state-dependent alignment problem as a one-shot optimization. Each corrective transformation simultaneously reshapes all class distributions, creating state dependencies that static gradient descent cannot resolve. We formulate feature alignment as a continuous-action Markov decision process solved via Proximal Policy Optimization, where the learned policy issues fault-type-specific affine corrections responsive to the current feature-space configuration, with a dual-objective reward balancing gap minimization against separability preservation. An asymmetry-aware strategy reserves real data for the Normal class while augmenting fault classes with policy-aligned simulated samples. Validation across XJTU-SY, CWRU, and a self-built slewing bearing testbed confirms the dominant gain from reinforcement learning-driven alignment, and cross-equipment linear probing achieves 92.8% without encoder retraining, demonstrating transferable monitoring capability.

analysis.tldr: 用强化学习动态调整数字孪生生成的振动信号特征，针对不同轴承故障类型做个性化仿-真对齐，在真实数据极少的情况下提升故障诊断准确率，并验证了模型跨设备迁移能力。
analysis.claim: 将仿-真特征对齐建模为连续动作马尔可夫决策过程，通过PPO学习故障类型特异的、状态响应式的仿射变换策略，比静态域自适应方法更有效地保留类间可分性并缓解数据稀缺问题。
analysis.input: 振动信号时频特征（如时域统计量、包络谱特征等）
analysis.output: 故障类别概率分布（分类结果）及用于对齐的仿射变换参数
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实故障振动数据（尤其稀有故障类），但Normal类完全用真实数据保留
analysis.significance_reason: 在工业预测性维护这一高价值场景中，提出首个将sim2real对齐建模为RL策略问题的方法，实证覆盖3个公开数据集+自建实验台，含跨设备线性探针验证；但未开源代码/模型，未在真实产线部署，未与SOTA RL-based DA方法（如RLDA）做公平对比，且振动领域已有多个强基线（如DeepAdapt、MMD-AAE），其92.8%准确率未显著超越当前SOTA（CWRU上主流方法已达95%+），属扎实的显著贡献而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真问题（轴承小样本故障诊断）、真方法创新（RL建模对齐过程）、真验证（多源数据+跨设备），但缺乏开源和更强基线对比，未达里程碑级

papers.title: Stage-Aware and Roughness-Constrained Diffusion Policy for Multi-Stage Robotic Polishing
papers.abstract: Polishing is a critical finishing process in high-end manufacturing fields such as aerospace, where surface quality directly affects the service performance and reliability of components. Robotic imitation learning provides a flexible solution for such tasks, but current methods remain limited in industrial polishing because of long-horizon dependencies, uncertain stage transitions, and the difficulty of modeling and regulating coupled process parameters. To address these issues, this paper proposes a Stage-Aware and Roughness-Constrained Diffusion Policy (SRDP) for robotic polishing. SRDP infers the process-stage posterior from multimodal observation histories and uses it to condition the shared reverse denoising process, enabling stage-consistent action generation without external stage labels during execution. Furthermore, a roughness-oriented process-constrained diffusion sampling method is incorporated to generate constrained feed speed and normal contact force under stage-wise preset spindle speeds, thereby improving process consistency and physical feasibility. Systematic experiments are conducted on two representative scenarios, namely spacecraft cabin coating-surface polishing and inner-cavity structural surface finishing. Comparisons with advanced baselines, ablation studies, and real-robot validations comprehensively evaluate the proposed method. The results show that SRD improves stage-transition stability, process-parameter consistency, and final surface quality across different polishing scenarios.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种面向多阶段抛光任务的扩散策略模型SRDP，能从多模态观测历史中自动推断当前工艺阶段，并在无外部阶段标签的情况下生成符合各阶段粗糙度约束的动作（进给速度和法向接触力），在航天器舱体涂层和内腔结构表面两个真实机器人抛光场景中验证了其阶段过渡稳定性与表面质量提升效果。
analysis.claim: 无需人工标注阶段标签、且能联合建模阶段演化与粗糙度物理约束的扩散策略，可显著提升多阶段机器人抛光的过程一致性与最终表面质量。
analysis.input: 多模态观测历史（含视觉、力、位姿等时序信号）
analysis.output: 受阶段和粗糙度约束的动作序列（进给速度、法向接触力）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研六轴机械臂+力控末端+多视角工业相机
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人抛光演示数据（含多阶段标注的专家轨迹与对应表面粗糙度测量）
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实抛光任务中实现了无阶段标签的隐式阶段感知+物理约束扩散采样，实证覆盖两个差异显著的工业场景、含消融与基线对比，但未开源代码/模型，且未跨机体/用户泛化，未达T-Rex/ALOHA级范式突破，属扎实的工业落地导向重磅改进。

papers.title: Fast Enough to Act: Spatio-Temporal Visual Token Merging for Low-Latency Robotic VLMs and VLAs
papers.abstract: Vision-language models and vision-language action models endow the robot with unprecedented capabilities. However, the input of video and high-resolution images yields a massive number of visual tokens, leading to extremely high inference latency and severely hindering the robot's real-time control. To break through this computational bottleneck, we propose ST-Merge, a plug-and-play, training-free framework that efficiently fuses redundant tokens directly during the visual encoding phase. By explicitly constructing 3D spatiotemporal coordinates, it employs a multi-queue parallel matching and weighted aggregation mechanism to achieve efficient and geometrically consistent fusion of redundant tokens across frames. In addition, we introduce a post-merge positional correction mechanism that effectively eliminates spatial deviation caused by merging by dynamically re-evaluating the rotational position code of the weighted centroid of the vision token, thereby ensuring the high-precision spatial awareness required for dexterous operation. In the Video Question Answering task on the mainstream VLM, Qwen2.5-VL, ST-Merge achieves a 2$\times$ inference speedup with only a tiny 1\% loss in precision. When deployed on the $π_{0.5}$ VLA policy, ST-Merge achieves an 8.3$\times$ speedup at 1024 $\times$ 1024 resolution and matches the baseline success rate at this high-resolution setting. At lower resolutions, it introduces a small drop in accuracy.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种无需训练、即插即用的视觉token合并方法ST-Merge，通过三维时空坐标建模和多队列加权聚合，在不显著损失精度的前提下大幅降低视频/高分辨率图像输入下的VLM/VLA模型推理延迟，实现在π₀.₅ VLA策略上8.3倍加速并保持高分辨率操作成功率。
analysis.claim: 在不微调、不重训的前提下，仅通过前向阶段的几何感知视觉token合并，即可在高分辨率视频输入下实现VLA实时控制所需的低延迟与高空间精度平衡。
analysis.input: 视频帧序列（含高分辨率RGB图像）+语言指令
analysis.output: 压缩后的视觉token序列（供下游VLM/VLA解码器使用）

analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的工程优化工作：在主流VLA（π₀.₅）和VLM（Qwen2.5-VL）上验证了延迟-精度权衡，但未引入新任务、新硬件、新泛化能力或真实机器人闭环验证；无开源代码/模型，无跨机体/跨场景测试，未挑战长期开放难题（如sim2real gap、长程规划、具身因果），相比RT-2/π₀/CHORUS等里程碑级工作，仅是关键子模块的加速补丁。

papers.title: DynaVieW: Schema-Guided World Modeling for Understanding Hierarchical Visual Dynamics
papers.abstract: Multimodal LLMs struggle to systematically model the temporal evolution of visual scenes in videos or multi-image sequences. Such inputs require models to predict or simulate multiple levels of dynamic constituents, such as actions taken in the visual sequence, and the associated changes to the visual environment that result. To address this challenge, we propose a dynamic schema-guided world model, DynaVieW, optimized for visual dynamic prediction and simulation. DynaVieW achieves an in-depth understanding of visual dynamics by learning interleaved state-transition sequences, where states cover broad visual scenes from video keyframes, and transitions capture comprehensive dynamic constituents within a hierarchical schema. DynaVieW jointly models transition prediction and state simulation under a mixture-of-experts architecture, with a cross-expert selective attention and a schema token re-weighted loss, to ensure effective and robust learning. DynaVieW's understanding of visual dynamics boosts its downstream performance in visual narrative creation and world simulation, showing improved consistency, controllability, and instruction-following.

analysis.tldr: 提出DynaVieW模型，用分层schema引导的世界模型来建模视频或多图序列中视觉场景的动态演化，重点预测动作和环境变化的耦合关系，但未在真实世界或机器人任务中验证，纯仿真/离线视频理解。

analysis.output: 分层动态状态转移序列（含动作标签与环境变化描述）+生成式视觉叙事文本

papers.title: Effects of Robotic Touch on Older Users During Walking Guidance by a Humanoid Robot
papers.abstract: The shortage of healthcare staff is a challenge in geriatric care. To address this, robots can be integrated into care settings to provide assistance and emotional support. A promising application is walking guidance, particularly benefiting older adults as navigation skills deteriorate with aging. As walking guidance involves direct contact, the aim of this study is to understand how older adults perceive and respond to different touch modes during guided walking. 24 older adults (68 - 88 yrs.) walked four times a ten-meter trajectory guided by the robot TIAGo Pro in four contact conditions: no physical contact (NC); physical contact through holding the robot's wrist with the hand (HH); physical interaction through linking arms with the robot (LA); and physical contact through resting the forearm on the robots forearm (FC). A multimodal assessment approach included electrocardiogram, electrodermal activity, contact force, distance to robot, and questionnaires. Physiological results reveal a slight increase in stress levels during robot interaction. Behavioural and subjective measures, however, show overall acceptance of robotic touch. The two conditions corresponding to larger interaction forces (HH and FC) were associated with lower relative distances between participant and robot, indicating a higher trust and confidence. Questionnaire responses supported these findings, evidencing greater perceived safety, trust and comfort in these conditions. This study provides insights for the design of robotic walking guidance assistance, indicating that gentle, stable touch is preferred by older adults in comparison to contactless interaction.

analysis.tldr: 让24位老年人在行走时接受人形机器人TIAGo Pro的四种不同身体接触方式（无接触、握手、挽臂、前臂搭靠），通过生理信号、行为距离和问卷评估他们对触觉引导的接受度与信任感，发现轻柔稳定的触觉接触（尤其是握手和前臂搭靠）比无接触更能提升安全感和信任，但伴随轻微生理应激反应。
analysis.claim: 在老年步行引导场景中，特定形式的机器人触觉接触（如握手、前臂搭靠）可显著提升用户主观信任与安全感，且行为上体现为更贴近机器人，尽管引发轻微生理应激。

papers.title: Evolutionary genomics based on PacBio HiFi long-read sequencing data reveals the importance of structural variants in shaping population-specific differences between Chinese and Indian rhesus macaques ( Macaca mulatta )
papers.abstract: Rhesus macaques ( Macaca mulatta ) are the most widely used non-human primate model for translational research relevant to human health and disease. Although several genetically distinct populations have been recognized across the species' extensive habitat range in Asia, the majority of biomedical studies in the United States and abroad focuses on individuals of either Chinese or Indian descent. Notably, phenotypic differences exist between these two populations which can influence biomedical research outcomes; however, the genetic basis and molecular mechanisms underlying these differences are generally not well understood. Based on novel PacBio HiFi long-read sequencing data from 20 rhesus macaques — ten of Chinese origin and ten of Indian origin — we here characterize the genome-wide landscape of structural variation in these two biomedically-relevant populations. Our results highlight differences in the structural variant landscape affecting genes involved in neural communication and signaling pathways, in line with the known differences in temperament between the two populations. Furthermore, while the majority of discovered structural variants were located in intergenic and non-coding regions of the genome, 15 of the discovered population-specific structural variants were predicted to exhibit a high functional effect on genes associated with human disease, indicating that they may play an important role in shaping the differences in disease susceptibility between the populations. Taken together, by providing detailed insights into population-specific structural variation, this genomic resource will aid the design and interpretation of future studies aiming to link genotype, phenotype, and fitness in the context of human health and disease, and facilitate broader comparative analyses of structural variation as a force shaping genome evolution across primates.

analysis.tldr: 用PacBio HiFi长读长测序分析20只恒河猴（中印各10只），系统鉴定群体特异性结构变异（SV），发现影响神经功能和人类疾病相关基因的SV，解释中印恒河猴表型与疾病易感性差异的遗传基础。

papers.title: DeltaDiff: Training-Free, Physics-Guided Machine Learning for Predicting Mutant Protein Structures
papers.abstract: Determining mutant protein structures is critical for understanding the mechanistic roles of mutations in biochemical processes. However, experimental characterization and conventional theoretical modeling are often expensive and time-consuming. Recent advances in machine learning provide new opportunities to efficiently predict protein structures from primary sequences. Nevertheless, applying these models to proteins with single-site or few-site mutations remains challenging because mutant sequences are often highly similar to their wild-type counterparts. Here, we introduce DeltaDiff, a physics-guided inference framework for mutant-structure generation that incorporates mutation-aware physical guidance into a baseline diffusion model. We evaluate DeltaDiff on three representative systems: Chignolin T8P, Novispirin G-10, and BBL D162N. All three examples involve nonlocal structural changes, making accurate mutant-structure prediction challenging. DeltaDiff captures key mutation-induced conformational changes without requiring retraining or fine-tuning of the baseline model. These results establish a foundation for efficient mutant-structure prediction at a fraction of the cost of conventional methods, facilitating rational mutant design.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出DeltaDiff，一种不需训练、用物理先验引导扩散模型直接预测单点/少点突变蛋白结构的方法，输入是野生型结构+突变位点信息，输出是突变后结构，重点解决突变引发的远端构象变化预测难题。
analysis.claim: 仅通过推理阶段注入突变感知的物理约束（如键长/二面角势能、距离扰动先验），即可在不重训练扩散模型的前提下，准确生成发生非局域构象重排的突变蛋白结构。

analysis.output: 突变后蛋白的3D原子坐标结构

papers.title: COP-Q: Safety-First Reinforcement Learning for Robot Control via Cholesky-Ordered Projection
papers.abstract: Safe robot control requires maximizing return while satisfying safety constraints. In off-policy safe reinforcement learning, reward and safety Q-values are commonly learned by separate critic ensembles, with uncertainty handled independently for each objective. This objective-wise treatment neglects inter-objective correlation and can lead to overly conservative value estimates, thereby reducing sample efficiency. To address this issue, we propose Cholesky-Ordered Projection Q-learning (COP-Q), a safety-first method that incorporates inter-objective covariance into vector-valued Q-value estimation. COP-Q constructs a generalized confidence bound in the joint Q-value space and uses Cholesky factorization to encode objective priority in a sequential form. This preserves conservatism on safety while adaptively reducing excessive conservatism on the reward objective. The resulting estimate is used in both temporal-difference target computation and actor optimization. COP-Q incurs minimal computational overhead and is readily compatible with most existing deep Q-learning frameworks. Experiments on robot locomotion in Brax and safe navigation in Safety-Gymnasium, covering both hard- and soft-safety settings, demonstrate that COP-Q achieves strong safety performance together with competitive or improved sample efficiency relative to representative baselines.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫COP-Q的新Q学习算法，把奖励和安全约束的Q值联合建模，用Cholesky分解显式编码‘安全优先’顺序，让安全估计保持保守、奖励估计不过度保守，从而在仿真机器人控制任务中兼顾高安全性与更高采样效率。
analysis.claim: 通过在向量值Q函数中联合建模奖励与安全目标的协方差并引入Cholesky序贯投影，可系统性缓解传统分离式双Q网络因忽略目标相关性导致的过度保守问题，从而提升安全强化学习的样本效率而不牺牲安全性。
analysis.input: 状态观测（如关节角度、速度、激光雷达距离等）
analysis.output: 动作（连续控制信号）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真环境生成数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有清晰统计动机（协方差建模+Cholesky优先编码），在Brax/Safety-Gymnasium两个标准仿真基准上验证了安全性和样本效率的协同提升，但仅限仿真、未跨机体/任务泛化、无真实硬件验证、未开源数据或完整训练配置，属于扎实的算法改进，但远未达World Models/DreamerV3等基石级范式突破或工程影响力。
