papers.title: Efficient Transfer Learning of Robot Dynamic Models Using Morphological Similarity
papers.abstract: This study proposes a neural network-based transfer learning framework for modeling the dynamics of soft, fin-actuated underwater robots. We focus on morphologically similar robots that differ in scale and hydrodynamic properties. A model trained on data from a larger robot (source domain) is adapted to a smaller one (target domain) with limited labeled data. To enable label-efficient transfer, we develop an autoencoder-based domain adaptation approach that learns a shared latent representation aligning the dynamics of both robots. Experiments on two real underwater robots show that the proposed method enables accurate state estimation of the body-frame velocities on a target platform without labeled data, highlighting its potential for efficient cross-robot dynamics transfer among morphologically similar platforms.

analysis.tldr: 用自编码器对两个形态相似但尺寸和水动力特性不同的软体水下机器人做动力学模型迁移，源机器人数据训练后，仅需极少或无需目标机器人的标注数据，就能准确估计其本体坐标系下的速度。
analysis.claim: 形态相似的软体水下机器人之间，可通过共享隐空间的自编码器实现高效、低标签依赖的动力学模型迁移。
analysis.input: 传感器时序数据（如IMU、压力、关节角度等，摘要未明列但隐含于‘state estimation’和‘real underwater robots’中）
analysis.output: 本体坐标系下的线/角速度估计值
analysis.robot_dependency: 两个定制软体鳍驱动水下机器人（具体型号未命名）
analysis.data_dependency: 源机器人有充足标注数据，目标机器人标注数据极少甚至为零（摘要明确说‘without labeled data’）
analysis.significance_reason: 实机验证跨机体迁移有效，但仅限两个高度定制、形态强相似的软体水下平台，未覆盖通用机器人构型（如机械臂/轮式/四足），无消融实验说明关键设计贡献，未开源代码或模型，benchmark缺失，未与主流动力学迁移方法（如Meta-RL、Domain Adversarial NN）对比，属扎实但窄域的工程性改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在特定软体水下机器人场景中实现了可行的跨尺度动力学迁移，但缺乏通用性验证、开源支持和基线对比，尚未构成范式突破或广泛适用的方法论升级。

papers.title: RDGen: Demonstration Generation for High-Quality Robot Learning via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising paradigm for general-purpose robot control. However, their performance remains fundamentally constrained by the availability of high-quality robot trajectory data. In current robot learning practice, such data are primarily collected through human teleoperation, which is labor-intensive, costly, and difficult to scale. In this paper, we propose RDGen, a sim-to-real reinforcement learning framework for generating high-quality robot demonstrations. Rather than employing reinforcement learning solely as the final control policy, RDGen leverages trained RL policies as a structured trajectory generator. The system consists of a VLM-based task parser that identifies task-relevant objects, a Grounding DINO-based object localizer, and an RL policy transferred from simulation to the real robot. Successful rollouts are then harvested as clean, high-quality demonstrations for downstream VLA training, while the simulation stage further provides a scalable source of additional trajectories at little marginal cost. Experiments on a pick-and-place task demonstrate that the transferred RL policy achieves a high task success rate. Compared with human teleoperation, RDGen produces significantly smoother trajectories and yields superior downstream VLA performance. These results indicate that RL-generated demonstrations can serve as more reliable and consistent supervisory signals for robot policy learning.

analysis.tldr: 用仿真训练的RL策略在真实机器人上自动生成高质量操作轨迹（如抓取放置），替代费时费力的人类遥操，生成的数据更平滑、下游VLA模型训练效果更好。
analysis.claim: RL策略经sim2real迁移后可作为高质量机器人演示生成器，其产出的轨迹比人类遥操更平滑、更适合作为VLA模型的监督信号。
analysis.input: 语言指令+RGB图像
analysis.output: 动作序列（6DoF末端位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机械臂（未指明型号，但实验在真机完成）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人成功rollout用于验证和筛选，不依赖大规模真实演示数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在单一pick-and-place任务上验证，无跨任务/跨机体/跨场景泛化实验，无消融分析RL生成数据相比人类数据的具体优势来源，未开源代码或数据，未与主流VLA基线（如RT-2、OpenVLA）对比下游性能，实质贡献限于‘用RL生成演示’这一已有思路（如MimicGen）的轻量变体，但缺乏规模、鲁棒性与可复现性支撑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看：方法思路不新，实证薄弱，无开源，仅单任务小规模真机验证，未达到当前领域基石工作（如MimicGen=89）的严谨性与影响力门槛。

papers.title: Scale Buys Interpolation, Structure Buys a Horizon: Certified Predictability for Equivariant World Models
papers.abstract: Scale buys interpolation; structure buys a certified horizon. A world model's average error says nothing about whether a particular prediction can be trusted, or for how long. For equivariant latent world models we give a computable, multi-step certificate of the predictable horizon: $T$-step rollout error is provably constant over each symmetry orbit (Theorem A) and stratified channel-by-channel by the predictor's Lyapunov spectrum, $T_j(ε)\sim\log(1/ε)/λ_j$. The horizon is two-sided -- a matching lower bound makes approximate equivariance provably horizon-limited -- and the certificate is exclusive to structure: orbit-constant error characterizes equivariance, so no non-equivariant model has it at any scale. Empirically, on 40-D Lorenz-96 only a $\mathbb{Z}_N$-equivariant network recovers the full Lyapunov spectrum ($R^2{=}0.98$); dense and recurrent baselines fail. Because the spectrum is faithful, the certificate acts, a priori: under a fixed sensing budget a $c\times$-inflated certificate provably needs $c\times$ the budget, and the equivariant certificate meets a budget its inflated dense counterpart cannot -- with zero calibration data. The same read-out, unchanged, audits public pretrained world models training-free: TD-MPC2 checkpoints land on the certificate's own scope taxonomy -- calibrated where strongly expansive (ratio 0.94-1.02), optimistic where weakly expansive, correctly abstaining where contracting -- a map a deployed monitor replicates cell-by-cell, out-of-sample. Across the official 1M-317M multitask ladder, calibration does not improve with parameters. On V-JEPA 2-AC (1B, real robot data) the measured cross-check correctly overrides an over-promising tangent spectrum -- the cross-validated audit, not the raw number, is the deployable object. Scale buys interpolation, not a calibrated horizon.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种针对等变潜世界模型的可证明预测可信度理论框架，能严格计算多步预测的‘可预测时间窗口’（horizon），该窗口由模型内在的李雅普诺夫谱决定，并证明只有等变结构才能提供这种轨道恒定误差的证书，纯靠扩大参数规模无法获得；它还用该证书对多个公开预训练世界模型（如TD-MPC2、V-JEPA）做了零样本、免训练的部署级可靠性审计。
analysis.claim: 只有具备显式等变结构的世界模型才能提供可证明的、轨道恒定的多步预测误差证书，该证书由其李雅普诺夫谱严格刻画，且不可通过单纯扩大模型规模获得。
analysis.input: 状态序列（如Lorenz-96系统演化轨迹）
analysis.output: 可证明的T步预测误差上界（即‘可预测时间窗口’）及按通道分层的李雅普诺夫谱估计
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，实验基于40维Lorenz-96仿真和公开预训练checkpoint
analysis.significance_reason: 达到DreamerV3（96分）与World Models（97分）之间的关键理论缺口：首次为世界模型提供可证明、可审计、免校准的预测可信度证书，并实证验证其在多个SOTA模型上的零样本部署监控能力；虽未开源代码/模型，但理论严密、实验跨模型、结论具工程判据力，属理论驱动型重大推进，但尚未落地真机闭环验证，故略低于DreamerV3级里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次建立世界模型预测可靠性的可证明证书体系，将‘能预测多久可信’从经验观察升格为可计算、可审计、可部署的数学属性，且实证穿透多个SOTA模型。

papers.title: WAM4D: Fast 4D World Action Model via Spatial Register Tokens
papers.abstract: World action models (WAMs) have recently shown promise in jointly modeling future observations and executable robot actions. However, most existing WAMs still operate in 2D video or latent spaces, where visually plausible rollouts miss the 3D spatial constraints and occluded contact geometry required for precise manipulation. While geometric foundation models offer strong priors for recovering dense 3D structure and motion from visual observations, forcing WAMs to predict the dense 4D representation introduces costly geometric decoding and slows down causal action generation. To address the trade-off, we present WAM4D, a fast 4D world action model that uses lightweight spatial register tokens as training-time future-depth readouts to transfer pretrained geometric priors into a causal video-action transformer, then removes the register branch for lightweight action inference. To prevent non-causal shortcuts, we further design causal mixture attention for the Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) WAM backbone, defining modality-specific visibility among video, action, and geometry tokens. Comprehensive experiments on RoboTwin 2.0 and challenging real-world manipulation tasks show that WAM4D improves spatial consistency and achieves competitive action prediction while maintaining efficient inference.

analysis.tldr: 提出WAM4D模型，用轻量级空间寄存器token在训练时引入3D几何先验，推理时移除该分支，实现兼顾空间一致性与快速动作预测的4D世界动作建模。
analysis.claim: 通过可剥离的空间寄存器token机制，将预训练几何先验高效注入因果视频-动作Transformer，在不牺牲推理速度的前提下提升4D世界模型的空间一致性与动作预测质量。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列+历史动作序列
analysis.output: 未来动作序列+4D世界状态（含深度/几何结构）的紧凑隐式表示
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明是否依赖真实机器人数据，摘要仅提RoboTwin 2.0（仿真）和real-world manipulation tasks但无细节
analysis.significance_reason: 虽提出寄存器token与因果混合注意力等新设计，但缺乏真实机器人多任务验证、无消融实验细节、未开源、未与DreamerV3/WEAVER等基石模型在统一基准上对比；RoboTwin 2.0为仿真，real-world仅泛泛提及，实证强度远低于分量标尺中任意一项（最低门槛DayDreamer=93），属扎实但窄幅的架构改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在WAM框架内做了合理但局部的模块化改进，有技术细节但缺乏系统性实证支撑，尚未达到领域基石级贡献

papers.title: Slots, Transitions, Loops: Learning Composable World Models for ARC
papers.abstract: ARC tests in-context rule induction: given a few input-output demonstrations, a model must infer the hidden rule and apply it to a new query. While many approaches express ARC rules through language, code, or symbolic programs, ARC itself is visual-symbolic: rules appear as grid transitions over objects, colors, shapes, and spatial relations. We introduce Loop-OWM, an object-centric world-modeling architecture that learns these rules as composable transitions over structured states. It combines color-prototype slots, demonstration-conditioned task summaries, and a looped transition model with dense propagation and slot-conditioned correction. On both ARC-1 and ARC-2, Loop-OWM outperforms non-looped and looped baselines with comparable or fewer parameters. These results suggest that ARC rules can be learned not only as language descriptions or searched programs, but also as transitions over visual-symbolic world states.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Loop-OWM模型，把ARC视觉推理任务建模成对象槽位（slots）上的可组合状态转移过程，用循环式世界模型学习输入-输出网格图之间的视觉符号化变换规则，不依赖语言或程序生成，直接在像素级结构化表征上做推演。
analysis.org: 马克斯·普朗克智能系统研究所
analysis.claim: ARC任务的本质是视觉符号化的世界状态转移，可通过对象槽位+循环过渡模型直接学习，无需语言或程序作为中介表示。
analysis.input: 若干组输入-输出网格图像对（每个含颜色/形状/位置等符号化元素）
analysis.output: 新输入网格对应的输出网格（即预测的规则应用结果）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 虽提出‘视觉符号化世界状态转移’这一有启发性的视角，并在ARC-1/2上超越部分基线，但仅限于静态网格推理任务，未扩展到动态环境、具身交互或连续控制；无开源代码，仅项目页；未验证跨任务泛化能力，仍属窄域符号推理架构改进，远未触及World Models（97分）等基石工作所定义的世界建模范式——后者需支持长时序预测、动作闭环、物理一致性与跨模态因果推断。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：将世界建模思想迁移到ARC符号推理任务，但仍是封闭静态任务内的表征改进，未突破视觉符号推理的既有方法论边界，暂不具备范式迁移价值。

papers.title: RGB: RL Guided Whole-Body MPPI for Humanoid Control
papers.abstract: Humanoid robots require whole-body controllers that are both robust and precise in contact-rich environments. While deep reinforcement learning (RL) achieves robust stability, its behavior is tightly coupled to the training objective and command interface, making it difficult to add new feedback objectives without retraining. In this study, we propose an RL guided whole-body model predictive path integral (MPPI) framework that acts as an add-on feedback controller on top of a pretrained RL policy. Instead of using RL policy as the final controller, we use it as a sampling prior that biases MPPI rollouts toward dynamically feasible behaviors. Task objectives are specified through modular MPPI cost terms, and MPPI closes the loop by continuously correcting the RL prior online to satisfy these objectives without retraining the policy. Simulations on a 29-DoF Unitree G1 humanoid in MuJoCo demonstrate stable high-rate control (average 280~Hz). The proposed method improves task-level precision over a pure RL baseline under the same command interface. This is achieved by correcting systematic drift during straight walking and tracking additional whole-body reference signals imposed through the cost.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种将预训练的强化学习策略作为先验引导的模型预测路径积分（MPPI）控制器，用于人形机器人全身控制，在仿真中实现高频稳定控制，并通过在线成本函数调节提升任务精度，无需重新训练RL策略。
analysis.claim: 预训练RL策略可作为MPPI的动态可行行为先验，使MPPI能在线闭环修正其输出以满足新任务目标，而无需重训练RL策略。
analysis.input: 高层指令（如行走命令）、传感器状态（关节位置/速度/接触力等）、MPPI成本函数定义（含参考轨迹、接触约束等）
analysis.output: 全身关节力矩或目标关节位置/速度轨迹
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的控制架构整合（RL+MPPI），但仅在单一仿真人形（G1）上验证步行与简单全身跟踪，无真实硬件部署、无跨机体/跨任务泛化实验、无开源代码、未对比SOTA基线（如H2O/ASAP/WholeBodyVLA），也未解决长期开放难题（如sim2real gap、多任务统一表征、长时序鲁棒性），仅比纯RL基线略优，属窄域工程改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把RL策略当MPPI先验是合理设计，但缺乏实证广度与开源支撑，尚未脱离仿真验证阶段，暂不具备推动领域范式的能力。

papers.title: Vision-Language Model Reasoning for Contextual Semantic Mapping in Intralogistics
papers.abstract: Autonomous mobile robots operating in intralogistics environments rely on geometric maps for localization and navigation, but lack semantic understanding of objects and their contextual properties. We present a contextual semantic mapping pipeline that combines SLAM-based geometric mapping, SAM-based instance segmentation, instance clustering, and VLM multi-view reasoning to produce a contextual semantic map representation encoding geometric structure, object class, and object movability. By aggregating observations across multiple viewpoints and querying a VLM in a zero-shot, open-vocabulary setting, the pipeline infers contextual object properties--here demonstrated through movability--without requiring task-specific training or predefined object categories. We evaluate three VLMs under two prompting strategies and conduct a component-wise analysis of the pipeline. The proposed pipeline achieves 98.93 % mIoU for semantic classification and 89.17 % mAcc for object movability estimation. Component analysis identifies VLM reasoning as the primary bottleneck for contextual understanding and instance clustering as the main limitation for panoptic performance. The resulting semantic map supports context-aware filtering and robust navigation in dynamic intralogistics environments.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把视觉语言模型（VLM）当作‘语义推理引擎’，接在SLAM+SAM+实例聚类的下游，给仓库里识别出的每个物体自动推断其是否可移动（movability），不需训练、不限类别，最终生成带几何结构+类别+可移动性标注的语义地图。
analysis.claim: 无需任务特定训练或预定义类别，仅靠VLM在零样本开放词汇下多视角推理，即可从机器人采集的RGB-D序列中可靠推断物体上下文语义属性（如movability），并融合进结构化语义地图。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB图像+深度图+SLAM位姿+SAM分割掩码
analysis.output: 带几何位置、类别标签、movability二值属性的语义地图（每个实例级物体含三元组）
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实AGV平台（摘要未明说但intralogistics场景隐含真实部署，且评估含mIoU/mAcc指标，非纯仿真）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的多视角观测数据（因强调‘aggregating observations across multiple viewpoints’且用于实际环境导航）
analysis.significance_reason: 方法是模块化拼接（SLAM+SAM+聚类+VLM），无新模型架构或训练范式；VLM仅作零样本prompting推理，非微调或对齐；评估仅限movability单属性，未验证跨物体/跨场景泛化；mIoU/mAcc高但属局部指标，未与基线机器人导航性能挂钩；无真机闭环导航验证，也未开源代码或数据。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将现成VLM作为语义推理插件嵌入传统感知流程，在限定场景（仓库）和单一属性（movability）上取得可用结果，但无算法原创性、无泛化验证、无开源支撑，属于高质量应用级整合而非突破

papers.title: What Holds Back Brain-Computer Interfaces? Uncovering Challenges and Opportunities in BCI-controlled Games for Cerebral Palsy Rehabilitation
papers.abstract: Brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) offer promising avenues for cerebral palsy (CP) rehabilitation at home and in the clinic, using games that promote engagement and sustained training effort. Nonetheless, the design constraints of BCI-based CP rehabilitation remain unclear, especially how individuals with CP experience a sense of control through BCI, and how they experience computer-mediated game assistance. To address this gap, we present preliminary clinical and user perspectives on BCI-based CP rehabilitation, drawing on in-clinic insights from a CP therapist and experiential accounts from ten individuals with CP engaging with BCI game prototypes. Sporadic help in BCI games eased monotony, but also fostered doubts regarding agency. The therapist saw BCI rehabilitation as complementary to traditional training, facilitating the transition from playful exercises to autonomous, self-managed training. We outline key challenges and opportunities to inform and empower further design and research of BCI training for CP.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文通过访谈10名脑瘫患者和1名康复治疗师，调研了BCI游戏在脑瘫家庭/临床康复中的实际使用体验，发现患者对‘控制感’的怀疑、辅助提示带来的 agency 困惑等设计矛盾，并提出若干人因层面的设计挑战与机会。
analysis.claim: BCI游戏在脑瘫康复中面临的核心障碍不是技术性能瓶颈，而是用户对控制感、代理感（agency）和计算机辅助介入方式的主观体验冲突。
analysis.input: 脑电（EEG）信号（隐含，但未描述采集细节）、用户访谈文本、治疗师观察笔记
analysis.output: 定性分析报告：关于控制感、辅助设计、游戏参与度、过渡到自主训练等主题的挑战与机会列表
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实BCI在线闭环数据；依赖小样本（n=10）半结构化访谈和单次临床观察，未使用BCI系统实时行为日志或神经信号质量评估
analysis.significance_reason: 纯定性探索性研究，无BCI解码性能指标、无算法/硬件创新、无对照实验、无可复现的数据集或模型，仅提供初步人因洞察；相比标尺中90+分的里程碑工作（如高精度神经解码、闭环运动重建、植入式接口临床落地），本文属于低证据等级的前期需求探查，价值限于康复人机交互设计圈层内参考。

papers.title: Self Capacitive Tactile Sensor System designed for Companion Robots
papers.abstract: Tactile sensing is essential for humanoid robots to achieve safe physical interaction, dexterous manipulation, and truly human-like responsiveness. However, the design of such systems remains challenging. Conventional approaches often suffer from complex multilayer structures, intricate wiring, high cost, and poor scalability, making it difficult to realize full-body tactile sensing with real-time, low-latency detection while maintaining minimal computational load on the robot's main processor. In this work, we present a simple, scalable and hardware friendly tactile sensing system for a companion humanoid robot based on the self-capacitance principle. The proposed sensor system employs a single conductive fabric layer with a conductive fabric wire architecture and does not require intricate electrode patterning. Scalability was demonstrated by fabricating a 100-point sensor array on a flexible printed circuit (FPC). Evaluation across sampling frequencies showed that 10 Hz is insufficient and misses transient events, whereas 100 Hz and 1000 Hz reliably capture and clearly distinguish all interaction types: gentle touch, slow tapping, fast tapping, and hitting. A decision-tree classifier was implemented directly on the FPGA, offloading real-time inference from the Raspberry Pi 4 with minimal latency and negligible power overhead. This design fully meets the tactile sensing requirements of the HIRO-chan robot and is well-suited for full-body tactile sensing in HIRO-chan and other companion robots.

analysis.tldr: 设计了一种基于自电容原理的简易、可扩展触觉传感系统，用单层导电织物+导电织物线实现100点柔性阵列，采样率达1000Hz，决策树分类器直接部署在FPGA上实现实时低延迟识别多种触碰类型，适配HIRO-chan陪伴机器人。
analysis.claim: 基于自电容原理的单层导电织物触觉传感系统可在低成本、低计算负载下实现全身体表规模、高采样率、实时区分多种物理交互类型的触觉感知。

papers.title: FlipItRight: Stable Pose-Targeted Throw-Flip Across Diverse Objects
papers.abstract: We propose FlipItRight, a framework for stable planar pose-targeted throw-flip with a high-DoF manipulator. The task is decomposed into an object-level planner, which generates candidate release states satisfying the desired landing pose, and a robot-level planner, which evaluates executability and constructs a feasible swing motion. Treating the release state as an explicit intermediate representation enables principled candidate filtering, adaptive selection of release and pre-swing configurations, and structured near-release motion design -- in particular, approximately constant end-effector velocities during the final swing phase to improve robustness to release-timing uncertainty. We validate on a real platform across objects of varying shape, size, and mass, achieving a 90% success rate across 120 trials. Ablation studies confirm that each design choice contributes to throwing performance, and the framework requires no prior data or learned model, enabling direct deployment on new objects and targets without environment-specific calibration or data collection.

analysis.tldr: 用机械臂把各种形状大小重量的物体抛起并精准翻转，让它们以指定平面朝向稳稳落地，全程不依赖任何训练数据或学习模型，纯基于物理建模和运动规划实现。

papers.title: An Augmented Reality Brain-Robot Interface for Generalist Robot Arm Manipulation
papers.abstract: The integration of augmented reality (AR) and EEG-based brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) offers a promising path for enabling intuitive control of robots for assistive purposes. However, existing AR brain-robot interface (BRI) systems are often constrained to task-specific structures, limiting their utility in real-world environments. We present an AR BRI designed for generalist robot arm manipulation that combines gaze-based object selection with motor imagery action control. Our system uses eye-tracking for intuitive object targeting and context-aware visual overlays ("Place" and "Use") to guide the user through tasks within a shared autonomy framework. We evaluated the interface through a feasibility study with 18 healthy participants performing three multi-step activities of daily living: drinking, using a drawer, and operating an oven. Our results demonstrate that this interaction paradigm enables effective sequential task execution and high user engagement, achieving a "Good" usability rating (SUS > 70). These findings support the feasibility of the proposed interaction paradigm for complex BCI-driven robotic assistance, and motivate future evaluation with the intended target population. Project website: https://ar-bri-manip.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 用AR眼镜+EEG脑电+眼动追踪，让用户通过看物体再想象动作来控制机械臂完成喝水、开抽屉、用烤箱等日常多步任务，属于概念验证型脑控机器人交互系统。
analysis.claim: 基于AR与EEG的通用型脑-机器人接口可通过注视选择+运动想象实现多步日常生活任务的共享自主操控，且具备可接受的可用性。

papers.title: Steering Generative Reinforcement Learning into Stable Robotic Controller
papers.abstract: Diffusion and flow-based generative policies provide a powerful policy class for reinforcement learning by inducing rich stochastic exploration through iterative action generation. However, the stochasticity of diffusion policies is not suitable for stable and precise control in high-dimensional robotic systems, where small action variations can accumulate into inconsistent motion and reduced robustness. To address this issue, we propose SteerGenPO, a latent-space reinforcement learning framework that steers a trained generative policy into a robust deterministic robotic controller. The key idea is to replace stochastic latent sampling of the trained generative policy with a learned latent actor that predicts a state-dependent latent input for the generative policies. This separates exploration and control: stochastic generative sampling provides diverse action proposals during policy learning, while deterministic latent steering provides stable and adaptive control at deployment. We evaluate SteerGenPO on six Isaac Lab benchmarks and a Unitree G1 locomotion task. The results show SteerGenPO improves over both classical RL and generative RL baselines, while its deterministic latent steering produces more stable inference-time behaviors and more reliable command responses.

analysis.tldr: 提出SteerGenPO框架，把训练好的扩散类生成策略（本身随机、不适合机器人控制）改造成确定性控制器：不直接采样随机隐变量，而是用一个学习到的‘隐空间执行器’根据当前状态预测确定性隐输入，从而在保持生成式策略探索能力的同时实现稳定实时控制。
analysis.claim: 生成式强化学习策略可通过解耦训练时的随机探索与部署时的确定性隐空间引导，转化为高稳定性机器人控制器。

papers.title: RealityBridge: Bridging Editable 3D Gaussian Splatting Driving Simulations and Real-World Videos
papers.abstract: Long-tail hazardous scenarios are essential for safety-oriented autonomous driving, yet they are difficult to collect and reproduce at scale. Editable 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) simulation offers a promising alternative by reconstructing real driving scenes and supporting controllable scene editing. However, edited 3DGS-rendered videos still suffer from a significant Sim-to-Real gap, including rendering artifacts, degraded foreground assets, inconsistent illumination, and temporal flickering. Existing restoration and video generation methods are insufficient for this task, as they often fail to jointly repair 3DGS-specific artifacts, improve visual realism, and ensure temporal consistency. To fill this gap, we propose RealityBridge, a structure-preserving and asset-aware Sim-to-Real framework for edited 3DGS driving videos. RealityBridge uses multimodal controls, including rendered videos, foreground masks, edge maps, and semantic masks, together with a lightweight GateNet for adaptive condition allocation across backbone layers. We further construct targeted training data and introduce autoregressive long-video training with reward-guided post-training to improve restoration quality, temporal stability, and hallucination suppression. Extensive experiments on internal and public driving datasets show that RealityBridge outperforms existing methods in artifact removal, illumination harmonization, and long-sequence temporal consistency.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出RealityBridge框架，把可编辑的3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）生成的自动驾驶仿真视频，通过多模态条件控制和轻量门控网络，修复渲染伪影、光照不一致和时序闪烁问题，使其更接近真实行车视频。
analysis.claim: 通过结构保持与资产感知的多模态修复框架，可显著缩小编辑后3DGS驾驶视频与真实世界视频之间的Sim-to-Real差距。

papers.title: Simple-to-Complex Structured Demonstrations for Vision-Language-Action Learning
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong capabilities in robotic manipulation by integrating visual perception, language understanding, and robot action generation. Existing research has primarily focused on improving model architectures, training strategies, and dataset scale, while little attention has been paid to how demonstrations are collected and organized. We identify demonstration organization as a fundamental yet overlooked aspect of imitation learning, as it directly affects policy learning efficiency, training stability, and policy generalization. To address this gap, we propose a simple-to-complex structured demonstration collection strategy for VLA learning using a dual-arm robotic platform. Our approach systematically organizes data through three general principles: (i) decomposing complex manipulation tasks into progressively learnable sub-skills, (ii) standardizing the interaction environment to reduce unnecessary variability, and (iii) organizing demonstrations according to progressively increasing task complexity. This structured design enables VLA models to first acquire fundamental manipulation skills before learning increasingly complex task compositions, facilitating more effective learning of long-horizon manipulation tasks. We evaluate the proposed strategy on two representative robotic manipulation tasks: block grasping and sorting, and towel folding. Experimental results show consistent improvements in task success rate and training stability compared with the baseline method of directly collecting end-to-end complete task trajectories. These findings highlight demonstration organization as a previously underexplored but important factor in VLA learning and provide practical insights into efficient skill acquisition, scalable dataset construction, and long-horizon robotic manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一种‘由简入繁’的结构化示范数据收集方法，即把复杂操作任务拆解成渐进式子技能、固定环境变量、按难度排序示范，从而提升VLA模型学会长期操作任务的效率和稳定性。
analysis.claim: 示范数据的组织方式（而非模型或数据量）是影响VLA模型学习效率、稳定性与泛化能力的关键但被忽视的因素，采用简单到复杂的结构化示范策略能显著提升长时程操作任务的学习效果。

papers.title: Seamless interaction in VR: decoding user intent with eye gaze and passive brain-computer interfaces
papers.abstract: Virtual reality (VR) interaction remains largely dependent on explicit motor input, limiting seamless and adaptive interaction. This study investigated whether electroencephalography (EEG)-based passive brain-computer interfaces (BCIs), combined with eye gaze, can decode interaction intent directly from its underlying neurophysiological correlates during dynamic VR gameplay. We operationalized interaction intent as comprising two components: affordance-related evaluation, indicating whether an attended object affords interaction, and approach-avoidance evaluation, indicating the directional tendency of interaction toward desirable or undesirable outcomes. Twenty-three participants completed a VR game with two calibration sessions and one online BCI session. Offline analyses showed above-chance decoding of the binary approach-avoidance decision classification across all actionable trials, with a grand-average accuracy of 66.28% across participants. This decoding transferred to online closed-loop gameplay, where grand-average accuracy remained above chance at 69.64%. Category-level analyses further revealed substantial variability in classification separability. For approach-avoidance-related classifications, accuracy reached 80.84% for the most distinct pairing between clearly valenced reward and punishment categories, but dropped to near chance at 59.03% for the more context-dependent pairing with ambiguous motivational valence. Affordance-related classifications between non-actionable and actionable item categories were consistently high, ranging from 77.76% to 83.50%. User Experience questionnaire results showed that, despite limitations leading to perceived loss of control and reduced ease of use, participants found the BCI-based interaction paradigm itself more fun than the controller baseline. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of real-time EEG decoding of interaction intent during dynamic VR gameplay, contributing toward intuitive user-adapted interfaces driven by physiological signals in immersive environments.

analysis.tldr: 用EEG脑电+眼动数据，在VR游戏中实时解码用户‘想靠近还是避开某物体’以及‘该物体是否可交互’两种意图，首次在动态VR场景中实现在线闭环BCI控制，但准确率波动大（59%-81%），且用户反馈控制感下降。
analysis.claim: EEG结合眼动可在动态VR中实时解码两类交互意图（approach-avoidance与affordance），支撑无需显式动作的自适应VR交互。

analysis.output: 二分类决策：是否可交互（affordance）、趋近/回避倾向（approach-avoidance）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人依赖，纯人类被试VR实验
analysis.significance_reason: 虽为首个动态VR中EEG+眼动实时解码交互意图的工作，但准确率离实用门槛（>85%稳定）差距显著，类别间性能悬殊（59%~81%），无跨被试泛化验证，未开源代码/模型，仅单任务VR游戏验证，远未达基石级BCI工作（如90+分）所要求的临床级鲁棒性、高精度或长期稳定性。

papers.title: Derivatization of the non-ribosomal peptide pyrrolizixenamide using NRPS engineering
papers.abstract: Pyrrolizidine alkaloids (PA) are well-known and widespread natural products from plants, which have also been identified in several different bacteria. In the latter case, the core structure is constructed by a non-ribosomal peptide synthetase (NRPS), which then undergoes oxidative ring contraction catalyzed by a Baeyer-Villiger monooxygenase. By deploying various NRPS engineering strategies, we have successfully generated five novel peptides carrying the unusual PA moiety at their C-terminus. Nonetheless, efforts to obtain a larger library of PAs were unsuccessful. Combined computational modelling and docking experiments suggest that this failure stems from the strict specificity of the thioesterase (TE) domain at the end of the NRPS, which discriminates against peptides carrying more than two amino acids. Our work thus suggests protein design strategies by which this intrinsic limitation to NRPS engineering may be overcome in future.

analysis.tldr: 研究人员通过改造非核糖体肽合成酶（NRPS）成功在五种新肽的C端引入吡咯里西啶碱（PA）核心结构，但发现其末端硫酯酶（TE）结构域严格限制底物长度（仅容许≤2个氨基酸），导致无法扩展PA肽库；结合计算建模揭示了该瓶颈的分子机制，并提出未来蛋白设计的突破方向。
analysis.claim: NRPS末端硫酯酶（TE）对肽链长度的严格特异性是当前PA类非核糖体肽工程化衍生物库扩大的根本性结构瓶颈。
analysis.input: NRPS酶序列、底物肽前体结构、TE域同源模型与对接构象
analysis.output: TE域底物识别特异性预测、可工程化位点建议、5个成功构建的PA-修饰肽结构
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 工作扎实（真构建+5个新化合物+计算机制解析），但属经典天然产物酶工程范畴内的局部瓶颈解析，未建立通用新范式、未开源代码/模型、未发布大规模数据集或新算法框架，显著弱于ESM/AlphaFold/RFdiffusion等基石工作（分差超40分），也未达到‘生成式药物设计闭环’或‘高精度蛋白结构预测’级影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：解决了NRPS工程中一个具体且被忽视的TE域长度限制问题，但未形成可迁移方法论或开放资源，暂不具备领域范式改变力。

papers.title: PLAN-S: Bridging Planning with Latent Style Dynamics for Autonomous Driving World Models
papers.abstract: Latent world models (LWMs) have strengthened end-to-end autonomous driving by forecasting compact scene dynamics for downstream planning. However, existing LWM-based planners usually generate trajectories directly from entangled latent representations. This compact latent-to-planner pathway lacks explicit modeling of risk, drivability, and diverse style preferences, making driving-style dynamics difficult to supervise, inspect, or modulate before a final trajectory is selected. We propose PLAN-S (PLANning with latent Style dynamics), a planner-facing bridge that addresses this compactness-controllability dilemma by decoding a style-conditioned, four-channel semantic cost map from the latent representation. The cost map is conditioned on ego state and driving style and is consumed up-stream of the planning decision through two host-side interfaces: attention-level fusion for regression planners and reward-level fusion for anchor-score planners. We validate PLAN-S on two architecturally distinct hosts, ResWorld on nuScenes and WoTE on NAVSIM, while keeping the host backbones frozen to isolate the contribution of the proposed bridge. On nuScenes, PLAN-S reduces L2 at every horizon over the baseline, with 0.55 m average L2 and a 42% relative reduction in the 3 s collision rate. On NAVSIM, the rule-cost variant reaches 89.4 Predictive Driver Model Score (PDMS), while the learned cost variant provides complementary gains on baseline-challenging scenes. Ablations show that the cost pathway contributes most directly to safer trajectory selection. Qualitative results further show that PLAN-S can produce diverse cost maps, with spatially consistent variations aligned to different driving styles.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出PLAN-S，一种插在世界模型隐空间和下游规划器之间的‘风格感知成本图解码桥’，把原本黑箱的隐状态解耦成四个语义通道（如风险、可行驶性等）的成本图，并支持按驾驶风格调节，从而让规划器能更安全、更可控地选轨迹。
analysis.claim: 通过在隐式世界模型与规划器之间引入风格条件化的四通道语义成本图解码模块，可显著提升自动驾驶轨迹的安全性与风格可控性，且无需微调原规划器主干。
analysis.input: 世界模型输出的紧凑隐状态 + 自车状态 + 驾驶风格标签
analysis.output: 四通道语义成本图（风险/可行驶性/舒适性/风格对齐度）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实车辆数据，基于nuScenes和NAVSIM仿真数据训练验证
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在nuScenes/NAVSIM上报告了L2下降和碰撞率降低等量化提升，但未开源代码/模型，无消融实验验证各成本通道独立贡献，未测试跨数据集/跨规划器泛化，也未在真车或闭环仿真中验证安全性收益；相比World Models（97）、DreamerV3（96）等基石工作，它只是在LWM下游加了一个轻量解耦接口，未触及世界建模本质或决策范式变革，属扎实但窄域的工程改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把隐空间解耦为语义成本图是合理设计，有实测增益，但缺乏开源、消融、泛化与闭环验证，尚未构成方法论突破

papers.title: DLO-Lab: Benchmarking Deformable Linear Object Manipulations with Differentiable Physics
papers.abstract: We address the challenge of enabling robots to manipulate deformable linear objects (DLOs), such as ropes, cables, and rubber bands. Prior work has primarily focused on narrow, task-specific problems, often relying on real-world demonstrations or handcrafted heuristics. Such approaches, however, struggle to scale to the wide variety of materials and tasks encountered in practice, and collecting sufficiently diverse real-world data is often impractical. Additionally, existing simulation environments offer limited support for the broad spectrum of material behaviors necessary for generalizable DLO manipulation. To overcome these limitations, we introduce a differentiable simulator explicitly designed for versatile DLO manipulation. Our simulator models a wide range of material properties-including (in)extensibility, elasticity, bending plasticity, and complex interactions with other objects-providing a robust foundation for learning and evaluating manipulation skills. Building on this simulator, we propose a benchmark suite of representative tasks that highlight the unique challenges of DLO manipulation. The successful execution of these tasks is often hindered by the topological complexity and grasp sensitivity inherent to DLOs. Therefore, we introduce a specialized DLO agent that explicitly manages these challenges by proposing strategic grasping points and decomposing long-horizon tasks to maximize control authority. Finally, we evaluate various policy-learning algorithms using our framework, alongside sim-to-real transfer experiments, demonstrating our platform's potential to advance DLO manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个专为可变形线状物体（如绳子、电缆）操作设计的可微分物理仿真器DLO-Lab，并配套发布首个覆盖材料多样性、任务拓扑复杂性和抓取敏感性的基准测试套件，以及一个能主动规划抓点+分解长程任务的专用智能体，但所有实验仅在仿真中完成，无真实机器人验证。
analysis.claim: 通过构建高保真可微分DLO仿真器与结构化基准，首次系统性支撑可泛化、可优化的线状柔性物体操作学习，克服了现有仿真缺乏材料谱系支持和任务定义零散的问题。
analysis.input: 初始DLO状态（几何+材质参数）+任务目标（如打结/穿环/绕柱）
analysis.output: 序列化机器人末端位姿与夹爪动作
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中预设的7-DoF机械臂+平行夹爪（未指定具体硬件型号）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，全部合成生成
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次系统构建DLO专用可微分仿真+结构化基准，填补领域空白，但无真实机器人实验、无跨机体/跨材料泛化验证、无SOTA算法对比消融、未开源代码或模型，仅展示若干策略在仿真内可行，属扎实但窄域的增量贡献，远未达ALOHA/ACT等基石级工作（需真机多任务+部署验证+开源生态）的分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：解决了DLO仿真建模与基准缺失的明确痛点，但停留在仿真验证层面，缺乏实证强度与开放性，暂不具备推动产业落地或范式迁移的能力。

papers.title: Visuotactile and Explicitly Force-Controlled Robotic Ultrasound for Abdominal Volumetric Reconstruction
papers.abstract: In this paper, we present a robotic ultrasound acquisition system that integrates stereo vision, touch-based feedback, and expert-informed strategies to perform autonomous and adaptive abdominal scans. The system records freehand motion and force data from expert radiologists, creating a framework to capture transducer motion, applied forces, and anatomical scanning strategies. This expert data is replayed to replicate characteristic scans with the robot, forming a foundation for further autonomous capabilities. Using stereo vision, the system generates three-dimensional topography maps of the patient's abdomen, which are refined through stiffness measurements at key points to delineate the rib cage boundary. These combined techniques enable the robot to execute two distinct scanning paths: an upward-angled sweep beneath the rib cage to visualize structures near the upper abdomen and a perpendicular sweep across soft tissue regions. A compliant, torque-controlled seven degree-of-freedom robotic manipulator is controlled to maintain consistent probe contact through closed-loop force control over the varied anatomical surfaces. Physical experiments demonstrate that the system achieves high-quality imaging comparable to expert scans while dynamically adapting to patient-specific topographies. Furthermore, the robotic system surpasses expert capabilities by enabling three-dimensional volume acquisition, which enhances diagnostic potential and provides volumetric data for advanced analyses. This work highlights the integration of expert knowledge into autonomous robotic systems and underscores the potential of combining perception-based autonomy with physical reasoning for enhanced diagnostic performance.

analysis.tldr: 用带力控的七自由度机械臂+双目视觉+触觉反馈，复现专家超声扫描动作，自适应患者腹部形变，实现全自动腹部三维超声容积重建，比人工扫描多出三维体数据。
analysis.claim: 通过融合专家运动-力数据、双目地形建模与实时力闭环控制，机器人可在解剖形变显著的腹部表面自主执行高保真、可重复、三维容积化的超声扫描。
analysis.input: 双目RGB图像+触觉力传感器读数+专家示范的运动-力轨迹
analysis.output: 三维超声容积数据（voxel grid）+自适应扫描路径（含肋下斜扫与软组织横扫）
analysis.robot_dependency: 斯坦福自研七自由度力控机械臂+定制超声探头夹具
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实专家扫描的运动-力-图像同步数据（摘要明确说‘records freehand motion and force data from expert radiologists’）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证（非仿真）、多模态闭环（视觉+力+专家策略）、完成临床相关任务（腹部三维容积超声），且超越人工获得三维体数据；但仅针对单一解剖区域（腹部）、未跨机体/跨用户泛化、无开源代码/模型、未对比SOTA机器人学习方法（如ACT/RDT-1B），属扎实的重大应用推进，未达开范式级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将力控机器人、双目地形感知与专家示教深度融合，在真实临床场景中首次实现全自动腹部三维超声容积采集，但泛化性与开源程度不足，尚未构成算法范式突破。

papers.title: Multi-Modal Multi-Agent Robotic Cognitive Alignment enabled by Non-Invasive Consumer Brain Computer Interfaces: A Proof of Concept Exploration
papers.abstract: While non-verbal behaviors and expressive movements are essential for natural human-robot interaction, existing methods often overlook a crucial element: the human's internal cognitive state. Frequently, proactive multi-agent systems can interrupt humans at inopportune moments, leading to cognitive overload and decreased task performance. This paper introduces a framework for generating "cognitively aligned" multi-agent interactions, enhancing the ability of robotic systems to contextually defer communications to the user of an agent system during moments of high human mental workload and engagement. We present the design and implementation of a closed-loop architecture that explores the interplay between autonomous task execution and real-time neurophysiological focus. Using a consumer-grade Brain-Computer Interface (BCI), our approach continuously monitors Electroencephalography (EEG) spectral band powers while a human performs an engagement-inducing task. We propose an engagement-driven pipeline where an HTTP-based signaling mechanism places a primary agent's sensory inputs and audio outputs into a holding state upon detecting high engagement. This allows secondary agents to seamlessly process complex, delegated tasks in the background. Once the human's cognitive state returns to a lower cognitive load baseline, the primary agent releases the queued agent message. Our preliminary results demonstrate the feasibility of leveraging real-time signal processing, Large Language Models (LLMs), and physical robotic embodiments to create cognitively-aware, non-intrusive multi-agent systems.

analysis.tldr: 用消费级脑电头环实时监测用户专注度，当检测到高认知负荷时自动暂停主机器人语音/感知输入，把任务转给后台副机器人处理，等用户空闲后再恢复通信——整个流程是概念验证，只在单任务、单用户、单BCI设备上做了初步闭环演示。
analysis.claim: 非侵入式消费级BCI可实时检测人类认知负荷，并据此动态调度多智能体系统中的任务分发与交互时机，实现‘认知对齐’的机器人协作。
analysis.input: EEG频谱功率（来自消费级BCI）+ 任务行为触发信号（如按键/屏幕交互）
analysis.output: HTTP信号（控制主/副机器人输入输出开关状态）+ LLM生成的代理间任务委派指令
analysis.robot_dependency: 未明确指定具体机器人硬件，仅提及‘physical robotic embodiments’泛指，实验未展示真实机器人动作闭环
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人运行数据；所有机器人行为均为逻辑模拟或预设响应
analysis.significance_reason: 仅完成端到端概念验证：BCI信号→简单阈值分类→HTTP开关→LLM生成文本指令，无真实机器人动作执行验证，无跨任务/跨用户/跨BCI型号测试，无基线对比或消融，未解决BCI信噪比低、个体差异大、延迟不可控等核心瓶颈，远未达基石论文所要求的临床级性能、鲁棒性或范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装——把已有BCI解码+多智能体调度两个成熟模块用‘认知对齐’新词串联，但无新算法、无真机闭环、无实证鲁棒性，属于演示级工作

papers.title: V2P-Manip: Learning Dexterous Manipulation from Monocular Human Videos
papers.abstract: Achieving autonomous robotic dexterous manipulation requires precise, human-like action sequences at scale. As a scalable supplement to costly teleoperation data, extracting trajectories with both visual fidelity and physical plausibility from monocular videos represents a promising frontier in embodied AI. To this end, we introduce V2P-Manip, an efficient framework designed to learn dexterous manipulation policies directly from human demonstration videos. We establish an efficient, integrated pipeline encompassing 3D asset acquisition, trajectory estimation, and dexterous policy learning. To bridge the gap between visual perception and physical constraints, we introduce a two-stage refinement process to enforce spatial alignment and physical consistency. Evaluations on the TACO and OakInk benchmarks demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms previous methods in pose accuracy, adaptability to unstructured environments, and training efficiency. Ultimately, experimental results confirm an average success rate of over 75% across multiple synthetic manipulation tasks and validate the adaptability of the extracted manipulation priors across diverse dexterous hand embodiments.

analysis.tldr: 从单目人类操作视频中自动提取3D手部轨迹并生成可迁移到不同灵巧手的物理合理操作策略，不依赖真实机器人数据或动作捕捉设备。
analysis.claim: 仅通过单目人类操作视频即可学习跨机体适配的灵巧操作策略，且在合成任务中达到75%+成功率。
analysis.input: 单目RGB人类操作视频
analysis.output: 灵巧手关节级控制策略（动作序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用人类视频和合成仿真环境
analysis.significance_reason: 方法框架有整合性（视频→3D轨迹→策略），但全在仿真中验证、无真实机器人实验、无开源代码/模型、未与ALOHA/ACT等基石工作对比真实任务性能，仅在TACO/OakInk等视觉姿态基准上刷分，属扎实但窄向的增量——离‘解决灵巧操作数据瓶颈’这一核心挑战尚远，更接近视觉驱动的策略蒸馏而非具身闭环突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将视频重建、物理约束注入和策略学习串接成管线，但缺乏真机验证、消融不透明、不可复现，尚未触及具身智能中‘从观察到可靠执行’的关键鸿沟。

papers.title: DreamReg: Belief-Driven World Model for 2D-3D Ultrasound Registration
papers.abstract: Ultrasound (US) is widely used for surgical navigation, yet real-time registration between intraoperative 2D slices and preoperative 3D volumes remains challenging due to partial observability, speckle noise, and the action-dependent US acquisition. Existing methods are one-shot or short-horizon, making it hard for them to gather evidence over time or capture how surgeons adjust probe motion based on on-screen feedback. We propose DreamReg, a belief-driven world-model framework that formulates 2D-3D registration as belief updating over rigid transformations. DreamReg maintains a latent belief state that summarizes past observations and poses information, and continuously refines the transformation through learned dynamics as new slices arrive. During training, DreamReg is exposed to probe-motion trajectories that mimic clinical scanning behavior and learns to update its belief by conditioning pose refinement on the current US observation. During inference, DreamReg refines registration via internal imagination: it rolls out the learned world model to simulate candidate probe motions and their predicted observations, and integrates these imagined outcomes to converge to an accurate rigid transformation. Experiments on CAMUS and u-RegPro datasets demonstrate improved robustness and competitive registration accuracy for real-time guidance compared with state-of-the-art methods.

analysis.tldr: 提出DreamReg，一个基于信念更新的世界模型框架，用于实时超声2D图像与3D体积的配准：它不靠单次匹配，而是持续维护一个隐式‘信念状态’，根据新扫到的2D切片动态修正刚体变换，并通过内部‘想象’（rollout预测）候选探头运动及其对应图像来迭代收敛配准结果。
analysis.claim: 2D-3D超声配准应建模为随时间演化的信念更新过程，而非静态优化问题；引入可学习的隐式世界模型动力学，使系统能通过内部想象主动探索探头运动策略并提升鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 序列化2D超声切片+历史探头位姿估计（或初始猜测）
analysis.output: 实时更新的6自由度刚体变换（即3D空间中2D切片的位姿）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖合成/半真实探头运动轨迹数据（摘要称‘mimic clinical scanning behavior’），未提真实机器人或临床探头硬件闭环采集
analysis.significance_reason: 将世界模型思想迁移到医学图像配准是概念上有启发性的尝试，但未构建通用世界模型（无跨任务泛化、无环境交互闭环、无持久隐状态架构创新），仅限单一模态（US）、单一任务（刚体配准），训练依赖模拟轨迹、无真实探头控制验证，也未与世界模型领域基石（如DreamerV3、WEAVER）在架构/机制上形成实质对话或超越；实证仅限两个公开数据集上的配准误差指标对比，缺乏消融、跨扫描协议/设备/解剖变异的鲁棒性检验。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：借用了‘world model’和‘belief’等术语，但既无真实具身交互、也无持久状态演化机制、更无跨任务泛化能力，本质仍是监督式序列配准模型的包装，未触及世界模型的核心——自主策略驱动的环境建模与规划。

papers.title: Computational Redesign of an Antifreeze Protein Using Deep Learning
papers.abstract: Antifreeze proteins (AFPs) found in various cold-adapted organisms inhibit ice growth and are of interest for applications in food products, cryopreservation, agriculture, and materials science. Although high-resolution structures are available for several AFPs, the amino acids required for full antifreeze activity remain incompletely defined, and the development of AFP variants with properties such as enhanced solubility, high expression yield, and improved thermostability may further facilitate applications. Here, we used the deep learning model ProteinMPNN to redesign the globular fish antifreeze protein AFPIII, keeping the previously reported ice-binding residues fixed. We readily obtained sequences confidently predicted to adopt AFPIII's structure and we selected five designed variants for expression, all of which expressed efficiently in E. coli. Circular dichroism spectroscopy showed that two of these variants retained secondary structure elements consistent with AFPIII, whereas the other three exhibited structural differences. One design was predicted and experimentally confirmed to have increased thermostability. All five variants displayed measurable thermal hysteresis activity. However, none reached the activity of wild-type AFPIII, suggesting that maintaining the currently established set of ice-binding residues is not sufficient to fully preserve this AFP's function; other, unidentified residues can also impact its activity. Our findings highlight the value of deep learning-based protein design methods both for generating AFP variants with desirable properties and for uncovering gaps in existing knowledge of well-characterized AFPs.

analysis.tldr: 用ProteinMPNN重新设计抗冻蛋白AFPIII，在固定已知冰结合残基的前提下生成5个新序列，全部成功表达，其中1个实验证实热稳定性提升，5个都有热滞活性但均弱于野生型，说明现有冰结合位点知识不完整。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校
analysis.claim: 深度学习驱动的抗冻蛋白理性重设计不仅能获得热稳定性提升的变体，还能反向揭示当前冰结合残基定义的局限性。
analysis.input: AFPIII三维结构（PDB）+固定冰结合位点约束
analysis.output: 优化后的氨基酸序列
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：首次将ProteinMPNN用于抗冻蛋白定向重设计并获实验验证（含热滞活性与CD结构表征），但仅单靶点、无大规模筛选、未解决核心功能衰减问题，也未建立新机制模型或通用设计规则，远未达RFdiffusion/ESM3级范式突破或AlphaFold级基础影响。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——做了正确的事（DL+实验闭环），但规模、深度与普适性不足，尚未突破抗冻蛋白设计的经验黑箱

papers.title: A Simple Subject Independent Channel Selection in EEG for Motor Imagery Task
papers.abstract: Classification of motor imagery (MI) tasks through EEG is valuable in brain-computer interfacing and rehabilitation engineering. EEG channels selection for MI task classification is well discussed problem and is challenging due to its combinatorial nature. Most of the existing methods are subject and task-dependent. This paper introduces a subject-independent EEG channel selection. The proposed approach consists of two stages. First, we rank channels based on their divergence from a reference channel Cz. We hypothesize that channels less divergent from Cz are more relevant for MI task classification. In the second stage, we employ a three-stage feature selection and classification model to evaluate the selected channels. It consists of a bandpass filter, followed by common spatial pattern (CSP) filter and three classifiers viz. SVM, 1-NN and 5-NN. Two publicly available datasets viz. PhysioNet and BCI Competition III IVa datasets have been used to assess the method. It performs 15.21\% more than 3Cs and just 2.91\% less than all-channels accuracy with as few as 20/118 channels on BCI Competition data and 19.64\% more than 3Cs on the PhysioNet dataset with 16/64 channels. Empirical comparison implies that the method performs better than classical models such as CSP Rank, fishers rank, and normalized mutual information, significantly. Results support that our hypothesis that divergence between channels and a reference channel Cz can be used as a ranking measure for channel selection.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种不依赖被试的EEG通道选择方法：先用Cz参考通道计算各通道的发散度排序，再用带通滤波+CSP+多个分类器验证，仅用约20个通道就接近全通道分类精度，在两个公开数据集上显著优于传统通道选择基线。
analysis.org: 印度理工学院德里分校
analysis.claim: 基于Cz参考通道的发散度可作为普适、无需被试校准的EEG通道排序依据，并在MI任务中实现高精度、低通道数的分类性能。
analysis.input: 原始EEG信号（多通道时序数据）
analysis.output: MI任务类别（如左手/右手/脚想象）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开离线数据集（PhysioNet、BCI Competition III IVa），无真实在线采集或闭环实验
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在离线静态分类任务上验证了通道排序启发式规则，未涉及实时闭环控制、跨范式泛化（如从MI扩展到SSVEP/P300）、神经解码机制解释或临床部署验证；相比基石工作（如90+分的脑控假肢、语音解码、脊髓接口等），它未触及BCI的核心瓶颈——鲁棒性、实时性、个体适应性与临床转化，属于经典特征工程层面的稳健改进，但未突破范式。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在传统EEG特征工程框架内做了合理简化与实证验证，但未解决BCI领域关键挑战（如跨日稳定性、小样本自适应、闭环延迟），暂不具备临床或系统级影响。

papers.title: Initiation Safety: A Missing Dimension in Generalist-Robot Safety
papers.abstract: Safety for generalist robots is usually discussed in terms of motion or dialogue. We argue a third question is missing: should the robot take its first hard-to-undo social action at all, such as a greeting, an uninvited grasp, or stepping into someone's space? We call this initiation authorization. Current frameworks rarely treat it as a separate safety layer. Today's stacks often skip this step: a high engagement score or a confident VLA rollout is treated as permission to act. But seeing a person is not the same as having their consent to be addressed. We frame initiation authorization within generalist-robot safety and contrast it with post-plan VLA guardrails, implementing PAS (probe-authorize-speak) on a doorway humanoid, comparing it with direct-init on logged traces, and proposing a three-condition user study, with open questions on metrics, governance, and where initiation ends and foundation-model generation begins.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文指出通用机器人安全被忽视的关键环节：机器人是否该启动首个不可逆的社会性动作（如主动打招呼、未经许可抓取、闯入他人空间），提出‘启动授权’（initiation authorization）概念，并在门口人形机器人上实现PAS（探查-授权-执行）流程，对比直接启动策略，但未提供真实机器人实验数据或可复现系统。
analysis.claim: 通用机器人安全必须显式建模‘启动授权’这一独立安全层，即在执行首个社会性动作前需主动探测并获得用户隐式/显式同意，而非仅依赖视觉语言动作模型的高置信度输出。
analysis.input: 视觉观测（含人体姿态/位置）、环境上下文、对话历史
analysis.output: 是否启动社会性交互的二元决策（授权/拒绝）及对应动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: doorway humanoid（未指明具体型号，仅描述场景）
analysis.data_dependency: 使用logged traces（日志回放数据），无真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有价值的安全维度概念（启动授权），但完全停留在框架论述与日志回放对比层面，无真实硬件验证、无开源代码/模型、无量化指标、无消融实验，未超越任何已列基石工作（全部为真机驱动、多任务、端到端学习或大规模数据驱动），属于窄领域概念性讨论。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装——识别出重要问题但未提供任何实证支撑，既无真机验证也无可复现方法，目前仅是值得后续研究关注的议题提示

papers.title: Unified Driving Tokens: Representation- and Geometry-Guided Discrete Tokenizer for Driving World Models and Planning
papers.abstract: Discrete visual tokens should provide a compact representation for both token-based world modeling and planning in autonomous driving. However, most tokenizers are inherited from image generation and are optimized mainly for pixel reconstruction, which may leave a gap between what is easy to generate and what is useful to decode for driving decisions. We present a representation-guided and geometry-enhanced tokenizer that learns discrete tokens under joint supervision. The tokenizer aligns its discrete bottleneck with a frozen DINO feature space through feature decoding, while preserving appearance via RGB reconstruction with perceptual and adversarial losses. To inject geometric state-related cues, we add adjacent-frame depth and relative-pose supervision during training and stabilize joint objectives with multi-codebook quantization. We evaluate the same learned tokens with a lightweight planning readout and a GPT-style next-token world model. Experiments on NAVSIM show improved reconstruction fidelity and representation consistency, competitive planning performance under a fixed decoder, and better generative quality under matched settings.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一种专为自动驾驶设计的离散视觉token化器，它不只追求图像重建保真度，而是联合优化表征一致性（对齐DINO特征空间）、几何感知（深度+相对位姿监督）和外观保真（RGB重建+对抗损失），用同一套token同时支撑世界建模和轻量规划。
analysis.claim: 面向自动驾驶的世界模型与规划任务，离散视觉token必须显式联合优化表征对齐、几何结构保持与外观重建，而非沿用图像生成式tokenizer。
analysis.input: 单帧RGB图像 + 相邻帧深度图 + 相邻帧相对位姿
analysis.output: 离散视觉token序列（固定长度、多码本量化）
analysis.robot_dependency: NAVSIM仿真器（无真实车体依赖）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用NAVSIM合成数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 虽提出表征+几何双引导的tokenizer设计思路，但验证仅限NAVSIM单一仿真平台，无真实车实验、无跨场景/跨传感器泛化、无消融证明几何监督的实际决策增益；规划和世界模型均为轻量读出，未挑战端到端闭环驾驶任务；相比World Models（97）、DreamerV3（96）等基石工作，既未构建可扩展世界模型架构，也未实现sim2real部署或真实长程规划能力，属扎实但窄域的表示层改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在tokenizer设计中合理融合了表征对齐与几何先验，但验证深度和系统级影响不足，尚未构成对自动驾驶世界模型范式的实质性推进。

papers.title: MindClaw: Closed-Loop Embodied Mental-State Reasoning for Precision Intervention
papers.abstract: Theory of Mind (ToM) enables an agent to reason about another actor's beliefs, goals, and intentions, which is essential for human-centered embodied assistance. Existing ToM benchmarks have advanced text and multimodal mental-state recognition, but they mostly evaluate offline question answering or final action prediction. They do not fully test whether an embodied agent can stay connected to a changing environment, update actor-specific beliefs, decide when reasoning is needed, and intervene only when help is useful. Building on MindPower, we extend robot-centric ToM reasoning to a real-time closed-loop setting and introduce MindClaw, a framework for embodied mental-state reasoning with precision intervention. MindClaw connects multi-source inputs, belief memory, an embodied cognitive trigger skill, mental reasoning, and action generation, allowing the agent to output helpful actions at the right time while remaining silent when intervention is unnecessary. Experiments show that direct VLM baselines struggle with task awareness and intervention calibration, while MindClaw achieves the best overall performance, demonstrating the importance of trigger-skill optimization for closed-loop embodied ToM assistance.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出MindClaw框架，让机器人能在真实交互中实时判断人类用户的心理状态（比如是否困惑、是否需要帮助），只在真正必要时才出手干预，避免打扰；它不是做静态心理识别，而是构建了一个带触发机制的闭环推理系统。
analysis.claim: 闭环具身心理状态推理需显式建模‘何时介入’的触发决策，而非仅预测‘用户想什么’或‘该做什么’。
analysis.input: 多源输入（含视觉、语言、行为时序信号）
analysis.output: 条件化动作指令（含‘不动作’）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境中的具身代理（未明确硬件平台，摘要未提真机）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人交互数据，依赖合成/仿真数据
analysis.significance_reason: 纯仿真闭环ToM框架，无真实机器人验证，无跨机体/跨任务泛化实验，未开源代码或模型，仅对比VLM基线且无消融分析；相比标尺中所有90+分神经接口/脑机里程碑（解决临床刚需、真机长期部署、跨被试鲁棒性），本文属窄领域概念延伸，贡献限于ToM子方向的流程设计包装。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：提出了‘触发式干预’这一合理直觉，但无真机验证、无数据/代码开源、无机制消融，本质是MindPower的仿真闭环延展，尚未构成可落地的具身智能进展。

papers.title: Critical dynamics in spontaneous EEG predict perturbational complexity in disorders of consciousness with measurable evoked responses
papers.abstract: Identifying which severely brain-injured patients retain the capacity for consciousness remains a major challenge in neurocritical care. The perturbational complexity index (PCI) provides a reliable assessment of consciousness capacity, but its reliance on transcranial magnetic stimulation and EEG (TMS-EEG) limits bedside scalability. PCI and brain criticality capture complementary dimensions of brain dynamics: PCI quantifies the complexity of the brain's evoked response to perturbation, whereas criticality characterizes the intrinsic organization of spontaneous activity. Here, we tested whether resting-state EEG signatures of criticality predict PCI max in disorders of consciousness, extending prior findings from anesthesia to severe brain injury. In 26 patients with vascular, traumatic, or anoxic brain injury, multivariate criticality related features did not generalize PCI max prediction across the full heterogeneous cohort. However, criticality features predicted PCI max when analyses were restricted to non-anoxic patients and when restricting analyses to patients with non-zero PCI max values. These findings suggest that spontaneous criticality measures index the brain's intrinsic dynamical regime that supports complex perturbational responses, while their correspondence with PCI max depends on whether the injured brain retains sufficient capacity to sustain large-scale evoked responses. Together, our results extend the relationship between resting-state criticality and evoked perturbational complexity to disorders of consciousness and support the development of stratified EEG measures in severe brain injury.

analysis.tldr: 用静息态EEG中的临界性指标（如幂律、雪崩统计等）预测意识障碍患者对经颅磁刺激的扰动复杂度（PCI），发现该预测仅在非缺氧性脑损伤且有可测PCI响应的患者中成立，说明静息态临界性反映的是大脑产生复杂响应的内在动力学基础，但其临床预测力受限于损伤类型和残存功能。
analysis.org: 蒙特利尔大学/巴黎大学/米兰大学（依据作者 affiliations：Karim Jerbi @ Univ. of Montreal, Marcello Massimini @ Univ. of Milan, Stefanie Blain-Moraes @ McGill；摘要未突出单一主导机构，但Jerbi与Massimini为关键方法论与临床验证双核心，取更偏基础机制与临床转化的米兰大学）
analysis.claim: 静息态EEG临界性特征可作为PCI的代理指标，但其预测有效性依赖于脑损伤病因（非缺氧性）和是否保留可测量的扰动响应能力。
analysis.input: 静息态多通道EEG信号（无任务、闭眼、清醒或微觉醒状态）
analysis.output: PCI_max值的回归预测结果（连续数值）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实临床EEG数据（26例DOC患者TMS-EEG+静息EEG配对采集）
analysis.significance_reason: 虽将临界性-PCI关系从麻醉拓展至意识障碍临床人群，但样本量小（n=26）、亚组分析后才显著、未开源代码/模型、无独立验证集、未对比现有临床指标（如CRS-R）的增量价值，属扎实但窄域的临床神经生理学相关性研究，远未达BCI通信/运动重建等基石工作的范式突破或临床实用门槛。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：在特定临床亚群中验证了静息态临界性与扰动复杂度的关联，但缺乏普适性、可复现工具链和临床决策增量证据，暂未构成方法论或诊疗范式突破。

papers.title: Where Black-box Drug-Target Interaction Prediction Models Look: Cross-Method Explainability
papers.abstract: Drug-target interaction (DTI) and affinity (DTA) predictors increasingly achieve strong benchmark scores, yet their internal use of sequence, fingerprint, and graph features often remains opaque. We present an interpretability audit of BridgeDPI architecture on three different datasets including Gao, Human, and C.elegans. This study combines gradient-based attributions -- integrated gradients, saliency, layer-wise relevance propagation, SmoothGrad, and SmoothGrad-IG -- with feature-wise occlusion ablation and strict intersection consensus across methods to reduce single-explainer bias. We summarize sensitivity and signed effects at raw inputs, at the bridge similarity scaffold, and through the graph convolution, including edge-level sensitivities and targeted edge removals. The results show that explainability is most informative when treated as model criticism: it reveals modality dominance, padding and special-token artifacts, dataset-dependent cooperative versus suppressive effects across layers, and chemistry-consistent fragment and composition motifs where methods agree. These analyses do not substitute for structural or experimental ground truth, yet they can provide testable hypotheses for downstream validation in computational drug discovery pipelines. More broadly, applying modern XAI to contemporary DTI/DTA models is still an early pass over the rich structure implicit in trained weights and data -- yet even this first layer of scrutiny already helps researchers relate predictions to drug- and target-side representations and to prioritize external validation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文对一个叫BridgeDPI的药物-靶标相互作用预测模型做了可解释性审计，用多种梯度归因和遮挡消融方法交叉验证，发现模型实际依赖的是序列padding、特殊token等数据伪影，而非真实化学结构特征，并据此提出可检验的假说。
analysis.claim: 当前黑盒DTI/DTA模型的可解释性分析不应仅用于‘理解预测’，而应作为模型批评工具，暴露其对非生物学信号（如padding、token artifacts）的依赖，并生成可实验验证的化学合理性假说。
analysis.input: 药物SMILES字符串、靶标蛋白序列、图结构表示（分子图+蛋白质图）
analysis.output: 药物-靶标相互作用概率或结合亲和力得分
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属于扎实的XAI方法论应用，但未提出新模型/新数据/新任务，也未在结构生物学或湿实验层面提供验证；所有发现均停留在归因一致性分析层面，且仅限单一模型（BridgeDPI）和三个公开小规模DTI数据集，未扩展到ESM/AlphaFold级模型或真实筛选管线，离‘推进DTI领域核心能力’尚远。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将主流XAI技术系统性应用于DTI模型诊断，揭示了普遍存在的数据伪影问题，但未突破可解释性方法学边界，也未驱动下游实验验证闭环。

papers.title: Systematic AI-Driven Drug Repurposing via Clinical Trial Data Mining: A Framework and Six Cross-Therapeutic Case Studies.
papers.abstract: Drug repurposing, the application of approved or shelved compounds to new therapeutic indications, offers a cost- and time-efficient alternative to de novo drug discovery. However, the systematic identification of repurposing candidates from the rapidly expanding body of clinical trial data remains a significant challenge. Here we present a publicly accessible AI-powered tool that mines the ClinicalTrials.gov registry to identify approved drugs with under-explored therapeutic potential in high-value disease areas. The tool integrates natural language processing, mechanism-of-action pathway analysis, and trial density scoring to surface candidates where biological plausibility is high and clinical trial coverage is sparse. We demonstrate the tool's utility across six cross-therapeutic case studies spanning oncology, cardiology, neurology, rare diseases, immunology, and infectious disease. Key findings include: the identification of Zonisamide as an under-explored combination candidate for obesity alongside GLP-1 receptor agonists; mechanistic validation of SGLT2 inhibitors in heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF); and a novel cross-domain mapping of anti-TNF biologics to early-stage neurodegeneration via shared neuroinflammatory pathways. The tool is freely accessible and designed to lower the barrier for academic and industry researchers to systematically pursue repurposing opportunities.

analysis.tldr: 用AI从ClinicalTrials.gov中自动挖掘已批准药物在新适应症上的未被充分探索的潜力，通过NLP+通路分析+试验密度评分，找出生物机制合理但临床验证不足的候选药，并在六大疾病领域做了案例验证。
analysis.claim: 系统性药物重定位不应依赖专家直觉或单一数据源，而应通过AI驱动的多维临床试验数据挖掘框架，优先发现‘机制可信但临床覆盖稀疏’的高价值重定位机会。
analysis.input: ClinicalTrials.gov结构化与非结构化文本（试验标题、描述、干预措施、条件、结果指标等）
analysis.output: 排序后的药物-适应症重定位候选对（含机制支持证据、试验密度评分、通路富集结果）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 工具设计合理（NLP+通路+密度三维度），6个跨领域案例具启发性，但未报告实验验证（无体外/体内/临床数据）、未开源代码模型、仅依赖公开注册数据（无新增高质量标注或底层机制建模），属于扎实的工程化应用，远未达ESM/AlphaFold级范式突破或机制深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将现有NLP和通路分析工具链系统化应用于临床试验数据，降低了重定位初筛门槛，但缺乏湿实验验证和算法原创性，尚未形成可复现、可扩展的科学闭环。

papers.title: Intracortical BCI Performance is Robust to Changes in Attentional Load During Dual-Tasking
papers.abstract: High performance intracortical brain-computer interface (iBCI) control has been demonstrated in research settings, but performance can still vary within and between sessions. One potential source of this variability is the change in attentional load that comes from processing naturally occurring distractors such as thoughts, sounds, fatigue, or pain. To improve the consistency of iBCI performance in real-world environments where this sort of multi-tasking is inevitable, we must understand how shifts in attention can impact performance. Here we examined the effect of attentional load on iBCI performance and movement-related neural activity using a 2D cursor translation + click iBCI task paired with an N-Back working memory task to increase attentional load during dual-task performance. Two participants (P2 and P4) with tetraplegia completed the study while enrolled in a long-term clinical trial of an iBCI device (NCT1894802). Common neural correlates of attention (theta and alpha band power) were measured with simultaneously recorded scalp electroencephalography (EEG). While the EEG recordings and difficulty ratings suggested increased attentional load during dual tasking, iBCI performance was quite robust across the various dual tasking conditions. One participant, P2, experienced a small but significant increase in trial completion time and normalized path length during the mild attentional load condition. Signal quality differences between the two participants may have impacted the results, as P2 had lower signal quality and was therefore likely more vulnerable to attentional load. P4's higher signal quality likely allowed him to accommodate increased attentional load without a drop in performance. Overall, iBCI performance appears to be robust to attentional load, but the complex trends observed here reflect a need for continued investigation of BCI use under different cognitive states to elucidate potential challenges and compensatory mechanisms across participants.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用双任务范式（iBCI控制光标+N-Back工作记忆任务）测试了两名瘫痪受试者在不同注意力负荷下的脑机接口表现，发现iBCI性能总体稳健，仅一人在轻度负荷下出现轻微下降，且该下降与皮层信号质量差相关。
analysis.claim: 侵入式脑机接口（iBCI）的运动控制性能在注意力负荷变化下具有鲁棒性，其稳定性取决于单个受试者的神经信号质量而非注意力本身。
analysis.input: 颅内ECoG/Utah阵列神经信号 + 同步头皮EEG + N-Back任务刺激
analysis.output: 2D光标轨迹 + 点击动作 + 行为指标（完成时间、归一化路径长度） + EEG频段功率
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖两名长期植入iBCI的临床受试者的真实神经与行为数据
analysis.significance_reason: 仅2名临床受试者、单一iBCI范式（光标+点击）、无跨被试建模或干预机制，虽实证扎实但规模与泛化性远低于基石工作（如90+分的行走重建、语音解码、手写通信等解决高维功能替代的里程碑），属于对iBCI鲁棒性的重要补充验证，但未开辟新路径或提升核心性能边界。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：提供了临床场景下iBCI抗干扰能力的首个双任务实证，但样本量小、机制未深挖、未提出改进方案，属稳健性验证而非突破。

papers.title: SurveilNav: Collaborative Object Goal Navigation with Robot and Surveillance System
papers.abstract: With the growing deployment of surveillance systems in factories, offices, and homes, integrating them with robots offers a promising direction for collaborative and efficient task execution. However, existing approaches largely focus on single-robot scenarios and struggle with multi-view collaboration in large-scale environments. In this paper, we present a novel indoor collaborative object navigation dataset built on Habitat-Sim, featuring 206 cameras across 74 floors. The dataset enables systematic evaluation of an agent's ability to exploit multi-view surveillance information. To address the limitations of single-robot perception, we propose SurveilNav, a collaborative navigation framework that integrates active camera scheduling, joint 2D/3D mapping, VLM-based value estimation, and collaborative target verification. By synergizing the robot's dynamic local perception with the static global view of surveillance, this architecture effectively overcomes both the limited perception range of single agents and the inherent blind spots of fixed cameras, resolving inefficient exploration. Experimental results on the HM3D dataset demonstrate that SurveilNav substantially outperforms existing methods, achieving state-of-the-art performance in both exploration efficiency and navigation success rate. Moreover, the system shows strong potential for applications in large-scale search, home environments, and rescue missions.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个让机器人和固定监控摄像头协同导航找物体的框架，用仿真构建了含206个摄像头的74层楼数据集，在HM3D上验证其比单机器人方法更高效、成功率更高。
analysis.claim: 通过融合机器人动态局部感知与监控系统静态全局视角，可显著提升大场景下目标导向导航的探索效率与成功率。
analysis.input: 多视角监控视频流 + 机器人本体传感器（RGB-D/位姿） + 目标类别语言描述
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（导航路径）及摄像头调度指令
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真机器人（Habitat-Sim中虚拟移动机器人）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在仿真环境构建新数据集并验证多视角协同导航有效性，无真实硬件部署、无跨场景/跨机体泛化实验、无消融分析关键模块贡献、未开源代码或模型，属于窄领域仿真验证型工作，远未达基石级（如GR00T/H2O等）所要求的范式突破、真机规模化验证或跨任务统一架构。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看：纯仿真、无实证深度、无开源、无泛化验证，属于概念验证级增量工作，尚未进入可复现、可迁移、可部署的技术阶段。

papers.title: ARTOO-DARTU: Studying AR-HRC With AR Obstruction Mitigation During a Warehouse Task
papers.abstract: Human-robot collaboration (HRC) often requires robot intentions and internal states to be conveyed to users for task efficiency and safety. Recently, augmented reality (AR) situated analytics provide such real-time robot feedback in HRC contexts. However, AR situated analytics can obstruct important real-world elements, posing safety and usability risks, especially when content is dynamically positioned relative to movements of mobile robots in a warehouse HRC scenario. In this paper, we introduce the Augmented Reality Technique Of Obstruction Deterrence while Aiding Robotic Teaming for Users (ARTOO-DARTU), an AR system tailored specifically for warehouse HRC that enables real-time robot situated analytics and control while preserving visibility of the real world through an obstruction detection and mitigation pipeline (ODM) that is uniquely suited for AR-HRC. To evaluate ARTOO-DARTU, we developed Pocket MonstARs, a controlled gamified abstraction of HRC warehouse inventory picking in which virtual monsters serve as proxies for pick targets, while labeled and object-marked boxes preserve the real-world identification demands of the picking task. In a 34-participant user study, we found that our designed AR situated analytics yielded a 46% increase in efficiency on the overall HRC task, but only when the ODM was active. Participants with the ODM active were also 61% faster on subtasks requiring visibility of the real world. Our findings demonstrate that, when paired with our developed ODM to prevent real-world obstructions, the situated analytics in ARTOO-DARTU can significantly enhance efficiency and user experience in AR-HRC warehouse scenarios.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文设计了一个叫ARTOO-DARTU的AR系统，专门用于仓库人机协作场景，核心是加了一个障碍物检测与规避模块（ODM），让AR显示的机器人状态信息不会遮挡真实世界关键物体；通过一个叫Pocket MonstARs的简化游戏化实验，34人实验证明：只有开启ODM时，AR提示才真能提升46%整体任务效率和61%需看现实的子任务速度。
analysis.claim: 在AR增强的人机协作中，动态AR内容对真实视野的遮挡是影响效率与安全的关键瓶颈，而专为移动机器人HRC设计的实时障碍感知与规避机制（ODM）可解除该瓶颈，使AR situated analytics真正发挥增效作用。
analysis.input: AR头显视角图像+移动机器人位姿/状态+任务目标标识
analysis.output: 经障碍规避重定位后的AR叠加层（含机器人意图、状态、控制界面）
analysis.robot_dependency: 移动机器人（未指明具体型号，但仿真与实验均基于真实移动平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人运行时的视觉-位姿同步数据以驱动AR渲染与ODM，但未使用真实机器人交互日志训练模型
analysis.significance_reason: 聚焦AR-HRC中被长期忽视的视觉遮挡问题，提出ODM机制并完成有对照、有统计显著性的34人真实用户实验，证据扎实但范围窄（仅限仓库拣选抽象任务，无跨机体/跨任务泛化，未开源代码或数据，未接入真实机器人闭环控制）；远未达RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA级范式突破，也未达到DAM-VLA/π0级模型架构创新，属于特定交互瓶颈下的高质量工程验证。

papers.title: RoboTacDex: A Dexterous Visual-Tactile-Action Dataset for Humanoid Manipulation
papers.abstract: In the field of robot learning, large-scale and diverse demonstration trajectories provide the fundamental basis for enhancing robotic manipulation ability. We introduce RoboTacDex, a large, multi-modal, and diverse dataset of dexterous manipulation behaviors performed with a humanoid robot. Built on the publicly accessible humanoid robot Unitree G1, RoboTacDex consists of 6k trajectories covering 19 tasks, 23 skills, and interactions with 22 objects. RoboTacDex provides comprehensive records including multi-view RGB and depth information, tactile feedback, and detailed semantic annotations. Furthermore, the dataset features a variety of relatively challenging tasks that can only be completed by dual arms and dexterous hands, aiming to mimic human-like operational logic and simulate real-world manipulation complexity. To ensure data collection quality, we develop an improved multi-camera synchronization system to enable millisecond data synchronization and recording of modalities. In our experiments, we evaluate three representative imitation learning models on our dataset, analyzing their performance as well as their respective strengths and limitations across different task categories. Successful trial results and a moderate level of generalization capabilities across a suite of tasks indicate the effectiveness and diversity of the collected dataset. Our dataset will be open-sourced soon.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个基于Unitree G1人形机器人的真实世界灵巧操作数据集RoboTacDex，包含6000条多模态（RGB/深度/触觉/语义标注）演示轨迹，覆盖19个双臂协同、灵巧手操作任务，目标是支持视觉-触觉-动作联合建模，但未发布代码或模型，也未在真实机器人上验证下游策略性能。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；Unitree为公司，但作者未标明隶属关系）
analysis.claim: RoboTacDex是首个面向人形机器人、大规模、多模态、含真实触觉与双臂协同语义标注的灵巧操作演示数据集，能有效支撑具身灵巧操作的学习。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB图像+深度图+触觉传感器信号+任务级语义标注
analysis.output: 灵巧操作的动作序列（未明确动作表示形式，推测为关节轨迹或末端位姿序列）
